spots.addr: Jiangbin 3rd Road, Duanzhou District

spots.name: Nanfeng Kiln
spots.desc: A great place to see ceramics being made, and then to buy them. Founded during Zhengde period of Ming Dynasty (1506-1521). A reminder of Foshan's once great porcelain industry.

spots.name: Leiqiong Global Geopark Zhanjiang District
spots.desc: A UNESCO global geopark spanning Hainan Island and Guangdong’s Leizhou Peninsula. The centerpiece of the park’s Zhanjiang District is a large maar lake known as Huguangyan Lake. The park’s other main district is the Haikou District in Haikou, which contains the Haikou Volcanic Cluster.
spots.addr: Huguang Town, Mazhang District (麻章区湖光镇)

spots.name: Xiuying Battery
spots.desc: A 19th-century coastal fort near Evergreen Park. You can visit the fort and see the replica cannons, underground chambers, and many banyan trees. The new museum in the middle of the fort presents the history of the fort and Chinese coastal defence in general, but unfortunately for those who can't read Chinese, everything in the museum is in Chinese only. A short summary of the history in English…
spots.addr: 5 Shimao Road South, Longhua District (龙华区世贸南路5号)

spots.name: Hainan Provincial Museum
spots.desc: This provincial museum is focused on the history and culture of Hainan Island/Province. The museum is on the east side of the city across the street from the provincial government buildings. The museum is housed in a new, gleaming architectural masterpiece structure. There are exhibits about the people and history of the island.
spots.addr: 68 Guoxing Ave

spots.name: Hainan Provincial Library
spots.desc: Hainan's largest public library. Visitors are required to obtain a library card before being allowed past the reception area.
spots.addr: 36 Guoxing Avenue, Qiongshan District (琼山区国兴大道36号)

spots.name: West Island
spots.desc: A small island near Sanya Bay. As is the case at Wuzhizhou Island, opportunities abound for snorkeling, scuba diving, jet skiing and other water sports. There are also a few attractions on the island itself, including a traditional fishiing village, which has some old houses made from coral and a couple of small museums. Most of the hotels on the island do not accept foreign guests. The only one…
spots.price: Entry fee is ¥95 (including a two-way ferry ticket. The return is an open ticket if you stay on the island.)
spots.addr: Tianya District (天涯区)

spots.name: Jia Yi's Former Residence
spots.desc: This courtyard contains a number of carved slate tablets and is worth a quick visit. It is located off of Taiping Street, a pedestrian street which sells traditional crafts, clothes and refreshments.
spots.addr: 28 Taiping Street, Tianxin District (天心区太平街28号)

spots.name: Tianxin Pavilion
spots.desc: This pavilion is next to the ancient city wall. Cannons that have been used to defend the city are perched in the wall.
spots.price: Entry to the park is free. Entry to the pavilion is ¥32
spots.addr: 17 Tianxin Road, Tianxin District (天心区天心路17号)

spots.name: Autumn-Admiring Pavilion
spots.desc: Founded in the 57th year of the Qianlong reign of the Qing Dynasty (1792), it was founded by Luo Dian, the head of the Yuelu Academy in the Qing Dynasty. Originally named Hongye Pavilion, it was later renamed Aiwan Pavilion by Bi Yuan, the governor of Huguang, according to the poem "Stop and sit in the evening of the maple forest, and the frost leaves are red than the flowers in February".
spots.addr: Yuelu Mountain Qingfeng Gorge Middle, West Bank of Xiangjiang River

spots.name: Hongfu Temple
spots.desc: The temple, built as a monastery in the early Qing Dynasty, is comparable in extent to the Lama Temple in Beijing. Surrounded by woods, the buildings have elaborate ornaments (roof corners and eaves, etc.). There are several large deity figures, a pond with carp, water well for coins for good luck, incense burning pits, a large bell you ring, some shops, and a restaurant there.
spots.addr: Qianlingshan Park, 187 Zaoshan Road, Yunyan District (云岩区枣山路187号黔灵山公园内)

spots.name: Maotai Town
spots.desc: A town famous for the alcoholic beverage named after it. See China#Alcohol.
spots.addr: Renhuai City (仁怀市)

spots.name: Tianfu Square
spots.desc: This square, overlooked by an enormous Chairman Mao statue in the center of the city, has been spruced up. Every evening at dusk, as well as at noontime, an elaborate water show, synchronized to music, bursts out from the square's fountains. Below the square is the hub of Chengdu's subway system. In the subway entrance plaza, a small shopping mall has been built, almost literally under Mao's nose.

spots.name: Sichuan Science and Technology Museum
spots.desc: This huge four-storey museum is filled with interactive exhibits about science, aerodynamics, space, mathematics, robotics and physics. Children will love the interactive displays and indoor playground on the 4th floor. Adults will appreciate the descriptions in both English and Chinese. Everyone will love the crowd-pleasers like the robotic orchestra and walk-through maps of Sichuan's waterways.…
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, closed on Mondays (except during the summer holiday period)
spots.addr: 16 Renmin Middle Road Section One, Qingyang District (青羊区人民中路一段16号)

spots.name: Chengdu Zoo
spots.desc: Offers all the typical animals that one might expect in a zoo (elephant, tigers, giraffes, monkeys, as well as panda bears). While the zoo itself is large and spread out, some of the cages are woefully small and the facility seems understaffed. Might be good for a family to visit. The zoo has vendors selling Chinese snacks as well as some carnival type rides.
spots.addr: 234 Zhaojue Temple Road South, Chenghua District (成华区昭觉寺南路234号)

spots.name: Jindian Park
spots.desc: The park, sprawling for more than 133.3 hectares on the Mingfeng Mountain, is a national forest reserve comprising natural scenery mingled with sites of historical interest and man-made gardens. Some 12% of the surface are lakes or ponds. On the Mingfeng Mountain stands the exquisite and serene Golden Temple, 6.7 meters in height and 7.8 meters in width, and cast of 250 tons of solid bronze. It…
spots.price: The park is free to visit. A trip on the cable car to the World Horti-Expo Garden may be purchased for ¥40
spots.addr: Chuanjin Road, Panlong District (盘龙区穿金路)

spots.name: World Horti-Expo Garden
spots.desc: The garden was constructed for the 1999 Kunming International Horticulture Exposition but is still in use and displays a wide variety of plants. It attracts many locals who can buy annual tickets at a fraction of the cost charged to foreigners, and is a popular site for wedding photographs.
spots.price: The garden is free to enter. A ticket for the cable car to Jindian park may be purchased for ¥40
spots.addr: 10 Shibo Road, Panlong District (盘龙区世博路10号)

spots.name: Fujian Museum
spots.desc: A comprehensive museum about the history and culture of Fujian Province. All major signs and some minor ones are translated to English. The history exhibition gives you a good understanding of five millennia of history in Fujian, including wars, migration, arts and trade. Downstairs, there are further exhibitions on Fujian art (sculptures and porcelain) as well as local opera. There might be…
spots.addr: 96 Hutou Street, Gulou District (鼓楼区湖头街96号)

spots.name: Nine Bend River
spots.desc: Taking a bamboo raft downstream and enjoying the stunning Danxia landforms along the way is a classic experience in Wuyishan.

spots.name: Xifengkou
spots.desc: Xifengkou is a strategic pass along the Great Wall of China and the site of a World War II battle. Besides the wall, visitors can also visit the Great Wall Anti-Japanese War Museum and the Taidao Garden.
spots.price: General admission is free; some attractions in the area may charge a fee
spots.addr: Shitizi Village, Luanyang Town, Qianxi County (迁西县滦阳镇石梯子村)

spots.name: Ruyi Lake
spots.desc: The centrepiece of the Zhengzhou New Area, surrounded by an impressive ring of modern apartments, malls and office towers, including the Henan Arts Centre, and crowned by a JW Marriott designed like a Chinese lantern. The area is lit up in a charmingly tacky fashion at night.
spots.addr: Jinshui District (金水区)

spots.name: Five-Spring Mountain
spots.desc: (五泉山) A jumble of a poor amusement park and some renovated temples.

spots.name: People's Park
spots.desc: A wonderful place for people watching. Busy at all times of day but particularly in the early mornings and evenings, with people making music, singing, dancing, playing games, exercising, doing tai chi, practicing calligraphy, in fact pretty much any recreational activity. Not to be confused with People's Park in Midong District.
spots.addr: 3 Youhao Road South, Shayibake District (沙依巴克区友好南路3号)

spots.name: Hongcheng Lake Park
spots.desc: The formerly putrid lake has been thoroughly cleaned up and is now a pleasant place for a stroll. Fishing and swimming are prohibited, however.
spots.addr: Hongcheng Lake Road, Qiongshan District (琼山区红城湖路)

spots.name: Zhangguying village
spots.desc: A small village from Ming dynasty, 80 kilometers to the southeast.

spots.name: Jiangsu Art Museum (New Branch)
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 333 Changjiang Road, Xuanwu District (玄武区长江路333号)

spots.name: Dunhuang Museum
spots.desc: Dunhuang's main museum.
spots.hours: 09:00-18:30 (May to September), 09:00-18:00 (October to April), no entry in last 60 minutes, closed on Mondays
spots.price: Entry is generally free, but fees may be charged for access to special exhibitions
spots.addr: 1390 Mingshan North Road (鸣山北路1390号)

spots.name: Ningxia Museum
spots.local: 宁夏回族自治区博物馆
spots.addr: 6 People's Square Street East, Jinfeng District (金凤区人民广场东街6号)

spots.name: Keyuan Museum
spots.price: ¥8 to enter the area with the old buildings; other areas of the museum and gardens are free
spots.addr: 32 Keyuan Road, Guancheng District (莞城区可园路32号)

spots.name: Guanyin Mountain National Forest Park
spots.local: 广东观音山国家森林公园
spots.hours: October to May: 07:00-17:00; June to September: 07:00-17:30
spots.addr: Bijiashan Avenue, Shixin District, Zhangmutou Town (樟木头镇石新区笔架山大道)

spots.name: Sifang Contemporary Art Museum
spots.hours: 10:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 9 Zhen Qi Road, Pukou District (浦口区珍七路9号)

spots.name: Wanda Plaza Huai’an
spots.desc: The shopping mall integrates shopping, dining, cinema, and entertainment. The dining options are diverse, ranging from chain fast food to mid-range restaurants, primarily featuring popular brands and national chains. It's especially lively on weekends and holidays, making it ideal for families and young people.

spots.name: St Mary's Church
spots.desc: Once one of China's grandest churches, St Mary's Church was built by the Carmelites near the centre of Jiaxing (just west of the Citadel - see below). Constructed over 13 years and completed in 1930, most of its construction material was imported from France, as was the bell. The church was for a long time the tallest building in Jiaxing. During the Cultural Revolution (1966-1976), the church was…
spots.addr: 55 Ziyang Street

spots.name: Shuanglong Cave
spots.desc: Shuanglong Cave is known for its unique geological formations and abundant natural scenery, making it one of the most famous natural attractions in the Jinhua area.
spots.addr: Within Shuanglong Scenic Area

spots.name: Chang'an Grand Theater
spots.desc: Traditional Chinese performances with focus on Beijing Opera. Also has a shop with paintings and folk handicrafts.
spots.addr: 7 Jianguomennei Street (建国门内大街7号; Jiànguóménnèidàjiē)

spots.name: China Ethnic Museum
spots.desc: Large anthropological museum and cultural park showcasing the cultures of China's 56 officially recognized ethnic groups. The site combines exhibition halls with full-scale reconstructions of traditional villages, houses, temples and landscapes, along with regular cultural performances and festivals. Covers about 50 hectares in two sections (North and South Parks).
spots.addr: 1 Minzuyuan Road (民族园路1号; Mínzúyuánlù)

spots.name: Lidai Diwang Miao
spots.desc: Large temple built in 1530 used to sacrifice to past emperors. Opened to the public in 2004 after a decade of renovation. Here can be seen memorial tablets for many past emperors.
spots.addr: 131 Fuchengmennei Street (阜成门内大街131号 Fùchéngménnèidàjiē)

spots.name: Huode Zhenjun Temple
spots.desc: A Taoist temple built during the Ming Dynasty and then rebuilt in 1759 during the Qing Dynasty.

spots.name: Guo Moruo's Former Residence
spots.desc: Museum showing the life of Guo Moruo (1892-1978). Guo was an author, poet, historian and government official. His works seems quite dated now, but his former residence is still worth a visit.
spots.addr: 18 Qianhai W St (前海西街18号 Qiánhǎi Xījiē)

spots.name: Jieyang Tower
spots.desc: Built in a traditional Han-style architectural form, this 38-metre-high tower is one of Jieyang's landmarks. It stands beside the Rongjiang River and is surrounded by Jieyang Tower Square.
spots.addr: No. 193 Yanjiang Middle Road

spots.name: Anyuan Coal Miners Memorial
spots.local: 安源路矿工人运动纪念馆
spots.desc: Large square highlighted with a huge high statue of the young Mao Zedong. Contains a museum (革命列士纪念馆)
spots.addr: Jinggangshan Road (井冈山路)

spots.name: Xizhou Town
spots.desc: Xizhou has almost 200 national heritage listed private houses dating from the Qing Dynasty. The houses are among the best examples of traditional Qing architecture in China and are exquisitely detailed. Chinese style with local touches. Building craftsmen from Xizhou were famous throughout Southeast Asia and travelled to Vietnam, Myanmar and throughout Southwest China to build and decorate…

spots.name: Shuanglang Ancient Village
spots.desc: An old fishing village with many well-preserved buildings, at the northeast shore of Erhai Lake. Lots of restaurants as well as traditional buildings, and access to Yuji Island (玉几岛, accessible by bridge for ¥10) and Nanzhao Island (南诏岛, take the ferry for ¥50).

spots.name: Honglingjin Park
spots.desc: Here you can watch sculptures and gingko trees. The park also features indoor and outdoor playgrounds, boats for hire and a number of amusement park rides.
spots.addr: Houbalizhuang, East Ring Road Four (东四环路后八里庄5号; Dōngsìhuánlù Hòubālǐzhuāng)

spots.name: Songyang Academy
spots.desc: One of the four great academies of ancient China, it was first built in the Northern Wei Dynasty and has served as a place for scholars to lecture throughout the ages. The academy boasts ancient cypress trees, lecture halls, and inscriptions.

spots.name: PYIFF(Pingyao Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon International Film Festival)
spots.desc: Initiated by director Jia Zhangke, with Marco Muller as chief consultant and Lin Xudong as artistic director, it is held annually in the ancient city of Pingyao with a history of 2700 years. It features films from non-Western countries (China, Asia, Eastern Europe, Latin America, Africa).Under the special authorization of Director Ang Lee, the Pingyao International Film Exhibition is named…

spots.name: Nielong cave
spots.desc: Natural karst cave approximately 4 km long. Unfortunately, there exists no convenient public transportation to the cave. (The closest bus stop is about 1.2 km from the cave entrance)

spots.name: Maritime Silk Road Museum of Guangdong
spots.local: 廣東海上絲綢之路博物館
spots.desc: See Maritime Silk Road for background.
spots.addr: Songkang Avenue, Ten-Li Silver Beach, Hailing Island Experimental Zone (海陵岛试验区十里银滩宋康大道)

spots.name: Shanghai Centre
spots.desc: Three towers above an 8-story base. The base has quite a bit of high-end shopping, plus a supermarket in the basement with a range of imported foods. There is a pleasant coffee shop at ground level, back left corner as seen from the street. One tower has the Shanghai Ritz Carlton hotel; the others are apartments and offices, including several consulates. The complex also includes a theatre and an…

spots.name: Longquan Temple
spots.desc: Longquan Temple is a historic Buddhist temple on the southern slope of Longquan Mountain in central Yuyao. Founded in 336, the temple has a history of more than 1,600 years. The surviving complex includes the Mahavira Hall, western side hall and Guanyin Pavilion. The temple is also associated with Yuyao's historical and cultural heritage.
spots.addr: No. 114 North Binjiang Road, Yangming Subdistrict

spots.name: China Printing Museum
spots.desc: Traces the history of printing in China, from early woodblock techniques and movable type through to industrial presses. A quiet, thorough museum that gets few foreign visitors; displays are mostly captioned in Chinese.
spots.addr: 25 North Xinghua Road, Huangcun (黄村兴华北路25号)

spots.name: 济渎庙 (Jidu Temple)
spots.desc: One of the four ancient temples in China, it was built in the Northern Wei Dynasty and is dedicated to the water god Jishui. The temple is large in scale and has a profound cultural heritage.
spots.addr: Northern part of Jiyuan city

spots.name: Mount Mian
spots.desc: Mian Shan (or Silky Mountain) is noted for its natural scenery, especially for its cultural and religious relics. AAAAA Tourist Attractions of China. It is also the birthplace of the Qingming Festival (Grave Cleaning Day), which is one of China’s most important traditional festivals and items of intangible cultural heritage. The mountain is located in Jiexiu City, 40 km south of Pingyao. Tours…
spots.addr: Nanhuaizhi Village, Mianshan Town, Jiexiu City (介休市绵山镇南槐志村)

spots.name: Wang Family Compound
spots.desc: With 54 courtyards and over 1000 rooms, this massive compound is one of the largest of the residential complexes built by successful Shanxi merchants. It is, for instance, four times the size of the Qiao Family Compound. The Wang family started in farming and expanded into trading, then became officials. As the family grew in size and as they prospered, more and more courtyards were added to this…
spots.addr: JIngsheng Village, Jingsheng Town, Lingshi County (灵石县静升镇静升村)

spots.name: Shipai Village
spots.desc: The largest urban village in Guangzhou. An "urban village" in China is a village that has been swallowed up by the expanding city, while still retaining its village population and culture.

spots.name: Temple of the Five Immortals
spots.desc: A historic temple built to commemorate the folk legend of the “Five Immortals,” preserving Guangzhou’s rich history and cultural heritage.
spots.addr: 233 Huifu West Road (惠福西路)

spots.name: Shennong Stream
spots.desc: Shennongxi Tiafu Cultural Tourism Scenic Spot is a scenic spot with excellent natural scenery and cultural landscape in central China, and occupies an important position in the tourism pattern of the Three Gorges area and Wuling Mountain area. The development of the scenic spot began in 1989 and was opened to the outside world in 1991. After more than 10 years of development and construction, it…
spots.addr: Yanjiang Road No.138

spots.name: Simbiling Monastery
spots.desc: A monastery full of rich history where the Tibetan government defeated the Ladakh army.

spots.name: Xishuangbanna Zongfo Temple
spots.desc: The Xishuangbanna Zongfo Temple was one of the first Pali-speaking Buddhist monasteries to be established in Xishuangbanna and is said to have been built in 615. On 18 June 1990, Zhao Puchu, the president of the Chinese Buddhist Association, changed the name of the temple to "Xishuangbanna Zongfo Temple".
spots.addr: 18 Baji Road

spots.name: Yanbian Museum
spots.desc: Large museum with exhibitions on the history and culture of Yanbian Prefecture. It is dedicated to the culture and history of the Korean ethnic minority in China. The museum contains over 10,000 exhibits, including 11 first-level artifacts. The exhibits' labels and explanations are bilingual in Korean and Chinese.
spots.addr: 8627 Changbai West Road (长白西路8627号)

spots.name: Beijing Auto Museum
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no tickets sold after 16:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mon (except when Mon is a public holiday)
spots.addr: 126 South 4th Ring Road West (南四环西路126号)

spots.name: New Town Central Park
spots.desc: 130,000-m² park, 115 plants species and a 52,000-m² grassland
spots.addr: 2238 Yan'an Xi Lu

spots.name: Wukang Mansion
spots.desc: A protected historic apartment building in French Renaissance style completed in 1924 that has been the residence of many celebrities.
spots.addr: 1850 Middle Huaihai Road

spots.name: IAPM Mall
spots.desc: This upscale mall houses big-name boutiques, restaurants and cafes. It features an atrium famous for its large-scale decoration exhibits during (Chinese and western) holidays.
spots.addr: Huaihai Middle Road 999.

spots.name: Guyi Garden
spots.desc: One of Shanghai's famous old gardens, now a hybrid between a classical garden and a family-friendly public park. The garden was owned by magistrate Min Shiji during the Jiajing era (1522–1566) of the Ming dynasty. In 1789 it became communal property, and saw the addition of various pavilions and shrines, as well as the opening of shops, taverns and restaurants at its west edge.
spots.hours: 07:00-18:00. Between May and October the last exit is at 18:30 at the south gate and at 19:30 at the west gate
spots.addr: 218 Huyi Highway

spots.name: Xilin pagoda
spots.desc: A 46.5-m-high pagoda with temple located in the western part of Songjiang near the intersection of Zhongshanzhong Lu and Xilin Bei Lu (中山中路, 西林北路). The original pagoda dates back to 1440 and is within a Buddhist temple, which has been renovated. The pond is crowded with fish and visitors can touch them.
spots.price: Temple area and garden: free (it might be ¥6 on certain days); Pagoda: not accessible for climbing
spots.addr: Xita Lane, Zhongshan Middle Rd (松江区中山西路)

spots.name: Zuibai Pond Garden
spots.desc: It’s one of the five classical parks in Shanghai, also a national scenic spot ranked AAA. The park is famous for the peony in spring, lotus in summer, chrysanthemum in autumn and plum flower in winter. There is a central pond, lots of pavilions, terraces, path leading to the loneliness maze and maintained precious treasure relics such as the Square Hall, the Boat-like Hut, Reading Hall, the…
spots.addr: Renmin South Rd

spots.name: Guangfulin Cultural Relics Park
spots.desc: A park centered around the Guangfulin archaeological site, where many ancient artefacts have been unearthed. It includes several museums and temples.
spots.hours: General opening hours are 09:00-17:00; the museums and temples shut at 16:30
spots.price: ¥30 (archaeological museum); ¥5 (ancient pottery museum); ¥5 (art museum); ¥30 (Guangfulin Culture Exhibition Hall)…
spots.addr: Lane 3260, Guangfulin Road (广富林路3260弄)

spots.name: Shanghai Railway Museum
spots.desc: Museum about trains and railways in China. Closed on Sundays and Mondays.
spots.addr: 200 East Tianmu Road (闸北区天目东路200号)

spots.name: Shanghai Circus World
spots.desc: Known, among other things, for fine acrobatic shows and is on many tour group itineraries.
spots.addr: No. 2266 Gonghexin Road

spots.name: Safari Park Shenzhen
spots.desc: Billed as a safari park where the animals stare at the humans. It is dirty and disorganised, but children may like it.
spots.addr: Xili Rd (西丽路; Xīlì Lù)

spots.name: Wuying Pagoda
spots.desc: Built in 1270, the Wuying Pagoda is the oldest standing architectural structure in Wuhan. It used to be part of the Xingfu Temple until the temple was destroyed by the Taiping rebels in the mid-19th century. It was moved to the present location in the early 1960s. The name Wuying Pagoda literally means Shadowless Pagoda, which derives from the myth that when the pagoda was in its original…
spots.addr: Hongshan Park, 509 Wuluo Road, Wuchang District (武昌区武珞路509号洪山公园内)

spots.name: Shibati (18 Stairs)
spots.desc: A historic neighborhood on the south side of the Yuzhong Peninsula. This former slum area underwent a major renovation project from 2017 to 2021 and is now fully gentrified and commercialized. The Shibati Memories Museum (十八梯记忆馆) near the northern entrance explains the history of the area.
spots.price: General entry to the area is free

spots.name: Langqi Island
spots.desc: Langqi is a beautiful island located at the mouth of the Min River. People can enjoy swimming, sunbathing, surfing and other aquatic sports here. Also, the seafood is excellent.

spots.name: Zhuanghang Old Street
spots.desc: With a history of over 600 years, Zhuanghang Old Street is a well-preserved water town featuring traditional Ming and Qing architecture, stone bridges spanning the Nanqiaotang River, and a lively local community with residents going about their daily lives.
spots.addr: No. 101, Yixin Street, Zhuanghang Town

spots.name: Former Site of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea
spots.local: 大韩民国临时政府旧址 (上海)
spots.desc: In 1919, during the Japanese occupation of Korea, Korean independence activists in Shanghai established the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea. This building served as the provisional government's main headquarters from 1926 to 1932. The site is now owned and preserved as a museum by South Korea. Everything is explained in Chinese and Korean, and there's nothing in English.
spots.addr: No. 4 Lane 306, Madang Road, Huangpu District (黄浦区马当路306弄4号)

spots.name: Former Site of Wuhan Nationalist Government
spots.desc: It was built in 1917 for the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Company. From January to September 1927, the building served as the seat of power for the Wuhan Nationalist Government, a government led by a left-wing faction of the Nationalist Party (Kuomintang), which briefly operated independently of Chiang Kai-Shek's government. A museum on the 3rd floor of the building explains the history.
spots.hours: Tue-Sun 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 708 Zhongshan Avenue, Jianghan District (江汉区中山大道708号)

spots.name: Eling Park
spots.desc: Eling Park is a historic hilltop park in central Chongqing. It gets its name from the shape of the terrain, which resembles a goose's head. It is known for its traditional gardens, walking paths and panoramic views of the Yangtze and Jialing rivers.
spots.addr: 176 Eling Main Street

spots.name: Shanghai Business School
spots.desc: A university.

spots.name: Hubei Provincial Library
spots.hours: Tue-Sun 08:30-17:30, Mon 12:30-17:30. The children's reading room is open till 18:30
spots.addr: 25 Gongzheng Road, Wuchang District (武昌区公正路25号)

spots.name: Snowy Jade Cave
spots.addr: Diandao Road (垫道路)

spots.name: Dadieshui Waterfall Scenic Area
spots.hours: As of May 2019, this scenic area is temporarily closed to visitors

spots.name: Baiyun Guan Temple
spots.desc: A Taoist temple. Look for the statue of the guardian spirit for your Chinese zodiac.
spots.addr: 239 Dajing Road

spots.name: Baishi Mountain
spots.desc: The most picturesque mountain scenery in north China. It takes about half a day to walk along the mountain path. There is also a short glass floor cliff walk. Foggy days that obscure the mountains are renowned but rarely occur.
spots.price: Standard entry fee is ¥135; the park bus charges ¥30 a ride; the cable cars charge between ¥45 and ¥70
spots.addr: Lianggou Village, Baishishan Town (白石山镇丰凉沟村)

spots.name: Qinglongdong Ancient Architectural Complex
spots.desc: Qīnglóngdòng Gǔ Jiànzhù Qún) is located on the cliff of Mount Zhonghe (中和山; Zhōnghé Shān), and on the riverside of Wu River. Three religions, Buddhism, Taoism and Confucianism, co-exist in the Qinglongdong Ancient Architectural Complex, including Zhusheng Bridge, Zhongyuan Chan Temple (Buddhist), Ziyang Academy of Classical Learning (紫阳书院; Zǐyáng Shūyuàn), Qinglongdong, Wanshou Palace (万寿宫…

spots.name: Shuhan Tianshifu
spots.desc: Taoist temple in Shangqing town, former home of Taoist masters.

spots.name: China Maritime Museum
spots.hours: 09:30-16:00, no entry after 15:30, closed on Mon (except when Mon is a public holiday)
spots.price: Standard adult tickets are ¥30, tickets for adults aged 60 to 64 are ¥10, adults aged 65 or over may enter for free…
spots.addr: 197 Shengang Avenue (申港大道197号)

spots.name: Tongjin Bridge
spots.desc: A historic stone bridge with origins in the Song Dynasty. During the Ming and Qing periods, it was the bustling commercial heart of the Nanxun silk trade, with shops lining its banks.

spots.name: Hongji Bridge
spots.desc: A single arch stone bridge built in the Qing Dynasty. Notable architectural features include its “Wu Wang Lei” style railings. Sections of the railing bear cement repairs from damage sustained in 1937, preserved as historical testament.

spots.name: Guanghui Bridge
spots.desc: Also known as "Zhangwang Temple Bridge". A stone arch bridge with uncertain origins; the present structure dates from a 1866 reconstruction. It is associated with a local legend involving the late Yuan rebel leader Zhang Shicheng. The bridge is a protected cultural relic of Huzhou City.

spots.desc: It is the most worthwhile private garden in Nanxun Ancient Town, renowned as the "First Private Garden in Jiangnan." It was built as a private garden developed by the Liu Yong family, the richest man in Nanxun during the late Qing dynasty, but it served not just as a garden, but also as a family temple, righteousness estate, and library. Walking in, you can clearly sense that "wealthy yet…

spots.name: Mao Dun Former Residence
spots.desc: Mao Dun (1896-1981) was a famous revolutionary writer. His former residence including personal effects and writings can be seen here.
spots.addr: 13 Yuanensi Hutong (后圆恩寺胡同13号; Hòuyuánēnsì Hútòng)

spots.name: The Five Avenues
spots.desc: Fifth Avenue (Wudadao) is located in the south of the downtown Tianjin, a parallel street from east to west named under five cities of southwest China, namely Chongqing, Changde, Dali, Munan and Machang. Local Tianjinese call it the "Fifth Avenue", together with over 230 buildings of all kinds from the architecture of Britain, France, Italy, Germany and Spain, as well as over 50 houses ever been…
spots.addr: Wudadao, Heping, Tianjin (和平区五大道)

spots.name: China House Museum
spots.desc: A priceless building decorated with about 4,000 pieces of ancient porcelain, 400 pieces of jade stone carving, 20 tons of crystal and agate and million pieces of ancient Chinese ceramic chips. China house museum is a private museum which belongs to the Tianjin Yueweixian Cultural Industry and Investment Group. It is built with more than 700,000,000 pieces of Chinese ancient porcelain; 15000…
spots.hours: Apr-Oct: 09:00-19:00, Nov-Mar: 09:00-18:30, no tickets sold in last 30 minutes
spots.addr: 72 Chifeng Road, Heping District (和平区赤峰道72号)

spots.desc: This is the Wuhan campus of a national university that also has a campus in Beijing. The campus has three sections: the eastern and western ones are connected by a pedestrian bridge over Lumo Rd, the western and northern, by a pedestrian tunnel under Fujiashan/Nanwangshan. The well landscaped area around the university's main buildings (on both sides of Lumo Lu) also has the university museum.

spots.addr: Moshan Hill Scenic Area, 118 Luomo Road, Hongshan District (洪山区鲁磨路118号东湖磨山景区内)

spots.addr: No. 1 Luoruihe Street North, Nanlian Community, Longgang Subdistrict, Longgang District (龙岗区龙岗街道南联社区罗瑞合北街一号)

spots.name: OCT East
spots.desc: An amusement park built by the same company that brought you Window of the World. Located on the mountainside behind the Dameisha beach neighborhood, it features thrill rides, shows, a water park, and a replica of a European town, not to mention beautiful views of the mountains, forest, and ocean. To reach all the different rides or attractions, be prepared to climb a lot of stairs or escalators…
spots.price: ¥200 for Knight Valley, ¥180 for Tea Stream Valley, ¥250 for a combined ticket

spots.name: Fenghuang Mountain
spots.desc: Literally "Phoenix Mountain", this forested mountain in northwestern Shenzhen is covered with a network of well-maintained hiking trails paved with steps. The main point of interest is Fengyan Temple (凤岩古庙, Fèngyán Gǔmiào), a Buddhist temple partway up the mountain, dating back to the Yuan Dynasty. spots.name: Ciyun Temple
spots.desc: One of the largest Buddhist temples in Chongqing. It was founded in the Tang Dynasty and rebuilt during the reign of Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty. The original name of the temple was the Guanyin Temple. After undergoing a major expansion in 1927, it was renamed the Ciyun Temple. It is said to be the only Buddhist temple in China that provides accommodation for both monks and nuns.

spots.desc: Shangxiahang is a historic commercial district about 5 kilometers south of the Three Lanes and Seven Alleys. Sightseeing cars are available to take visitors around the park for ¥10.

Part of the garden is the Nanmu Hall with a collection of furniture made of nanmu, a wood that is fairly common in China and prized because it looks good and resists both humidity and decay. Mandarin Duck Hall is divided into two parts by a meticulously carved partition.

spots.name: Garden of Pleasure (Pleasence)

spots.desc: A 600-year-old screen made of glazed tiles and depicting nine dragons, this is the oldest glazed screen in China. Only three nine-dragon walls exist in China. The Datong Nine-Dragon Wall was built during the early Ming Dynasty as a screen wall for the residence of Zhu Gui, the thirteenth son of Zhu Yuanzhang.

spots.name: Vincent Abbey

After 1949, it became a nursing home. It is no longer open for visits, but the public can get a good view of the cloisters from the street. The city government plans to restore the abbey and turn it into another tourist attraction.

spots.name: Fangguang Temple
spots.desc: Buddhist temple located on Mount Tiantai. Shiqiao Temple, originally named Shiqiao Temple, was built in the first year of the Song Dynasty Jianzhong Yasukuni (1101), located in Shiqiao Hill, Shiliang Town, Tiantai County, 25 kilometers away from Tiantai County. Fangguang Temple is a national key temple announced by The State Council.

spots.name: China National Museum of Women and Children
spots.desc: A museum exhibiting numerous cultural and historical artefacts related to women and children in China. Visitors are expected to make a booking on WeChat at least one day before visiting the museum. The museum's WeChat account may be found by searching "中国妇女儿童博物馆公众号".
spots.addr: 9 Beijige Road (北极阁路9号; Běijígé Lù

spots.desc: This abandoned, overgrown Baroque Revival complex, dating to the early 20th century, has acquired an international reputation as the best-known allegedly haunted house in China. According to residents of the nearby hutongs, even the Red Guards moved out after a few days, supposedly scared off by the ghost of a Kuomintang officer's mistress who hanged herself when he fled to Taiwan without her. It…
spots.addr: 81 Chaoyangmen Inner St, 朝阳门街道内81号

spots.name: Changpu River Park

spots.addr: 22 Wangfujing Street (王府井大街22号; Wángfǔjǐngdàjiē)

spots.desc: It was established in the Yuan Dynasty (1270), reconstructed during the Ming Dynasty. In the tenth year of the Tongzhi era of the Qing Dynasty (1871), the temple was destroyed by fire. Only five buildings remain standing.

spots.name: National Assembly Building
spots.desc: The first purpose-built meeting place of the National Assembly of the Republic of China in Beijing. It is now part of the compound of Xinhua News Agency.

spots.name: Zhoukou Guandi Temple
spots.desc: Founded in 1693 and further expanded during the 18th and 19th centuries, this is the largest temple in Henan Province dedicated to Guan Yu, a famous Han Dynasty general.

spots.name: Pingdingshan Museum
spots.desc: The Pingdingshan Museum houses over 30,000 artifacts and more than 2,000 precious artifacts of grade 3 and above.Pingdingshan boasts a rich historical and cultural heritage, making it particularly worth visiting if you want to learn about China's historical and cultural heritage.

spots.name: Shanshan Guild Hall
spots.desc: Built in 1743 by merchants from Shanxi and Shaanxi. It is a magnificent example of Qing Dynasty architecture, famous for its exquisite wood, stone, and brick carvings.

spots.name: Tiefo Temple (also called Dayun Temple)
spots.desc: Tiefo Temple (Dayun Temple) in Linfen is a historic Buddhist temple famous for its six-tier glazed pagoda and a colossal iron-cast Sakyamuni Buddha head dating to the Tang dynasty.

spots.name: Yuquan Temple
spots.desc: Ancient Taoist temple overlooking Tianshui, dating from the Yuan dynasty. It is still possible to drink from the spring, for a donation.

spots.desc: Said to be the largest Confucius temple in Northwest China. It was built in the 15th century, and rebuilt and expanded several times. The temple is now administered as a branch of the nearby Wuwei Xixia Museum.
spots.hours: 08:00-18:00 (summer), 08:30-18:00 (winter), no entry after 17:30, closed on Mon (except when Mon is a public hoiliday)

spots.name: Jinxian Gate
spots.desc: A Chinese-style entrance gate to the city, built during the Ming Dynasty.

spots.name: Former Residence of Ding Richang
spots.desc: This traditional Chaoshan residence was built in 1878 for Ding Richang, a prominent official and reformer of the late Qing Dynasty. The complex features traditional architecture and wood carvings, with a distinctive layout in the shape of the Chinese character “興”.
spots.addr: Yuanding Road

spots.name: Tonglushan Ancient Copper Mine Site
spots.desc: A 4A-level archaeological site with over 3,000 years of mining history, dating from the Shang to Han dynasties. It was discovered in 1973 and is one of China's best-preserved ancient copper mines. The site was listed as a national historical and cultural heritage site in 1982 and was included in the UNESCO World Heritage Tentative List in 2012. The museum displays bronze swords, mining tools, and…
spots.price: Adult ¥70; half price for seniors over 60; free for children under 1.4m
spots.addr: Jinhu Subdistrict, Daye City

spots.name: Golden Hall
spots.desc: Built at the same time as the Forbidden City as a thanks to the god Zhen Wu for helping the emperor take over the country.

spots.name: Nanyan Palace
spots.desc: The place where Zhenwu attained enlightenment. The Tianyi Zhenqing Palace, a stone hall built during the Yuan Dynasty, is embedded in the cliffs and is the most prominent of the 36 rocks on Wudang Mountain.

spots.name: Lizhuang
spots.desc: A sleepy riverside town to the east of Yibin city with crumbling Qing dynasty buildings and pleasant tree lined streets. The town was a base for the resistance against the Japanese during the second world war and Shanghai's Tongli University was relocated here in that period.

spots.name: Shenhai Well
spots.desc: The Shenhai Well is a one-kilometre-deep salt well that was constructed in 1835. It is the only traditional salt well in China that is still being used to this day.

spots.name: Pingliangtai Ancient City Ruins

But the top of the 7-story, 22-meter…

spots.name: Mao Dun residence / Lizhi College
spots.desc: Mao Dun's residence was the family home of the family of Mao Dun, renowned 20th-century Chinese writer and playwright. Both buildings together form the Mao Dun Memorial.

spots.desc: This is one of China's biggest and most splendid temples to Tianhou, also known as Mazu, the Goddess of Heaven who guards over sailors and fishermen. It was founded in the early fifteenth century by the famous eunuch admiral Zheng He who, during one of his voyages of discovery, was saved from shipwreck here during a typhoon by the intercession of Tianhou, this despite the fact that Zheng He was a…

Originally they had twelve gun positions but now only the Left Fort is in any reasonable degree of repair. Perched on Ying Zui Mountain, at over 160 m (500 feet) above the Pearl River, they commanded a full field of fire. Their failure to make any…

Fashion, food (Chinese and foreign), drinks, accessories, name-brand cosmetics, a movie theater, ice skating rink, and whatever else you might expect. spots.desc: The temple was built in 1504, and was rebuilt in the 1680s after being damaged in an earthquake. spots.name: Menghuan Great Golden Pagoda

The pagoda is open daily from 08:30 to 22:00, with an entry fee of ¥50.

spots.name: Bodhi Temple

spots.name: Baima Snow Mountain

spots.desc: Make sure to go all the way towards the back inside the garden to see the best part. This tucked away place is a little tough to find but totally worth the effort if you want to find a quiet, unpretentious place visited mainly by locals.

spots.name: Suzhou Museum West
spots.desc: If you’re unable to secure a booking at the Suzhou Museum’s main branch, you may want to come here instead. Suzhou Museum West is actually a lot larger than the main branch. It has exhibitions on local history and culture, and often hosts temporary exhibitions. There is also a cafe and a restaurant.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:00, closed on Mondays
spots.price: General entry is free, fees are sometimes charged for temporary exhibitions
spots.addr: 399 Changjiang Road, Huqiu District (虎丘区长江路399号)

spots.name: Puhaddin Park
spots.desc: Puhaddin Park is centered on the tomb of Puhaddin, an Islamic missionary, said to be a descendant of Mohammed, who arrived to Yangzhou in the 13th century. Puhaddin's tomb, in an inscription-covered building, is surrounded by tombs of his disciples and other important Muslims. A few smaller buildings contain an exhibit on the history of Yangzhou's and China's Muslim community (the Hui people), a…

spots.name: Wenchang Ge
spots.desc: The name mean "Promoting Literature Pavilion". Once part of the Confucian Academy, this pavilion is all that's left. Now it stands in a roundabout in a city square, marking Yangzhou's symbolic central point

spots.name: Guo's Villa
spots.desc: One of the best traditional private gardens in Hangzhou. It is one of the garden masterpieces of Jiangnan (the lower region of the Yangtze River) thanks to its incomparable surroundings and the smartly managed garden space. The garden develops as you enter further into it with regular switches between tight, closed spaces and sudden, open ones. The key feature, or spirit, is water. Cleverly…

spots.name: Baiyun Manor
spots.desc: A home from the 1300s, which the family turned into an exclusive school in the 1600s. Wooden plaques provide details on family members and students in Chinese and English. It's in a quiet area, behind a park, ringed by a garden, with canals on two sides, and gets 5-10 visitors per day so it can be a tranquil escape from the city, but is otherwise unremarkable if you don't recognize the names.
spots.addr: Guan River Bank, West of Haishu District, Haishu District

spots.name: Drum Tower
spots.desc: A symbol of Ningbo and an entrance to a pedestrian shopping district, this tower is a mix of architectural styles.

spots.name: Fufu Shi
spots.desc: Another old house that gets 5-10 visitors per day, this one displays a literature collection.
spots.addr: 鼓楼街道孝闻街91号

spots.name: Ningbo Banking Guild Hall
spots.desc: Former guild hall for banking and foreign exchange, which was important in Ningbo due to significant foreign trade. Closed down when the banks were closed in 1949, it now houses an impressive coin museum

spots.name: Ningbo Bang Museum
spots.desc: Displays the long and proud history of Ningbo's mafia-like groups.
spots.addr: 255 Siyuan Road, Zhenhai District

spots.name: Ningbo Museum of Art
spots.desc: Ningbo Museum of Art, opened 2005, designed by WANG Shu & LU Wenyu of Amateur Architecture Studio. The striking building features large operable panels that allow the entire upper-level gallery space to be opened to the elements; the materials and the entry bridges make reference to the old docks along the Ningbo Bund. Located immediately to the north of the Old Bund / LaoWaiTan area.
spots.addr: 122 Renmin Road, Jiangbei District / 浙江省宁波市江北区人民路122号

spots.name: Ningbo Youngor Zoo
spots.desc: The zoo has over 10,000 animals, dozens of routes to walk, and beautiful panoramic views of the entire zoo from atop man-made mountains.
spots.hours: May-Oct 08:00-16:30, Nov-Apr 08:30-16:30; Ticket selling hours: May-Oct 07:45-15:30, Nov-Apr 08:15-15:30
spots.addr: Ningbo Dong Qian Lake

spots.name: Po Pagoda
spots.desc: Standing nine storeys tall until the Ming dynasty, this stocky three-storey hexagonal pagoda dates to 974, and is covered in large tiles featuring Buddhist figures. Tourists seldom visit. It can be climbed if the internal stairway's gate is unlocked that day.
spots.addr: 30 Po Ta West Road, 禹王台区繁塔西街30号

spots.name: Kaifeng Qingming River Garden
spots.desc: Kaifeng Qingming River Garden is a national AAAAA-level tourist attraction, a large historical and cultural park with Song culture as the theme.It is based on the famous Northern Song Dynasty painter Zhang Zetuan's work "Qingming River Map" for the model built.The scenic area covers an area of more than 600 mu, of which 180 mu of ancient ships, landscape construction area of more than 30,000…
spots.addr: No.5 West Longting Road, Longting District

spots.name: Anyang Museum
spots.desc: This large museum shows permanent exhibitions on porcelain, traditional Chinese woodblock new year prints, and on archaeological discoveries dating to several centuries that have been excavated during preparation for the "South-North Water Transfer Project". Anyang City Museum covers a total area of 20,000 m², exhibition area of 5000 m², a total of 8 warehouses, 7 exhibition halls. There are more…

spots.name: Yuan Shikai Tomb
spots.desc: Tomb of the second president of the Republic of China who attempted to restore the empire with himself as the new emperor. The layout and grandeur of the tomb follows that of a Chinese emperor, reflecting Yuan's ambitions. The Chinese name is also a pun on the Chinese word for "imperial tomb" (陵 líng).

spots.name: Fusheng Temple Pagoda
spots.desc: Founded in the Northern Song Dynasty, the pagoda was built with 13 levels and stood more than 66 meters high. But during the late Yuan Dynasty, the upper 6 levels were destroyed during a battle. The temple that the pagoda once belonged to also no longer exists, though the government reportedly plans to rebuild it. During the restoration of the pagoda in 1988, many valuable Buddhist artefacts were…
spots.price: Access is free but visitors are not allowed inside the pagoda
spots.addr: Intersection of Gucheng Road and Tuanjie West Road, Dengzhou (邓州市古城路与团结西路交汇处)

spots.name: Dingding Gate Ruins Museum
spots.desc: Built during the Sui and Tang dynasties when Luoyang was the capital of the Chinese empire, the Dingding Gate was the city's main gate up until the Song Dynasty when it was gradually abandoned. The ruins are housed inside a building complex that is designed to resemble what the gate may have looked like during its heyday.
spots.hours: Tue-Sun 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: Gucheng Road, Luolong District (洛龙区古城路)

spots.name: Duke of Zhou Temple Museum
spots.desc: A memorial temple dedicated to the Duke of Zhou, a famous statesmen and aristocrat who acted as the regent of the Zhou Dynasty from 1042 BC to 1035 BC. The temple was commissioned in 618 AD by the Sui Dynasty general Wang Shichong and rebuilt during the Ming Dynasty.
spots.addr: 21 Dingding South Road, Laocheng District (老城区定鼎南路21号)

spots.name: Langyatai Platform
spots.desc: A 4A historic coastal site in Huangdao disctrict. First built by King Goujian of Yue, it was rebuilt after three imperial visits by Qin Shi Huang, who dispatched Xu Fu to sail east from here. Visitors can climb ancient stone paths for sea views and relic sightseeing
spots.price: ¥50 adult; ¥25 student / seniors 60–69; free for children under 6/1.4m, seniors ≥70, disabled & military personnel
spots.addr: Dengtai Rd,Huangdao District

spots.name: Mid-Autumn Festival
spots.desc: Is on the 15th day of the 8th lunar month, usually in September or October. In Zibo, families enjoy mooncakes and seasonal fruits while gathering to admire the full moon. Boshan mooncakes, with their delicate sweetness and crispy layers, are a local specialty. Many residents visit scenic spots like Yuanshan National Forest Park or take a stroll along city parks to enjoy the autumn scenery under…

spots.name: Datong Museum

spots.name: Drum Tower
spots.desc: Built in the Ming Dynasty, it was repaired several times in the Qing Dynasty. Unlike the drum towers in Xi'an and Beijing, the Datong Drum Tower is not built on a high platform, but rather on the ground floor in the center of the street, with a cross-shaped gate on the first floor. Climb to the top floor to enjoy a 360-degree view of Datong's ancient cityscape. There are some historical photo…
spots.hours: 08:30 to 17:00; extended hours during holidays such as the Spring Festival

spots.name: Harbin Ice and Snow World
spots.desc: A magical kingdom built with 400,000 cubic meters of ice and snow. Highlights include the 500-meter super ice slide, the Snowflake Ferris Wheel, and the Asian同心 Main Tower. Lights turn on around 16:00-16:30, creating a dreamlike atmosphere.
spots.addr: West side of Songbei Avenue, Songbei District

spots.name: 9.18 Memorial Museum
spots.desc: At 22:30 on 18 September 1931, a bomb exploded beside the Japanese-run railway line near Shenyang. Though instigated by the Japanese, the Chinese were blamed for the event giving the Japanese an excuse to invade and occupy the whole of the northeast of China. Shenyang was the epicenter of that invasion, so it is most appropriate that the museum for the Mukden Incident, known in China as the '9.18…
spots.hours: Summer: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays. Winter: 09:00-16:30, no entry after 16:00, closed on…

spots.name: China Museum of Industry
spots.desc: Tells the story of the industrialisation of China. The museum is built on the site of an old foundry, which has been largely preserved in its original state.
spots.addr: 14 Weigong North Street, Tiexi District (铁西区卫工北街14号)

spots.name: Paleontological Museum of Liaoning
spots.desc: Claims to be the largest paleontological museum in China. Maintains a huge collection of fossils.

spots.name: White Pagoda Mountain Park (Baitashan)
spots.desc: Park ranging over the wooded hillside north of the river, dotted with pagodas and shrines. Enter next to Zhongshan Bridge and wander uphill by any path, eventually to the White Pagoda Temple. (There's also a cable-car from south bank of the river.) Refurbished in 2013 yet the buildings look well-worn, several boarded-up; the "Jade Temple" compound is in the best condition. The pagoda was closed…

spots.desc: Built in the Ming Dynasty and rebuilt in the Qing Dynasty. There is a huge drum hanging upstairs, once used to report the time and convey warnings. The top has an excellent view of the city. Open but wrapped in a big ugly canvas for renovations as of June 2026.

spots.name: Eighth Route Army Xi'an Office Museum
spots.local: 八路軍西安辦事處舊址
spots.desc: The Eighth Route Army was a Communist-controlled group army that was created from the Red Army in 1937 when the Communists and the Nationalists formed the Second United Front against Japan. From 1937 to 1946, this site served as the army's official liaison office for coordinating communications with the Nationalist authorities in Xi'an.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, closed on most Mondays, except Mondays that fall on a public holiday

spots.name: Gao Family Compound
spots.desc: Built over 400 years ago during the late Ming Dynasty, this 86-room courtyard mansion is the former residence of a famous scholar-official by the name of Gao Yuesong (高岳崧). The mansion has been fully restored and turned into a museum. It also functions as a venue for puppet shows. The Gao Family Compound should not be confused with Gao Peizhi's former residence on Xinglong Lane, another…
spots.addr: 144 Beiyuanmen, Lianhu District (莲湖区北院门144号)

spots.name: City God Temple of Xi'an
spots.desc: A Taoist temple dedicated to the city god of Xi'an, the protector god of the city whose earthly incarnation was the Han Dynasty general Ji Xin. The temple was established in 1387 at a site near the city's east gate. It was moved to the present location in 1432 and rebuilt in 1723 after being destroyed in a fire. It is one of the largest city god temples in China.
spots.addr: 129 West Avenue, Lianhu District (莲湖区西大街129号)

spots.name: Guilin Museum
spots.desc: The museum's collection includes over 30,000 pieces of culture relics including 22 pieces of national first-class relics, 687 pieces of national second-class relics and 2592 national third-class relics. For foreigners, passports may be required to get free admission tickets. The Guilin Library and the Guilin Grand Theatre can be found in the same building complex.

spots.desc: The view across Hefei is great on a clear day and there is a TV tower at the top. It can get crowded on days when the weather is nice. The walk up to the top of the mountain takes about 30 minutes. The Hefei Zoo is near but not much; it's a long walking distance along Wangjiang road.

spots.name: Former Residence of Li Hongzhang
spots.desc: Li Hongzhang was an important statesman and military leader during the late Qing Dynasty. Originally from Hefei, he spent much of his career in Beijing and other cities, but often stayed here when he returned to his hometown. The residence is now a museum and has exhibitions on Li Hongzhang’s life.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays

spots.name: Guangde Temple
spots.desc: Guangde Temple was built during the Tang dynasty and renamed during the Ming dynasty. It features traditional Ming and Qing architectural styles. Highlights include the Mahavira Hall, Sutra Library, and the brick-and-stone Duobao Pagoda, a national protected relic from the Ming period. The temple’s ancient ginkgo tree, revered since imperial times, adds to its rich historical and cultural…

spots.name: Site of the Zunyi Conference
spots.desc: This former merchant's home served as the site for the Politburo meetings in January 1935. The leaders of the People's Republic from 1949 to 1997 attended this meeting including Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai and Deng Xiaoping. Tense confrontations between supporters of the Soviet and Maoist revolutionary lines ensued. In the end, the Maoist side won out and it was decided that the CCP should continue…
spots.addr: 96 Ziyin Road, Honghuagang District (红花岗区子尹路96号)

spots.name: Kuanzhaixiangzi

spots.name: Chengdu City Concert Hall
spots.desc: Chengdu City Concert Hall is a landmark cultural venue that blends modern architecture with world-class acoustics, serving as a premier stage for music and performing arts in Chengdu. It regularly hosts symphony concerts, chamber music, opera, and other high-level classical and contemporary performances.

spots.name: Zhongzhou Island
spots.desc: In 2003, the city government together with foreign investors constructed a "fairytale island" with European architecture on Zhongzhou Island. The project was a failure since no shops and restaurants moved in, and has been turned into a wholesale market since 2006. The entire island is brightly illuminated at night and a very beautiful sight of traditional architecture, with the contrast of modern…
spots.addr: 台江区中州岛1号(解放大桥旁)

spots.name: Suzhou Arts and Crafts Museum
spots.desc: This is a relatively new museum, opened in 2003, but the building it is in dates back to the reign of Emperor Qianlong, 1735-1796. The museum's collection numbers nearly one-thousand pieces and includes modern Suzhou embroidery, sandalwood, tapestry, wood carving, stone carving, Ming-style furniture, ethnic musical instruments, antique bronze, lacquerwork and metal crafts.

spots.name: Zhongshan Park
spots.desc: It used to be the West Lake Temporary Imperial Palace of Qing Dynasty. It is close to Zhejiang Museum and Xiling Society of Seal Arts. The historic sites of the imperial palace are well protected and available easily.

spots.desc: The Shaoxing Museum, located in the city center, is a comprehensive museum showcasing the rich history and local culture of Shaoxing. Its collections include ancient artifacts, calligraphy, ceramics, and traditional handicrafts, with a special focus on the legacy of Yu the Great, Lu Xun's literary contributions, and Shaoxing rice wine culture. The museum’s modern exhibitions and interactive…

Among its most remarkable collections are the Naoma Elephant ivory…

spots.addr: 22 Longze South Road, Lubei District (路北区龙泽南路22号)

spots.name: Henan · Drama Fantasy City
spots.desc: The park is built with 56 blocks, featuring yellow earthen walls as the main architectural style. It includes three large theaters and 18 small theaters. Through immersive theater, it tells stories about land, grain, and cultural heritage, while the three main theaters showcase Henan’s history and local culture, offering visitors an engaging, first-hand experience.

spots.name: Zhengzhou Zoo

If you generally enjoy zoos, you may very well walk away sad at how the animals are cared for, or not in this case.

The dig produced roughly 4,900 bamboo slips, including Sun Tzu's The Art of War alongside Sun Bin's Art of War, lost for more than 1,700 years — settling a centuries-old argument over whether Sun Wu and Sun Bin were the same man and whether one or two…
spots.addr: 216 Yimeng Road, Lanshan District (兰山区沂蒙路216号)

spots.name: Qi Xi, or Chinese Valentine's Day
spots.desc: It falls on the 7th day of the 7th lunar month. In Zibo, couples may celebrate with a quiet dinner featuring local delicacies such as Zibo barbecue or handmade noodles. spots.name: Wentong Pagoda
spots.desc: The Wentong Pagoda was built in 708, at which time it was known as the Zunsheng Pagoda. It was renamed the Wentong Pagoda in 1629 following a major renovation. In 1668 an earthquake caused severe damage to the pagoda and it had to be almost completely rebuilt.
spots.addr: 46 Ximen Street, Huai'an District, Huai'an (淮安市淮安区西门大街46号)

spots.name: Wu Cheng'en's former residence
spots.desc: Wu Cheng'en, the acclaimed author of Journey to the West, lived here during the Ming Dynasty.

spots.addr: 7 Fuma Lane, Huai'an District, Huai'an (淮安市淮安区驸马巷7号)

spots.name: Pavilion of Mist and Rain
spots.desc: The Pavilion of Mist and Rain was built in 1549 on an artificial island in the middle of South Lake, to replace a 10th-century original built on the lake shore that had fallen into ruin. The pavilion and the gardens around it were improved over the next couple of centuries as a pleasure garden used by local officials and, on occasions, visiting emperors. The Qianlong Emperor loved the island so…
spots.addr: mid-lake island, South Lake

spots.name: Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Shiwang Mansion
spots.desc: Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Shiwang Mansion is a nationally protected cultural heritage site, showcasing the history and culture of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom period.

spots.name: Tianning Temple Main Hall
spots.desc: The Main Hall of Tianning Temple is a nationally protected cultural heritage site with a long history, serving as one of the cultural centers for Buddhism in Jinhua.
spots.addr: Tianning Temple

spots.name: Taiwan Volunteer Army Former Site
spots.desc: The Taiwan Volunteer Army Former Site is a protected cultural site in Zhejiang Province, important as a historical site.

spots.name: Jinhua City Fucheng Temple
spots.desc: The Fucheng Temple in Jinhua City is a protected cultural site in Zhejiang Province, with deep religious and historical significance.

spots.name: Huangjiu House
spots.desc: Jinhua Huangjiu House specializes in serving local Huangjiu (yellow wine), a traditional alcoholic beverage with a rich history and unique flavor. Huangjiu is popular for its smooth taste and health benefits, and it’s a great way to experience Jinhua's culinary culture.
spots.addr: 1 South Street

spots.name: China Court Museum
spots.desc: A museum about the court system in China. The museum is in a historic building dating from 1910 that was originally the Beijing branch of the Yokohama Specie Bank, a Japanese bank.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:00, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 4 Zhengyi Road (正义路4号; Zhèngyì Lù)

spots.name: Xibianmen City Wall Relics Park
spots.desc: The section of Ming-era city wall in this area was constructed in the fourth year of the Zhengtong reign (1439) and formed part of Beijing's Inner City wall. The central portion retains the junction where it connected with the Outer City wall, while the southern section consists of the surviving rampart base of the Inner City's Southwest Corner Tower. To the west of this segment of the Inner City…

spots.name: Jiaying Temple
spots.desc: Built in 1723, this is the largest and best-preserved Yellow River temple in China. It is known as the "Little Forbidden City of the Yellow River" because its layout follows the design of the Forbidden City in Beijing. It was built by Emperor Yongzheng to honor river gods and officials who contributed to flood control. The temple's main hall features a rare ceiling with 65 sandalwood paintings…
spots.addr: Jiayingguan Town, Wuzhi County

spots.name: Lu Wang's Tomb
spots.desc: Tomb of emperor Wan Li's Brother Lu Wang. This is nearly an exact duplicate of one of the Ming dynasty tombs located outside of Beijing. Close examination reveals a change in the dragon designs so that there are two instead of one in the stone working. Lu Wang desired to be the emperor so much that he tried copying much of the architecture found in Beijing at the time. Thirteen sets of animals…

spots.name: Yexian County Yamen
spots.desc: Occupying an area of 16,848 m², it was founded in the second year of Ming Hongwu (1369). Here you can see ancient government offices, with prisons, kitchens, prefectural residences, and other buildings distributed from south to north on the eastern side.It is the only well-preserved Ming dynasty government office（yamen） in China.
spots.addr: Ye County East Street

spots.name: Xiangshawan
spots.desc: Biggest draw for tourism in the region as one of the four AAAAA rated tourist sites in the province (only other 5A site in Ordos prefecture is the Mausoleum of Genghis Khan) and the most popular desert sightseeing destination in Inner Mongolia. The sand dune scenery is nice and the lotus shaped hotel set in the desert is eye catching but the grounds have been turned into an amusement park and…

spots.name: Guangyue Tower
spots.desc: Built in 1374 during the Ming Dynasty, it is one of the largest surviving wooden pavilions in China and the iconic landmark of Liaocheng. Climb to the top for a panoramic view of the lake and the ancient city.
spots.addr: Center of the Ancient City, Dongchangfu District (东昌府区古城中央)

spots.name: Hushi Ancient Residence Construction
spots.desc: It was built during the Jiajing era of the Ming Dynasty by Hu Laijin, a scholar who passed the imperial examination. It is divided into two parts: the South and the North Residence. The South Residence has now been converted into the Tianshui Folk Museum.

spots.name: Fuxi Temple
spots.desc: Ancient Taoist temple dedicated to the inventor of the trigram and a number of other mathematical systems, games, and tricks. Fuxi is a mythical deity that introduces the bagua (八卦) or eight trigrams. Not a huge complex, but well worth visiting.

spots.name: Baoji Bronzeware Museum
spots.desc: Visitors are expected to make an appointment on the museum’s WeChat account before visiting.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mon (except when Mon is a public holiday)
spots.addr: Chinese Stone Drum Park, Binhe Avenue, Weibin District (渭滨区滨河大道中华石鼓园)

spots.name: Jintai Taoist Temple
spots.desc: A major Taoist temple dedicated to Zhang Sanfeng, the legendary Taoist monk who is credited with the invention of Tai Chi.
spots.addr: 42 Jintai Lane, Jintai District (金台区金台巷42号)

spots.name: Guo'en Temple
spots.desc: Literally "temple of national mercy" and also known as Lóngshān Sì (龙山寺, "dragon mountain temple"). A big temple covering more than 10,000 m², that was built in the year 683 in the Tang Dynasty.
spots.addr: at the foot of Longshan (Dragon Mountain), Liuzu Town, Xinxing County 新兴县六祖镇龙山脚下

spots.name: Dawan Ancient Buildings
spots.desc: A couple of old villages built around the end of the Qing Dynasty.
spots.addr: Dawan Town, Yunan County 郁南县大湾镇

spots.name: Pingxiang Confucian Temple
spots.desc: Established at the start of the Tang dynasty, rebuilt in 1654. Extensively damaged during the Cultural Revolution, it has been mostly repaired

spots.name: Dali Municipal Museum
spots.desc: Housed in the former headquarters of Du Wenxiu, the museum includes historical relic exhibitions, traditional courtyard architecture and a stele forest.
spots.addr: Middle section of Fuxing Road, Dali Old Town

spots.name: Dali Bai Nationality Autonomous Prefecture Museum
spots.local: 大理白族自治州博物馆
spots.desc: Worth a visit. It has an extensive collection of exhibits, with half signs are translated into English. The museum grounds are beautiful as well, the exhibits are set around a traditional garden.
spots.price: Free, but requires ID to enter
spots.addr: 8 Erhe South Road, Xiaguan (下关洱河南路8号)

spots.name: China Water Transport Museum
spots.desc: Huai'an has long been an important port on the Grand Canal. This museum tells the story of Huai'an's role in the transportation of grain to the imperial capital.
spots.addr: Caoyun Square, Huai'an District, Huai'an (淮安市淮安区漕运广场)

spots.name: Cangzhou Confucian Temple
spots.desc: Cangzhou Confucian Temple was built in the early Ming Dynasty. It has three existing main halls and east and west corridors. It is the only ancient building with beam frame and bracket structure in Cangzhou from the Ming Dynasty. It is a key cultural relic protection unit in Cangzhou City and a key cultural relic protection unit in Hebei Province. The main building of Cangzhou Confucian Temple…
spots.addr: Diagonally opposite Nanhu Park, Yunhe District

spots.name: Baiyun Temple
spots.desc: Baiyunsi National Forest Park is located in Huixian City at the southeast foot of the Taihang Mountains, which was approved by the Ministry of Forestry and opened to the public in 1992, and was approved by the State Council as a national-level Taihang Mountain macaque nature reserve in 1999. The park covers an area of 2,591 hectares, with 95% forest coverage.
spots.addr: at the bottom of Bailu Mountain, 35 km west of Huixian County, Henan Province

spots.name: Wushan Water Curtain Cave Scenic Area
spots.desc: Situated in Luban Gorge in Wushan County to the west of Tianshui, covering an area of 2,000 square meters. The park features several cave temples with ancient rock paintings and carvings. The star attraction is the Lashao Temple Buddha, which is said to be the largest cliffside Buddha carving in the world.
spots.addr: Wushan County (武山县)

spots.name: Yuhua Palace
spots.desc: Yuhua Palace, a significant historical site, features Tang Dynasty architectural styles and offers an experience of Buddhist culture. Once a royal summer palace, it is now a cultural and religious landmark. Visitors can enjoy a serene environment and explore the various cultural exhibitions.
spots.addr: Yuhua Palace

spots.name: Sandiequan
spots.desc: Spectacular three-step waterfall, totalling 155m of falls, inside a deep canyon. Often described as the unmissable highlight of the park. The main trail climbs steeply up the end of the valley, with a ridge separating it from the falls, to connect with a miniature funicular railway or trail to the rest of the park. A small tourist complex sits by the pool at the bottom of the falls, and a trail…

spots.name: Jueyuan Temple
spots.desc: Jueyuan Temple was first built in the Tang Dynasty during the reign of Zhenguan, named Hongji Temple, and was given the name Jueyuan Temple during the reign of Yuanfeng in the Song Dynasty. At the end of the Yuan Dynasty, part of the temple was destroyed. In 1457, the monk Jingzhi and his disciple Daofang came here to rebuild the temple, remodel the statue of Buddha, and paint the Buddhist…
spots.addr: Jueyuan street Jiange County Xiwulian Township

spots.name: Zhongguancun Book Building
spots.addr: 68 Beisihuan Xilu, 北四环西路68号

spots.name: Changzhi Museum
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mon (except when Mon is a public holiday)
spots.addr: 9 Yingbin Street, Luzhou District (潞州区迎宾大街9号)

spots.name: Oriental Buddha Park
spots.desc: A Buddhist theme park.
spots.addr: 362 Lingyun Road, Shizhong District (市中区凌云路362号)

spots.name: Shanghai Museum of Glass
spots.desc: A large privately-owned museum occupying a former glass factory.
spots.price: ¥60 for entry to the main museum building, ¥60 for entry to the children’s museum, ¥60 for entry to the maze and ¥60…
spots.addr: 685 West Changjiang Road (长江西路685号)

spots.name: Yiwu Meihu Sports Center
spots.desc: Yiwu Meihu Sports Centre is a multi-purpose sports complex in Yiwu. It includes a stadium, an arena and a swimming centre. The Yiwu Meihu Stadium has a seating capacity of 35,260, while the Meihu Arena has a capacity of 6,000. It is used for sporting events, entertainment and public recreation.
spots.addr: No. 299 Binwang Road

spots.name: Hemudu Site Museum
spots.desc: The Hemudu Site Museum presents archaeological discoveries from the Hemudu Neolithic culture, including pottery, rice remains, wooden structures and other artifacts. The site is associated with a Neolithic culture dating back about 7,000 years.
spots.addr: Lushan Temple Village, Hemudu Town

spots.name: Garden Expo Park
spots.desc: Very large park with dozens of gardens included, each dedicated for a specific region. The Suzhou, Hokkien and Cantonese garden are must-sees.

spots.name: Gardens Museum of China
spots.desc: A through introduction of Chinese gardening, such as the Summer Palace (yes the Summer Palace is considered a "garden"/yuanlin in Chinese).

spots.name: Xihaizi Park
spots.desc: Small park next to the old shopping street and market and with a view to Randengfo Pagoda. Small playground for the children.
spots.addr: Xihaizi West Street (通州区西海子西街; Tōngzhōuqū Xīhǎizixījiē)

spots.name: Gaomiao Temple
spots.desc: Multichambered Chinese version of Hell. Featured in the movie Kill Bill vol. 2 as the residence of kung fu master Pai Mei.

spots.name: Zilicun
spots.desc: A village with lots of beautiful diaolou amidst rice fields and lotus ponds. Chickens and vegetable gardens are around too, and you'll see villagers working in the garden.
spots.hours: Closes at 17:30, but the diaolou start closing up around 17:00
spots.price: ¥78 alone, or included on the joint ticket

spots.name: Majianglong
spots.desc: Diaolou among the bamboo thickets. This village is very quiet, though the chickens and geese in coops prove there are still people living here. Not many villagers and even fewer tourists walking around.
spots.price: ¥60 by itself, or included on the joint ticket

spots.name: Jinjiangli
spots.desc: Two impressively shaped diaolou with bulbous cantilevered upper storeys, one of which you can go up in for lovely views. There are quite a few additional diaolou nearby in various states of disrepair. This is the farthest out of the four main villages, but it has much more life than Majianglong. You can experience a bit of the atmosphere of Chinese rural life—chickens and geese puttering around…
spots.price: ¥50 by itself, or included on the joint ticket

spots.name: Xiuhu Park
spots.desc: Yiwu Xiuhu Park is a large open public green space and an important part of the project of rebuilding Yiwu old City and improving the landscape of the central urban area in 2000.
spots.addr: Beimen Street

spots.name: Nanhaizi Park
spots.desc: Beijing's largest wetland park, on the site of an imperial hunting ground used by the Yuan, Ming and Qing courts. Pleasant for a walk, and the setting for the Milu Yuan deer park.

spots.name: Mange Temple
spots.desc: The Mange Temple is the oldest Buddhist temple building in Jinghong, located in the Mange Cottage, just north of the Lancang River Bridge and not far from the river. The Mange Temple is a typical Theravada Buddhist monastery and is one of the ancient temples in Xishuangbanna. The monastery was built in 1477 and the original site is 1km west of the compound.
spots.addr: 102 Zhongxin Lane

spots.name: Riyue Bay
spots.desc: The surfing capital of Hainan, if not the whole of China.
spots.addr: Hainan Circular Expressway (海南环岛高速)

spots.name: Chengjiang Fossil Site World Natural Heritage Museum
