spots.name: Longhua Martyrs' Cemetery
spots.desc: Longhua Temple's old garden and orchard has now been converted into this large green space. Very few people are buried here, so it's more of a memorial garden and museum but the acreage is beautiful and large, akin to Luxun Park. The temple grounds became a "cemetery" because, during the civil war, Koumintang troops executed Communists on these grounds and the cemetery, poetry, fountains, steles…
spots.addr: 180 Longhua Lu

spots.name: Beijing Amusement Park
spots.desc: Beijing's first amusement park. Quite large with many rides. Most rides are ok. The location in and around a lake is fine, but the landscaping is not very inspired and the atmosphere is a bit boring, especially on days with few visitors.
spots.addr: 1 Zuo'anmennei Street (左安门内大街1号; Zuǒānménnèidàjiē)

spots.name: Shrine of Yuan Chonghuan
spots.desc: Yuan Chonghuan (1584-1630) was a famous hero and prominent marshal of the Ming Dynasty.
spots.addr: 52 Donghuashixie Road (东花寺斜街52号; Dōnghuāsìxiéjiē)

spots.name: Jin dynasty imperial tombs
spots.desc: The burial ground of the Jurchen Jin emperors, who ruled from Beijing in the 12th and 13th centuries.

spots.name: Zhengding City Wall
spots.desc: Ancient city walls that surround the town, can be accessed from near the southern gate that buses from Shijiazhuang pass through.

spots.name: Rongguofu Mansion
spots.desc: A faux-ancient film set for a famous TV portrayal of Chinese novel Dream of the Red Chamber. A popular site with many visitors; the TV program was very popular on release and many come to walk around a fantasy version of the main home from the novel. There is some information on the book and explanation of its popularity, but very little in English.

spots.name: Liang Ancestral Hall
spots.desc: Built in the late Ming Dynasty for the prominent local Liang family.

spots.name: Zhengding Prefectural Temple of Literature
spots.desc: Only the second gate and its east and west side rooms remain, which are built in the Yuan Dynasty.

spots.name: Jun Royal Kiln Site Museum
spots.desc: The museum is made up of three floors, the first for local history dating back to neolithic times, the second and third for porcelain. The huge structure is spotless and largely empty on a weekday, and flawless highly detailed English captions make it well worth a visit for anyone interested in Chinese history and/or porcelain production.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00 (extended to 17:30 between May and September), closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 492 Junguanyao Road (钧官窑路492号)

spots.name: Yuzhou City God Temple
spots.desc: This historic temple is dedicated to the City God, a deity believed to protect the local area. The temple complex includes ornate altars, statues, and murals that showcase traditional religious art. Visitors can also learn about the customs surrounding City God worship in Yuzhou.
spots.addr: West Street

spots.name: Shenhou Ancient Town
spots.desc: An ancient town known for its rich porcelain culture, specifically Jun porcelain. Visitors can explore traditional workshops, shop for local ceramics, and stroll through well-preserved ancient streets.
spots.addr: Shenhou Town

spots.name: Faxing Temple Pagoda
spots.desc: The Faxing Temple Pagoda is a brick pagoda that integrates the craftsmanship of the Tang, Song, and Jin dynasties. It is 20.87 meters high and consists of a tower base, a tower body, and a tower brake. The tower base is nearly square, with a south facing round ticket gate in Tang Dynasty style. The upper octagonal nine-story eaves are in a beautiful parabolic shape, combining the characteristics…
spots.addr: On the former site of Faxing Temple in the northeast corner of Linru County

spots.name: Ruzhou Confucian Temple
spots.desc: Inside, there are ancient buildings from the Ming and Qing dynasties (Dacheng Hall, Qisheng Palace, etc.) and precious cultural relics, including calligraphy treasures such as the Northern Song Dynasty's "Ru Tie" and rare Ru porcelain from the Ru Porcelain Museum.
spots.addr: No. 65 Wangsong Middle Road

spots.name: Chimelong International Circus
spots.desc: A 90-minute, action-packed show featuring 300 award-winning performers from more than 20 countries, blending acrobatics, aerial stunts, and dazzling stage effects.

spots.name: Wuhan Zoo
spots.desc: Although it is a zoo, there is more to this zoo than just animals. The zoo contains a small area of amusement park rides, and a beautiful bonsai garden. Of course, those who are interested in seeing the animals will not be disappointed, as the zoo features a Giant Panda (be aware that they occasionally take the panda out to travel to other parts of the country), red pandas, hippos, wolves…
spots.price: ¥20 (standard adult ticket), ¥10 (children aged 6 to 18 and adults aged 60 to 65). Children under 6 and adults over 65…
spots.addr: 60 Dongwuyuan Road, Hanyang District (汉阳区动物园路60号)

spots.name: Zhongshan Warship Museum
spots.desc: This museum, near the right bank of the Yangtze in the far southwestern suburbs of Wuhan, commemorates a naval battle that happened here, hundreds of miles from the sea, in October 1938. Sunk by the Japanese aviation - just three years before the Pearl Harbor attack on the US fleet - the Chinese warship Zhongshan was raised from the bottom of the Yangzte in 1997, restored, and is now displayed in…
spots.hours: Tue-Sun and public holidays 09:00-17:00; entrance closes at 16:00
spots.addr: 1 Zhongshan Jian Road, Jinkou Subdistrict (江夏区金口街中山舰路特1号)

spots.name: The starting point of the Central Red Army's Long March
spots.local: 中央红军长征出发地旧址
spots.desc: This area was the core of the Central Revolutionary Base, where Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai, Zhu De and other leaders directed the Red Army. After the failure of the Fifth Counter-Encirclement Campaign, they decided to preserve the revolutionary forces through a strategic transfer, setting out from Ruijin on the world-famous Long March.Because of this, the land is honored as “the Starting Point of the…
spots.addr: Ruilin Town

spots.name: Pipa Mountain Park
spots.desc: Pipa Mountain Park is a hillside park in central Chongqing and the highest point in Yuzhong District. It is known for its green paths, gardens and panoramic views of the city. The Red Star Pavilion at the top offers views of the Yuzhong Peninsula and the surrounding cityscape.
spots.addr: 74 Pipa Mountain Main Street

spots.name: Baodingshan Rock Carvings
spots.desc: Baodingshan Rock Carvings is located 15 kilometers northeast of Longgang Town in Dazu County, with an elevation of 527.83 meters. The cliffside carvings at Baodingshan Rock Carvings began during the Southern Song Dynasty and cover an area of 2.5 kilometers, featuring numerous Buddha statues carved into the surrounding rock formations. These carvings include the main sites of Dafowan and…
spots.price: The ticket price for Baodingshan Rock Carvings (including Shengshou Temple) during the peak season is ¥115 for a…

spots.name: Dafo Temple
spots.desc: Just north of the downtown area on the Fuijiang River is the Dafo Temple. It is 30 min outside the downtown area along the winding river banks. The highlight is a large 18-m high Buddha carved into the rock and covered in gold. More Buddhist carvings can be seen on the cliffs outside the temple. Tourists are a rare occurrence at the temple and you will be greeted with great interest and…
spots.addr: Zitong Subdistrict (梓潼街道)

spots.name: Yang Family Residence
spots.desc: This stately residence, which was built in the 19th century, was the home of Yang Shoulu, the wealthy uncle of the two Yang brothers. Yang Shoulu spared no effort in showing off his wealth and the residence is filled with many elaborate carvings and engravings.
spots.addr: 85 Zhen Street, Shuangjiang (双江镇镇街85号)

spots.name: Chongqing Three Gorges Immigration Memorial and Wanzhou Museum
spots.desc: This is one of the largest museums in Chongqing Municipality outside the central urban area. The exhibitions on the basement level document the history of Wenzhou from prehistoric times up until the 20th century. The upper floors contain temporary exhibition halls as well as exhibition halls dedicated to telling the story of the Three Gorges Dam and the relocation of over a million people to make…
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 1469 Nanbin Avenue (南滨路1469号)

spots.name: Tianshengcheng Ruins Park
spots.desc: Tianshengcheng or Tiansheng Fortress was one of several fortresses built in this region during the 13th century to defend the country against the Mongol Empire. Today the ruins are a national heritage site. There is signage throughout the park with information in Chinese and English. There is also a museum with exhibits on the history of the site, including the battles with the Mongols.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no tickets sold after 16:00, no entry after 16:10
spots.price: As of November 2025, the entry fee is ¥10 but this is likely to increase to ¥30 in 2026
spots.addr: 368 Tianlong Road (天龙路368号)

spots.name: Qingchengshan-Dujiangyan National Park
spots.desc: Dujiangyan Scenic Area is a world-famous ancient Chinese water conservancy project, known for its Taoist temples.

spots.name: Erwang Temple
spots.desc: A historic temple honoring Li Bing and his son, the engineers who designed the Dujiangyan Irrigation System. Rebuilt multiple times over the centuries, the halls contain cultural relics, river-god statues and inscriptions related to ancient water management.
spots.addr: Inside the Dujiangyan Scenic Area

spots.name: Wuyun Temple
spots.desc: Wuyun Temple is a historic Buddhist temple in Mangshi. It is known for its peaceful environment and vibrant incense offerings, and is a popular place for worship among locals and visitors alike. The temple is open all day and free to visit.

spots.name: Mengbana Xizhenqi Garden
spots.desc: Mengbana Xizhenqi Garden is an eco-park in Mangshi that integrates tropical plants, animals, and ethnic cultures. The garden showcases rich tropical plant and animal resources, as well as exhibits on the Dai, Jingpo, and other ethnic groups. It is open daily from 08:00 to 18:00, with an entry fee of ¥60.

spots.name: Feilai Temple
spots.desc: Amazing view of Meilixue Mountain worth seeing at sunrise. Feilai Temple also has a large number of hostels and hotels. Consider staying there instead of Deqin. The owner of "Once Upon a Time in FeiLaiSi" speaks English and can give advice on hiking in the area.

spots.name: Tuanshan Village
spots.desc: A historic village with more than 600 years of history. Tuanshan preserves traditional residences, village gates, temples and ancestral halls from the late Qing and early Republican periods. The village combines traditional Han Chinese courtyard houses with Yi-style earthen houses and is a nationally recognized traditional village and 4A-rated tourist attraction.

spots.name: Chaoyang Gate Tower
spots.desc: The preserved eastern gate tower of the former walled city of Lin'an and one of Jianshui's best-known landmarks. Built in 1389 during the Ming dynasty, it is the only one of the city's four original gate towers to survive substantially intact. The upper floors contain exhibition space and offer views over the old town. The building has been protected as a Major Historical and Cultural Site at the…

spots.name: Xingmeng Mongol Ethnic Township
spots.desc: The only ethnic Mongol township in Yunnan. Although the people known as "Yunnan Mongol", or Khatso, trace their ancestry to the Mongols of Khublai Khan, who conquered Yunnan in the 13th century, they actually speak the region's indigenous Yi language, rather than Mongol.

spots.name: Jiele Big Golden Pagoda
spots.desc: One of Wanding’s most significant religious sites, the Jiele Big Golden Pagoda captivates visitors with its towering, gold-plated exterior. The pagoda is surrounded by beautiful gardens and smaller stupas, making it an excellent spot for quiet reflection or photography. During major Buddhist festivals, the site comes alive with pilgrims and colorful ceremonies.

spots.name: Bihai Jinsha
spots.desc: A popular water park for Shanghai residents to visit on weekends. Covering a water area of 650,000 and an 80,000 sandy beach with sand transported from Hainan, it is one of the largest man-made beach resorts in China. The seawater here has been purified through sedimentation and treatment, making it the only stretch of (relatively) blue sea in Shanghai. This beach is suitable for family outings…
spots.addr: No.6 Haihan Road, Haiwan Tourist Resort

spots.name: Father and Son Double Jinshi Memorial Arches
spots.desc: Built by the Ming government in 1610 in honour of Rao Xiang and his son Rao Yuling, two scholar-officials from Chayang who both attained the Jinshi, the highest degree in China's imperial examination system.

spots.name: Wofo Town
spots.desc: Wofo Town used to be named Taipingchang. It was burned down in the late Ming Dynasty and rebuilt in the early Qing Dynasty and named Fuxing. Fuxing Township was established in 1951 and renamed Wofo in 1985. Wofo Town is a small town with a very modern atmosphere.
spots.addr: About 20 km northwest of the city

spots.name: Dujiangyan Phoenix Stadium
spots.desc: A multi-purpose stadium that is used mostly for association football matches. The stadium holds 12,700 people. The venue broke ground in February 2008 with original name Dujiangyan Sports Centre Stadium. It opened in May 2010 with a new name "Phoenix", which was in memory of the city rebirth from 2008 Sichuan earthquake.
spots.addr: No. 699 Caihong Avenue

spots.name: Border Trade Street
spots.desc: A 1-km-long trade market, showing the prosperity of border trade. Local Dai crafts such as wood carvings, leather and textiles are sold here, reflecting the diversity of local culture.

spots.name: Dalian Discovery Kingdom
spots.desc: An amusement park, which is said to the largest of its kind in Liaoning Province, with the fastest catapult roller coaster in Asia and the third fastest in the world.

spots.name: Dalongqiu Scenic Area
spots.desc: The main attraction in this zone is the Dalongqiu waterfall, literally "Big Dragon Pond" -- the waterfall is viewed as a dragon coming down to drink from the pool. At 197m high, it's one of China's highest waterfalls, and is most spectacular the first day or so after a rainstorm. The area also has some cliffs and rocks, including peaks claimed to resemble a pair of scissors.

spots.name: Xianshui Rock
spots.desc: Cliff looming over the river, with ancient coffins stuffed in holes. It is possible to visit a small temple built into the cliff, and the trail also winds around through a gap in the rock to the lower end of the rafting, then up to an eye-level viewpoint of another 15-20 ancient wooden coffins.

spots.name: Overseas Chinese Museum
spots.desc: A museum of Overseas Chinese culture and history, started by Tan Kah Kee who also founded Xiamen University. The #21 bus, from the train station to the university with a Zhongshan Road stop, has a stop at the museum. Special attention is given to overseas Chinese who returned to, invested in, or aided the homeland in some way, including activists and military volunteers. Labels are mostly in…
spots.hours: 09:30-18:00, no entry after 15:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: No.493 Siming Nan Lu (Siming South Road), Siming District (思明区思明南路493号)

spots.name: Guanghuigong Temple
spots.desc: A Taoist temple that was built during the Northern Song Dynasty, around 1066 CE. It is one of the earliest Taoist palace temples in Nanxun. It was called the "Guanghui Shrine" and primarily worshipped the City God. After multiple renovations during the Ming and Qing dynasties, it gradually integrated into both Buddhist and Daoist cultures and became one of the most important faith centers in the…

spots.name: Former Residence of Liu Ansheng
spots.desc: Commonly known as the “Red House” due to its exterior walls. It features a traditional Jiangnan-style facade while housing a European style interior complete with Roman columns and a grand ballroom, showcasing the unique aesthetic of its era.

spots.name: Qiushuli Villa
spots.desc: A villa built in 1930 by Liu Chenggan, the owner of the famed Jiaye Library. Blending Eastern and Western architectural styles, it was named “Qiushuli” (“Seeking Forgiveness”) to reflect Liu's scholarly and reclusive philosophy.

spots.name: Jili Natural Silk Exhibition Hall
spots.desc: Housed in a representative early modern building that once served as the Nanxun Chamber of Commerce. The exhibition hall is dedicated to the history of Nanxun's most famous product, Jili Silk, which brought immense wealth and international renown to the town.

spots.name: Baijianlou
spots.desc: Baijianlou was built by Dong Fen, the Minister of Rites during the Ming Dynasty, as a riverside residence for his servants. It was named for its initial number of about one hundred rooms. The buildings meander along the river, with arcade style corridors, arched gates, and firewalls arranged in a harmonious and orderly manner. It is the best preserved and most vibrant water town area in Nanxun…

spots.name: Liuyin Park
spots.desc: Park showing what rural China looks like. Also contains children's playground and a tea house.

spots.name: Poly Theatre
spots.desc: Large theater holding 1,428 seats, eight balcony boxes and two VIP boxes. Chinese, classical music, opera and ballet performances are staged here by both Chinese and international artist groups. The [Beijing Music Festival http://www.bmf.org.cn] is also held here.

It is the largest and oldest in town, covering 10,600 m² (114,000 ft²). The temple houses the Tianjin Buddhist Institute and exhibits many ancient statues. spots.name: Tianshi Cave (天师洞)
spots.desc: Tianshi Cave is the core Taoist site on Qingcheng Mountain. Founded over two thousand years ago, it preserves ancient Taoist halls, old cypress trees and religious relics. It is regarded as the birthplace of Chinese Taoism.
spots.addr: Inside Front Mountain scenic area of Qingcheng Mountain

spots.name: Shaxi Xingjiao Temple
spots.desc: In the main hall of Xingjiao Temple, there are more than 20 large-scale murals by Zhang Bao, an ancient Bai painter in Diantou Village, Shaxi. They are very precious. Among them, "Prince's Garden" and other paintings vividly depict the ancient Nanzhao and Dali palaces. Life has made up for the lack of historical records about the palace life of the ancient Nanzhao and Dali Kingdoms that were very…

spots.name: The Poly Museum
spots.desc: Small art museum specialising in bringing Chinese artifacts home to China from abroad. Main exhibitions cover ancient bronze art, ancient stone carvings and Buddha statues.

spots.name: Hanas National Nature Reserve
spots.desc: Kanas National Nature Reserve is in Xinjiang Province of China. Kanas is also called Hanas which is the name used by local Kazakhs. Kanas is the named used by local Tuvans, and has been recognised by local government as the official name.

spots.name: Qing'ao Bay
spots.desc: Nan'ao Island's beach, shaped like a crescent. Its "Natural Gate," a landmark tower marking the Tropic of Cancer, is a popular sunrise viewing spot.

spots.name: General's Mansion

spots.name: Nangzhik Gompa and Topgyel

spots.name: Maijishan National Park

spots.desc: This museum, which is constructed on both sides and underneath of a motorway, has galleries containing information about and full-scale replicas of chariots from various periods in Chinese history. The chariots are impressive. An archeological site displaying slain horses from an ancient Qi State royal tomb sits directly under the motorway and is the reason for the rather isolated location of…
spots.addr: Qiling Town, Linzi District

spots.name: Qin and Han Museum
spots.local: 陕西历史博物馆秦汉馆
spots.desc: Opened in 2024, this new museum is a branch of the Shaanxi History Museum. It specializes in displaying artifacts from the Qin and Han Dynasties. Visitors are expected to make a booking on the museum’s WeChat account before visiting the museum. The museum’s WeChat account may be found by searching for “陕西历史博物馆” on your WeChat app.

spots.name: Zhan Garden

Notably, it houses 346 ancient bronze drums, making it the world's largest and most comprehensive collection of such artefacts. Its textile collection comprises 18,600 items (sets), representing all 12…

The current structure mainly dates from the Ming and Qing dynasties. spots.desc: Scallion Pork Pastry are a highly representative traditional snack in Fuzhou, Fujian Province, and are loved by locals and tourists alike. They are typically found at small stalls or long-established shops, and are one of the most representative snacks of Fuzhou's street food culture.

spots.name: Quanzhou Museum of Overseas Chinese History
spots.desc: Each floor of the museum has a different focus. The first floor introduces the historical circumstances under which people emigrated from Quanzhou. The second floor has exhibits showing how Quanzhou migrants adapted to life abroad, particularly in Singapore, Malaysia and other parts of Southeast Asia. The top floor shows some of the contributions that Overseas Chinese people have made to…

spots.name: Suzhou Embroidery Research Institute
spots.desc: Suzhou is famous for embroidery work, with silk as the main material. The Suzhou style has a history going back 2000 years and is considered one of China's four great types of embroidery. (The others are centered in Changsha, Chaozhou and Chengdu.) The Institute functions as a museum, as a workshop for modern craftspeople, and as an outlet for their products. Prices may be somewhat higher than…

spots.name: Pilu Monastery
spots.desc: Built in the Tang dynasty and underwent major restorations under the Yuan and Ming dynasties. The main hall (Vairocana Hall; 毗庐殿; Pílúdiàn) contains a stone pedestal with excellent Tang carvings, as well as murals from the Yuan-Ming period, some of which are truly magnificent (if you have the luck to visit when the sunlight is good enough to observe the details).

spots.name: Dazhu Mountain
spots.desc: Dazhu Mountain is a 4A coastal scenic spot in Huangdao District, split into two zones: Zhushan Xiugu and Shimen Temple. Famous for vast wild azalea blossoms from March to May, it features grotesque rock formations, ancient grottoes and a centuries-old Buddhist temple built in the Jin Dynasty. Hiking uphill offers panoramic views over the Yellow Sea.

spots.name: Shuilu Nunnery
spots.desc: Originally, it was the Water and Land Hall within the Beiputuo Lanzhu Nunnery of Wuzhen Temple. Wuzhen Temple was first built during the Northern Dynasties, but the temple was later destroyed, leaving only the Water and Land Hall. The main hall contains more than 3,700 statues, making it the largest existing group of painted sculptures in China.

spots.name: Shantou Post Office Building
spots.desc: A post office in European style that was built in 1922 and used for the same purpose. There is a gallery about postcards and Shantou's postal history. As a serving post office, postal stamps and postcards are also sold there.

spots.name: Baisha Longmu Temple
spots.desc: Baisha Longmu Temple is a historic temple dedicated to Longmu, the Dragon Mother, on the western outskirts of Zhaoqing beside the Xi River. The temple was originally built during the Southern Song period and was designated a Zhaoqing municipal cultural heritage site in 1984. Surviving historic structures include the Guangyin stone archway, Longmu Pavilion and the rear hall.

spots.name: Temple of Madam Xian

Through its diverse programs—including exhibitions, workshops, and public lectures—the Chengdu…

The burial chamber has been excavated and is open to the public. An on-site museum displays artefacts that have been excavated from the tomb.

spots.desc: A rare mixed-religion temple dedicated to all 3 of China's main religions: Confucianism, Taoism and Buddhism. The temple was established during the Tang Dynasty and rebuilt during the Qing Dynasty. During the Second World War, the temple was used as a command post by the Chinese Expeditionary Force. It is now a national heritage site.

spots.name: Zhoukou Safari Park

spots.price: ¥138 (adults), ¥88 (seniors aged 60 or over and children between 1.2 and 1.39 meters in height)
spots.addr: 188 North Section, Zhongzhou Road, Chuanhui District (川汇区中州路北段188号)

spots.name: Qingtian River Scenic Area
spots.desc: A national 5A-level tourist attraction, it is known as the "Three Gorges of the North" because of its alternating canyons, mountains and waters, and boat tours are available.
spots.addr: 博爱县青天河镇

spots.name: Danhe Canyon
spots.desc: This scenic area encompasses a canyon along the Dan River. A river drifting activity is offered here during the summer months. The canyon walls feature preserved remnants of ancient freight cliff pathways carved in historical periods, alongside several natural rock caves. Sites of ancient fortifications believed to date from the Song and Ming dynasties are also located along the cliffs.
spots.addr: Changping Township, Qinyang City

spots.name: Yueshan Temple
spots.desc: Yueshan Temple is one of the four great ancient temples of Central China, alongside Shaolin, White Horse, and Xiangguo temples. Founded in 1158 during the Jin Dynasty, it is also the birthplace of Baji Quan (Eight Extremes Boxing). The temple is known for its tranquil atmosphere, ancient brick pagoda forest with 11 Ming-dynasty pagodas, and the Qigong Cave where the founder of Baji Quan…
spots.addr: Yueshan Town, Bo'ai County

spots.name: Chenjiagou Village
spots.desc: The birthplace of Tai Chi (Taijiquan), where visitors can explore the Tai Chi Ancestral Hall and the China Tai Chi Museum. Daily morning practice sessions (around 06:00-08:00) are held in the square, and visitors can join or watch local masters. The "Tonight in Donggou" evening light show is a popular optional activity featuring 3D projections and AR technology. Tai Chi classes and uniform…
spots.addr: Zhaobao Town, Wen County

spots.name: Hwamei Valley
spots.desc: Huamei Valley was named after the large number of Hwamei birds that inhabit and breed there.The Huamei Valley Scenic Area is rich in forest and water resources, with beautiful natural scenery that resembles a pastoral paradise and a landscape painting. It has great development potential and is a charming tourist destination in Central China.
spots.addr: Lushan County Yaoshan Town Si Daohe Village

spots.name: Jingju Temple
spots.desc: It was the source of the first Chinese section of the Buddhist "Tiantai school" as early as the fifth year of Tianbao in the Northern Qi Dynasty (554 CE), since the saint monk Huisi came to the Jingju Temple. Emperor Shenzong of Song bestowed the "Emperor entitled Brahma Temple" still conserved in the temple.

spots.name: WuHai Yellow River Road Bridge
spots.desc: The Wuhai Yellow River Highway Bridge is part of the National Highway 110 Haibowan to Mahuanggou section and one of the main longitudinal traffic frameworks of Wuhai City. The starting point of the bridge is located at Erdaokan, Bayintaohai Town, Hainan District, crossing the turbulent Yellow River to the west, and the end point is located at the east entrance of Bayinsaida Street, Wuda District.…
spots.addr: Hainan District G6 Beijing-Tibet Expressway

spots.name: Wuhai solar updraft power plant
spots.desc: As of early 2018, the Wuhai updraft power plant is the only updraft power plant in operation in the world. It is located in Jinshawan, near the Chinese city of Wuhai in a desert area of Inner Mongolia. The power plant has an installed capacity of 200 kW and went into operation on December 10, 2010.

spots.name: Quancheng Oleburg Dream World
spots.desc: It is a large theme amusement park. The scenic spot is dominated by European classic architectural styles and incorporates the most advanced technological elements from Europe and the United States. It has the most sophisticated equipment, the most complete projects, and the highest technological content in China. Quancheng Polar Ocean World sits to the east.
spots.addr: No. 08, Tourism Road, Yellow River International Ecological City, Qihe County

spots.name: Dongchang Lake
spots.desc: The largest urban lake in northern China. It surrounds the ancient city, forming a unique "city within water, water within city" landscape. Boating and cycling around the lake are highly recommended.
spots.addr: Dongchangfu District (东昌府区)

spots.name: Iron Pagoda of Longxing Temple
spots.desc: The iron tower is 18.5 meters high (some say 15.53 meters) and is an octagonal wooden structure cast iron Buddhist tower. It consists of four parts: the underground palace, the tower base, the tower body, and the tower brake. It has twelve octagonal floors and is known as one of the three treasures of Dongchang Prefecture, along with the Ganlu Temple Iron Tower in Zhenjiang, Jiangsu, the Yuquan…
spots.addr: West side of Xiaolibaisi Street, Dongchangfu District, Liaocheng City, Shandong Province, China

spots.name: Linfen Drum Tower
spots.desc: This impressive drum tower, located at the center of a busy roundabout in central Linfen, is the second tallest drum tower in China. (At 43.75 m tall, it is just a bit shorter than the one in Beijing.) Also known as Dazhonglou, this magnificent square tower was built in the Northern Song Dynasty, approximately 1000 years ago, and has been rebuilt a number of times since then, including in 1984.…
spots.addr: Yaodu District, Gulou East Street

spots.name: Huangqi Mountain
spots.desc: Huangqi Mountain is close to the railway station. It is a good choice for mountain climbing in Jieyang. This mountain is also one of the eight ancient scenic spots in Jieyang, and there are many cultural relics. There are steps on the mountain, and it is a good place to overlook the scenery of Jieyang.
spots.addr: The junction of Puning City and Jieyang City

spots.name: Gulongxia Rafting
spots.desc: A natural-water rafting course 6,063 m long with a vertical drop of 378 m.
spots.hours: Mid-April to end of October; usually 11:00-15:00 on weekdays
spots.addr: Sankengtan, Qingxin District, Qingyuan, Guangdong

spots.name: Zhanggong Temple
spots.desc: A small Ming dynasty temple that was built in 1587, one of the relatively well-preserved ancient buildings from the Ming Dynasty in the city. It was built by local people to pay homage to Zhang Yuanxun, the general of Guangdong during the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty. It features distinct architectural art characteristics. All the decorations, including poetry, colorful lyrics, painted…
spots.addr: 郁南县连滩镇城东路65号 65 Chengdong Road

spots.name: Beijing Police Museum
spots.desc: Large museum on police history.
spots.hours: 09:00-16:00, no entry after 15:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 36 Dongjiaomin Lane (东交民巷36号; Dōngjiāomín Xiàng)

spots.name: China Children's Art Theater

spots.name: Baiwangshan Forest Park
spots.desc: Small forest park, but close to the city, and not crowded.

spots.name: Yunhe Terraces Scenic Area

spots.name: Xinyang Tea Culture Festival

spots.desc: commercial and trade festival for the Chinese tea industry.

spots.addr: Shanzhou Park, Taiyang Road, Hubin District (湖滨区太阳路陕州公园内)

spots.name: Baiyu
spots.desc: A village with 100-200 traditional court yards. Baiyu is still rather unexplored, but it has plenty of guesthouses to sleep and eat in. Quality is good, prices low, the scenery is beautiful and the people friendly. Baiyu is about 6 km from the more well known ancient mountain village Cuandixia, so combining a visit to both places is a good idea. It costs ¥30 for tourists to enter the Cuandixia…

spots.name: China Quaternary Glacier Museum
spots.local: 中国第四纪冰川遗迹陈列馆
spots.desc: This museum was founded in 1992 and offers an introduction to geology, geography, and glaciers.
spots.addr: Moshikou Dajie (模式口大街)

spots.name: Manting Imperial Garden
spots.desc: Another pleasant park which is divided in eight parts, the main entrance, the National Cultural Plaza, the Tropical Orchid Garden, the Peacock Garden, the Life-leaving Lake, the Buddhism Cultural Quarter, the Planting Memorial Quarter and the Dai Cultural Teahouse. There are extra performances of singing, dancing and fire (which cost extra as well), check with the counter in the entrance for…
spots.addr: No.35 Manting Road

spots.name: Xishuangbanna Nationalities Museum
spots.desc: A museum about the various ethnic groups that live in Xishuangbanna.
spots.hours: Tue-Sun 09:00-12:00 (do not enter at 11:30), 13:00-17:00, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: Yulin Avenue (雨林大道)

spots.name: Enterprise Building
spots.desc: One of the headquarters of NetDragon, a company specializing in the development of online games and education software. Unusually, the building is designed to look like the Starship Enterprise from the Star Trek TV series, making this place a must-see for Star Trek fans. The building is not normally open to the public, but can be viewed from the outside.
spots.addr: Binhai Road (滨海路)

spots.name: Cishan Temple
spots.desc: This is also known as Tiantai Temple. You will be lucky to see this one: the temple only opens March 15–17 of every year.

spots.name: Shahu Lake
spots.desc: Consists of desert (an island of sand) and surrounding lake, islands, and marshlands. The reed marshes around the lake are habitats for more than 1 million birds in 190 or so kinds, including swans and red-crested cranes. On the island there are many attractions like camel riding, sand skiing, a chairlift up a sand dune, hot air balloon rides, jet skis, a salamander petting zoo, museums, a room…
spots.price: ¥120 for entry plus the large, slow boat to access the main sand island, but there are a bewildering array of other…

spots.name: Ziyun Cave
spots.local: 紫云苗族布依族自治县格凸河穿洞风景名胜区管理条例
spots.desc: A limestone karst cave that formed during the Jurassic Period. As is common in China, the cave is illuminated with multi-coloured lights.
spots.addr: Limu Village, Etang Town, Pinggui District (平桂区鹅塘镇栗木村)

spots.name: Zhongding Temple
spots.desc: A Ming dynasty Taoist temple.

spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 2 Jiyang West Road, Yangshe Town (杨舍镇暨阳西路2号)

spots.name: Former Residence of Wang Shizhen
spots.desc: The former residence of Wang Shizhen, who served as the Premier of the Beiyang Government during the Republic of China era, was built in 1912. Originally, it had three sections: east, central, and west, but only the central section remains. It is a two-courtyard Siheyuan.

spots.name: Shekou Sea World
spots.desc: A shopping/entertainment complex full of foreign restaurants, which has nothing to do with the US marine animal park. In 1984 Shekou was booming and there was a serious shortage of accommodation. To deal with this, the cruise ship "Ming Hua" (commissioned in 1962 in France) was moored alongside the dock and used as a floating hotel and restaurant. Only nine years before it had been the focus of a…
spots.addr: 1128 Wanghai Road, Shekou (蛇口望海路1128号)

spots.name: Central Revolutionary Base History Museum
spots.local: 瑞金中央革命根据地纪念馆
spots.desc: This memorial museum was established to commemorate the period of the Agrarian Revolutionary War, during which the Communist Party of China and its leaders—such as Mao Zedong, Zhu De, and Zhou Enlai—directly led the creation of the Central Revolutionary Base Area and the First Red Army, and founded the Chinese Soviet Republic.
spots.addr: No. 1, Longzhu Road, Xianghu Town

spots.name: Wanfenglin Scenic Area
spots.desc: Commonly known as the Forest of Ten Thousand Peaks, it is one of the five most beautiful parks in China and one of the three largest karst topographies in southwest China. It is a popular place for exploring the emerald green peaks, abundant golden rapeseed fields and quaint traditional villages. Additionally, the attraction is inhabited by locals, where farmers can be seen tending to the fields…
spots.price: Standard adult tickets are ¥70 between March and November, ¥60 between December and February, the tour bus charges ¥50
spots.addr: Wanfenglin Subdistrict (万峰林街道)

spots.name: 芒市米线馆
spots.desc: Mangshi Rice Noodle House is famous for its delicious local rice noodles. The restaurant serves a variety of Mixian (rice noodles) dishes, including spicy and sour versions with different meats, vegetables, and a rich broth. It's a must-visit for noodle lovers in the city.
spots.addr: No. 12 Mingxin Road

spots.name: Foding Shan
spots.desc: Or, you could hike up Foding Shan as described above under Huiji Temple. The summit, the highest point on the island, is a military radar station and cannot be accessed, but the temple is worth a visit and the route up passes some interesting rocks and structures.

spots.name: Doudian Site
spots.desc: A later Yan capital, walled before 279 BC and in use into the Han dynasty. Protected at municipal level. Little to see.

spots.name: Yellow River Wetland Cycling
spots.desc: A relaxing riverside ride through wetlands, bird habitats, and wooden boardwalks.
spots.addr: Wetland Belt Area

spots.name: Zhanggongxiang Kiln Site
spots.desc: The Zhanggongxiang kiln site from the end of the Northern Song Dynasty to the beginning of the Yuan Dynasty can be seen with ancient kiln ruins such as foundations and ash pits, as well as contemporaneous kiln equipment such as boxes and bowls. You can also see exquisite blue porcelain and specimens with thin body and glaze from this period, with glaze colors including sky blue, and egg blue.…
spots.addr: Intersection of Zhongda Street and Zhanggong Lane

spots.name: Li Lou Site
spots.desc: You can see relics such as house foundations, ash pits, and tombs from the Neolithic Age to the Xia Dynasty, as well as pottery, stone tools, bone artifacts, and some ash pits containing charred rice.
spots.addr: Northwest of Lilou Natural Village, Mazhuang Village, Yanglou Town

spots.name: Zhurong Feng Peak
spots.desc: The highest point in the park, at 1300.2m. There's a temple from the Ming dynasty on top.

spots.name: Roosevelt Library
spots.desc: Originally founded in 1938 as a branch of China’s National Library, the library was renamed the Roosevelt Library in 1946 in honor of US president Franklin D Roosevelt. In the 2020s, the library underwent major restoration work. It reopened to the public in 2026 as a branch of the Chongqing Library. The rooms have been restored to their original mid-20th century appearance and there is an…
spots.addr: Changjiang First Road (长江一路)

spots.name: Hechuan Binjiang Park
spots.desc: Hechuan Binjiang Park is a public riverside park along the Fujiang and Jialing Rivers in central Hechuan. It has green spaces and walking areas that can be used for leisure activities. Visitors can walk along the river and enjoy views of the surrounding waterways.
spots.addr: Jiabin Road

spots.name: Maling River Canyon
spots.desc: It is a national key scenic spot; the valley is deep and the flow is rapid, the murals are transcendent, and the silver waterfall is flying down, which is worthy of being the gap between the sky and the ground. It is a famous rafting resort in China, and the first China International Kayak Rafting Competition was held here in 1998. The whole course of rafting on the Maling River is more than 50…
spots.price: Admission around ¥70; sightseeing lift about ¥40 return

spots.name: Yun Temple
spots.desc: A Qing-dynasty historic building complex also known as the Yunnan Guild Hall. It was used as a meeting place for merchants and is closely connected with Gejiu's commercial and tin-mining history. The complex is a provincial-level protected cultural heritage site.
spots.addr: 1-15 Baohua Road

spots.name: Rui Li Daying River
spots.local: 瑞丽江－大盈江国家级风景名胜区
spots.desc: The Daying River flows through Rui Li and is an important waterway in the region, possessing high ecological and sightseeing value. The river has rapid currents and unique rock formations along its banks, creating many natural wonders. Visitors can relax by the riverside or engage in water activities like rafting. The picturesque scenery changes with the seasons, especially during the rainy…

spots.name: Fuling Museum
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:00, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 72 Xinghua Middle Road (兴华中路72号)

spots.name: Wenfeng Pagoda
spots.desc: A 13-storey pagoda dating from the early 19th century.
