The eastern end of the square contains a musical fountain that displays an artistically directed light, water and music show occasionally throughout the day. A semicircular viewing structure stands next to the fountain and statues of famous ancient…

spots.name: Shandong Communist Party History Museum
spots.desc: Three exhibition halls display the history of the Communist Party in Shandong Province.
spots.addr: 3 Gongqingtuan Rd, Tianqiao District

spots.name: Shandong Scientific and Technology Museum
spots.desc: Standing at the eastern end of Quancheng Square, this is a very simple museum for schoolchildren.
spots.addr: Nanmen Street

spots.name: Jinan Archaeological Museum
spots.desc: A small museum displaying the development of archaeological undertakings in Jinan.
spots.addr: 2 Qianfoshan West Rd, Lixia District

spots.name: Jinan Battle Memorial Hall
spots.desc: A museum dedicated to a battle that took place in Jinan during the Chinese Civil War. A stairway north of the memorial hall leads to the Revolutionary Martyr's Memorial Tower, a large war memorial dedicated to Communists who died during the Chinese Civil War. There is an excellent view of Jinan city from the point at the top of the hill where the tower stands.
spots.addr: Hero Mountain

spots.name: Jinan Museum
spots.desc: A short walk west from the northern main entrance to Qianfo Mountain; includes exhibitions on the history of the city, Chinese ceramics and old clocks.
spots.addr: 30 Jingshiyi Rd, Lixia District

spots.name: Jinan Planning Exhibition Hall
spots.desc: Small exhibition space at the north-west end of Quancheng Park shows the history of development of Jinan city. Temporarily closed.
spots.addr: 9288 Jingshi Rd, Lixia District

spots.name: Qianfo Mountain Scenic Spot
spots.desc: Must-see Jinan site, this famous park contains gardens, pavilions, a bizarre imitation cave with neon-lit Buddha art, an enormous golden Buddha, statues, the Shandong Revolutionary Martyr's Cemetery for the Revolution of 1911, and temples containing the ancient Buddha statues set into stone grottoes. The top of the hill has an impressive view over the city.
spots.addr: Jingshiyi Rd, Lixia District

spots.name: Quancheng Park
spots.local: 泉城公园 or Spring City Park
spots.desc: A large public park to the south of Jinan city centre and west of Qianfu Mountain. Paths lead through the densely planted park and around a central pond that contains swan-shaped boats that may be rented. A small children's amusement park stands beside the pond. At the eastern end is a small museum of ancient jades containing interesting examples from most Chinese dynasties (you may need to find…
spots.addr: No. 106 Jingshi Rd

spots.name: Shandong Carved-Stone Art Museum
spots.desc: Small museum displaying a collection of ancient stone carvings and statues.
spots.addr: 6 Qingnian East Rd, Lixia District

spots.name: Shandong University of Art & Design Gallery - Qianfoshan Campus
spots.desc: Art gallery within the campus of the Shandong University of Art and Design.
spots.addr: 23 Qianfoshan East Road, Lixia District

spots.name: Folk Art Paradise Museum
spots.desc: The former site of the out-patient clinic of Shandong Red Swastika Society (a Chinese version of the Red Cross/Red Crescent societies), this museum focusses on Chinese folk arts.
spots.addr: Wanda Plaza, 5 Jingsi Rd, Shizhong District

spots.name: Hongjitang Museum
spots.desc: A museum of traditional Chinese medicine based in a former building of the Hongjitang pharmaceutical company The building housing the museum was moved 8 meters in 2008 so that it would be saved from demolition.
spots.addr: 281 Jinger Rd, Huaiyin District

spots.name: Jinan Commercial Port Cultural Hall and Cai Gongshi Memorial Hall
spots.desc: A small museum displaying the history of the German Quarter and developments around the train station as China opened to the world. Shares a building with the Cai Gongshi Memorial Hall, a memorial at the site where Cai Gongshi, a negotiator sent by Chiang Kai-Shek to negotiate with the Japanese during the Jinan Incident, was murdered along with 16 members of his team by their soldiers.
spots.addr: 370 Jingsi Road, Huaiyin District

spots.name: Qilu Coin Museum
spots.desc: Shows coins and paper money from over 4000 years of Shandong history.
spots.addr: 382 Jingqi Rd, Shizhong District

spots.name: Qingdao-Jinan Railway Gallery
spots.desc: A museum showing the history and development of the Qingdao-Jinan railway.
spots.addr: 30 Station Rd, Shizhong District

spots.name: Shandong Museum of Letter Writing Culture
spots.local: 山东华夏书信文化博物馆
spots.desc: Includes exhibitions on the history of letter writing, ancient and modern letter writing, and the letter writing of famous people of Shandong. Very little here for non-Chinese speakers apart from a collection of Chinese postcards although the old colonial building (formerly Jinan Telegraph Office) still has original features and is worth a quick look around.
spots.addr: 91 Jingyi Road, Shizhong District

spots.name: Shandong Post and Telecommunications Museum
spots.desc: Located in the China Unicom building on the site of the former Shandong Postal Administration Office Building, this museum mainly displays information on the history and development of communications in Shandong Province.
spots.addr: 77 Jingsan Rd, Shizhong District

spots.name: Xiaoguanghan Film Museum
spots.desc: Formerly the site of Jinan Xiaoguanghan Theater, the earliest cinema in Jinan, this now exhibits objects related to film history.
spots.addr: 48 Jingsan Rd, Shizhong District

spots.name: Zhongshan Park
spots.desc: Jinan's oldest public park, which was rededicated mid-20th-century to the life and achievements of Chinese revolutionary and first president Sun-Yat Sen.
spots.addr: 132 Jingsan Rd, Shizhong District

spots.name: Huayang Palace
spots.desc: Taoist temple at the foot of Hua Mountain. The mountain was site of a famous battle during the Spring & Autumn period. There is another small temple halfway up the mountain with a viewing platform. Hua Spring, another of Jinan's famous springs is also at this site.
spots.price: ¥10 for the palace. Free to climb the mountain

spots.name: Jinan Zoo
spots.desc: Situated in the north-west of the city, this is a large zoo alongside the banks of the Xiaoqing River.
spots.addr: 87 Jieluo Road, Tianqiao District

spots.name: Xiaoqinghe River Comprehensive Treatment Exhibition Hall
spots.desc: An exhibition hall situated alongside the Qinghe River in northern Jinan, explaining the history and human management of the river.
spots.addr: North Qinghe Rd / North Lishan Rd, Tianqiao District

spots.name: Zhang Yanghao's Tomb Park
spots.desc: A short walk along the Xiluo River that flows into the Xiaoqing River, this small park contains the tomb of Yuan dynasty poet Zhang Yanghao and four of his family members.
spots.addr: Shuitun North Rd, Tianqiao District

spots.name: Jinan Olympic Sports Center
spots.local: 济南奥林匹克体育中心
spots.desc: A large complex holding the Jinan Olympic Sports Stadium, Gymnasium, Tennis Stadium, and Natatorium, as well as restaurants and cafes.
spots.addr: Hening Rd, Lixia District

spots.name: Jinan Police Museum
spots.desc: A small museum displaying police related relics from the Qing Dynasty and relating the history of the Jinan police force from foundation in 1902.
spots.addr: 17777 Lvyou Rd, Lixia District

spots.name: Baihua Park
spots.desc: A park at the eastern end of the city that contains the Filial Piety Culture Museum.
spots.addr: 10 Min Ziqian Rd, Licheng District

spots.name: Forest Park
spots.desc: Large well planned park with interesting walks and lots of activities taking place in the daytime.
spots.addr: 321 Zhang Zhuang Lu, Jinan

spots.name: Jiangshui Scenic Area
spots.desc: An attractive natural park, a number of hiking paths lead through the valleys and hills at the south-eastern edge of Jinan. There is a grotto containing some of Jinan's famous springs and ancient Buddha statues carved into a rock face. Higher on the hills is an enormous modern head of the Buddha and a platform with a view over Jinan.
spots.addr: Lvyou Rd

spots.name: Jinan Art Museum
spots.desc: At the junction of Lashanhe West Road and Weihai Road, this is a modern art museum.
spots.addr: Lashanhe West Rd, Huaiyin District

spots.name: Jinan Automobile Museum
spots.desc: On the campus of Shandong Transport University, this is a museum dedicated to the history of automobiles.
spots.addr: 118 Wuyingshanzhong Rd, Tianqiao District

spots.name: Shandong Military History Museum
spots.desc: Traces the history of Shandong during the anti-Japanese war.
spots.addr: 7777 Jingshi Rd, Shizhong District

spots.name: Shandong University Museum
spots.desc: A museum displaying the collection of the Department of Archaeology and School of Historic Culture of Shandong University over two floors. Floor 26 contains a number of texts written in examples of ancient Chinese writing while the larger floor 27 has descriptions of major archaeological finds in Shandong Province with well designed exhibitions, important relics on display and good English…
spots.addr: Zhixin Building, Shandong University Campus, 27 Shanda South Rd, Licheng District

spots.name: Tomb of Min Ziqian
spots.desc: Small garden containing the tomb of ancient Confucian philosopher Min Ziqian and a large number of statues and other relics from the larger graveyard that previously stood at this location.
spots.addr: 10 Min Ziqian Rd, Licheng District

spots.name: Yellow River Forest Park
spots.desc: A riverside park and garden on the northern bank of the Yellow River, this is at the most northern end of the city proper. The river can be crossed via a busy and old-fashioned floating bridge to a small village beside the park. A beach area along the river is busy with locals fishing and barbecuing in good weather.
spots.addr: 309 Guodao Rd, Tianqiao District

spots.name: Changqing Museum
spots.desc: Exhibits relics from the tomb of the Jibei King's Tomb from Western Han dynasty.
spots.addr: 17017 Jingshi Rd, Changqing District

spots.name: Changqing Qi Dynasty's Great Wall Tourist Area
spots.desc: An open air museum for the Great Wall of the Qi State, a precursor to the Chinese Great Wall that was used in defence of the ancient state of Qi that ruled half of Shandong before the first imperial consolidation of China.
spots.addr: 220 Zhangda Road, Changqing District

spots.name: Five Peak Mountain
spots.desc: A large natural park 10 km south-east of Changqing town containing two temples and pavilions. AAA attraction.

spots.name: Guo Family Ancestral Hall
spots.local: 孝堂山郭氏墓石祠 or Xiaotang Mountain Han Shrine
spots.desc: A funerary stone shrine from the Western Han dynasty on the bank of the Yellow River.
spots.addr: Xiaotangshan, Changqing District

spots.name: Jinan International Garden Expo Park
spots.desc: A large park with a number of different themed gardens. AAAA attraction.
spots.addr: Haitang Rd, Changqing District

spots.name: Shandong Traditional Medicine Museum
spots.local: 山东省中医药文化博物馆
spots.desc: Museum at the Shandong College of Traditional Chinese Medicine.
spots.addr: University Road, Changqing District

spots.name: Shandong University of Art & Design Museum
spots.desc: Located in Changqing Campus of Shandong University of Art & Design, this museum contains two collections: the Sun Changlin art collection and the Shandong Oriental Chinese Folk Art Museum.

spots.name: Shandong University of Art & Design Gallery - Changqing Campus
spots.desc: Art gallery within the campus of the Shandong University of Art and Design.
spots.addr: 1225 University Road, Changqing District

spots.name: Baimai Springs
spots.desc: Set within the Baimai Park in Zhangqiu district, this site was once the residence of Song dynasty poet Li Qingzhao. The park also contains other springs, a lake, historical buildings and a garden dedicated to the poet.

spots.name: Longdong Scenic Area
spots.desc: Includes the Dragon Cave, Buddha Ravine, Horse Hoof Ravine and a number of springs.
spots.addr: Lixia District

spots.name: Longshan Culture Museum
spots.local: 龙山文化博物馆 or 城子崖遗址博物馆
spots.desc: Museum connected to the Chengziya Relic Site, displaying items from the prehistoric Longshan culture including the famous black shell pottery.
spots.addr: 1 Longshan Town Administration West, Zhangqiu District

spots.name: Red Leaves Valley
spots.desc: A natural park in the mountains south of Jinan known for its autumn beauty.
spots.addr: 327 Provincial Rd, Licheng District

spots.name: Jinan International Convention & Exhibition Center
spots.local: 济南国际会展中心 or 济南国际会展
spots.desc: Large conference center on the eastern outskirts of the city proper. Mostly holds industry and business fairs but there are occasional cultural exhibitions too.
spots.addr: Huizha Rd, Lixia District

spots.name: Minghu Ju
spots.desc: Qing Dynasty theater showing traditional operas with a restaurant and tea house.
spots.addr: 29 Daminghu Rd, Lixia District

spots.name: Shandong Grand Theatre Opera Hall
spots.local: 山东省会大剧院歌剧厅
spots.desc: Modern theatre in the new western area of the city near the western railway station.
spots.addr: Weihai Road, Huaiyin Qu, 250000

spots.name: Huashan Lake walking trail
spots.desc: A 9.5-km walking route around Huashan Lake, with views of Hua Hill and the surrounding wetlands. Suitable for walking, jogging, and sightseeing.
spots.addr: Huashan Scenic Area, Licheng District

spots.name: Guihe Shopping Center
spots.desc: A luxury shopping center immediately to the east of Parc 66; Guihe shopping center holds high-end stores such as Armani, Boss, Louis Vuitton and Omega. At the eastern side of the building is the entrance to Jinan Crowne Plaza Hotel where you can have tea in the lobby or eat at the international buffet.
spots.addr: 3 Tian Di Tan Street, Quancheng Road, Lixia District

spots.name: Inzone Shopping Mall (Silva Plaza)
spots.desc: A large department store with a number of luxury boutiques such as Prada, this outlet of the Inzone chain stands a short walk from the south-eastern corner of Quancheng Square. The store can be entered from either the north or south of Luoyuan Street as a wing of the building is constructed over and on both sides of the street. There is a supermarket and small food hall in the basement.
spots.addr: 66 Luoyuan Street, Lixia District

spots.name: Parc 66
spots.local: 济南恒隆广场 or Plaza 66
spots.desc: This enormous modern structure stands immediately north of Quancheng Square with a convenient bridge passing between them. Lower storeys hold Western brands such as Adidas, Clarks, Nike, Omega, Pizza Hut, Starbucks, Swarovski, and Zara; higher storeys hold Chinese brands and high-quality restaurants. There is parking and a supermarket in the basement. A number of casual Chinese dessert cafes…
spots.addr: 188 Quancheng Rd, Lixia District

spots.name: Shimao International Square
spots.desc: A large modern shopping center on Quancheng Road, a short walk east from Guihe Plaza, this building holds a large number of modern Chinese brands and also some Western brands such as Casio, Costa Coffee, C&A and Uniqlo. There are cafes, restaurants and a bakery plus access through the building to the faux-ancient shopping district at the corner of Heilongquan West and Heilongquan North roads.
spots.addr: 26 Quancheng Rd, Lixia District

spots.name: Xinhua Book Store
spots.desc: Standing on the northern side of Quancheng Road, opposite Parc 66, this is an enormous multi-storey outlet for the national book selling chain. Foreign language books can be found on the top floor.
spots.addr: 185 Quancheng Rd, Lixia District

spots.name: Harmony Plaza
spots.desc: An enormous modern shopping center standing on the western corner of the junctions of Jingshi Road and Latitude 12th Road, this building hosts a number of Western brand stores such as C&A, H&M, Starbucks, Uniqlo, Vera Moda as well as restaurants and a cinema on higher storeys. Another shopping center, Liancheng International, containing more restaurants and a basement food hall stands on the…
spots.addr: 22799 Jingshi Rd, Huaiyin District

spots.name: Inzone Shopping Mall (Yuhan Branch)
spots.desc: Another branch of the Inzone chain, this is located to the north-west of Quancheng Square and conveniently placed for a day exploring the southern end of the city center.
spots.addr: 19288 Shijing Rd, Lixia District

spots.name: Wanda Plaza (Gaoxing)
spots.desc: A modern shopping mall next to the International Exhibition Center; there are many restaurants outside and behind the building and mixed Western and Chinese brands inside.
spots.addr: 57 Gongye South Rd, Lixia District

spots.name: Wanda Plaza (Weijiazhuang)
spots.desc: A large modern shopping mall at the eastern end of the German Quarter, this is the centrepiece of the larger Jingsi Road shopping district which also includes the Zhenhua and Daguanyuan department stores, an underground market beneath Jingsi Road (look for subway-style entrances on the pavements), and close proximity to the restaurants and cafes at the Greenland Puli Center.
spots.addr: Jingsi Road, Shizhong District

spots.name: Guangyou Tea City
spots.desc: Large shopping district for teas including warehouse size stores and a large number of classically styled boutique shops.
spots.addr: Zhuanghu Road, Huaiyin District

spots.name: Hero Mountain Culture Market
spots.desc: A large market with scores if not hundreds of stalls selling ancient-styled furniture, homeware, books, and antiques of all sorts. Thriving on Saturdays when a bird and insect market also takes place outside the western entrance to the culture market.
spots.addr: 46 Ma'anshan Rd, Shizhong District

spots.name: Qilu Qixian Culture City
spots.desc: A market selling cultural items from a number of stores such as the Stone Appreciation Museum and Red Sun Bookstore.
spots.addr: 122 Jiwei Road, Shizhong District

spots.name: Technology Markets District
spots.desc: At the junction of Jiefang Road and Shanda Road, on each of the northern corners stand Saibo Digital Square and Huaqiang Electronics World, two large multi-storey indoor technology markets. Further north along Shanda Road stand a host of other electronics markets and stores. It would be difficult to get a good deal without Mandarin skills.
spots.addr: Shanda Rd, Lixia District

spots.name: Bon Appetit
spots.desc: Authentic Italian food. Pastas, pizzas and entrees from ¥70 served in an elegant atmosphere. Most of the staff speaks English and there's an English menu.
spots.addr: Lushang Shopping Center in Yuhan Inzone Mall, B-204

spots.name: Furong Street
spots.desc: Jinan's famous food street, a long narrow alley with traditional buildings holding scores of restaurants, canteens, bakeries and stalls. Foods range from traditional dishes and snacks to experimental desserts.
spots.addr: Lixia District

spots.name: Lydia restaurant
spots.desc: An Italian restaurant. Favorite place of foreign students and young Chinese. The food is not as good and tasty as in Jenny's, but cheaper.
spots.price: About ¥40 for a lunch with drinks
spots.addr: 38 Shanda Road (山大路38号 Shandalu)

spots.name: Muslim Quarter
spots.desc: The authentic Muslim Quarter (Huimin Qu) is set among busy alleys in the city block immediately to the West of Baotu Spring. There are many barbecue restaurants where one may eat lamb and drink beer; many have outdoor seating with tiny chairs and tables. There are a couple of mosques and market stalls with fresh fruits, vegetables, cloth and trinkets.
spots.addr: Yinhuchi Street

spots.name: Daguanyuan
spots.desc: A shopping mall with fast food chains on the street, restaurants serving regional Chinese cuisines within an inner courtyard, and alleys of simple food stalls.
spots.addr: 34 Xiaowei Er Rd, Shizhong District

spots.name: Liancheng International Shopping Centre
spots.desc: Multi-storey shopping centre with a range of restaurants including a second branch of Tales of a Small Town, plus a food hall in the basement.
spots.addr: Jingshi Rd, Shizhong District

spots.name: Tales of a Small Town
spots.desc: Attractive restaurants with interiors designed to evoke mid-20th century small-town life, the main attraction for locals is the stewed chicken cooked in enormous outdoor pots next to the entrance. Service is good and there are a variety of interesting dishes.

spots.name: Silver Sky Revolving Restaurant
spots.desc: Extravagant restaurant at the top of the Sofitel Jinan Silver Plaza serves both Asian and Western dishes.
spots.addr: 66 Luoyuan Avenue, Lixia District

spots.name: Maan Coffee (CCPARK)
spots.desc: First Jinan branch of the trendy national coffee chain situated on the ground floor of the CCPARK shopping center, this Maan Coffee has an attractive interior and serves all types of coffee along with large desserts such as waffles and French toast. Free wifi connections and a late close at midnight.
spots.addr: CCPARK, 1 Foshan Rd, Lixia District

spots.name: Maan Coffee (Greenland Puli Center)
spots.desc: The city's second branch of the trendy national chain, this is situated at the bottom of the prominent Greenland Puli Center, Jinan's tallest and most prominent building. Another attractive interior, free wifi and various coffees and desserts make this a pleasant spot for a late night break.
spots.addr: Greenland Puli Center, 28 Gongqingtuan Road, Shizhong District

spots.name: Old Town Ancient Photograph House
spots.desc: In the centre of Jinan's Old Town, a short walk from the Daming Lake and Furong Street, this small coffee counter serves iced lattes and other drinks, perfect for exploring the alleys and springs of the Old Town on a hot summer day.
spots.addr: 9 Qushuiting Street, Lixia District

spots.name: Jenny's Cafe
spots.desc: Offers a wide range of cuisines including Italian and Mexican. This place used to be a foreigner hangout until management changed and the staff became unfriendly, the dishes halved in size and the prices doubled. Expensive western food in addition to many expensive drinks. Prices are like European prices, but at least you can eat something else than garlic beans and tofu. They also serve imported…

spots.name: Lang Kwui Fong
spots.desc: Cheaper than the clubs and more lively than English Corner. This is a favorite of many foreign students, although some locals come here as well.
spots.addr: Wenhua Dong Rd

spots.name: Soho Disco
spots.desc: Western-oriented disco. Populair with foreign students. Different kinds of beer are available.

spots.name: Cinderella
spots.desc: A big club, mostly locals visiting. The main alternative to 1+1.
spots.addr: Jingshi Lu, underneath the big sports stadium

spots.name: Linyi Animal and Botanical Garden
spots.desc: The only large-scale ecotourism destination in Subei, and the first wildlife rescue station in Linyi City, Zaozhuang City, etc.

spots.name: Yimeng Mountain Tourism Area
spots.desc: The Mount Yimeng Tourist Scenic Area comprises Yishan Scenic Area, Mengshan Yunmeng Scenic Area, and Guimeng Scenic Area. Its core scenic area includes the Qi Great Wall, a World Cultural Heritage site renowned as a health and longevity destination. The area is now a national 5A tourist scenic site, a national forest park, a national geopark, and a national water conservancy scenic area.

spots.name: Bamboo spring village
spots.desc: The bamboo forest, spring water, ancient village natural forms and various folk-custom projects of Zhuquan Village are examples of the beautiful village construction in China.
spots.addr: in Tongjing Town, Yinan County

spots.name: Underground Grand Canyon in Shandong
spots.desc: Shandong Underground Grand Canyon lies the sprawling Grand Canyon, measuring an impressive 6,100 m in length. Within its expanse, a 3,100-m-long collection of scenic marvels has taken shape. This cavern, forged between 65 million to 230 million years ago, originated from a colossal karst fissure. It proudly ranks as one of China's grandest karst caves and bears the distinguished title of the…

spots.name: Tianyu Natural History Museum
spots.desc: Enormous museum of natural history across two large buildings. Built by a local billionaire to house his enormous personal collection of fossils and minerals. The museum holds the Guinness World Record for largest dinosaur museum in the world and there are numerous Guinness World Record awarded items inside, usually for being the largest. AAAA attraction.
spots.addr: Linyi, Pingyi, Lianhuashan Rd

spots.name: Linyi Guantang Hot Spring Resort
spots.desc: Guan Tang Hot Spring is located in the ancient town of Millennium Hot Spring with beautiful scenery on the east bank of Yihe. Guantang Hot Spring is planned according to the national AAAA-level tourist attraction standard, mainly by "Jiangbei first, leading in the country" large open-air hot spring park.
spots.addr: Intersection of Binhe East Road and Wensi Road, Hedong District

spots.name: Tianfo Tourist Area
spots.desc: The Buddha landscape can be found in the northern region of Jian County. It spans about 40 km² and features the Buddha Scenery, Lotus Lake, and Shui Temple, amongst other attractions. The Buddha landscape is officially recognised as a National Geological Park.
spots.addr: Tianqiao Road North Park Road No. 1

spots.name: Hiking trail starting point
spots.desc: Start the ascent here. Hiking up the mountain can be tiring (about 4–7 hours of stairs), but there are places to stop along the way and buy water and drinks; prices increase as you climb.

spots.name: Zhanqiao Pier
spots.desc: Zhanqiao Pier, built in 1891 under the direction of Qing Dynasty general Zhang Gaoyuan, is Qingdao's oldest artificial pier and a key provincial cultural relic. Originally a 200-meter naval wharf, it was expanded to its current 440-meter length in 1931, extending into Qingdao Bay. The pier is renowned as "a rainbow stretching far into the distance" and features an octagonal pavilion, the Huilan…
spots.addr: No. 14 Taiping Road, Shinan District

spots.name: Qingdao Textile Valley
spots.desc: Once a major textile mill, this vast industrial complex has been transformed into a creative art district. It features graffiti-covered walls, contemporary art installations, and spacious lofts, making it a paradise for urban exploration and photography.

spots.name: Baihuayuan Gardens
spots.desc: Small park with lots of trees, flowers and sculptures. For many years it was the cemetery for foreigners, but the cemetery was destroyed during the Cultural Revolution. It is now a beautiful park with sculptures of writers, artists, and revolutionaries.
spots.addr: 55 Yan'an First Rd (延安一路55号; Yán​'ān​ Yīlù​)

spots.name: Polar Ocean World
spots.desc: An aquarium focusing on polar animals, including polar bears and penguins. Newer and more modern than the Underwater World. It has a well known Beluga whale and dolphin show, as well as a daily large seal exhibition.

spots.name: Qingdao Eastern Bear Park
spots.desc: A new attraction in Qingdao that houses Asian Black Bears (Dog Bears) among others. The bears are segregated by age, and visitors can feed them the food provided. While the bears are interesting, there are large numbers crammed in relatively small spaces. Bear shows take place several times a day and feature bears with chains around their necks being hit by their trainers until they perform…
spots.addr: Next to Shilaoren Sightseeing Park, No. 1 Laoshan Road, Laoshan District

spots.name: Xiaoyushan Park
spots.desc: A park built in traditional Chinese style in 1983. It has great hilltop views of Qingdao especially during sunrise.
spots.addr: 24 Fushan Access Rd

spots.name: Xinhaoshan Park
spots.desc: This hill was used by the Germans as a signalling station, and was later turned into a park. It has lovely landscape and features a revolving tea shop offering a 360-degree panorama of Qingdao. Visitors will also see the Heart to Heart Bridge, where local couples place a heart-shaped padlock on the bridge to ensure that their relationship will last forever.
spots.addr: No. 16 Jia Longshan Road, Shinan District, Shandong

spots.name: Museum of the Chinese People's Liberation Army Navy
spots.local: 中国人民解放军海军博物馆, previously known as the Qingdao Naval Museum
spots.desc: A major national-level museum with exhibits on the history of the Chinese navy, as well as full-size warships that visitors may tour. The museum includes indoor exhibition halls and an outdoor area with decommissioned warships and submarines. Visitors can board some of the vessels. The museum is located near the old town and is a short walk from Renmin Huitang Metro Station (Line 3). Advance…
spots.addr: 8 Laiyang Rd, Shinan District (市南区莱阳路8号)

spots.name: Qingdao Municipal Museum
spots.local: 青岛市博物馆; Qīng​dǎo​shì Bówùguǎn
spots.desc: This museum includes exhibits of art and antiquities of ancient to modern Qingdao, and exhibits on porcelain and calligraphy.
spots.addr: 27 Meiling Rd, Laoshan District (崂山区梅岭路27号; Láo​shān​qū Méilǐnglù)

spots.name: Qingdao Art Museum
spots.local: 青岛市美术馆; Qīngdǎoshì Měishùguǎn​
spots.desc: The building is a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit, the former site of the Qingdao Branch of the Red Swastika Society. It is divided into three exhibition halls: the front courtyard (Roman-style architecture), the middle courtyard (traditional Chinese palace-style architecture), and the rear courtyard (Islamic-style architecture).
spots.addr: 7 Daxue Rd (大学路7号; Dà​xué​lù​)

spots.name: Tsingtao Brewery Museum
spots.local: 青岛啤酒博物馆; Qīngdǎo Píjiǔbówùguǎn
spots.desc: The museum offers a self-guided tour through the original 1903 brewery buildings, including the fermenting hall and the historic bottling line. The tour takes about 1-1.5 hours. Visitors can see original brewing equipment, historical photographs, and exhibits on the development of China's beer industry. The tour ends at a bar area where the included beer samples are served. The museum is a short…
spots.price: ¥50 for regular ticket, ¥70 including one hour free drinking
spots.addr: 56 Dengzhou Rd (登州路56号; Dēng​zhōu​lù​)

spots.name: German Governor's Residence
spots.desc: A Bavarian-style castle where Mao stayed as well. Also the observatories on the hills around it are interesting for good views and museum sites.
spots.addr: No. 26, Longshan Road, Shinan District

spots.name: Qingdao German Prison Site Museum

For the best daytime photos, head to the peak of Shangxian Bridge, where you can capture stunning views of the tower. Haidai Tower lights up around 18:30 and turns off at 23:00. If you’d like to capture the moment it lights up, be sure to arrive a bit early. The light show starts after 20:00 and is…
spots.addr: Qisheng Lake Park, Zhangdian District (山东省淄博市张店区齐盛湖公园)

spots.name: China Ceramics and Glazed Glass Museum
spots.desc: As one of the largest and most comprehensive modern museums dedicated to ceramics and glazed glass in China. The museum spans four floors, with two galleries on the first floor and around six galleries on each of the remaining floors. Here, visitors can explore ceramic artworks from the Neolithic era to the present, as well as exquisite glassware from around the world and innovations brought by…
spots.hours: 09:00-18:00 (last entry at 17:30), closed on Mondays except public holidays

spots.name: Zhengjue Temple
spots.desc: Zhengjue Temple in Boshan is a serene and charming spot, ideal for a calm break amidst travel. The temple’s traditional Buddhist architecture and peaceful setting make it a worthwhile visit, especially since it’s free to enter. After exploring the temple, head to Qingmei Residence Boshan Halal Restaurant nearby, a local favorite known for its crispy beef jerky and sesame beef. It’s an authentic…
spots.addr: Anshang Village, Boshan District

spots.name: Qi Heritage Museum
spots.desc: This museum contains galleries about the ancient Qi State that once controlled half of modern Shandong Province. A second paid-for gallery contains relics from an ancient royal tomb; very much like the Terracotta Warriors in miniature. There is also some information about China's ancient football-like sport 'cuju' and a confirmation from FIFA that Zibo was the origin of professional soccer…
spots.hours: Tue-Sun 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays (except for Chinese public holidays)
spots.addr: No. 308, Linzi Avenue, Linzi District

spots.name: Thousand Buddha Temple
spots.desc: Thousand Buddha Temple is located across from the north gate of Zhoucun Ancient Commercial City, offering a stark contrast to the bustling crowds of the marketplace. Its modest exterior can easily be overlooked. However, inside lies a charming garden surrounded by six grand halls, forming a historic architectural complex where Buddhism, Taoism, and Confucianism coexist harmoniously.
spots.addr: Shinjian West Road, Zhoucun District

spots.name: Red Leaf Persimmon Rock Tourism Area
spots.local: 山东文旅红叶柿岩旅游区
spots.desc: Autumn is the most beautiful time in this tourist area. The best viewing days are from Sep 1 to Nov 30. Lushang Red Leaf Persimmon Rock Tourist Area is in a valley surrounded by mountains, with a rural atmosphere. Scenic buildings covered by blue stone masonry and red tiles are built in the mountains, and there are well-preserved Qing buildings.
spots.addr: Heshangfang Village, Boshan District

spots.name: Badaju Pedestrian Street
spots.desc: This is a pleasant spot for a leisurely stroll, with old buildings on both sides of the street. Here, you’ll find plenty of authentic Zibo snacks and unique handmade craft shops—enjoyed by locals and visitors alike. The area isn’t very large, but has winding alleys and a lively crowd, and there are many long-established stores that may be of interest to you. If it’s your first time in Zibo…

spots.name: Xiaofu River Wetland Park
spots.desc: Known for its expansive water surfaces and natural wetland landscapes, it’s a popular spot for nature lovers and families to enjoy a peaceful day outdoors. The park features walking and biking trails, along with seasonal fountain shows, making it a great place for relaxation and active exploration. Watch out for mosquitoes, though. There are music fountain shows; check the schedule in advance if…

spots.name: Tangku Cultural and Creative Park
spots.desc: Tangku Cultural and Creative Park was converted from the original Mashang Warehouse of Zibo’s Sugar and Wine Station, which used to be a national sugar reserve storage facility—hence the name “Tangku.” Admission is free, but the location is a bit out of the way. From the train station, it’s about a 30-minute bike ride or around 20 minutes by car. If you’re visiting on a weekend, it’s best not to…
spots.price: Admission is free, but if there is a special festival market, tickets may be required, priced around ¥10
spots.addr: No. 1 Heping Road, Mashang Town

spots.name: Qishan Scenic Area
spots.desc: Not only is the natural scenery breathtaking, but Qishan Scenic Area also has deep cultural significance. Here, you can find relics such as stone rice mills from the military camps of the Qi State during the Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods, as well as the ancient Qi Great Wall. This area was the site of the uprising led by Tang Saier, a heroic woman from Putai, Shandong, during the…
spots.hours: Open year-round, Mon to Fri from 08:00-17:00，Saturdays and Sundays from 07:30-17:30
spots.price: The ticket price is ¥68 (online booking is more convenient)
spots.addr: 5 km south of Taihe Town Government, Zichuan District

spots.name: Mata Lake Wetland Park
spots.desc: Within the scenic area, there are various transportation options for visitors, including rowboats, motorboats, pleasure boats, and sightseeing shuttles. The most unique experience is the rowboat, which takes you through the scenic reeds for about 30 minutes at a price of ¥99 per person. This boat ride, which follows the water route into the park, includes the entrance ticket. Tickets can be…
spots.hours: The park's opening hours are typically from 08:30-17:00 daily, but specific times may vary due to seasons or special…
spots.addr: Mata Lake Wetland Park, Dibo Town, Gaoqing County

spots.name: Tanxi Mountain Scenic Area.
spots.desc: After reaching the high-altitude glass walkway, you can follow the downhill stone path with this recommended route: Longfeng Terrace → Beauty Cave → Three Teachings Temple → Heaven Bridge (Upper and Lower) → Dragon’s Back Peak → Sky Glass Rafting. This path has a high concentration of red-leaf forests, making it a beautiful and easy walk. The path is not steep, with vibrant red, orange, yellow…

spots.addr: Tanxi Mountain Scenic Area,Shigou Village, Ezhou Township, Taihe Town, Zichuan District

spots.name: Lushan National Forest Park
spots.desc: Lushan, the fourth-highest mountain in Shandong, stands at an elevation of 1,108.3 meters. Lushan Forest Park is mainly divided into two scenic areas: Zaoshuyu Scenic Area and Guanyun Peak Scenic Area. There are no additional charges once you enter, and there are no cable cars or glass bridges. Unlike mountains with well-paved stairways, Lushan remains relatively undeveloped and closer to its…
spots.price: Entrance Fee: ¥40 per person.Car Entry Fee: ¥20.If you stay at a hotel inside the park, the entrance fee is waived.
spots.addr: Shagou Village, Chishang Town, Boshan District

spots.name: Qi Culture Festival
spots.desc: Takes place annually from September 12 to November. The specific dates may vary depending on the year, but the general timeframe typically falls between September 12 and November.First established in 2004, the Qi Culture Festival features a wide range of cultural, tourism, and academic activities during its run. Events include ceremonies to honor the birthday of Jiang Taigong, visits to the Guan…

spots.name: Cornfield Barbecue (Main Branch)
spots.desc: Zibo has five branches of Cornfield Barbecue, but due to its popularity, you may need to wait in line. It’s a good idea to call ahead and make a reservation. If you're unable to, be sure to arrive early to take a number. If your phone battery tends to run out quickly, don't forget to bring a power bank. If you forget, don't worry,there are shared power banks available all around China. You can…
spots.addr: 118 Manan Rd, Fujia Town, Zhangdian District

spots.name: Wu's Barbecue (Honggou Road Branch)
spots.desc: The restaurant is very close to Zibo Railway Station, just a 10-minute drive away. Wu's Barbecue has 30 branches across Zibo, but the most popular one is this location on Honggou Road. The dishes here are very affordable, and the restaurant is equipped with electric grills, so there's no need to worry about undercooked meat causing stomach issues. The restaurant does not accept…
spots.addr: No. 21, Honggou Road, Zhangdian District, near Honggou North Street and Honggou West Street

spots.name: Xiaohanyang Barbecue
spots.desc: The prices at Xiaohanyang Barbecue are slightly higher compared to other barbecue restaurants, but the fresh ingredients and pleasant environment make it worth it. Additionally, the restaurant has a ventilation system, so you won’t leave with unwanted odors on your clothes. Sesame salt and garlic need to be purchased separately, as they are not provided for free. Bread slices can easily burn.…
spots.addr: First floor of the Kairui Times Building, at the southeast corner of the intersection of Renmin West Road and Xianghe Road, Zhangdian District

spots.name: Juyouzai (Liuquan Road Branch)
spots.desc: Local diners typically order three must-try dishes: Tea-Flavored Pork Ribs (slightly sweet), Boshan Fried Pork, and Qiugao (a traditional cake). These dishes generally suit most tastes. For other options, feel free to choose dishes you like or are curious to try,it’s a great way to explore something new! Keep in mind that the portions for each dish are quite large. If you can’t finish your meal…
spots.addr: 166 Liuyuan Road, Zhangdian District, near the Youth Palace to the south.

spots.name: Youyicun Grand Hotel (Liantong Road Branch)
spots.desc: If you’ve just visited the Haidai Tower Zhongshuge bookstore, you can take a taxi to this restaurant in just 15 minutes. It’s recommended to arrive about 30 minutes early to register your number at the entrance. If it’s crowded, you might have to wait quite a while. The portions here are very generous, so dining with a group is more cost-effective as you’ll get to try a wider variety of dishes.…
spots.addr: 2nd Floor, Units 8–10, No. 26 Liantong Road, Zhangdian District

spots.name: 48 Bar
spots.desc: And is where Zibo's expats as well as locals head on Friday or Saturday Evenings to kick back. The beers are relatively cheap for a foreigner bar: large Qingdao bottles are ¥10. Liquor is a little more expensive at about ¥30 to ¥50 for a single shot of your favourite Vodka, Tequila or Jack Daniel's. Zibo's small expat population make most patrons usually very friendly and they will even let you…
spots.addr: Liuquan Lu (六泉路)

spots.name: Montana Bar
spots.desc: A cozy bar with a great ambiance and perfect lighting. Jazz music and classic movies play in the background, allowing you to sip a drink while watching a film (non-alcoholic options are also available for those who don’t drink). A variety of snacks are offered, and the atmosphere is pleasantly quiet—ideal for chatting with friends over drinks. Here’s a tip: you don’t have to stick to the menu.…
spots.addr: No. 6 North Xiwulu Road, Courtyard 8, Building 1, Floor 1, Zhangdian District

spots.name: Qi Wang Fu Night Club
spots.desc: Most taxi drivers are familiar with this location, so getting there should be easy. Entrance is typically free for ladies and costs around ¥10-20 for men. Known among foreigners as the "bouncy club," it offers a lively atmosphere for those who enjoy dancing. The dance floor is larger than in most Chinese nightclubs, with plenty of local techno music. Drinks are on the pricier side, so locals…
spots.addr: No. 66 Huaguang Road, Zhangdian District

spots.name: Second Cosmic Velocity Coffee & Pub
spots.desc: During the day, this place is a warm and inviting coffee shop. Their lattes are especially worth a try. It’s a great spot to get some work done, use the Wi-Fi, or just take a break with friends. After 19:00, it shifts into a bar, serving a wide range of cocktails, including some unique Chinese herbal mixes if you’re up for something different.
spots.addr: No. 61, Dongyi Road, Zhangdian District

spots.name: Haida Tower Whisky Bar
spots.desc: This bar is often called a “Harry Potter-style pub” by visitors for its unique and creative atmosphere. The decor stands out, and the bartenders sometimes organize fun games based on the crowd size. If you enjoy lively places with lots of people, you’ll love it here. Since it’s located in Haidai Tower, you can always head downstairs to explore if you’re looking for something to do after a drink.…
spots.addr: 5th Floor, Haidai Tower Zhongshuge Bookstore, Qisheng Lake Park, Zhangdian District

spots.name: naaaachr
spots.desc: This café is inside the botanical garden, making it a perfect spot to take a break if you’re feeling tired. It has two floors, and since it’s right by the lake, the view from the second floor is especially nice—a great choice for anyone who enjoys taking photos. However, it can get crowded on weekends, and some desserts might sell out, so it’s best to arrive early.
spots.addr: 28 Shiji Road, Zhangdian District

spots.name: Le Yin Dessert
spots.desc: The interior of the shop has a Japanese-inspired design, and the view through the windows reveals a garden full of greenery that feels straight out of a movie. Drinks are priced around ¥30 each, while canelés are available for ¥19 but only on Sundays and Wednesdays. If you’re a fan of scones, make sure to arrive early. The owner is very friendly, and if you’re interested in baking, she’s more…
spots.addr: East of Building 20, Wangxin Community, Southeast Bamboo Grove, Zhangdian District

spots.name: Mountain Blossom Tea House (Fuyuan Branch)
spots.desc: This place feels like a blend of a tea house and an art gallery, offering a quiet and calming environment. The teas here are of good quality, with some sourced from their own plantations. If you’re not familiar with tea, just tell the staff what you like, and they’ll recommend something that suits your taste. Each cup of tea you order comes with a card detailing the type of tea used, its flavor…
spots.addr: No. 117, Building C, Fuyuan Yunshu, at the intersection of Gongqingtuan West Road and Shiji Road, Zhangdian District

spots.name: Chunyang Taoist Temple
spots.desc: A small collection of Daoist temples and a peaceful courtyard. A more human scale than the nearby Huayan Monastery. Completely rebuilt in 2010.

spots.name: Datong Confucian Temple
spots.desc: Datong was the first city outside of Qufu to establish a place for worshipping Confucius. The current Confucian temple was built in the early Ming Dynasty, and its original features include the Halberd Gate, Dacheng Hall, Ancestral Hall of Local Worthies, Ancestral Hall of Famous Officials, Divine Storehouse, and Divine Kitchen. The Confucian Temple also preserves some relocated historical…
spots.addr: Yunlu Street, Pingcheng District

spots.name: Emperor Temple
spots.desc: The Dijun Temple was built during the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty. It is a three-courtyard temple dedicated to the Taoist deity Wenchang Dijun and also serves as the location of the Datong Taoist Association. The main hall (Yuhuang Pavilion), side halls, and western side hall are Ming Dynasty structures. Wenchang Dijun is the deity who protects literary fortune and examinations.
spots.addr: No. 67, Shizi Street, Pingcheng District

spots.name: Chunyang Palace
spots.desc: Chunyang Palace is the largest Taoist temple in the ancient city of Datong. The temple is divided into two sections: the western section is a garden, and the eastern section has three courtyards. Along the central axis are the mountain gate archway, Lingguan Hall, Zushi Hall, and Sanqing Hall, with side halls and kiln houses on either side. The palace buildings feature Taoist-themed murals…
spots.addr: No. 8, Gulou West Street, Pingcheng District

spots.name: Great Mosque
spots.desc: First built in the second year of the Zhenguan era of the Tang Dynasty, and rebuilt during the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The current structure dates from the Qing Dynasty to the Republic of China period. The Great Mosque is an example of the fusion of Chinese and Islamic architectural styles. For instance, the main prayer hall is largely in the style of Qing Dynasty architecture, but its domed…
spots.addr: No. 5, Jiulou Lane, Pingcheng District

spots.name: Yuantong Temple
spots.desc: The first temple was built here in the Ming Dynasty but was destroyed during the Qing army's massacre at Datong. In 1664, Emperor Kangxi ordered its reconstruction to pray for the souls of those killed in the massacre. This temple is the only one in the ancient city of Datong that faces north. The buildings along the central axis are Qing Dynasty structures.
spots.addr: Pingcheng District, Bawutujing Lane

spots.name: Datong Christian West Church
spots.desc: The West Church was renovated in 2006, and its spire with a cross is a key feature of the ancient city's skyline.
spots.addr: No. 13 Qipan Street, Pingcheng District

spots.name: Church of Our Lady of the Sacred Heart
spots.desc: An cultural relic of Datong City. It was built in 1891, and was burned down by the Boxers and rebuilt in 1906. The bell tower was destroyed during the Cultural Revolution and renovated in 1982, followed by further restoration in 2006 and 2016. It is one of the landmark buildings of the ancient city of Datong. It now serves as the cathedral of the Catholic Diocese of Datong and the residence of…

spots.name: Ancient Bronze Art Museum
spots.desc: Datong is renowned for its bronze ware production and the museum's permanent exhibition includes imitations of Shang and Zhou bronze ritual vessels, Xuande incense burners, scholar's objects, and Mongolian and Han goods made in the Datong area during the Ming and Qing dynasties.
spots.hours: Tue-Sun 09:00-17:00; entry will stop 30 minutes before closing time
spots.addr: No. 11-12, Gulou East Street

spots.name: Datong Red Memory Museum
spots.desc: Part of the Datong Museum, this permanent exhibition mainly displays relics from the Chinese Communist Party and the Communist Youth League organizations in the Datong area from 1921 to 1949, as well as their student and worker movements.

spots.addr: No. 6-9, Xianlou South Street, Pingcheng District

spots.name: Memorial Hall of the Former Residence of Zhang Aitang
spots.desc: Part of the Datong Museum. Wei stele calligraphy is a style of calligraphy found on stone tablets in northern China during the Northern and Southern Dynasties period, and in modern times calligraphers such as Zhang Aitang inherited and developed this style. The museum showcases Zhang Aitang's life and his calligraphy.
spots.hours: Tue-Sun 09:00-17:00. Entry will stop 30 minutes before closing time
spots.addr: No. 18, Mawangmiao Street, Pingcheng District

spots.name: City Walls
spots.desc: Although the city walls are in the Ming Dynasty layout, many sections retain rammed earth layers dating to as early as the Han Dynasty. Since 2008, restoration work has been carried out on the brickwork, gate towers, and city gates, as well as the dredging of the moat. The city walls have four main gates: Heyang Gate to the east, Yongtai Gate to the south, Qingyuan Gate to the west, and Wuding…

spots.name: Bell Tower
spots.desc: The tower was built in the early Ming Dynasty but demolished in 1951. It was rebuilt in 2015 based on survey data and historical images, although with slight changes. The bell tower is a single-eaved hip-roofed pavilion with three tiers, four stories high (two of which are hidden levels). It houses an iron bell cast in the mid-Ming Dynasty, and the tower hosts frequent bell-ringing ceremonies for…
spots.addr: Pingcheng District, Qingyuan Street Center

spots.name: Memorial Hall of the Former Residence of the County Magistrate of Datong County
spots.desc: A three-courtyard siheyuan (traditional courtyard house) built in the late Qing Dynasty. It is named after two Datong County magistrates who resided here during the Republic of China period.

spots.name: Tulin
spots.desc: Wind-eroded loess pillars and walls create a surreal landscape. Presents a beautiful scene at sunset.

spots.name: Gulou East Street
spots.desc: One of the eight alleys, it stretches from the Drum Tower in the west to the west side of the Guandi Temple in the east.

spots.name: Huayan Street
spots.desc: One of the main pedestrian streets in the southwest corner. The history of the street can be traced back to the Tang Dynasty, proving Datong's status as the "starting point of the Silk Road" from the Northern Wei to the Tang and Liao Dynasties. In the early 21st century, the street underwent renovation and is now a pedestrian commercial street. At the north entrance of the street is a wooden…

spots.name: Erban Datong Sliced Noodles
spots.desc: Delicious knife-cut noodles and friendly service. All bowls come with pork; you choose the rest of the ingredients.
spots.price: Small pork bowl ¥9; larger bowls with extra ingredients go up to ¥32

spots.name: Yongzuo Temple
spots.desc: This temple is noted for its pair of 13-story octagonal pagodas, dating back some 400 years. These twin pagodas, which can easily be seen from much of Taiyuan, are often used as a symbol of Shanxi's largest city. The two towers, made of brick and stone, are 53 meters in height. Visitors can climb a spiral staircase to the top of the western pagoda to enjoy a panoramic view over the city.

The temple is home to the Buddhist Association of Shanxi Province and includes the Bell Tower, the Dabei Hall, and the east and west wing rooms. The main hall has 3 magnificent statues, one of Guanyin, Goddess of Mercy, with 1,000 hands and eyes.

The museum also offers research courses in geological science parks and cultural…

spots.name: Simon's bar

spots.desc: Harbin's old quarter, which covers a wide area of the city near the Songhua River, is still today mostly made up of buildings that were constructed by the Russians at the turn of the 19th century. Most of them are built in baroque or byzantine style with spires and cupolas and interesting shades of yellow, white, green, or red. While St. Sophia is known as the main architectural attraction to the…

spots.name: Zhongyang Dajie
