spots.desc: Built in 1900, this was the first bridge across the Songhua River in Harbin and served the railway system for over 100 years. In 2016, with the opening of a new bridge nearby, it was converted into a pedestrian bridge. It offers excellent views of the river and the city skyline.
spots.addr: From the Flood Control Monument, walk east along the riverbank for about 6 minutes

spots.name: Laodaowai
spots.desc: Laodaowai used to be the poorest part in Harbin. A century ago there were only two districts in Harbin, east (Daoli, "Dao" means Avenue, and "Li" means inside.) and west (Daowai, "wai" means outside). The rich expats lived in the east part, and the poor locals lived in the west part. In the early 1920s, some Chinese businessmen started their business in the area. The constructions they built…

spots.name: Riverbank Park
spots.desc: Long tree covered walkway that stretches the city-side banks of the Songhua river, a really nice and pleasant walk.
spots.addr: Along the Jiangpan Road in Daowai District

spots.name: Zhaolin Park
spots.desc: During the winter this park houses ice sculptures for the festivals, but during the off season, it is a pleasant stroll as well.
spots.addr: Youyi Lu and Shangzhi Jie

spots.name: Grape Kingdom
spots.desc: A live operating "organic farm" that has expansive grape and corn fields. In the fall you can enter the fields and pick as many fresh grapes as you want and watch how the Chinese process corn.

spots.name: Flood Control Monument
spots.local: 防洪胜利纪念塔 Fánghóng Shènglì Jìniàn Tǎ
spots.desc: Built in 1958 to commemorate the successful defense against the 1957 Songhua River flood. The 22.5-meter-tall tower features a circular platform with relief sculptures. It marks the northern end of Central Avenue and is a popular spot for riverside views.
spots.addr: Riverside end of Zhongyang Dajie, Daoli District

spots.name: Heilongjiang Provincial Museum
spots.local: 黑龙江省博物馆 Hēilóngjiāngshěng Bówùguǎn
spots.desc: A comprehensive museum housing Heilongjiang's history, nature, and art collections. Permanent exhibitions include "Heilongjiang Historical Relics," "Natural History," and the "Harbin Past — Early 20th Century Social Life" exhibition, which recreates scenes of the city a century ago. Built in 1922, the museum is a landmark of Harbin.
spots.hours: October 8th to March 31st: 9AM-4PM; April 1st to October 7th: 9AM-4:30PM
spots.price: Free (but remember to bring your ID)
spots.addr: 64 Hong Jun Street, Nangang District (南岗区红军街64号)

spots.name: The Liao & Jin History Museum of Heilongjiang
spots.local: 黑龙江辽金历史博物馆
spots.desc: As the name indicates, this museum focuses on the history of the Liao and Jin dynasties. It is said to contain over 10,000 artefacts.
spots.addr: Level 7, Qiulin International Shopping Centre, 320 Dongdazhijie, Nangang District (南岗区东大直街320号 秋林国际购物中心7层)

spots.name: Heilongjiang Art Museum
spots.desc: A provincial art museum founded in 1962, housed in a three-story European-style building from the 19th century. Its collection focuses on modern and contemporary Chinese art, especially woodblock prints from the Beidahuang and Heilongjiang schools. The museum also holds a significant collection of Russian oil paintings.
spots.addr: 97 Diduan Street, Daoli District (道里区地段街97号)

spots.name: Northeast China Revolutionary Martyrs’ Memorial Hall
spots.desc: During the Japanese occupation, this building was used as the Harbin police headquarters of the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo. It played a pivotal role in the suppression of all those opposed to Japanese rule. A number of prominent Chinese patriots were imprisoned and tortured here. In 1946, about one year after the Japanese surrender, Harbin came under the control of the Communist Party of…
spots.addr: 241 Yiman Street, Nangang District (南岗区一曼街241号)

spots.name: Dragon TV Tower
spots.desc: Tallest steel structure in northeastern Asia. Only built for the Chinese need of having something as the biggest and the best. Somewhere along the way they forgot to add any pleasant looking qualities to it. There is a revolving restaurant on top and views of the city. You can walk outside at the top and even strap on a harness for a thrill.

spots.name: Gondola ride over Songhua River
spots.desc: A nice way to work your way back from Sun Island in a gondola car that takes you over the banks of the Songhua.
spots.addr: access point is the Sun Island Park

spots.name: Ice and Snow World
spots.desc: Large buildings and sculptures made of ice. Best viewed after sunset. This festival is one of the main reasons people come to Harbin in winter.
spots.addr: North side of the river, west from Sun Island

spots.name: Ice Festival, Zhaolin Park
spots.local: 冰雪游园会, 兆麟公园 Bīngxuě yóuyuánhuì, Zhàolíngōngyuán
spots.desc: Rather small exhibits compared to the other two main festivals. Best viewed after dusk.
spots.addr: in the city center at Zhaolin Park, south side of the river

spots.name: Sun Island International Snow Sculpture Art Fair
spots.local: 太阳岛国际雪雕艺术博览会; Tàiyángdǎo guójì xuědiāoyìshù bólǎnhuì
spots.desc: Beautifully carved snow sculptures, massive dimensions. However, if you plan to visit the Ice and Snow World then this is not a must see. Pretty expensive for what you get to see and all other activities in the park are extra.
spots.addr: on Sun Island, north side of the river

spots.name: Harbin Summer Music Festival
spots.local: 哈尔滨之夏音乐节 Hāěrbīn Zhīxià Yīnyuèjié
spots.desc: Held every two years in July (next will be in 2018), this festival is organized by the city and brings in famous Chinese bands for free concerts held in the city square.

spots.name: Harbin International Beer Festival
spots.local: 哈尔滨国际啤酒节 Hāěrbīn Guójì Píjiǔjié
spots.desc: The city takes a break and honors the local "Harbin Beer" for a week. A whole public square is cordoned off and there are stages that host music concerts and dance contests. Most of the beer drunk is the local Harbin brew, but there is a tent for international beers. In the summer of 2005 a number of the foreigners in the city assembled a "drinking team" and ended up getting into a drunken brawl…
spots.hours: Held in late August of every year

spots.name: Sauna/bath houses
spots.desc: Literally all over the city. Many local people do not shower in their own apartments but use these public shower houses instead. There are upscale, midrange, and low end places. Check with a 5-star hotel to get the most up to date facility for the type you prefer. Upscale spas will cost about ¥120 plus additional ¥200 and up for a massage. Low end ones cost ¥30 plus an additional ¥100 for…

spots.name: Yangge Traditional Chinese Dance
spots.desc: You will notice that during the warmer months (and even sometimes in the winter) there will be legions of senior citizens out on the street doing a group dance complete with drumming and costumes. This is called niu yang ge and if you are adventurous just jump in and dance along!

spots.name: Bowling
spots.desc: Very popular among the Chinese in Harbin. Most of the larger hotels have a bowling alley. There is also a bowling club behind the Sino Way hotel with 2 floors and pool tables.

spots.name: Swimming
spots.desc: Believe it or not, people swim in the Songhua during the winter, but after all the pollution spills, it's probably not even safe to swim during the summer. If you are looking for a clean pool to swim in, try the pool at the Shangri-La Hotel or Heilongjiang University.

spots.name: Haerbin Grecism International Health Club
spots.local: 哈尔滨恒详国际健身俱乐部 Hāěrbīn Héngxiáng Guójì Jiànshēn Jùlèbù
spots.desc: One of Harbin's nicest health clubs that includes a full pool, American workout equipment, sauna and hot tub, indoor track and cafe.
spots.addr: 95 Hayao Road (道里区哈药路95号; Dàolǐqūhāyàolù)

spots.name: Fitness Ark Health Club
spots.local: 美丽方舟健身俱乐部 Měilì Fāngzhōu Jiànshēn Jùlèbù
spots.desc: This is a great and cheap health club. Foreign students and teachers hang out here.
spots.addr: 3rd floor of Hate Mall, 118 Xidazhi Jie (南岗区西大直街118号哈特)

spots.name: Churin
spots.desc: Founded in 1900 as part of a Russian department store chain, Churin is an icon of Harbin. The company’s main branch on Dongdazhi Street is now a cross between a traditional department store and a modern shopping center, that is to say there is a mixture of shops owned by Churin and shops owned by other companies. The underground floor sells the most famous red sausage and lieba (列吧, the big…
spots.addr: No.319 Dongdazhi Street, Nangang District (南岗区东大直街319号)

spots.name: Bank of China Heilongjiang Branch
spots.desc: This is the only bank in the city where you can exchange Travelers Checks.
spots.addr: No.19, Hongjun Jie

spots.name: Sofia Jintaiyang Fashion City
spots.desc: This shopping centre is Harbin's answer to Beijing's Xidan. Multi story fashion market lined with small stalls selling the hottest fashions from China at cheap prices.

spots.name: Hongbo Century Square
spots.desc: Not to be confused with the underground market, this is a huge mall in the basement of the Harbin exhibition center. There is also a fried chicken chain from Texas. There are daily fashion model shows.

spots.name: Watsons
spots.desc: This small convenient store has every health care product you can think of including western deodorants and shampoo. If you're in the city just for a few days and you need something quick it's fine, but if you plan to stay in Harbin longer, find yourself a Chinese convenient store. Watsons has a lot of European and American Brands but also the multiple of the prices the same things have in the…

spots.name: Metro German Supermarket
spots.desc: German owned walmart type supermarket with the city's biggest selection of western food, a huge selection of imported wine, alcohol and beer, cheese, pastas and ice cream. It's all there, including the steep prices!

spots.name: Scholars Bookstore
spots.desc: Harbin's largest bookstore is near Heilongjiang University on Xuefu Lu (学府路).

spots.name: Modern Ice Lolly
spots.desc: One of the icon of the city. Visit Harbin without Modern Ice Lolly is like going to Beijing without seeing the Great Wall. While everywhere in Harbin sale Modern Ice Lolly, only the hundred-year shop in Zhongyang St is the real one. Hardly can one find a place with everyone in all age group on the street hold an ice lolly, and it is worth to go and have a look even if you are not a sweet tooth.…
spots.addr: No. 89 Zhongyang St

spots.name: Assorted Meats on a Stick
spots.desc: Sold on every street, try asking for grilled bread buns (考馒头; Kǎomántou), it's really good. Finish everything off with an egg and tomato Gada Tang (soup).
spots.price: No more than ¥10 for 6-7 kabobs and soup

spots.name: Harbin Smoked Sausage
spots.desc: A treat only known to Harbin, you see stores selling it everywhere, it is REALLY good.

spots.name: Russian Breads
spots.desc: Lots of Bread and pastry stores around the city, including Zhongyang Dajie.

spots.name: Haws
spots.desc: Hawthorn fruit stacked on sticks and served covered with a sweet sauce. You tend to find other fruits available also.

spots.name: Lamb
spots.desc: Lamb with spices grilled over coals served with sesame flat bread from the nice Uighur guys (from Xinjiang province) on a street between Hong Bo Shopping Center and Guogeli Dajie.
spots.price: ¥5 will buy you a good meal

spots.name: Harbin Spring Rolls
spots.local: 春饼 or 卷饼; Chūnbǐng or Juǎn bǐng
spots.desc: A tasty wrap of potato strips, cucumber, sausage and egg all with a spicy sauce. Sold on the street or in most markets (even Walmart). If you want a real spring roll experience go to Lao Changs on Zhongyang Dajie (mentioned below).

spots.name: Old Sandpot House
spots.desc: Delicious small Dongbei snacks like dumplings, grilled breads.
spots.addr: 98 Zhongyang Avenue, Daoli District (道里区中央大街98号; Dàolǐqū Zhōngyāngdàjiē)

spots.name: Hamama's Kofi House
spots.desc: A little Cafe near Harbin Institute of Technology run by a Papua New Guinean and his Taiwanese wife. Western food like burgers, milkshakes and an omelet breakfast. Good strawberry and banana smoothies and carrot cake but some of the other items on the menu a bit variable. Coffee is fairly good too.
spots.addr: #2 mugong road unit 104 (木工2号)

spots.name: Xiang E Meishi
spots.desc: Great Hunan and Hubei style restaurant in a nice atmosphere.
spots.addr: 140 Guangmang Jie (南岗区光芒街140号)

spots.name: Hans Beer BBQ
spots.desc: Great draft beer that is all you can drink during lunchtime. The food is Chinese BBQ with assorted and spiced meat kabobs. A chain restaurant that is available in any large city in China.
spots.addr: 254 Zhongshan Lu, near Wal-mart (南岗区中山路254号, 近沃尔玛)

spots.name: Big Harvest
spots.desc: Traditional Donbgei cuisine in a unique environment. The only tea in the house is made from wheat.
spots.addr: 283 Yiman Street 南岗区一曼街283号

spots.name: Fucheng Hotpot
spots.desc: Great Hotpot restaurant always bustling with Dongbei atmosphere.
spots.addr: 47 Wenchang Jie (南岗区文昌街47号)

spots.name: Old Changs Spring Cakes
spots.desc: Pancake like food stuffed with vegetables and meat, a staple of the northeast and tasty as hell! You'll order plates with the fillings, such as meat, potato stripes, soy sprouts, ... and stuff the pancakes with them. Due to high popularity, Old Changs opened a few other branches in the vicinity. If this one is too crowded (expect more than 50 people to be waiting for a table during lunch time)…
spots.addr: 178 Zhongyang Dajie (道里区中央大街178号)

spots.name: Homestyle Hotpot
spots.desc: Great hotpot, especially their beef and potato. Heat source is piped in from the ceiling straight to the pot, none of the wimpy table-cooker stuff. They have a great spicy broth, and there is tableside sauce mixing available.
spots.addr: 92 Dongfeng Jie (东风街92号)

spots.name: Wuji Rib House
spots.desc: Dongbei style ribs that are simply amazing! You eat them with your hands and are given plastic gloves to keep things clean. The other dishes are great too and it's always packed and full of energy.

spots.name: Daquan BBQ
spots.desc: The locals call this the best BBQ joint in town. Always packed, really good. When you go there, ask for the (Honey Plum Meat) Mizhimeirou
spots.addr: 86 Beixing Jiaoyu yuan (北兴教育园86号)

spots.name: Xiaozi Zai Xianxin HK Cafe
spots.local: 小资再现新派港式餐厅
spots.desc: Harbin's trendiest restaurant in terms of design and the people who go there. Fairly good HK style food.
spots.addr: 350 Dongdazhi Jie (东大直街350号)

spots.name: Qianlima Baihe Liaoli
spots.desc: Affordable Korean food in an upscale environment, packed with Chinese families and businessmen out on the town for a dinner.
spots.addr: 777 Xianfeng Lu (南岗区先锋路777号)

spots.name: Marhaba Arabian
spots.desc: This is a great mom and pop sized restaurant which has some low and medium priced dishes. If you don't know Arabian food, the dishes are similar to many Indian and Lebanese dishes. They also have hookahs/shisha with flavored tobacco if desired.
spots.addr: Hanguang Street 1-19

spots.name: Cafe Russia
spots.desc: The owner is half Chinese, half Russian, and has created a fantastic atmosphere that feels like a high-class cafe in London or Paris. Elegant furniture, tasteful music, a working grandfather clock (with chimes) and a display to commemorate one of the last White Russians who lived in Harbin make this a place well worth visiting. Service is good too. The name in Chinese is 'Luxiya' i.e. Lucia…

spots.name: Pizza Hut
spots.desc: Standard pizza hut faire. Another Pizza Hut is on Guogeli Dajie.
spots.addr: Zhongyang Dajie

spots.name: Shangri-la Hotel Buffet
spots.desc: Upscale hotel dining with a huge assortment of western foods. Managed by a western head chef. The quality of this buffet is reasonable. Look out for the live silk worms in the chef station.

spots.name: Portman's
spots.desc: Mentioned in almost all of the guidebooks but its really nothing more than a Chinese version of western food. You are better off going to Hamama's or a Russian cafe. However they do have steak, fillet mignon, and goose liver pate, if you want to spend the money.
spots.addr: 12 Xidazhijie right off of Hongbo Square (南岗区西大直街12号)

spots.name: Japanese Teppanyaki
spots.desc: Japanese BBQ where you are seated in private rooms and real Japanese cook your food right in front of you!
spots.addr: 393 Hanshui Lu (南岗区汉水路393号)

spots.name: Upscale Sushi and Tempura
spots.desc: Another but less expensive Japanese restaurant. Full menu of sushi, tempura, Japanese curry etc. can be had here. Seating is in cozy bamboo paper rooms with heated seats! Atmosphere is very good. You can order affordable packages at around ¥100 per person that includes all-you-can-drink Kirin beer.
spots.addr: 458 Hanshui Lu (开发区汉水路458号)

spots.name: Thai Restaurant
spots.desc: Thai dishes cooked by Indian chefs. You can buy alligator meat here and listen to a singing Thai dance troupe.
spots.addr: 183 Changjiang Lu across from the Dragon tower (长江路183号)

spots.name: Tiantian Fish Village
spots.desc: Upscale Chinese seafood dining. You can mingle with Harbin's moneyed and enjoy exotic fish. When you walk in you can pick which fish you want from the giant tanks.
spots.addr: 2 Gongcheng Jie (道里区工程街2号)

spots.name: Blue's
spots.desc: Dirty, crowded, and dangerous. Everything that is Harbin, Russians, Mongolians, Turks, Canadians, Brazilians, Koreans. Frequent staging ground for fights between Koreans and Mongolians or Russians fighting with Russians. The staff has also been known to get involved in fights or start them. Friday nights 22:30 and afterward get really crazy when about 80% of Harbin's foreign newcomers head out to…
spots.addr: 100 Diduan Jie (地段街100号)

spots.name: Costa Coffee
spots.desc: Coffee House, unlike Starbucks it's not quite as packed with people and you can still meet a lot of foreigners here
spots.price: a bit cheaper than Starbucks in some things, but mainly the same applies here too, Chinese western snacks and no real…
spots.addr: Zhonyang Dajie, quite close to the Flood Monument, next to a Russian Shop and Babelas Kitchen

spots.name: Luyu Cafe
spots.desc: This is a good place to relax and escape the crowds or to warm up on a cold winter day. Situated in a historic Russian building right next to Zhongyang street, the warm atmosphere and nicely decorated surroundings, combined with a creative coffee blend from the friendly owner, will let you forget that you're in a city with a population of 10 million.
spots.addr: 43 Hongzhuan Jie 红专街43号(靠近中央大街)

spots.name: Aihui History Museum
spots.local: 爱辉历史陈列馆; Àihuī Lìshǐchénlièguǎn
spots.desc: Covers Sino-Russo history in the area. Some exhibits have Russian headings.

spots.name: Great Island International Trade Centre
spots.desc: Hangar consisting of two floors selling food, clothes, household items, jewellery, and all kind of kitch Russian and Chinese stuff.

spots.name: People's Park
spots.desc: The 49 hectares large park is a good place to people watch and get a glimpse at urban Chinese culture. Near the northern entrance, there are several squares where you can watch elderly people dance and enjoy amateur performances of traditional Chinese signing. There you'll also find another monument dedicated to the resistance against the Japanese invaders during the Second World War. Yixin Lake…
spots.price: Park entrance and zoo are free. Tickets for the amusement park range from ¥10 to ¥30 per ride/attraction

spots.name: Dacheng temple
spots.desc: Dacheng temple, also known as the Big Buddha Temple, is located at the intersection of Muhai Street and Minhang Road, Tiefeng District, Qiqihar City, south of the West Manchu Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery, covering an area of 31,000 square meters.DachengTemple, a key cultural relic protection unit in Heilongjiang Province, was built by Kong Yushu in 1943. It adopts traditional ancient…
spots.addr: Minhang Rd No.499(民航路499号)

spots.name: Rice halal best beef and mutton main shop
spots.local: 米家清真极品牛羊肉总店
spots.desc: It's a local chain of kebab shops in Qiqihar. Beef and lamb, halal meals only.
spots.addr: 31 Yumin Street, Jianhua District(建华区裕民街31号)

spots.name: Goguryeo Ancient sites
spots.desc: The remains of the ancient kingdom of Goguryeo. Goguryeo was one of Three Kingdoms of Korea. These sites include including Wunu Mountain City, Guonei City and Wandu Mountain City; fourteen imperial tombs; twenty-six noble tombs; a General's Tomb; and the monument to the nineteenth Emperor of the Koguryo Kingdom, which are now UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Most of these are around Ji'an.

spots.name: The 8 Puppet Manchukuo Government Departments
spots.desc: Around 1936, the puppet Manchukuo government built its capital with several important government departments in what is now Changchun's Chaoyang District. Now 8 of them remain and are used for other purposes. Visitors usually cannot get inside, but it is still good to have a look at the old buildings from outside and think of their history.

spots.name: Puppet Manchukuo government's Agricultural Department
spots.desc: Now it is the Northeast Normal University's affiliate high school.
spots.addr: 8 Ziyou Avenue, Chaoyang District (朝阳区自由大路8号)

spots.name: Puppet Manchukuo government's Culture and Education Department
spots.desc: Now it is the Northeast Normal University's affiliate primary school.
spots.addr: 696 Ziyou Avenue, Chaoyang District (朝阳区自由大路696号)

spots.name: Puppet Manchukuo government's Foreign Affairs Department
spots.desc: Now it is a Traditional Chinese Medicine clinic operated by the Moii Group.
spots.addr: 1122 Jianshe Street, Chaoyang District (朝阳区建设街1122号)

spots.name: Puppet Manchukuo government's State Department
spots.desc: Not usually considered as one of 'the eight departments', as this was an organ of the executive government and thus more highly ranking than the other departments. It is now part of the Jilin University Medical College.
spots.addr: 126 Xinmin Street, Chaoyang District (朝阳区新民大街126号)

spots.name: Puppet Manchukuo government's Welfare Department
spots.desc: Now it is the Jilin Province Petrochemical Engineering Design and Research Institute.
spots.addr: 3623 Renmin Street, Chaoyang District (朝阳区人民大街3623号)

spots.name: Museum of Former Changchun Film Studio Site
spots.desc: For lovers of Chinese movies and the history of the Chinese movie industry. The site used to be the Manchukuo Film Studio (株式会社满洲映画协会) from July 1937-July 1945. After changing its name a few times, Changchun Film Studio was founded as the PRC's first film studio.
spots.hours: Summer: 09:00-17:00, winterː 09:00-16:30, ticket office closes one hour before museum closes
spots.addr: 1118 Hongqi Street, Chaoyang District (朝阳区红旗街1118号)

spots.name: Norman Bethune Health Science Center of Jilin University
spots.local: 吉林大学白求恩医学部
spots.desc: Norman Bethune was a remarkable Canadian doctor. He is quite famous in China, partly because Mao wrote an essay about meeting him and millions of kids read that in school. He was a military doctor in both World War I and the Spanish Civil War, then came to China. The Americans wanted to send him to the Nationalist Army, but he refused and went to the Communists instead. He founded this school in…
spots.addr: 828 Xinmin Street, Choayang District (朝阳区新民大街828号)

spots.name: People's Square
spots.desc: In the Chaoyang District around the cross streets of Xi'an Lu (西安路), Renmin Dajie (人民大街), and Changchun Dajie (长春大街). It is one of the focal points of Changchun. It is close to Baishan Park (白山公园), and a mini "Culture Square" of sorts. The site commemorates the Russian soldiers, and specifically Russian pilots that died to liberate Changchun during World War II.
spots.addr: Chaoyang District (朝阳区)

spots.name: Wenhua Square
spots.desc: A pleasant urban hangout which offers a glimpse into Changchun's Japanese imperial past. The square is surrounded by several historical buildings from the Manchukuo era. On the north end of the square sits the majestic former New Palace of the Emperor of Manchukuo (新帝宫), which was intended to replace the Puppet Imperial Palace. On the south end of the square are the former Manchukuo State Council…
spots.addr: Chaoyang District (朝阳区)

spots.name: Banruo Temple
spots.local: 般若寺, 护国般若寺
spots.desc: Changchun's most important Buddhist temple. The Jilin Province Buddhist Association has its headquarters here. The temple is particularly active during Chinese New Year when the faithful flock to receive the Buddha's blessings.
spots.hours: 08ː00-16ː00, closed from the 1st day of the 10th month of the Chinese lunar year to the 22nd day of the 12th month of…
spots.addr: 377 Changchun Street, Nanguan District (南关区长春大街377号)

spots.name: Changchun Confucius Temple
spots.desc: Built in 1872, the temple is now a museum. Hence it is also known as the Changchun Confucius Temple Museum (长春文庙博物馆).
spots.hours: 09ː00-16ː00, may be closed on public holidays
spots.price: Usually ¥10. Tickets are sometimes available for free, such as during the National Day holiday week.
spots.addr: 239 Dongtian Street, Nanguan District (南关区东天街239号)

spots.name: China FAW Group Corporation
spots.local: 中国第一汽车集团公司
spots.desc: One of the earliest and largest car factories in PRC. The main building is huge and marvelous. One needs an invitation letter to see the factory.

spots.name: Changchun Film Century City
spots.desc: A large and very popular theme park owned by the Changchun Film Group Corporation.
spots.price: ¥198 (November to March), ¥240 (April to October). Children between 1.2 and 1.5 m in height pay half price. Children…
spots.addr: Intersection of JIngyue Street and Yongshun Road, Jingyue National High-Tech Industry Development Zone (净月国家高新技术产业开发区净月大街与永顺路交汇)

spots.name: Shengli Park
spots.desc: The park offers activities such as a petting zoo and bumper cars (summer) and a frozen pond for skating (winter).
spots.addr: Intersection of Renmin Street and Beijing Street, Kuancheng District (宽城区人民大街与北京大街交会处)

spots.name: Changchun World Sculpture Park
spots.local: 长春世界雕塑公园; Chángchūn Shìjiè Diāosù Gōngyuán
spots.desc: A large, beautiful sculpture park surrounding a serene lake. The park features sculptures from artists around the world. At the center is a large pillar, the 'Friendship Peace Spring'.
spots.price: ¥30 to enter the park, ¥30 to enter the sculpture museum and ¥30 to enter the African art museum. ¥60 for a combo ticket
spots.addr: 9518 Renmin Street, Nanguan District (南关区人民大街9518号)

spots.name: Jingyuetan National Forest Park
spots.local: 净月潭国家森林公园; Jìngyuètán guójiā sēnlín gōngyuán
spots.desc: It is the largest man-made forest park in Asia, and a great place for skiing in the winter.
spots.price: General admission fee is ¥30. Ski field access fee is ¥110 on weekdays, ¥120 on weekends and ¥130 during Chinese New…
spots.addr: 5840 Jingyue Street, Jingyue Development Zone (净月开发区净月大街5840号)

spots.name: Northeast Tiger Park
spots.desc: A wildlife park situated within the Jingyuetan National Forest Park. Besides tigers, the park also has a variety of other animals, including pandas, lions, black bears, brown bears, Tibetan mastiffs, ponies, reindeers, alpaca, sika deer, peacocks, white cranes, ostriches, emus, vultures and many other species.
spots.price: General admission is ¥60. Access to the panda house costs ¥40. Persons aged between 60 and 65 pay half price, while…
spots.addr: 10500 Jingyue Street, Nanguan District (南关区净月大街10500号)

spots.name: South Lake Park
spots.desc: A large park which is a favorite picnic and recreation spot for locals. In the summer, the lake is used for boating and water sports, and there is a stand of huge lotus plants near one part of it. In the winter, the lake freezes over and serves as a natural skating rink. In winter months it's a romantic and quiet place - but you have to suffer the low winter temperatures. The park almost feels…
spots.addr: 2715 Gongnong Road, Chaoyang District (朝阳区工农大路2715号)

spots.name: Longtou Mountain
spots.desc: These hills contain ancient Tombs including the Mausoleum of Princess Zhenxiao and royal tombs of the Balhae kingdom. It is in Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture.

spots.name: The Happy Home
spots.desc: This is the default meeting place for a lot of foreign teachers and other young and English - or Russian - speaking people.
spots.addr: 1323 Xikang Hutong (西康胡同1323号) - not far from Mayflower 2

spots.name: Three Monkeys
spots.desc: The interior, music collection, drinks menu and all other aspects of the pub were designed by British, Italian and American engineers. The music is all western and the drinks menu includes English ale and Irish stout. This is the only place in Changchun to have a beer and a game of pool in peace. A front terrace away from the main road to have a beer on a summers evening in pleasant surroundings.
spots.addr: Tian An City One, 661 Guigu Street, Chaoyang District (朝阳区硅谷大街661号天安第一城)

spots.name: Old Ship Bar
spots.desc: Literally housed in a small wooden sailing ship. Serves beer and other beverages, has indoor barbecue features for seafood as well as other types of barbecue, Western flavors, a cheerful atmosphere and melodious music.
spots.addr: Between Jingcheng Street and Anshun Road

spots.name: Mayflower Bar
spots.desc: It's been said this is the hottest club in town, and that the "old Mayflower" is simply the best. There are two rooms. In the outer room there is a live show daily from 21:00, and after that the DJ plays disco. The inner room is small but quite popular. It plays hip-hop and it gets out of control after 13:00. The third Mayflower bar was opened in the basement of the Shangri-La hotel. Here it's…
spots.addr: Between Qinghua Road and Lixin Street

spots.name: Ferryport
spots.desc: This bar is located on Changqing Jie and Guilin Hutong in the Guilin Lu section of Changchun. Small dark place with music in the evenings. Is popular with both locals and foreigners

spots.name: Jilin City Manchu Museum
spots.desc: A museum about the history and culture of the Manchu people.
spots.hours: Visitors must enter the museum at one of the following timesː 09ː00, 10ː00, 13ː30, or 14ː30. The museum is closed on…
spots.addr: 47 Desheng Road, Chuanying District (船营区德胜路47号)

spots.name: Jilin Navy Barracks Museum
spots.desc: Tells the story of the Jilin Navy Barracks, which was established in 1661 and played a major role in the city's history up until its disbandment in 1910.
spots.hours: 09ː00-11ː00, 13ː00-15ː30, closed on Mondays, Thursdays and public holidays
spots.addr: 206 Desheng Road, Chuanying District (船营区德胜路206号)

spots.name: Century Square
spots.desc: Public Square. Locals come to skate (skate and skateboard hire shops avail.), or sit and people watch.
spots.addr: 100 Jilin Avenue, Fengman District (丰满区吉林大街100号)

spots.name: Catholic Church of Jilin
spots.local: 吉林天主教堂 Jí​lín​ Tiān​zhǔ ​Jiào​táng​
spots.desc: This is an active church with a few dedicated nuns. To visit this church is a way an escape from the contemporary money-oriented city for a time. The interior design of this church is similar to that of modern churches which were built in Scandinavia during the early 20th century. There is a very small library inside, with Bibles mainly in Chinese and a few in Russian.
spots.addr: 3 Songjiang Middle Road (船营区松江中路3号 Sōng​jiāng​ Zhōng​lù​), Chuanying District

spots.name: Jilin Wen Miao Confucian Temple Museum
spots.local: 吉林文庙博物馆 Jí​lín​ Wén​miào Bówù​guǎn​​
spots.desc: This is the largest Confucius temple in Manchuria. It was built in 1736 but replaced by the present one in 1909, it includes an exhibition on the Qing Dynasty imperial examination system. There is a modern Confucius sculpture in front of the main buildings. If you have seen some old photos of this temple, you would probably feel sad when visiting it. Around the temple, there are a lot of tall…
spots.addr: 2 Nanchang Road (南昌路2号 Nānchāng Lù​)

spots.name: Xuandi Temple
spots.desc: One of the largest Taoist temples in Jilin Province. The temple was built in 1738 but destroyed during the Culture Revolution. Most of the present structures, which are modelled on the originals, were constructed between 2006 and 2016, and as of 2019, some buildings were still under construction.
spots.addr: Xuantian Ridge, Beiji Subdistrict, Chuanying District (船营区北极街道玄天岭)

spots.name: Beidahu Skiing Ground
spots.desc: Has a long snowing season, and is a renowned skiing ground in China. Snow sports section of the 6th Asian Winter Games was held there.

spots.name: Beishan Park
spots.local: 北山公园 Běi​shān​ Gōng​yuán​; lit. North Hill Park
spots.desc: This large park is a good place to see lotus flowers in the summer and ice-rimmed trees in the winter. The park features lakes where you can go boating and also some small mountains. Scattered around the park is a number of temples and other buildings.
spots.addr: 51 Desheng Road (船营区德胜路 Déshèng ​Lù​), Chuanying District

spots.name: Ice-rimmed Trees
spots.desc: This is a natural phenomenon which occurs when warm water from the river meets the cold winter air, forming ice crystals on the trees. The phenomenon is considered one of the four major natural wonders of China (along with the mountains and lakes of Guilin, Stone Forest of Yunnan, and Three Gorges of Yangtze River).

spots.name: Longtan Mountain Park
spots.local: 龙潭山公园 Lóng​tán​shān​ Gōngyuán​; lit. Dragon Pool Mountain Park
spots.desc: Also known as the Longtan Mountain Ruins Park (龙潭山遗址公园). This was once the site of a city built by the ancient Korean Kingdom of Goguryeoi.
spots.addr: 2 Longshan Road, Longtan District (龙潭区龙山路2号)

spots.name: Songhua Lake
spots.desc: Also known as Fengman Reservoir, this is a man-made lake that formed during the Japanese occupation following the construction of the Fengman Dam and Fengman Hydropower Station.
spots.addr: Fengman District (丰满区)

spots.name: Zhuque Mountain National Forest Park
spots.local: 朱雀山国家森林公园 Zhū​què​shān Guójiā Sēnlín Gōngyuán​; lit. Rosefinch Mountain
spots.desc: Temples, hiking and the local ski area. Food and accommodation are available at the park.
spots.addr: 10 km, Jifeng Road East, Fengman District (丰满区吉丰东路10公里)

spots.name: Yangmazi Da Bing
spots.desc: Feast on delicious family-style dishes and a wide variety of the eponymous flat breads (Da Bing). With beer, a meal will cost less than ¥30.

spots.name: Mom's house
spots.desc: As you might expect, dishes are traditional family style at this bright, loud, smoky, home-style restaurant. The difference from many places in Jilin is the sheer quality of the dishes, and the location ensures enough foreign patrons that you won't encounter any staring squads or over-curious waiters.

spots.name: Xiang Rui Chuan Dian
spots.desc: A loud and smoky kebab house just a short walk east of Century Square, this always-busy place sells what is hands-down the best chuan (Chinese kebab) in town. Lamb kebabs (羊肉串), chicken heart kebabs (鸡心串), mantou (馒头), chicken wings (鸡翅) are all amazing. Also delicious noodles like the spicy beef noodles (麻辣牛肉面).

spots.name: Little Boy Western Food
spots.desc: Inauthentic but still good western and Korean food, some Chinese dishes. Good prices, nice atmosphere, and a streetside patio for a beer or five.

spots.name: Liyade Shifu
spots.desc: Muslim restaurant. Serves small portions of tasty mutton dishes.
spots.addr: 56 Jiefang Zhong Road

spots.name: Jin Zhou Tang Cheng
spots.desc: Good, authentic Korean restaurant. Galbi, Bibimbab, Bulgogi, and, of course, Kimchi. Also, dog meat. Second location on Jiefang Beilu north of Yan'an Lu.

spots.name: Full House
spots.desc: Excellent Korean food in the heart of Jilin's Korean district. Staff and most customers are ethnically Korean. Most staff speak English very well.

spots.name: Cherry Blossom
spots.desc: Housed in a small two-storey building (you can't miss it in this city where everything is 6 storeys), this Japanese sushi house offers a variety of all-you-can-eat options. At ¥169, the cheapest option is still pricey, but the quality and variety of sashimi and dishes are unmatched in Dongbei, and come with as much hot sake as you can drink.

spots.name: German Beer Bar
spots.desc: If you get tired of dumplings, noodles, and chuan, head for this place in the plaza near Wen Miao. German beer by the bottle and European sausages and mustards are served for the premium prices you might expect.

spots.name: Hive Bar
spots.desc: A college dive bar like you'd expect to see in California. Cheap draft beer, Western spirits (not fake), and a laid-back atmosphere with snowboards on the wood-panelled walls, and a fireplace, populated almost exclusively by college students, often foreigners. It is almost impossible to get a taxi from here after 23:00.

spots.name: Xiao Temple
spots.local: 鞍山市岫岩县卧鹿山效圣寺
spots.desc: Legend dates the site to the Tang Dynasty. It is the province's only large ancient temples of stone structure. It's known locally as the 'Old Temple'.
spots.addr: Xiuyan

spots.name: Lohan Holy Land
spots.desc: Within the Jade Buddha Temple area but requires and additional ticket fee. This underground tunnel contains many Buddhist statues with coloured lights.

spots.name: 219 Park
spots.desc: The largest park in the region. Named after the date of liberation of Anshan by the PLA on the nineteenth of February 1948. The park contains woodland areas around a series of lakes. The area is very popular with the local people who can frequently be seen exercising, dancing, singing, playing music and practicing taichi in the grounds — especially in the early morning of mid evening.
spots.addr: Yuanlin Lu, Anshan.

spots.name: Dongshan Park
spots.desc: This is a network of paths, the longest of which is a path way runs along the crest of the hills that form the eastern flank of the city. The Park covers 975 hectares of which 946 hectares is woodland and 22 hectares is water. Dongshan translates as East Mountain. Views can be enjoyed of the city and surrounding land as you stroll through dense woodland. Approximately half way along, a tower on…

spots.name: Lieshishan Park
spots.desc: A small park in the centre of the city. Most of the city is visible from the top of the hill. If the steps look too daunting, there is a gentle path to the east side of the entrance that will spiral up to the top.
spots.addr: Shengli Lu, Anshan.

spots.name: Mengtai Park
spots.desc: A large and popular park in Lishan district to the north of the city. The park includes an attractive lake behind which run a crescent shaped ridge of hills.
spots.addr: Jianguo Street, Lishan, Anshan.

spots.name: Aviary
spots.desc: A large netted complex within which a huge variety of birds may be observed.

spots.name: Qianshan National Park
spots.desc: Qianshan literally means 'thousand mountains' and that is the impression you get as you look up at the jagged peaks. The name is actually and abbreviation of 'thousand lotus flower mountains'. The peaks were said to resemble the petals of the lotus flower which had been dropped to earth by a goddess. The area is filled with many Buddhist and Taoist temples and monasteris and nunneries. It is one…

spots.name: Dongshan Amusement Park
spots.desc: A large number of amusement rides are situated here and run throughout the year.

spots.name: Anshan Country Club
spots.desc: A Country Club and 18 hole golf course on the south side of the city near Tangangzi. Golf cubs are available to hire and prices are per round.

spots.name: Anshan Qianshan Ski Centre
spots.desc: This small ski centre is open throughout most of the winter. There are several slopes for beginners through to intermediate levels. Advanced skiers may find the slopes a little short though. The centre also has snow mobiles, quad bikes and rubber ring slides for the kids. After skiing, you can relax in the mixed-sex outdoor hot spring spa included in the price so remember your swimwear.

spots.name: Skating
spots.desc: During winter you can skate on the lakes in the parks. The ice is maintained by the park attendant. If you bring your own shoes it is free or you can hire skates for a modest fee.

spots.name: Tanggangzi
spots.local: 鞍山市汤岗子温泉旅游度假区
spots.desc: Just south of the city, visitors may have mud treatment where they are buried in hot volcanic sand, which has been infused with the spring water. Tangangzi is the oldest hot spring spa in Anshan. The spa dates back to the Tang dynasty of China. It was used by the last emperor, Puyi and his wives. The spa is popular with many foreign visitors, especially Russians.

spots.name: Street food
spots.desc: A wide variety of foods form lamb kebabs, quick fried chicken strips and even octopus on a stick. Look out for a popular local pancake cooked with an egg smeared over the surface, some spring onion, leak and a hotdog sausage in the center.

spots.name: Savour Life Coffee Shop
spots.desc: A small coffee shop but the best in the city. Popular with the young professionals and foreigners.
spots.addr: Shengli South Street

spots.name: San Bao BBQ
spots.desc: Anshan is close to the border with Korea, so a large Korea population lives here. The town has dozens of Korean BBQ restaurants. Food is served raw, marinated in a variety of spicy sauces. In the center of the table is a pit containing hot coals. It is over these coals that you cook your food. A selection of spices and sauces are provided for you to dip the cooked meat into.
spots.addr: Yuanlin Road

spots.name: Pizza house
spots.desc: Serves a variety of pizzas as well as steaks. Will deliver locally.
spots.addr: Tiedong Wodao Jie

spots.name: Jullette Cafe
spots.desc: Western food in a relaxing atmosphere. The buildings were originally houses built by the Japanese in the 1930s and now converted into a restaurant. The front building is no smoking and the rear building allows smoking. The chef used to work in Taiwan and is proficient at cooking western food. The fillet steak is particularly popular.
spots.addr: Zhonghua Street.

spots.name: Sun Club
spots.desc: This is one of the more popular music bars. They have a live band playing every night from 9pm.

spots.name: Guangyou Temple Scenic Area
spots.local: 广佑寺风景区 Guǎngyòusì Fēngjǐngqū
spots.desc: Constructed during the Eastern Han Dynasty, this is one of the oldest Buddhist sites in China. In the year 1161, the site received favour of the Emperor and was expanded. In the early 1900s, the army of the old Tsarist Russia burned the site. It has since been restored. This temple complex covers some 60,000 square metres. Within lies a large statue of Sakyamuni Buddha made of camphor wood and…

spots.name: Longfeng Mountain Scenic Spot and Temple
spots.local: 龙峰寺风景区 Lóngfēngsì Fēngjǐngqū
spots.desc: Longfeng temple dates to the time of the Tang Dynasty Emperor Zhenguan, over 1,300 years ago. It was renovated during the Ming and Qing dynasties. According to inscriptions in the temple, Tang Emperor Taizong visited the site as did the Emperor Qianlong of Qing in the 44th year of his rule. The temple was damaged during the Cultural Revolution of the 20th century. It has since been restored.
spots.addr: Xiadahe Town

spots.name: Liaoyang City Museum
spots.local: 辽阳市博物馆 Liáoyángshì Bówùguǎn
spots.desc: This museum opened in 1985 and in 2002 was graded as a AA class site by the Provincial Tourism Bureau. The museum covers 31,450 square meters over five galleries and contains 4,000 items from the neolithic through to Ming and Qing dynasties.
spots.addr: 2 Zongxin Road, Wensheng District (文圣区中心路2号 Wénshèngqū Zhōngxīnlù)

spots.name: Cao Xueqin Memorial Hall
spots.local: 曹雪芹纪念馆 Cáoxuěqín Jìniànguǎn
spots.desc: "The Dream of Red Mansions" is one of the four most famous novels of China. It was written by Cao Xueqin. Over the years, there has been much debate as to where Cao Xueqin was born. Liaoyang has been put forward as the likely location. In 1995, a Memorial to Cao Xueqin was opened in Liaoyang.
spots.addr: 2 Woshi Hutong (卧狮胡同2号; Wòshīhútòng)

spots.name: Wang Erlie Memorial Hall
spots.local: 王尔烈纪念馆 Wángěrliè Jìniànguǎn
spots.desc: Wang Erlie was a court official born in Liaoyang during the reign of the Emperor Qianlong. He achieved excellent scores in his Imperial exams and subsequently had a career that saw him become one of the richest and most powerful people in China. The museum tells the story of his life and has some English language translations.
spots.addr: Baita District

spots.name: Dongjing City
spots.desc: Liaoyang became the capital city of the Manchurian Late Jin Empire in 1621. An imperial palace was built here called Dongjing or "East Capital" and covers and area of 0.75 square kilometres. A few walls and gates remain of the old palace.
spots.addr: Taizihe District (太子河区 Tàizǐhéqū)

spots.name: Dongjing Mausoleum
spots.desc: Build by the first Manchurian Emperor, Nurhachu, in 1624, to house the remains of his grandfather, wife, brother, son and others. In total ten people of Nurhachu's family were placed here.
spots.addr: Taizihe District (太子河区 Tàizǐhéqū)

spots.name: Qingfeng Temple
spots.desc: Qingfeng Temple, a provincial cultural relic. The temple was built in the fifth year of the Ming Dynasty (1571) and was historically known as "the first temple outside the Shanhai Pass". It was rebuilt in the Qing Dynasty and remains largely intact, and is one of the city's key ancient buildings.

spots.name: Yanzhou Town
spots.desc: The mountain city of Yanzhou was built with large stone walls on the east, west and north sides, with the south side facing the river, and has a perimeter of 2,500 metres, with a commanding platform built on the high point of the city, surrounded by an inner city 45 metres long and 35 metres wide.

spots.name: Li Zhaolin House
spots.desc: The former residence of General Li Zhaolin is located in Houtun Village, Dengta City, Liaoyang, covering an area of 2080 square metres

spots.name: Hehuogou Provincial Level Forest Park
spots.desc: Part of the Qianshan mountain range, Hehuoguo Park contains canyon scenery with waterfalls, natural springs and ancient pine trees.

spots.name: City walls
spots.desc: The original city walls of Shenyang were destroyed in the 1950s. Some small sections have been reconstructed to give an impression of the former city. These remains consist of two gates, Huaiyuanmen and Fujinmen, at either end of Shenyang Lu.
spots.addr: Shenyang Lu

spots.name: Former Site of Shenyang Military Tribunal for the Trial of Japanese War Criminals
spots.local: 中国审判日本战犯法庭旧址陈列馆
spots.desc: 36 Japanese war criminals were publicly tried and prosecuted at this site between June 9th and July 20th, 1956. The site is now a museum.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00 (summer), 09:00-16:30 (winter), no entry in last 30 minutes, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 77 Heilongjiang Street, Huanggu District (皇姑区黑龙江街77号)

spots.name: The old Longkou Wine Museum
spots.desc: A small museum beside the Laolongkou distillery tells the history of Baiju production on the site which dates to the early 17th century. The display includes old maps and photographs of the area. Equipment used in the wine production and a collection of old bottles, labels and trademarks used by the company.
spots.addr: Xiao Dong Lu

spots.name: Shengjing Ancient Cultural Street
spots.desc: Shenjing is the old name for Shenyang during the 17th century - jing meaning capital city. This street tries to recreate the architectural styles of the time. It is however only a facard over the front of relatively modern 20th-century structures within which a variety of tourist orientated shops operate.
spots.addr: Shenyang Rd

spots.name: Xinle Ancient Ruins Museum
spots.local: 沈阳新乐遗址博物馆, Xinle Site Museum
spots.desc: On this location were found the remains of a 7000-year old, stone age, village. A museum now houses the archaeological finds and the village has been reconstructed. The site is in two sections. The ticket office is on the north side of the road. You will then be directed across to the museum on the south side to view the display before returning to the north side again to enter the reconstruction…
spots.hours: May 1st to October 14th: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30. October 15th to April 30th: 09:00-16:30, no entry after…
spots.addr: 1 Longshan Road, Huanghe North Street, Huanggu District (皇姑区黄河北大街龙山路1号)

spots.name: Shen-Air Museum
spots.desc: Beiling Airport is the site where China produced its first modern jet aircraft in the early 1950s. The first ones were copies of Soviet MIG fighters but gradually Chinese designs were developed. A strong focus is placed on comparing Chinese and American aircraft, in particular those involved in the Korean War of the 1950s. They also tell the history of Chinese missile development and other…
spots.addr: 1 Lingbei Street, Huanggu District (皇姑区陵北街1号)

spots.name: Royal Ocean World
spots.local: 皇家极地海洋世界; Huángjiājídehǎiyángshìjiè
spots.desc: Opened in 2008 and still being expanded, this claims to be the biggest aquarium in Asia. There are four displays open. The Ocean World display contains sea and fresh water aquariums filled with all manor of aquatic life. The Century Forest display focuses on reptiles. There is also the Narnian Castle which is a theatre where animal shows are performed several times throughout the day (show times…
spots.addr: Wanghua District (抚顺高湾(沈吉高速抚顺西出口))

spots.name: Shenyang Horticultural Exposition Garden
spots.desc: This is the site of the 2006 International Horticultural Exposition. One of Shenyang's main tourist attractions, it continues to operate though the expo has officially ended. It features international gardens reminiscent of Epcot Center in Disney World in the U.S, (the amusement park is really awesome compared to the gardens, which includes a roller coaster and many other fun activities!). It…
spots.addr: Dongling District

spots.name: North, East, South and West Pagodas
spots.local: 北塔 Beita, 南塔 Nanta, 东塔 Dongta, 西塔 Xita
spots.desc: Built in the 1640s and now restored to close to original, these four pagodas stand each about 4 km north, south, east and west of the Imperial Palace that was the centre of the old city. Each pagoda is almost identical to the others but the north and south pagodas are in the best condition today.

spots.name: Happy Family
spots.local: 兴隆大家庭 xīng lóng dà jiā ting
spots.desc: The Happy Family Malls (one in Tiexi and the one on Zhongjie) have indoor ice rinks with skates you can rent an occasional specials on teachers.

spots.name: Public Bathhouses
spots.desc: Going to wash up at a bathhouse is an experience highly recommended by Shenyang locals. Entrance fees vary from ¥50–150 which usually cover showers, shower supplies, bathtubs, and saunas. You can also add extra services like spa treatment or massages. Bathhouses can be found around the city by searching for Tang Quan (汤泉). Yun Qi Tang Quan (元气汤泉) is clean and has great service.

spots.name: Shenyang Huangsi Temple Fair
spots.desc: Shenyang Shisheng Temple is also known as Huangsi. Founded in 1636 (the first year of Chongde in the Qing Dynasty), it is a large-scale and early Lama temple in Shenyang. In Shenyang, as long as the temple fair is mentioned, the first reaction of most Shenyang people is Huangsi Temple Fair. To this day, Shenyang holds Huangsi Temple Fair every year. During the temple fair, there are colorful…
spots.addr: No. 206, Huangsi Road, Heping District

spots.name: Northeast Asia Ski Resort
spots.local: 东北亚滑雪场 Dongbeiya Huaxue Chang
spots.desc: With 700,000 m² of skiing area, this is the biggest ski resort.
spots.price: Daytime skiing ¥135 for two hours and night skiing is ¥125. Discounts for groups of 15 or more are available.
spots.addr: Magang, Xingchengzi District

spots.name: Baiqingzhai Ski Field
spots.desc: The site includes a freestyle aerial skiing and off-piste areas. Total area is 530,000 m².
spots.price: Daytime skiing ¥135 for two hours and night skiing is ¥120. Discounts for groups of 15 or more are available.
spots.addr: Sujiatun District

spots.name: Qipanshan Ice and Snow World
spots.desc: Within Qipanshan Scenic Area and covering an area of 500,000 m².
spots.price: Daytime skiing ¥150 for two hours and night skiing is ¥130. Discounts for groups of 15 or more are available

spots.name: Zhong Jie
spots.desc: It has shops selling cell phones, computers, electronic equipment or the latest fashions and accessories. Box/department stores are within walking distance of Zhong Jie as well as the north train station. There are many western brands here, including cafes and restaurants. The Forum 66 Mall is well-travelled and full of international food and clothing brands, and its relatively empty companion…

spots.name: Taiyuan Jie
spots.desc: This area has an English language bookstore and main post office nearby, as well as food, clothing from international brands, and electronics. Don't miss the underground shopping mall under the street. Box stores common throughout China can be found here. Cheap prescription glasses and sunglasses can be found on south Taiyuan street in the 赛隆广场 Sailong Mall. Don't forget to bargain!

spots.name: Beishichang
spots.desc: One of the oldest shopping areas in Shenyang. There is an important Lama temple (Huang Shi, founded in 1636), which was worshiped by all the Manchu emperors during their regular trips to Shenyang.

spots.name: Wu'ai Market
spots.desc: The biggest wholesale market in the northeast of China, with 300,000 customers per day and annual turnover of more than ¥2 billion. It covers an area of 139,000 m² with multiple massive buildings connected by bridges and stairways. Products include dresses, shoes, caps, groceries, knitted goods, cloth materials, boxes, home appliances, gifts, daily sundry goods, beauty and hairdressing articles…

spots.name: Lao Bian Jiaozi Restaurant 老边饺子
spots.desc: Dumplings restaurant. Lao Bian Jiaozi, founded in 1829, is one of the most famous dumpling restaurants.Guinness World Records 2000 for the World's Oldest Dumpling Restaurant.
spots.addr: No.208 Zhong Jie, Shenhe District

spots.name: BaoFaYuan 宝发园
spots.desc: Famous for its 四绝 (Four Outstanding). While locals might not remember the name "BaFaYuan", everyone knows "Four Outstanding" given the name was giving by Zhang Xueliang.
spots.addr: No.1 Tianyuan, Xiaoshizi Street, Dadong District, Shenyang 沈阳市大东区小什字街天源巷1号

spots.name: Cafe Lido
spots.desc: It is recognized as being the best Western food in Shenyang. Serving Australian beef, mashed potatoes Irish style, Guinness meat pies, fresh fish, salads and the tastiest pastries in town. Special on Friday's Seafood Night, small price for all you can eat and drink!
spots.addr: Qingnian St

spots.name: La Bellevue
spots.desc: For bigger budget there is also a fine dining French restaurant, "La Bellevue".

spots.name: Xita Korea Town
spots.desc: Not one restaurant but an area with many good restaurants. The streets around the Western Pagoda (Xita) are home to many Korean people giving the area the name Korea Town.

spots.name: Buddha Bar and Restaurant
spots.desc: Cocktail and wine bar with large selection of imported beers, Also serves sushi.
spots.addr: Xi Bin He Lu 58

spots.name: Party 98 -2
spots.desc: One of the most popular clubs for foreigners. The first floor plays HipHop and R&B (mainly foreigners), the second floor (mainly Chinese) has singers and electronic music.
spots.addr: Shi San Wei Road (十三纬路 near Heidis and the U.S. Embassy, walking distance to the Kempinsky Hotel)

spots.name: Black Sheep
spots.desc: Very popular with expats. A bar and pub with frequent social events.
spots.addr: Sanjing Jie and Shisanwei Lu

spots.name: Pure Colours
spots.local: 米亚本色 mi ya ben si
spots.desc: The second popular club for foreigners and rich Chinese. They have an informal special for foreigners: buy one get two (for longdrinks only).
spots.addr: 6-328 Fengtian Street (奉天街)

spots.name: Don't Tell Mama
spots.local: 别告诉妈妈 bié gàosu mā ma
spots.desc: Packed even on weeknights, this large Chinese-style club offers a constant cabaret-style variety show with over-the-top dance acts and live singing. One highlight is the male performers seem compelled to chug any quantity of beer bought for them, up to two-liter pitchers, in one go, without using their hands.
spots.addr: Xita St (西塔街), in Korea town

spots.name: Sunny's Night Club
spots.desc: A popular spot for foreigners but staff and service are low quality.

spots.name: Party 98
spots.desc: Noisy Chinese music, close to the 24/24h barbecue restaurants.
spots.addr: Xita St (西塔街), in Korea town

spots.name: Club 97
spots.desc: A shiny, trendy club with an outdoor patio frequented by expats, mostly Russian ones. Not too crappy music, great food before 23:00, a bit pricey though.
spots.addr: No 97 Zhongshan Lu, 100 m W of Zhongshan Sq and its Mao statue (中山路97号，中山广场西100米)

spots.name: Sophie's World Bar
spots.desc: The oldest foreigner bar in town is like an institution for both expats and locals. Cheap alcohol, darts, soccer games on TV.
spots.addr: Er Jing St, Bawei Rd (二经街 八伟路

spots.name: Shamrock Irish Pub
spots.desc: Serving probably the best draught Guinness in Shenyang and more in a clean, laid-back pub. They also have a great selection of foods including Irish stew and onion rings. Great place to go for a pint and a meal and of course the craic. Call for directions. Open from 16:00 till late 7 days a week.
spots.addr: 134/11 Changjiang Street

spots.name: Green Mile
spots.desc: A smoky, grungy sports-bar style bar, which gets especially busy and smoky late on the weekends. A good place to go for shots and cocktails. Some claim that the Green Mile has the best American style pizza in Northeast China, and they deliver. Very popular with expats.
spots.addr: No. 3-1 Bei San Jing Jie

spots.name: Lengyan Temple
spots.desc: One of the largest Buddhist temples in the northeast of China. The site contains Lengyan Pagoda which was opened in 1997.

spots.name: Spa Temple
spots.desc: It is a historic attraction that combines a Buddhist temple with natural hot springs. According to historical records, the temple was founded in the late Ming dynasty by the monks Guanghui and Guangzhi. Because there was a natural hot spring beside the temple and a mountain ridge behind it, it was once known as Tangshan Temple. It was renamed Wenquan Temple in the early Qing dynasty and was…
spots.addr: About 150 meters northwest of Benxi Tianzhu Bus Station, Bentong Road

spots.name: Nantian Gate
spots.desc: Nantian Gate is a mountain scenic area in Baiyu Village, Nanfen District. Its name comes from a large natural opening in the rocky ridge that resembles a gateway in the mountains. The area includes steep cliffs, forested valleys, streams, the historic Nanfen mountain road and geological formations. It was once an important mountain route between Benxi and Dandong. Nantian Gate is also known as a…
spots.addr: Baiyu Village, Xiamatang Subdistrict, Nanfen District

spots.name: Wangtian Cave
spots.desc: A large karst cave with underground chambers, narrow passages and limestone formations. Nearly 10 km of passages have been explored, although only part of the cave is open to visitors. The temperature inside remains cool in summer.
spots.addr: Wanwanchuan Village, Yahe Township, Huanren Manchu Autonomous County

spots.name: Dishui Cave
spots.desc: A mountain stream drops over a cliff more than 30 m high, forming a waterfall in front of several natural caves. The surrounding area is covered by forest and rocky slopes, making it a popular place for hiking and enjoying the scenery. The waterfall is particularly impressive after periods of rain.
spots.hours: 07:30–18:00 from April 21 to October 10; 08:00–17:30 from January 1 to April 20 and October 11 to December 31
spots.price: ¥40; a reduction to ¥20 has been proposed, check current price before visiting
spots.addr: 136 Nantianmen Road, Mingshan District

spots.name: Benxi Lake Park
spots.local: 本溪湖公园; Běnxī Hú Gōngyuán
spots.desc: Benxi Lake Park is a small historic park built around Benxi Lake, a spring-fed cave lake closely connected with the origin of the city's name. Visitors can see water flowing from the limestone cave into the lake, especially during the wetter months from May to October. Paths lead up the surrounding hillside and offer views over Xihu District. The park is relatively small, so it is better suited…
spots.addr: 212 Xihu West Road, Xihu District

spots.name: Dashi Lake Scenic Area
spots.local: 大石湖风景名胜区; Dàshíhú
spots.desc: Dashi Lake Scenic Area is a mountain-valley scenic area with lakes, streams, waterfalls, forest trails and rocky slopes. The main area includes Wulong Lake, where several pools and waterfalls are arranged along the valley, as well as Bingling Gorge and Mulan Valley. The scenery changes with the seasons: spring and summer are good for walking and viewing streams, while autumn is popular for…
spots.price: Around ¥52–60 for an adult ticket; combination tickets with boat rides cost more
spots.addr: Xinchengzi Village, Dongyingfang Township, Benxi Manchu Autonomous County

spots.name: Jiuding Tiecha Mountain
spots.desc: A mountain area known for hiking routes, caves, temples and sites connected with Daoist history in northeastern China. The terrain is steep in places, so allow enough time for the climb.
spots.price: Check current ticket price before visiting
spots.addr: Xiaozhangbao Village, Tieshashan Village, Tianshifu Town, Benxi Manchu Autonomous County

spots.name: Wangxi Park
spots.desc: A large urban park on a hill in central Benxi, with walking paths, trees and viewpoints over the city. It is mainly used by local residents for walking, exercise and recreation.
spots.addr: Renmin Road, Pingshan District

spots.name: Benxi Pingdingshan Forest Park
spots.local: 平顶山森林公园; Píngdǐngshān Sēnlín Gōngyuán
spots.desc: An urban forest park on Pingding Mountain, with hiking paths and viewpoints over central Benxi and the Taizi River. The climb can be fairly steep in sections.
spots.price: Free entry is commonly reported; cable car and some activities may require separate payment
spots.addr: Pingdingshan Huanshan Road

spots.name: Miaohoushan Site
spots.desc: Miaohoushan Site is a Paleolithic cave site on the southern slope of Miaohoushan. Archaeological excavations have uncovered human teeth, stone and bone tools, animal fossils and traces of fire, providing evidence of early human activity in northeastern China. The site is a nationally protected cultural heritage site rather than a conventional tourist attraction, and public access may be limited.…
spots.addr: East of Shanchengzi Village, Benxi Manchu Autonomous County

spots.name: Daya River Rafting
spots.local: 大雅河漂流; Dàyǎ Hé Piāoliú
spots.desc: Daya River Rafting is a seasonal rafting route through a mountain valley near Huanren. The official scenic-area description gives the rafting route as about 6.6 km, with alternating faster and calmer sections as the river narrows and widens. The surrounding area has forested slopes and exposed sandstone formations. Expect to get wet, so quick-drying clothes, secure footwear and a change of…
spots.price: Ticket prices vary. Current online packages combining Longxi Valley and rafting start at about ¥138
spots.addr: Laomanzi Village, Pulerbao Town, Huanren Manchu Autonomous County

spots.name: Benxi International Maple Leaf Festival
spots.local: 本溪（国际）枫叶节; Běnxī Guójì Fēngyè Jié
spots.desc: An annual autumn festival held during Benxi's maple-leaf season. Events usually include cultural performances, markets, photography exhibitions and activities at scenic areas around the city. Peak foliage varies each year depending on the weather. Many public activities are free, although admission fees may apply at individual scenic areas.
spots.hours: Late September to October，2026 opening: September 28
spots.price: Many public activities are free; admission fees may apply at individual scenic areas
spots.addr: Events take place at several locations across Benxi; the 2026 opening ceremony was held at the Benxi Lake Industrial Heritage Complex

spots.name: Benxi Ice and Snow Festival
spots.local: 本溪冰雪节; Běnxī Bīngxuě Jié
spots.desc: An annual winter festival featuring ice-and-snow activities, winter sports, snow games, performances and seasonal events. The 2025 festival opened at Dongfeng Lake Ice and Snow World on January 18. Activities generally continue through the winter snow season, usually from mid-January to late February, although the programme and closing date vary depending on weather and snow conditions.
spots.addr: Dongfeng Lake Ice and Snow World and other winter venues across Benxi

spots.name: Xiaoshi lamb soup
spots.desc: Xiaoshi lamb soup is a local specialty associated with Xiaoshi Town in Benxi Manchu Autonomous County. It is made by simmering locally raised goat meat and offal for several hours until the broth becomes rich and the meat tender. It is usually served hot and is especially common at lamb-soup restaurants around Xiaoshi. Portions can be filling, and the flavour of offal may be unfamiliar to some…

spots.name: Láodòng (Labour) Park
spots.desc: You can walk up or use a seat-lift to reach the peak of the mountain. When you arrive there, you have the possibility to go up the Reach Sightseeing Tower to have an even higher panoramic view. On a beautiful day it is worthy a trip and the gorgeous view will pay off. To get back down you can take the "First Land Sled" which is a really fun experience. Besides looking at probably one of the…
spots.addr: (Zhongshan District)

spots.name: Xinghai Bay Beach
spots.desc: The beach is in the Shahekou District of Dalian Xinghai international business center zone of south coast, adjacent to the square and park, is China's largest artificial seawater baths.

spots.name: Dalian Beer Festival
spots.desc: Thousands of visitors. Day-time folks tend to go for the food and music acts, night-time goers for the beer and music acts. Domestic and regional vendors, some selling beer from Germany and the U.S.
spots.hours: 10 days in late-July and early Aug
spots.addr: Xinghai Sq

spots.name: North Korean Border
spots.desc: As the boundary between China and North Korea, the Yalu River flows over 300 km between the countries. Yalujiang Park is the best place to view North Korea, see the public sculptures, the swimming platforms (Warning: do not swim into North Korea), and possibly take a fast boat ride up and down the river along the border. There are remnants of an original railroad bridge across the river, bombed…

spots.name: Jinjiangshan Park
spots.desc: It is west of the railway station and is easily accessible by a 10-minute walk. The park is very popular to visit by local families on the weekend and by the elderly community during the weekdays as they gather to sing Chinese revolutionary or folklore songs. During the Korean War a giant ammunition bunker was dug into the mountain by the PLA and is still there. The walk to the top can be…
spots.addr: 93 Shanshang Street, Yuanbao District

spots.name: Andong Old Street
spots.desc: A multi-functional cultural street with nostalgia sightseeing of the Nationalist period, classic food and tourism and shopping. The outer street and inner street shops are designed to reproduce the old streetscape by drawing on the classic architectural elements of the old Andong, together with the old objects and streetscape sculptures, including century-old brands, branded catering…
spots.addr: 49 Renmin Road, Zhenxing District

spots.name: Yalu River Park
spots.desc: Riverside park regarded as having some of the best views into North Korea.

spots.name: Yalu River Art Museum
spots.desc: A unique art museum that only displays one exhibition at any one time and only changes its exhibitions once a year. Visitors who wish to visit the museum between October 20th and April 1st are required to make a booking at least one hour before visiting. Bookings can be made by scanning the QR code on the museum website.
spots.hours: 10:00-12:30, 13:00-17:00, no entry between 11:30 and 12:30 or between 16:30 and 17:00, closed on Mondays
spots.price: Standard entry fee is ¥40; free entry is granted to persons over 70 and children under 1.3 meters in height who are…
spots.addr: 11 Moon Island Street, Zhenxing District (振兴区月亮岛大街11号)

spots.name: Moon Island
spots.desc: A beautiful island with an area of 134,000 square meters on the Yalu River. The island consists of several major parts such as dining and entertainment areas, hotels, fitness and leisure. The buildings on Moon Island are all European-style, integrating accommodation, catering, entertainment and shopping. There is a small playground on Moon Island and facilities such as a Ferris wheel and a pirate…

spots.name: Dandong Laishun Hot Pot Restaurant
spots.desc: A Chinese hotpot restaurant still serving the old-fashioned Beijing-style copper hot pots.
spots.addr: Jingjuyuan Unit No.1111, Caishenmiao Street, Yuanbao District

spots.name: Dagu Mountain
spots.local: 大孤山; Dàgūshān; lit. Lonely Mountain
spots.desc: Several Tang dynasty Taoist temples occupy the mountain site.

spots.name: Lei Feng Memorial Hall
spots.local: 雷锋纪念馆; Léi Fēng Jìniànguǎn
spots.desc: This building was built as a museum in 1964, and was converted to the Lei Feng Memorial Hall in 1992. Lei Feng spent the last years of his adult life in Fushun and later became famous throughout the country. His life is seen as an example of how every Chinese person should conduct themselves. The modern memorial hall contains an exhibit in English and Chinese which tells the story of Lei Feng's…
spots.addr: 61 Huping Road, Wanghua District (望花区和平路东段61号; Wànghuāqū Hépínglùdōngduàn)

spots.name: Royal Ocean World
spots.local: 皇家极地海洋世界; Huángjiājídehǎiyángshìjiè
spots.desc: A family theme park opened in 2008 and still being expanded, it claims to house the largest aquarium in Asia. It offers the following attractions:Ocean World contains sea and fresh water aquariums filled with all manor of aquatic life.Century Forest focuses on reptiles, lizards, snakes and crocodiles.Narnian Castle, a theatre where animal shows are performed several times throughout the day (show…
spots.addr: Wanghua District (抚顺高湾(沈吉高速抚顺西出口))

spots.name: Xilutian Mine
spots.desc: This National Industrial Tourist Exemplary Spot is the largest open cast coal mine in Asia. It is 6.6 km from east to west, north to south it is 2 km wide, with a total area of 13.2 km². The vertical depth is 388 meters mining. The site opened in 1914 and is still in use.
spots.addr: Wanghua District

spots.name: Gao'er Mountain Park
spots.desc: A beautiful area of mountainous park land dotted with Buddhist temples, statues and pagodas. The tall pagoda at the top of the hill dates to 1088 making it the oldest extant pagoda in China. It is 14.1 m high with a diameter of 6.8 m.
spots.addr: 97 Gaoshan Road

spots.name: Saerhu Scenic Area
spots.desc: This park of 268 km² surrounds Dahuofang Reservoir which is itself 110 km² and the largest artificial lake in Liaoning. It was in these surroundings that the Nuzhen tribes first settled before going on to united the Manchu and become the Qing rules of China. The mountains were the scene of Sar Hu Battle in 1619 between the fledgling Manchu kingdom and the mighty Ming Dynasty of China. The Ming…
spots.addr: Dongzhou District (东洲区; Dōngzhōuqū)

spots.name: Yuanshuailin National Forest Park
spots.local: 元帅林国家森林公园; Yuánshuàilín Guójiāsēnlín Gōngyuán
spots.desc: This park, created in 1992, covers an area of 10.44 hectares. It is northeast of Fushun city on a promontory on the north side of Dahuafang Lake.
spots.addr: Fushun County (抚顺县; Fǔshùnxiàn)

spots.name: Guanshanhu National Water Conservancy Scenic Area
spots.local: 关山湖国家水利风景区; Guānshānhú Guójiāshuǐlìfēngjǐngqū
spots.desc: This reservoir, also known as Beihu (north lake) is a popular beauty spot with dense forest, mountain and lake.
spots.addr: Fushun County (抚顺县; Fǔshùnxiàn)

spots.name: Sankuaishi Forest Park
spots.local: 三块石森林公园; Sānkuàishí Sēnlíngōngyuán; lit. Three Stone Forest Park
spots.desc: Here you can hike through forest covered mountains which abound in wildlife. Within the area is the site of a revolutionary base during the war again Japan and the following Chinese Civil War. Preserved trenches can still be seen.
spots.addr: Fushun County (辽东山区腹地的抚顺县)

spots.name: Pingdingshan Massacre Memorial Hall
spots.local: 平顶山惨案遗址纪念馆; Píngdǐngshān Cǎnàn Jìniànguǎn
spots.desc: In 1932, Japan invaded the north east of China. In an event know to history as the Pingdingshan Massacre (or Pingdingshan Tragedy), 3000 people in the village of Pingdingshan were killed by the Japanese army. This site marks a mass grave where, in 1972, the bodies of 800 victims were found.
spots.addr: 17 Nanchang Road, Dongzhou District (东洲区南昌路17号)

spots.name: Hetuala City or Xing City
spots.desc: This nationally rated AAAA-class scenic area is near to the Yongling Tomb UNESCO world heritage site. It was here that in 1616, Nurhachu set up his capital city founding the Late Jin Dynasty of the Manchurian people that would later become the ruling Qing Dynasty of China. The site preserves the remains of this former capital and displays unique Manchurian architecture, customs and culture.
spots.addr: Near Yongling in Xinbin Manchu Autonomous County

spots.name: Qingyong Tomb
spots.desc: One of the three tombs of the Qing dynasty 'North of the wall', built in honor the ancestors of Nurhachi's, the dynasty's founder. Dating to the 17th century, the buildings are a fine example of Manchu architecture. This is a .

spots.name: Houshi National Forest Park
spots.local: 猴石森林公园; Hóushísēnlíngōngyuán; lit. Stone Monkey Forest Park
spots.desc: On the national scale, this is a National AAAA-class scenic area.
spots.addr: Xinbin Manchu Autonomous County (新宾满族自治县西南)

spots.name: Honghu Red River Canyon rafting
spots.desc: Explore down a 12.8-km section of river in a small, four- to six-seater, rubber raft passing through unique mountain scenery. This attraction has acquired AAAA ratings in China's national tourist attraction scale. The river has a catchment of 784 km² with sparse population, so there is plenty of water which is clean and free of pollution. The route takes you over some white water sections rated…
spots.hours: Open all year, peak season: J, A and S.
spots.addr: Red River Valley, Qingyuan Manchu Autonomous County, Fushun. (清原满族自治县大苏河红河谷漂流)

spots.name: Su River rafting
spots.desc: This 13-km stretch of unspoiled river is 90 km from any urban area. It takes about 3 hours to complete the route.
spots.addr: Xinbin Manchu Autonomous County, Fushun.

spots.name: Huyang Forest
spots.local: 胡杨林, 敦煌千年胡杨林
spots.desc: It consists of a small forest of rare poplares (Populus Divesifolia). Some are more than 600 years old. Can give an opportunity for a walk far from town. Not to be confused with the Huyang Forest in Jinta County.
spots.addr: Group 3, Wudun Village, Mogao Town (莫高镇五墩村三组)

spots.name: Playing Pipa Statue
spots.desc: The 5-m-high Playing Pipa Statue is the symbol of Dunhuang. It was modelled after a figure of a pipa player that features in a wall painting in Cave 112 of the Mogao Caves.
spots.addr: Intersection of Yangguan Middle Road and Shazhou North Road (阳关中路与沙洲北路交汇)

spots.name: Summer of Dunhuang Variety Show
spots.desc: Performances of singing and dancing in the Silk Road traditions.

spots.name: Camel Trek, arranged by Charlie Johng's Cafe
spots.desc: Get to know the desert firsthand on a 2- to 7-day camel trek across spectacular sand dunes. A typical trek goes for 3 days and includes a visit to the Mogao Cave. Alternately, just camp out in the desert for a night to experience the Gobi Desert's night sky, sunset and sunrise. If you don't have much time you can have a one day tour with staying in the desert and riding to the Mogao Cave in the…
spots.price: Bargain hard, but going rate is between ¥250-500 per day
spots.addr: Mingshan Road

spots.name: Night market
spots.desc: Good dried fruits and nuts (walnuts, dates, raisins, apricots, small tomatoes...). Many souvenirs. Some people sell wood stamps, pretending they are made from the rare Huyang tree, but they are not. Huyang tree is too soft to be carved.

spots.name: Charlie Johng's cafe
spots.desc: Reasonably priced western meals available. Very helpful staff.
spots.addr: Mingshan Road

spots.name: Yunnan Cross Bridge Mixian
spots.desc: Own by a lively small lady, eager to introduce you to her home cuisine. Tasty rice noodles with authentic sauces. Chinese speaker handy.
spots.addr: 7 Baiwei Jie

spots.name: Lovina Pizza
spots.desc: A nice quiet pizza restaurant (only one in town) with good easy to read menu with English and pictures. Free wireless internet and decent relatively cheap coffee. They also do deliveries if you can speak Chinese.
spots.addr: No. 1, Level 3, B Building, Business Walking Street (敦煌市商业步行街B座三楼1号)

spots.name: Oasis
spots.desc: Run by an Oklahoman, this cafe has good coffee, milkshakes, and a small menu with pizza and hamburgers. The wifi is fast.
spots.addr: Pedestrian Street

spots.name: Sculptures of the Mother River
spots.desc: Gansu sculpture by the famous sculptor He E creation, 6 meters long, 2.2 meters wide, 2.6 meters tall, weighing 40 tons, from "mother" and a "baby" of composition.
spots.addr: Lanzhou City Qilihe District South Binhe middle Road(兰州市七里河区南滨河中路)

spots.name: Tianxu sand Palace Geopark
spots.desc: This is the most unique natural landscape in Lanzhou City, located in the Longfeng Gorge east of Renshou Mountain, Taohuayuan, Anning District, is a red sandstone about 25 million years ago, after long-term weathering and water erosion formed a group of Danxia-like landform wonders. It is named because it is natural, such as the sand palace carved by God.
spots.addr: 兰州市皋兰县(Gaolan County, Lanzhou City)

spots.name: Gansu Sanmu Bicycle Museum
spots.local: 甘肃三木自行车博物馆
spots.desc: A privately owned museum with a large collection of old bicycles from all over the world.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 1 Nanbinhe East Road, Chengguan District (城关区南滨河东路1号)

spots.name: Waterwheel Garden
spots.desc: (水车博览园) Small park along the Yellow River housing impressive traditional waterwheels, originally used to irrigate farmland around Lanzhou.

spots.name: Yantan Park

Later turned into parks, gardens lush forests, beautiful scenery, has built a pavilion, and the Yellow River scenery mutual authentic, very magnificent.

spots.name: Xiaoxihu Park
spots.desc: Metro Line 1 Xiaoxihu Stn. A small park, supposedly to be a (poor) replica of the Xihu (West Lake) in Hangzhou.

spots.name: Qiaomenjie Mosque
spots.local: Bridge Gate Mosque, 桥门清真寺
spots.desc: Qiaomenjie Mosque is located in Qiaomenxiang, a Hui inhabited area south of Zhongshanqiao, Lanzhou City, Gansu Province. It is a Chinese Islamic mosque. According to legend, as early as the Ming Dynasty, there was a simple mosque in Qiaomenxiang (street). The temple was once listed as a "provincial cultural relic protection unit".
spots.addr: Zhongshan Road, Chengguan District, Lanzhou City(兰州市城关区中山路)

spots.name: Nanguan Grand Mosque
spots.desc: also known as the Gongnanmen Mosque or Nanshao Gate Mosque. It stands as one of the six most renowned mosques in Lanzhou since the Ming and Qing dynasties, initially constructed during the Hongwu period of the Ming Dynasty (1368-1398). The present-day grand mosque was rebuilt in 1986.

spots.name: White Cloud Temple
spots.desc: t is also known as 'Lüzu Temple' because it is dedicated to worship Lü Dongbin. It is on the south river bank, Nanbinhe East Road, one block west of Zhongshan Bridge. It's much less touristy, a peaceful little compound, so the wear-and-tear on the buildings feels venerable rather than run-down.
