spots.name: UBC Coffee House
spots.desc: For when you need a Western food break that's consistent wherever you are.
spots.addr: Zhongshan Road

spots.name: Zhangye Museum
spots.desc: A great little history and culture museum if you can read Chinese – unfortunately almost none of the displays are in English.

spots.name: Muto-ji Temple
spots.desc: The Wooden Pagoda Temple is one of the Five Elements Pagodas in Zhangye. The existing wooden pagoda was rebuilt in 1926. The tower is high, with nine levels on eight sides. Each level has a wood-carved dragon head, a pearl in the mouth, and a wind chime hanging below. The main body of the tower is a wooden structure, and the outer eaves are built in the style of a pavilion. You can climb up the…
spots.addr: Muta Lane, Ganzhou District

spots.name: Zhangye Danxia National Geological Park (Binggou Danxia)
spots.local: 张掖丹霞国家地质公园 (冰沟丹霞)
spots.desc: Less colourful than the more famous Qicai Danxia, this one features columns of red rock (with some white bands), in two valleys. There's a network of trails accessing viewpoints in and around two different valleys.

spots.name: Heihe Wetland Park
spots.desc: Wetland habitat for birds and other wild animals with bird-watching towers.
spots.addr: Suburbs of Ganzhou District

spots.name: Luopangzi Noodle Restaurant
spots.desc: Gansu-style firecracker noodles and pork plates. The service is a bit gruff and the noodles an acquired taste, but the pork is delicious.

spots.name: Xianhuo Barbecue
spots.desc: Barbecued meat and vegetables on skewers. Friendly service (though unclear whether any English spoken). It is one of the top-rated places in the city on Dianping and deservedly so.

spots.name: Ningxia Great Wall
spots.desc: This part of the wall is in various states of decay, but maintains some impressive examples ancient masonry. The site is undeveloped and you are free to wander about/climb on it as you like. Sections of the Ningxia Great Wall originate primarily from the Ming Dynasty. It is about 1 km in length, and continues up the mountains and further out in both directions. Well worth the trip, but be…

spots.name: Public bus
spots.desc: From in front of the Alashun Hotel or at the bus depot hidden away down the street from the train station in the New Town (what once was the bus station entrance hall is a furniture store, the main station entrance looks like a small shop but is in the same building next door). Public buses going there do not have numbers but are white with blue lettering and travel between Yinchuan and Zuoqi…
spots.addr: Departs: Alashun Hotel and New Town bus depot

spots.name: The city
spots.desc: The best thing in Yinchuan is the people and the Hui neighbourhoods, so the best option is just to take a bus in any direction and getting down in a street market or in a park. It is also recommended to go to the main square in the night where there are dances and games.

spots.name: Hiking
spots.desc: Aside from the trails mentioned above under Helanshan Suyukou, other parts of the mountain offer hiking. In principle, there is a trail from Suyukou to the rock art area, although it is still closed due to flood damage as of fall 2018.

spots.name: Xinhua Street
spots.desc: The economic centre and shopping centre of Yinchuan with many large malls and department stores and all the large clothing chains (Nike, Disney, Jack Jones, etc.) Do not expect to bargain here.

spots.name: Emanuelle's
spots.desc: A wonderful ESL school, Christian bookstore, library, teahouse and restaurant run by one of China's top entrepreneurs. It provides a retreat from the chaos of the city and serves a variety of foreign foods. Recommended platters are the chicken curry and the beef with rice soup (which is Chinese food directed at Western tongues).

spots.name: Uncle Robin's American Pizza
spots.desc: The only real American-style pizza in Yinchuan. Owned by Robin, a Korean-Chinese man, you can find authentic home pizza. The Meat Lovers, Vegetarian and Pepperoni pizzas are all full marks. The staff speak very good English here. It is also the only restaurant in town to find Dr. Pepper. They have two locations. One is in the Old City at #278 Beijing Dong Lu, near the International Hotel (but on…
spots.price: A pizza costs between ¥50 and ¥60 and serves two people (Pizza Hut size). A can of Dr. Pepper, Mountain Dew, or root…
spots.addr: 中国宁夏回族自治区银川市，西夏区朔方路梧桐花园北门 1-13

spots.name: Napoli Italian Cuisine
spots.desc: A curious blend of western dishes and Chinese ingredients. Though it is well marketed the food in Napoli generally does not appeal to foreigners. If you are looking for something to remind you of home, you are better off finding an alternative.

spots.name: Lian Yuan Bar
spots.desc: A well decorated bar, and the best in New Town. The staff is very relaxed and friendly, and there are unobtrusive musical performances every night starting 8PM-9PM.
spots.price: The drinks here are a little more expensive than some other places

spots.name: Fall in Love Bar & Marry Bar
spots.desc: Comfortable seating and a younger crowd, you can sit back with any of the local beers and relax.
spots.addr: Hubin East Street

spots.name: The King Divine Luck Club
spots.desc: Popular club featuring dancers and a very impressive layout.
spots.price: Booths and box seats have a higher minimum purchase

spots.name: Baby Face
spots.desc: Popular club featuring dancers and a very impressive layout.
spots.price: Booths and box seats have a higher minimum purchase

spots.name: Come Back
spots.desc: Although traditional western coffee is hard to come by, this drink chain (which can be found almost everywhere in Yinchuan) sells their version of a coffee drink that can be served hot or cold. While it is still not western style coffee, it is quite good, somewhat similar to Starbucks' caramel macchiato.

spots.name: Bob and Leo's BBQ
spots.desc: Bob and Leo (chubby and happy twins) have some of the best BBQ chicken in Yinchuan, if not China. They both speak English and are extremely friendly. It is an outdoor grill with great selections of mutton and fish as well as a selection of vegetables. Cheap beers and the occasional expat make it a must-visit. Open late or until you stop buying beers.
spots.addr: beijing luo

spots.name: Tongguan Live House
spots.desc: Laid-back rock n’ roll student bar. Imported beers and spirits. Live bands and alternative music. Hao Ting Ting is the bartender and she is very friendly, open minded and speaks English. Just as likely to see teenaged art rockers and students as grisly punks and misguided foreigners.
spots.addr: 银川市西夏区801创意园内往东100米（北方民族大学对面）

spots.name: Qinghai Provincial Museum
spots.desc: Nice place to learn about Qinghai's history and ethnic relationships. Covers the history of Silk Road on the Qinghai region. Some English text available. Exhibition nicely arranged from Room 1 to 5, although you need to pay a bit of attention of the flow inside the Hall. Audio guide available for ¥20.
spots.hours: Summer: 09:00-17:00, Winter: 09:30-16:30, no tickets issued in last 30 minutes of operation, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 58 Xiguan Street, Chengxi District (城西区西关大街58号)

spots.name: Qinghai Tibetan Culture Museum & Tibetan Medicine Museum of China
spots.local: 青海藏文化博物院, 青海藏医药文化博物馆
spots.desc: This is two museums in one. The Tibetan Medicine Museum occupies the north building and the Qinghai Tibetan Culture Museum occupies the south building. Both museums have unique exhibits. The Tibetan Medicine Museum, for example, displays a large collection of medical thangkas while the Qinghai Tibetan Cultural Museum is home to the world's longest thangka, at 600m long, not to mention thousands…
spots.hours: May to September: 09:00-18:00, October to April: 09:00-17:30, no entry in last 30 minutes
spots.price: Entry to the Tibetan Medicine Museum is free; the Qinghai Tibetan Culture Museum charges ¥60
spots.addr: No.36 Jing'er Road, Biological Science & Technology Park, Chengbei District (城北区生物科技产业园区经二路36号)

spots.name: Qinghai-Tibet Plateau Natural History Museum
spots.desc: As the name implies, this museum focuses on the natural history of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau. It is said to be one of the largest natural history museums in China. You can learn about the origin of 3 big rivers from this region, as well as flora and fauna. Exhibition halls on two floors. Can be explored in 2h.
spots.addr: 21 JIng'er Road, Biological Science & Technology Park, Chengbei District (城北区生物科技产业园区经二路21号)

spots.name: North Mountain Temple
spots.local: 北山寺 Beishan Temple, 北禅寺 Northern Chan Monastery, 土楼观 Tulou Temple
spots.desc: An shared complex for Buddhism and Taoism in the hill, be prepared for a climb. The first temple serving as a landmark is Tulou Temple. A lot of it is closed for safety reasons. This includes the walkways between man-made caves in the mountain. There is a pagoda above, on the hill. From here there is a great view over the city. As of June 2026, the path up the hill is closed due to erosion. No…
spots.addr: 38 Qilian Road West, Chengbei District (城北区祁连路西38号)

spots.name: Tsongkha Monastery
spots.desc: A small but historically significant Tibetan Buddhist monastery. In December 1951, the 10th Panchen Lama came here to meet with Xi Zhongxun, the father of Xi Jinping, who at that time was head of the Northwest Bureau of the CPC Central Committee. A few months later, Xi Zhongxun was appointed to be the Chinese government’s main liaison officer for communications with the 10th Panchen Lama, and the…
spots.hours: General opening hours are 08:00-18:00; the main hall closes at 17:00
spots.addr: 26 Hongjuesi Street, Chengzhong District (城中区宏觉寺街26号)

spots.name: Dangaer Ancient Town
spots.desc: Previously serving as a key stop on Tang-Tibet Ancient Road for tea-horse trade route.

spots.name: Chaka Salt Lake
spots.desc: 'Chaka' means 'salt pond' in Tibetan language. It was used to be salt mining, but now it is known for photography for the reflection of its shallow lake surface. There are several hotels nearby if you want to stay overnight. If you want to walk on the lake you must rent a rubber boots shoe cover for ¥10.
spots.price: ¥60 for entrance. ¥50 for one-way ride of scenic train ride.

spots.name: Amdocraft
spots.desc: Handicraft produced by Tibetan nomads and farmers - felt bags, knit scarves, sheepskin gloves, yak milk soap and the like.
spots.addr: Lenghulu 2, JiesenHuaYuan South Gate 冷湖路2号杰森花园西南门

spots.name: Mojia Market
spots.desc: The front end of the market has many small snack stands selling spicy ground meat birds egg pizza-style bing (¥3), spicier Liangpi noodle (¥4.5) and mouth cooling bowl-set yoghurt with a creaming texture and slightly sour/citrus flavour (¥3). Further into the market mounds of dried fruit and nuts from the region can be bought by weight.
spots.addr: Mojia Lu

spots.name: XiNanGuanJie Market
spots.desc: lively street market outside Dongguan Mosque. You can get tea, street food, fruits, bread, and other Muslim (Hui) delicacies here.
spots.addr: XinNanGuanJie

spots.name: KFC
spots.desc: There are a few KFCs in the city, but this is by far the most centrally located.
spots.addr: Near the Wangfujing Shopping Mall, Xi Dajie

spots.name: Will's Coffee Shop
spots.desc: Minimalist, hipster cafe serving excellent, freshly brewed coffee. English spoken.
spots.addr: 11-21 Beiyuejing Alley / 北玉井巷11-21号(玉树办事处家属院沿街商铺)

spots.name: Cafe Java
spots.desc: Expat couple from the UK opened this cafe in 2009. Excellent coffee and home-made food at a great price. Favourite dishes include Mexican wraps, chilli, bagels of all kinds, pancakes & waffles with sweet or savoury toppings. Also a great place to meet other foreign residents or expats in Xining. Free Wi-Fi.
spots.addr: 47 Haiyan Road (海晏路47号9-1号铺)

spots.name: Green House Cafe
spots.desc: Great little cafe opened up by an American expat in Xining. Relaxed atmosphere, good Wi-Fi, and, some say, the best coffee in the city. They have desserts and sandwiches as well.
spots.addr: Xiadu Avenue, Near Yangshan Villas

spots.name: Qilin Bay Bar Strip
spots.desc: A complex of bars by the riverside, built around an atrium. They cannot be seen from down the road, but just below the bridge you should see a number of cars parked, with steps down into the park. You will see several small bars.
spots.addr: Intersection of Kunlun West and Huanghe Road

spots.name: Culture Street Bar Strip
spots.desc: A large complex with about two dozen bars over three different floors with an open center atrium. You can choose between more relaxed lounge bars, live music venues, or one or two bars that have dance floors on the ground floor.
spots.addr: Culture Street (Wenhua Jie)

spots.name: Soho
spots.desc: Soho is Xining's most popular nightclub, usually busy past 2AM most nights. Lots of tables and a bar, but there is no dancing. Music is mostly live. Soho is a nightclub franchise in China, but this one apparently is an "unofficial club."
spots.addr: 116 Nanguan Street

spots.name: No. 88 Bar
spots.desc: Similar to Soho bar, but a larger dance floor. Crowded on the weekends, but a bigger crowd at Soho.
spots.addr: 7-1 Road, Across from the TCM Hospital

spots.name: Shaanxi Science & Technology Museum
spots.local: 陕西科学技术馆, 陕西科技馆
spots.desc: The museum has four floors. The first floor focuses on the history of human technological development. The second floor is devoted to electromagnetics. The third floor is concerned with optics, mechanics and mathematics. The fourth and uppermost floor has multimedia and electronics exhibitions.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 15:00, closed on Mondays and Tuesdays
spots.price: Tickets are free but there are strict limitations on visitor numbers. From Wednesday to Friday, there are no more than…
spots.addr: 252 Dongxin Street, Xincheng District (新城区东新街252号)

spots.name: Xi'an Art Museum
spots.desc: Displays a wide range of artworks from both Chinese and foreign artists.
spots.addr: Zhenguan Culture Square, Great Tang All Day Mall, Qujiang New District (曲江新区大唐不夜城贞观文化广场)

spots.name: Tang West Market Museum
spots.desc: Said to be China's first privately run on-site archaeological museum. The museum is located at the site of the excavated ruins of the West Market, probably the most important market in China during the Tang Dynasty. Thousands of artefacts have been unearthed at the site, including not only Tang Dynasty artefacts, but also artefacts from earlier and later dynasties.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:30 (summer), 09:00-17:00 (winter), no entry in last 60 minutes, closed on Mondays and the eve of Chinese New…
spots.price: General admission is free. Tickets for the special exhibitions are ¥60. Tickets for the epitaph collection are ¥150.
spots.addr: 118 Laodong South Road, Lianhu District (莲湖区劳动南路118号)

spots.name: Shaanxi Archaeological Museum
spots.desc: Opened in 2022, this new museum displays artefacts from several important archaeological sites in Shaanxi Province. Visitors are required to make a booking on the Shaanxi Archaeological Research Institute's WeChat account before visiting the museum. The WeChat account name is 陕西考古 (Shaanxi Archaeology).
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, tickets must be collected between 09:00 and 12:00 or between 13:00 and 16:00, visitors must enter by 16:20
spots.addr: Intersection of Wenyuan South Road and Zhongnan Avenue, Chang'an District (长安区文苑南路与终南大道交汇处)

spots.name: Lantian Man Site
spots.desc: In 1964, at this site in Lantian County, the cranium of a hominid was discovered. The discovery came just one year after a mandible belonging to a similar individual had been found in another part of the county. The two individuals were later classified as belonging to a subspecies of Homo erectus known as Homo erectus lantianensis or Lantian Man. A small museum at the site displays both the…
spots.addr: Gongwangling, Jiujianfang Town, Lantian County (蓝田县九间房镇公王岭)

spots.name: Louguantai
spots.desc: It is a Daoist temple complex. This is supposedly the place where Laozi preached and composed the classic Taoism book, Dao De Jing. Upon entering, some drivers may offer you a ride to the main temple at the back of the complex for ¥10.

spots.name: Qinling National Botanical Garden
spots.desc: Covering an area of 639 km², the Qinling National Botanical Garden lays claim to being the largest botanical garden in the world.
spots.hours: Mar-Oct: 08:30-17:30; Nov-Feb: 09:00-17:00; no tickets issued in last 60 minutes
spots.addr: Guanzhong Circuit, Jixian Town, Zhouzhi County (周至县集贤镇)

spots.name: Taiping National Park
spots.desc: Famous for its waterfall and the largest area of wild Zijing flower (the city flower of Hong Kong) in north China.

spots.name: Xiangyu Forest Park
spots.desc: Sitting the foot of Guanyin Mountain, next to the Xiang River, the park features pine, poplar and bamboo forests as well as waterfalls, caves and different scenic spots.

spots.name: Hui Muslim Quarter
spots.desc: Walk through the Muslim quarter sampling food and buying souvenirs. The Hui Muslim Quarter (回民街 Huí mín jiē, hwei-min-jyeh) is a series of small alleys located in a high-density Hui community (very much like Chinatown in North America) inside the city walls, where the residences open up small restaurants and food shops like street food. Some of these restaurants are among the most famous ones in…

spots.name: Bike the City Walls
spots.desc: Bicycling around the city walls will take about 2 hours leisurely and just over an hour if you only stop a little. Bicycles can be rented on each of the four main gates for 180 minutes, ¥45 per person (=¥90 for a tandem), and it may to be returned to any of the other stations (however, be sure to verify this before starting your ride or if they are still open as the other gates close at ~20:00).…

spots.name: Terracotta Warriors
spots.desc: If you are visiting the Terracotta Warriors, be prepared to meet some of the most hardcore hawkers you are likely to meet anywhere. If you keep quiet, they will usually bargain themselves down in front of you in desperate pleas for your money. A box of 15-cm-high Terracotta Warriors cost ¥5-10 (if you're lucky) or ¥15-25 (more likely) even if they offer it to you for ¥45. Wood-carved Buddhas and…

spots.name: Calligraphy Street (书院门步行街)
spots.desc: This is another souvenir shopping area. Less hectic than the Muslim Quarter.

spots.name: Tang Tricolored Pottery Factory
spots.desc: Tang Tricolored Pottery is a style that was lost and has now been recreated from pieces of pottery found in tombs. It is graphic in image and eye-pleasing in color. The factory recreating the style offers over 100 varieties of items, like statues, animals and utensils.

spots.name: Shuyuanmen Antique Paper & Ink
spots.desc: Tucked away on the historic street, this shop sells traditional rice paper, ink stones, and calligraphy sets. It's a great place to find a thoughtful, cultural souvenir away from the mass-produced trinkets.
spots.addr: Shuyuanmen Ancient Culture Street

spots.name: East Street
spots.desc: Has regular fashion shops. On the right side of the street there is an underground mall (called LuoMaShi) where one can find cheap socks, knockoff goods, and local brands

spots.name: South Street
spots.desc: Has finer clothes and shoes, and is home to boutiques like Prada, Louis Vuitton, Gucci and Marc Jacobs.

spots.name: Baihui Market
spots.desc: Local youngsters shop here. It is one of those fake-brand markets. Sport shoes should be less than ¥150, pullovers and nice jeans sometimes less than ¥100, lots of cheap fashion accessories. This is also a great place for DVDs and CDs but understand these are mostly pirated copies.

spots.name: Kangfu Road
spots.desc: A great place for a bargain. Nothing is (bargained for) over ¥50 and most clothes can be bargained down to about ¥20 if you are really aggressive. But this place is full of poor quality stuff.

spots.name: Shida Lu
spots.desc: A trendy place to shop in a largely student populated area in the south of the city. Shida Lu has lots of hair salons, and clothing boutiques.

spots.name: Century Ginwa
spots.desc: This luxury shopping mall has three locations in Xi'an. One downtown by the Drum Tower, one in Gaoxing on Keji Lu, and one just outside of the South Gate.

spots.name: Jiahui Hantang Book City
spots.desc: The largest bookstore in Xi'an, Book City has a fairly decent selection of imported English books. You'll find a wide range of books here, from educational ones, to classic novels, and modern literature to children's books. The place gets swamped with people at the weekends, so for a more pleasant browsing experience, come during a weekday.
spots.addr: 111 Chang’an Zhonglu, Yanta District; 西安市雁塔区长安中路111号

spots.name: Xi'an Book Building
spots.desc: Four floors of books as far as the eye can see. Though the vast majority of books are in the Chinese language, you will find a small selection of English books on the second floor. The building also houses a small audio and video section, as well as a café.
spots.addr: 214 Jiefang Lu; 西安市新城区解放路236

spots.name: Bell Tower Xinhua Bookstore
spots.desc: Another very small English language book selection can be found at the Bell Tower Xinhua Bookstore. Unless you're nearby, your best bet for English books is still the Foreign Language Bookstore or even the Book City. However, if you're also looking for stationary, cards, wrapping paper etc. then it may be worth checking out and to trying to kill two birds with the one stone. Otherwise don't…
spots.addr: 377 Dong Dajie; 西安市东大街377号

spots.name: Wen Xin Jiaozi Guan
spots.desc: A good cheap place for jiaozi (Chinese dumplings). There is no menu, but endless supplies of fresh jiaozi of many flavors.
spots.addr: 123 Xushimiao Street

spots.name: Lao Sun Jia
spots.desc: Has fantastic yangrou paomo which is very cheap but flavorful. No English spoken but easy to communicate with sign language! Franchises all across town.
spots.addr: 364 Dong Dajie

spots.name: Li Ming's Dumpling House
spots.desc: A tiny, family-run spot known only to locals, serving exceptional guotie (potstickers) and baozi (steamed buns) with secret-recipe fillings. No frills, just authentic flavor.
spots.addr: Off the main tourist streets in the Beilin District

spots.name: Green Molly Restaurant & Pub
spots.desc: A restaurant where you can indulge in the tastes of home, whether that be in the U.S., Europe or even Mexico. The restaurant owns only the second authentic pizza oven in Xi'an. Downstairs, the first and only real pub in Xi'an has a wide selection of beverages ranging from imported beers to wine and delicious cocktails.

spots.name: Small World Cafe
spots.desc: Run by a Dutch woman and her Chinese husband. Known by the older generations as "the oldest western restaurant in Xi'an", which opened in the early 70s. Great European cafe feel. Good food. Pizza, salad, fried chicken and real cake. From the windows, one could see busy Huancheng Nanlu (环城南路), while it is really quiet inside.
spots.addr: Huancheng Nanlu Dongduan 90#

spots.name: Delhi Darbar
spots.desc: Authentic North Indian food run by a wonderful Indian manager. Service is good, food is divinely delicious, and prices are very affordable. Mango Lassi for only ¥10 is a must-have. Average meal price is about ¥40 per person.
spots.addr: Dayanta West Road (雁塔区大唐通易坊东头路北)

spots.name: Yongxingfang
spots.desc: Set in a historical building complex, and translating to "the food museum" the restaurant serves traditional food from the Shaanxi province. There are also different folk cultural performances. This place is the home of the local "smashing wine bowl" tradition where you drink rice wine from a small cup, then smash it into pieces, which is supposed to bring luck.
spots.addr: Shuncheng Lane

spots.name: Zhen Er Lao Tan Suan Cai Yu
spots.desc: Traditional Sichuan restaurant, whose name translates to Sijiong Old Jar Fish With Chinese Sauerkraut.
spots.addr: Dianzizheng St

spots.name: Tang Paradise Hotel
spots.desc: Dinner show in a 165-acre theme park. The charm lies in that all the buildings in the park are built in the luxurious style of the Tang Dynasty. The best time to visit is at night when most of the shows, including fireworks and dances, are performed.

spots.name: Tongshengxiang
spots.desc: Upscale restaurant serving traditional dishes of the Hui community. Three other locations in the city.
spots.addr: 雁塔区 北池头二路 1 层 邮政编码: 710061

spots.name: De Fu Lou Cafe & Bar
spots.desc: In Bar Street (De Fu Xiang), one of the first bars ever to open in Xi'an and a favorite hangout for locals. Live football on the big screen and live music every night.
spots.addr: De Fu Xiang Street

spots.name: Havana Bar
spots.desc: Has a Colombian band and makes good cocktails. It's not your average Buena Vista Social Club, though: they play loud music in between band performances and the band plays a wide array of pop and salsa. This location is more of a club than an actual Latin bar.
spots.addr: 319 Dongxin St

spots.name: Qingweilou Art Museum
spots.desc: The museum building is a reconstruction of the Qingweilou, a famous historical tower that was demolished during the 20th century. It displays both ancient and modern artwork, including paintings, calligraphy, ceramics, bronzeware and jade artifacts.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00，no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays and public holidays
spots.addr: Weiyang East Road, Weicheng District (渭城区渭阳东路)

spots.name: Xianyang Kaiyuecheng Shopping Center
spots.desc: A large shopping mall featuring domestic and international brands, supermarkets, cinemas, and a food court. Popular among both locals and visitors.
spots.addr: Century Avenue & Renmin Road, Qindu District, Xianyang

spots.name: Xianyang Pedestrian Street
spots.desc: A historic commercial street integrating shopping, dining, and entertainment, ideal for local specialties and souvenirs.
spots.addr: Renmin Road, Qindu District, Xianyang

spots.name: Turpan Idikut Ancient City
spots.local: 吐鲁番高昌故城; Tǔlǔfān Gāochāng Gùchéng
spots.desc: Ruins of an ancient Silk Road town standing isolated in the Gobi Desert. Built in the 1st century B.C. and called Gaochangbi, it used to be a garrison town.

spots.name: Night Market
spots.desc: An alternative to the night market outside the bazaar, this option is more for locals than tourists.
spots.addr: Guanghui Street, near Bezeklik St

spots.name: Confucian Temple
spots.desc: A beautiful, quiet and peaceful temple. To find it follow the red wall alongside the Autonomous Regional Party Committee building north from People's Square. Take the first turn to the right and follow the road east to the end where you will find the temple. It closes at 13:00 for lunch.
spots.addr: Qianjin Lu.

spots.name: Liyushan Park
spots.desc: The park is showing old trees from the desert, large stone trees, stones with carvings from BC and some Przewalski horses (which are rare) plus other animals. The north entrance is hard to find and just behind the Yema International Business Hotel (4th floor of the building in the back yard).
spots.addr: No.158 Kunming Rd

spots.name: Erdaoqiao Folk Instrument Maker Visit
spots.local: 二道桥民俗乐器制作家坊
spots.desc: Visit the small workshop of a Uyghur craftsman specializing in making traditional instruments like the rawap and dutar. See the meticulous process from wood selection to stringing, and even try playing a few notes.
spots.addr: Erdaoqiao Market area

spots.name: 二道桥民俗乐器制作家访
spots.desc: Visit the small workshop of a Uyghur craftsman specializing in making traditional instruments like the rawap and dutar. See the meticulous process from wood selection to stringing, and even try playing a few notes.
spots.addr: Erdaoqiao Market area

spots.name: Qosh Amet
spots.desc: For perhaps the best dapanji (大盘鸡 dà pán jī in Chinese, چوڭ تەخسە توخۇ قورۇمىسى chong texse toxu qorumisi in Uyghur) in town — a famous Uyghur dish, head to Konsulhana Kochisi (near the large mosque across from the north end of Yan'an Lu) where you'll find Qosh Amet. For those who don't know Uyghur, simply look for the large English sign that reads "Chicken Food" and head on in. It's a…
spots.addr: Lingguan Alley

spots.name: Bodun (博盾)
spots.desc: Delicious and cheap Uyghur staples. Good location in the city center.
spots.addr: 42 Heping Rd N

spots.name: Avral
spots.desc: Delicious and finely decorated, Avral is also well known for its Uyghur ice cream (marozhni). This location is undergoing renovation, but their delicious ice cream shows up in other restaurants.
spots.addr: 60 Shengli Rd

spots.name: Dumpling House
spots.desc: For an authentic local experience, just around the corner from the Rendezvous cafe, try here. They serve a form of fried, then steamed dumplings that are very popular with the local crowd, accompanied by a hot bowl of butter milk tea.

spots.name: Rendezvous
spots.desc: American-run. Also offers an excellent breakfast menu on the weekends, and their wraps are quite delicious. Try the Enchilada if you are hungry or the Burgers. They also have a great range of cakes, some say the best chocolate cake in Urumqi. For the money, the best and cheapest Western food in Urumqi.
spots.addr: 960 Yan'an Rd

spots.name: Eversun Coffee Minzhu Rd
spots.desc: A trendy local coffee chain with a comprehensive western menu including several steak options. Eat and drink in a classy Urumqi establishment. Smoking is permitted, and there is live piano music some nights.
spots.addr: Hongqi Rd and Mingzhu Rd

spots.name: The Texas Cafe
spots.desc: A Tex-Mex and classic American café. For comfort food try their fajita plates or tacos. They've got refried beans and homemade taco shells. The place is decorated with a lot of Texas memorabilia and it's somewhat of a Tex-Mex oasis there in Xinjiang. Also, they have a good selection of English books.
spots.addr: Nanmen Mashixiaoqu

spots.name: Vine Coffeehouse
spots.desc: A Caribbean cafe serving a wide array of western and Caribbean specialty dishes. Somewhat overpriced with small portions, but the little steaks are nice.
spots.addr: 65 Minzhu Rd

spots.name: Edo No Sakura
spots.desc: For those intrigued by the prospect of eating sushi in the city furthest from an ocean. It is a bit pricey as can be expected. Next door is also a Brazilian barbecue restaurant, Sabbath.
spots.addr: 65 Guangming Rd

spots.name: Tashkent
spots.desc: Pleasantly decorated Central Asian cafe (with a smattering of European dishes, as well), in the Dawan Bei Lu area. From the Number 10 bus stop, turn right at the first semblance of a road, pass a few run-down shops and suddenly you will enter a nearly new strip-mall area surrounded by fancy apartments. Keep walking about two (short) blocks, and Tashkent will be on your left. Madina, a tasty…
spots.addr: 47 Xinhua Rd S, near the Huaqiao Hotel (华侨宾馆)

spots.name: Ice Mountain Creamery
spots.desc: American-owned ice cream shop selling delicious ice cream. They have a very small window in the center of town but you can also buy it at the Texas Cafe.
spots.addr: 乌市人民路车市 H9 (Wushi renmin lu che shi H9), near the center of town

spots.name: Vegan Yuanqi Vegetarian Restaurant
spots.desc: A Buddhist restaurant near the junction of Altay Road and Xinyi Road. Walk about 200 m north from the junction. On the left side of the road stands a big apartment block with two buildings. Restaurant is 50 m inside a little alley between A and B wings. The staff are charming but speak no English, the menu is entirely in Chinese.
spots.addr: 2 Altay Rd

spots.name: Korgan
spots.desc: Luxuriously decorated Uyghur restaurant. Very good Uyghur food if somewhat inflated prices.

spots.name: Victoria
spots.desc: A popular hangout with hip Uyghurs, Central Asians and Russians. The dancing and atmosphere are good but the prices are high. Small beers start at ¥25 (local beer by comparison is ¥2), and most dishes begin around ¥60.
spots.addr: 94 Shengli Rd

spots.name: Almaly Club
spots.desc: This Kazakh themed restaurant and club serves a wide variety of Kazakh and Russian dishes. After 22:00 Beijing time there is live music and dancing (but also a minimum expense of ¥200 per party).
spots.addr: 38 Renmin Rd (F5, Xinhongxin Mansion, 新宏信大厦5楼)

spots.name: Mor Buddhist Pagoda
spots.desc: Built in 7th century during the Tang dynasty and destroyed in the 12th century. Nowadays only one pagoda is left, next to the pagoda is a platform. The pagoda is the place where the monks in the city to come and do their worship. The Mor pagoda has three square layers, each a little smaller than the one below it. The bottom layer has circumferences of more than forty-eight meters, the second…

spots.name: Mal Bazaar
spots.desc: The livestock market, where locals from all the surrounding villages come to town to buy and sell animals. It's held on an open and fenced ground. It's popular with tourists, yet is so big it still feels like (in fact it is) a working bazaar. It changed its location some three years ago; now it's a good 30 minute bus ride north of the city (bus 23, get off with everyone else - you'll know when)…

spots.name: Old Town
spots.desc: The old town used to have warren-like niches and winding streets, home to friendly (if occasionally guarded) residents and delightfully improvised architecture. However, in 2017, the Chinese government tore down the original buildings and rebuilt the town with wider streets and modern amenities, and it can come off as a little tacky.

spots.name: Gaotai Ancient Homes
spots.desc: Those seeking more "authentic" old buildings should visit the small hill just outside the East Gate (immediately north of Donghu Park): the buildings near the entrance of this area have been converted into cafes and shops, while numerous buildings at the back are in a state of ruin and can be seen from an elevated viewing pathway. Entrance is free.

spots.name: Tomb of Yusup Khass Hajip
spots.desc: The tomb of Kashgar's much loved philosopher and poet who wrote the 13,290-line poem The Wisdom of Happiness and Pleasure in the Uighur language.

spots.name: Tomb of Mahmud Kashgari
spots.desc: The tomb of an Uyghur scribe, famous for compiling a dictionary of the Turkic languages in the 11th century. This picturesque complex is situated on a hillside and includes a mosque and a sacred spring. Upal has a lively bazaar.

spots.name: Davakul Lake
spots.desc: Davakul Lake is 130 km from Kashgar, on the southeast tip of Taklimakan Desert. Davakul means "curing lake" in Uyghur language. It is one of the nearest places to Kashgar to do one or more days camel trekking in the Taklamakan Desert.

spots.name: Visit the Karakoram Highway
spots.desc: Various agencies around the Old Town offer day trips to Baisha Lake and Karakul Lake on the stunning Karakoram Highway, either by tour group or private car and driver. In April 2025, a private car (SUV) and driver (Chinese-speaking) cost 1,000RMB with entrance tickets to both lakes included. Before setting off, make sure you get a (free) permit for this area from the office just north of the…

spots.name: Kashgar Silk Road Expeditions tour company
spots.desc: Offers several types of tours in the area, including mountain treks.
spots.addr: 144 Seman Road

spots.name: Kashgar Guide tour company's Shipton's Arch Trekking
spots.desc: This is a one-day trek done in steeply walled canyons and over Rocky River bed terrain. The arch is 500 metres high and 100 metres wide, and is a little known wonder of the world.
spots.addr: 407 Wusitang Boyi Rd

spots.name: Food stalls
spots.desc: For a variety of snacks and dishes, try the food stalls opposite the Id Kah mosque. The stalls start operating during the evening.

spots.name: Karakoram Cafe
spots.desc: Western style. Quality food, hot drinks and service that speak English, this may be an oasis in the middle of hectic Asia. Prices are a little pricey but if you can afford it, it is worth it.
spots.addr: 87 Seman Road

spots.name: K2 Rooftop Cafe
spots.desc: Western style. Fine coffee& pizza, iced drinks, dessert and waiter that speaks good English, the terrace that covered with plants has great view of the mosque and the old town. The cafe is within the Kashgar Pamir Hostel.
spots.addr: Rd Nuo'er Beixi

spots.name: Shawarma
spots.desc: Owned and run by a native Pakistani, this is the place to get home-made Pakistani food in Kashgar. Serving mostly daily specials, such as a spicy ground beef platter or curried chicken, the taste of the food is impressive. Ask politely in advance to have delicious falafel or houmous made to order.
spots.addr: 110 Seman Road

spots.name: Yasin Kariagim Silk Road Uighur Restaurant
spots.desc: Popular among the locals, this place serves very fresh meat. In fact, sometimes they have no more meat to offer because they've sold out. Buy a nan bread fresh out of the oven from one of the many local bakers on the side of the road and bring it with you. Get lamb skewers and liver skewers and enjoy it with your nan bread.
spots.addr: 库木代尔瓦扎路 Kumudaierwazha Road

spots.name: John's Cafe
spots.desc: Offers backpacker hospitality at 1.7 times the price of other locations, and is very popular among single travellers. Managed by Jack who speaks fluent English. Seems to be closed in the off-season.

spots.name: The Gallery Cafe
spots.desc: A little oasis for those looking for home style western food or a cup of coffee. Foreign-owned Gallery Cafe opened in October 2009. The place also acts as a showcase for local artists' oil paintings and a tourist information center.
spots.addr: Jie Fang Bei Lu

spots.name: Khotan Market
spots.desc: Almost as large as the Sunday Market in Kashgar, but more chaotic and free-spirited. Open every day, busiest in the early afternoon (XJ time), and on Sundays. Not to be confused with the "International Bazaar" which is a tall landmark building near the bus station and more like a mall than a market.

spots.name: Jade Factory
spots.desc: Free entry to see people carving Jade with modern tools and intricate Jade pieces for sale. No tours, but you can look and ask questions if you speak Mandarin.

spots.name: Rawaq Stupa
spots.desc: Better preserved than most buildings at Melikawat but smaller and northeast of town, east of the cross-desert highway. A visitor center is under construction, but until it is completed then ¥20 ticket fees are paid on entry to the stone path leading to the boardwalk around the stupa. In mid-2017, the direct road was under construction but the site was accessible via the cross-desert highway…

spots.name: Desert Vista "Platform"
spots.desc: It is free to walk up to the "platform," a scenic vista point situated on top of a large dune, and down to the restrooms. Camel rides are also available on request, for a fee. Can combine with a trip to Rawaq, which is accessible by turning off the highway north of the desert viewing platform.

spots.name: Khotan Public Square -- TuanJie GuangChang
spots.desc: There is communal dancing by both the Uyghur and Han communities and a great Uyghur night market on one of the corners.

spots.name: Khotan Carpet Factory
spots.desc: An industry over 2000 years old in Khotan, carpets woven by hand in a small workshop, tours and sales of carpets available. Seems to be free, without many services for visitors, especially in the off season.

spots.name: White Jade River
spots.desc: Locals search the riverbed for rare white jade but beauty lies in all the other stones left behind.

spots.name: Silk Workshop
spots.desc: Free tours, only in Chinese, of the local silk workshop, where Atlas Silk is made entirely by hand. Even if you don't speak Chinese it's an interesting place to wander around. Opens at 09:00 Xinjiang time, 11:00 Beijing time, though that may also vary by season.

spots.name: Imam Asim Tomb
spots.desc: Imam Asim Ancient Tomb is in Jiya Township of Lop County. It is about 23 km from Khotan city. The tomb is 1 km inside of the desert where the farmland and desert merge. Best time to visit the Imam Asim tomb is during April and May on Thursday. Local people come from different parts of Khotan and Xinjiang to observe local wrestling and story-telling with music. This is not really a tourist…

spots.name: Desert Camp and Camel Trek
spots.desc: Camel ride into the Taklamakan Desert with overnight camping. You can enjoy a camp fire dinner and breakfast in the desert. Necessary camping equipment, tents, sleeping bags and blankets, etc. can be provided by.Guide on Line

spots.name: Marco's Dream Cafe
spots.desc: Run by a Malaysian woman and her family, has awesome local travel information and affordable western and Malay food options, coffee and desserts. SE of the Public Square (Tuanjie Guangchang).
spots.addr: YouYiLu

spots.name: Yi Garden
spots.desc: A museum and art gallery that tells the life story of Rao Zongyi, artist and sinologist.
spots.addr: 15 Dong Zhong Cheng Jiao

spots.name: The Lighthouse of Buddha
spots.desc: The lighthouse was used by sailors for navigating the Han river. It is said a former emperor once passed in his dragon boat while he was sleeping and was woken by the light from this lighthouse. He thought it must have been a bodhisattva sending him the light and therefore named it the Lighthouse of Buddha. Closed for renovation as of July 2026.

spots.name: The old site of Song Kiln
spots.desc: Shows the scale of production and the exquisite craftsmanship of ceramic in ancient Chaozhou.

spots.name: Xu Imperial Son-in-law Mansion
spots.desc: Retains the basic pattern of the architecture of the Song Dynasty.
spots.addr: North Ma Road, Xiangqiao District (湘桥区北马路 Xiāng​qiáo​qū​ Běi​mǎ​lù​)

spots.name: Jiluehuang Temple
spots.desc: Displaying the wood carving art of Chaozhou in the Qing Dynasty.
spots.addr: Yian Road, Xiangqiao District (湘桥区义安路 Xiāng​qiáo​qū​ Yì​ān​lù)​

spots.name: Kaiyuan Temple
spots.desc: Buddhist center embodied with the quintessence of the architectural art of various dynasties such as the Tang, the Song, the Yuan and the Qing. This temple is over 200 years old. The temple is also home to the most influential Buddhism Study Institute in Southeast China. Inside, handsome calligraphy and inscribed steles remind visitors that this temple once functioned as the record keeper of the…
spots.addr: 32 Kaiyuan Road, Xiangqiao District (湘桥区开元路32号 Xiāng​qiáo​qū​ Kāi​yuán​lù​)

spots.name: West Lake
spots.desc: There is a museum in the park, which has a unique collection of stones with natural geological markings representing (or resembling) Chinese characters. There is also a small crumbling historical building (revolutionary site) and a large modern phoenix at the top of a hill, with an interesting old painting of ancient Chaozhou.

spots.name: Lianhua Vegetarian Restaurant
spots.local: 莲花素食府 Lianhua Sushi Fu
spots.desc: Vegetarian chain restaurant also found in Shantou and Jieyang.
spots.addr: Kaiyuan Square (Kaiyuan Guangchang)

spots.name: McDonald's
spots.desc: A standard high quality McDonald's with free Wi-Fi as long as you have a mobile phone that can receive a text message. You can get stable food here 24 hours a day, and coffee.
spots.addr: China, 广东省潮州市湘桥区新桥东路南片1、3、5号商铺首、二层

spots.name: Pizza Hut
spots.desc: Standard Pizza Hut is across the street from the main McDonalds.

spots.name: KFC
spots.desc: Standard KFC (Kentucky Fried Chicken) is across the street from the main McDonald's.

spots.name: The old town
spots.desc: Most of the lovely historic buildings are so dilapidated that it seems like a European city that has been bombed, although the city has invested to keep the ground floor operating. They are slowly being torn down and replaced with ugly modern buildings, so see it while you can! The one section that is marked for preservation is the part that is next to the renovated post office and the Shantou…

spots.name: Shantou Museum
spots.desc: This museum has the space for an impressive collection, but not all the exhibit halls are open. There are exhibits on Buddhist figurines and sculptures, paintings and calligraphy, ceramic wares, and relics recovered from a Ming Dynasty commercial vessel that was discovered in 2007 just a little way southeast of Shantou. Past temporary exhibits include photos of Shanghai of a bygone era.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: Yuemei Road, Jinping District (金平区月眉路)

spots.name: Shantou Founding Museum
spots.local: 汕头开埠文化陈列馆 Shantou Kaibu Wenhua Chenlieuan
spots.desc: Not to be confused with Shantou Museum. This museum is devoted to the establishment of Swatow (Shantou) as a treaty port in the 19th century, and its subsequent history and daily life.
spots.addr: 1 Yongping Road, Jinping District (金平区永平路1号)

spots.name: Longyan South Road
spots.desc: Longyan South Road is an urban street known for its high concentration of food vendors and small restaurants. Most eateries and night-time stalls operate in the evening, forming one of the commonly visited night-dining zones in the district. The street hosts a mix of traditional snacks and more contemporary casual food options, reflecting a diverse local food scene. Hygiene is poor on the street…
spots.addr: Dongfeng Subdistrict, Jinping District,

spots.name: Pagoda Mountain
spots.local: 塔山风景区, Tashan Scenic Area
spots.desc: Not to be confused with a similarly named place at the Queshi Scenic Area.
spots.addr: Tashan Temple Avenue, Lianshang Town, Chenghai District (澄海区莲上镇塔山寺道)

spots.name: Stone Fort Park
spots.desc: A fort by the sea, with replica cannons. You may be able to smell some interesting strains of mold inside, admire the moat and bridges, or go rollerskating in the middle of the fort (with Chinese techno music of course).
spots.addr: 20 Haibin Road, Jinping District (金平区海滨路20号)

spots.name: The former residence of Chen Cihong
spots.desc: A mansion (or a mini-palace) built in the early 20th century, still pretty much intact. It was built in traditional Chinese style, with houses from one to three stories, with sloped tile roofs. People still live in many of these houses. Outside of the tourist center and museum and the parking lot, one can wander in the alleys to feel the atmosphere. For those that pan the ubiquitous residential…
spots.addr: Qianmei Village, Longdu Town, Chenghai District (澄海区隆都镇前美村)

spots.name: Nan'ao Island
spots.local: 南澳岛, 汕头南澳岛旅游区 Nan'ao Island Tourism Zone
spots.desc: This is one of the most beautiful islands in China. It is accessible by a 9-km bridge. The island still hasn't been overdeveloped and has kept its original view. Here you can not only get the most gorgeous sea view but also a taste of the real life of fishermen in China. Besides that, it is a fantastic place to taste all kinds of seafood. On this island, one can see a Song Dynasty fresh water…
spots.addr: Nan'ao County (南澳县)

spots.name: Qingyun Rock
spots.desc: Temples and a lake on a cemetery hill. The site combines religious structures, historical grave areas, and landscaped footpaths that follow the natural slope of the hill. Visitors often walk along the terraces to view the traditional architectural features of the temples, the stone inscriptions, and the surrounding forested areas. The lake sits at a lower platform and is bordered by simple…
spots.addr: Haojiang District (濠江区)

spots.name: Dahao Ancient Town
spots.desc: A rather small but beautiful town, enclosed by a thin ancient wall.
spots.addr: Yonghao Street, Haojiang District (濠江区永濠街)

spots.name: Queshi Scenic Area
spots.local: 礐石风景区, 礐石风景名胜区
spots.desc: A large hilly park on the south bank of the Rong River, just opposite the city centre.
spots.price: ¥15 (combo ticket including both Pagoda Hill and Flame Peak), ¥10 (Pagoda Hill only), ¥6 (Longquan Cave), ¥25 (one-way…
spots.addr: 4 Queshi Haipang Road, Haojiang District (濠江区礐石海旁路4号)

spots.name: Shantou small park
spots.desc: Shantou small park is a key historic cultural district in the old urban area, featuring early commercial streets and arcade-style buildings. The district centers on Shengping road and Anping road, forming a fan-shaped layout with many preserved early twentieth-century arcades and commercial structures. It combines traditional Chaoshan commercial culture with modern dining businesses and is a…
spots.addr: In the vicinity of shengping road and anping road, jinping district

spots.name: Shantou xidi park
spots.desc: Shantou xidi park is a linear waterfront park built along the south bank of the Han River, featuring riverside walkways, landscaped green areas, and small leisure spots near the water. The park connects directly to surrounding urban streets and is commonly used for walking, jogging, and everyday relaxation. The park connects directly to surrounding urban streets and is commonly used for walking…
spots.addr: At the intersection of waima road and xidi road in Jinping district, along the south bank of the Han River

spots.name: Shantou east-coast park
spots.desc: Shantou east-coast park is a large coastal and waterfront park in the east-coast new town. The park is organized with several themed zones based on a “time concept,” offering walkways, cycling paths, waterfront decks, sports areas, and open plazas. Its design emphasizes openness, spaciousness,and access to the water, blending modern urban landscapes with coastal natural features. It is suitable…
spots.addr: Along donghaian avenue in longhu district

spots.name: Changshanwei lighthouse
spots.desc: Changshanwei lighthouse stands on the breakwater of the harbor with the same name on the west side of Nan’ao island and serves as a recognizable coastal marker. The lighthouse supports navigation, and the surrounding breakwater area offers open views of the sea, nearby bridges, and the shoreline. Visitors often come to walk along the breakwater, enjoy the seaside, and take photos, especially…
spots.addr: At the breakwater of Changshanwei harbor beside s336 road in Houzhai town, Nan’ao county

spots.name: Suning Plaza Mall
spots.desc: A Western-style mall with Pizza Hut and the first Starbucks & Haagan Daz in Shantou. There are other cafes in this mall where one can overpay for coffee.

spots.name: Lotus Center
spots.desc: Another western-style mall with Starbucks and a Lotus supermarket in the basement. There are other places in this mall where one can overpay for their coffee.

spots.name: Lianhua Vegetarian Restaurant
spots.local: 莲花素食府 Lianhua Sushi Fu
spots.desc: Vegetarian chain restaurant also found in Chaozhou and Jieyang.
spots.addr: Haibin Road, Dayang Group Building, west wing

spots.name: Hotel Internationale restaurant
spots.desc: On the 4th floor of International Hotel, this Chinese restaurant serves good dim sum and Hong Kong style dishes. Prices are also on par with those of Hong Kong.
spots.addr: Jinsha Donglu near intersection with Dongxia Nanlu

spots.name: Apricot Blossom Wu Ji Beef Hot Pot（杏花吴记牛肉火锅）
spots.desc: A popular local hot pot restaurant known for its fresh beef and efficient service, there are often queues for meals。
spots.addr: No. 16, Xinghua West Road, Jinping District（金平区杏花西路16号）

spots.name: Nanling National Forest Park
spots.desc: Located in Ruyuan Yao Nationality Autonomous County, 8 kilometers from the bridge exit of Beijing-Zhuhai Expressway. The park covers area of 27300 hectares. It is the core zone of Nanling Mountain, the only preserved virgin forest in Guangdong and the oasis with the largest area in the areas with the same latitude in the world. The park has developed scenic spots including No.1 Peak in Guangdong…

spots.name: Guangdong Grand Canyon
spots.desc: The Grand Canyon is located in Guangdong Ruyuan Yao Autonomous Dabu Town, from the Beijing-Zhuhai Expressway in Ruyuan export 70kilometers. Canyon of up to 15 kilometers, more than 300 meters deep, belong to quartz sandstone. The original site of the Grand Canyon is a ravine in small basin, due to the Yanshan movement effects, makes the crust with block uplift of the expansion, and make partial…

spots.name: Qixingyan Musical Fountain
spots.desc: A musical fountain at Paifang Square beside Star Lake. The fountain combines water jets with music and lighting and is a feature of the square. Performance times vary and may be suspended temporarily; check the official Xinghu Scenic Area website for current schedules.
spots.addr: Paifang Square, Duanzhou District

spots.name: Piyun House
spots.desc: A historic three-storey tower on the northwestern section of the Zhaoqing Ancient City Wall. The present structure was rebuilt in 1986 and stands at the highest point of the city wall. The tower is part of the protected historic city-wall complex.
spots.addr: People's Middle Road, Duanzhou District

spots.name: Ling Hill Fort
spots.desc: A historic fort on Ling Hill in eastern Zhaoqing. The site is listed among Zhaoqing's revolutionary heritage sites.
spots.addr: Ling Hill, Dinghu District

spots.name: Baogong temple
spots.desc: Baogong Temple is a memorial temple dedicated to Bao Zheng, who served as the prefect of Duanzhou from 1040 to 1043. The present temple forms part of Baogong Cultural Park, which was developed on the site of the former temple and also includes a museum, Qingxin Garden, a cultural square and a riverside promenade.
spots.addr: Jiangbin 4th Road, Duanzhou District

spots.name: Zhaoqing Guangfu Culture Temple Fair
spots.desc: A temple fair featuring intangible cultural heritage parades, lion and dragon dances, and Song-style markets. The parade runs from Qixingyan East Gate Square to Paifang Square.
spots.addr: Qixingyan East Gate Square, Duanzhou District

spots.name: Deng Huo Shi Duanzhou Light Festival
spots.local: 灯火是端州光影艺术嘉年华
spots.desc: A light and shadow art festival at the Zhaoqing Fu City Ruins Park, with light shows, Song-style markets and parades.
spots.hours: Usually held around the Mid-Autumn Festival
spots.addr: Zhaoqing Fu City Ruins Park, Chengzhong Road, Duanzhou District

spots.name: Gaoyao Kaigeng Festival
spots.desc: A traditional spring farming festival in Hetai Town, dating back to the Ming dynasty. Features dragon mother worship, lion dances, and folk performances.
spots.hours: Held on the second day of the second lunar month
spots.addr: Hetai Town, Gaoyao District

spots.name: Paifang Square Shopping Area
spots.desc: A commercial area around Paifang Square with shops and restaurants.
spots.addr: Paifang Square, Duanzhou District

spots.name: Yue
spots.desc: A Chinese restaurant inside Sheraton Zhaoqing Dinghu serving traditional Cantonese cuisine, Guangfu specialties and Chinese tea snacks. It also has six private dining rooms.
spots.addr: Sheraton Zhaoqing Dinghu, No. 1 Yongli Avenue, Dinghu District, Zhaoqing

spots.name: Zhaoqing Restaurant
spots.desc: A local restaurant serving Cantonese and Zhaoqing dishes, including bamboo shoot and river fish specialties.
spots.addr: 10 Tianning Road, Duanzhou District

spots.name: Dongguan Numismatic Museum
spots.desc: A museum run by the Dongguan Rural Commercial Bank. It displays old coins and notes, as well as items pertaining to the history of the bank. Visitors may opt to take a guided tour. The tour guides can speak Mandarin, Cantonese and English.
spots.hours: 09:00-12:00, 14:00-17:00 (weekdays), 10:00-16:00 (Sat), no entry in last 30 minutes, closed on Sun
spots.addr: Ground floor, Dongguan Rural Commercial Bank Building, No. 2 Hongfu East Road, Dongcheng District (东城区鸿福东路2号农商银行大厦一层)

spots.name: Jin'aozhou Pagoda
spots.desc: This pagoda was built between 1597 and 1624, and attained its present appearance following a major rennovation in 1737. Experts are said to be impressed by the fact that since 1737, the pagoda has tilted by less than 1% despite being situated only a few meters from the river bank.
spots.addr: Jinqu Road South (金曲路南)

spots.name: Shajiao Fort
spots.desc: Built in 1801, this fort is closer to the open sea than the other forts in Humen and formed part of the Pearl River's first line of defence together with the Dajiao Hill Fort on the other side of the river in Guangzhou's Nansha District. Below the fort is a small dock that was used by Lin Zexu for confiscating opium.
spots.addr: Shajiao Community, Humen Town (虎门镇沙角社区)

spots.name: China Agarwood Culture Museum
spots.desc: A museum dedicated to the use of agarwood in Chinese culture. Agarwood is a type of wood that is highly valued in China and other Asian countries due to its aromatic and medicinal properties. Visitors are expected to make a booking on the museum’s WeChat account before visiting the museum. The WeChat account name is ‘香市文化旅游区’ (Xiangshi Cultural Tourism Area).
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: Xiangshi Park, 281 Xiangfu Road, Liaobu Town (寮步镇祥富路281号香市公园内)

spots.name: Dongguan Xiangshi Zoo
spots.desc: Animal and acrobat performances are held here at 10:40 and 15:00 on weekdays, and at 10:40, 12:30, 14:30 and 16:30 on public holidays.
spots.price: Tickets are ¥120 for adults, ¥80 for seniors over 65 and ¥80 for children between 1.2 and 1.5 meters in height…
spots.addr: 170 Fuxing Road, Yaole Village, Liaobu Town (寮步镇药勒村富兴路170号)

spots.name: Xixi Ancient Village
spots.desc: A well-preserved traditional village on the west bank of the Hanxi River. The village was founded in 1489 and has around 200 buildings dating from the Ming and Qing dynasties.
spots.price: General entry to the village is free; some attractions in the village charge a fee, which is covered in an…
spots.addr: Liaobu Town (寮步镇)

spots.name: Arts De Chine Museum
spots.local: 东莞市逸颐艺舍博物馆
spots.desc: A museum established by a private art collector. It displays a range of different items, including paintings, calligraphy, ceramics and bronzeware. The museum website has not been updated since 2013. Visitors should refer to the museum’s WeChat public account for the latest updates.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no tickets issued after 16:00, closed on Monday (except when Monday is a public holiday)
spots.addr: 129 Caixia Road, Hengli Town (横沥镇彩霞路129号)

spots.name: Fenggang History Museum
spots.desc: A small museum on the history of the town of Fenggang. One of the highlights is an exhibition about Yang Guanlin, one of the most famous xiangqi players of all time and winner of China’s first ever national xiangqi championship in 1956. The exhibition features wax models of Yang and his opponent Hu Ronghua facing each other off at Guangzhou Culture Park in 1961.
spots.addr: 107/9 Fenggang Kangjia Road, Fenggang Town (凤岗镇凤岗康佳路9号107号)

spots.name: Guangdong Memorial Hall of the East River Column
spots.desc: A memorial museum dedicated to telling the story of the East River Column (also known as the Dongjiang Column), a Communist-affiliated guerrilla army that fought the Japanese during the Second World War and later took part in the Chinese Civil War. The museum is on a hill overlooking the historic village of Dawangling, which is where the East River Column's main base was located from 1940 to…
spots.addr: Houda Road, Dawangling Village, Dalingshan Town (大岭山镇大王岭村厚大路)

spots.name: Yinping Mountain
spots.desc: The highest mountain in Dongguan, on the border between Xiegang Town and Huizhou. A beautiful area with waterfalls, paved trails, and cable cars.

spots.name: Yuan Chonghuan Memorial Park
spots.desc: Dedicated to Yuan Chonghuan (1584-1630), a famous Ming Dynasty general who defeated the Jurchen leader Nurhaci at the Battle of Ningyuan in 1626. It includes a re-creation of Yuan Chonghuan’s house, a memorial hall and a large statue.
spots.hours: 08:30-17:30 (extended to 18:00 during holiday periods), no entry after 17:00, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 38 Chonghuan East Road, Shijie Town (石碣镇崇焕东路38号)

spots.name: Yuehui Garden
spots.desc: A traditional Lingnan style garden built by a wealthy farmer in 2005. It is larger than the more famous Ke Garden, but tends to receive fewer visitors.
spots.addr: 1 Yuehui Road, Daojiao Town (道滘镇粵晖路1号)

spots.name: Longfeng Villa Film and Television Tourist Area
spots.desc: A theme park resort based on the theme of marriage and romance. It features several dozen amusement rides, a marriage customs museum, a theater and a shopping center. Accommodation is available at the Castfast Hotel (嘉辉会酒店).
spots.price: Fees vary widely depending on what you want to see and do; for adult visitors, a general entry ticket (which includes…
spots.addr: 12 Jiahui Road, Fenggang Town (凤岗镇嘉辉路12号)

spots.name: Hundred Flowers Times Square
spots.local: 百花时代广场, Bǎihuā Shídài Guǎngchǎng
spots.desc: Eight-story mall with free Wi-Fi. The ground floor has a food court with a good selection of Chinese restaurants, and the fifth floor has a movie theater. Just outside the mall are several jewelry stores and clothing stores, and the neighborhood around it is lively and full of restaurants and shops as well.
spots.addr: 1 Shichang Road, Changping Town (常平镇市场路1号)

spots.name: V8
spots.desc: Popular club and local hangout with a dance floor and good cocktails.

spots.name: One for the Road
spots.desc: Popular ex-patriate bar. English pub style. Good food, good beer.
spots.addr: Room 101, Building 2, Xinghe Legend Xintiandi, Dongcheng East Road, Dongcheng 东城东路星河传说新天地2号楼101号

spots.name: Day & Nite
spots.desc: The center of expat life in Changping, with a TV playing football (soccer) and a menu with Western comfort foods like macaroni and cheese, burgers, and fries, as well as a variety of drinks. Menu in Chinese and English.
spots.addr: 21 Yangwu Street, Changping Town (常平镇朝阳五街21号)

spots.name: Liangyuan Park
spots.desc: Formerly the residence of the Liang clan, the park is actually a large garden housing a number of traditional Chinese-style buildings. Well worth a visit.

spots.name: Zhongshan Park
spots.desc: Offers nine specific scenic areas and family entertainment facilities.

spots.name: Renshou Temple
spots.desc: Founded in 1925. The temple originally belonged to the Vajrayana school, but later was converted into a Chan (Zen) temple. Houses an exotic pagoda, and is an interesting mix of colorful Vajaryana icons and simple Chan aesthetics.
spots.addr: Zumiao Road

spots.name: South China Sea Temple
spots.desc: The South China Sea a Buddhism goddess Guanyin temple was built in 990 AD (namely Song Taizong Chunhua five years), dating back more than one thousand years of history, blocks north to south, excellent scenery, as the Lingshan resort.

spots.name: Southern Taoyuan
spots.desc: Southern Taoyuan peach hometown, tree beautiful, bud, flower color of fresh, long flowering period. Here picturesque scenery, green grass, forest covers an area of more than 90%. Every year before the Spring Festival, large tracts of peach trees in early puberty, peach strains, clump, bunch, sinks into the red.

spots.name: Sanshui Forest Park
spots.local: 三水森林公园, Sānshuǐ Sēnlín Gōngyuán
spots.desc: A huge, beautiful park in Sanshui District. Attractions within the park include a giant reclining Buddha statue (108 meters long), a Confucian temple, and a lake with imported crocodiles.
spots.price: Free, ¥25 for the Confucian temple, ¥20 for the crocodile lake
spots.addr: 13 Yundonghai Avenue (云东海大道13号)

spots.name: Foshan Ancestral Temple
spots.desc: Explore traditional Lingnan architecture and watch scheduled Cantonese opera and lion dance performances held in the temple complex.
spots.addr: Zumiao Road, Chancheng District

spots.name: Shiwan Ceramics Street
spots.desc: Visit ceramic workshops and galleries to observe traditional Shiwan pottery techniques and purchase locally made ceramics.
spots.addr: Shiwan Town, Chancheng District

spots.name: Lingnan Tiandi
spots.desc: Walk through a renovated historic district featuring Lingnan-style buildings, cafes, boutiques, and cultural exhibitions.
spots.addr: Zumiao Street, Chancheng District

spots.name: Qiandeng Lake Park
spots.desc: Relax in a large urban park popular for walking, jogging, and evening light displays around the lake.
spots.addr: Nanhai District

spots.name: Taoci Town
spots.desc: A small village with a long tradition of pottery making. An excellent place to find some pieces of traditional-style Chinese porcelain.

spots.name: Baihua Square
spots.desc: One of the tall buildings in Foshan, containing a great shopping mall with restaurants offering Japanese and continental cuisine. It is near the Zumiao temple.

spots.name: Nanhai Wanda Plaza
spots.desc: A large modern shopping mall with international brands, restaurants, and entertainment facilities.
spots.addr: Nanhai District

spots.name: Lingnan Tiandi Shops
spots.desc: Boutique shops selling local crafts, souvenirs, and design products in a historic setting.
spots.addr: Chancheng District

spots.name: Foshan Ancestral Temple Vegetarian Restaurant
spots.desc: A popular vegetarian restaurant serving traditional Cantonese-style Buddhist cuisine.
spots.addr: Near Foshan Ancestral Temple, Chancheng District

spots.name: Lingnan Tiandi Restaurants
spots.desc: A concentration of restaurants offering Cantonese dishes, desserts, and modern Chinese cuisine.
spots.addr: Chancheng District

spots.name: Lingnan Tiandi Cafés
spots.desc: Stylish cafés located in renovated historic buildings, suitable for breaks while sightseeing.
spots.addr: Chancheng District

spots.name: Qiandeng Lake Tea Houses
spots.desc: Traditional tea houses around Qiandeng Lake, popular for afternoon tea and casual meetings.
spots.addr: Nanhai District

spots.name: Downtown Foshan Milk Tea Shops
spots.desc: Numerous local and chain milk tea shops offering popular Chinese-style beverages.
spots.addr: Chancheng District

spots.name: Xiangtou Mountain
spots.desc: A nature reserve about 18km north of Huizhou's urban area. The park is noted for its high-level of biodiversity. A number of rare animal species live here, including pangolins, clouded leopards and sambar deer. Tourist infrastructure has been kept to a minimum and the place does not see many tourists.
spots.addr: Boluo County (博罗县)

spots.name: Wing Kee Farm Park
spots.desc: A recreational farm established by Wing Kee, a Hong Kong based food distribution company.
spots.price: Entry tickets to the farm are ¥60, tickets to the zoo are ¥32, combo tickets are ¥88, discounts are available for…
spots.addr: Yongji Avenue, Qiaoxin Area, Daling Town, Huidong County (惠东县大岭镇桥新区永记大道)

spots.name: Kaiping Watchtowers
spots.desc: The construction of the Kaiping Watchtowers began in the early Qing Dynasty, and a lot of construction took place in the 1920s and 1930s. These towers were built as defense against bandits. There are many towers, they are mostly beyond Kaiping from the direction of Jiangmen so you are better off staying in Kaiping or it will be a very long day.
spots.addr: Kaiping

spots.name: Tea Hut Park
spots.desc: Site of the Tea Hut Temple (茶庵古寺), a temple built during the Ming Dynasty in honour of Zhang Sui (张遂), a famous astronomer monk who lived here during the Tang Dynasty.
spots.addr: Central Jiangmen

spots.name: Aofong Hill
spots.desc: Ao mountain tourist area in Enping District of Beijiao, has 150-m-high, majestic mountains. Known as the ancient stone mountain.
spots.addr: Enping

spots.name: Shangchuan and Xiachuan Islands
spots.desc: Shangchuan and Xiachuan Islands fall under Taishan's jurisdiction and are locally known for their scenery. Boats to the islands are aggressively halted during and after bad weather, so transport to and from the mainland can be patchy.
spots.addr: Taishan

spots.name: Mei Courtyard
spots.desc: Mei Courtyard compound (i.e. Tingjiang River dike Overseas Construction Group) is in the town of Datong River Fen side.
spots.addr: Taishan

spots.name: Fortuna Spa Resort
spots.desc: The resort has the high yield rice demonstration area, producing Taishan specialty Duhu rice. The hot spring in this castle has spa crystal clear water, a pure natural sea salt water hot springs, without any industrial pollution.
spots.addr: Taishan

spots.name: Jiangmen Wuyi Overseas Chinese Museum
spots.local: 江门五邑华侨华人博物馆
spots.desc: Museum built in 2010 to commemorate the overseas achievements, lifestyle and journeys of the Jiangmen (Wuyi) region's massive number of overseas migrant Chinese.
spots.addr: Central Jiangmen

spots.name: The new citrus
spots.desc: Half-fermented soft citrus peel is a local specialty. It tastes very sour/tart and is typically consumed in small quantities with tea.

spots.name: Rainbow
spots.desc: A chain of large, moderately high-end shopping centers. They have branches in many cities in China, but a lot more in Shenzhen than anywhere else, and indeed their headquarters is in Nanshan District.

spots.name: B&Q 百安居
spots.desc: This British chain offers DIY supplies and goods for the home and garden.

spots.name: Decathlon
spots.desc: The French sports supplies retailer Decathlon has several stores in Shenzhen, as well as over 200 stores in the country in all major cities. Store locator.

spots.name: Wal-Mart
spots.desc: There are 8 stores of the US chain, but more are being built. Also check out Sam's Club (山姆会员店). Sam's is a favorite shopping choice for Shenzhen's enormous and ever growing bourgeoisie and it's fun watching them. Be warned. They can be scary on a busy Sunday evening. Sam's membership is ¥150. Walmart's China HQ is in Xiangmi Hu (香密湖), above an enormous mall/cinema complex which includes a Sam's…

spots.name: Jusco
spots.desc: The Japanese supercenter and supermarkets. It has several locations in Shenzhen, next door to the CITIC Mall (中信广场), Metro: Science Museum (科学馆), exit D, at Coco Park (Metro Gou Wu Gong Yuan) and in Coastal City (海岸城) Nanshan.

spots.name: The Scripted Garden
spots.desc: A speakeasy-style cocktail bar accessed through a disguised door. Known for its literary theme and inventive drinks that incorporate Chinese herbs and teas. A favorite for a sophisticated night out.
spots.addr: Upper floors of a mixed-use building in Nanshan

spots.name: China Radio Museum (Zhongshan)
spots.local: 中山·中国收音机博物馆
spots.desc: Contains what may be the largest and most diverse collection of old radios in China. Of the more 2000 items in the collection, just over 200 are on public display at any one time. Captions are in Chinese only but that should be no deterrence, particularly if you happen to be a radio enthusiast.
spots.addr: Zhongshan Museum Annex Building, 197 Sunwen Middle Road, Shiqi District (中山市孙文中路197号中山市博物馆副楼)

spots.name: Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall
spots.desc: Not to be confused with the Sun Yat-sen Memorial Museum (listed below). Contains a photographic exhibition of Sun Yat-sen's life and legacy. Captions are in Chinese only.
spots.addr: 188-192 Sun Wen Middle Road (孙文中路188-192号)

spots.name: Xiangshan Commercial Culture Museum
spots.desc: From the 1920s to the 1940s, this building served as the offices of the Shiqi Town Chamber of Commerce. Today it is a museum about the history of the city, with a focus on commerce. The museum occupies three floors. The ground floor gives a general overview of Zhongshan's commercial history and culture, the second floor introduces some business people who were prominent in Zhongshan during the…
spots.addr: 152 Culture & Tourism Pedestrian Mall, Sunwen West Road, Shiqi District, Zhongshan (中山市石岐区孙文西路文化旅游步行街152号)

spots.name: Zhongshan Cartoon Museum
spots.desc: Zhongshan is the hometown of several of China's most prominent cartoonists. This museum displays some of their works, as well as works by cartoonists from other parts of China.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: Inside Yixian Lake Park, Hubin Road, Shiqi District (中山市石岐区湖滨路 逸仙湖公园内)

spots.name: Zhongshan Museum
spots.desc: This museum, which is housed in a 1930s hospital building, is mainly used for hosting temporary exhibitions. Information and captions are usually in Chinese only.
spots.hours: 09ː00-17ː00, no entry after 16ː30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 197 Sunwen Middle Road, Shiqi District, Zhongshan (中山市石岐区孙文中路197号)

spots.name: Zhongshan Museum of Art
spots.desc: A small art museum focused on displaying works by local artists.
spots.hours: 09ː00-17ː00, no entry after 16ː30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: Qi River Park, West District, Zhongshan (中山市西区岐江公园内)

spots.name: Qi River Park
spots.desc: This was once the site of the Central Guangdong Shipyard (粤中造船厂). At the end of the 20th century, the shipyard was converted into a park. While most of the old industrial structures were removed, some have been retained or reconstructed for artistic effect. The Zhongshan Museum of Art (listed above) can be found in the middle of the park.
spots.addr: Intersection of Zhongshan Yi Road and Xidi Road, West District (西区中山一路与西堤路交叉口)

spots.name: Zhongshan Park
spots.desc: Occupies a hill in the middle of the city known as Yandun Hill (烟墩山 Yandunshan). The hill has various other names, including Fu Peak (阜峰 Fu Feng) and Shiqi HIll (石岐山 Shiqishan). The Fufengwen Pagoda stands on the hill.
spots.addr: Gongyuan Avenue (公园大道)

spots.name: Fufengwen Pagoda
spots.desc: Also known as the Yandun Hill Pagoda (烟墩山塔), the pagoda was built in the Ming Dynasty during the 36th year of the reign of Emperor Wanli (around 1608) by the county magistrate Cai Shanji. The pagoda is a seven-storey octagonal-shaped brick tower and stands 24.5 m high. It was restored in 1952, but is now in need of further repairs. The pagoda is surrounded by a fence to prevent visitors from…
spots.addr: Zhongshan Park, Shiqi District (石岐区中山公园)

spots.name: Tianxin Forest Park
spots.local: 田心森林公园，田心公园, Tianxin Park
spots.desc: A 226-hectare forest park at the foot of the Wuguishan mountain range.

spots.name: Wuguishan Nature Park
spots.local: Wuguishan Natural Scenery Zone, 五桂山自然风景区
spots.desc: Centered around Wuguixiong Peak (五桂雄峰), the highest peak in the Wuguishan mountain range, which stands at 531 m above sea level and is also the highest land formation in Zhongshan.
spots.addr: Wuguishan Sub-District (五桂山街道)

spots.name: Zhongshan Studio City
spots.desc: An outdoor film studio that has been used to produce numerous films and television series set during the early 20th century, including several which were focused specifically on the life of Sun Yat-sen. Features street sets for several of the cities and countries that Sun visited during his life as well as re-creations of significant buildings such as the Whampoa MIlitary Academy in Guangzhou…
spots.addr: 85 Cuiheng Avenue, Nanlang Town (南朗镇翠亨大道85号)

spots.name: Chung Shan Hot Spring Golf Club
spots.desc: About 25 km from downtown Zhongshan. Features two 18-hole golf courses designed by American golf champions Arnold Palmer and Jack Nicklaus. Claims to be the first modern golf club to be established in the PRC.
spots.price: Fees for non-members vary between ¥400 and ¥1600. Discounts are available if accompanied by a club member
spots.addr: Sanxiang Town (三乡镇)

spots.name: Qi River Cruises
spots.desc: A short cruise down the Qi River and back. The journey time is about 30-40 minutes. You may either sit in the cabin or stand on the rear deck. Standing on the front deck is not permitted.
spots.hours: Boats depart every half an hour from 18:30 to 22:00
spots.addr: Qi River Cruise Boat Pier, Qi River Park, West District (中山市西区岐江公园内岐江游码头)

spots.name: Zhongshan Culture & Art Center
spots.desc: Zhongshan's premier performing arts venue. International artists sometimes perform here.
spots.addr: 73 Xingzhong Avenue, East District (中山市东区兴中道73号)

spots.name: Zhongshan Sky Wheel
spots.desc: The Zhongshan Sky Wheel is a 108-m-high Ferris wheel on the roof of a shopping centre in Zhongshan's downtown area. Perhaps due to its central location, the Zhongshan Sky Wheel is often considered to be one of the city's most important landmarks. A souvenir shop near the ticket gate sells various kinds of minature Ferris wheels and other Zhongshan-related gifts.
spots.addr: Level 5, Block C, Central Power Plaza, 9 Fengming Road, Shiqi District (石歧区凤鸣路9号兴中广场C座5楼)

spots.name: Holiday Plaza
spots.desc: This shopping centre is noteworthy for its many art shops (particularly on the 2nd floor), some of which double as art schools or training centres. The interior of the shopping centre is decorated with sculptures and other forms of public art. The 3rd and 4th floors are home to Pok Art (博雅), one of the city's largest privately-owned book stores, which besides books, also sells a wide range of…
spots.addr: 6 Xingzhong Avenue, Shiqi District (石岐区兴中道6号)

spots.name: Yangtze River Food Court
spots.desc: Come here for Zhongshan style hotpot (da been lo). You are given a dried bowl of ground nuts, cilantro, dried yellow beans and red beans. After adding in a scoop of the broth, it becomes dipping sauce for the food cooked at the table.
spots.addr: Yijing Rd

spots.name: Bellavista Restaurant
spots.desc: 3 Chefs Restaurant. German and Italian (Peter), Thai (Toffee), and Indian (Johnny).
spots.addr: Unit 3, Borough 1, 39 Qiguan West Road (岐关西路39号，一区，3卡)

spots.name: Hefeng Japanese Restaurant
spots.desc: Established in 1996, this is one of Zhongshan's oldest-established Japanese restaurants. It offers a variety of different dishes in a traditional Japanese setting. The restaurant has another branch at No. 6 Changjiang Road South (长江南路6号).
spots.addr: 2 Fukang Road, Shiqi District 富康路2号

spots.name: Gen Ju Di Jiu Ba
spots.desc: A truly authentic Chinese bar. Look out for the communist star over the entrance.

spots.name: New Bar Street
spots.desc: A whole complex of clubs and bars, including iClub and Fashion Club.
spots.addr: Qiguan West Road

spots.name: Peter's Place
spots.desc: Really good German-style bar with German beer. Live music every day. The food is great, and they have nice pool tables! If you go Fridays or Saturdays, it is advisable to reserve a table. On Fridays you can eat pizza for ¥39, all you can eat. On Saturdays they do a buffet for ¥88, of which the best offerings are the Indian and Thai curries and the BBQ.
spots.addr: Qiquan West Road

spots.name: Fisher Girl statue
spots.desc: Legend has it that an angel descended to earth one day and fell in love with the beauty of the land. Reluctant to return, she turned herself into a fisher girl, weaving nets and searching for precious pearls to earn a living. In addition, she unselfishly used her knowledge and powers to heal villagers who were ill, and so was well loved by one and all. Soon she met a young fisherman named Hai…
spots.addr: Lovers' Road

spots.name: Zhuhai Museum
spots.local: 珠海市博物馆 Zhūhǎi shì bówùguǎn
spots.desc: A museum about the history of the Zhuhai region. The museum also hosts travelling exhibitions from other parts of China.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:00, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 191 Jingshan Road, Jida (吉大景山路191号)

spots.name: Martyrs Cemetery
spots.desc: A memorial to the martyrs in the revolution in Zhuhai led by marshal Ye Jianying. It was transformed to a quiet place for citizens and tourists to relax and pay homage in the busy centre of the city now.
spots.addr: 1149 Fenghuang Road (凤凰路1149号)

spots.name: Meixi Royal Stone Archways
spots.desc: Built in 1886 and extended in 1891 under the orders of Emperor Guangxu, it was a memorial to praise Chen Fang, a consul of the Qing Empire. It was partly damaged during the Cultural Revolution, but not seriously. Chen Fang's former residence, which is just a few hundred metres east of the arches, can also be visited.
spots.addr: 268 Lüyou Road, Qianshan (前山旅游路268号)

spots.name: Mangzhou Wetland Park
spots.local: 芒洲湿地公园 or 杧洲湿地公园
spots.desc: Located on the tip of Hengqin Island, the park is an excellent alternative to the Chimelong Ocean Kingdom if you don't want to pay for its ticket because the park is free. It's a place to escape the noise of city, enjoy the sea wind and the flow of water on the pontoon.
spots.addr: Qinhai North Road, Hengqin Island (横琴琴海北路)
