spots.name: Qi'ao Mangrove Forest Wetland Park
spots.desc: A province-level wetland preserve, also a good place to enjoy the nature and watch birds.
spots.addr: Qi'ao Island (淇澳岛)

spots.name: Lovers' Road
spots.desc: It stretches along a big chunk of Zhuhai's eastern coastline, from near the border with Macau to well past the Fisher Girl statue. It's good for walking or biking, and offers a majestic view of the Macau skyline across the border, but the sea tends to be brown and muddy.

spots.name: Zhuhai's many islands
spots.desc: One of Zhuhai's nicknames is the city of a hundred islands (146 to be exact), and it has a number of islands that are accessible from ports by ferry boat (see the Districts Section for more information).

spots.name: Doumen District Museum
spots.desc: A general museum with exhibits on the history of the district. The museum is also known as the Zhaozhen Museum, a name given to honour John C. Young (Rong Zhaozhen), a famous Chinese-American army colonel whose father was born in Doumen's Longtan Village.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, closed on Mondays and the eve of Chinese New Year
spots.addr: 2233 Xidi Road, Jing'an Town (井岸镇西堤路2233号)

spots.name: Doumen Old Street
spots.local: 斗门旧街, 斗门古街 Doumen Ancient Street, 斗门清朝古街 Doumen Qing Dynasty Street
spots.desc: A historic precinct featuring an agglomeration of old commercial buildings, most of which were built between the late 19th and early 20th centuries when Doumen was an important trading post.
spots.addr: Dama Road, Nanmen Village, Doumen Town (斗门镇南门村大马路)

spots.name: Jintai Buddhist Temple
spots.desc: Scenic temple built at the end of the Song Dynasty, over 1,000 years old and well worth a visit if you are in this area.
spots.addr: Doumen Town (斗门镇)

spots.name: Swim, sunbathe or go diving
spots.desc: At a number of islands which are approximately 50 minutes away by ferry (see Zhuhai Islands Section for more details).

spots.name: China International Aviation & Aerospace Exhibition
spots.local: 中国国际航空航天博览会
spots.desc: Held every two years, it's the biggest airshow in China, attracting thousands of people and companies around the world including well-known Boeing, Airbus and Ilyushin. This show has already become the top card of Zhuhai.

spots.name: Imperial Yuwenquan Hot Springs
spots.desc: The first Japanese-style open air hot spring in China. There are over 20 kinds of hot springs, massage rooms and sauna rooms. This is considered to be one of the best spa resorts in China. From Gongbei it takes about two hours to get to there by bus, or an hour and ~¥130 one-way by taxi.
spots.addr: Huangyang Avenue West (黄杨大道西)

spots.name: Lost City
spots.desc: A water park with an ancient Egyptian theme. Features numerous water slides, an 800-metre long lazy river, a 3000-square metre wave pool, and various other water-based amusements.
spots.hours: April 26th to June 15th: 11:00-18:00 (weekdays), 10:00-18:30 (weekends and public holidays). June 16th to September…
spots.price: ¥135 (standard adult tickets), ¥95 (persons over 65), ¥95 (children between 1.2 and 1.5 metres in height). Children…
spots.addr: Lanpu Road, Jiuzhou Avenue, Xiangzhou District (香洲区九洲大道兰埔路)

spots.name: Zhuhai Opera House
spots.desc: A shell-like theater which made itself a new symbol of Zhuhai. The shape is also originated from the legend of the Fisher Girl. It's the only theater located on an island in China.
spots.addr: 129 Yuwan Road, Yeli Island (野狸岛渔湾路129号)

spots.name: Golden Gulf Golf Club
spots.desc: Features a 27-hole golf course designed by Scottish golf champion Colin Montgomerie. Accommodation is available on-site at the Golden Gulf Golf Hotel (珠海金湾高尔夫酒店).
spots.addr: 2000 Jinwan Avenue, Jinwan District (金湾区金湾大道2000)

spots.name: Lianhua Road
spots.local: 莲花路; Liánhuālù; lit. Lotus Road; also known as Walking Street (步行街; Bùxíngjiē)
spots.desc: Pedestrian-only street. The merchandise available here is similar to what you find in the underground shopping mall, primarily clothing and electronics. There is also a Bank Of China branch here with ATMs for foreign cards.

spots.name: Underground shopping complex
spots.local: 拱北地下广场; Gǒngběi Dìxià Guǎngchǎng
spots.desc: This is a huge complex; the entire open concrete area in front of the border crossing has two floors of shops under it. There are several hundred shops, many with goods targeted at tourists, such as clothing and shoes, jade and other jewelery, handicrafts e.g. Tibetan accessories, and consumer electronics. There are also many CDs and DVDs for sale at cheap prices, although they are unlicensed…

spots.name: Yingbin Road
spots.desc: It has several large shopping complexes with everything from cheap Chinese goods to trendy pricey international brands. On the left, there is Wanjia Department Store (万家百货 or formerly 万佳百货; Wànjiā Bǎihuò), which is the most recognizable landmark in Gongbei. Any local or taxi driver will know where it is. Slightly further up, there is also the Yingbin Plaza (迎宾广场; Yíngbīn Guǎngchǎng) on the right…

spots.name: Computers and electronics
spots.desc: Two large buildings full of computer and electronics shops. This is the place to go in Zhuhai for anything computer or electronics related.

spots.name: Xiangzhou Shopping Mall and Yangming Plaza
spots.desc: Has plenty of shops, and is generally less touristy than Jida or Gongbei. Many locals shop here to buy their Chinese brand name clothing. The main street has the Japanese department (and grocery) store Jusco. There are also a number of other shops and several fairly large shopping complexes along the street north of Jusco.

spots.name: AEON
spots.desc: AEON (formerly Jusco and still called Jusco by many locals) is the place many Zhuhai expats go to buy groceries. Even though they seem to specialise in Japanese food, you can also find some decent western items at fair prices. More expensive than other supermarkets but carries a much wider range of products. Special discounts on Tuesdays and after 20:00 everyday.
spots.addr: There are two AEON stores in Zhuhai, one at Yangming Plaza (扬名广场) on Fenghuang Road, one at Aoyuan Plaza (奥园广场) on Meijie Road

spots.name: Carrefour
spots.desc: There are two Carrefour supermarkets. The one in Jida has western food available; the other one does not

spots.name: Gongbei Seafood
spots.desc: There is a multitude of outdoor eating establishments with high quality seafood in Gongbei near the Macau border. Simply wandering around would probably work, but one large area with many such establishments is just Northwest of the border. Only a 5 minute walk from the border, any type of seafood can be had here (crab, oysters, prawns, large fish and the more exotic variety) as well as other…

spots.name: Jinding Barbeque
spots.desc: By far the largest outdoor street barbeque in Zhuhai. The BBQ is over 100 meters long, with scores of proprietary stalls and tables (who vigorously compete against one another). Steam rises, motorcycles whiz by, and music blares from shops as dozens of proprietary stands serve up street specialties (such as spicy grilled squid tentacles) well into the night to a lively crowd seated at plastic…
spots.hours: The BBQ opens around 17:30 and ends around 24:00

spots.name: Macanese Vegetarian Buffet
spots.desc: Buddhist vegetarian restaurant offering unlimited all you can eat vegetarian buffet including everything from cooked vegetarian Chinese dishes through cakes and pastries, cold dishes, noodle bar, fresh fruit, fresh real fruit juices, various teas, various soups, even vegetarian pizza! Tremendously popular and great value.
spots.addr: 2A, Level 2, Laimeili Women's World, Xiangzhou District (香洲区来魅力女人世界2楼2A)

spots.name: Azur Restaurant
spots.desc: Very good Mediterranean cuisine with a Croatian chef. The menu is quite small and constantly changes according to seasons and what's freshly available on the market. Most of the items on the menu are handmade, including bread, pastas, gnocchi etc. They also do excellent events with great musicians from all over the world. They are linked to the Hong Kong Jazz Festival, and occasionally bands that…
spots.addr: Shop 1-04, Building 9, Midtown, 2055 Jiuzhou Avenue West, Xiangzhou District (香洲区九州大道西2055号富华里9栋1-04室)

spots.name: Jenny's Cafe
spots.desc: A neat, cozy, jazz infused cafe serving mostly Chinese food but with an extensive and reasonably priced drinks menu that includes coffee, tea and some alcoholic drinks. (It's tucked back from the road, but easily seen due to the large signage around the door.)
spots.addr: 10 Haibin Road North, Xiangzhou District (香洲区海滨北路10号)

spots.name: May Flower Restaurant
spots.local: 皇朝五月花大酒楼; Huángcháo Wǔyuèhuā Dàjiǔlóu
spots.desc: Offers excellent seafood. As in many places in this area, you pick your fish from tanks. You may also pick your own vegetables and specify the cooking methods. This is not the kind of place to come if you like to pick things off a menu, but if you are willing to select your food while it is still swimming, it is a great choice. There is a large airplane attached to the front of the building.
spots.addr: 3F, Ridong Square, 49 Qinglü Middle Road, Xiangzhou District (香洲区情侣中路49号日东广场3楼; Xiāngzhōuqū Qínglǚzhōnglù Rìdōngguǎngchǎng)

spots.name: Amici Miei Authentic Italian Restaurant
spots.desc: Truly authentic Italian cuisine, owned and operated by Italians, Amici Miei is the latest addition to Zhuhai's pizza scene.
spots.addr: 珠海市华伐世纪城

spots.name: Mr Pizza
spots.desc: Imported wine is available here. The restaurant also has a small deli where you can buy cheese and other goodies. The first owner was an Englishman named Ken, but Mr. Pizza is now under new management.
spots.price: Pizza is ¥40-80. Happy Hour 17:30-19:00 with beer at half price
spots.addr: Level 2, K-Box Houfang, Tangren Commercial Street, Tangjia Town (唐家镇唐人街商业街K-BOX后方2楼)

spots.name: Uncle Mike's Pizza and Chicken
spots.desc: Great pizza and chicken is now accompanied by a partner Italian Restaurant and the Down Under Pub.
spots.addr: 10-105 Building 5, Tangren Street, 3399 Tangqi Road, Xiangzhou District (香洲区唐淇路3399号唐人街5栋105-10)

spots.name: Deyuefang Seafood Restaurant
spots.local: 得月肪海鮮酒樓; Déyuèfáng Hǎixiān Jiǔlóu
spots.desc: Large and popular high-end seafood place on an impressive looking boat in Xiangzhou harbour.
spots.addr: Inside Mingting Park, Yeli Island, Xiangzhou District (香洲区野狸岛名亭公园内; Xiāngzhōuqū Yělídǎo Míngtínggōngyuánnèi)

spots.name: The Old Chinese Junk
spots.desc: The Old Chinese Junk in Tangjia is a rooftop restaurant and pub run by an Englishman named Mike.
spots.addr: 5-401 Tangrenshangye Street, 3399 Tangqi Road, Tangjiawan District (唐家湾唐淇路3399号唐人商业街5栋401号; Tángjiāwān Tángqílù Tángrénshāngyèjiē

spots.name: Indian Restaurant
spots.desc: The name refers to the Native American Indian decor of the restaurant, not curries and nan bread. The specialty is high-priced steak that is no more than tolerable. However, you might consider going for the decor, which is American Plains Indian with a few pieces of Northwestern coastal art. The waitresses there wear fringed skirts with feathers in their hair.

spots.name: No. 88 Bar
spots.desc: By far the most popular bar in Zhuhai is the no. 88 bar. It's on the corner and the first bar you see when you approach bar street. It's ¥380 for a dozen beers or ¥500 for a bottle of whiskey like Jack Daniel's or Chivas Regal. Beware of the bottle service though, you might get counterfeit alcohol and feel like crap afterwards. The best thing about this place is that most of the females that show…
spots.addr: First Bar on Bar Street. 203-209 Shuiwan Road, Xiangzhou District (香洲区水湾路203-209号)

spots.name: Casa Pepe
spots.desc: Quiet place where you can sip red wine and have some fine dining. They have a private room in the back.
spots.addr: 215-217 Shuiwan Road, Xiangzhou District (香洲区水湾路215-217号)

spots.name: Cohiba
spots.local: 西洋会·葡国烧烤西餐·酒吧, Xi Yang Hui
spots.desc: Older crowd with quiet outdoor seating and fireplace outside. Indoor seating with live singers and dancers. A nice break once in a while from the hardcore partying at Bar 88.
spots.addr: 203-209 Shuiwan Road (香洲区水湾路203-209号)

spots.name: Hill Cocktail
spots.desc: The only bar of its kind in Zhuhai where the bartenders actually mix cocktails according to specifications. For example a Long Island Ice Tea actually has 5 different kinds of alcohol in it. If you order this in other bars it's just a mix of lemon iced tea and vodka. Located in the basement of a hotel up the ramp from back street. It's a quiet setting - good for romancing a date you just met at…
spots.addr: Basement level, 223 Shuiwan Road, Xiangzhou District 香洲区水湾路223号负一层地窖

spots.name: La Bohemia
spots.desc: Aside from the hugely popular Friday night Latin dance parties, La Bohemia offers excellent Portuguese food, Mediterranean food and Asian dishes, as well as a large selection of fine wines and cocktails.
spots.addr: Level 1, Haiwan Haoyuan, 225 Shuiwan Road, Xiangzhou District (香洲区水湾路225号海湾豪苑1楼)

spots.name: Dragon Union Opera House
spots.desc: a large entertainment venue inside the Dragon Union Hotel (聚龙酒店), occasionally featuring live, perhaps tacky, variety shows with acrobats, jugglers, rope climbers and singers, etc. Beer is expensive during shows. There is also a floor dedicated to massages. There are quite a few karaoke rooms available, complete with furniture, beds, food, drink, choice of girls, and optional adult entertainment…
spots.addr: Dragon Union Hotel, Building D, Tangjia Commercial Plaza, Shanfang Road, Tangjiawan, Xiangzhou District (香洲区唐家湾山房路唐家商业广场D栋聚龙酒店内)

spots.name: Open Pit Ecological Park
spots.desc: Where the city of Maoming sprang up. It used to be a mine where a large amount of oil shale was mined, but now it is no longer mined. The mine has accumulated water to form a lake, and the area has been converted into an ecological park. There are green trees everywhere, and a museum introducing the history of Maoming.

spots.name: China's First Beach
spots.desc: The most famous beach in Maoming, it is a must-visit place for Maoming people on vacation. The beach stretches from the mountains in the west to the harbor in the east.

spots.name: Chicken Island
spots.desc: The most famous island in Maoming, the island is a resort with a number of hotels.

spots.name: Former Site of French Legation in Guangzhouwan
spots.local: 广州湾法国公使署旧址
spots.desc: Built in 1903, this was the main administrative office of the French colonial government. The site is now a museum.
spots.hours: 09:00-16:30, no entry after 16:00, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 3 Haibin Road, Xiashan District (霞山区海滨路3号)

spots.name: Former Site of Guangzhouwan French Police Station
spots.local: 广州湾法国警察署旧址
spots.desc: Built in 1900, just one year after the formal establishment of the Guangzhouwan colony. After the French moved out, the building was occupied by Chinese police and continued to be used as a police station up until 2013.
spots.addr: Yan'an Road, Xiashan District (霞山区延安路)

spots.name: Guangdong Ocean University Museum of Aquatic Organisms
spots.local: 广东海洋大学水生生物博物馆
spots.desc: Contains specimens of over 3000 different aquatic species collected from around the world.
spots.hours: Mon-Fri 09:00-16:00 (closed on weekends except to tour group who book at least one week in advance)
spots.addr: Waihuan Road West, Mazhang District (麻章区外环西路)

spots.name: Guangzhouwan Museum of History and Folk Culture
spots.desc: A small museum focused on the French colonial period (1898-1945). Only 50 visitors are permitted to visit each day.
spots.addr: 51 Heping Road. Chikan District (赤坎区和平路51号)

spots.name: Haibin Hotel and Hotsprings
spots.desc: Admission includes a dinner buffet and an evening to enjoy the various hotsprings and pools.
spots.addr: Xiashan District

spots.name: Trust Mart
spots.desc: A large supermarket with a number of things to buy. Also found in the same building KFC and Macau Street Food City.

spots.name: Wal-Mart
spots.desc: Has a few imported items not found at other locations and also regularly has fresh milk.
spots.addr: Xiashan District and Chikan District

spots.name: Export Market
spots.desc: A clothing and fabric market with goods that are produced in China for export. You can sometimes find name-brand clothing items for cheap prices here.

spots.name: Inner Mongolia Dumpling Restaurant
spots.desc: If you would like dumplings or to sample a different variety of Chinese cuisine, this restaurant serves excellent food at inexpensive prices.

spots.name: Steakking Kitchen Production
spots.desc: An upscale restaurant. The menu includes fairly authentic western food and an excellent Japanese sushi selection. Included in the price of your meal is a free trip to the salad bar.

spots.name: Macau Street Food City
spots.desc: This restaurant is very foreigner-friendly and offers tons of dishes to choose from.

spots.name: The Museum of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region
spots.local: 广西壮族自治区博物馆, Guangxi Museum
spots.desc: The only national-level museum in Guangxi, it has quite an eclectic exhibition. The museum's large collection of pottery and porcelain is displayed on the first floor, while on the second floor, there are exhibits on the early culture of Guangxi, including a collection of bronze drums, prehistoric tools and metalwork. There is also an open-air exhibition, with performances, and has houses of some…
spots.hours: 09ː00-17ː00, no entry after 16ː30, closed on Mondays (public holidays excepted)
spots.addr: 34 Minzu Avenue, Qingxiu District (青秀区民族大道34号)

spots.name: Guangxi Natural Resources Museum and Archives
spots.local: 广西自然资源档案博物馆
spots.desc: The museum has eight major exhibition halls: the Earth Hall, Palaeontology Hall, Mineral Resources Hall, Geological Environment Hall, Land Resources Hall, Marine Resources Hall, Geodetic Surveying Hall, and Jewellery and Gemstone Hall. It also houses auxiliary facilities including a cinema, a science popularisation library, and a geological science experience centre.
spots.hours: 09ː30-16ː30, no entry after 16ː00, closed on Mondays (public holidays excepted)
spots.addr: 2 Zhongma Road, Qingxiu District (青秀区中马路2号)

spots.name: Xinhui Academy
spots.desc: A traditional Confucian academy dating from the Qing Dynasty. It was established during the reign of the Qianlong Emperor and rebuilt in the 19th century. These days there are no students here and the site is basically a museum. It also serves as a venue for Cantonese opera performances.
spots.addr: 1/42 Jiefang Road, Xingning District (兴宁区解放路42-1号)

spots.name: Guangxi Medicinal Botanical Garden
spots.desc: The Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Medicinal Plant Garden (Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Medicinal Plant Research Institute, Guangxi Branch of the Institute of Medicinal Plant Research, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences), founded in 1959, now covers an area of ​​202 hectares. It is engaged in the protection of medicinal plant and animal resources, popular science education, development of…
spots.price: Usually ¥65, but may be discounted to ¥20
spots.addr: 189 Longgang Road, Xingning District (兴宁区长堽路189号)

spots.name: Nanning Zoo
spots.desc: The zoo goes viral for gorilla that threw objects at visitors, with a rich collection of African and Asian animals, reptiles, birds, panda, and fish, all in well-maintained settings. Admission includes an hour-long performance of dancing bears, bicycling monkeys, elephants, and acrobats
spots.addr: 3 University Road West, Xixiangtang District (西乡塘区大学西路3号)

spots.name: South Lake Park
spots.desc: Lake in the southeastern part of town surrounded by a park including bonsai and orchid gardens
spots.addr: 1 Shuangyong Road, Qingxiu District (青秀区双拥路1号)

spots.name: Wuxiangling Forest Park
spots.desc: Pleasant forest park with some light hiking trails. Be careful not to approach the military area in the mountains
spots.addr: Liangqing District (良庆区)

spots.name: Yiling Rock
spots.desc: Karst caverns 18 km north of Nanning City in Wuming District.
spots.addr: State Highway 210, Wuming District (武鸣区210国道)

spots.name: China-ASEAN Expo
spots.desc: The China-ASEAN Expo is an international economic and trade event co-hosted by the economic and trade authorities of China and the 10 ASEAN countries and the ASEAN Secretariat, and hosted by Guangxi. It is held in mid-September every year and lasts for five days. The last two days are open to the public and you can buy tickets to visit.
spots.addr: 106 Minzu Avenue, Qingxiu District(青秀区民族大道106号)

spots.name: Nanning Bird and Flower Market
spots.desc: An eclectic mix of flowers, shrubs, pot plants and all thing floral, as well as a vast array of birds, fish, and other pets. Thrown into the mix is an assortment of household goodies to brighten up an otherwise dull abode: furniture fashioned from tree stumps, traditional Chinese tea sets, carvings, wall hangings, etc. This is an amazingly interesting place to while away an afternoon, and get…
spots.addr: 2 Kunlun Avenue, Xingning District (兴宁区昆仑大道2号)

spots.name: Chao Yang Road
spots.desc: The main shopping street lined with department stores, like Nanning Department Store and Parkson, and also Walmart, in addition other intentional brands and local brands. It is also a nice place to go people-watching, as people from all walks of life can be seen here: youngsters, street performers, roadside vendors, etc.

spots.name: Underground Mall
spots.local: runs for several city blocks under Xinhua Road 新华街 near the center of town.
spots.desc: And underground shopping mall that is always busy, particularly during the hot summer months. Primarily composed of small clothing shops but also includes food outlets and other small stores of a variety of types.

spots.name: Heping Market
spots.desc: Located a block west of the north Nanning Department Store (百货大楼), Heping Market has 4 crowded stories of small vendors selling electronics, kitchenware, makeup, clothing, and fabrics. Expect low prices and few (genuine) name brands.

spots.name: The Mixc
spots.desc: Located on the east side of town, on Minzhu Avenue, the Mixc is a new, 7-story mall featuring high-end, mostly foreign brands. Uniqlo, Parkson, and H&M are the anchor stores. There is plenty to eat on all levels, as well as an ice rink and a movie theater. Expect prices to be on par with the West.

spots.name: Nanning night food market
spots.desc: This is a 300-meter long stretch where you will find a vivid display of various exotic dishes ready to be served.
spots.addr: Zhongshan Rd

spots.name: Little Fat Sheep
spots.desc: Chain serving traditional hotpot, with lamb the meat of choice.
spots.addr: Dongege Rd and Henyang Rd

spots.name: Central Square
spots.local: 桂林中心广场; Guì​lín Zhōng​xīn Guǎng​chǎng
spots.desc: 51,400-m² large gathering place in the centre of town. Here you can watch a giant atlas on the ground and an artificial waterfall every evening at 20:30.
spots.addr: 22 Yiren Road, Xiufeng District (秀峰区依仁路22号)

spots.name: Official Residence of Li Zongren
spots.desc: Built in the 1940s to accommodate Li Zongren, a Guilin-born Kuomintang military leader who served as vice president of the Republic of China from 1948 to 1949 and acting president from 1949 to 1950. It is sometimes referred to informally as the 'Guilin Presidential Palace' (桂林总统府). The building is open to the public and has exhibitions about Li Zongren's life.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 4 Wenming Road, Xiangshan District (象山区文明路4号)

spots.name: Sun and Moon Pagodas
spots.desc: Although there is nothing much to see inside the pagodas, the view from the outside as well as the surrounding lake offers a good respite from the traffic and noise of Guilin's city center. The view is better at night than day.
spots.addr: 10 Wenming Road, Xiangshan District (象山区文明路10号)

spots.name: Eighth Route Army Guilin Office Museum
spots.local: 八路军桂林办事处纪念馆
spots.desc: Has exhibitions about the Eighth Route Army's political and military activities in Guilin during the Second World War. The Eighth Route Army was a Communist-controlled army unit that was formed following the agreement between Communist and Kuomintang leaders to work together to fight the Japanese. The Eighth Route Army's office was located at this site from 1938 to 1941.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:50, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 14 Zhongshan North Road, Diecai District (叠彩区中山北路14号)

spots.name: Guilin Guanshitang Chicken-Blood Stone Museum
spots.local: 桂林观石堂鸡血玉博物馆
spots.desc: Displays various sculptures and other items fashioned out of chicken-blood stone, a type of gemstone also known as chicken-blood jade. Visitors should be aware that there have been a lot of complaints about rude staff pressuring people to buy overpriced items in the museum shop.
spots.addr: Opposite Reed Flute Cave Carpark, Xiufeng District (秀峰区芦笛岩景区停车场对面)

spots.name: Museum of Guihai Stele Forest
spots.desc: Maintains a collection of 213 stone steles dating from the Tang Dynasty to the early 20th century.
spots.price: Entry fee is included in the ticket for Seven Star Park
spots.addr: 1 Longyin Road, Qixing District (七星区龙隐路1号)

spots.name: Guilin Flying Tigers Heritage Park
spots.local: 美国飞虎队桂林遗址公园
spots.desc: A memorial park dedicated to the Flying Tigers, the nickname given to the First American Volunteer Group (AVG), a group of American pilots who joined the Republic of China Air Force in 1941 and carried out missions against the Japanese during the Second World War. The park is at the site of the former Yangtang Airport, which is one of the airports where the Flying Tigers were based. There is a…
spots.addr: Xicheng Avenue, Lingui District (临桂区西城大道)

spots.name: Seven Star Park
spots.desc: A large park with a small zoo area on the east side farthest from the entrance with the main attraction being the giant pandas and the red pandas, additional fee to enter the zoo of ¥32, the staff host a small show with monkeys, bear, tigers and lion at scheduled hours. Additional ¥60 fee to enter Seven Star Cave inside the park.
spots.addr: Qixing Rd

spots.name: West Hill Park
spots.desc: Park with a lake, temples and hundreds of Buddhist statues. In the park is also the Hidden Hill with a number of caves. Guilin Museum is also here, see separate listing.
spots.addr: 2 km west of city centre

spots.name: Xiongsen Bear and Tiger Mountain Village
spots.local: 雄森熊虎山庄; Xióngsēn Xiónghǔ Shān​zhuāng
spots.desc: 300,000-m² area with tigers, bears, lions and other wild animals. Here you can witness research, breeding and entertainment. The place is a bit shabby and you will not see the animals in their natural environment, but you get close to the animals and can see them being much more active than in a zoo.

spots.name: Zengpiyan National Archaeological Park
spots.local: 甑皮岩国家考古遗址公园
spots.desc: A park centered around the Zengpiyan Cave neolithic site where thousands of stone tools, pottery pieces and other artefacts have been unearthed since the site was discovered in 1965. The cave can be visited and there is a museum displaying some of the artefacts.
spots.addr: 26 Zengpiyan Road, Xiangshan District (象山区甑皮岩路26号)

spots.name: Diecai Mountain
spots.desc: A park built around several peaks, which are climbed using stone staircases. There is also a small aviary and butterfly museum with examples of pinned and mounted butterflies and moths in the park.
spots.addr: Longzhu Rd (龙珠路; Lóngzhūlù

spots.name: Fubo Hill
spots.desc: Contains historical stone carvings from the Tang Dynasty and Buddhist inscriptions. The hill is an impressive sheer-sided rock.

spots.name: Elephant Trunk Hill
spots.desc: Hill with a large natural arch cut into it. This resembles the trunk of an elephant dipping into the river. This scene is frequently used as a symbol of the city and so has developed some fame. There is a fun and cheaper alternative to get into the park, you can go all the way to the river on the street just at the right side of the west gate, you will find some people asking if you want a boat…
spots.addr: Binjiang Rd (滨江路; Bīn​jiānglù)

spots.name: Peach Blossom River
spots.desc: This is a river going through the western parts of town. Beautiful and relaxing area. As the name indicates, here you can see the peach blossoms in spring and the red leaves in autumn.

spots.name: Reed Flute Cave
spots.desc: This limestone cave with impressive stalactite and stalagmite formations is worth a visit if you have not seen such caves before. An English-speaking guide will take you around the various artificially lit formations supposedly resembling lions, monkeys, old men, the skyline of Guilin, etc. There is also a brief laser/light/music show inside the cave. You may have to wait a while for a large…
spots.addr: Ludi Rd (芦笛路; Lúdílù)

spots.name: Solitary Beauty Peak
spots.desc: Rises dramatically above the center of Guilin and offers spectacular views of the city and surrounding countryside. As with so many peaks and rocky upthrusts in and around Guilin, centuries of visits have led to the creation of a carved stairway leading to the summit. The pathway starts at Wang Cheng, the Ming Dynasty palace in the center of town, now home to the campus of Guangxi Normal…

spots.name: Yaoshan Hill Park
spots.desc: This is a large country park which encompasses the highest peak in the area. Foot paths run to the summit, however the chair lift provides an effortless way to attain the top and enjoy the scenery. There are extensive views of the surrounding area from the summit. There is a wheeled toboggan run down part of the mountain. To access this, dismount the chairlift at the station half way down the…
spots.addr: Jingjiang Rd

spots.name: Crown Cave
spots.desc: A 3-km section of the cave is open to tourists. At the entrance of the cave, take the elevator and venture 30-m deep into the cave. After looking at the various stalactite and stalagmite formations, you can also visit the waterfall (¥5) inside the cave. After that, take the monorail to admire the largest and most beautiful section of the cave. To exit the cave, you can either travel back to the…
spots.price: ¥65 per person excluding transport to/from cave entrance
spots.addr: 45 minute by long distance bus, then take the monorail or visitor jeep (¥35) to the entrance of the cave

spots.name: Daxu Old Town
spots.desc: Ancient town along the east bank of the Li River dating back more than 1,000 years, probably the nicest in the area. The town is beautifully located close to the Millstone Hill and the Snail Hill. The heart of town is the 2 km long Bluestone St with many well preserved buildings. The town has lots of attractions dating back hundreds of years including the Gauzu Temple, The Hanhuang Temple, the…
spots.addr: 23 km southeast of Guilin, 0.5 hours by bus

spots.name: Chucun
spots.desc: A large old town perhaps 6km behind the airport, with signs directing visitors to several houses, a small bridge, a school, and an ancestral temple, among other places. When the town was invaded by the Japanese in the 1940s, the villagers hid in an enormous cave in the mountain behind the town, protecting its entrances with ground chilli peppers. The mountain can be climbed, but the cave is…

spots.name: Xiongcun
spots.desc: A relatively large old town with small city gates at many of its entrances. Signs with English direct you to the major old streets

spots.name: Li River Cruise
spots.desc: The boats operate on a daily basis and reservations can be booked in advance or at any hotels in Guilin. Most tourists will go from Guilin to Yangshuo (a very picturesque smaller town downstream of Guilin). The river winds through some truly spectacular limestone formations and a slow boat trip there and back (with a stop in Yangshuo) will take a whole day. The cruise from Guilin to Yangshuo…

spots.name: Two Rivers and Four Lakes Cruise
spots.desc: A boat tour around the four lakes and two rivers of Guilin city. At night, the scenery is spectacularly flood lit. At the mid point in the tour, there will be a demonstration of traditional cormorant fishing. It is the best activity at night. Tours last about 90 minutes.
spots.addr: Binjiang Rd

spots.name: Dreaming on Li River Show
spots.local: 夢幻漓江秀; Mèng​huàn Lí​jiāng Xiù
spots.desc: A theatrical dance and music performance daily. The show tries to recreate the culture of the various ethnic groups around Guilin.
spots.addr: 95 Qixing Rd (七星路95号; Qī​xīnglù)

spots.name: Mountain Bike Rental
spots.desc: A centrally located bike shop at city downtown with 24/27 speed mountain bikes for rent (¥45-100 a day). English speaking staff. Many one and multi-day cycling/hiking trips in and around Guilin.
spots.addr: 40 Sanduo Road (三多路40号)

spots.name: Guilin Shangri-la park
spots.desc: Set in beautiful scenery, this ethnic theme park tries to introduce visitors to the wide range of local nationalities and their cultures. A short boat trip will take you around the butterfly lake. On the way, various performances are staged on the shore of the lake, demonstrating different aspects of the culture. The boat will drop you off at the 'village' where you can see displays of local…

spots.name: Butterfly Cave
spots.desc: A pair of sheer sided mountains surrounded by a butterfly themed park. One of the mountains has a cave running through the core of it. Inside this cave are many strange rock formations including stalagmites and stalactites. One particularly unusual formation is shaped like a butterfly, lending the hill its name. A rope bridge connects from the cave's exit over to the other mountain. At the side…

spots.name: Golf Course
spots.desc: Beautiful golf course with 27 holes. A bit on the expensive side but well worth the money.

spots.name: Wada Bar @ Wada Hostel
spots.desc: This place has a great vibe attracting many foreigner travellers from around the world. Spacious outdoor lounge provides a great atmosphere to hang out all day long. The night comes alive with music and happy hour drinks with premium cocktails at ¥20-30 each. Great Western/Chinese food options to choose from.
spots.addr: 212 Huancheng Xiyi Rd (Chinese Address: 环城西一路212号)

spots.name: Hao Heng Shi Jia
spots.desc: Good steaks, western and Chinese food. Located on the main shopping street. Internet cafe just upstairs.
spots.addr: 2nd floor, 9 Middle Zhong Shan Rd

spots.name: Islam Restaurant
spots.desc: Owned by the Islam Association of Guilin. Serves traditional halal food.
spots.addr: 55 Xicheng Rd (西城路55号)

spots.name: Jufulin
spots.desc: Serving standard Chinese dishes. Seating in and out: inside can be a bit crowded, but outside is nice.
spots.addr: 10 Zhengyang Rd

spots.name: Rosemary Cafe
spots.desc: Good coffee and Western food, sandwiches with wholemeal bread. Free Wi-Fi. A few books for sale or exchange. Staff are polite and efficient, though perhaps slightly cool in their attitude.
spots.addr: 1 Yiren Rd

spots.name: UBC Cafe
spots.desc: This is a Shanghai chain coffeehouse also serving Chinese and Western food. The coffee card appears reasonable, but sometimes you get the feeling they serve more or less the same regardless of what you order. Large place with a piano player.
spots.addr: Yiren Rd

spots.name: Kaya café & bar
spots.desc: One of the few real bars in Guilin. Very laidback atmosphere. Located in a quiet street near the center. Offers chilled out music. They also have a branch in Yangshuo.
spots.addr: Zhonghua Lu 6

spots.name: Red Lips -- On the Road -- Usual Place -- Go In
spots.desc: Four bars nearby, each nicely decorated and with relaxed atmosphere, some with Internet access, young audience, often English-speaking Chinese students. Also Sharon's Coffee for excellent Western food (e.g. steak, schnitzel, burgers and baguettes) close-by.
spots.addr: Chuanshan South Rd

spots.name: Logo
spots.desc: Bar/club, often has a cover band playing and/or DJs very loud, but not a bad atmosphere if there's a good crowd.
spots.addr: 1-8 Chaoyang Rd, 540004

spots.name: Lakeside Inn
spots.desc: Drinks and German beer, at the other side of the ShanHu Hotel building, right between the Central Square and the Sun and Moon Pagodas. English-speaking staff and visited mostly by tourists and expats.
spots.addr: No1-1-2 Shan lake Building, Shan Lake North Road

spots.name: Ho Chi Minh's Former Residence
spots.desc: This place used to be an inn called the Nanyang Inn. Ho Chi Minh lived here from 1943 to 1944 following his release from prison. A museum inside the building explains the history.
spots.addr: 1-2 Liushi Road, Liunan District (柳南区柳石路2-1号)

spots.name: Liuzhou Industrial Museum
spots.desc: Displays various kinds of antiquated machines and vehicles from Liuzhou's past.
spots.addr: 220 Liudong Road, Yufeng District (鱼峰区柳东路220号)

spots.name: Liuzhou Military Museum
spots.desc: Reportedly the largest military museum in southwestern China. The museum is on the grounds of the old Liuzhou Airport. The airport dates from the Second World War when it was an important base for the allied forces, including the American Volunteer Group (AVG), a group of volunteer American fighter pilots popularly known as the Flying Tigers. The Soviet Volunteer Group were also based here. Many…
spots.addr: Intersection of Hangwu Road and Hangyin Road, Liunan District (柳南区航五路与航银路交叉口)

spots.name: Liuzhou Museum
spots.desc: Tells the history of Liuzhou from prehistory to the present. Has lots of Chinese ethnic minority displays.
spots.addr: 37 Jiefang North Road, Chengzhong District (城中区解放北路37号)

spots.name: Liuzhou Confucius Temple
spots.desc: Reconstructed in 2009. The original temple, with a history of over 1000 years, burnt down in the great fire of 1928.
spots.addr: 8 Fuzi Road, Yufeng District (鱼峰区夫子路8号)

spots.name: Liuhou Park
spots.desc: The park commemorates Liu Zongyuan, a Tang dynasty poet and statesman who was governor of Liuzhou.
spots.addr: 60 Wenhui Road, Chengzhong District (城中区文惠路60号)

spots.name: Liuzhou Zoo
spots.desc: Home to around 700 animals from 100 different species, including pandas.
spots.addr: 89 Hangyin Road, Yufeng District (鱼峰区航银路89号)

spots.name: Liyufeng Scenic Area
spots.desc: Consists of two interlinking parks, Yufeng Park (鱼峰公园) and Ma'anshan Park (马鞍山公园). Has wonderful views and caves which have shown evidence of human inhabitation in Neathandrical times.
spots.price: Entry is free. The cable car costs ¥30 per ride
spots.addr: 59 Yufeng Road, Yufeng District (鱼峰区鱼峰路59号)

spots.name: Malushan Rare Stones Exposition Garden
spots.local: 马鹿山奇石博览园, 马鹿山公园, Malushan Park, Malu Hill Park
spots.desc: A large garden filled with a variety of unusual-looking rocks. The rarest specimens are kept in a small museum in the southeast corner of the garden.
spots.hours: The garden is open all day. The museum is open Tue-Sun 09:00 to 17:00
spots.price: Entry to the garden is free. The museum charges ¥50 per head
spots.addr: 272 Donghuan Road, Chengzhong District (城中区东环路272号)

spots.name: Yaobu Ancient Town
spots.desc: Yaobu Ancient Town is a historic riverside town known for its traditional architecture, local culture, and scenic views.
spots.addr: No. 9 Yonglong Road

spots.name: Liuzhou city queershan Water world
spots.local: 柳州市雀儿山水上世界
spots.desc: A water park in Que'er Mountain Park, featuring swimming pools, water slides, and various recreational facilities.
spots.addr: 5 Queershan Road

spots.name: Liuzhou MixC
spots.desc: A modern shopping mall offering a wide range of shops, restaurants, entertainment, and leisure facilities in Liuzhou.
spots.addr: 17 Wenchang Road

spots.name: Liuzhou Wanda Plaza
spots.desc: One of the new commercial centers in Liuzhou, which integrates large shopping centers, large entertainment centers, five-star cinemas, five-star hotels, Grade A office buildings and SOHO offices.
spots.addr: 256 Donghuan Avenue

spots.name: Wuxing Pedestrian Street
spots.desc: It is the largest and the most prosperous commercial pedestrian street in Liuzhou. It is a comprehensive pedestrian street integrating entertainment, shopping, leisure, social, cultural, commercial and catering. It has become a representative of Liuzhou's commercial prosperity and a must-see for foreign tourists.
spots.addr: 2 Jiefang South Road

spots.name: Old Street
spots.desc: The street is famous for its old colonial buildings, which are rotting away. This is the original site of the first Western trade centres in Beihai. Now there are quite a few bars there and a busy nightlife.

spots.name: Underwater World
spots.desc: Oceanorama and exhibition center of shellfish and coral. A must-see for aquarium enthusiasts. Featuring over a thousand kinds of coral and shellfish, the combined complex also features a large collection of fish, sharks, and turtles, as well as a ten meter tall column-style aquarium. In addition to the sea life, there is also a large section on China's naval history, with some nods to foreign…

spots.name: Beihai Jinhaiwan Mangrove Forest Ecotourism Area
spots.local: 北海金海湾红树林生态旅游区
spots.desc: The Beihai Jinhaiwan Mangrove Forest covers an area of about 20 square kilometers and is home to a wide variety of birds and sea creatures. There is also a museum about the Tanka people (or boat people), a subgroup of Han Chinese people who have traditionally lived in their boats.
spots.addr: Yinhai District (银海区)

spots.name: Silver Beach
spots.desc: Beach with grey-white quartz sand which is well worth visiting. Do not expect clear blue water, as the quartz sand makes the water appear quite murky, even though it is considered to be safe for swimming. If you have the chance to stick around the beach after dark, you will be in for a wonderful sight. If the sky is clear and the light from the moon is shining on the water, you will be treated to…

spots.name: Night Markets
spots.desc: Locals enjoy staying up late and one of the best things to do in Beihai is just to wander around streets with food and market stalls. There are a couple of public parks that are open late and many locals head there at weekend nights to have a drink, do some dancing and just to meet their friends.

spots.name: Cinema
spots.desc: Around the Beibuwan Square there are at least three locations for the cinema. At the top of two shopping malls. 1st one: Crossing of Changqing Road & Hai'an Road (3rd floor), 2nd one: Beibuwan Middle Road & Hai'an road (5th floor) and the third one is at the Beibuwan Middle Rd (4th floor). The first two are very new, where as the last one is slightly older.

spots.name: Sea Turtles 911
spots.desc: The only non-profit organization promoting sea turtle conservation in China, Sea Turtles 911's primary facility is a floating sea turtle hospital in Lingshui near Nanwan Monkey Island, as well as programs in Sanya and Haikou. While on Hainan Island visitors are welcome to volunteer with the sea turtles and the organization's educational programs.

spots.name: Bin Lang Gu
spots.desc: A cultural village for the Li people (黎族), the largest non-Han ethnic minority of Hainan, and the original inhabitants of the island before large-scale Han settlement during the Song Dynasty.
spots.addr: 224 National Rd, Baoting Lizumiaozuzizhixian

spots.name: South Bay Monkey Island (also known as Nanwan Monkey Islet)
spots.desc: Lingshui South Bay Monkey Island (also known as Nanwan Monkey Islet). Be wary of the monkeys that steal bags.
spots.addr: Lingshui South Bay

spots.name: Volcano Park and lava rock villages
spots.desc: The Volcano Park has an entrance fee of about ¥60. Lava rock villages are generally free, but if visiting Rongtang Protected Village pay the local elders ¥5.
spots.addr: about 15 km south of Haikou city, next to Shishan Town

spots.name: Old Qilou Streets
spots.local: 骑楼老街; qílóu lǎojiē, Sotto Porticos Streets
spots.desc: Explore old city streets, markets and shops. This is the largest area in Haikou where old buildings are preserved, giving rise to an authentic atmosphere. It has an eclectic range of shops, e.g., pets (puppies, chicks, cats, rabbits), household drapes, kitchen tools, hardware, roast duck, toys. You can walk into some of the old courtyard style buildings and see the original wood work and details.…
spots.addr: Longhua District (龙华区)

spots.name: Tianhou Temple
spots.desc: Dedicated to Mazu (妈祖), the goddess of the sea who is also known as Tianhou (天后), meaning Queen of Heaven. This is one of the oldest temples in Haikou and has a history of over 700 years.
spots.addr: 87 Zhongshan Road, Longhua District (龙华区中山路87号)

spots.name: Xitian Temple
spots.desc: A memorial temple dedicated to honouring the memory of Wang Zuo (王佐), a famous poet from Hainan's Lingao County who lived from 1428 to 1512. The temple was founded about half a century after Wang Zuo's death, but was later destroyed and rebuilt. The current structures date from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries.
spots.addr: 75 Yixing Street, Longhua District (龙华区义兴街75号)

spots.name: Former Residence of Feng Baiju
spots.desc: Feng Baiju (1903-1973) was the chief Communist military leader on Hainan Island during both the Chinese Civil War and the Second Sino-Japanese War. His house was burned down by the Japanese army in 1942 and rebuilt in 1984. There is a small museum about him next to the residence.
spots.addr: Changtai Village, Yunlong Town, Qiongshan District (琼山区云龙镇长泰村)

spots.name: Former Residence of Qiu Jun
spots.desc: Built in the second year of the Ming Dynasty (1369), Qiu Jun's former residence is the oldest wooden building in Haikou and a rare example of early Ming architecture.
spots.addr: No. 9 Lane 3, Jinhua Road, Qiongshan District (琼山区金花路三巷9号)

spots.name: Qiongtai Academy
spots.desc: Established in commemoration of Qiu Jun, believed to be the most brilliant scholar in Hainan and a renowned Ming Dynasty academic. Construction began in 1705. The two-storey main building is made of brick and wood and is rich in traditional ethnic characteristics. The well-preserved academy is now the site of Qiongtai Normal University. The academy became celebrated after a well-known Cantonese…
spots.addr: 8 Zhongshan Road, Fucheng Town, Qiongshan District (琼山区府城镇中山路8号)

spots.name: Qiongya Red Army Yunlong Reorganization Site
spots.local: 琼崖红军云龙改编旧址
spots.desc: In 1938, at this site in the town of Yunlong, the Qiongya Workers and Peasants‘ Red Army led by Feng Baiju was reorganized and rebranded as the Independent Column of District 14 of the Guangdong People's Anti-Japanese Defense Corps. This was done in the wake of an agreement by Communist and Kuomintang forces to halt the civil war and work together to fight the invading Japanese army. A memorial…
spots.addr: 9 Haiyu Road South, Yunlong Town, Qiongshan District (琼山区云龙镇海榆南路9号)

spots.name: Qiu Jun's Tomb
spots.desc: Qiu Jun's tomb is much less frequently visited than Hai Rui's tomb, in part because it was neglected for so many years. Restoration work began in the early 2010s and was completed in 2020. The tomb is now part of a small park called Qiu Jun Cultural Park (丘浚文化园). The park includes a museum about Qiu Jun, which opened in May 2022.
spots.addr: Qiu Jun Road, Chengxi Town, Xiuying District (秀英区城西镇邱浚路)

spots.name: Tomb of Hairui
spots.desc: Hairui Tomb is a key national cultural protection unit. Hairui, a famous official in the Ming dynasty, was born in Qiongshan and was known as "Hai Qingtian" (incorruptible official). The tomb was built in 1589 and it is said that when people was carrying Hairui's coffin, suddenly the rope broke, and then people decided that this should be the place. Hairui Tomb has an area of 3 ha (7.4 acre). In…

spots.name: Fengxiang Wetlands Park
spots.desc: Not just a park, this is part of an ongoing environmental project aimed at rehabilitating the Meishe River (美舍何). The project has been heavily promoted by the local media and touted by some government officials as a model for other cities in China. Before and after photos appear to show that the river is much cleaner than before. The main highlight of the park is the artificial wetlands, which…
spots.addr: Yehai Avenue, Qiongshan District (琼山区椰海大道)

spots.name: Swan Lake Animal Base
spots.desc: Also known as Cozy Lake Zoo Park in English, this is a small zoo centered around a lake and is mostly populated by exotic animals from other parts of the world. Besides the swans that live in the lake, you can also see flamingoes, parrots, emus, kangaroos, lemurs, monkeys, goats, llamas and various other species.
spots.price: Standard adult tickets are ¥80; tickets for children over 1.2 meters and adults aged 65 to 69 are ¥50; children under…
spots.addr: Guilinyang Avenue, Meilan District (美兰区桂林洋大道)

spots.name: Feng Xiaogang's Movie Town
spots.local: 冯小刚电影公社, 观澜湖华谊冯小刚电影公社 Mission Hills • Huayi Brothers • Feng Xiaogang Movie Town, Movie Town Haikou
spots.desc: A theme park established by the famous Chinese film director Feng Xiaogang. The two main 'scenic areas' are 1942 Street and Nanyang Street. The former is modelled on a street in Chongqing that appeared in the film Back To 1942, while the latter is designed to look like a typical Chinatown in Southeast Asia. The main thing to do here is wander about the streets and look at the buildings while…
spots.price: ¥68 (1942 Street), ¥68 (Fanghua Street), ¥88 (Nanyang Street), ¥98 (1942 Street + Fanghua Street), ¥158 (1942 Street +…
spots.addr: 19 Yangshan Avenue, Longhua District (龙华区羊山大道19号)

spots.name: Haikou City Museum
spots.desc: A small museum focused on art and local history. The main exhibition halls are on the second floor.
spots.price: Free (provided you don't come here via the Wugong Temple, which charges a fee of ¥20)
spots.addr: 169 Haifu Road (琼山区海府大道169号)

spots.name: Hainan State Farms Museum
spots.desc: This museum depicts the history of Hainan State Farms (HSF). Focuses especially on the development of Hainan's rubber industry. Also includes an exhibition on the Down to the Countryside Movement - a movement during the Cultural Revolution in which urban youths were required to relocate to rural areas, including rubber plantations on Hainan Island. The captions for individual objects are…
spots.addr: Levels 1 & 2, Finance Building, 103 Binhai Ave

spots.name: Teddy Bear Museum Haikou
spots.desc: This museum is actually a branch of a chain of museums based on Jeju Island in South Korea. The museum is divided into three sections. The first section features models of many of the cities on the Silk Road with teddy bears standing in place of humans. The second section displays some antique teddy bears and the last section is filled with teddy bear artwork. Predictably there is a shop near the…
spots.addr: Mission Hills Haikou, 39 Yangshan Avenue, Longhua District (龙华区羊山大道39号海口观澜湖新城)

spots.name: Wormhole Library
spots.desc: Opened on 12 April 2021, this is Haikou's newest landmark building. The quirky design is the work of MAD Architects, a Beijing-based architectural design firm. For the time being, visitor numbers are restricted to a maximum of 400 per day and it is mandatory to make a booking on either the website or the official WeChat account before visiting, though this can only be done in Chinese. The…
spots.addr: Century Park Music Square, Gangwan Road, Longhua District (龙华区港湾路世纪公园音乐广场)

spots.name: Xixiu Beach
spots.desc: Nice beach with a few restaurants. Watch the locals windsurfing and jogging. Not as much activity as at Holiday Beach, but closer to the city centre.

spots.name: Sea Turtles 911
spots.desc: The only non-profit organization promoting sea turtle conservation in China, Sea Turtles 911's primary facility is a floating sea turtle hospital in Lingshui near Nanwan Monkey Island, and programs in Sanya and Haikou. While on Hainan Island visitors are welcome to volunteer with the sea turtles and the organization's educational programs. Recommended donation. Go to www.seaturtles911.org for…

spots.name: Haikou Bay Performing Arts Center
spots.desc: Opened in 2020, this is Haikou's newest performing arts center. It used to be the Haikou City People's Congress. For the latest show schedule (in Chinese only), see the official WeChat account (WeChat ID: 小海艺).
spots.addr: 42 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District (龙华区滨海大道42号)

spots.name: Haikou Antique City
spots.desc: Haikou Antique City occupies the 3rd to 6th levels of the Yishenghe Department Store. It claims to be the largest and oldest center in Haikou for the sale and purchase of antiques. Contains almost 600 antique stores.
spots.addr: Yishenghe Department Store, 20 Haixiu Road East (海秀东路20号亿圣和百货)

spots.name: Hainan Antique City
spots.desc: Hainan Antique City occupies the first four levels of the Huafa Building on Datong Road. Like its similarly named rival, this is not one shop, but a center containing numerous small independent antique stores.
spots.addr: Huafa Building, 25 Datong Road, Longhua District (龙华区大同路25号华发大厦)

spots.name: DC Computer Town
spots.desc: Haikou's largest and most popular center for buying computers and other electronic devices. Contains shops and stalls representing all major brands.
spots.addr: 10 Haixiu Road East (海秀东路10号)

spots.name: Haida South Gate Snack Food St
spots.desc: Regarded by locals as the best place to eat street food. There are around 40 stalls to choose from. Foreigner friendly because you can look at the food first and choose what appeals.
spots.addr: 3 West Rd (Sanxi Lu)

spots.name: Jiu Mao Jiu
spots.desc: One of Hainan's most successful chain restaurants. Jiu Mao Jiu was founded in Haikou in 1995 by a businessman from Shanxi Province. It specializes in Shanxi cuisine, particularly noodles. There are around 12 branches in Haikou. Most branches are inside shopping centers. The most centrally located branch is probably the one on the 6th floor of the Friendship Commercial Plaza (友谊商业广场) on Datong…
spots.addr: Multiple locations

spots.name: The Manchurian
spots.desc: This restaurant chain was established in Haikou in 1993 by a group of migrants from northeastern China. The chain has been fairly successful and has established branches in several other cities, including Sanya, Shenzhen, Zhuhai and Shanghai. The flagship store on Haixiu Avenue is one of the largest dumpling restaurants in Haikou. Besides dumplings, the restaurant also serves various other…
spots.addr: Multiple locations. The flagship restaurant is located at 49 Haixiu Avenue (海秀大道49号) near the Longhua Road intersection. See English website for other locations

spots.name: Hainan Restaurant
spots.desc: Haikou-based restaurant chain specializing in Hainanese cuisine. Very popular with the locals.
spots.addr: Multiple locations

spots.name: Yushang Jianglai Xinjiang Cuisine
spots.desc: A large and fairly popular Xinjiang restaurant in the Guomao area. Has a fully-illustrated menu with English translations. Dancers from Xinjiang occasionally perform on the stage on the ground floor.
spots.addr: 10 Jinlong Road, Longhua District (龙华区金龙路10号)

spots.name: Romantic Turkey
spots.desc: A Turkish restaurant run by a Turkish Australian man. Serves kebabs, pides and various other Turkish dishes.
spots.addr: Building 6, Bilin Pavilion, 102 Jinmao West Road, Longhua District (龙华区金贸西路102号碧林阁6栋)

spots.name: Songchuanjie Exquisite Cuisine
spots.desc: A large Japanese restaurant. The restaurant is housed inside a purpose-built Japanese-style building. Some cats live in an enclosed area at the back of the restaurant. Both à la carte and all-you-can-eat menus are available, but the à la carte menu is only available in the day time. There are two different all-you-can-eat menus, including one costing ¥298 and one costing ¥328.
spots.addr: b1/13 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District (龙华区金贸中路13号-b1)

spots.name: Fushan Coffee
spots.desc: Large cafe with primarily male guests hanging around for hours drinking coffee and smoking. Other branches at Bin4 Hai3 Da4 Dao4 (滨海大道会展中心附楼), Nan2 Sha1 Lu4 59 (南沙路59号), Yi4 Long2 Lu4 (义龙路市人大宾馆道层).
spots.price: Imported coffee at ¥15-25 a cup, local brew at ¥12 for as much as you like
spots.addr: Bailong South Rd, 白龙南路琼苑广场道层

spots.name: Coffee World Lighthouse Store
spots.desc: Offers 32 specialty drinks and an array of freshly made sandwiches and a nice selection of cakes and ice creams. Outdoor dining provided as well as a fully air conditioned restaurant. Coffee World Lighthouse is a Haikou City Landmark having one of the nicest outdoor balconies situated alongside the river. A relaxing environment to meet friends and entertain guests. English speaking staff.
spots.addr: Bin Jiang Hai An

spots.name: Dongtian Park
spots.desc: A coastal park in Sanya's far west. Famous for its rocky beach and historical calligraphy. Swimming is prohibited and climbing on the rocks is also not permitted. The area is popular with couples who come here to take wedding photos.
spots.addr: Yacheng Town, Yazhou District (崖州区崖城镇)

spots.name: Paddy Field National Park
spots.desc: A park comprised of picturesque rice paddies and filled with life-sized dinosaur models.
spots.addr: Wanpo Road, Haitang District (海棠区湾坡路)

spots.name: Phoenix Hill
spots.local: 凤凰岭 Fenghuangling, 凤凰岭海誓山盟景区 Fenghuangling Haishishanmeng Scenic Area
spots.desc: The tallest land formation in the central part of Sanya. Take the cable car to the top for a panoramic view of the city, but be careful not to take pictures of the military base.
spots.hours: 08:00-21:00, no tickets sold after 19:30, no entry after 19:40
spots.addr: 300 Longling Road, Jiyang District (吉阳区龙陵路300号)

spots.name: Yalong Bay Tropical Paradise Forest Park
spots.local: 亚龙湾热带天堂森林公园
spots.desc: The park was the main setting for If You are the One 2, a 2010 romantic comedy directed by Chinese film director Feng Xiaogang. Visitors can visit specific scenes from the film, including the famous rope chain bridge. Other major attractions include an orchid garden and a glass bridge. When on the glass bridge, be careful not to inadvertently take pictures of the military base below, as this will…
spots.hours: 07:30-18:00. No tickets sold after 17:30. Online tickets may not be collected after 17:00
spots.price: The entry fee is ¥108 during peak season (October to April) and ¥90 during slack eason (May to September). The…
spots.addr: Yalong Bay Road, Jiyang District (吉阳区亚龙湾路)

spots.name: Jingrun Pearl Museum
spots.desc: A museum run by a pearl retailer. There's a shop here too, as well as a pearl-themed hotel and restaurant.
spots.addr: Haiyu Highway West, Tianya District (天涯区海榆(西)线)

spots.name: Sanya Natural History Museum
spots.desc: Maintains a small but fairly respectable collection of fossils, mostly from other parts of China, particularly Liaoning. The museum's most prized item is a complete fossil of a Sanya Pterosaur - so-called not because it lived in the Sanya region, but because the Sanya Natural History Museum was the first to identify it.
spots.price: The entry fee is included with the entry fee for Dongtian Park
spots.addr: Dongtian Park, Yacheng Town, Yazhou District (崖州区崖城镇三亚大小洞天旅游区内)

spots.name: Yacheng Confucius Temple
spots.desc: One of the very few major historical sites in Sanya. The Yacheng Confucius Temple is the southern most Confucius temple in China. It was established in 1054 and has been rebuilt and relocated over a dozen times. The current structures date from 1832, though of course there have been some renovations since then. To get here from the city without taking the train, take bus no. 58. If coming from…
spots.addr: National Highway 225, Yacheng Town, Yazhou District (崖州区崖城镇225国道)

spots.name: Insight Adventures
spots.desc: Insight Adventures are the largest operator in Sanya and offer surfing and many other activities such as kayaking, biking, snorkelling and stand up paddle boards. Insight offers a large staff of foreign and Chinese guides.
spots.addr: LuHuiTou Village (best use email or phone)

spots.name: Gelball Gun Games (Airsoft)
spots.desc: There is a small group of foreigners and Chinese "weekend warriors" that play gun games (水弹枪) in Sanya. The guns are "water ball" or "crystal ball" guns (水弹枪). They shoot a small "crystal" or "water" ball, similar to a paintball (but smaller, at lower velocity, and with no mess), and the guns look like their real-steel counterparts (they are modified airsoft guns). Two locations: one is an…
spots.addr: Summer Mall (Basement) west of / beside the Train Station; & Other hidden locations

spots.name: Three Kingdoms Ruins Park
spots.local: 三国新城遗址公园 Héféi sānguó xīnchéng yízhǐ gōngyuán
spots.desc: There are some minor pavilions etc. there, and the trees are very picturesque in Spring.
spots.addr: 庐阳区 Luyang district

spots.name: Emerald Lake scenic area
spots.local: 翡翠湖风景区, Fěicuì hú
spots.desc: Hire tandem bikes and pedal around the lake. Good place to have a picnic or read a book. Few people and quiet.
spots.addr: 开发区大学城内 Development zone University City.

spots.name: Feng le ecological park
spots.local: 丰乐生态园 Fēng lè shēngtài yuán
spots.desc: 安徽省合肥市双凤工业区魏武路中段 Shuāng fèng gōngyè qū wèi wǔlù zhōngduàn (Shuangfeng inductrial area, Wei Wu middle Rd)

spots.name: Zi Peng mountain
spots.desc: 肥西县 Feixi county. A forest park with some walking tracks. There is a large Buddhist temple at the top of the mountain and multi-storey Buddhist statues carved into the side of the mountain. Best to have a driver/take a local. Stop somewhere to try 肥西老母鸡 Féixi lǎo mǔjī (famous Feixi old hen) for lunch. About 30-45 mins drive from Hefei.

spots.name: Memorial Museum of the Yangtze River Crossing Campaign
spots.desc: Dedicated to the Yangtze River Crossing Campaign, a.major military campaign launched by the People’s Liberation Army in the final stages of the Chinese Civil War. The campaign was fought over a large area of the Yangtze basin and culminated in the successful capture of Nanjing, the capital of China during the Republican period. Another Yangtze River Crossing Campaign memorial museum can be found…
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mon (except when Mon is a public holiday)
spots.addr: 299 Yunggu Road, Baohe District (包河区云谷路299号)

spots.name: Swan Lake
spots.desc: 市蜀山区 Shushan district. There is an artificial beach there + 合肥大剧院 Héféi dà jùyuàn (Hefei Poly Grand Theater). Live theater and concerts and MBox cinema.

spots.name: Daishan lake
spots.desc: 岱山湖旅游度假区肥东县 Daishan Lake tourist resort, Feidong county. Somewhere to go if you have a driver and want to get out into the countryside. There are some minor attractions there incl. 4 wheel buggies, skirmish, and a Buddhist temple with large statue on the lake.

spots.name: Hefei Pedestrian Mall
spots.desc: Along the mall is 李鸿章故居 Lihóngzhāng gùjū (Former residence of Li Hong Zhang) + 合肥明教寺 Héféi míngjiào sì (Mingjiao temple). From the Suzhou lu end of the mall is 市政府广场 Shì zhèngfǔ guǎngchǎng (Municipal government square).

spots.name: Temple Market
spots.desc: A bustling market + temple area where you can buy everyday items. Known for cheap products.
spots.addr: 庐阳区合肥霍邱路99号 Luyang Rd

spots.name: Sanhe Ancient Town
spots.desc: Day trip 40 km. Small but orderly town which is well known for its 米酒 Mǐjiǔ (rice wine). It has some cultural attractions like temples and pagodas. Unlike in other ancient towns, most of the buildings are newly built, if in a style resembling old Chinese houses. Streets are unusually wide and straight. It is a pleasant trip out of Hefei, especially if you have not visited any Chinese ancient…

spots.name: Snow Villa
spots.local: 雪霁山庄 Xuě jì shānzhuāng
spots.desc: A traditional Anhui opera hall and restaurant. Have dinner in a traditional Anhui setting and watch a local Hui opera show. Good ambience. There is usually one show every evening. Call for show times.
spots.addr: 合肥市蜀山区玉兰大道8号(近名人馆) 雪霁山庄 Héféi shì shǔshān qū yùlán dàdào 8 hào (Magnolia Ave.)

spots.name: Anhui Provincial Opera and Dance Drama Theater
spots.local: 安徽省歌舞剧院 Ānhuī shěng gēwǔ jùyuàn
spots.desc: 宝他区曙光路45号 bāo hé qū shǔguāng lù 45 hào. (45 Shuguang lu, Baohe district)

spots.name: Wanda Plaza
spots.local: 合肥万达广场 Wàndá guǎngchǎng
spots.desc: A very large shopping mall and cinema complex. Has Starbucks, movie cinemas, and a variety of restaurants on the top level. The mall is very new. 包河区马鞍山路与芜湖路交叉口(Ma On shan lu)

spots.name: Yintai Center
spots.local: 合肥银泰购物中心 Héféi Yíntài gòuwù zhòngxīn
spots.desc: Another very large shopping mall with restaurants on top level. This mall has a huge range of designer stores, from high-end to mid-range. No cinemas.
spots.addr: 长江中游路98号 Chángjiāng zhōngyóu lù 98 hào (98 Changjiang middle road)

spots.name: Baida CBD Mall
spots.local: 百大CBD购物中心 Bǎidà CBD gòuwù zhòngxīn
spots.desc: Comprises one large, multi-level department store. There is also a Habitat Coffee lounge in the center that has a very nice atmosphere. No restaurants or cinema.
spots.addr: 庐阳区长江中路150号CBD中央广场 (Chángjiāng lù 150 hào)

spots.name: Guo Gou Plaza
spots.local: 合肥国购广场 Guo Gou guǎngchǎng
spots.desc: A large shopping mall and cinema complex. Has a number of restaurants on the top level (but not as much variety as Wanda) + movie cinema. The center contains a very large Carrefour supermarket/dept. store. This is one of the older malls in Hefei.
spots.addr: 长江路199号 Chángjiāng lù 199 hào (Changjiang West Road)

spots.name: Yuan Yi Times Square
spots.local: 元一时代广场 Yuán yī shídài guǎngchǎng
spots.desc: Has a Walmart and Parkson department store + cinemas. This is one of the older malls in Hefei.
spots.addr: 新站区胜利路89 Xīnzhàn qū shènglì lù 89

spots.name: Hefei Bai Shui Ba
spots.desc: A medium-sized mall mainly based around one large TESCO supermarket. The center has quite a few clothing stores and restaurants, incl. Thai and Korean. In warmer months, sellers set up a small night market in the square outside.
spots.addr: 蒙城北路 MengCheng bei lu

spots.name: Níngguó Rd.
spots.local: 宁国路龙虾美食街 Níngguó lù lóngxiā měishí jiē
spots.desc: Hefei's most famous longxia street. Even though this appears to be an attempt at a tourist attraction, most of the restaurants cater only to large groups (solo travelers may have trouble), and the service is unfriendly.

spots.name: Hupo street food
spots.local: 琥珀山庄美食街 Hǔpò shānzhuāng měishí jiē
spots.desc: Street is lined with restaurants and vendors selling bbq. Pedestrian street filled with tables. Very cheap.

spots.name: Li Hongzhang Hotchpotch
spots.desc: A local restaurant known for serving a version of Li Hongzhang hotchpotch, a mixed stew with meat and vegetables.
spots.addr: No. 138 Bowang Road, Luyang District, Hefei (合肥市庐阳区博望路138号)

spots.name: Wan Dou Huang (Tofu Pudding)
spots.desc: A small eatery known locally for tofu pudding and traditional snacks.
spots.addr: No. 15 Wuhu Road, Baohe District, Hefei (合肥市包河区芜湖路15号)

spots.name: Shun De Roast Duck
spots.desc: A restaurant specializing in roast duck and northern Chinese dishes.
spots.addr: No. 56 Hefei Road, Baohe District, Hefei (合肥市包河区合肥路56号)

spots.name: Bitburger Beer Hall
spots.desc: Hefei’s first German bar and one of the first establishments in the city to serve imported draught beer – German, of course. With its helpful staff, spacious layout, mellow ambience and a decent selection of bar snacks and East-West fusion food, Bitburger is a popular destination for the more discerning tourist or business visitor. German-brand draught beers start at around ¥45. Imported wine…
spots.addr: 258-6 Wuhu Road

spots.name: Soho Bar
spots.desc: Top range sports bar located in The Hilton Hotel. Showing live sports on a multitude of widescreen TVs and with its athletic-themed staff, Soho Bar is the best place in town to watch Premier League football, rugby and whichever international sports events you care to imagine. Due to the plethora of TVs available, staff are quite happy to let you take over the remote control to find the game or…
spots.addr: 198 Shengli Road

spots.name: CoCo Fresh Tea & Juice (Huaihe Road)
spots.desc: Chain tea and beverage shop offering milk tea and fruit tea drinks.
spots.addr: Walking Street, 77 Huaihe Road, Luyang District, Hefei (合肥市庐阳区淮河路77号)

spots.name: Mixue Ice Cream & Tea (Yuxin & Bayi)
spots.local: 蜜雪冰城（育新街八一大道店）
spots.desc: Chain beverage shop known for tea drinks and soft ice cream.
spots.addr: Intersection of Yuxin Street and Bayi Avenue, Luyang District, Hefei (合肥市庐阳区育新街与八一大道交叉口)

spots.name: Luckin Coffee (Sanxiaokou)
spots.desc: Coffee chain shop offering brewed coffee and other beverages.
spots.addr: No. 68 Changjiang Road, Luyang District, Hefei (合肥市庐阳区长江路68号)

spots.name: Tims Coffee (Hefei Binhu)
spots.desc: Coffee and beverage shop serving espresso, tea, and related drinks.
spots.addr: Huizhou Avenue, Binhu New District, Hefei (合肥市包河区徽州大道)

spots.name: Huainan Wanda Plaza
spots.desc: The largest shopping mall in Huainan, offering a mix of international and Chinese brands, restaurants, a cinema, and entertainment facilities.
spots.addr: No. 268 Tianjia'an Avenue, Tianjia'an District (田家庵区田家庵大道268号)

spots.name: Huainan Department Store
spots.desc: A long-standing department store selling daily goods, clothing, cosmetics, and local specialties.
spots.addr: No. 45 Renmin Middle Road, Tianjia'an District (田家庵区人民中路45号)

spots.name: Longhu New Town Shopping Street
spots.desc: A modern commercial street combining shopping, dining, and leisure, popular among young locals.
spots.addr: Shannan New District (山南新区)

spots.name: Huainan Night Market
spots.desc: A lively night market offering street snacks, accessories, clothes, and local products; ideal for experiencing local nightlife.
spots.addr: Near Sports Center, Tianjia'an District (田家庵区体育中心附近)

spots.name: Huangshan
spots.desc: The main tourist destination is Huangshan (Yellow Mountain). From the Yuping Cable Car/Mercy Light Temple entrance, the "Western Steps" lead up for about 14 km over spectacular terrain. Allow 6-7 hours for the ascent. If you are fit and have a good head for heights, the steep ascent to Celestial Capital Peak is rewarding. From the Yungu Cable Car parking lot, the ascent by the "Eastern Steps" is…

spots.name: Zhuhai
spots.desc: Do not miss this nearby gorgeous valley covered with a bamboo forest. Some very nice restaurants and rustic inns you can stay in (preferable to Tunxi).

spots.name: Laojie Diyilou
spots.desc: Bright, tastefully decorated restaurant with examples of the food so you know what you are ordering. Not high cuisine, but not bad and predictable!
spots.addr: 249 Laojie (老街249号)

spots.name: Chengkan Ancient Village
spots.desc: Chengkan Village is the top attractions of Huangshan famous for its splendid architectural complex in the Huizhou style. The former residents of Chengkan Village are quite special. The memorial of Chengkan Village is also towering and full of traditional culture.

spots.name: Hongcun
spots.desc: Water village. Hongcun is slightly prettier than Xidi, but much more crowded; if pressed for time, you do not need to see both villages. Some very nice restaurants and rustic inns you can stay in (preferable to Tunxi).

spots.name: Xidi
spots.desc: Water village. Some very nice restaurants and rustic inns you can stay in (preferable to Tunxi).

spots.name: Guangji Temple (广济寺)
spots.desc: This Buddhist temple dates back to the Tang Dynasty and is famous for the Zhe Pagoda, a cultural relic from the Northern Song Dynasty.
spots.addr: Near Mount Zhe, Jinghu District

spots.name: Mirror Lake (镜湖)
spots.desc: A picturesque lake at the heart of the city, offering a serene environment for walking, jogging, or boating.
spots.addr: Jinghu District

spots.name: Yangtze Riverside Park (滨江公园)
spots.desc: Stretching along the Yangtze River, this park features walking paths, gardens, and stunning river views. Perfect for picnics or a leisurely stroll.
spots.addr: Along Binjiang Road, Yijiang District

spots.name: Fantawild Adventure (方特乐园)
spots.desc: A theme park with thrilling rides, shows, and attractions. Suitable for families and children.
spots.addr: 55 Hexie Road, Jiujiang District

spots.name: Mount Zhe (赭山)
spots.desc: A hill park offering hiking trails and panoramic views of Wuhu. It's especially popular during spring when the flowers bloom.
spots.addr: Jinghu District

spots.name: Maren Qifeng Scenic Area (马仁奇峰风景区)
spots.desc: Features a glass bridge, mountain trails, and river rafting. The area offers breathtaking views of Anhui's natural beauty.
spots.addr: Near Fanchang District

spots.name: Macrolink Beluga Ocean Park (新华联大白鲸海洋公园)
spots.desc: A marine park showcasing aquatic life through exhibits, performances, and interactive displays.
spots.addr: Fanchang District

spots.name: Riverside Teahouse (江畔茶馆)
spots.desc: A traditional teahouse with riverside seating, offering a variety of Anhui teas. Try the locally grown green tea.
spots.addr: Binjiang Road, Yijiang District

spots.name: Jinghu Café (镜湖咖啡)
spots.desc: A modern café serving specialty coffee and light snacks. Ideal for relaxing after exploring the city.
spots.addr: Near Mirror Lake, Jinghu District

spots.name: Sky Bar (天空酒吧)
spots.desc: A rooftop bar with panoramic views of the city, serving cocktails, beer, and wine.
spots.addr: Top floor of Wuhu Wanda Plaza

spots.name: Yangtze Brewpub (扬子精酿啤酒馆)
spots.desc: A cozy microbrewery offering craft beers brewed on-site. Popular among locals and expats.
spots.addr: Hexie Road, Jiujiang District

spots.name: The Yangtze levees
spots.desc: In the lowlands of eastern and central Hubei (the Jianghan Plain), the Yangtze is lined with levees (embankments), protecting fields and villages from floods. The top of the levees is well paved, making them pleasant paths for walking, running, and biking. Typically, there is only a very limited amount of motor vehicle traffic on the levee roads - farmers accessing their fields, people who have…

spots.name: Guandi Temple
spots.desc: The Jingzhou Guandi Temple, also known as the Guanyu Temple, is a national AAA tourist attraction built in 1396 during the Hongwu period of the Ming dynasty. It has been rebuilt several times, with the current structure reconstructed in 1987 based on Qing-era designs. Together with the Guandi Temples in Jiezhou, Dangyang, and Luoyang, it is one of the four major Guanyu memorial sites in China.…
spots.addr: No. 48 Aimin Road, Jingzhou District

spots.name: Zhang Juzheng Former Residence
spots.desc: Zhang Juzheng Former Residence is a national 3A tourist attraction, rebuilt in the Ming and Qing courtyard style on an area of about 7,000 square meters. Major structures include Taiyue Hall, Chunchong Hall, and the Zhang Wenzhong Memorial Hall. The site displays Zhang Juzheng's calligraphy, imperial gifts, and writings, along with themed exhibition halls and cultural installations showcasing his…
spots.addr: No. 2, Jingnan Road, Jingzhou District

spots.name: Guan Yu Temple
spots.desc: Jingzhou Guan Yu Temple is a nationally recognized 3A tourist attraction, that was built in the early Ming dynasty to honor Guan Yu, the historic defender of Jingzhou. Destroyed in 1940, it was rebuilt in 2010. The temple features traditional Ming and Qing architectural styles, with key structures including the main gate, main hall, Xianghe Hall, and Chengxin Hall. The main hall houses statues of…
spots.addr: No. 99, Inner South Ring Road, Xinnanmen, Jingzhou District

spots.name: Wanshou Park
spots.desc: Wanshou Park is a 3A-rated national tourist attraction and key cultural heritage site, centered on the Ming-era Wanshou Pagoda and the Southern Song Guanyin Rock. The seven-story octagonal pagoda houses marble Buddha statues and numerous carved bricks, with its base slightly sunken due to the rising Yangtze riverbed. Guanyin Rock, named for its elephant-trunk shape, has served in flood control…
spots.addr: No. 90, Jingdi Road, Shashi District

spots.name: Zhongshan Park
spots.desc: Jingzhou Zhongshan Park, established in 1933, is one of the largest comprehensive parks on the Jianghan Plain. Its main attractions include the Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall, Chunqiu Pavilion, and the Tomb of Sun Shuao. The park consists of a southern area with a zoo and bonsai garden, and a northern area centered around Jiangjin Lake and the Chu Embankment Corridor. With lush greenery, seasonal…
spots.addr: No. 1 Gongyuan Road, Shashi District

spots.name: Zhanghua Temple
spots.desc: Zhanghua Temple was built around 1325 during the Yuan Dynasty and is one of the most renowned Buddhist temples in the Jingchu region. The temple features a grand palace-style layout with main halls such as the Mahavira Hall, Guanyin Hall, and Amitabha Hall. Along with Guiyuan Temple in Hanyang and Yuquan Temple in Dangyang, it is known as one of the "Three Great Monasteries of Hubei" and is…
spots.addr: No. 34 Taishiyuan Road, Shashi District

spots.name: Chuwang Chariot and Horse Formation Scenic Area
spots.desc: The Chuwang Chariot and Horse Formation Scenic Area (Xiongjiazhong National Archaeological Site Park) is Hubei's first national archaeological park and a national 4A-level tourist attraction. Covering 731 acres, it centers on the royal tomb complex of the Chu Kingdom, featuring the main tomb, subsidiary tombs, sacrificial pits, and chariot-horse pits. Excavations uncovered 138 burial tombs, 40…
spots.addr: Zhangchang Village, Chuandian Town, Jingzhou District

spots.name: Jingzhou Fantawild Oriental Heritage
spots.desc: Opened in September 2019, Jingzhou Fantawild Oriental Heritage is a high-tech cultural theme park focused on Chinese history and Jingchu regional culture. The park includes 41 indoor and outdoor themed attractions and around 200 facilities, using technologies such as laser multimedia, 3D effects, and miniature scenes to present themes related to figures and stories such as Qu Yuan, Nüwa Mending…
spots.addr: No. 1 Fantawild Road, Jinan Eco-Cultural Tourism Zone, Jingzhou District

spots.name: Jingzhou Ocean World
spots.desc: Jingzhou Ocean World is a large marine-themed cultural and recreational complex. It features one of Central China's large indoor aquariums, a Caribbean-themed water area, an IMAX-style theater, a children's activity zone, as well as a themed night market and local food section. Its main elements include marine displays, entertainment facilities, and regional cultural settings.
spots.addr: 6 Tiangu Avenue, Shashi District, 500 meters north of the 318 National Road intersection, east side of the street

spots.name: Honghu Wetland National Nature Reserve
spots.local: 洪湖湿地国家级自然保护区
spots.desc: Honghu Wetland National Nature Reserve centers on the freshwater wetland ecosystem of Lake Honghu and contains diverse wildlife and relatively preserved ecological landscapes. The area includes lakeside paths, water routes, and several indoor public facilities such as game rooms and multipurpose halls, which are used for ecological exhibitions, environmental education, or group activities.
spots.addr: Jinwan Avenue, Honghu City

spots.name: Zhang Juzheng Street
spots.desc: Zhang Juzheng Street is a district focused on food and cultural displays, featuring a range of local snacks and traditional pastries, along with shops from long-established brands. The area includes digital exhibitions, heritage displays, and festival performances such as Sichuan opera face-changing, fish lantern dances, and light shows. It also offers cultural products such as Chu-style…
spots.addr: No. 7, Zhang Juzheng Street, Jingzhou District

spots.name: Jingzhou Fish Cake Festival
spots.desc: Held annually in winter in Gong'an County, the festival showcases the local fish cake industry and culinary traditions. Activities include winter fishing ceremonies, fish cake challenges, "Whole Fish Feast" cooking and tasting events, and Chu-style New Year fairs, offering visitors hands-on food experiences. Gong'an County is recognized as the "Hometown of Fish Cakes in China."

spots.name: Jingzhou Peach Blossom Festival
