spots.name: Shouning Shibi Mountain
spots.desc: Shibi Mountain is located in Shouning County, Ningde City, Fujian Province. It is a typical natural scenic area, renowned for its unique cliffs, rock formations, and rich natural landscapes. The mountain is scattered with unusual rocks, cliffs, and caves, with lush vegetation and picturesque scenery, making it a popular destination for adventure seekers and hikers. The natural beauty here is…

spots.name: Dongji Island, Ningde
spots.desc: Dongji Island is located in Fuding City, Ningde, Fujian Province. It is the easternmost island of mainland China. Due to its unique geographical location, it has become a popular spot for tourists and is an ideal place to watch the sunrise and enjoy the island atmosphere. Dongji Island features pristine natural landscapes, with a fishing village, lighthouse, clear seawater, and abundant marine…

spots.name: Ningde Seaside Park
spots.desc: Ningde Seaside Park is located in the city center of Ningde, and it is a comprehensive park that combines beaches, green spaces, and recreational facilities. It is a popular destination for walking, running, and family gatherings, and also offers an excellent spot for visitors to enjoy the city’s seascape. The park is an ideal place to relax, connect with nature, and enjoy various outdoor…

spots.name: Ningde Yellow Croaker
spots.desc: Ningde has abundant marine resources, and the Yellow Croaker is one of the local specialties. The fish has tender, delicious flesh and is rich in protein, making it a famous seafood delicacy in the region. You can purchase either fresh or dried Yellow Croaker to take home and share with your family.

spots.name: Ningde White Tea
spots.desc: Ningde is one of the important tea-producing areas in Fujian Province, particularly famous for its white tea. Ningde's white teas, such as Zhenghe white tea and Fuding white tea, are highly popular. The tea has a delicate fragrance and is rich in nutrients, making it an ideal gift for health-conscious individuals.

spots.name: Xiapu Shell Crafts
spots.desc: Xiapu is a county under Ningde, known for its rich marine resources. The local shell crafts are very unique, with many artisans creating exquisite jewelry and ornaments from shells. These make perfect souvenirs or small gifts.

spots.name: Yangzhong Mixed Noodles
spots.desc: Yangzhong Mixed Noodles is a traditional snack with distinctive characteristics in the Ningde area, particularly popular in Yangzhong Town and the surrounding regions of Fu'an. This dish is loved by both locals and tourists for its simple yet unique flavor.

spots.name: Fuding Pork Slices
spots.desc: Fuding Pork Slices is a traditional and iconic dish from Fuding, Ningde, Fujian. Made with pork and unique seasonings, it offers a tender and flavorful taste, making it a beloved dish for both locals and visitors, often served at family gatherings and celebrations.

spots.name: Taro Noodles
spots.desc: Taro Noodles is a traditional and locally beloved snack in the Ningde area of Fujian Province, especially popular in Fu'an and its surrounding regions. The dish features taro as the main ingredient, paired with handmade noodles, offering a unique texture and rich flavor.

spots.name: Shouning Rice Cake
spots.desc: Shouning Rice Cake is a traditional specialty snack from Shouning County, Ningde City, Fujian Province. It is loved by locals and tourists alike for its unique texture and flavor. As a traditional rice-based food in Fujian, Shouning Rice Cake has a distinct preparation method and flavor, making it one of the region's iconic dishes.

spots.name: Fuding White Tea
spots.desc: Fuding White Tea is one of the traditional famous teas from Fuding City, Ningde, Fujian Province, known for its delicate fragrance, sweet taste, and unique production process. As one of the six major tea categories in China, Fuding White Tea is carefully produced to preserve the natural flavor of the leaves, making it highly favored by tea enthusiasts and health-conscious individuals.

spots.name: Fuding Black Tea
spots.desc: Fuding Black Tea is one of the traditional famous teas from Ningde City, Fujian Province, known for its unique flavor and high-quality production process. As a type of Chinese black tea, it features a rich aroma and smooth, mellow taste, making it an important representative of tea culture in the Ningde region.

spots.name: Anxi Tie Guan Yin
spots.desc: Anxi Tie Guan Yin is a traditional famous tea from Anxi County, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province, and is one of the most famous oolong teas in the world. Tie Guan Yin is renowned for its unique fragrance, rich flavor, and deep cultural heritage, making it one of the finest teas in China. The name "Tie Guan Yin" is derived from the name of the Bodhisattva Guanyin, symbolizing the tea's miraculous…

spots.name: Unicorn Mountain Park
spots.desc: The park has restaurants, teahouses, Department of photography and the arts and crafts exhibition hall and other service facilities. To the top of the hill cable tramway for hanging chair type scenic cableway, a hanging seat41,82 people can sit. There are mountains roads to the peak.Located in the eastern city, built in the park.

spots.name: Zhou Enlai Memorial Hall
spots.desc: Contains exhibitions about the life and work of Zhou Enlai, one of the most prominent political figures in China during the 20th century.
spots.addr: 2 Yonghuai Road, Huai'an District, Huai'an (淮安市淮安区永怀路2号)

spots.name: Huai'an Government House
spots.desc: This is one of the very few surviving examples in China of a prefecture-level yamen. The complex was first built in 1370 and was restored several times after being damaged by fires.
spots.addr: 38 Dongmen Street, Huai'an District, Huai'an (淮安市淮安区东门大街38号)

spots.name: Zhenhuai Building (old city gate)
spots.desc: The Zhenhuai Building was constructed during the 12th century as a libation hall for the Jin army. In the 19th century, the building was rebuilt and given its present name, which literally means 'building that controls the Huai River', reflecting the fact that flooding of the river was a serious issue at the time. There is a small museum in the building.
spots.addr: 2 Zhenhuai Road East, Huai'an District, Huai'an (淮安市淮安区镇淮楼东路2号)

spots.name: The place where Zhou Enlai studied as a child
spots.desc: This was a family school operated by Zhou Enlai's elder relatives. Zhou Enlai attended classes here with his younger brother and his two younger sisters.
spots.addr: 174 Caoyun Road West, Qinghe District, Huai'an (淮安市清河区漕运西路174号)

spots.name: Huai'an Zoo
spots.desc: This zoo was established in 1958 and moved to the present location in 2012. It has imported animals and native animals.
spots.addr: 198 Jiankang Road West, Qingjiangpu District, Huai'an (淮安市清江浦区健康西路198号)

spots.name: Journey to the West Amusement Park
spots.desc: A major theme park based on the characters and stories in Wu Cheng’’en’s novel, Journey to the West.
spots.hours: 10:00-21:00, ticket office closes at 19:30 sold after 19:30, visitors must enter the gate no later than 20:00
spots.price: Adults ¥280, seniors aged 60 to 69 and children between 1.2 and 1.49 meters in height are charged ¥210, tickets for…
spots.addr: 6 Xiyou Avenue, Huai’an Economic and Technological Development Zone (淮安市经济技术开发区西游大道6号)

spots.name: Xinya Mall
spots.desc: One of the earliest commercial centers in Huai'an, it mainly sells clothing, shoes, hats and daily necessities. It has many local consumers and the prices are relatively affordable. Snack shops often gather around it.

spots.name: Golden Eagle Shopping Mall
spots.desc: The mall is clean and modern, with brands mainly focusing on mid-to-high-end clothing, cosmetics, and boutique retail. The restaurants are relatively refined, with many cafes and light meals. The customer flow is relatively stable, and the overall atmosphere is quieter.

spots.name: Yellow eel Noodles
spots.desc: Yellow eel noodles are a delicious dish commonly found in noodle shops in Huai'an, Baoying, Yangzhou, Zhenjiang and other places in Jiangsu Province, China, where Huaiyang cuisine is popular. Yellow eel is a widely used ingredient in the region, and its preparation is quite experienced and has the effect of nourishing food. Yellow eel noodles made with it are also very popular among local diners.

spots.name: Wenlou soup dumplings
spots.desc: Wenlou soup dumplings are one of the most iconic traditional snacks in Huai'an, originating from the historic Wenlou Restaurant during the late Qing Dynasty. The dumplings feature an extremely thin wrapper filled with rich, flavorful broth and finely minced pork seasoned with scallion and ginger. Diners gently bite open the skin to sip the hot soup before eating the dumpling, often with black…

spots.name: Pingqiao tofu
spots.desc: Pingqiao tofu is a signature dish of Huaiyang cuisine, originating from Pingqiao Town in Huai'an during the Qing Dynasty. It features soft, delicate tofu simmered with shredded chicken, slices of ham, and bamboo shoots in a rich chicken or ham broth. The result is a creamy white soup with a light yet deeply savory flavor, representing the refined balance and gentle freshness that define Huaiyang…

spots.name: Qingong meatballs
spots.desc: Qingong meatballs are a traditional dish from Huai'an, similar in style to Yangzhou’s famous “Lion’s Head” meatballs. They are made from finely minced pork with a balanced fat-to-lean ratio, mixed with diced water chestnuts, eggs, and starch. The mixture is hand-shaped into large balls and gently steamed or braised, resulting in tender, juicy meatballs with rich broth, often served during…

spots.name: Huaian fried noodles twist
spots.desc: Huaian fried noodles twist, known locally as cha san, is a traditional deep-fried snack popular in Huai'an and neighboring regions. Made from hand-rolled dough twisted into fine strands and fried to a golden crisp, it offers a light, crunchy texture. The snack is often served with tea or as a breakfast item, and it also appears in festive offerings. Easy to store and carry, it remains a beloved…

spots.name: Tanggou Wine Industry
spots.desc: Tanggou wine is a special product of Lianyungang. Tanggou wine has a thousand years history and is an intangible cultural heritage of Jiangsu Province. On September 9, 2010, the government established Tanggou Liquor Geographical Reserve. Tanggou liquor company is responsible for the production and sales of Tanggou liquor. Tourists often buy Tanggou liquor to give to their family or friends after…
spots.addr: Tanggou Town, Guannan County (江苏省连云港市灌南县汤沟镇)

spots.name: Lianyungang jiaruibao plaza
spots.desc: This is a large shopping mall. Visitors can shop, entertain, and eat inside. There are many famous brands to choose from in the square. It is also one of Lianyungang's most famous shopping malls.
spots.addr: Zhongshan Road, Lianyungang District

spots.name: Sihong Ancient Xucheng Scenic Area
spots.desc: This is a scenic area full of historical and cultural heritage, where tourists can experience the historical features of the ancient Xu Kingdom.
spots.addr: Ancient Xu City scenic spot, Southern New City, Sihong County

spots.name: The Ancestral Home of Xiang Yu
spots.desc: Xiang Yu's hometown is a good place to learn about the history of the Chu-Han contention. The scenic area includes historical relics such as Xiang Yu Temple, Xiang Yu Statue, and ancient battlefield.
spots.addr: No. 288, Huanghe South Road, Sucheng District

spots.name: Lakeside Park
spots.desc: Located in the center of Suqian City, Lakeside Park is a scenic spot with natural scenery and lakes as its theme. The park has natural landscapes such as lakes and lotus ponds, as well as cultural landscapes such as the lakeside music fountain. It is a good place for citizens to take a leisure walk and ride.
spots.addr: Yingchun Avenue, Hubin New Town, Suyu District

spots.name: Hongze Lake Wetland Park
spots.desc: Hongze Lake Wetland Park, officially known as the Hongze Lake Wetland National Nature Reserve, is located in the southeast of Sihong County, Suqian City, Jiangsu Province, and in the northwest of Hongze Lake. It is the largest freshwater wetland nature reserve in Jiangsu Province and ranks 11th among China's inland freshwater wetlands and 2nd in East China in terms of significance.
spots.addr: Chengtou Village, southeast of Linhuai Town, Sihong County

spots.name: San Tai Mountain Forest Park
spots.desc: Santaishan Forest Park, whose full name is Jiangsu Santaishan National Forest Park, is located in the Hubin New District, on the shore of the beautiful Luoma Lake.
spots.addr: Santaishan Avenue, Suyu District

spots.name: Luoma Lake Tourist Resort

spots.desc: Large complex with Buddhist temples scattered around. There's a dragon cave temple and a combination of older and newer temples dotting the hillside.
spots.addr: 瓯江支流好溪下游

spots.name: Xixi village
spots.desc: The ancient village set more than 1000 years ago. The buildings themselves aren't that old, but walking through the narrow streets certainly makes you think like you're a part of some historical TV drama. It's not a museum though. People are still living there.A really pretty place with unique atmosphere accessible with the city bus. No entrance fee.

spots.name: Guanling Ancient Rd.
spots.desc: An old path through the mountains connecting two villages - Lishan and Guanling. It leads through a bamboo forest, with nice views on surrounding mountains. Both villages are quite picturesque. The trail itself is quite easy and takes around 1 hour to walk between the villages. Reaching the bus stop is quite problematic though (from each village you need to walk additional 3 km). Another choice…

spots.name: Lishui Adventure Island Water World
spots.desc: Huge water park only open during the summer. Top-of-the-line rides purchased from the USA. Dining options available.
spots.hours: varies but usually 10:00-19:00 during June–September. Closed October - May
spots.price: ¥220 for adults, ¥138 for children above 1 meter. Seasonal cards available.
spots.addr: 水阁工业区绿谷大道353号

spots.name: Horse riding (莲城马会)
spots.desc: There are small stables in a park near the river bank. You need to bring your own water/snacks since there are no shops in the area. Prior booking is not necessary.
spots.price: ¥30 for one round or ¥260 for one hour

spots.name: Lishan Advenure Park (利山亲子拓展基地)
spots.desc: Adventure park with obstacles (suspended bridges, wires, ladders etc) suspended 1-2m over the creek. There's no zip wire. It takes 30-40 min to finish the whole route. Obstacles range from very easy to very difficult, requiring a lot of strength. Children have to be at least 120cm tall to be able to participate. There's also a playground for kids with zorbing, swings and a jungle gym.

spots.name: Lishui Grand Theatre
spots.desc: Performing arts theater with live concerts, dance performances and children's shows. National and international artists.
spots.addr: 丽水市人民路处州公园东首

spots.name: Deng Xuxia Massage
spots.desc: Very large massage place with hour-long full-body massage (clothes on) for ¥80 by disabled massage therapists. Also offers acupuncture and other treatments. Staff do not speak English and massages vary in quality but it's clean, cheap and reputable (no mini-skirts here).
spots.addr: 丽水市囿山路597号

spots.name: Baiyun Shan
spots.local: 白云山 - Chinese 'the Mountain of the White Clouds'
spots.desc: Large mountain park in the Northern part of Lishui. Many paved hiking trails with occasional pavilions, providing shelter from rain. Large Buddhist temple at the top. At the foot of the mountain, there is a small museum about rock carving, a large pottery shop and a few stalls and restaurants. Nice place for morning coffee. Access by bus no 1. Just hop on the bus going North and get off at the…

spots.name: Nanming Shan
spots.local: 南明山 - Chinese 'the Mountain of the Southern Brightness'
spots.desc: Mountain south of the city that is popular with locals. There is an old temple, rock carvings, waterfalls, koi fish ponds and an outdoor gym on the top of the mountain with fantastic views of the city. You can reach it by taking bus number 1 South. The mountain is at the very last stop. Free entry.

spots.name: General hiking
spots.desc: Lishui is surrounded by mountains. Most of them could be climbed, despite not being official hiking trails. Easiest access to the mountains is behind the railway station (200 m west from the Station, there is a tunnel). Local villagers grow fruit (tangerines, peaches, mulberries, bayberries) in those mountains, so there are plenty of trails used by farmers. You'll also pass through many old…

spots.name: Wandi Plaza Mall
spots.desc: Very large shopping complex with tons of clothing stories, eateries, cafe, gaming park (3rd and 4th floors) with indoor playgrounds, skating rink and small go-kart area, moving theater and more.

spots.name: Night Market
spots.desc: Market opens in evening hours on the sidewalk along Jiguang Rd. You can usually find cheap clothes, shoes and accessories. You can also buy sugar cane, steamed chestnuts and other fresh fruit. Prices are not given so be prepared to haggle. Merchandise sold at the market usually costs under ¥70.
spots.addr: West from McDonald's along Jiguang St. (继光街)

spots.name: Zhejiang Hotel Supplies
spots.local: 浙江万年红宾馆酒店用品有限公司
spots.desc: This place is some kind of Aladdin's cave of bizarre souvenirs, hotel supplies and kitchenware. It's two stories tall and goes back very, very far, such that it wouldn't be shocking if no customer has seen the whole store. Don't miss the Chinglish signs on the 2nd floor. Prices are shockingly cheap and everything is well marked.
spots.addr: 浙江省丽水市莲都区中山街164-8号

spots.name: Western Plaza
spots.desc: Large plaza with two stories and dozens of restaurants and food stalls. Almost all Chinese food except for two sushi places and an Italian restaurant (corner of the 2nd floor). Very reasonable prices.
spots.addr: 36 Xueyuan Road (学院路36路西城广场)

spots.name: Lishui Vegetarian Restaurant
spots.desc: Vegetarian buffet restaurant. All Chinese options and drinks available too. Very popular around 6pm so get there before or after.
spots.addr: 566 Dangshan Road (囿山路566号)

spots.name: Heart Sushi
spots.desc: Somewhat authentic sushi. Lots of options, including avocado. Picture menu.
spots.addr: 217 Youshan Road (囿山路217号)

spots.name: Wandi Plaza (花园万地广场)
spots.desc: Most good restaurants in Lishui could be found here. Things to try: Beijing duck (北京烤鸭), baked fish (炉鱼), a Thai restaurant (on the 2nd floor) and a restaurant with Xinjiang cuisine.
spots.price: Dinner for 4 people costs anything from ¥120 - 300

spots.name: Xinjiang Cuisine
spots.desc: Wonderful restaurant featuring Xinjiang food, from caramelized sweet potatoes to grilled mutton. Lots of offerings but make sure your phone has a text translator unless you go with someone that can read Chinese. Prices per dish - ¥4-35. There's a decent amount of vegetarian options.
spots.addr: 万地广场4楼020号

spots.name: Sparrow
spots.desc: Large two story restaurant with local specialties, such as lotus porridge and brown sugar dessert. There's a large picture menu that you can select from. Best for large groups. Prices vary from ¥15-50 per dish. Very pretty surroundings in a calm area next to a river offshoot.
spots.addr: 绕城公路 塔下开潭村

spots.name: First Generation
spots.local: 初代宇治抹茶 蛋糕西点
spots.desc: Adorable Japanese-inspired tea and cake place. Three floors of cuteness. Great place to take a date. Prices are relatively high for the area.
spots.addr: 万地广场步行街5-103

spots.name: BeerGo
spots.desc: Restaurant and craft beer joint, frequented by many expats. Sliders, fries, etc. Reasonable prices.
spots.addr: 浙江省丽水市莲都区大猷街27号(洋房餐厅隔壁)

spots.name: Fucheng Cultural Tourism Zone
spots.desc: An historic town best known for its defensive wall, popularly referred to as the Southern Great Wall (江南长城), which is considered a prototype for that in Badaling, Beijing. There is also a small museum about the history of the wall. Note: The coordinates displayed here are for the visitor centre. A bilingual map of the area, can be found on the official website. In Ziyang Old Street (紫阳古街), there…
spots.addr: Linhai City (临海市)

spots.name: Tiantai Mountain
spots.desc: Mount Tiantai used to be known as Dongmeng Mountain. It is a rare box-shaped syncline mountain in China. The whole mountain is roughly in the shape of the English letter U, like a "chair" facing west and east. The mountain is divided into three levels of terraces from low to high: the First Terrace, the Second Terrace, and the Main Terrace, forming three distinctive scenic spots of "one layer of…
spots.addr: Tiantai Mountain Scenic Area, Tiantai County

spots.name: Kokuseiji Temple
spots.desc: The existing buildings of Guoqing Temple were rebuilt in the 12th year of Emperor Yongzheng's reign (1734). Tiantai Guoqing Temple in Zhejiang Province is known as one of the four best temples in China, along with Lingyan Temple in Jinan, Qixia Temple in Nanjing, and Yuquan Temple in Dangyang. Many famous monks have resided in the temple, including Master Yixing of Tang, Hanshan, Shi De, Monk…
spots.addr: Guoqingsi Road, Tiantai County

spots.name: Taizhou Ocean World
spots.desc: Taizhou Ocean World is divided into six floors. It is an aquarium that can be visited from top to bottom. It has more than 10,000 marine creatures and has marine life displays and amusement facilities such as the Tropical Rainforest Hall, Coral Reef Hall, Undersea Tunnel Hall, Ocean Carnival, and Ocean Style Hall. It also offers performances such as mermaids, human-shark dances, and seals. There…
spots.addr: Donghai Avenue, Jiaojiang District

spots.name: God immortal scenic area
spots.desc: Formerly known as Xipoultice Temple Scenic Area, it is located in Xianju National Park, Danzhu Township, Baita Town, Xianju County, Taizhou City, Zhejiang Province. Taizhou Shenxianju Scenic Spot was built in 1998, with a total area of 22.32 square kilometers.
spots.addr: Xianju County,near Juxian Waterfall (near Xianju Scenic Area) (仙居县聚仙瀑附近(仙居风景名胜区附近))

spots.name: Dachen Island
spots.desc: Dachen Island consists of "Upper Dachen Island" (an area of 7 square kilometers) and "Lower Dachen Island" (an area of 4.89 square kilometers), both belonging to the Taizhou Islands. Lower Dachen Island is the garrison of Dachen Town.The forest coverage rate of the island reaches 50%-60%, and it is a provincial Marine forest park. Dachen Island is a legendary and famous island, southeast of…
spots.addr: Dachen Town, Jiaojiang District(椒江区大陈镇)

spots.name: Taizhou Fonte • Wild Mainland
spots.desc: Taizhou Fonte • Wild Mainland is a large-scale theme park created by Huaqiang Fonte with the theme of animation and science fiction, integrating interactive experience, science education, leisure and holiday, dining and shopping. The park uses AR, VR, ball screen, giant screen and other cutting-edge technologies, with the core of Fangte's classic "Boonie Bears" series, the newly launched national…
spots.addr: 1188 Fangda Road, Taizhou Bay New District, Luqiao District(路桥区台州湾新区方特大道1188号)

spots.name: Wenling Changyu Dongtian national scenic spot
spots.local: 温岭长屿硐天国家级风景名胜区
spots.desc: Covering an area of 16.18 square kilometers, Changyu Dongtian Scenic Spot is a stone cultural landscape formed by the quarrying sites of successive dynasties since the Southern and Northern Dynasties. Thousands of years of excavation left 28 groups, 1314 caves, formed a variety of stone wall corridor. It has the only rock cave concert hall in Asia, won the Guinness Book of the world's largest…
spots.addr: Wenling City, south corner of Taizhou Bay(湾南隅温岭市东北)

spots.name: Opium War Relics Park
spots.local: 鸦片战争遗址公园, 竹山公园 Zhushan Park
spots.desc: This park commemorates the history of the First Opium War in Zhoushan. Visitors can explore the park and learn about the area's historical significance. Check local information for current access arrangements before visiting.
spots.addr: 81 Zhushanmen Road, Dinghai District 定海区竹山门路81号

spots.name: Xiaoxixi Seafood Food Stall
spots.desc: A local seafood restaurant serving fresh seafood and Zhoushan-style dishes.
spots.addr: 209-210 Bingang Road

spots.name: CourtYard Gallery
spots.desc: Founded in 1996. Exhibits emerging and mid-career artists working in a wide range of media.
spots.addr: 53 Donganmen Dajie (东安门大街53号; Dōngānméndàjiē)

spots.name: Wan Fung Art Gallery
spots.desc: Worth a peek if you're in the area. Housed in a side building in the courtyard of the Imperial Archives, which you can't go in, but is quite impressive. The courtyard itself is a quiet corner in an otherwise crowded area of the city.
spots.addr: 136 Nanchizi Jie

spots.name: Goldsail Concert Hall
spots.desc: Small concert hall without speakers. Suitable for chamber music also.
spots.addr: 24 Wangfujing Street (24 Wangfujing Street (王府井大街24号; Wángfǔjǐngdàjiē)

spots.name: Hutong Cuisine Cooking School
spots.desc: A few places around Nanluoguxiang now offer Chinese cooking classes. One such place, Hutong Cuisine, is run by an English-speaking chef in a small hutong home. Classes are small. Reservations are necessary. Optional market tours are also conducted before cooking classes commence.
spots.addr: 35 Dengcao Hutong (灯草胡同35号)

spots.name: New China Children's Store
spots.local: 新中国儿童用品商店; Xīnzhōngguóértóngyòngpǐnshāngdiàn
spots.desc: Play center for children where the kids can catch goldfish, play in the gigantic sandpit or other. They also sell all kind of gear for children.
spots.addr: 168 Wangfujing Street (王府井大街168号; Wángfǔjǐngdàjiē)

spots.name: The Malls at Oriental Plaza
spots.local: 东方新天地 Dōngfāng Xīn Tiāndì
spots.desc: At one time this was the largest mall in Asia. Modern shopping mall is expensive but provides you with a lot of buying opportunities from diamonds, to real (affordable) DVDs, (international) music CDs and food. You can find lots of brands in Oriental Plaza, from high-end to low. Besides shopping, you also can eat here, from Western cuisine to traditional Chinese food.
spots.addr: East of Tian'anmen Square, on Wangfujing

spots.name: Poetry Cafe
spots.desc: A beautiful cafe with soul as its name "Poetry", is operated by a lovely young lady, who enjoys travel and photography, that she gathers a group of 'specialists' in those fields; thus, customers can get tonnes of information about travel and photography. Customers can enjoy a view of the Forbidden City over a perfectly brewed coffee.
spots.addr: No 15 Nanchizi street Dongcheng District Beijing (南池子大街15号故宫东华门旁

spots.name: Wangfujing Snack Street
spots.desc: Many stalls selling Beijing-style snacks, both sweet and savoury.

spots.name: Donghuamen Night Market
spots.desc: The place to come for exotic snacks such as scorpions, starfish, and silkworm grubs. You can also buy more typical snacks like fried noodles, dumplings, and kebabs. More expensive than a "real" neighbourhood market, but still reasonably priced.

spots.name: Oriental Dumpling King
spots.desc: Cheap and delicious Dongbei (northeast) style dumplings. This is a chain, one of several around town. Their location in Harbin is recommended in several guidebooks, but if you're not going there you can get the same dumplings in Beijing. A few dozen different kinds, and can be boiled or fried. As with many dumpling places, order by weight: An order is usually two liang (èr liǎng) which is 100g…
spots.addr: 14 Chaoyangmen Nanxiaojie (朝阳门南小街14号楼; Cháoyángménnánxiǎojiē)

spots.name: Donglaishun
spots.desc: This king of Beijing hotpot has been around since 1903. Founded by the Hui (ethnic Muslims), Donglaishun serves halal cuts of top-quality lamb and beef. Also serves cooked-by-chef dishes, including traditional Beijing sweets.
spots.addr: 198 Wangfujing, Dong Dan,

spots.name: Yuxin Sichuan Restaurant
spots.desc: One of the contenders in the ongoing competition for Beijing's best Sichuanese, Yuxin delivers on authenticity, flavor, and service. It's always busy, and always good.

spots.name: Dadong Duck Restaurant
spots.local: 大董烤鸭店 Dàdŏng Kăoyā Diàn
spots.desc: Considered by some to be the best Peking duck in the city, this upscale restaurant also delivers on a nice atmosphere. Reservations suggested. full/half Peking duck is ¥240/120 with extra ¥8 for condiments. Meal is served with free hot water, small soup, light fruits and black sesame for dessert.
spots.price: sea cucumber ¥200-600, lobster from ¥200, +10% service charge
spots.addr: Three locations in Dongcheng district

spots.name: Ritan Park
spots.desc: The park contains the Temple of the Sun with an altar built in 1530 and used for sacrifices to the sun. Great park with entertainment for the children, good cafés and restaurants, plenty of local life to watch and also historical stuff. The altar is a round open space popular for flying kites. If you couldn't get close to the "Echo Wall" at Temple of Heaven due to crowds, you can do the same…
spots.addr: 6 Ritan North Road (日坛北路6号; Rìtán Běilù)

spots.name: China National Film Museum
spots.desc: One of the world's largest film museums, tracing the history of Chinese cinema from the late Qing dynasty to the present day. Features historic cameras, costumes, film memorabilia, reconstructed movie sets and extensive exhibits on major Chinese films and directors.

spots.name: China Science and Technology Museum
spots.desc: China's national science museum, featuring hundreds of hands-on exhibits covering spaceflight, robotics, transportation, physics and information technology. Also contains IMAX and dome theatres and hosts regular temporary exhibitions.

spots.name: China Archaeology Museum
spots.desc: Major national museum showcasing archaeological discoveries from across China, including prehistoric cultures, bronzes, ceramics, tomb artefacts and relics from early Chinese civilizations.

spots.name: China National Arts & Crafts Museum
spots.desc: National museum dedicated to traditional Chinese decorative arts and intangible cultural heritage. Exhibits include jade, lacquerware, embroidery, cloisonné, textiles and masterworks of traditional craftsmanship.

spots.name: Museum of the Communist Party of China
spots.local: 中国共产党历史展览馆
spots.desc: A comprehensive museum on the history of the Communist Party of China and modern Chinese history. Opened in 2021.

spots.name: Red Sandalwood Museum
spots.desc: Founded by collector Chen Lihua, this museum houses one of the world's largest collections of traditional zitan (red sandalwood) furniture, architectural models and decorative arts.

spots.name: China Sports Museum
spots.desc: Museum covering the history of Chinese sport and Olympic participation, with exhibits on major athletes, international competitions and the development of sport in modern China.

spots.name: Art Museum of the Beijing Fine Art Academy
spots.desc: Museum attached to the Beijing Fine Art Academy, known for exhibitions of traditional Chinese painting, calligraphy and works by influential modern masters including Qi Baishi.

spots.name: Ethnic Costume Museum
spots.desc: Specialized museum affiliated with the Beijing Institute of Fashion Technology, displaying traditional costumes, textiles, embroidery, jewelry and ornaments from China's many ethnic groups. Particularly strong for research on ethnic dress and textile traditions. For a broader collection of ethnic artifacts, costumes and historical exhibits, see the Cultural Palace of Nationalities (民族文化宫) near…

spots.name: Museum of Tibetan Culture
spots.desc: Museum dedicated to Tibetan history, religion and culture, with exhibits on traditional art, manuscripts, architecture and daily life across the Tibetan Plateau.

spots.name: National Museum for Modern Chinese Scientists
spots.desc: Highlights the lives and achievements of leading Chinese scientists, engineers and inventors from the late Qing period to the present day.

spots.name: National Museum of Modern Chinese Literature
spots.desc: China's principal museum of modern literature, with exhibits on major twentieth-century writers, original manuscripts, personal belongings and reconstructed studies.

spots.name: China Railway Museum
spots.desc: Museum devoted to the history of China's railways, featuring historic locomotives, railway equipment and exhibits on the development of the country's rail network.

spots.name: UCCA Center for Contemporary Art
spots.desc: China's leading contemporary art museum and the anchor institution of the 798 Art District. Hosts major exhibitions of Chinese and international artists, along with film screenings, talks and educational programmes.

spots.name: Tang Contemporary Art
spots.desc: One of Asia's most prominent commercial contemporary art galleries, exhibiting established and emerging Chinese and international artists.

spots.name: Beijing Commune
spots.desc: Influential gallery representing many of China's leading contemporary artists, with exhibitions often focused on experimental and conceptually driven work.

spots.name: Three Shadows Photography Art Centre
spots.desc: One of China's leading photography institutions, hosting exhibitions, festivals, educational programmes, a library and artist facilities.
spots.addr: 155 Caochangdi

spots.name: Galerie Urs Meile
spots.desc: Established Swiss gallery exhibiting both Chinese and international contemporary artists.
spots.addr: 104 Caochangdi

spots.name: China Art Archives and Warehouse
spots.desc: Influential non-profit contemporary art institution focusing on experimental Chinese art, research and archival work.

spots.name: Century Theater
spots.desc: A long-running performance venue in the Liangmaqiao/Lufthansa Centre area hosting a mix of concerts, theatre, dance, and touring productions. While once especially popular with the expat community, it now serves a broader mainstream audience and continues to operate as a multi-purpose cultural venue.
spots.addr: 40 Liangmaqiao Road (亮马桥路40号; Liàngmǎqiáolù)

spots.name: Chaoyang Theater
spots.desc: One of Beijing’s best-known venues for acrobatics shows, presenting highly polished, tourist-oriented performances with occasional cultural programming such as Peking opera. It remains a staple evening entertainment option in Chaoyang.
spots.hours: Performances typically in the late afternoon and evening
spots.addr: 36 North East Third Ring Road (东三环北路36号; Dōngsānhuán Běilù)

spots.name: China Puppet Theater
spots.local: 中国木偶剧院; Zhōngguó Mù’ǒu Jùyuàn
spots.desc: A dedicated theatre for puppet performances, primarily aimed at children and families. It stages both traditional Chinese stories and adapted Western classics, along with interactive educational shows.
spots.addr: 1 Anhua Xili, East Third Ring Road (东三环安华西里甲1号; Dōngsānhuán Ānhuáxīlǐ)

spots.name: Tuanjiehu Swimming Pool
spots.local: 团结湖游泳池; Tuánjiéhú Yóuyǒngchí
spots.desc: A public swimming complex that operates mainly during the summer months. Facilities typically include indoor/outdoor pools depending on the season and weather conditions. It is a straightforward municipal option rather than a leisure resort-style water park.
spots.addr: 16 Tuanjiehu South Road (团结湖南路16号; Tuánjiéhú Nánlù)

spots.name: Guwan Cheng Antique Market (Ancient Arts City)
spots.desc: A multi-storey indoor antique and collectibles complex positioned slightly upmarket from Panjiayuan. It focuses on ceramics, furniture, calligraphy, and curated “antique-style” pieces. Compared with Panjiayuan’s outdoor flea-market atmosphere, Guwan Cheng is more formal, with greater emphasis on established dealers and higher entry pricing. As always in Beijing’s antiques trade, authenticity…
spots.addr: North of Panjiayuan, East 3rd Ring Road

spots.name: Friendship Store (Jianguomen Branch)
spots.desc: A legacy department store from the early reform era when foreign visitors had restricted retail access. Today it operates as a quiet, fixed-price retail space with mid- to high-end goods. It is no longer a practical shopping destination for value, but remains of historical interest as a symbol of earlier foreign-access retail in Beijing.
spots.addr: CITIC Building, Jianguomenwai Dajie

spots.name: Liangma Flower Market
spots.desc: A large indoor flower and home goods market. The ground floor focuses on cut flowers and plants at low prices, while upper levels sell kitchenware, decorative items, and household goods. It remains one of the better-value casual shopping options in the Lufthansa embassy district.
spots.addr: Behind Kempinski Hotel, Lufthansa Centre area

spots.name: The Place (Shimao Tianjie)
spots.desc: An outdoor commercial complex best known for its massive overhead LED canopy screen, which displays synchronized light shows in the evening. Beyond the visual attraction, it contains mid-range retail shops, cafés, and restaurants.
spots.addr: 9 Guanghua Lu / 光华路9号

spots.name: Side Street Jianguomen
spots.desc: Popular local burger place owned by Indian expat, known for creative burgers and strong value. Widely regarded as one of Beijing’s better casual burger options.

spots.name: Khan Baba
spots.desc: Long-running Pakistani restaurant popular with diplomats, expats and students. Serves kebabs, curries, biryani, naan and other South Asian and Middle Eastern dishes. Service can be slow at peak times.

spots.name: The Middle 8th
spots.desc: Well-known Yunnan restaurant featuring mushroom dishes, grilled fish and regional specialties.

spots.name: Mosto
spots.desc: Modern Mediterranean restaurant with a large terrace and extensive wine list.

spots.name: Home Plate BBQ
spots.desc: Texas-style barbecue and one of Beijing’s long-established expat dining institutions.

spots.name: Turkish Feast
spots.desc: Turkish restaurant serving kebabs, pide, mezze and desserts.

spots.name: Migas Mercado
spots.desc: Spanish tapas and paella restaurant with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the Beijing CBD skyline, including close views of the CCTV Headquarters.
spots.addr: China World Mall

spots.name: Hua's Restaurant
spots.desc: Upscale Beijing cuisine and seafood served in traditional courtyard-style settings.
spots.addr: Various branches

spots.name: Xi He Ya Yuan
spots.desc: Well-known restaurant specializing in Peking duck and refined northern Chinese cuisine.
spots.addr: Ritan area

spots.name: Makye Ame
spots.desc: Tibetan restaurant with traditional décor and occasional cultural performances.
spots.addr: Jianguomenwai area

spots.name: Opera Bombana
spots.desc: Elegant Italian fine dining by chef Umberto Bombana, known for refined tasting menus and high-quality ingredients. One of Beijing’s top upscale Italian restaurants.
spots.addr: Parkview Green Fangcaodi (芳草地)

spots.name: Da Dong
spots.desc: One of Beijing’s most famous Peking duck restaurants. Reservations recommended.
spots.addr: Tuanjiehu and other branches

spots.name: TRB Hutong
spots.desc: Fine dining in a restored historic building near the Forbidden City. Frequently ranked among Beijing’s top special-occasion restaurants.
spots.addr: Shatan North Street

spots.name: Bottega
spots.desc: Upscale Italian restaurant popular with expats and business diners.
spots.addr: Taikoo Li Sanlitun

spots.name: Wall of Khanbaliq
spots.desc: Khanbaliq translates as "the khan's camp"; it was the capital of the Yuan Dynasty. It was a substantial city even in Yuan times (see Marco Polo's late 13th century description), and later grew into Beijing, but nearly all Beijing's important buildings were built by later dynasties.

spots.name: Art Gallery (and Library) of China National Academy of Painting
spots.desc: Besides painting, there's an old Huizhou Building (w:Huizhou,_Anhui#Architecture) moved from Anhui to here. Huizhou is not easy to visit so this may be. Visitors are required to make an appointment before visiting.
spots.addr: 54 Xi San Huan North Road (西三环北路54号)

spots.name: Geological Museum of Peking University
spots.desc: Visitors are required to make a booking before visiting the museum.
spots.addr: 5 Yiheyuan Road (颐和园路5号)

spots.name: Memorial of Famous Generals in the War of Resistance Against Japanese Agression
spots.desc: Dedicated to the Chinese generals who fought the Japanese during World War II. See World War II in China for context.
spots.addr: 18 Xiangshanbeizhenghuangqi (香山北正黄旗18号)

spots.name: Purple Bamboo Park
spots.desc: One of the larger parks in Beijing, this is centered around three lakes. As the name indicates, there is an outstanding variety of bamboo groves here. A superb place for a stroll and, since it's a favorite spot for locals to relax and exercise, a splendid opportunity to get away from the tourist draws and experience ordinary life in Beijing.
spots.addr: 45 Baishiqiao Road (白石桥路45号 Báishíqiáolù)

spots.name: Nanchanghe Trail East
spots.desc: Not connected to the west section - break at the Beijing-Kalgan high speed railway

spots.name: Nanchanghe Trail West
spots.desc: Not connected to the east section - break at the Beijing-Kalgan high speed railway

spots.name: Sujiatou III and IV village
spots.desc: A typical northern Chinese village reminiscent of the 1980s. Not recommended unless you have a "special interest" in it. The villagers are expecting that the village can be demolished in the near future.

spots.name: Changlecun
spots.desc: A typical Haidian pond village. Not recommended unless you have a special interest in it.

spots.name: Tour the University District
spots.desc: Peking and Tsinghua universities are the two most prestigious in China, and have attractive campuses next to one another at the center of Beijing's university district. Limited tickets are available for the public to visit the campuses on weekends and summer holidays, but must be reserved in advance; like with any other tourist attractions in China, tickets are tied to your ID, so do not buy…

spots.name: Haidian Theater

spots.name: Mei Lanfang's Residence

Sunday masses in Chinese are held early in the morning (06:00, 07:00, and 08:30), offering the experience to hear the local faithful chanting Christian prayers in Chinese, as they have been for centuries. English masses (10:30 and 15:00) and an Italian mass (12:30) are popular with foreigners.

The scenic spot covers a total area of ​​about 274 acres. The internal exhibitions in the scenic area are divided into seven parts: the river history display, the government culture display, the official culture display, the ancient building…

spots.name: The ruins of Langyin Tower in Ming Dynasty
spots.desc: Cangzhou Langyin Tower was built during the Qianlong period of the Qing Dynasty. It is a traditional cultural building with a long history. This building is an important place for the cultural life of the people in Cangzhou City and an important platform for music and art exchanges in the Cangzhou region. Langyin Tower has a unique architectural style and exquisite structure. The roof is covered…

spots.name: 纪晓岚墓

Above it is a sealing earth. The sealing earth is 5 meters high and 10 meters in diameter at the bottom. It is in the shape of a hemisphere and covers an area of ​​about 80 square meters. In front of the tomb stands a stele given by…

It is the first salt industry museum in Hebei Province and the most informative museum among the Chinese Salt Industry Museums. The museum uses salt industry materials from all over China as its basic display content, supported by a variety of high-tech technical means…

spots.name: Lotus Pond Park
spots.desc: This is an important scenic spot in Cangzhou City. The lotus pond has rippling blue waves and blooming lotus flowers. It is a good place for citizens to relax and have fun. You can take a stroll here to enjoy flowers and feel the freshness and tranquility of nature.

spots.name: Nanhu Park

It is the largest natural water area in Cangzhou City, covering an area of ​​13 hectares. There are patches of reeds in the lake, an island in the lake, thick trees and flocks of birds. According to incomplete statistics, the island in the center of the lake is home to more than 10 rare birds…

The features of the park include Celebrity Avenue, Landscape Greenhouse, Hall of Fame, etc. There are 20 groups of bronze sculptures of Cangzhou historical celebrities on both sides of the Celebrity Avenue. The…

spots.desc: The World Geopark is famous for its canyon landscapes such as Hongshi Gorge and Tanpu Gorge, where mountains and water complement each other and are suitable for all seasons.
spots.addr: Anshang Township, Xiuwu County, Jiaozuo City, Henan Province

spots.name: Qinglongxia Scenic Area
spots.desc: This scenic area is centered around the Fenglinxia Reservoir. It is part of Yuntai Mountain, but has its own entrance and management area. The area's most prominent feature is its dam, which stands over 100 meters high. The standard visit involves taking a shuttle bus to the top of the dam, after which visitors can choose to either take a boat tour on the reservoir or walk down along the hiking…

spots.name: Zhu Zaiyu Memorial Hall
spots.desc: Zhu Zaiyu Memorial Hall is housed in a Ming-Qing courtyard that used to be part of the Zheng Princely Mansion's music office, where Zhu Zaiyu and his father studied music theory. Opened as a memorial in 1991, it is a National Key Cultural Relic Protection Unit and a AA-level scenic spot. Zhu Zaiyu (1536–1611), a Ming dynasty prince and polymath, was the first in the world to devise the…
spots.addr: No. 1 Xue Street, Beisi Street, Qinyang

spots.name: jingyingdaxiagu
spots.desc: Located in the Yuntai Mountain World Geopark, this canyon is known for its red cliff and danxia landforms, clear streams, and the 1,500-year-old Jingying Temple. The area is a popular summer retreat with an average temperature of around 20°C.
spots.price: ¥40 (students half price; free for seniors over 70 and children under 1.2 m)
spots.addr: Xicun Township, Xiuwu County

spots.name: Fenglin Gorge
spots.desc: Also known as "Yuntai Tianchi" (Yuntai Sky Lake), this scenic area is famous for its emerald lake, canyon landscapes, and boat tours. It is part of the Yuntai Mountain World Geopark and offers a quieter alternative to the main Yuntai Mountain zones. It shares the visitor center with Qinglong Gorge.
spots.price: 60 yuan (online discounts available); sightseeing bus ¥30; boat tour ¥35
spots.addr: Shuangmiao Village, Xicun Township, Xiuwu County

spots.name: Huaifu Dinosaur Par
spots.desc: A dinosaur-themed amusement park opened in 2025, featuring a dinosaur museum, flight theater, and nearly 30 large rides across 9 functional zones. Suitable for families with children.
spots.addr: Jianshe South Road, Qinyuan Subdistrict, Qinyang

spots.name: Shennong Pottery Cultural Creative Park
spots.desc: A cultural park dedicated to black pottery (Heitao), featuring a pottery museum, DIY wheel-throwing workshop, pottery-making experience center, and archaeological excavation activities. It combines intangible cultural heritage with tourism and education.
spots.addr: Gouzhuangtun Village, Wangzhao Township, Qinyang

spots.name: Xunfan Yuantong Temple
spots.desc: A Buddhist temple known for its minimalist white walls and Tang-style architecture. The main highlight is the large Guanyin statue. The site is suitable for a quiet walk or photography. Entry is free. Allow about 1 hour for a visit.
spots.addr: Xunfan Village, Shanyang District

spots.name: Mogou Village
spots.desc: A traditional village known for its cave dwellings (yaodong) and rural charm. It has been renovated into a tourism destination that preserves the local “old home” atmosphere. Visitors can see the Ming and Qing dynasty cave houses, visit a library built inside a cave, and take a small sightseeing train around the village.
spots.addr: Xiguo Town, Mengzhou

spots.name: Jiaozuo People's Park
spots.desc: The city's oldest comprehensive park, it includes a zoo (with Siberian tigers, African lions, etc.), an amusement park (with over 100 kinds of water, land, and air attractions), and a scenic lake. With flowers blooming year-round, it's a great spot for strolls and flower viewing, and you can also walk across the suspension bridge and admire the holiday sculptures.

spots.name: Jiaozuo Fengshan National Mining Park
spots.local: 焦作缝山国家矿山公园
spots.desc: A former limestone quarry transformed into a mining heritage park, with a 20-meter-tall stainless steel needle sculpture on the peak symbolizing the "healing" of the mountain. The park covers a large area with several distinct spots, including a lake, a cliffside waterfall, a valley garden, and paved walking trails that wind up to the summit. It is a popular place for local hiking, morning…

spots.name: Maocha Village
spots.desc: A rural micro-vacation village in the hills of Jiefang District, featuring boutique homestays, a popular countryside café ("Xiangxia de Shenghuo"), and a petting farm. It combines rural landscapes with modern leisure facilities, making it a popular weekend escape from the city.
spots.addr: Shangbaizuo Subdistrict, Jiefang District

spots.name: Dananpo Village
spots.desc: A former "hollow village" transformed through art and rural revitalization. It features the Fangsuo Bookstore (in a renovated old opera stage), Bishan Workshop store, art exhibition spaces, and traditional Huai Bang opera performances. The village has become a model for cultural tourism in rural China.
spots.addr: Xicun Township

spots.name: Yuntai Mountain Canyoning
spots.desc: A canyoning experience through the original streams of Yuntai Mountain. Participants climb, jump, and slide down natural pools along an 800-meter route through waterfalls and rock walls.
spots.addr: Xiuwu County

spots.name: Jiaozuo Film and Television City
spots.desc: A large film and television production base built in the styles of the Spring and Autumn, Warring States, and Three Kingdoms periods. Visitors can explore the ancient streets, city gates, and palaces where historical dramas were filmed. There are also interactive activities on site, such as archery and traditional performances, making it a popular spot for both sightseeing and photography.
spots.addr: Puji Road, Jiefang District

spots.name: Fengshanzhen Park
spots.desc: A former limestone quarry transformed into a unique mining heritage park. Its most striking feature is a 20-meter-tall stainless steel sculpture shaped like a giant surgical needle, sitting on the peak at an altitude of 327 meters. The sculpture symbolizes the "healing" of the mountain after years of mining damage. The park includes scenic spots like Xizi Lake, a cliff waterfall, and a valley…
spots.addr: North of the city, Jiefang District

spots.name: Wanda Plaza
spots.desc: Jiaozuo's most famous and popular one-stop shopping center. It integrates international fashion, trendy clothing, a large supermarket (Wanda Yonghui Supermarket), children's entertainment, a high-end cinema (Wanda Cinema), and numerous catering brands.
spots.addr: Southeast corner of Fengshou Road and Minzhu South Road, Jiefang District

spots.name: Dennis
spots.desc: This is a local retail giant in Henan Province, with multiple branches in Jiaozuo. It offers a complete range of goods, from daily necessities to clothing and home appliances, and is usually integrated with large supermarkets, making it very affordable and convenient.
spots.addr: 558 Tanan Road, Shanyang District

spots.name: Xinya Commercial Building
spots.desc: Opened in 1993, Xinya Commercial Building is one of Jiaozuo's oldest department stores. After a full renovation in 2019, it expanded to about 40,000 square meters and now includes a shopping mall, supermarket, cinema, food court, and a themed hotel. It is located in the heart of the old commercial district, adjacent to the city's traditional shopping area.
spots.addr: No. 137 Jiefang Middle Road, Jiefang District

spots.name: Dong's Donkey Meat
spots.desc: This restaurant specializes in Huai Fu braised donkey meat. Their donkey meat is braised in a secret broth until tender and juicy, making it a highly recommended choice for locals to try this specialty dish.

spots.name: Wang's Noodle Soup
spots.desc: A noodle shop specializing in fermented noodle soup, which has been operating in the liberated area for many years, focuses on this local specialty snack.

spots.name: Wuzhi Clay Pot
spots.desc: A traditional dish from Wuzhi County that is available in many local restaurants. Meat is simmered in a clay pot over low heat until tender and flavorful. Before serving, hot chili oil is poured over the pot, creating a sizzling sound and a rich aroma. It is a signature dish of Jiaozuo's Yellow River culture.
spots.addr: Wuzhi County

spots.name: Majia Daye Beef Noodles
spots.desc: A famous beef noodle shop in Jiaozuo, originating from the Huaiqing Prefecture's Qinghua Suzha village. The broth is clear and rich, and the noodles are smooth and chewy. The dish is known for its "one clear, two white, three green, four red, five yellow" presentation.
spots.addr: Multiple branches in Jiefang District, Shanyang District

spots.name: Jiang's Doumo
spots.desc: A century-old breakfast shop, now in its fifth generation. Doumo is a thick porridge-like soup made from millet, peanuts, soybeans, sesame, and vegetables. The shop was recognized as a Jiaozuo Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2010.
spots.addr: Lieshi West Street, Jiefang District

spots.name: Bo'ai Assorted Stew
spots.desc: A traditional Bo'ai dish made with over ten ingredients including pork skin, fried tofu, and meatballs, simmered together in a rich meat broth. It is a representative dish of Jiaozuo's local cuisine that is available in local restaurants.
spots.addr: Bo'ai County

spots.name: Mengzhou Hunjiang Liangfen
spots.desc: A unique cold noodle dish from Mengzhou, made from fermented mung bean paste. It has a distinctive tangy flavor and a cool, smooth texture. It is typically served with mustard, garlic, and chili oil. It is available in local snack shops.
spots.addr: Mengzhou

spots.name: Four Huai Medicines Banquet
spots.desc: A unique banquet centered on the "Four Huai Medicines" (四大怀药) — yam, achyranthes, rehmannia, and chrysanthemum. A representative dish is Sima Huaifu Chicken (司马怀府鸡), made with local Tiegun yam and free-range chicken, historically associated with Sima Yi.
spots.addr: Wen County

spots.name: Wuliyuan Century Eggs
spots.desc: A specialty from Wuliyuan Township in Xiuwu County. These century eggs are made using local water from the Yuntai Mountain area, giving them a distinctive flavor. They are a popular local delicacy.
spots.addr: Wuliyuan Township, Xiuwu County

spots.name: Macun Roast Chicken
spots.desc: A traditional roast chicken from Macun District. The chicken is cooked until tender with a rich, savory flavor. It is a popular local food item and a good gift for friends and family.
spots.addr: Macun District

spots.name: Chenjiagou Vegetarian Meals
spots.desc: A vegetarian meal experience near the Taiji birthplace, focusing on simple, balanced dishes made with local vegetables and tofu. The food is prepared in a light, health-conscious style that reflects the principles of Tai Chi. Prices are usually quite low, making it a good option for a casual lunch after visiting the Tai Chi Ancestral Hall.

spots.name: Youcha
spots.desc: A traditional savory porridge-like drink made from roasted flour, peanuts, and sesame. Despite the name, it's a thick, warming soup rather than tea. It has over 2,000 years of history and is a provincial-level intangible cultural heritage of Henan. Look for local snack shops or street vendors selling traditional oil tea.
spots.addr: Wuzhi County

spots.name: Huaichuan Yuye
spots.desc: A yam-based qingxiang (light aroma) baijiu produced by Henan Laohuai Yam Wine Co., Ltd. It uses local Tiegun yam and sorghum as raw materials, fermented in earthen jars with a "three-steaming, three-distilling" process. The company spent 12 years developing this new category of yam qingxiang baijiu, which was launched in 2021. Produced by Henan Laohuai Yam Wine Co., Ltd. Available at restaurants…
spots.addr: Huaiqing Road, Qinyang

spots.name: Dongning Temple
spots.desc: (东宁寺）covers an area of eighteen acres, with majestic buildings, including the Mountain Gate Buddha Hall, Thousand-handed Guanyin Hall, Zunti Bodhisattva Hall, Twelve Old Mothers Hall, Ancestor's Hall, Jade Emperor Hall, and Buddha Zun Pagoda. Buddha Pagoda is the main building of the temple, which is seven stories and twenty-six meters high.
spots.addr: South Ring Road, Hongqi District

spots.name: Guandi Temple
spots.desc: A provincial-level cultural relic protection site originally built during the Yuan Dynasty, nearly 700 years ago. The temple was once dedicated to both Guan Yu and Yue Fei. It features well-preserved Ming and Qing architecture, including a theater tower, worship hall, and main hall. The main hall's roof is decorated with colorful glazed tiles and a rare green-glazed lion. Free to visit and less…
spots.addr: 53 Dongdajie, Hongqi District

spots.name: Wanxianshan Scenic Area
spots.desc: This area in the Taihang mountains on the border with Shanxi features a valley encircled by more than 100m high sandstone cliffs and is protected as a national geological park and national forest park. Atop the cliffs sit small villages, and above those villages are even higher limestone cliffs. The villages in the area, including Guoliang, are made from slabs of this stone held together with…

spots.name: Guanshan Geopark
spots.desc: (关山地质公园） is located at the curved turn end of the South Taihang Mountains. Represented by Red Stone Gorge and Stone Pillar Forest, it is called " The First Landslide Wonders", which combines the water landscape of South Taihang and the unique geological landform of landslide peak forests, with waterfalls and springs, clear pools, stone wonders, groups of pillars, peak forests, and the sea of…
spots.addr: Shangbali Town, Huixian

spots.name: Qiu Gully Scenic Spot
spots.desc: （秋沟风景区） is located in Nanzhai Town, Huixian County, Xinxiang City. It covers an area of 24 square kilometers. It is called "natural zoo" because of dozens of wild animals and birds such as rhesus monkeys, money leopards and wild badgers. There are a large number of ancient marine plant and animal fossils, natural stone tanks, ice caves and other landscapes in the Qiu Gully. It is a good place for…
spots.addr: Nanzhai Town, Huixian

spots.name: Tianzhugou Grand Canyon
spots.desc: （天柱沟大峡谷）is located in Huixian County, Xinxiang. The scenery is beautiful, and you can experience the nature's ingenious work. You can see the broken rock layers formed by crustal fracture and plate rise in the ancient times, the mountains are majestic and magnificent, the vegetation coverage is high, and the streams are crystal clear. Rafting is also available.

spots.name: Guo Liang Village
spots.desc: （郭亮村） is located in the midst of the Taihang Mountains' walled canyons. There is the famous Hanging Wall Highway, which is also the only road leading to Guo Liang Village. Walking in Guo Liang Village, it is as if you have entered the world of stone, everywhere you can see stone mills, stone mills, stone alleys, stone tables, and even stone bowls, stone chopsticks, stone axes, stone hoes, it…
spots.addr: Shayao Town, Huixian

spots.name: Baligou Scenic Area
spots.desc: （八里沟）is located in Bali Town, Hui County, Xinxiang City. There are five main scenic spots: Peach Blossom Bay, Red Rock River, Rhesus Monkey Area, Jade Palace, and Sheep Chau Land. Among them, Baligou waterfall is magnificent, known as "Taihang Heavenly Waterfall". The Red Stone River, with its blue water, red and green colors, is known as "Taihang Heavenly River" because of its altitude of 1700…

spots.name: Xiangyun Observation Platform
spots.desc: A glass-bottom observation platform - actually kind of a ferrata, since there's no railing and instead one is attached to the footpath side by a wire. Provides unusual view of the valley/water reservoir underneath, and is not for the faint-hearted.

spots.name: Baoquan Tourist Area
spots.desc: A 5A-level scenic spot known as the "Taihang Water World". It consists of the Grand Canyon and the Cliff World. The Grand Canyon features spectacular waterfalls and clear pools, while the Cliff World offers thrilling cliff-side activities and views over the Taihang Mountains.
spots.addr: Bobi Town, Huixian

spots.name: Huilong Tianjie Mountain
spots.desc: A 4A-level scenic area in the southern Taihang Mountains, part of the Wanxian Mountain complex. It is famous for the Huilong Cliff-Hanging Road (a tunnel carved by hand through the cliff) and the 360-degree cliff walkway. Key sights include the Dragon Chant Gorge with its pools and waterfalls, and Laoyeding Peak (1,570m), known as the "Iron Summit" of Taoism. It is also the site associated with…
spots.addr: Shangbali Town, Huixian

spots.name: Bigan Temple
spots.desc: (比干庙), North end of Bigan Avenue, Bigan Village, Weihui City. Summer 8:00-19:00; winter 8:30-17:30. The temple of Bigan Temple is located in the north and faces south, covering an area of more than 400 acres. The main buildings are Bigan Temple Square, Bigan Wealth and Culture Square, Danxin Square, God's Way, Changfu Square, the wall, the gate, the door, the wooden square, the monument corridor…

spots.name: Tongmeng Ancient Town Yuanjia Village
spots.desc: （同盟古镇袁家村） is located in Huojia County. It is a good place in the downtown around Xinxiang. The scenery is good with few people. It is a combination of Suzhou Garden and the water town of Jiangnan. You can sip tea and tease your dog, and enjoy your leisure. The ancient town has delicious specialty snacks, fun entertainment facilities. Although the ancient town only three streets are enough to…
spots.addr: Kangcun Town, Huojia County

spots.name: DL
spots.desc: (胖东来） As a famous landmark in Xinxiang. In this building facility, there are many Xinxiang special snacks. Locals like to meet and eat here.And because of its humanized service facilities, it is liked by many people in many places.The doll machine inside the DL is particularly easy to operate. You can catch a lot of dolls for a small amount of money.

spots.name: Xidajie
spots.desc: （西大街）is a famous snack night stall street in Xinxiang. At about 00:00, it is the time when the flow of people is the highest. This place is very popular with young people. It consists of different small food carts inside. There is a rich variety of food and the repetition rate of the food sold is low. There are a lot of Xinxiang specialty snacks and some Southeast Asian food. Of course, there are…

spots.name: Oriental Walking Street
spots.desc: （东方步行街）.If you like to shop in specialty style clothing stores, or make crafts, you are welcome to come here. There are many antique clothing stores in the Oriental Walking Street. Here you can feel Gothic style, rock style, American retro, new Chinese style and many other style elements of clothing stores. There are also handmade shops that make mobile phone cases and wallets by yourself.

spots.name: Yiyuan
spots.desc: (怡园）is not a building, it's an area. In this area, there are many coffee shops with special decoration and unique coffee taste. There are also old bookstores. Due to the retro style of the Yiyuan, here, you can feel the feeling of the 1980s in Xinxiang, a comfortable sense of time and space slowing down. Perfect for visitors to enjoy a nice afternoon tea time here.

spots.name: Municipal Plaza
spots.desc: A square for residential sports activities. If you like throwing frisbee sport, this is the best place for you. This square was built by the government organization, which provides people with oversized activity sites. Here you can dance with your aunties. You can also fly kites. You can also play tai chi with the uncles. Of course, any sports activities that won't hurt others can be done here.

spots.name: Dingguo Lake Park
spots.desc: （定国湖公园） is a man-made lake park in Xinxiang. Its total area is 41.75 hectares. Free entry and exit. Here is not only a good place to enjoy the beach lake view, but also a best place to enjoy the sunset. Take a stroll in the evening breeze, sit on the Fisherman's Wharf in Dingguo Lake Park, drink coffee and watch the sunset. It's a good place to relax.

spots.name: Xinxiang Flower Market
spots.desc: （花卉市场） is a base for selling flowers, birds and fish. It is composed of various small shops, because it is a professional flower seller, so here, you can also see a lot of flowers that cannot be grown in the local climate. If you like to look at flowers, you can come here and stroll around. And the price of flowers here is very low, and can be matched arbitrarily, very suitable for tourists who…

spots.name: Muye Park
spots.desc: A popular city park in Xinxiang, known for its greenery and walking paths. It is a good spot for a relaxing stroll, with a lake and open areas for families and locals. Free entry and convenient bus access.
spots.addr: 532 Pingyuan Road, Hongqi District

spots.name: Xinxiang Lantern Festival Folk Performance
spots.local: 新乡市元宵节非物质文化遗产民俗展演
spots.desc: Xinxiang's largest annual folk culture event, held on the Lantern Festival. The 2026 edition featured over 15 intangible cultural heritage performances including the Huoshen Drum, Henan Zhuizi, Dapingdiao, and Huai Bang martial arts. County-level activities run simultaneously across Xinxiang, including Long Shi (dragon and lion) dances in Weihui, traditional lantern displays in Changyuan, and the…
spots.addr: South Square of Xinxiang Municipal Government, Weibin District

spots.name: White Egret Island National Urban Wetland Park
spots.desc: Because it is close to the city center, it has become a relaxing and entertainment destination for most Pingdingshan people, offering beautiful scenery where you can experience the essence of nature. You can go by bike or bus.
spots.addr: Xin Hua District Xi GaoHuang street Jian She Road West Segment

spots.name: Bai Gui Lake National Wetland Park
spots.desc: Bai Gui Lake is Pingdingshan City's largest artificial reservoir, boasting picturesque lakeside scenery and a natural ecological environment. Camping here is also a daily activity for many locals, and cycling by the lake is also a great option.
spots.addr: Xin Cheng District Qingfeng Road

spots.name: Ping Ding mountain
spots.desc: Pingdingshan, as a city, is named after this mountain. As the name suggests, the summit of this mountain is flat. You can hike or hike up the mountain, offering a panoramic view of the entire city.
spots.addr: Waidong District

spots.name: Xiangshan Pumen Zen Temple
spots.local: 香山寺大悲观音大士塔及碑刻
spots.desc: The temple was founded in the fourth year of Guanghe during the Eastern Han Dynasty (181) and is one of China's early Buddhist temples, revered as a holy site for Guanyin Bodhisattvas to attain enlightenment.At the start of the new year, locals flock to light the first incense stick of the year to pray for good fortune.
spots.addr: Xin Hua District Daxiangshan Road

spots.name: Fengxue Temple
spots.desc: Fengxue Temple was founded in the first year of the Eastern Han Dynasty (circa 190 AD) and has a history of over 1800 years, making it one of China's oldest Buddhist temples.Many scenes in the movie "Shaolin Temple" were actually filmed at Fengxue Temple, not at Shaolin Temple. This is mainly due to the severe destruction of Shaolin Temple, while Fengxue Temple is relatively well-preserved.
spots.addr: No. 985 Fengxue Road, Ruzhou City

spots.name: Eagle City Square
spots.desc: is a fairly new city square and will be one of the largest in the province. It features a large, musical fountain with a giant megatron presiding overhead. Also, some classical Chinese waterway structures, a Greek-style outdoor theater and a few hills and ponds. In the evenings you can listen to the locals perform folk songs or maybe some Henan opera. There's also a drum troupe that comes once a…
spots.addr: Near the intersection of JianShe Road and Guangming Road

spots.name: Riverside Park
spots.desc: This is the main venue for leisure and entertainment in Pingdingshan's daily life, featuring small amusement parks and zoos with various garden designs of different sizes, making it a great place for leisurely walks.
spots.addr: Intersection of Huishun Road and Yaxing Road

spots.name: Yao Mountain Grand Canyon Rafting
spots.desc: Due to its seasonal nature, it is only open from May to October. The watershed features numerous rapids and deep ponds dotted with flat lakes, with rivers varying in width and narrowness, making it an ideal destination for rafting.If you enjoy thrilling experiences, rafting will provide you with an excellent experience.
spots.addr: Yaoshan Town, Xiaping Village, Lushan County

spots.name: Yao Mountain TianHe Rafting
spots.desc: Like Grand Canyon rafting, the difference is that it's cheaper here, but the experience will be different, so you can choose whoever you like.
spots.addr: Yaoshan Town, Xiaping Village, Lushan County

spots.name: Bao Feng Ma Street Shu Hui (National Intangible Cultural Heritage)
spots.desc: It is one of China's largest and oldest folk art festivals, known as the "Holy Land of Storytellers." National storytellers gathered, performing a variety of songs including storytelling, quick board, large drums, and Taoist sentiments on stage.But there is a temporal aspect to it, starting around the 13th day of the first lunar month each year.
spots.addr: Baofeng County Majie Village

spots.name: Yao Mountain Highland Rhododendron Festival
spots.desc: In spring, rhododendrons bloom in a sea of flowers, with pink, red, and purple intertwining across the mountains. They frequently host mountain climbing, photography exhibitions, and flower sea hikes, making them the most influential natural landscape festival of Pingdingshan's spring.Held in April each year, it is necessary to plan your itinerary in advance as it is farther from the city center.
spots.addr: Lushan County Yaoshan Scenic Area

spots.name: Yao Mountain Ice and Snow Festival
spots.desc: From December to February, there are many ice and snow activities here, including skiing, snowmobile racing, children's ice and snow amusement parks, as well as ice sculpture exhibitions and winter folk events.It's perfect for playing with kids.
spots.addr: Yao Mountain Ski Resort

spots.name: Wanda
spots.desc: Wanda Square is a comprehensive shopping center that integrates shopping, leisure, entertainment, and dining. It meets all your needs for eating, drinking, and having fun, so if you feel bored and have nowhere else to go, it is highly recommended that you visit.
spots.addr: The intersection of Jianshe Road and Chengpu Road

spots.name: ZhongJun
spots.desc: Similar to Wanda Square, but built later than Wanda Plaza, and with updated internal facilities, it and Wanda Square are in the eastern part of the city, making them suitable for shopping needs at both ends of the city.
spots.addr: The intersection of HeShun Road and Lingyun Road

spots.name: Denis department store
spots.desc: The earliest comprehensive department store in Pingdingshan is located in the heart of the city center, but it was established relatively early, offering a shopping experience that isn't as enjoyable as Wanda and Zhongjun, though it's still a great place to visit.
spots.addr: Zhanhe District, Kaiyuan Road

spots.name: Nanwan lake
spots.desc: With a history of more than 1,500 years, in the Nanwan Lake scenic area, you can boating, you can also enjoy the beauty of the waterfall.
spots.addr: No. 188 Nanwan St, Shihe District

spots.name: Guishan Pavilion
spots.desc: It is one of the new eight sceneries in Xinyang, located on the bank of the Shihe River. Guishan Pavilion is quite rich in Jiangnan garden style. Commanding position, ascend to look up, both sides of the scenery panoramic view.

spots.name: Guo State Museum
spots.desc: The state of Guo was a vassal state of the Zhou Dynasty. This is the largest comprehensive museum dedicated to the state of Guo and has an extensive collection of artefacts. Highlights includes items unearthed from the royal tombs and an actual burial pit containing the remains of dozens of horses and chariots.
spots.addr: Liufeng North Road, Hubin District (湖滨区六峰北路)

spots.name: Swan Lake Wetland Park
spots.desc: Swan Lake (Qinglong Lake) is located west of National Highway 209 and east of Qinglong Dam, with a water area of 2,070 mu (138 ha). Every October, tens of thousands of white swans migrate from distant Siberia to live and overwinter here. On the sparkling lake surface of the scenic area, thousands of white swans fly freely, play together peacefully and gracefully, caress each other tenderly, comb…
spots.addr: West side of Canglongjian River Bridge on Shanzhou Avenue, Shanzhou District

spots.name: Shanzhou Silo-Cave
spots.desc: Shanzhou troglodyte houses have a long history. The Book of Rites states: "In winter, they live in caves, and in summer, they live in cypress nests." "Caves" are a type of underground house. The earliest way of living for humans was cave dwellings, which is also the earliest form of cave dwellings. Shanzhou troglodyte houses have witnessed the development and evolution of cave dwellings. Cave…
spots.addr: Beiying Village, Zhangbian Township, Shanzhou District

spots.name: Yangshaoxianmen Mountain Scenic Area
spots.desc: Yangshao Xianmen Mountain Scenic Area is a characteristic "wine culture and tourism" scenic area developed by Henan Yangshao Tourism Development Co., Ltd. The scenic area is centered on Yangshao culture and Yangshao wine brewing as the main line. It is a large-scale comprehensive tourist attraction integrating tourism, cultural display, catering and accommodation, leisure and vacation, science…
spots.addr: Mianchi County

spots.name: Lingbao Fudi Mountain
spots.desc: Located in Lingbao, Fudi Mountain is known for its Taoist temples and beautiful natural surroundings. It offers scenic hikes and a peaceful atmosphere for visitors interested in both nature and ancient religious sites.

spots.name: Sanmenxia Sports Center
spots.desc: The Sanmenxia Sports Center is a large facility offering a variety of sports activities, including swimming, tennis, and fitness. It's a great place to enjoy some physical activity or relax in its modern amenities.

spots.name: Sanmenxia Shopping Mall
spots.desc: A modern shopping complex with a variety of local and international brands. Great for buying clothes, electronics, and daily necessities.
spots.addr: Heping East Road, Hubin District

spots.name: Local Markets
spots.desc: For a more traditional shopping experience, visit the local markets in the city center, offering a range of local products, snacks, and crafts.

spots.name: Yellow River Souvenirs
spots.desc: Look for items related to the Yellow River, such as artwork, handmade crafts, and locally produced food items.

spots.name: Great Mountain Forest Park

spots.name: Yunmeng Mountain
