spots.name: Taihe Ancient Cave
spots.local: 太和古洞; Taihe Ancient Cave Scenic Area
spots.desc: A cave and mountain scenic area in Taihe Town, suitable for visitors interested in caves, mountain scenery and walking.
spots.addr: Taihe Town, Qingxin District, Qingyuan, Guangdong

spots.name: Lianzhou Underground River
spots.local: 连州地下河; Lianzhou Underground River Scenic Area
spots.desc: A large karst cave system containing an underground river. The attraction is one of the major natural attractions in northern Qingyuan.
spots.price: About ¥120; check the current price before visiting
spots.addr: Dadong Village, Dongpi Town, Lianzhou, Qingyuan, Guangdong

spots.name: Dongtian Xianjing
spots.local: 洞天仙境; Yingxi Fenglin Dongtian Scenic Area
spots.desc: A karst landscape attraction with caves, cliffs and a natural opening through the mountain.
spots.addr: Jiulong Town, Yingde, Qingyuan, Guangdong

spots.name: Huangchuan Three Gorges
spots.desc: A scenic gorge system on the Lianjiang River. Boat trips and river scenery are among the main reasons to visit.
spots.addr: Longtan Village, Jiubei Town, Lianzhou, Qingyuan, Guangdong

spots.name: Qingxin Hezhong Hot Spring
spots.local: 清新河中温泉; Qingxin Hot Mineral Spring; Qingxin Hot Spring
spots.desc: A national 4A-rated hot spring resort on the Manshui River. The resort has outdoor hot spring pools surrounded by forest and includes the Hezhong Spring, Spring Valley and Forest Villa areas.
spots.addr: No. 2 Quangu Road, Sankeng Town, Qingxin District, Qingyuan, Guangdong

spots.name: Qingyuan Museum
spots.local: 清远市博物馆; Qingyuan Museum Visit
spots.desc: Visit Qingyuan Museum to learn about the history and culture of Qingyuan through archaeological remains, historical objects, ceramics, calligraphy and other local heritage. The museum also hosts temporary exhibitions, public lectures and educational activities.
spots.hours: Tuesday-Sunday 09:00-17:30; last admission 17:00; closed Mondays except public holidays
spots.addr: Yinquan North Road, Qingcheng District, Qingyuan, Guangdong

spots.name: Panwang Festival and Shua Ge Tang
spots.local: 盘王节·耍歌堂; 盘王节; 瑶族耍歌堂; Panwang Festival
spots.desc: An important Yao traditional festival featuring Panwang worship, Shua Ge Tang ceremonies, Yao singing and dancing, traditional cultural performances and festive activities. Shua Ge Tang is a national-level intangible cultural heritage tradition. The 2025 festival included an original Shua Ge Tang performance at Youling Village Gētángping.
spots.hours: Usually held around the 16th day of the tenth lunar month; the 2025 festival was held from 5 to 7 December
spots.addr: Youling Village Gētángping, Sanpai Town, Liannan Yao Autonomous County, Qingyuan, Guangdong

spots.name: Nangang Millennium Yao Village Farming Festival
spots.local: 千年瑶寨开耕节; 南岗千年瑶寨开耕节; Yao Farming Festival
spots.desc: An annual Yao farming festival marking the beginning of the spring agricultural season. Traditional activities include a farming ceremony, Yao folk performances and agricultural experiences in the rice terraces.
spots.hours: Usually held around the third day of the third lunar month; check the annual program
spots.addr: Nangang Millennium Yao Village, Sanpai Town, Liannan Yao Autonomous County, Qingyuan, Guangdong

spots.name: Qingyuan Lantern Festival
spots.local: 清远元宵节; Qingyuan Lantern Festival
spots.desc: Qingyuan's annual Lantern Festival celebration featuring dragon and lion dances, lantern displays and other traditional festive activities. The 2026 Dragon and Lion Dance Lantern Festival Championship was held at Qingcheng Performance Plaza on 3 March, while additional lantern activities and a drone light show were held at Fengcheng Cultural Square.
spots.hours: Usually held around the 15th day of the first lunar month; the 2026 main program was held on 3 March
spots.addr: Qingcheng Performance Plaza, Qingcheng District, Qingyuan, Guangdong

spots.name: Qingyuan Qingcheng Wanda Plaza
spots.local: 清远清城万达广场; Qingyuan Wanda Plaza
spots.desc: A large shopping and entertainment complex with retail stores, restaurants, a cinema and other leisure facilities.
spots.addr: 89 Huxi Road, Qingcheng District, Qingyuan, Guangdong

spots.name: Shunying City Plaza
spots.local: 顺盈城市广场; Qingyuan City Plaza
spots.desc: A central shopping centre with department stores, supermarkets, restaurants, entertainment and other retail services.
spots.addr: 18 Xianfeng Middle Road, Qingcheng District, Qingyuan, Guangdong

spots.name: Qingyuan Yiyuecheng
spots.local: 壹悦城; Qingyuan Yiyuecheng Shopping Mall; 锦绣清城
spots.desc: A large lakefront shopping and entertainment complex with retail shops, restaurants, supermarkets, cinemas and family entertainment facilities.
spots.addr: East Gate Tang Road, Qingcheng District, Qingyuan, Guangdong

spots.name: Panlong Cave
spots.desc: A long karst cave named after the "coiled dragon" of ancient Chinese legend.

spots.name: Dayunwu Mountain
spots.desc: Dayunwu Mountain has an altitude of 1,140 m. The northeastern main peak of the Yunwu Mountain Range, which runs northeast-oriented, is perpetually shrouded in clouds and mist. High mountains and misty clouds produce fine tea. In small villages, villagers mostly grow tea for their own consumption. There are also protected animals such as pangolins and protected plants like tree ferns.
spots.addr: Yun'an District

spots.name: Jinjiling Forest Park
spots.desc: Jinjiling Forest Park, located near the city, is a forest park integrating natural landscape, ecological protection and leisure and entertainment. The park is shaded by trees and the air is fresh. It is an ideal place for outdoor activities, attracting many tourists to hike, ride and relax. Jinjiling Forest Park is characterized by its rich natural resources and diverse vegetation. There are many…
spots.addr: Sports Road, Jiangcheng District

spots.name: Zhapo Windmill Tianlu Mountain and Sea Resort
spots.local: 闸坡风车天麓山海度假区
spots.desc: Zhapo Windmill Tianlu Mountain and Sea Resort is a famous resort in Yangjiang. Located in Zhapo Town, it is a seaside resort that combines natural scenery and modern leisure facilities. The resort area is famous for its vast beaches, fresh air and majestic windmills, attracting a large number of tourists to vacation and relax.
spots.addr: Jiangcheng District

spots.name: Ten-Mile Silver Beach
spots.desc: This beach is known for its clear water, soft sand, and scenic beauty, making it a great destination for relaxation and beach activities. You can access it via local buses or by taxi.
spots.addr: Hailing Island Experimental Zone (海陵岛试验区)

spots.name: Yangjiang Ocean Culture Museum
spots.desc: The museum showcases Yangjiang’s rich maritime culture and history, making it a great place to learn about local marine resources.
spots.addr: Yangjiang City Ocean Culture Center（阳江市江城区海洋文化中心）

spots.name: Beishan Ancient Temple
spots.desc: Beishan Ancient Temple, located in the northern part of Yangjiang, is a peaceful historical temple renowned for its cultural significance and traditional architecture. You can reach it by local bus or taxi.
spots.addr: Beishan Village, Baisha Subdistrict, Jiangcheng District (江城区白沙街道北山村)

spots.name: Yangjiang Kite Museum
spots.desc: The Yangjiang Kite Museum, located in the city center, is a unique museum that showcases the city’s long history of kite-making. It is an ideal destination for visitors interested in traditional craftsmanship. You can reach the museum by local bus or taxi.
spots.addr: No. 88, Dongfeng Third Road, Jiangcheng District（广东省阳江市江城区东风三路88号）

spots.name: Yangjiang Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall
spots.desc: The memorial hall was established to honor Sun Yat-sen and is an important place to learn about Yangjiang’s history and its role in the Chinese revolution.
spots.addr: Zhongshan Avenue, Jiangcheng District（阳江市江城区中山大道中）

spots.name: Fishermen's Fishing Festival on Hailing Island
spots.desc: Held in August every year, it is a traditional festival for fishermen of Yangjiang Hailing Island to celebrate the opening of the sea for fishing. During the event, fishermen will hold a grand ceremony to worship the god of the sea, pray for good harvest and peace, and accompany their fishing boats out to sea. Visitors can watch traditional performances by fishermen and experience the local…

spots.name: Yangjiang Spring Festival Flower Market
spots.desc: The Spring Festival Flower Market in Yangjiang is an annual festival, usually held on the eve of the Spring Festival. In the flower market, there are all kinds of flowers, New Year goods and folk handicrafts, citizens and tourists will come to buy flowers to decorate their homes and welcome the arrival of the New Year.
spots.hours: every year during the days leading up to the Chinese New Year

spots.name: Yangjiang Shabaoban Dragon Boat Race
spots.desc: During the Dragon Boat Festival, a traditional dragon boat race is held at Shaba Bay in Yangjiang. The event attracts teams from different regions to participate, and visitors can watch the intense dragon boat races on the shore and experience the local Duanwu culture.
spots.hours: The event generally takes place during daylight hours

spots.name: Hailing Island International Kite Festival
spots.local: 阳江海陵岛国际风筝节
spots.desc: There is a kite festival on the 9th day of the 9th lunar month. Every spring, Hailing Island holds a kite festival to attract kite lovers from home and abroad. Visitors can see kites of various shapes and colors flying in the sky, and can also participate in kite flying activities to feel the happy atmosphere of the festival.

spots.name: Ice room wonton
spots.desc: Yangjiang Ice Room Wonton is a restaurant with a unique flavor, famous for its authentic Cantonese wonton. The restaurant attracts a large number of diners with its simple and warm decoration style. It is a popular place for locals and tourists to enjoy traditional Cantonese cuisine. The signature dish of the restaurant is ice room wonton, which uses fresh meat stuffing and paper-thin wonton…
spots.addr: No. 14 Renmin Road, Zhapo Town, Hailing Island, Jiangcheng District

spots.name: New City Fishing Estate
spots.desc: Xincheng Yucun is a popular seafood restaurant that is famous for its fresh seafood ingredients and authentic local flavors. The restaurant's signature dishes include a variety of seafood dishes, such as steamed scallops with garlic, salt and pepper prawns, steamed grouper, etc.
spots.addr: Jiangcheng District

spots.name: Sister Rong's seafood food
spots.desc: Rongcheng Seafood Food is a restaurant focusing on seafood cuisine, providing a variety of seafood dishes, which are deeply loved by diners. The signature dishes of the restaurant include steamed scallops with garlic, salt and pepper prawns, white-burned shrimps, steamed crabs, etc. All seafood are selected from fresh ingredients caught on the same day to ensure that the meat is tender and rich…
spots.addr: Hailing Island, Jiangcheng District

spots.name: Yangjiang Seafood Bar
spots.desc: A popular seaside bar offering a perfect mix of local seafood and refreshing drinks. The bar is famous for its wide selection of fresh seafood platters, paired with locally brewed beers, classic cocktails, and signature drinks crafted with tropical fruits. The relaxed atmosphere, ocean breeze, and live music performances in the evenings make this bar a great spot for both locals and tourists.
spots.addr: No. 10 Haibin Road, Zhapo Town

spots.name: Yangjiang Old Street Tea House
spots.desc: Located in the heart of the historic Old Street area, this traditional tea house offers a tranquil retreat with a variety of fine Chinese teas. Guests can enjoy a selection of jasmine, oolong, and pu-erh teas, along with traditional snacks such as mooncakes and sesame cakes. The tea house is an ideal place for both relaxation and cultural immersion, with its nostalgic ambiance and attentive…
spots.addr: No. 19, Wenhua Street, Old Street, Qianjin District

spots.name: Yangjiang Fruit Wine Bar
spots.desc: A charming bar that specializes in fruit wines made from locally grown fruits such as lychees, longans, and dragon fruit. Guests can enjoy unique fruit-based alcoholic beverages, including fruit wines, fruit cocktails, and slushies. The bar also offers a cozy atmosphere for casual gatherings with friends or a relaxing evening out. Regular promotions and tasting events allow visitors to explore…
spots.addr: No.85, Renmin Road, West District

spots.name: Yangjiang Coffee House
spots.desc: A popular spot among locals, this coffee house serves a variety of freshly brewed coffee drinks, teas, and light pastries. Known for its high-quality beans and cozy atmosphere, the coffee shop is perfect for coffee aficionados and casual visitors alike. The menu includes espressos, lattes, and iced coffee options, along with snacks like croissants and fruit cakes. The warm ambiance, combined with…
spots.addr: No.56, Zhongxin Street, Yangdong District

spots.name: Leaning Pagoda
spots.desc: The whitewashed pagoda stands on top of a large rock in the middle of the river. When you get to the riverbank, a small boat can take you across to climb the pagoda for around ¥5. It is not possible to cross when the water is too high, mostly during the rainy season in spring/summer.
spots.addr: Intersection of Zuojiang Road and Xinmin Road in Jiangzhou District

spots.name: Chongzuo Ecology Park
spots.local: 崇左生态公园, Chóngzuǒ Shēngtài Gōngyuán
spots.desc: A research center by Beijing University on the white-headed leaf monkey (白头叶猴 báitóu yèhóu), of which around 500 individuals live in and near this reservation. Every morning, they leave their caves to spend the day on the hilltops, then return in the evening around sunset. There are observation points around the caves. During the daytime, you most likely won't be able to see them. There are rooms…
spots.price: Adult tickets are ¥36, child tickets are ¥18.
spots.addr: Jiangzhou District Shi Jinglin Road

spots.name: Stone Forest
spots.desc: This park is arranged around some natural carst stone formations that form a landscape somewhat similar to a forest made of stone. Smaller than similar parks near Yunnan's Kunming, this park is nevertheless a pleasant spot, and much less visited.
spots.price: Adult tickets are ¥36, child tickets are ¥18.
spots.addr: Shijinglin Road, Jiangzhou District

spots.name: Chongzuo Zhuang Nationality Museum
spots.desc: Contrary to its name, this large museum is only partly on the customs and culture of the Zhuang ethnic group, but dedicates the majority of its three floors to a well-designed exhibition on the Huashan rock paintings that were painted along the nearby Zuojiang River in Ningming some 2,000 years ago and are today a UNESCO World Heritage site.
spots.addr: New Min Road, Jiangzhou District

spots.name: Zhuang People’s Sanyuesan Festival
spots.desc: Sanyuesan is the most important traditional festival of the Zhuang ethnic group and is widely celebrated in Chongzuo. It usually takes place on the third day of the third lunar month. The festival features folk singing, bamboo pole dances, traditional costumes, ancestor worship, and colorful ethnic markets. It is often described as a “song fair” and reflects the rich cultural heritage of the…

spots.name: Nongzhang Festival
spots.desc: The Nongzhang Festival is a traditional folk festival unique to the Zhuang communities in parts of Chongzuo, especially in rural and mountainous areas. It is closely related to agricultural worship and village solidarity. Activities include sacrificial rituals, communal feasts, folk songs, and dances, expressing prayers for good harvests, peace, and prosperity.

spots.name: China–Vietnam Border Folk Culture Festival
spots.desc: Held in border areas such as Pingxiang and Youyiguan (Friendship Pass), this festival highlights cultural exchange between China and Vietnam. It features folk performances, traditional music and dance, ethnic costumes, and trade activities. The festival reflects Chongzuo’s role as a gateway city and cultural bridge along the China–Vietnam border.

spots.name: City Stadium
spots.desc: Chongzuo City Stadium is a key public sports facility serving local residents and visitors. It hosts a variety of athletic events, physical education activities, and community sports programs. The venue is often used for football matches, track events, mass fitness activities, and sometimes cultural gatherings. It is centrally located in the city, making it convenient for both organized sports…
spots.addr: Chengxi Road, Jiangzhou District

spots.name: Fusui County Gymnasium
spots.desc: This gymnasium in Fusui County (扶绥县) within Chongzuo is a local indoor sports hall that provides facilities for basketball, badminton, table tennis, and general fitness activities. It serves residents in the county and is commonly used for local competitions, school sports events, and community fitness classes. The venue contributes to grassroots sports development in the region.

spots.name: Sports Center Gymnasium
spots.desc: with a modern gymnasium as part of its complex. The center includes a main stadium, indoor gymnasium, tennis halls, training facilities, and fitness areas. It has hosted regional athletic games and events such as the Traditional Ethnic Sports Games of Guangxi, supports community fitness programs, and serves as a hub for large-scale competitions.

spots.name: Cinema China Film
spots.desc: It often shows current domestic and international films with multiple screens and comfortable seating. The cinema is part of a larger entertainment and shopping complex, making it convenient to combine movie-going with shopping and dining.
spots.addr: 4F, Yatu Film & TV Plaza, No. 20 Lichuan Road

spots.name: Municipal Cinema
spots.desc: Municipal Cinema screens popular films and is known as a neighborhood favorite for watching the latest Chinese releases and family films. It’s conveniently located along a main road and often visited by residents and visitors alike.
spots.addr: 325 Provincial Road,

spots.name: Chongzuo International Market
spots.desc: A bustling market offering local products, clothing, electronics, and fresh produce. It's a great place to experience local life and pick up souvenirs.
spots.addr: No. 8, Zhongshan Road

spots.name: Guding Tea House
spots.desc: Traditional tea house in Daxin County where you can buy local teas and regional specialty products (such as tea leaves). Great to combine a tea experience with shopping for gifts.
spots.addr: Taoyuan Road (桃源路), Daxin County

spots.name: Puyun Tianyun Tea Store
spots.desc: Local tea shop selling a range of regional tea products and packaged tea, including popular Guangxi-style teas. Ideal place to buy easily packable gifts such as tea packets.
spots.addr: No. 647 Tongzheng Avenue (同正大道647号), Xinning Town

spots.name: Chongzuo Food Street
spots.desc: It is famous for its local cuisine such as "Zhangji Rice Noodles", "Laos Zhao Bulgogi" and various barbecue snacks. It is a good place to experience authentic local tastes.
spots.addr: Intersection of Kam Siu Road and Wu Yi Road

spots.name: Lao Chongzuo Specialty Restaurant
spots.desc: known for authentic Guangxi and Zhuang-style dishes. Locals praise its steamed regional specialties, generous portions, and homey flavors featuring ingredients like passion fruit spare ribs and glutinous rice creations — perfect for tasting traditional border-region food.
spots.addr: No. 65 Friendship Avenue, Jiangzhou District

spots.name: No.93 Small Kitchen
spots.desc: It’s listed for excellent reviews (5★) and is an ideal spot for regional Chinese home-style meals and daily favorites. While not a major tourist dining spot, it’s beloved for its authentic local taste and friendly service
spots.addr: 136 (approx) near main street

spots.name: Longzhou Flavor Rice Noodle Restaurant
spots.desc: While simple, its flavors showcase Zhuang and Guangxi culinary staples (such as hand-pulled noodles, spicy broths, and savory condiments). It’s a great option for a quick, authentic local lunch or dinner.
spots.addr: Detian Road, Jiangzhou District

spots.name: 8090 Milk Tea & Cool Drinks
spots.desc: It’s a casual stop for bubble tea, fruit drinks, iced tea, and other refreshing cool drinks — perfect during the hot subtropical summers of Guangxi. Typical menu includes fruit tea, classic milk teas, and seasonal cold drinks.
spots.addr: Jiangzhou District

spots.name: Zhuang Oil Tea & Local Tea Stop
spots.desc: Zhuang ethnic oil tea (油茶) is a traditional northern Guangxi drink prepared with roasted tea leaves fried in oil with spices, sometimes served with peanuts and puffed rice. This rustic tea isn’t a branded shop but a local beverage experience available in small local tea houses and market stalls — great for tasting traditional rural flavors and understanding ethnic beverage culture.
spots.addr: Near downtown Chongzuo markets

spots.name: Fresh Fruit Juice & Refreshments Stand
spots.desc: While not always a fixed shop with a formal name, fresh fruit juice stalls are very common around busy market streets in Chongzuo’s downtown (especially near food streets). You’ll find locals selling freshly squeezed 龙眼糖水 (longan sugar water), 酸梅汤 (sour plum drink), bitter gourd juice, and seasonal tropical fruit juices made from local produce like pineapple, watermelon, and longan — all regional…
spots.addr: Near Jiangzhou Local Market / Food Street,

spots.name: Arcade Town
spots.desc: Consists of 22 streets filled with arcade-style buildings (known in Chinese as qílóu 骑楼), which are noteworthy for their blend of Chinese and foreign designs. The buildings generally date from the late 19th century to the early 20th century, with the peak period of construction being in the 1920s and 1930s, particularly after a fire destroyed much of the old city in 1924.
spots.addr: Wanxiu District (万秀区)

spots.name: White Cloud Mountain
spots.local: 白云山 Báiyūn Shān, Baiyun Mountain
spots.desc: A mountain to the north of the arcade town and east of the Dragon Mother Temple. Worth the climb.
spots.addr: 121 Baiyun Road, Chengbei Subdistrict, Wanxiu District (万秀区城北街道白云路121号)

spots.name: Zhongshan Park
spots.desc: Dedicated to the founder of China's first republic, Sun Yat-sen (Sun Zhongshan). There is a Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall (中山纪念堂 Zhōngshān Jìniàntáng) in the centre of the park, which was completed in 1930, making it one of the first Sun Yat-sen memorial halls to be completed in China following Sun's death in 1925 (it claims to be the first, but in fact there is one in Guangdong's Dabu County, which…
spots.hours: Park opening hours: 07:00-18:30, Memorial hall opening hours: 09:00-17:00, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 1 Wenhua Road, Wanxiu District (万秀区文化路1号)

spots.name: Crane Hill Tower
spots.desc: A modern reconstruction of a historic tower. The top of the tower has good views of the Gui River.
spots.addr: Zhushan Park, Wanxiu District (万秀区珠山公园内)

spots.name: Former British Consulate
spots.local: 英领事署旧址 Yīng Lǐngshìshǔ Jiùzhǐ
spots.desc: In 1897, British imperialists declared the entire hill to be the sovereign territory of Great Britain and built this consulate upon the hill. The consulate was abandoned about 30 years later when a campaign of civil resistance compelled the British to leave. Today the former consulate is a museum. There is a stone monument outside the building, which commemorates the return of the hill to Chinese…
spots.addr: Zhushan Park, Wanxiu District (万秀区珠山公园内)

spots.name: Former Site of Alliance Bible Institute
spots.local: 建道圣经学院旧址 Jiàndào Shēngjīng Xuéyuàn Jiùzhǐ
spots.desc: The Alliance Bible Institute is a Christian school founded by an American missionary at this site in 1899. The school continued to operate at this site until 1949 when it relocated to Hong Kong. Today the building is the property of the Wuzhou Christian Association, which holds regular church services here.
spots.hours: The building is normally closed but it may be possible to enter when religious services are being held: 09:00-10:30 on…
spots.addr: Zhushan Park, Wanxiu District (万秀区珠山公园内)

spots.name: White Crane Temple
spots.desc: Said to be one of the best preserved traditional Taoist temples in Guangxi. It was established in the 8th century AD, but has been renovated several times since then.
spots.addr: 1 Yuanjiang Road, Wanxiu District (万秀区鸳江路1号)

spots.name: Wuzhou Museum
spots.local: 梧州市博物馆 Wú​zhōu​ Shì Bówùguǎn
spots.desc: Wuzhou's main museum. Information is mostly in Chinese, though you will see some English when you get to the exhibition on the Arcade Town.
spots.addr: Zhushan Park, Wanxiu District (万秀区珠山公园内)

spots.name: Cool Heart Falls
spots.desc: The waterfall is about 42 km away from Teng County's county seat and 60 km from Wuzhou's main urban area.
spots.addr: Lizhai Village, Langnan Town, Teng County (藤县埌南镇黎寨村)

spots.name: Visit Historical Sites and Cultural Landmarks
spots.local: 参观历史遗迹与文化景点
spots.desc: Wuzhou boasts a rich cultural heritage with many historical sites worth visiting. The Wuzhou Ancient City features well-preserved ancient streets and buildings that offer a glimpse into the city’s traditional culture. Longmu Temple is an important religious site in Wuzhou, attracting many visitors for worship. The temple is known for its unique architecture and folk beliefs. Additionally, the…

spots.name: Enjoy Natural Scenery
spots.desc: Wuzhou offers stunning natural landscapes, particularly the Xijiang River, which flows through the city and is an ideal spot for boat tours. You can enjoy the scenic views along the river. The surrounding mountains of Wuzhou are also picturesque and great for hiking and photography. Tieshan Lake is another notable natural attraction. With its clear waters and lush surroundings, it’s perfect for…

spots.name: Try Local Cuisine
spots.desc: Wuzhou’s cuisine is known for its unique flavors. Wuzhou Rice Noodles are a local specialty, with smooth noodles complemented by a variety of seasonings, offering a rich taste. Wuzhou Beer Duck is another iconic dish, where the duck is cooked with beer and spices, giving it a rich and unique flavor. Sour Bamboo Shoots Fish is a dish with strong local character, combining the sourness of bamboo…

spots.name: Participate in Local Festivals
spots.desc: The Wuzhou Dragon Boat Festival is a major traditional event held every year around the Dragon Boat Festival. It features exciting dragon boat races, attracting many visitors and locals to either participate or watch the competition. You’ll experience the festive atmosphere and learn about the traditional dragon boat culture. In addition, the Wuzhou Lantern Festival, held during the Chinese New…

spots.name: Explore Nearby Attractions
spots.desc: Wuzhou is not only rich in its own scenic beauty, but also has several nearby destinations worth exploring. Hezhou, located not far from Wuzhou, is home to Huangyao Ancient Town, which preserves well-maintained streets and exudes a strong historical charm, making it a great place for history and culture enthusiasts. Pingle Ancient Town is another popular tourist spot near Wuzhou. The ancient…

spots.name: Shopping and Experiencing Local Culture
spots.desc: Wuzhou offers many traditional markets and handicraft stores where you can purchase local products and souvenirs, such as hand-crafted Zhuang silver jewelry, pottery, and other unique artisanal goods. Moreover, as Wuzhou is a cultural hub for the Zhuang people, you can learn more about their traditional culture, including clothing, dances, and music. Participating in Zhuang cultural activities…

spots.name: Zhuang Ethnic Silver Jewelry
spots.desc: The Zhuang people, one of the major ethnic groups in Wuzhou, have a long history of silver jewelry craftsmanship. You can find various hand-crafted silver jewelry such as necklaces, earrings, and bracelets in local ethnic markets or craft shops. Each piece is unique, and many feature traditional Zhuang patterns, symbolizing good luck and blessings. These make for wonderful cultural souvenirs.

spots.name: Zhuang Handwoven Fabrics and Embroidery
spots.desc: The Zhuang people are known for their handwoven fabrics and embroidery, which are vibrant and rich in cultural significance. You can purchase items like handwoven bags, scarves, tablecloths, and curtains, which are often adorned with traditional Zhuang symbols. These textiles are not only beautiful but also meaningful, making them perfect for home decor or personal accessories.

spots.name: Wood Carvings
spots.desc: Wuzhou, along with other areas in Guangxi, has a tradition of exquisite wood carving. You can find finely crafted wood carvings of people, animals, and landscapes, often inspired by local nature or ethnic culture. These pieces are perfect for decoration or as souvenirs and reflect the region’s unique artistic style.

spots.name: Wuzhou Rice Noodles
spots.desc: Wuzhou rice noodles are loved for their unique smooth texture and rich broth. The noodles are often served with various toppings like beef, pork, peanuts, and pickled vegetables, making them a popular street food. Whether in soup or stir-fried, these noodles represent the traditional flavors of Wuzhou and are perfect for everyday meals.

spots.name: Beer Duck
spots.desc: Beer duck is one of Wuzhou's signature dishes, where duck is slow-cooked with beer and spices, creating a rich aroma and tender meat. The beer infusion makes the dish particularly flavorful, and it’s a favorite for those who enjoy bold flavors. It is often served at gatherings and family meals, adding a special touch to the table.

spots.name: Pickled Bamboo Shoots with Fish
spots.desc: Pickled bamboo shoots with fish is a traditional dish in Wuzhou, where the tangy flavor of pickled bamboo shoots complements the fresh fish. The fermented bamboo shoots add a unique sour taste that pairs perfectly with the delicate fish meat. It’s a popular home-cooked dish in Wuzhou and offers a distinctive regional flavor.

spots.name: Wuzhou Roast Duck
spots.desc: Wuzhou roast duck is known for its crispy skin and tender meat. The duck is roasted with a special sauce that adds a rich aroma, making it a flavorful dish loved by locals and visitors alike. It is perfect for those who enjoy roasted meats and bold flavors, often served in restaurants and during special occasions.

spots.name: Wuzhou Cold Noodles (Liangpi)
spots.desc: Wuzhou cold noodles, or liangpi, are a classic summer snack made from rice or wheat flour, served with chili oil, garlic sauce, and other seasonings. The noodles are smooth and refreshing, with a spicy kick that makes them perfect for hot weather. They are a popular street food, offering a light, tasty option for those seeking a cooling snack.

spots.name: Wuzhou Spicy Skewers (Malatang)
spots.desc: Spicy skewers, or malatang, are a staple of Wuzhou’s night market culture. Various ingredients like vegetables, meats, and seafood are skewered and cooked in a spicy, numbing broth, delivering a bold and flavorful taste. This dish is perfect for those who love spicy food, offering layers of flavor that make it a fun and satisfying dish to share with friends.

spots.name: Wuzhou Savory Pancakes (Xian Jian Bing)
spots.desc: Savory pancakes are a traditional street snack in Wuzhou, made from rice flour with savory fillings like pickled vegetables, minced meat, and seafood. The pancakes are crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, offering a rich and satisfying taste. It’s a popular quick breakfast or snack and is commonly found at food stalls and street markets.

spots.name: Osmanthus Tea
spots.desc: Osmanthus tea is a traditional drink in Wuzhou and other parts of Guangxi, made from fresh osmanthus flowers and tea leaves. The tea has a clear, light color and a fragrant floral aroma that can help refresh the mind and clear heat from the body. It’s a calming and gentle drink often enjoyed in the autumn or winter, providing a soothing experience. Many local tea houses and restaurants in Wuzhou…

spots.name: Mint Herbal Tea
spots.desc: Mint herbal tea is a cooling and refreshing beverage that combines mint leaves with other herbs such as licorice to create a light, herbal drink. Known for its ability to relieve heat and soothe the stomach, this tea is popular during the summer months, offering relief from the heat and digestive comfort. You can find mint herbal tea at local street stalls, restaurants, and herbal tea shops in…

spots.name: Floral Herbal Teas
spots.desc: Wuzhou offers a wide variety of floral herbal teas, with common types including chrysanthemum tea and jasmine tea. These light and refreshing drinks are not only enjoyable for their subtle flavors but also known for their health benefits, including stress relief and improved sleep. They are ideal for those seeking a relaxing and mild beverage. These teas are commonly available in local tea…

spots.name: Herbal Tea
spots.desc: Herbal tea, or "cooling tea," is a traditional drink in Guangxi known for its ability to detoxify the body and reduce heat. Made from various herbs like chrysanthemum, licorice, and mulberry leaves, herbal tea has a slightly bitter taste but offers many health benefits, such as promoting digestion and relieving heat-related discomforts. spots.addr: Huangshi National Mine Park, Tieshan District

spots.name: Fuchi Sanyuesan Temple Fair
spots.desc: A traditional temple fair dating back to the Northern Song dynasty, held to commemorate the Three Kingdoms general Gan Ning. The event features folk performances, intangible cultural heritage demonstrations, and local food stalls. It was listed as a provincial intangible cultural heritage in 2011. Source: Hubei Daily.
spots.hours: Annual event held on the third day of the third lunar month (usually in April)
spots.addr: Fuchi Town, Yangxin County

spots.name: Dongfang Mountain Folk Art Event
spots.desc: A seasonal folk art event held at the Dongfang Mountain Scenic Area, featuring West Journey-themed parades, folk performances, intangible cultural heritage markets, and local food. The event is typically held during the Chinese New Year holiday. Source: Huangshi Civilization Network.
spots.hours: Usually held during the Spring Festival period (January-February)
spots.addr: Dongfang Mountain Scenic Area, Xialu District

spots.name: Central perk private cuisine
spots.desc: Scrambled eggs with tomatoes, boiled pork slices, floss and eggplant are all famous dishes.
spots.addr: Doulishan Road, huangshigang district

spots.name: Zhang River Scenic Area
spots.local: 漳河风景区, 漳河旅游风景区
spots.desc: Visitors can stay at the Zhang He (Zhang River) Peninsula Hotel (漳河半岛酒店).
spots.hours: The scenic area is open from 08:30 to 17:00. Boats depart at 09:00 and 13:00. The ticket office is open from 08:30 to…
spots.price: ¥20 to visit Yangguang Beach (阳光沙滩), ¥70 to visit Huxin Island (湖心岛), ¥50 for the boat trip to the island. Combo…
spots.addr: Dongbao District (东宝区)

spots.name: Xianling Tomb
spots.desc: Part of the UNESCO World Heritage site "Imperial Tombs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties". It commemorates Zhu Youyuan, a locally based scion of the Ming Dynasty's ruling family, and his wife, whose teenage son Zhu Houcong happened to inherit the throne when the previous emperor died without issue. Once Zhu Houcong went to Beijing and became the Ming's new Jiajing Emperor, he had his deceased…
spots.addr: No. 1 Xianling Road, Zhongxiang (钟祥市显陵路1号)

spots.name: Yuanyou Palace
spots.desc: The Jiajing Emperor's (Zhu Houcong's) ancestral hall. Built between 1540 and 1553 in the same style as the Forbidden City in Beijing. When the emperor revisited his hometown, he would often come here to pay homage to his ancestors.
spots.addr: 5 Yuanyou Road, Zhongxiang (钟祥市元佑路5号)

spots.name: Dakou National Forest Park
spots.desc: Hubei Dakou National Forest Park features low-mountain forest landscapes with deciduous and mixed woodlands. It includes several natural scenic areas as well as temple and Taoist site remains, combining natural and cultural elements.
spots.addr: Dakou Forest Farm, Zhongxiang

spots.name: Mochou Village
spots.desc: Mochou Village is a Chu-culture–themed attraction offering traditional craft experiences, folk performances, bonfire events, boat rides, and visits to Chu-style architecture. The area includes a literature and art museum, cultural sites, local food options, and accommodation facilities.
spots.addr: No. 59 Mochou Lake Road, Zhongxiang (next to the Mingxianling Cultural Tourism Scenic Area)

spots.name: Jingmen Garden Expo Park
spots.desc: Jingmen Garden Expo Park is an ecological park transformed from a former mining site, featuring themed gardens, a nature museum, Chu-culture attractions, children’s play areas, interactive installations, and night light shows.
spots.addr: Tianshan Road, Shuangxi Subdistrict, Duodao District

spots.name: Qinglong Mountain Dinosaur Egg Fossil Group National Nature Reserve
spots.local: 青龙山恐龙蛋化石群国家级自然保护区, 青龙山恐龙蛋化石群国家地质公园, Qinglong Mountain Dinosaur Egg Fossil Group National Geopark
spots.desc: Thousands of fossilized dinosaur eggs dating from the late Cretaceous Period have been unearthed here since the 1990s. The eggs are displayed at an on-site museum.
spots.addr: Qinglongshan Village, Liupi Town, Yunyang District (郧阳区柳陂镇青龙山村)

spots.name: Carefree Valley
spots.desc: A beautiful hiking area with monkeys, waterfalls, and fresh water pools large enough to take a dip.

spots.name: The Three Taoist Temples of Qiongtai
spots.desc: A 600-year old temple complex. Consists of 3 temples: the upper temple (上观 Shang Guan), the middle temple (中观 Zhong Guan) and the lower temple (下观 Xia Guan).

spots.name: The Poem Wall
spots.desc: Stretching for miles along the north bank of the river, this wall of poetry is beautiful even for those who can not read the characters. The wall is flanked by a riverside park and makes for a great place to walk and people watch. For a different perspective, stop by at night when the multicolored lights are on.

spots.name: Buxingjie
spots.desc: This is the most happening part of town and a good place to shop for the most fashionable attire that Changde has to offer. Western food at both the east and west ends.

spots.name: Bin Lake Park
spots.desc: This lakeside park is not only a great place to walk, but there is also a selection of carnival rides and games. From bumper cars to a miniature roller coaster to paddle boats, there are attractions here for both the young and the young at heart.
spots.price: Free to enter; prices of rides and games vary

spots.name: 柳叶湖渔夫文化体验
spots.desc: Join a local fisherman on Liuye Lake for a morning, learning traditional fishing methods and listening to stories about life on the water. A hands-on experience that ends with enjoying the fresh catch cooked in a local style.
spots.addr: Liuye Lake Scenic Area

spots.name: South of the Bridge Marketplace
spots.desc: This massive marketplace has the cheapest prices in Changde on a huge variety of goods. Clothing, shoes, appliances, sporting equipment, toys, stationery, and countless other items are sold here. Be sure to bargain for the best deals.

spots.name: Changde Beef Noodles
spots.desc: Changde is famous for their rice noodles with beef. These can be found at most local restaurants, but you can find some of the best at the east end of walking street or outside the main gate at Number 1 Middle School (常德市一中).

spots.name: Japanese Food
spots.desc: Japanese noodle and sushi restaurant located on the first floor of the Better Life shopping complex. The noodles are especially good.

spots.name: KFC
spots.desc: KFC is more popular in China than it is in its country of origin and Changde is no exception. For some deep fried American fast food, look for the Colonel. KFC is quite expensive compared to local fare, so budget accordingly.

spots.name: Changde Sauce Salted Duck
spots.desc: Changde Sauce Salted Duck has crispy skin and tender meat, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, with five flavors and the sweetness of the sauce. This is a famous specialty food in Changde City.Changde salted duck can be found everywhere in Changde. As long as you pay attention, you can buy authentic and delicious Changde salted duck on the street.

spots.name: Changde Spicy Meat
spots.desc: Changde's Spicy Pork is popular for its rich, spicy, numbing aroma and unique Hunan flavor. However, if you can't eat spicy food, we suggest you ask the restaurant to reduce the spiciness. Many restaurants and spicy hot pot restaurants in Changde will have Changde Spicy Pork as part of their menu. Alternatively, you can buy it at a Hunan specialty store on the street.

spots.name: Lotus Sausage
spots.desc: Lotus sausage is a traditional food of Changde, known for its unique production process. Lotus sausage can usually be bought at Changde food stalls, or if you want to take it home to your friends and relatives, you can buy it at a Hunan specialty store down the street.

spots.name: Modern China Tea Shop
spots.desc: This restaurant originated in Changsha, Hunan Province and now has a branch in Changde. Although there are not as many stores as Changsha, you can also visit both malls to purchase.
spots.addr: Changde Youa International Plaza Store,Changde Wanda Plaza

spots.name: syrup
spots.desc: Hunan has a rich sugar water culture. You can try various sugar water, such as red bean soup, mung bean soup, etc. Especially in summer, these sugar water can help cool down. Usually the people selling sugar water are old ladies carrying poles. You can pay attention to the elderly people carrying poles on the street. Or you can just find a restaurant that will have sugar water for purchase.

spots.name: Tongdao Dong Autonomous County
spots.desc: Visit Kam people, whose language is a branch of the Tai-Kadai linguistic family. A distant relative of the Thai people.

spots.name: Jingzhou Miao and Dong Autonomous County
spots.desc: Visit Hmong people, whose language is a branch of the Hmong-Mien linguistic family.

spots.name: Hongjiang old commercial town

spots.name: Xiangshipo Forest Park

spots.name: Gaoyi Ancient Village

spots.name: Wanfo Mountain

In the scenic area, there are "Single Rock", "Seven Star Ancient Temple", "Blessed Cave", "Lion Watching the Moon", "Optical Pillar", "Beauty Watching Her Husband", "Shenzhou Conch", "Golden…

Meanwhile, there are also various recreational facilities, such as children's play facilities and fitness equipment, which allow you to enjoy a healthy leisure…

Every Ching Ming and other war-related anniversaries, the park is visited to pay…

The library is free of charge to the public, aimed at enriching the spiritual life of the public, to create a harmonious and civilized environment in the park.

spots.name: Shi Feng Park

In addition, the 1,500-meter-long Stele Forest Road, which consists of more than 40 groups of stele stones, also forms a humanistic landscape of the park that is extremely elegant and fragrant…

spots.name: Jiulang Mountain Forest Park

spots.name: Buddhist temple
spots.desc: It is a famous Buddhist temple in Zhuzhou, built in 697 AD and has a history of over 1300 years. There are a lot of cultural relics in the temple, among which Guanyin Buddha statue was originally enshrined in the back hall, and 21 bronze Buddhas of the Ming Dynasty and an ancient incense burner have been preserved intact so far.

spots.name: Xiangyu Ling Farming and Eating College
spots.desc: There are a lot of books related to farming and Hunan culture, supplemented by cultural landscape vignettes such as the "Pavilion of Farming and Studying" and the "Celebration of Abundance Terrace". The landscape water system is constructed by using the terraced terrain of valleys and natural springs and streams, and the handmade wooden waterwheel, which is a historical evidence of the oriental…

There is not only a deep historical heritage and beautiful environment, but also a unique architectural style and humanistic…

It is the ancestral shrine of the Liling lineage of the Geng Clan, as well as the birthplace of Geng Biao, a proletarian revolutionary, militarist, and diplomat, and an important place for…

spots.desc: The museum has three floors of tours, all of which are filled with red slogans promoting "China's Red Culture". If you are interested in Chinese red culture, you can visit the museum. You can bring your elders to visit.

spots.name: Medog Nature Reserve
spots.desc: China's largest nature reserve with the best preserved primitive jungle in its bottom is found in an area of 460,000 hectares that slopes down from north to south on the southern side of the Himalayas in Medog County, southeast Tibet.
spots.addr: Medog County

spots.name: Pagsum Lake
spots.desc: The sacred lake of Nyingma, with its beautiful scenery, has a temple called Tsozong Gongba Monastery on the island in the heart of the lake.

spots.name: Namjagbarwa Peak
spots.desc: A mountain known as the most beautiful mountain in China. The peak can be viewed from Yarlung Tsangpo Canyon, Sejila Mountain pass and other places.

spots.name: Lulang
spots.desc: There are beautiful alpine forests, grasslands and flowers, giving a sense of Swiss scenery.

spots.name: Basu Lake
spots.desc: A pristine glacial lake surrounded by snow-capped mountains and lush forests. The lake is a popular spot for trekking and photography. Known for its serene beauty and clear waters, it’s a perfect place for nature lovers and those looking to escape the hustle and bustle.
spots.addr: Basongcuo Lake Scenic Area, Gongbu Jiangda County

spots.name: Peach Blossom Valley
spots.desc: Peach Blossom Valley is located in the south of Linzhi. Every spring (usually from March to April), thousands of peach blossoms bloom, attracting tourists to watch. The whole valley is covered with pink peach blossoms, forming a picturesque scenery. Visitors can hike, cycle, or simply immerse themselves in the beauty of nature here.
spots.hours: Best visited during the blooming season, March - April.
spots.addr: Peach Blossom Valley Scenic Area of Tibet Autonomous Region

spots.name: Miling Town
spots.desc: A small town located near Linzhi, rich in Tibetan culture and traditions, featuring traditional Tibetan houses, monasteries, and local markets. A chance to immerse yourself in local culture and explore the peaceful Tibetan countryside.

spots.name: Experience Local Tibetan Culture at a Traditional Village
spots.desc: Participate in cultural activities such as traditional Tibetan music, dance, and local festivals. These villages are open for visitors to experience the lifestyle of the Tibetan people. Learn about the customs, language, and traditions that have shaped Tibetan culture for centuries.
spots.hours: Open year-round, though festivals and events are held seasonally.

spots.name: Matsutake mushroom
spots.desc: Matsutake is a rare wild fungus that grows in the primeval forest of Tibet and is famous for its rich fragrance and delicate taste. It is a good product on the high-end table, and also has high medicinal value. It is known as the "king of bacteria". Linzhi's matsutake is of particularly superior quality and is deeply loved by consumers at home and abroad. The specialty area in the farmers' market…
spots.addr: Farmers' market

spots.name: Tibetan Saffron
spots.desc: Saffron is a precious medicinal material and spice of Linzhi, which is popular for its unique aroma and bright color. It is widely used to season high-end dishes, make tea drinks, relieve insomnia, improve blood circulation and other effects. Sarcon flowers produced in Tibet are famous for their high purity and excellent quality. Linzhi specialty stores, such as "Tibetan Specialty Store" in the…

spots.name: Basu Lake Crafts
spots.desc: Basoncuo handicrafts include special jewelry, wood carvings, traditional tapestries and Tibetan costumes. These handicrafts are inspired by the natural scenery and Tibetan cultural elements around Basongcuo Lake, each of which reflects the delicate skills and unique creativity of craftsmen. The small handicraft shop in Basongcuo Scenic Area is usually located near the tourist service center…

spots.name: Akutonba Tibetan Restaurant Grilled Tibetan Pork
spots.local: 阿酷顿巴藏家餐厅 烤藏香猪
spots.desc: Roasted Tibetan pork is a classic Tibetan cuisine. The local unique Tibetan pork is selected. After marinating with secret seasoning, the whole pork is roasted. The skin is crispy, the meat is tender, and the flavor is unique.
spots.addr: No. 207, Shuangyong East Road, Bayi Town, Baiyi District

spots.name: Snowy Tibetan Restaurant Glutinous rice cake
spots.desc: Glutinous rice cake is a traditional staple food of Tibetans. It is made of flour ground after stir-frying green barley. When eaten, it is usually mixed with ghee tea. It has a rich wheat fragrance and unique taste, and is an important source of energy in the plateau area. You can taste it in special Tibetan restaurants in Linzhi.
spots.addr: Bayi Town

spots.name: Ghee tea
spots.desc: Ghee tea is an indispensable drink in Tibetan daily life. It is made of strong tea, ghee and edible salt. It has a unique salty fragrance, which can effectively resist the cold of the plateau and provide rich energy. It is available in all major Tibetan restaurants.

spots.name: Neydo Tashi Choeling
spots.desc: The main monastery of Karma Chagme Rinpoche, the head of the Neydo Kagyu lineage of Vajrayana Buddhism, is located among stunning scenery near the village of Ngom, about three hours from Qamdo city.

spots.name: Erhai Lake Villages
spots.desc: There are 17 villages spread along the Western shore of the Erhai Lake between Xiaguan and Xizhou. Take a tour by bike by riding East from Dali Old Town until you reach the lake in Caicun Village and then North beside the lake shore taking local paths and roads. A great opportunity to see village life at its best, meet locals, see the Banyan trees in each village square and admire local…

spots.name: Butterfly Spring
spots.desc: A deep blue pool that periodically swarms with countless butterflies, with a legend to go with it: Long ago, a young woman named Wen Gu and a young man named Xia Lang were in love. But the prince took a fancy to Wen Gu and kidnapped her. Xia Lang rescued his beloved, but the soldiers pursued them and, unable to defend themselves, the star-crossed lovers jumped into the deep pond. Early the next…

spots.name: Wase Market
spots.desc: Combine a trip to Erhai Lake with a visit to the Wase Market on the eastern shore of the lake. Wase is a traditional and conservative Bai town with a weekly market aimed at townspeople and nearby farmers. The market offers an interesting look at life in a quiet country town.

spots.name: Shaping Market
spots.desc: Shaping Town offers a lively weekly market with plenty of local color. The market starts early. A great chance to see local farmers out in force and literally watch plenty of horse trading. Not much to buy (unless you are a farmer) but gives you the feeling of life in a small country town.

spots.name: Eryuan
spots.desc: Eryuan is a small town next to Cibihu lake. After taking a bus that leaves every hour for ¥13/person from the intersection with 214 National Road near the North Gate market you can get off in Eryuan town or anywhere along the way. If the bus is overloaded the bus driver's assistant will walk past police checkpoints with passengers that didn't have a seat. Cibihu lake is about 3 km downhill from…

spots.name: ClimbDali
spots.desc: 20 rock climbing routes have already been bolted (Shuanglang and Binchuan) with potential for hundreds more.
spots.addr: 393 Renmin Road

spots.name: Jizu Mountain
spots.desc: The mountain and its ranges look like a chicken's foot. It's a 2-3 day trip in its own right. The top and slopes are covered in temples, many in a state of disrepair. Some have been restored and have resident monks. This is a difficult hike with the summit at 3200 metres. Be prepared. Or there are horse rides and a cable car that starts halfway up.

spots.name: Rice and Friends Cooking School Dali
spots.desc: Rice & Friends Chinese cooking school offers hands-on Chinese cooking courses, highly rated on tripadvisor. Beautiful open-air setup with mountain views. Authentic and very personal 5-hour cooking experience, including outdoor-market shopping for ingredients, introduction to the theory of Chinese cooking, hands-on preparation of 3 dishes with a recipe booklet to take away and plenty of time for…
spots.addr: No.1 Hong Long Jing, Dali old town

spots.name: Johnny 'O palm reading
spots.desc: The guy, that looks like a retired Super Mario with dark sunglasses, reads your palm and gives you an interesting perspective of what happened to you in the past. Won't tell you the future until you explicitly beg for it. Worth the ¥100 he's asking for.
spots.addr: @Tibetan Cafe,

spots.name: Erhai Paradise
spots.desc: Certainly worth a visit. It is a magical Buddhist haven with giant statues, empty amphitheaters, demon-statues, tea gardens and an artificial beach. One way is to hire a taxi driver form Dali or Xiaguan for the entire day and negotiate a price. The driver can take you to the boat jetty and show you onto the island ferry. You will sail across the lake. Explore the island and come back by boat…

spots.name: Xiaguan Hot Springs
spots.desc: This swimming pool is called a hot springs resort because it probably really uses naturally hot water. Other than that it might be a little different from what most people might expect. These days it is a regular, pretty run down swimming pool (one pool on the inside, one on the outside, otherwise identical) with all the spa's (that are still on the price list) being closed. Interestingly there…

spots.name: Peter's Tourist Center
spots.desc: Fluent English speaking with experience in arranging tours around Dali, especially cultural tours like Shaxi day tour and Yi, Bai, Hui minority markets and villages. Air, bus and train ticket booking, hotel and guest house booking.
spots.addr: #65 Bo Ai Street, Dali Old Town, Yunnan, China中国 云南 大理古城 博爱路65号

spots.name: 再回首 (Zai Hui Shou)
spots.desc: Spicy cold noodles with chicken strips, very well known locally. There is only one thing to order.
spots.addr: 198 Renmin Road, Dali Old Town

spots.name: 色了木 (Se Le Mu)
spots.desc: The name literally means Salaam. Delightful eatery serving Dali Muslim food. Pictures are on the walls. Noodles only during breakfast hours while rice dishes are available for the rest of the day. Ask for chicken leg from the back kitchen.
spots.addr: Yu Er Road

spots.name: Golden Local-Style Noodles
spots.desc: Noodle shop that specialized in Cross-the-Bridge Noodles, a local specialty where a bowl of hot broth is brought to the table, and then the rice noodles and a number of plates with small quantities of other foods is immediately added by the waiter. The menu is all in Chinese, but there are pictures displayed throughout, and ordering should be no problem.
spots.addr: Renmin Road

spots.name: Vegetarian, Beef and Pork Dumplings
spots.desc: Great place for fresh homemade dumplings. Nine dumplings with sauce just made and freshly steamed only cost ¥3.5.
spots.addr: Renmin Road

spots.name: Vegetarian Buffet
spots.desc: All-you-can-eat vegetarian buffet operated by Buddhists, the choices are usually four different vegetable dishes, soup, rice, and pickled vegetables.
spots.addr: Boai Road

spots.name: Sun Island Cafe
spots.desc: A couple of steps away from the main tourist avenues lies this hybrid of Chinese and Japanese culture. This is the place to go for some genuine Japanese food cooked up the Chinese-, Japanese- and English-speaking owner or to relax to some chilled out music. The Japanese crew that manages the place might even throw a Jombei, Didgeridoo, Jews harp party which guests are more than welcome to join in…
spots.addr: 324 Renmin Road

spots.name: Marley's Cafe
spots.desc: Excellent first floor restaurant. Very good Bai dishes. Nice decor. Cheap and has a narrow balcony great for people watching.
spots.addr: Huguo Road

spots.name: Om Shanti
spots.desc: Vegetarian restaurant which serves great food and has a great, laid back atmosphere. The staff are very helpful too and can give you loads of helpful information.
spots.addr: 245 Renmin Road

spots.name: Dali Cookery School
spots.desc: Why not try to cook several Chinese dishes? Great time and good food. Several courses available with four dishes in each. Visit the local market to buy all the fresh veggies. Can be booked direct or through several guesthouses in Dali.
spots.addr: East Gate Village, Dali Old Town

spots.name: Ruben's Belgian Waffles
spots.local: 红龙井比利时挖福饼; bǐlìshí wāfúbǐng
spots.desc: This small waffle place, which is run by Belgian expat Ruben, offers delicious Belgian waffles, with several toppings available.
spots.addr: Corner of Fuxing Road and Honglong Jing (waterfall street), next to Dico's (红龙井和复兴路的十字路口,德克士旁边)

spots.name: The Sweet Tooth
spots.local: Sweet Tooth 甜点屋; Sweet Tooth Tiándiǎnwū
spots.desc: This cafe specializes in pastries and desserts. The cafe is owned and operated by local hard-of-hearing people. Serves delicious and high quality desserts, coffee and milkshakes.
spots.addr: 52 Boai Road (博爱路52号; Bó'àilù)

spots.name: Cafe de Jack
spots.desc: Dali's oldest Western cafe. Has a fireplace, great apple pie, pleasant atmosphere and a great rooftop garden. While the menu is a little tired, the breakfast is good, as well as the chocolate cake and the lasagne. Spread over three levels, Cafe de Jack is the largest and most successful of the backpacker cafe/bars in Dali. Very popular with locals and travellers alike. The owners, local brothers…
spots.addr: 82 Boai Road (博爱路82号; Bó'àilù)

spots.name: Bakery 88
spots.desc: This German-style bakery is easy to spot and has a great cake selection visible from the street. Run by a long term German resident, Karine, and is popular with both foreigners and locals.
spots.addr: 88 Boai Road (博爱路88号; Bó'àilù)

spots.name: Black Dragon Cafe
spots.desc: The best coffee, and generous, mouth-watering meals - the wraps (chicken, beef, smoked tofu) are a speciality. A good selection of books to borrow or buy.
spots.addr: No.42 Centre Square, Foreigner Street 人街中心广场42号

spots.name: Jim's Peace Cafe
spots.local: 大理吉姆和平饭店; Dàlǐ Jímǔhépíng Fàndiàn
spots.desc: Excellent Tibetan goulash, vegetarian or with yak meat. All-you-can-eat banquet for groups of four or more, ¥30 a head. Various other dishes. One of the town's oldest traveller hangouts.
spots.addr: Boai Road

spots.name: Old Dali Four Seasons Inn
spots.desc: Great place to meet people and pick up travel tips; the Inn is a major backpacker hangout and people discusses their next expedition over breakfast. Has relocated and no longer provide all-you-can-eat breakfast.
spots.addr: 55 Boai Road (博爱路55号; Bó'àilù)

spots.name: La Stella's Pizzeria
spots.desc: A well-run operation making generous portions of delicious woodfired pizzas, pastas, salads and Chinese dishes at good-value prices. They also have a wide selection of alcoholic beverages. The staff speak English, and there is a travel agent out the back of the three-storey restaurant. Worth a visit.
spots.addr: 21 Huguo Road, Dali Old Town (护国路21号, Hùguólù)

spots.name: LP café
spots.desc: It's the sort of place every neighbourhood would be lucky to have. The staff are friendly, the food thoughtfully composed and prepared. Serves deli style sandwiches and snacks made with high quality ingredients. Has a good selection of imported wine and liquors.
spots.addr: A18 Hong Longjing Road (红龙井A18号)

spots.name: Bad Monkey
spots.desc: Dali's longest running foreign bar. It is hosted by two well-travelled Englishmen Carl and Scott who entertain guests before the dancing starts later in the evening with a Derek and Clive patter of jokes and one-liners. The Monkey is a magnet to foreign and Chinese travelers (many of whom seem to wander in and never leave), and remains popular with Dali locals. The bar has a pool table, dancing…
spots.addr: 59 Renmin Road, Dali Old Town (人民路59号; Rénmínlù)

spots.name: Daliba
spots.desc: The first flavoured vodka bar in China, owned by Vanessa from Guizhou province. More than 30 flavoured vodkas made by Vanessa and Kiki, beer and cocktails are available too!
spots.addr: 260 Renmin Road, Dali Old Town

spots.name: 非常麻辣烫
spots.desc: This restaurant/bar makes an evening trip to the south of the lake worth it. They offer extremely kitschy Revolution-era Chinese military and cultural memorabilia decor, as well as one of the most friendly and talkative owners in the area, but the main attraction is the food and booze. Try their various homemade flavoured liquors made from local fruit: the Plum Baijiu is a favourite (梅子酒). The…
spots.addr: Xiaguan, Renminjie (下关，人民街)

spots.name: Neverland Cafe
spots.desc: On Bo Ai Lu has homemade wine and fruit wines, and needs your help in advising how to blend good wines. Great baked potatoes with tuna fish topping. Owner speaks English and listens to Billie Holiday.

spots.name: 苍山半山咖啡馆
spots.desc: A rustic cafe perched on the slopes of Cangshan Mountain, accessible only by foot via a scenic hiking path. It offers locally sourced coffee and tea with breathtaking, uninterrupted views of Erhai Lake and the Dali Old Town below.
spots.addr: Mid-level of Cangshan Mountain, near a hiking trail

spots.name: Jingning Pagoda
spots.desc: A tower on top of a hill visible from most of the city, with an impressive view of the area. Depending on fitness level and how direct of a path you choose, the hike could take 30 minutes to one hour. The trails up are mostly covered and paved. You can visit the interior of the tower to see some local art, but there are no windows. A shuttle up to the tower is available.

spots.name: Tiansheng Cave
spots.desc: A park with a very large and impressive cave. There are colored lights inside that make for some very nice photos. The trail inside is well marked and is an easy walk.

spots.name: Emerald Mountain Film and TV Set
spots.desc: A filming location that is also a theme park. There is a roughly 4km road up to the summit, and on the way there are different attractions such as a Chinese village with some shopping, temples, a glass bridge, and a mountain slide.
spots.price: Entrance is ¥10, includes the temples and village. Round trip shuttle to the summit is ¥20. Other attractions ¥20 each
spots.addr: 370 Wangsantun Village, Cuifeng Street

spots.name: Qilin Water Town
spots.desc: A wetland park with trails, boat rides, and lots of flowers. Very striking when the lavender and lotus are blooming.
spots.addr: Xinwei Community, Yanjiang Subdistrict

spots.name: Qujing Museum
spots.desc: A comprehensive museum presenting the history, archaeology and regional culture of Qujing. Its permanent exhibitions cover topics including the source of the Pearl River, local Cuan culture and the history of eastern Yunnan.
spots.hours: Tu-Su 09:00-16:30, last entry 16:00; closed Mondays except public holidays

spots.name: Baishijiang Park
spots.desc: A large urban park along the Baishijiang River, covering about 15 hectares. The park has walking paths, landscaped areas and recreational facilities, and also incorporates displays related to the historical Battle of Baishijiang.
spots.addr: 281 Qilin North Road

spots.name: Qujing Bund
spots.desc: A large outdoor market with shops, street food, restaurants, and bars. Especially busy on weekends. It is popular with young people and is the nightlife capital of the city.
spots.addr: 168 Sanjiang Ave

spots.name: Qilin Alley Commercial Street
spots.desc: A popular shopping street with tea, coffee, and restaurants.
spots.addr: Off of Qilin South Road

spots.name: Tanghang Road
spots.desc: Relatively quiet during the day, in the late afternoon vendors come out to sell snacks and other crafts. It also has many teahouses and bars, with a much more quiet vibe than the Bund.

spots.name: Jinlinwan Love Town
spots.desc: A large leisure and tourism complex centred on flower gardens and themed landscapes. Attractions include seasonal flower fields, landscaped walking areas, recreational facilities and photography spots. The site is especially popular during the spring flowering season.
spots.addr: 1 Jinlinwan Avenue, Qilin District

spots.name: 218 Square
spots.desc: Not as international as Kunming or larger cities, but this is where you'll find KFC, Starbucks, etc along with many other shops. There is a pop-up afternoon market on the terrace.
spots.addr: 218 Liaokuo South Road

spots.name: Wanda Square
spots.desc: The other big mall in Qujing, a bit west of downtown and nearby the Bund. Similar to 218 Square.
spots.addr: 361 Xuefu Street

spots.name: Walmart
spots.desc: Unlike other cities in China, Walmart is still going strong in Qujing. A very large store that has just about everything you could need.
spots.addr: 28 Jiaotong Street

spots.name: Yuan Yi
spots.desc: A restaurant that cannot be missed. It has a stylish wood decor with lots of little alcoves, a large selection of western food, and a full bar. They also pride themselves on employing women who otherwise find it difficult to find work. The pin is their primary location, not to be confused with their offshoot hotpot restaurant around the corner. They also have a new location on the east side of…
spots.addr: A-29, Qilin Xiang Walking Street

spots.name: Joy Bakery
spots.desc: A chain with many locations throughout the city. An excellent bakery that makes good sandwiches, cakes, and other baked goods.

spots.name: Jingchen Garden
spots.desc: A Qujing chain that is rapidly expanding throughout Yunnan. A clean, budget restaurant that has many local specialties. There are many in the city, and definitely worth a visit.

spots.name: Blue Umbrella Coffee (mo gu coffee)
spots.local: 蓝伞伞咖啡馆 mo gu coffee
spots.desc: A modern café in Wenyuan Square serving coffee, fruit tea, desserts and light snacks. It has indoor seating and is a convenient stop while exploring central Malong.
spots.addr: 16 Wenyuan Square, Malong District

spots.name: Yuanben Coffee (Changhe)
spots.desc: A local café in Changhe Community serving coffee and other drinks in a relaxed courtyard-style setting. It stays open late and is suitable for an evening coffee or casual drink.
spots.addr: C-9, Group 6, Changhe Community, Baishijiang Subdistrict

spots.name: zha laqueni
spots.desc: Main peak of Bai Ma mountain (白马雪山) aka Bai Mang mountain (白茫雪山).

spots.name: Kawagarbo
spots.desc: Main peak of Meili mountain (梅里雪山). Best viewed from Fei Lai Si (飞来寺) at sun rise.

spots.name: Former Residence of Nie Er
spots.desc: Nie Er's former residence is a traditional Chinese house made of wood. It was built by his great grandfather during the late Qing Dynasty. Nie Er lived here during his childhood and often came back here to visit his family. The house is now a museum.
spots.addr: 3 Beimen Street, Hongta District (红塔区北门街3号)

spots.name: Former Site of Wenxingxiang
spots.desc: Wenxingxiang was a textile business that operated here in the 1930s and 1940s. The building has a unique design, which combines elements of both Chinese and Western architectural styles. As of 2024-03-22, there is a tall fence surrounding the whole building such that you can only see the second floor sticking out unless you can get to a higher vantage point in a nearby building.
spots.addr: 2-63 Qiyang Road, Hongta District (红塔区棋阳路62-2号)

spots.name: Red Pagoda
spots.desc: The Red Pagoda is one of the city's major landmarks. It was built in 1839 and was originally known as the White Pagoda. In 1958, it was painted red and renamed accordingly. Hongta District takes its name from the pagoda.
spots.addr: Hongta Industrial Tourism Park, Hongta District (红塔区红塔工业旅游园)

spots.name: Yuxi Kiln Site
spots.desc: An old ceramics kiln believed to have been constructed in either the late Yuan Dynasty or the early Ming Dynasty.
spots.addr: 112 Hongta Avenue, Hongta District 红塔区红塔大道112号

spots.name: Yuxi Hongta Wanda Plaza
spots.desc: With over 170 brands, it provides fashion, leisure, parent-child and entertainment facilities
spots.addr: No. 66 Qiyang Road, Hongta District

spots.name: Hongyuan Restaurant
spots.desc: A popular local restaurant in Hongta District serving Yunnan-style and regional dishes. It has a large dining area and private rooms, making it suitable for families and groups. Average spending is around ¥54 per person.
spots.addr: Hongyuan Catering Culture Plaza, intersection of Lanxi Road and Shanhu Road, Hongta District

spots.name: Nanhai Ge Tianxia
spots.desc: A local hotpot restaurant specialising in pigeon dishes, including roasted pigeon and pigeon hotpot. Private rooms and a children's play area are available.
spots.addr: 86 Fenghuang Road, Hongta District

spots.name: Cafe Fin Du Monde
spots.desc: Historically well visited spot for foreign visitors, though still mostly local. If you are interested in international alcohols, they have imported wines from a few countries as well as German beers and a smattering of western food.
spots.addr: 小庙街三组团32

spots.name: Pu'er Museum
spots.desc: Part of a cluster of museums in the same building complex, which also includes the Pu'er Museum of Urban Planning, Science and Technology (普洱市城市规划与科技馆), the Pu'er Art Museum (普洱市美术馆) and the Pu'er Tea Museum (普洱茶博物馆).
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: No. 10 Pu'er Culture Center, Binhe Road, Simao District (思茅区滨河路普洱市文化中心10号)

spots.name: Pu'er Tropical Botanical Garden
spots.desc: It is a botanical garden northwest of Pu'er City that is dominated by tropical and subtropical plants. It is a paradise for biological enthusiasts and photographers.There are many characteristic areas in the park, such as tropical rainforests, coffee growing areas and wildlife reserves, which are a good place to understand the tropical ecological environment.

spots.name: Pu'er Tea Culture Square
spots.desc: Pu'er Tea Culture Square is one of the landmarks of Pu'er City, and there are many cultural facilities such as sculptures and exhibition halls on Pu'er Tea, which reflects Pu'er's unique charm as a "tea capital". There is a huge tea sculpture in the square, which is a symbol of Pu'er tea culture. In addition, there are regular tea cultural festivals, tea performances and other activities…

spots.name: Baoshan Museum
spots.desc: A small but comprehensive museum. Has exhibitions on the natural history of the prefecture, the ethnic minorities that inhabit the area, and Baoshan's experience during World War II.
spots.addr: Longyang Road, Longyang District (隆阳区隆阳路)

spots.name: Baoshan Qinghuahai National Wetland Park
spots.local: 保山青华海国家湿地公园
spots.desc: An important breeding ground for dozens of different bird species. The best time to see the birds is in the winter months. The park also includes some manmade attractions such as the Yongchang Pavilion.
spots.addr: Longyang District (隆阳区)

spots.name: Taibao Park
spots.desc: One of Baoshan's oldest parks. The park is centered around Taibao Hill, a prominent hill in the middle of the city. The hill isn't hard to climb and you can get some good views of the city. Also within the park are several temples as well as a zoo and a museum.
spots.price: Entry to the park is free but some attractions within the park charge a small fee
spots.addr: Baoxiu Road West, Longyang District (隆阳区保岫西路)

spots.name: Museum of Famous Historical Figures in Baoshan
spots.desc: Displays busts of many of the famous people who have lived in Baoshan. Each bust has biographical information beneath it in Chinese and English.

spots.name: Taibao Park Zoo
spots.desc: A fairly typical old-style Chinese zoo featuring sad-looking animals in cramped spartan cages. Has bears, lions, monkeys, and other popular zoo animals.
spots.addr: 114 Baoxiu Road West, Longyang District (隆阳区保岫西路114号)

spots.name: Wuhou Temple
spots.desc: A 19th century temple dedicated to Zhu Geliang, a famous statesman and military strategist of the Three Kingdoms period.

spots.name: Yiluo Pool
spots.desc: A small scenic lake on the south side of Yiluo Park. Surrounding features include a World War II memorial, a Buddhist temple and a pagoda.
spots.addr: 2 Longquan Road, Longyang District (隆阳区龙泉路2号)

spots.name: Cherry Valley Forest of Red Dawnwoods
spots.price: Part of the municipal Botanical Garden

spots.name: Din Tai Fung Restaurant
spots.desc: Famous Shanghai-style dumplings restaurant.
spots.addr: 40 Zhongguancun Dajie, 中关村大街40号

spots.name: Taihao Mausoleum
spots.desc: Mausoleum of Fuxi, a Chinese cultural hero.
spots.addr: Middle Section, Longdu Avenue, Huaiyang District (淮阳区龙都大道中段)

spots.name: Guigang Museum
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: Southwest corner of the intersection of Guilin Road and Xianyi Road, Gangbei District (港北区桂林路与仙衣路交汇西南角)

spots.name: East Lake Park
spots.addr: Donghu West Street, Gangbei District (港北区东湖西街东)

spots.name: Nanshan Temple
spots.desc: The city's largest and most important Buddhist temple.
spots.price: ¥9 (standard fee), ¥5 (persons aged between 60 and 69 and children between 1.2 and 1.4 metres in height). Entry is free…
spots.addr: Nanshan Park (南山公园内)

spots.name: Xianshan Pasture
spots.desc: Large, remote pasture area in the mountains.

spots.name: Huai'an Museum
spots.desc: A museum about the history and culture of Huai'an.
spots.addr: 1-146 Jiankang Road West, Qingjiangpu District, Huai'an (淮安市清江浦区健康西路146-1号)

spots.desc: It was built in the Qing Shunzhi decade (1653). Sitting east to west, it is composed of the gate, front hall, stage, main hall, etc., covering an area of 663 square meters. Gate forehead book "Kong family Temple"; The front hall is three wide, and the gate is hung with a straight gold plaque of "The Most Holy Descendant" in the imperial book of Qing Emperor Qianlong; Stage with octagonal caisson…
spots.addr: Guanyang town Xikeng village

spots.name: Xiyang Old Man Bridge
spots.desc: Xiyang Old Man Bridge is a wooden structure of curved ancient bridge, across the Xitan, the only existing wooden beam corridor house bridge in Fuding City. It was built in the Ming Dynasty (1506-1521) and rebuilt during Kangxi and Tongzhi years of Qing Dynasty. The bridge is east-west, 30.4 meters long, 4.8 meters wide, 8.0 meters high, and 25.2 meters across. There are two shrines in the center…
spots.addr: Guanyang town Xiyang village Qiaotou natural village

spots.name: Shilan Castle
spots.desc: Shilan Castle was built in the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty (1573-1620) for the Anti-Japanese War. Built on the mountain, the plane is slightly trapezoidal, and the wall is made of granite stone, with a circumference of 1200 meters. The existing north gate and more than 200 meters of residual walls. The city gate is 2.7 meters high inside, 4.7 meters high outside, 1.5 meters wide inside, 15…
spots.addr: She nationality township, Kip Men

spots.name: Qinyu guards the tombs of soldiers in Taiwan
spots.local: 秦屿戍守台湾将士墓群
spots.desc: Since the Ming and Qing Dynasties, it was originally to bury the bones of local anti-Japanese soldiers and those without heirs and houses. In the Qing Dynasty, Qinyu left and right battalions began to draw troops to defend Taiwan, and after the soldiers were killed or died of illness, they were buried here after Zheng Chenggong took Taiwan and garrisoned it mainly with troops from Fujian. It is…
spots.addr: Qinyu town agricultural village

spots.name: Guoxing Temple site
spots.desc: The ruins of Guoxing Temple are located below Taimu Mountain in Fuding County. The tower was built in the Tang Ganfu period, more than 1100 years ago, for the pavilion style stone tower, seven-level octagonal solid structure, 8.5 meters high, the base of the leopard foot seat, the base is engraved with men, flowers, gods and beasts, each layer has a Buddhist niche, the lower center has the…

spots.name: The twin towers of Sanfu Temple
spots.desc: According to the Annals of Fuding County in Qing Dynasty, it was built in the ninth year of Yongle (1141) of Ming Dynasty. There are two butu before, so it is also known as double Fu Temple. The tower is a brick tower with seven solid floors. At the end of the tower, there are gold statues, treasure beads, etc., collected by the city's cultural museum. The temple's twin towers are county-level…
spots.addr: Bailin town Zheli village

spots.name: Yishan Island
spots.desc: Yishan Island is a quiet island suitable for camping enthusiasts. You can set up a tent on the island and enjoy the starry sky and sea view at night. If you like fishing, some fishermen on the island will provide fishing gear and guidance, so you can experience the fun of fishing on the quiet seaside.

spots.name: Jiulixi
spots.desc: There are some hot spring resorts in Fuding, such as Jiulixi Hot Spring, which is a good choice for relaxation. The hot spring water here is of good quality and rich in minerals, which can relieve the fatigue of the journey. You can soak in the hot spring and enjoy the pleasure of physical and mental relaxation.
spots.addr: Yunhe Road

spots.name: Qianqi Town
spots.desc: Fuding has some well-preserved ancient villages, such as Qianqi Town and Diantou Town, where the architecture is typical of southern Fujian style. Walking on the ancient stone slabs, you can feel the strong traditional cultural atmosphere, visit some old houses and ancestral halls, and learn about the local history and folk customs.

spots.name: Nodding Town
spots.desc: This is the core production area of ​​Fuding white tea. There are many tea processing factories and sales outlets owned by tea farmers in the town. You can buy fresh and high-quality tea directly from tea farmers and learn about the production process of white tea.
spots.addr: Diantou Town is located in the central part of Fuding City

spots.name: Shacheng Fishing Port
spots.desc: This is one of the most important fishing ports in Fu'an, close to Shacheng Bay. There is a lot of fresh seafood here at affordable prices. You can also buy various processed dry goods at the fish market.
spots.addr: Shacheng Town

spots.name: Agricultural Products Market in Diantou Town
spots.local: 福鼎市点头镇农贸综合市场
spots.desc: The farmers' markets in the city also sell a large number of seafood, especially dried goods, which are suitable for tourists to buy and take home.
spots.addr: County Road 973

spots.name: Fuding Times Square
spots.desc: This is a relatively modern shopping mall in Fuding City. It is located in the city center and brings together many brand-name clothing, fashion accessories, cosmetics and other commodities. It also has dining and entertainment facilities, making it suitable for young people to shop and relax.
spots.addr: The intersection of Fudong Avenue and Shuangyue Avenue

spots.name: Langyue Hotel
spots.desc: Tongjiang sea bass, a special product of Fuding, was registered as a national agricultural product geographical indication in 2010. According to the Compendium of Materia Medica, "sea bass is sweet and warm, beneficial to the muscles and bones, strengthen the stomach and intestines, and speeds up the healing of wounds."Tongjiang perch has a long history, and is known as one of China's "four…
spots.addr: No. 303, Yulong North Road

spots.name: Dinghan Meat Slices
spots.desc: Fuding Meat Slices, a dish made by hand of lean meat, starch and other raw materials, is a very famous local traditional food in the area. The dish is sour and spicy with a faint taste of coriander. It is finely extracted, ingenious in craftsmanship and unique in taste.
spots.addr: No. 474 Taimu Avenue

spots.name: Dapin Tea
