spots.desc: Fuding White Tea is produced from the buds and leaves of Fuding "Huacha No. 1" or "Huacha No. 2" tea trees, and its appearance buds are complete, the tea is apricot yellow and clear, and the taste is light. According to the different picking buds and leaves, it can be divided into: Baihao silver needle, white peony, Shou Mei, new technology white tea, etc. Pressed white tea has been launched.
spots.addr: No. 176, Jinfu Road

spots.name: Fuding White Tea Culture Museum
spots.desc: Here you can not only taste various types of Fuding white tea, but also watch tea art performances and learn about the production process of white tea.Features of Fuding White Tea: Fuding White Tea is famous for its sweet fragrance and soft taste. It is a lightly fermented tea and has good health effects. White tea is rich in amino acids, polyphenols and vitamins and is often regarded as a…
spots.addr: No. 1 Lianfengshan Road

spots.name: Tea Garden Tea Shop
spots.desc: The scented tea in Fuding, especially the scented tea with white tea as the base, has a refreshing taste and can soothe the body and mind. Common scented teas include chrysanthemum tea and rose tea.A variety of teas are available, including scented teas, which can be tasted and purchased fresh.
spots.addr: Inside Times Square

spots.name: Liem Sioe Liong Memorial Hall
spots.desc: Liem Sioe Liong (1917-2012) was born in a village in Fuqing. He migrated to Indonesia in the 1930s and later became a highly respected business person and philanthropist in that country’s Chinese community. This memorial hosts exhibitions on not only Liem Sioe Liong but also other prominent overseas Chinese entrepreneurs who originally hailed from Fuqing.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: Fuqing Overseas Chinese Park, north of the intersection of Yuanhua Road and National Highway G228 (元华路与228国道交叉口北侧华侨公园内)

spots.name: Houxi Tourism Area
spots.desc: Best known for its rafting river, the ‘No. 1 Rafting River of the East’ (东方第一漂流). The park also has walking trails.
spots.addr: Houxi Village, Yidu Town (一都镇后溪村)

spots.name: Yunshuiyao Scenic Area
spots.desc: This settlement is a bit larger than the others, and also contains an ancient town. The large tulou are not as dense and a bit further apart.
spots.addr: 南靖县璞山村

spots.name: Fujian Tulou Museum
spots.desc: Provides visitors with detailed background information on the tulou. As the museum is in Yongding's main town rather than near one of the tulou clusters, it's probably best visited at either the very beginning or the very end of your tour.
spots.addr: Hakka Exposition Park, 1 Longxing Road, Fengcheng Town, Yongding District, Longyan (龙岩市永定区凤城镇龙兴路1号客家博览园)

spots.name: Small Stream Bridge Restaurant
spots.desc: This place offers local food, reasonable prices and nice views over the stream crossing Taxia village. Favorites are chicken soup, boiled eggplant and fried bamboo shoots (that might be strange to the Western taste)
spots.addr: 塔下村61号(雪英桥往河上游10米)

spots.name: Huanxing Hakka Restaurant
spots.desc: Right next to the Hongkeng tulou cluster, this place serves traditional Hakka food.
spots.addr: 永定土楼民俗文化村东门环兴客栈1楼

spots.name: Three Sisters Inn
spots.desc: A guest house within Wenchang tulou that also offers local Hakka food and tea ceremonies, fresh veggies and an insight into the rural lifestyle
spots.addr: 田螺坑土楼群文昌楼18号

spots.name: Hakka Restaurant and Brewery
spots.desc: This square tulou houses not only a restaurant, but also a brewery or winery for the Nuomijiu rice wine. You can see the production process and tools, and do a tasting of different types and ages. Jars of Nuomijiu sell for about &yan50;-80.
spots.addr: Hongkeng

spots.name: Wudianshi Traditional Street Blocks
spots.desc: The heart of old Jinjiang, with many well-preserved historical buildings.
spots.price: Entry to the general area is free
spots.addr: Meiyuan Road, Meiling Subdistrict (梅岭街道梅园路)

spots.name: Six Victories' Tower
spots.desc: Six Victories Tower is the study of architecture and art precious kind of Song and Yuan dynasties. The tower is of granite attic type structure, 36.6 m high, around the end of about 47 m, octagonal five layer, the carved Seiko, magnificent, with something comparable to Quanzhou tower.
spots.addr: Shihu Village (石湖村)

spots.name: Gulangyu International Calligraphic Carving Art Gallery
spots.local: 鼓浪屿国际刻字艺术馆
spots.desc: A small gallery of carved calligraphy from Chinese, Japanese, and Korean artists. Entrance near the main gate of Shuzhuang Garden.
spots.addr: 7 Gangzihou Road (港仔后路7号)

spots.name: Oriental Fishbone Gallery
spots.local: 东方鱼骨艺术馆, Xiamen Eastern Fishbone Gallery
spots.desc: Includes personalized explanations of every art-piece and autograph of the artist.
spots.addr: No 27 Guxin Road (鼓新路27号)

spots.name: Gulangyu 100 Years Museum
spots.desc: A museum focusing on the colonial-era foreign residents of Gulangyu, in a building that was once a villa belonging to the Singapore-based OCBC Bank.
spots.addr: 62 Fujian Road (福建路62号)

spots.name: Gulangyu Organ Museum
spots.desc: The organ museum is in the Trigram House (八卦楼 Bagualou) in northwestern Gulangyu; it is the only and the largest organ museum in the world. Matched with the piano museum in southeastern Shuzhuang Garden, it attracts a lot of music lovers from around the world. There are many styles of organ collected in this museum.
spots.addr: 43 Guxin Road (鼓新路43号)

spots.name: Gulangyu Piano Museum
spots.desc: A museum of pianos, including rare specimens from the 1700s. The entry fee to Shuzhuang Garden (normally ¥30) includes entrance to the museum. Guided tours several times a day include performances on a few of the instruments.
spots.addr: Shuzhuang Garden, 7 Gangzihou Road (港仔后路7号菽庄花园内)

spots.name: Koxinga Memorial Museum
spots.local: 郑成功纪念馆, Koxinga Memorial Hall
spots.desc: A rather small museum dedicted to Zheng Chenggong, or Koxinga as he is generally known in the West, who made his mark in history by driving the Dutch out of Taiwan in the 1660s. His headquarters were on Dragon Head Hill at the south end of Gulangyu; a watchtower and some other fortifications remain, and the statue is nearby (see listing below).Having defeated the foreign devils, Koxinga is one of…
spots.addr: 73 Yongchun Road (永春路73号)

spots.name: Statue of Koxinga
spots.desc: A 24-metre-high statue of Koxinga stands on a cliff looking toward Xiamen Island.
spots.addr: Bright Moon Garden (皓月园), 3 Zhangzhou Road (漳州路3号)

spots.name: Kulangsu Gallery of Foreign Artefacts from the Palace Museum Collection
spots.local: 故宫鼓浪屿外国文物馆
spots.desc: Occupies a heritage-listed 19th-century building, which used to be the site of the Hope Hospital and Nurses’ School. The museum was jointly founded by the Palace Museum in Beijing and the Xiamen government. As the name says, the museum displays foreign artefacts from the Palace Museum's collection.
spots.addr: 80 Guxin Road (鼓新路80号)

spots.name: Shell Dream World
spots.desc: Part theme park, part museum. The museum is said to contain over 6800 varieties of seashells from over 60 different countries.
spots.price: ¥78 (standard adult entry fee), ¥40 (persons aged between 60 and 69 as well as children between 1.2 and 1.5 metres in…
spots.addr: 5 Gusheng Road (鼓声路5号)

spots.name: Bright Moon Garden
spots.desc: Bright Moon Garden (Haoyueyuan) is on the Covering Rock (Fudingyan) on the east (Xiamen side) coast of Gulangyu. It covers an area of 3 hectares (30,000 square meters, about 7.5 acres) spreading along the shore with a sandy beach, rocks, trees and pavilions. Its name is from two lines of a poem about a King of Yanping. In the park stands a bronze sculpture of Koxinga (Zheng Chenggong) and some of…
spots.addr: 3 Zhangzhou Road (漳州路3号)

spots.name: Gulangyu Aviary
spots.desc: Over 1000 birds from over 100 countries. Many peacocks, including a rare Albino, several types of cranes, lots of ducks/geese, and other large birds (e.g. emus). Watch for falling excrement. Aviary performances take place several times per day, including at 09:30, 10:30, 11:30, 14:00, 15:00 and 16:00.
spots.addr: Gusheng Road (鼓声路)

spots.name: Shuzhuang Garden
spots.desc: Named after the original owner Lin Erjia (aka ShuZhuang), a wealthy Taiwanese businessman who fled here when Japan took Taiwan in the 1890s. Highlights include the 44 bridge, the Piano Museum (see below) and the rockery with hidden sculptures of all 12 zodiac animals. There is also a small private art museum to the right of the main entrance.
spots.addr: 7 Gangzihou Road (港后路7号)

spots.name: Xiamen Underwater World
spots.desc: Admission is a steep ¥90 for adults, ¥50 for children/seniors, but you can just stand outside and take photos of the Jules Verne-esque octopus statue.
spots.hours: 08:00-21:00 (April to October), 08:00-18:30 (November to March), no entry or ticket sales during last hour of operations
spots.addr: 2 Longtou Road (龙头路2号)

spots.name: Sunlight Rock
spots.desc: This is the highest point on the island with great views as far as Xiamen. Entry included into Buddhist temple, the Aviary and a cable car ride to the aviary on Yingxiong Hill. Warning: climbing to the top involves a lot of stairs, so probably not good for young children or the elderly.
spots.addr: 62 Huangyan Road (晃岩路62号)

spots.name: Xiamen Academy of Arts and Design (Gulangyu Campus) - Fuzhou University
spots.local: 福州大学厦门工艺美术学院(鼓浪屿校区)
spots.desc: Has some beautiful granite sculptures. A very old Buddhist temple is nearby.
spots.addr: 151 Kangtai Road (康泰路151号)

spots.name: Yuanxiangkou Fish Balls
spots.desc: An award-winning shop that is most famous for its fish balls, which are stuffed with pork and cooked in a savory soup. Try the fish balls alone (¥6) or with noodles (¥8). Unless you're an adventurous foodie and/or read Chinese well enough to understand exactly what you're getting, however, skip the other "snacks" (小吃) even though they're supposed to be famous Gulangyu specialties.
spots.addr: four locations around Gulangyu; one is behind the ICBC near the ferry terminal

spots.name: Chu Family Coffee
spots.desc: Quiet and lovely place. They offer coffee, western-style food and desserts. A bit overpriced, like many of the venues on Gulangyu.
spots.addr: 15 Zhonghua Rd

spots.name: Mr Lin Shachamian
spots.desc: Local branch of the well regarded shacha (satay) noodle chain. Their specialty is the luxurious seafood version with abalone (鲍鱼海鲜沙茶面), but the meat version is quite tasty as well.

spots.name: Black Cat Coffee
spots.desc: You can come just for the coffee (~¥30-35) and a look at the restored home and gardens, but definitely consider their food menu. They offer à la carte options for seafood and mixed grill items for ¥100-140, and 4-course set menus for ¥160-190. The "Italian consulate menu" is good. It consists of a crisp roast duck caesar salad, a sweet and creamy pumpkin soup, choice of prime rib or…
spots.addr: 14 Yong Chun Rd

spots.name: Shang Lake Scenic Area
spots.desc: A lake advertised as similar to the West Lake in Hangzhou, but with far fewer tourists. And for a good reason. It is not similar, but a nice getaway if you are into a new Chinese park located "on" a lake (including a small tivoli) without many visitors.
spots.addr: Wai Xi San Huan Road, Yushan Town (虞山镇外西三环路)

spots.name: Yu Mountain National Forest Park
spots.desc: See the "Great Wall" halfway up. There are nice views of the city and Shang Lake. An old temple may be found at the top.

spots.name: Hey Benny's
spots.desc: American restaurant with wood smoked meats, great burgers, televisions for sports and small patio. Great place to have a drink as well. Show the taxi : 新欧尚漫猫咖啡. Walk around the corner and you will see a bright Hey Benny's sign.

spots.name: Ebizui Park
spots.desc: Located by the Yangtze River, the park is named after its shape, which resembles a goose's nose. Here, you can enjoy stunning views of the river, as well as tree-lined paths, making it a great place for walking and photography
spots.addr: No. 288 Huangshan Road

spots.name: Huangshan Lake Park
spots.desc: An ecological park centered on a lake, with beautiful scenery, ideal for family outings or relaxation. The park features lakes, small bridges, and walking paths, where visitors can enjoy boating or cycling.
spots.addr: No. 88, Gongyuan Road

spots.name: Changjing Ancient Town
spots.desc: It is an ancient water town with a history dating back over 2,000 years. Known for its well-preserved traditional architecture and picturesque canals, Changjing offers a glimpse into the rich cultural heritage of the region. Visitors can enjoy walking along narrow streets, crossing ancient stone bridges, and experiencing local customs. The town is famous for its peaceful atmosphere, traditional…
spots.addr: Southeast of Jiangyin City

spots.name: Feima Water City
spots.desc: A modern cultural and tourist destination, featuring a unique blend of traditional architecture and water-based attractions. Inspired by ancient Chinese water towns, it showcases beautiful canals, bridges, and traditional buildings, offering visitors a peaceful and picturesque environment. The area also includes entertainment, shopping, and dining options, making it a popular spot for both…
spots.addr: Xinqiao Town

spots.name: Xu Xiake's Former Residence
spots.desc: The Former Residence of Xu Xiake is the birthplace of Xu Xiake, a renowned Chinese geographer and travel writer of the Ming Dynasty. This historical site preserves the traditional architectural style of the Ming period, including the study room where Xu wrote his famous *Travel Diaries of Xu Xiake*. Visitors can explore exhibits detailing his adventurous journeys, contributions to geography, and…
spots.addr: Xuxiake Town (formerly Ma Town)

spots.name: Jiangyin Junshan Park
spots.desc: Historically, it was a place for the kings and nobles of the Wu and Yue periods to play. There are many buildings and inscriptions related to the history of Jiangyin in the park.
spots.addr: Junshan Road

spots.name: Former Residence of Liu Brothers
spots.desc: It commemorates Liu Bannong and Liu Tianhua, two prominent figures in modern Chinese history. Liu Bannong was a celebrated linguist, poet, and a key advocate of the New Culture Movement, while Liu Tianhua was a pioneering musician known for modernizing traditional Chinese music. The residence showcases artifacts, manuscripts, and personal items, reflecting their contributions to literature…
spots.addr: No. 49, Xiheng Street

spots.name: Huangshan Fort
spots.desc: Built during the late Qing Dynasty, it was part of the Jiangyin Fortress system designed to protect the Yangtze River from foreign invasions. The fort features well-preserved gun emplacements, underground bunkers, and observation posts, showcasing the advanced military engineering of the time. Today, Huangshan Fort serves as a patriotic education base and a historical landmark, offering visitors…
spots.addr: Huangshan Scenic Area

spots.name: Zhongshan Park
spots.desc: It is a historic and scenic park located in the heart of Jiangyin. It was built in 1928 to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen, the founder of modern China. The park combines traditional Chinese landscaping with cultural and historical significance.Key attractions include monuments dedicated to Sun Yat-sen and other patriotic heroes, as well as historical relics reflecting Jiangyin's rich cultural…
spots.addr: Chengjiang Town Center

spots.name: Turkish Restaurant
spots.desc: The expats' favorite! Authentic Turkish food prepared by Uighur cooks under the supervision of the mustachioed Turkish boss. The menu is extensive, the prices fair, and they have excellent hookah (fruit-flavored tobacco) and water pipes imported from Turkey.Some taxi drivers know it under the name 土耳其饭店, but most have no idea. Ask them to drop you off at the International Hotel 国际大酒店, then walk…

spots.name: Hanlin Korean Restaurant
spots.desc: Excellent Korean fare, bibimbaps, barbecue, kimchi fried rice, sushi/sashimi. On Huangshan Road, a little east of the city center. There is also a mediocre Korean restaurant near the pedestrian street.
spots.addr: 韩林碳烤 黄山路

spots.name: Wawa Jiao
spots.desc: The bastardized Sichuan dish called 牛蛙干锅 (lit: bull frog dry pot, a stew made of mostly thinly sliced potatoes, ginger, garlic and of course frog) is pretty popular with the Jiangyin locals and most agree that Wawa Jiao is the best place in town to sample it. Make sure you are not on any kind of diet because it sure packs a lot of oil. On Qingguo Road, 200 m south of the Datonghua Supermarket…
spots.addr: 蛙蛙叫 青果路

spots.name: Höfbrauhaus München
spots.desc: Large Bavarian restaurant at one end of Bar Street. Their homemade brews are tasty, if a bit expensive, and the menu is huge but the portions are a bit on the small side. They sometimes have German or Filipino bands playing live.
spots.addr: 德国酒吧 酒吧街

spots.name: Seasons Bar
spots.desc: Just because there are occasionally scantily-clad Filipinas singing covers of popular English-language songs.

spots.name: City Hunter Pub
spots.desc: On the western end of Shoushan Road 寿山路. Nice little neighbourhood pub, complete with regulars slouched over their drink and grunting one to another, and every surface covered with flags, beer coasters or sports team logos. The barman, Bob, speaks great English and plays Euro/American music videos on the big screen.

spots.name: Havana Bar
spots.desc: Also on Shoushan Road 寿山路. Lacking a bit in the ambiance department, but their beer selection is excellent. Pretty expensive, as can be expected, but the place to go for the best Belgian brews and even the delicious Dead Guy Ale, straight outta Oregon.

Near the Sports Stadium 体育馆 on Chengjiang Road 澄江路. Full of people on Fridays, but closes very early. They have by far the most extensive imported beer selection in the whole city (priced between ¥40 and ¥60; Coronas are ¥20), but their staff could benefit from a crash course in elementary beer science, ie keeping the beers cold and having a general idea of what glass to use for each. Other than…

spots.name: Boss Club
spots.desc: On 人民东路, by the little bridge. Popular with a very young crowd.

spots.name: Phoebe Club
spots.desc: Noisy and flashy. Occasional police crackdowns but highly unlikely to affect foreigners present. Some report that their spirits are counterfeit factory-made stuff.
spots.addr: 菲比酒吧 澄江路

spots.name: Tinglin Garden
spots.desc: A traditional style Chinese garden dating from the early 20th century. The garden is named after Gu Yanwu, a famous 17th-century scholar whose literary name was Tinglin.
spots.addr: 1 Ma'anshan Rd (马鞍山路1号)

spots.name: Bacheng Old Street
spots.desc: A historic stone-paved street in Bacheng with traditional Jiangnan-style buildings. The main old street is about 280 m long and has buildings dating mainly from the late Qing Dynasty.
spots.addr: 70 m north of 272 South Jingcheng Road, Bacheng Town, Kunshan

spots.name: Longchi Mountain Scenic Area
spots.local: 龙池山风景区, 龙池山自行车公园 Longchishan Bicycle Park
spots.desc: Longchi Mountain Scenic Area is a nature reserve where precious tree species grow, including golden pine and magnolia magnolia, which are unique to China. Longchi Mountain is also a Buddhist holy place.
spots.hours: Apr-Jun and Sep-Oct: 08:00-17:00; rest of the year: 08:00-16:30;
spots.price: General entry is free; charges apply if you wish to ride on the sightseeing car or hire a bicycle, scooter or other…
spots.addr: Shengzhuang Village, Zhangzhu Town (张渚镇省庄村)

spots.name: Yixing Bamboo Sea Scenic Area
spots.desc: Yixing Bamboo Sea Scenic Area is a national AAAA tourist area, a national scenic spot, a provincial forest park, one of the Eighteen Scenic Spots in Wuxi, and one of the top ten scenic spots in Yixing.
spots.addr: Zhuhai Village, Hufu Town (湖滏镇竹海村)

spots.name: The Small Devil
spots.desc: Italian. The food is alright but not spectacular. Pizza is hit or miss.

spots.name: Mai Tian
spots.desc: French and American cuisine; the filet is a great meat choice. Total meal is about ¥160. Food overall is quite good and there is a decent wine menu. This is the only restaurant in town with truly Western service (servers will let you study the menu before asking you to order).

spots.name: Night Jasmine Lounge
spots.desc: Night Jasmine Lounge. A really nice bar. The newest bar in town. A really chill atmosphere and really good beer. Serves draft Hofbräuhaus, a German beer that is brewed in Jiangyin. From the west end of walking street, head north. It's a couple of blocks, on the west side of the road. Highly recommended.

spots.name: Champ de ble
spots.desc: A very elegant place yet affordable.The food is excellent and the waitresses can speak English and are very helpful. They also arrange parties and have a great musicians to entertain the entire crowd during party.A great place to enjoy good wines and good food.Highly recommended especially if you are bringing a date with you.

spots.name: House Bar & Kitchen
spots.desc: Chill, casual place to meet locals and foreigners in Zhangjiagang. The House Bar used to be Hug Bar at Yangshe Laojie but is now rebranded and reopened at a different location. The pizza is good and there's a selection of foreign beers, hot beverages, and good food on site and delivered. Cool international and local staff with good spoken English, polite, warm and willing to take you as you are.
spots.addr: YangShe DongJie

spots.name: Echo's Cafe & Pub
spots.desc: Artsy little pet-friendly joint, and a crowd puller among both locals and foreigners. Lots of character thanks to Echo and Rachel, the co-owners, Olaf the dog, Louis the black cat and Zozo the newest kitty in the family. Nice outdoor seating in the summer and perfect location for people watching. Great selection of movies and music in English, European languages and Chinese. Great place to have a…
spots.price: ¥15 for small glass, ¥25 for a pint of Tiger on tap
spots.addr: 1-2, 2nd floor, Yangshe Dongjie

spots.name: Shanghai Songhu Memorial Park for the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression
spots.local: 上海淞沪抗战纪念公园
spots.desc: Dedicated to those who fought and died during the Battle of Shanghai, one of the bloodiest battles of the Second Sino-Japanese War. Has a museum and a modern pagoda.
spots.addr: 1 Youyi Rd (宝山区友谊路1号)

spots.name: Chongming Island National Geopark
spots.desc: Chongming Island is the world's largest estuary alluvial sand island, and the national government has made the entire island officially part of the park.

spots.name: Changxing Island
spots.desc: An ecological island at the mouth of the Yangtze River in Shanghai, well-known for its citrus orchards and the city’s largest country park. It provides a peaceful natural retreat with riverside scenery, outdoor activities and fresh local flavors, ideal for a short getaway from urban Shanghai. Visitors can enjoy cycling, fruit picking, boating, camping and family-friendly activities.

spots.name: Huangpu River cruise
spots.desc: At the Bund's southern ferry port with the following: One hour, two-hour and three-hour cruises on the Huangpu. There is a large number of ticket offices and the prices differ slightly.

spots.name: Bund "Sightseeing" Tunnel
spots.desc: A slow-moving tram, through a comically low-tech tunnel with bizarre commentary in English and Chinese. It is marketed as a Sightseeing Tunnel, however there are no sights other than 80s-era rope lights, lasers and some inflatables that look as though they belong in a car dealership. It is a rather surreal experience. This is the fastest way of crossing between the Bund in Puxi and the Pearl TV…

spots.name: 3 on the Bund
spots.desc: Houses the nation's flagship Armani store as well as several critically-acclaimed restaurants.

spots.name: Suzhou Cobblers
spots.local: 上海市黄浦区福州路17号
spots.desc: Beautiful hand-embroidered, Chinese-style silk shoes, slippers, handbags and accessories. A rare combination of historic and modern Shanghai styles.
spots.addr: 17 Fuzhou Lu

spots.name: Da Niang Shui Jiao
spots.desc: Part of a chain of dumpling (饺子 "jiaozi") restaurants around the country. Think of it like the McDonalds of Chinese dumplings. Some of the cheapest food on the Nanjing Rd. pedestrian mall, but be prepared with either a phrase book or a Chinese friend. Dumplings are ordered in "fen". "san fen" (三分) is three fen, a normal-sized plate. To order dumplings: number + "fen" + filling (pork, vegetable…
spots.addr: East Nanjing Rd. (南京东路 "nanjing dong lu")

spots.name: City Bull Steak House and Bar
spots.desc: Close to the Bund, great views of the Pearl Tower from the second floor location. Food is reasonably priced and caters to Western palates.
spots.addr: 300 Nanjing Rd. at Henan Rd. 2nd floor.

spots.name: Aunt Jia's Leshan Style Cross-Cut Beef Shanks
spots.desc: Very popular hot pot, with some great other meat and veggie dishes. The "glutinous rice dessert" is delicious.

spots.name: M on the Bund
spots.desc: Open for over a decade, Shanghai's original "new" western restaurant. Attention to detail is given to freshness, quality and presentation. There is an excellent selection of wines to complement your meal and the desserts are extremely tempting. Miele considers it one of the best restaurants in Asia. Also has magnificent views of Pudong from the 7th floor on the waterfront.
spots.hours: Mon-Fri 11:30AM-2:30PM, 6PM-10:30PM daily, Sat Sun brunch 11:30AM-3PM, Sun tea 3:30PM-5:30PM
spots.addr: 5 The Bund

spots.name: Roof 325
spots.desc: The location is atop the colonial-era racetrack clubhouse. The racetrack has now become People's Park and the clubhouse has been restored as the Shanghai Art Museum. The menu offers gastronomical global cuisine with French influence. The views from the glass-encased rooftop and garden terrace are spectacular.
spots.addr: 325 Nanjing Xi (West) Road, 5th floor

spots.name: Jamaica Blue
spots.desc: Part of an Australia-based chain with several locations in Shanghai and others around China and the Pacific Rim. Coffee and Western food of good quality, and a range of beers. Patio. Prices are on the high side by Chinese standards, but competitive with other Western restaurants.
spots.addr: 700号 Jiujiang Road

spots.name: Bar Rouge
spots.desc: A magnificent dance club and bar with a terrace on the 7th floor, overlooking the Huangpu River. If you order their signature drink (Bar Rouge), they set the bar alight.

spots.name: Captain's Bar
spots.desc: A cheaper bar near the Bund, on the roof of Captain's Hostel. Low-key but welcoming atmosphere, popular with backpackers and visitors to Shanghai, Captain's caters to a younger, less pretentious crowd — a rarity in the district (Cheap mochito for ¥50).
spots.addr: 37 Fuzhou Lu, near Sichuan Zhong Lu 福州路37号， 近四川中路

spots.name: EVA Statue
spots.desc: The 25.06-meter-tall EVA Unit-01 statue holds the Guinness World Record as the largest anime sculpture in the world. Modelled after the iconic mecha from the Japanese anime Neon Genesis Evangelion, it is a free, permanent landmark.
spots.addr: No. 1056, Wanrong Road

spots.name: Shanghai Acrobatics Show
spots.desc: All the impressive acts of a Chinese circus packed into one 90 minute show. The location is easy to walk by as the theater is hidden inside a hotel. Tickets are best bought in advance, especially for weekend shows. The good acts are up right from the start, so don't be late! An alternative is the Shanghai Circus in Zhabei.
spots.addr: 1376 West Nanjing Lu

spots.name: Jingan Kerry Center
spots.desc: Very new shopping mall with lots of restaurants, clothes shops and an electronics store. Good cinema. In the basement is an Ole' supermarket (a top range China chain) which sells lots of good Western quality food at very high prices.
spots.addr: 1563 West Nanjing Road

spots.name: Reel Shanghai
spots.desc: Brand new upmarket mall with busy food court in the basement
spots.addr: Shop 2A, 1601 Nanjing Xi Lu

spots.name: Jiu Guang Shopping Mall
spots.desc: Launched in partnership with the Japanese Sogo chain, this mall has a distinctly Japanese feel to it. Food court in basement as well as 'Fresh Mart' supermarket.
spots.addr: 1618 Nanjing Xi Lu, 南京西路1618号8楼, 近华山路

spots.name: China Mobile
spots.desc: Get a mobile phone SIM or topup at this busy store on Nanjing Road
spots.addr: West Nanjing Road

spots.name: Saizeriya
spots.desc: One of a Japanese chain of Italian restaurants where a decently-sized plate of pasta can be had for less than ¥20 and all-you-can-drink soft drinks available for an additional ¥6 from 11AM-2PM. Menus are available in English.
spots.addr: Jing An Temple station

spots.name: CoCo Ichibanya
spots.desc: One of a Japanese chain of curry restaurants, with seafood, meat, and vegetarian curries available and variable levels of spiciness. There will be seasonal items on the menu that change depending on time of year. There is a spice rating from 1 (mild) to 5 (hot!); most people who like spicy food will be happy with 3, or perhaps 4. Others should chose 1 or 2 and consider ordering a larger serving…

spots.name: Reel Food Court
spots.desc: Although not cheap by national standards, this is definitely a budget option in the Jing'an district. A clean and fairly large food court can be found next to Jing'An station in the basement of the Reel Shopping Mall, with fried dumplings to be had (4 for ¥6) to larger rice dishes and hotpots. Can be very busy.
spots.addr: 1601 West Nanjing Road

spots.name: Nanxiang Steamed Bun Restaurant
spots.desc: A branch of the famous xiaolongbao restaurant found in the Old City, but with significantly shorter lines.
spots.addr: 328 North Maoming Road

spots.name: Yang's Dumpling
spots.desc: Where the Nanxiang Steamed Bun Restaurant is known for its xiaolongbao, this place just around the corner is known for its shengjianbao, the fried version. Although there are several stores throughout Shanghai, this is the original, where it has been since 1994. Dumplings are made fresh to order, and there are other Shanghai specialties available. Can be busy during peak hours.
spots.addr: 328 North Maoming Road

spots.name: Bali Laguana
spots.desc: (巴厘岛), No.3 Jinan Park, 189 Huashan Road (near West Nanjing Road, 静安区华山路189号静安公园3号门 近南京西路). Standard Indonesian food served in a romantic and delightful setting overlooking a small pool that is particularly pretty at night.

spots.name: Lavazza Coffee
spots.desc: Italian coffee shop with outdoor seating area. Good location for foreigners and Chinese to meet up for language exchanges. Free wifi and serves pasta.
spots.addr: 1486 West Nanjing Road

spots.name: Tonkatsu Qitiao
spots.desc: Japanese Ton Katsu restaurant which is somewhat more upmarket than CoCo Ichibanya.
spots.addr: Level B2, Reel Shopping Mall

spots.name: Mr Harry Authentic British Restaurant
spots.desc: If you have been in China a while and want to enjoy a break with an English breakfast or fish and chips for lunch, then Mr Harry's is possibly the place for you. English pub style decorations and English beer available.
spots.addr: 5th floor, 819 West Nanjing Road

spots.name: Dos Locos
spots.desc: A copy of the Mexican-American chain, Chipotle, this restaurant serves large portions of burritos and tacos.
spots.addr: Dos Locos - Suite B1-11, South Phase, 1515 Nanjing Xi Lu, near Changde Lu (静安嘉里中心, 南京西路1515号南区B1-11, 近常德路).

spots.name: Beef and Liberty
spots.desc: A 'premium' beefburger restaurant selling good tasting burgers at a high price.
spots.addr: Shanghai Centre, G/F, Shanghai Centre, No.1376 Nanjing Road

spots.name: Sumerian Coffee
spots.desc: Offers coffee roasted on site (including coffee beans sourced from southern China) and nice wrap sandwiches.
spots.addr: 415 Shaanxi Bei Lu (near Beijing Xi Lu)

spots.name: Wagas
spots.desc: Related to the 'Baker and Spice' chain and serving fairly familiar Western food.

spots.name: Pizza Express
spots.desc: The UK Pizza chain can be found in the Shanghai Centre. It is better tasting than the fast food pizza joints around Shanghai, albeit at a higher price.

spots.name: Baker & Spice
spots.desc: Another foreigner-friendly option in the Shanghai Centre. Free wifi. Opens at 07:30 which is convenient for early risers.
spots.addr: Shanghai Centre, G/F, Shanghai Centre, No.1376 Nanjing Road

spots.name: Just Grapes
spots.desc: Wine bar. It is also a wine store, and has an upstairs restaurant serving salads, pasta, and pizza. This is the perfect place to taste a glass of good wine at the bar or outside on the wooden patio
spots.addr: 462 Dagu Road

spots.name: Dr Wine
spots.desc: Classic style of European wine bar, offering relaxed atmosphere and Italian anti-pasta
spots.addr: 177 Fumin Lu

spots.name: Stampede Karting
spots.desc: Supposedly the largest go-kart track in Asia, it's not bad, though the price leaves a little to be desired.

spots.name: Brilliance Zhonghuan Mall
spots.desc: Massive shopping mall with multiple restaurants and shops for clothing (including maternity clothing) as well as an Apple Store. This is also home to the only bowling alley within a 2-km radius and the only Baskin-Robbins and Uniqlo in the district.
spots.addr: intersection of Meichuan and Zhenguang Roads

spots.name: Macalline
spots.desc: Has a huge furniture and bathroom fixtures' mall. It is amazingly well-stocked, and the newer half can even be considered an attraction in itself for the truly bored.
spots.addr: intersection of Meichuan and Zhenbei Roads

spots.name: Shanghai Light Textile Market
spots.desc: Not to be missed. Despite its name, it also sells various knick-knacks, photo frames, paintings, shoes, and all kinds of dresses, among other things.
spots.addr: Cao'an Road

spots.name: Tesco Supermarket
spots.desc: Very large supermarket; Tesco is the UK's largest chain but Chinese branches mostly sell domestic Chinese products.

spots.name: Muslim Market
spots.desc: Diversity of food from Western China. They prepare the halal meat mostly on BBQ sticks, and serve with fried vegetables, rice or "nang" bread. The Chinese steamed buns (baozi) also originate from these peoples. One recommendation is lamb mixed with rice and carrot. The great difference of their food compared to Han Chinese cuisine is remarkable, for example the Muslim yogurt tastes very natural…
spots.addr: 1328 Changde Road, near Aomen Road (常德路1328弄4号, 近澳门路)

spots.name: Tiger Topokki
spots.desc: When Yi Pin Quan closed, two dining establishments took its place. Tiger Topokki is a Korean restaurant aimed at a younger, cooler crowd and is if nothing else, newer and less well-known (and thus less crowded) than Hanlin.

spots.name: Hanlin Korean Restaurant
spots.desc: A new Korean restaurant that has somewhat expensive barbecue and more affordable regular Korean dishes. The larger location on Wan Zhen Lu has closed so only the smaller mall location remains.
spots.addr: Mei Chuan Lu/Zhen Guang Lu

spots.name: Zheng He Park
spots.desc: A memorial park dedicated to Zheng He. It includes a museum and a replica of a treasure ship.
spots.addr: 1 Nanhuan Rd, Fuqiao Town, Taicang Harbor District (太仓港区浮桥镇南环路1号)

spots.name: Liuhe Tianfei Palace
spots.desc: An old Taoist temple that was founded during the Yuan Dynasty and rebuilt several times. The temple is famous for its association with Zheng He. Zheng He used to come here to pray to the sea goddess Tianfei (also known as Mazu) before embarking on his journeys from the nearby port.
spots.addr: 90 Xindong St, Liuhe Town (浏河镇新东街90号)

spots.name: Butterfly Temple
spots.desc: The story, to the Northern Song Dynasty has been very popular, the" Butterfly Lovers in the office around the legend" Zhejiang Ningbo, Jiangsu Jiangdu, Shandong Jiaxiang, Anhui Shucheng, Gansu water as many as seven, but the real Shi Ke test in Ningbo bridge township.

spots.name: Shui Mu Nian Hua
spots.desc: 5-floor complex. 1st Floor is reception and shower area with large heated jacuzzi and pools. 2nd floor is the lounge, computer, gym area. 3rd floor is the massage area. ¥278 for oil massage, and ¥378 for oil massage in the VIP rooms. admission charge is waived if you get an oil massage. foot massage is ¥60 for 60 minutes. 4th and 5th floors are the mahjong rooms. Open 24 hours a day.…

spots.name: Water Cube
spots.desc: It has a show from 21:00 to 23:00 daily with singers and dancers on the 3rd floor. There is a hotel in the same building.

spots.name: Fu Qiao Zu Yu tui Na xi Yu Xiu Xian Zhong Xin
spots.local: 富侨足浴推拿洗浴休闲中心
spots.desc: Big Korean letters indicating it uses a Korean system or style.
spots.addr: 慈溪市孙塘北路1101号

spots.name: Da Wei Ying International Hydrotherapy Hotel
spots.local: 大卫营国际水疗度酒店
spots.desc: The biggest spa in Cixi. They have a theater with performers and a transvestite from Thailand, resting area, private hotels. A massage in the lounge includes admission fee for ¥89.
spots.addr: 浙江省慈溪市浒山前应路1号

spots.name: Xin Zhong An Yu Chang
spots.desc: They claim to not have oil massage, only Thai massage, but the masseuse will give you an oil massage by charging you two hours Thai massage, but give you one hour oil massage.
spots.addr: 坎墩镇街邮电局向东200米

spots.name: Dong Fang Gan Xi
spots.desc: They will pick up your dirty laundry from your hotel and deliver it back to you.
spots.addr: 慈溪市青少年宫北路37－39号

spots.name: Tera Wellness Club
spots.local: 一兆韦德健身启明运动馆
spots.desc: the most expensive and highest class health club in cixi. has a heated pool. 3 floors. golf, bowling, restaurant, table tennis, badmington, weights, pole dancing, yoga, spin room.
spots.addr: 中国宁波慈溪市青少年宫北路458号

spots.name: Cixi Perfect Healthy Club
spots.local: 慈溪市帕菲克健身俱乐部
spots.desc: This gym has an Olympic size swimming pool. Dance classes, yoga, table tennis, weights.
spots.addr: 新城大道南路1119号

spots.name: Joyhe
spots.desc: One of the handful of Apple authorized dealers in Cixi. Get your iPhone fix here.
spots.addr: 慈溪市浒山街道慈甬路106-108号

spots.name: Minghe Ancient Town
spots.desc: Shops along the historic streets offer traditional snacks and local food products. Visitors may find regional specialties and edible souvenirs.
spots.addr: Minghe Town

spots.name: Ningbo Century Jinyuan Shopping Centre (宁波世纪金源购物中心)
spots.desc: A large shopping centre with retail stores and food outlets.
spots.addr: No.19 Jinyuan Avenue, Qianwan New Area

spots.name: Sanbei Bean Crisp Candy (三北豆酥糖)
spots.desc: A traditional regional confection with a crisp, crumbly texture. Look for it at local specialty-food shops.

spots.name: Yangmei Products (杨梅制品)
spots.desc: Cixi is known for its bayberries (yangmei). Depending on the season, products include fresh fruit, dried bayberries and other bayberry-based foods.

spots.name: C. straits Cafe
spots.desc: 3 floors with private booths and rooms on the 2nd and 3rd floors.
spots.addr: 浙江省慈溪市青少年宫北路96号p.c.315300

spots.name: Pizza Hut
spots.desc: A high class Pizza Hut. You will be seated by a waiter. It's not easy flagging down the waiters though. You have to yell out loud, "FuWuYuan!" to get their attention to order something.

spots.name: Club MT (Multi Track)
spots.desc: This place features 20-40 dancers on stage a few times a night. They earn a low salary, so if you want them spend time with you, you either have to buy them drinks or buy them flowers. They earn 50% commission on the flowers, and they expect you to buy them ¥300 worth of flowers. So they earn ¥150 to spend time with you with no guarantees of taking them home. There is bouncing stage and…
spots.addr: 慈溪市天九街183号（南苑柏隆旁）

spots.name: SOS Entertainment Lucky Bar Clubbing ROAMKTV
spots.desc: This is the largest club in Cixi. although the facilities are getting old. It's got two levels and private rooms as well. There is a counter bar on the first floor for the loners. bouncing dance floor.
spots.addr: 慈溪市北二环线西路136号

spots.name: Phebe
spots.desc: Very upscale. You will find the most foreigners here. The atmosphere is better than the other clubs in Cixi.
spots.addr: 慈溪市南二环东路1277号

spots.name: Liang Jing Jing
spots.desc: There is a karaoke lounge with a dance floor. The night will vary between customers singing, hired professional singers, and a DJ playing music.
spots.addr: 浒山七房池东南（新天地12－13号）

spots.name: Yin Du Ju Le Bu
spots.desc: Once in the lobby at around 19:30, you will find 20-30 girls sitting around waiting for customers.
spots.addr: 浒山孙塘路198号p.c.315300

spots.name: Jin Xing
spots.desc: you will find all the girls sitting in the lobby at around 19:30
spots.addr: 慈甬路新时代大夏5楼

spots.name: One Hundred Chambers KTV
spots.desc: Once you enter the main entrance and exit the elevators, you will see a row of DJ girls on your right to greet you and there is another room on your left with all the KTV girls.
spots.addr: 浙江慈溪青少年宫北路100号

spots.name: Jiangbin Park
spots.desc: A riverside urban park in Yiwu with green spaces, flowers and recreational facilities. It is a relaxing place for walking and leisure activities.
spots.addr: 333 Jiangbin North Road

spots.name: Ocean World
spots.desc: A modern urban aquarium located inside Yiwu Paradise. It features marine life exhibits, a deep-sea tunnel, coral and tropical rainforest areas, and educational and interactive displays.
spots.addr: Jiangbin Middle Road

spots.name: Yiwu Stadium
spots.desc: A modern multi-purpose sports complex, with indoor and outdoor facilities for basketball, football, tennis, badminton and other sports. The complex is used for sporting events and recreational activities.
spots.addr: 299 Binwang Road

spots.name: Yiwu Futian Wetland Park
spots.desc: A large urban wetland park near Yiwu International Trade City, with lakes, green spaces, plants and walking paths. It is a popular place for walking, relaxing and enjoying the natural scenery.
spots.addr: East side of Futian Road

spots.name: Yiwu Botanical Garden
spots.desc: A large botanical garden in northwestern Yiwu, divided into five main areas and featuring a variety of plants, gardens and scenic landscapes. It is a popular place for walking, sightseeing and leisure activities.
spots.addr: 355 Xicheng North Road

spots.name: Yiwu Paradise
spots.desc: A large recreational park on the north bank of the Yiwu River, offering amusement facilities and leisure activities. Attractions include a go-kart track, cable car, cinema, science museum and other recreational facilities.
spots.addr: 502 Jiangbin Middle Road

spots.name: Old Station · 1970 Cultural and Creative Park
spots.desc: Explore the Old Station · 1970 Cultural and Creative Park, a creative and cultural complex developed from Yiwu's former railway station and old industrial buildings. Visitors can walk through the renovated industrial spaces, see graffiti and creative displays, take photos and enjoy cafés and other leisure activities.
spots.addr: 135 Chengzhong North Road

spots.name: Exotic Street
spots.desc: Explore Yiwu's international atmosphere at Exotic Street, a multicultural commercial area with restaurants, entertainment venues and shops. Visitors can walk through the district, try international food and experience one of Yiwu's most diverse neighbourhoods.
spots.addr: Binwang Business District

spots.name: Yiwu International Expo Centre
spots.desc: Attend trade fairs, exhibitions and other large events at Yiwu International Expo Centre. The centre hosts commercial and cultural events and is an important venue for Yiwu's international business activities.
spots.addr: Jiangdong East Road

spots.name: Santing Road Night Market
spots.desc: A lively night market in Yiwu's Binwang commercial area. Visitors can browse clothing, accessories, toys, small commodities and souvenirs, as well as try street food and local snacks. The market is particularly lively in the evening and provides an opportunity to experience Yiwu's night-time atmosphere.
spots.addr: 19 Santing Road

spots.name: Yiwu Jiming Pavilion
spots.desc: Climb to Yiwu Jiming Pavilion for views over the city. The pavilion features traditional Chinese architectural elements and is especially attractive after dark when it is illuminated. Visitors can walk around the surrounding hill, take photographs and enjoy views of central Yiwu.
spots.addr: Jimingshan Park, Yidong Road

spots.name: Xiaozici Park
spots.desc: A historic cultural park in central Yiwu, featuring gardens, ponds, walking paths and green spaces. The park is connected with local history and culture and is a pleasant place for walking, sightseeing and learning about Yiwu's history.
spots.addr: 126 Chengzhong North Road

spots.name: Luo Binwang Park
spots.desc: A cultural park dedicated to Luo Binwang, a famous poet from Yiwu during the Tang dynasty. The park features green spaces, walking areas and cultural elements related to the poet, making it a pleasant place to relax and learn about local history and culture.
spots.addr: 48 Chengzhong Middle Road

spots.name: Binwang Market
spots.desc: A traditional wholesale market area offering clothing, textiles, furnishings, food products and other everyday goods.
spots.addr: 158 Binwang Road

spots.name: Huangyuan Garment Market
spots.desc: A large specialized clothing market selling men's clothing, women's clothing, children's clothing, jeans, pajamas, sweaters and sportswear.
spots.addr: 180 Jiangbin Middle Road

spots.name: Yiwu International Home Furnishing City
spots.desc: A large home furnishings market offering furniture, home decoration products, bathroom products, lighting, flooring, doors, windows and other household goods.
spots.addr: 1779 Xicheng Road

spots.name: Yiwu Communications Market
spots.desc: A specialized market selling communication equipment, mobile phones, electronic products and related accessories.
spots.addr: 215 Binwang Road

spots.name: Yiwu International Production Materials Market
spots.local: 义乌国际生产资料市场
spots.desc: A specialized wholesale market for production materials, machinery, equipment, lighting, leather materials, packaging machinery and other industrial supplies.
spots.addr: 1566 Xuefeng West Road

spots.name: Yiwu Global Digital Trade Center
spots.desc: A new-generation market complex combining wholesale trade, digital commerce, business services and commercial facilities. It features fashion products, jewelry, toys, household goods, smart technology products and other commodities.
spots.addr: East of Yiwu International Trade City District 5

spots.name: Yuyao Museum
spots.desc: Yuyao Museum presents the history and cultural heritage of Yuyao and the surrounding Ningbo region. It is located in the historic central area of the city.
spots.hours: 08:30–17:00 (May 1 – September 30, last admission 16:30); 09:00–16:30 (October 1 – April 30, last admission 16:00).…
spots.addr: Laoximen Road

spots.name: Siming Lake
spots.desc: Siming Lake is a large lake surrounded by hills in Liangnong Town. It is known for its mountain scenery, lakeside landscapes and natural environment.
spots.addr: Siming Lake, Liangnong Town

spots.name: Lizhou Village
spots.desc: Lizhou Village is a mountain village in Simingshan Town. Visitors can walk through the village and enjoy the surrounding mountain and rural scenery.
spots.addr: Lizhou Village, Simingshan Town

spots.name: Siming Mountain National Forest Park
spots.desc: Siming Mountain National Forest Park is a large forested mountain area in southern Yuyao. The park features forests, streams, valleys, waterfalls and mountain scenery.
spots.price: ¥50 for adults; ¥25 discounted ticket. Free entry for children under 1.2 m, seniors aged 70 and above, military…
spots.addr: Simingshan Town

spots.name: Danshan Chishui Scenic Area
spots.desc: Danshan Chishui is a mountain scenic area in Dalan Town. The area features red rock formations, streams, waterfalls, mountain paths and traditional rural scenery.
spots.hours: 08:00–17:00 (April 1 – November 30, last admission 17:00);08:30–16:30 (December 1 – March 31, last admission 16:30)
spots.price: ¥65 for adults. Discounted tickets for students, seniors. Free entry for children under 1.2 m and seniors aged 70 and…
spots.addr: Shilin Village, Dalan Town

spots.name: Tianxia Yuyuan
spots.desc: Tianxia Yuyuan is a landscaped scenic area in Dayin Town. It combines gardens, water features, traditional architecture and exhibits related to jade culture.
spots.price: ¥60 for adults; ¥30 discounted ticket for children 1.2–1.5 m, students and eligible seniors. Free entry for children…
spots.addr: No.85 Shanwang North Road, Dayin Town

spots.name: Sichuangyan
spots.desc: Sichuangyan is a natural rock formation in the Siming Mountain area. The site is known for its distinctive rocks and mountain scenery.
spots.addr: Dayu Village, Dalan Town

spots.name: Baishuichong Waterfall
spots.desc: Baishuichong Waterfall is a natural waterfall on Baishui Mountain. Water falls from a height of about 53 meters into a pool below, surrounded by rocky mountain scenery and streams.
spots.price: ¥20 for adults; discounts for students and seniors. Free entry for children under 1.2 m and seniors aged 70 and above…
spots.addr: About 4 km south of Liangnong Town

spots.name: Zhedong Jiuzhaigou
spots.desc: Zhedong Jiuzhaigou is a natural scenic area with forests, streams, pools, waterfalls and unusual rock formations. Visitors can walk along the trails beside Baiyan Creek and explore the mountain landscape.
spots.price: ¥50 for adults. Discounted tickets for students and seniors. Free entry for children under 1.2 m and seniors aged 70…
spots.addr: Zhilin Village, Dayin Town

spots.name: Arhat Valley
spots.desc: Arhat Valley is a mountain valley with streams, pools, small waterfalls and forest scenery. A trail follows the valley and provides access to the surrounding natural landscape.
spots.price: ¥50 for adults; discounted ¥45. Free entry for children under 1.2 m and seniors aged 70 and above with valid ID
spots.addr: Xida Line, Dalan Town

spots.name: Siming Mountain Geological Park
spots.desc: Siming Mountain Geological Park is a mountain park in the Siming Mountain area. Visitors can explore its geological landscape and mountain environment on foot.
spots.hours: 08:00–16:30 (May 1 – October 31, last admission 16:00);08:30–16:00 (November 1 – April 30, last admission 15:30)
spots.price: ¥40 for adults. Discounted tickets for students and seniors. Free entry for children under 1.2 m and seniors aged 70…
spots.addr: Dashan Village, Simingshan Town

spots.name: Yangtian Lake Scenic Area
spots.desc: Yangtian Lake is a small highland lake surrounded by mountain scenery. Visitors can walk around the lake and explore the surrounding grassland and mountain landscape.
spots.price: Included in the Simingshan National Forest Park ticket: ¥50 for adults, ¥25 discounted ticket. Free entry for eligible…
spots.addr: Simingshan Town

spots.name: Longshan Park
spots.desc: Longshan Park is an urban mountain park in central Yuyao. Visitors can walk along the mountain paths, enjoy views of the Yao River and Yuyao city, and explore the park's historic pavilions and cultural sites.
spots.addr: 115 North Binjiang Road

spots.name: Yuyao yangmei Festival
spots.desc: An anuual festival held during the yangmei harvest season. Events have included yangmei tasting, orchard visits, fruit picking activities, cultural events, and tourism promotions. The festival and related activities are held at different locations in Yuyao’s main yangmei-producing areas.

spots.name: Rock bucket
spots.desc: The bucket rock Buddha Buddha Scenic Spot is located in the west of Mount Huangshan on the eastern side of the Buddha, by a rock composition, except the face is slightly modified, the statues of sitting contours in natural Tiancheng, is China's first natural Buddha.

spots.name: Fengqiao Temple
spots.desc: Fengqiao Temple, built in the Southern Song Dynasty, rebuilt in the Qing Dynasty, there are bell tower, drum tower, ananteroom, stage, middle hall, back hall, east and west wing room and so on. The whole building is carved and painted with exquisite and majestic atmosphere. On March 31, 1939, in the 28th year of the Republic of China, Comrade Zhou Enlai personally visited the anti-Japanese front…
spots.addr: Fengqiao Town (枫桥镇)

spots.name: Xishi Guli Tourist area
spots.desc: Xishi Guli Tourist area, located in the south of Zhuji City, is a national AAAA level tourist area. The tourist area is dominated by ancient buildings of Ming and Qing dynasties, which are well preserved and can be called "Jiangnan Ancient Architecture Museum". It is mainly composed of the Xishi Hall, the Hall of famous Chinese ladies in the past dynasties, Fan Li Temple, Zheng Ancestral Hall…
spots.addr: 2 Zhuluo East Road (苎萝东路2号)

spots.name: Wuxie Scenic Area
spots.desc: Wuxie Scenic Area, located 20 kilometers away in the northwest suburbs of Zhuji City, with a total area of 50 square kilometers, is a national key scenic area, a national AAAA tourism area, and a national forest park. 72 peaks, 36 ping, 25 cliffs, 10 rocks, 5 waterfalls, 3 valleys, 2 streams, 1 lake, for the five drains constitute a natural landscape picture, known as "small wild geese" said. The…
spots.addr: Wuxie Town(五泄镇)

spots.name: World Robot Conference
spots.local: 世界机器人大会; Shìjiè Jīqìrén Dàhuì
spots.desc: Billed as the world's largest robotics event, held annually since 2015 and based in E-Town since 2016. The exhibition is worth attending as a general visitor. Recent editions have filled the halls with humanoid robots, robot dogs, industrial arms and live demonstrations.
spots.hours: five days, usually in August; dates shift each year, so check before booking travel
spots.price: Admission charged; tickets are sold online and at door
spots.addr: Beiren Etrong International Exhibition & Convention Center (北人亦创国际会展中心), 6 Rongchang East Street (荣昌东街6号), Yizhuang

spots.name: World Park
spots.desc: Opened in 1993, this park, as seen in Jia Zhangke's film The World, contains large-scale replicas of famous buildings around the world (including Manhattan's destroyed World Trade Center towers). There are also song-and-dance shows and acrobatic displays. Kind of fake. Not recommended among local citizen.
spots.addr: 158 Huāxiāng Dàbǎotái 丰台区花乡大葆台158号

spots.name: Lianhuachi Park
spots.local: 莲花池公园 Liánhuā Chí Gōngyuán
spots.desc: The earliest mentions of the Lianhuachi (lit. Lotus Pool) area are from the Northern Wei period (386-534). The modern park was established around the lotus pool in 1998, and has impressive flower displays. Just south-west of the West Railway Station (subway 7,9).
spots.addr: 48 Guǎngwài Liánhuāchí Road 丰台区广外莲花池路48号

spots.name: Garden of World's Flowers
spots.desc: Has 7 greenhouses, the largest within the 4th Ring Rode of Beijing.

spots.name: Lakeside
spots.desc: Popular spot for Beijingers on a weekend trip. A dam was built at this section, blasting a gap in the run of the wall. The flow of water from the dam submerges a part of the wall. So the classic view of the wall running into the distance as a thin, continuous line is interrupted by the dam. But the small man-made lake is a good place for kids to practice steering a boat when the dock at the…

spots.name: Xiangshui Lake
spots.desc: The hiking trail is a circuit and goes past partially restored segments of the Great Wall. There is a break in the Great Wall for what was once the Moshikou Pass, which was a strategic gateway. The pass was replaced by a dam constructed in the 1970s. A highlight of the Xiangshui Lake section is a segment of the wall running along a ridge that leads to the top of a cliff overlooking the gap that…
spots.addr: Dazhenyu Village, Bohai Township

spots.name: Jiankou
spots.desc: Jiankou is translated as 'Arrow Nock' in English, because the shape of the mountain is like an arrow, with the collapsed ridge opening as its arrow nock. There are many famous sections of Jiankou Great Wall, such as The Nine-Eye Tower, an important command post. It has three layers, and there are nine holes which look like nine eyes on each side. The Beijing Knot (北京结 Běijīng jié) is the meeting…

spots.name: Labagoumen
spots.desc: A mountain park with birch trees, located in the northernmost part of Huairou. A visit in October is highly recommended as it is one of the best scenic views of autumn colors in Beijing.

spots.name: Mutianyu toboggan ride
spots.desc: The toboggan down is a curious addition to the Mutianyu section and makes it feel a bit theme-parky, but it's quite fun and quite long (over 1.5 km) with an elevation drop of 100 meters. Just don't get stuck behind a super-cautious slowpoke. The toboggan run is a one-lane affair, and most of the fun is racing down like you're on an Olympic luge track. But getting trapped behind someone too afraid…

spots.name: Hiking Jiankou to Mutianyu
spots.desc: The hike from Jiankou to watchtower #23, the western end point of Mutianyu, is a popular wild wall hiking route that offers breathtaking natural beauty in late September, the best time for autumn hues. The trailhead starts at Nanjili (2nd sub-group of Xizhazhi village) with a 1 hour hike to reach the ladder for climbing onto to the Jiankou section. The hike to Jiankou is atmospheric with a…

spots.name: Hiking beyond Mutianyu watchtower #1
spots.desc: From watchtower 1, the path appears to end. But only for the timid. Look out the windows. On the south side (where the sun will be), there is a completely wild and un-restored section of the wall. Hang off the window or jump to the old section of the wall, and you are on a fascinating trek. Incredible old ruins of walls, beautiful isolation, wild vistas, and most importantly: your own, real…

spots.name: Camp at Lakeside Great Wall
spots.desc: Lakeside Great Wall allows overnight camping but not on the wall itself. However, camping is allowed on a high viewing area next to a watchtower. Another camping spot is around the BBQ restaurant near the boat docks of the Peninsula. The spot has the advantage of being close to restrooms but hardly feels like camping near the wall.

spots.name: Goose'N'Duck Ranch
spots.desc: Ranch with activities including go-kart racing, horseback riding, archery, paintball, both outdoor and indoor swimming pool, bowling, table tennis and party games. Overnight accommodation has poor reviews.
spots.price: One day package including food, beverage and internal transporting ¥260; Two day package including food, beverage…
spots.addr: 怀柔县怀柔北宅; Huáiróuxiàn Huáiróuběizhái

spots.name: Labagoumen farmer's market
spots.desc: An extensive makeshift farmer's market is located outside of Labagoumen at least in October. Labagoumen is extremely far north in Beijing, attracting farmers from the local rural area to bring out for tourists fruits, beef jerky, raw honey, and homegrown eggs (¥100 for a box of eggs).

spots.name: Yanhecheng Great Wall
spots.desc: A section of the Inner Great Wall, part of the double layer of Great Wall protecting Beijing.

spots.name: Pearl Lake
spots.desc: Good views of the mountain tunnels of the Fengtai–Shacheng railway which runs along the Yongding River.

spots.name: Mount Baihua
spots.desc: A popular day trip for Beijingers. It's a long 4km climb to the meadow at the top of Mount Baihua and the landscape is spectacular. On windy day a large misty cloud settles on top of the meadow which is filled with exotic flowers.

spots.name: Miaofeng Mountain
spots.desc: A mountain area known for its temples, traditional pilgrimage culture, mountain scenery and roses. The main peak is 1,291 m above sea level. Miaofeng Mountain has a long religious and folk tradition, and pilgrims have historically traveled to temples on the mountain to worship. Its traditional temple fair originated in the Ming dynasty and has a history of more than 400 years. The fair includes…
spots.addr: North of Jiangou Village, Miaofengshan Town

spots.name: Longjiazhuang Market
spots.desc: A traditional local market selling seasonal fruit and vegetables, local foods, snacks, dried fruits, daily necessities and other goods. A good place to experience local life and buy local products.
spots.addr: 160 m west of the intersection of Shidan Road and Longjiazhuang Ring Road

spots.name: Longjiazhuang Shaobing with Pork
spots.local: 陇驾庄烧饼夹肉热肘子
spots.desc: A local specialty in the Longjiazhuang area. Shaobing, a baked flatbread, is served with sliced pork and braised pork knuckle. It is a traditional local food that combines baked bread with cooked meat.
spots.addr: 50 m east of Longjiazhuang East bus stop, Miaofengshan Town

spots.name: Tianyi's Tomb
spots.desc: This is the most extensive and well-preserved Ming dynasty tomb of a eunuch. There is a Eunuch Culture Museum (¥8 entrance fee) at the same site.
spots.addr: 80 Moshikou Dajie (模式口大街80号)

spots.name: Beijing International Sculpture Park
spots.local: 北京国际雕塑公园 Běijīng Guójì Diāosù Gōngyuán
spots.desc: Opened in 2002, this park places sculpture from around the world in an attractive, green setting.

spots.name: Shougang Industry Heritage Park tour
spots.local: 首钢工业旅游; Shǒugāng Gōngyè Lǚyóu
spots.desc: A former steel production complex converted into an industrial heritage and cultural site. Guided tours explain the steel-making process and the history of the complex. Part of the former plant has been transformed into So Real, an intergalactic station-themed attraction where cosplayers gather. The blast furnace area is worth visiting during the day, but is particularly atmospheric at night…

spots.name: 工人 bar
spots.desc: Upstairs bar overlooking the Shougang steelworks, located across the street west of the blast furnaces. The house specialty is the "Blast Furnace", a spicy cocktail featuring a generous dose of Tabasco sauce.

spots.name: Randengfo Pagoda
spots.local: 燃灯佛舍利塔; Rándēngfó Shèlìtǎ
spots.desc: The oldest and tallest pagoda in Beijing and also the symbol and most famous landmark of Tongzhou.
spots.addr: Yongshun Road (通州区永顺路; Tōngzhōuqū Yǒngshùnlù)

spots.name: Artist Village Gallery
spots.desc: This is a very large gallery, which aims at making local Songzhuang artists famous and making it possible for them to stay in the village while they build their fame.
spots.hours: Daily 09:00-18:00, though it is a good idea to make an appointment before you go
spots.addr: 1 north of Renzhuang Village, Songzhuang Village (通州区宋庄镇任庄村北1号; Tōngzhōuqū Sòngzhuāngzhèn Rènzhuāngcūn Běi)

spots.name: Soemo Fine Arts
spots.desc: The first foreign (Dutch) gallery in the area. Houses some of the very most famous artists in China as well as artists just breaking through.
spots.addr: 66 Xiaopu South Street, Songzhuang (通州区宋庄小堡南街66号; Tōngzhōuqū Sòngzhuāng Xiǎopùnánjiē)

spots.name: TS1
spots.local: 宋庄壹号当代艺术中心; Sòngzhuāng Yīhàodāngdài Yìshùzhōngxīn
spots.desc: Promotes contemporary art in all forms and media. Represents eight artists.
spots.addr: 600 m west of Liuheqiao, 102 Highway, Songzhuang (通州区宋庄102国道六合桥向东600米)

spots.name: Grand Canal Culture Park
spots.desc: Park at the historic place where the Grand Canal strecting from Hangzhou to Beijing ended. Great place for a walk along the river and for showing your kite flying skills. The park also comprises playing grounds, cafés and a small restaurant primarily serving barbeque. Under the bridge you can roller skate during the day and dance in the evening. Except for winter, you can usually rent you own…
spots.addr: Tonghu Avenue (通州区通胡大路; Tōngzhōuqū Tōnghúdàlù)

spots.name: Tongzhou Market
spots.desc: Outdoor morning market in the old part of Tongzhou. Mostly food.
spots.addr: West Meizi West Street (西梅子西街)

spots.name: Xinbashu Shuizhuyu Sichuan Restaurant
spots.local: 鑫巴蜀水煮鱼川菜馆; Xīn​bā​shǔ​ Shuǐ​zhǔ​yú​ Chuān​cài​guǎn; lit. Xinbashu Sliced-fish-in-hot-oil Sichuan Restaurant​
spots.desc: Sichuan cuisine. The food is good but the service is not impressive.
spots.addr: 29 Chezhan Road (车站路29号; Chē​zhàn​lù​)

spots.name: Taishouxi
spots.desc: This is one of the best restaurants on Chezhan Road. Popular with locals, especially late at night when all other places are closed.
spots.addr: 21 Chezhan Road (车站路21号; Chē​zhàn​lù​)

spots.name: Dio Café
spots.local: 迪欧咖啡园景点; Dí​ōu ​Kā​fēi​yuán​ Jǐng​diǎn​
spots.desc: Modern café with both Western and Chinese drinks and food. However, the staff is not familiar with the Western stuff, and you seem to get the same coffee regardless of what you order.
spots.addr: Yunjing East Road (云景东路)

spots.name: Riverside Café
spots.local: 外滩风向西餐咖啡; Wài​tān​fēng​xiàng​xī​cān​kā​fēi​
spots.desc: Modern café with both Western and Chinese drinks and food. The best coffee in the district is served here. A nice place to hang out for a couple of hours. Free internet is available.
spots.addr: Chezhan Road (车站路; Chē​zhàn​lù​)

spots.name: Lower Chenjiapu
spots.desc: This is a section of wild Great Wall offering a challenging hike on the crumbling stones forming narrow causeways that are the remnants of the wall. By hiking west you will reach a long restored section in Upper Chenjiapu, a favorite camping spot. The area is right at the boundary area of Yanqing District and in Huailai County. The Great Wall Fresh provides transportation from Dafutuo bus station…

spots.name: Badaling Remnant
spots.desc: Located about 5km to the west of the Badaling section, Badaling Remnant is not merely an extension for overflow during peak periods for the more popular Badaling section. The combination of a more dilapidated condition of the wall and taller mountain peaks in the background give a more authentic feeling to the site compared to the perfect renovation of Badaling.

spots.name: Great Wall Museum
spots.desc: Visit the under-appreciated Great Wall Museum. The walk-through exhibits provide a good overview of the wall's multi-dynasty history, along with many artifacts from those time periods and photo-worthy models of watchtowers, scaling ladders, etc. The bathrooms are also probably the cleanest you'll find at Badaling (there's even a Western-style toilet). Great Wall circle-vision theater (40y/pers).

spots.name: Shuiguan (Water Pass)
spots.desc: Located to the east of Badaling, the Shuiguan section is sometimes referred together as the Badaling-Shuiguan Great Wall. It often happens that visitors are guided to Shuiguan rather than Badaling especially during holidays or peak periods. Besides climbing the wall, you can also visit the Genghis Khan Palace, the Stone Buddha Temple, Luotuo Peak (Camel Peak) and the Great Wall Stele Forest…

spots.name: Longqingxia (Longqing Gorge)
spots.desc: This scenic area is one of the most popular day trips in Beijing. The Lonqing Gorge is called the "Little Three Gorges" because of the resemblance to the Three Gorges near Yichang. The highlight is taking a boat cruise down the scenic canyon, which had been flooded by the dam completed in 1981. Cruise tickets are available for ¥60/person that take in sights along the water including Coronet…

spots.name: Yudu Mountain
spots.desc: A scenic hiking and family camping spot. The primary attraction is the mountain meadow, a large field with a view of the mountain. The Mountain Meadow is packed with families who have pitched tents for the day. For a quiet nearby hike, choose the route that goes to the Second Sino-Japanese War memorial on the mountain top.
spots.addr: Eastern Yuhuangmiao Village, Zhangshanying Town (张山营镇玉皇庙村东)

spots.name: Guishui River Forest Park
spots.desc: The park is suited for cycling. A well designed wooden plank platform overlooks the Guishui River which runs from the Guanting Reservoir on the border of Hebei and Yanqing.

spots.name: Four Seasons Flower Valley
spots.desc: One of a number of areas in eastern Yanqing with flower fields. The best time to see is July–August. Disappointing especially considering Yanqing was host the 2019 Beijing International Horticultural Exhibition, an international flower festival.

spots.name: Badaling Safari World
spots.local: 八达岭野生动物园; Bādálǐng Yěshēngdòngwùyuán
spots.desc: Large wild animals like tigers, lions, bears and wolves can be seen in this park from own car or park buses. Poor reputation for safety and treatment of animals. Alternatively there is Beijing Wildlife Park at Daxing District.
spots.addr: South of Badaling Great Wall

spots.name: Guyaju Caves
spots.desc: The 1,000 year old cave complex of a community hewn from the rock face of cliffs is an "archaeological cipher". The community halls and dwellings are huddled together in a fortified position. One idea is the community may have been founded by the Kumo Xi, a Mongolic steppe tribe on the run. As a Beijing attraction, the site is underrated and does not draw too many tourists. Bring your lunch and…

spots.name: Yongning town
spots.desc: The town is typical of small towns in China but with historical gems. It was a major garrison for troops during the Ming Dynasty. In the early 20th century it was a Catholic mission center with a church built in 1904 or 1905. The town square tower was restored in the lead up to the Beijing Olympics in 2008. Parishioners have beautified the Catholic church. On the weekends, there is a bustling…

spots.name: Pingbei Sino-Japanese War Martyrs Memorial Park
spots.desc: Dedicated to the many Chinese soldiers who died fighting the Japanese in the Pingbei region (a vast region which includes northern Beijing and northern Hebei Province). Inside the park is the Pingbei Sino-Japanese War Museum (平北抗日战争纪念馆), which displays around 200 photographs and artefacts. As of April 2021, the museum is closed for renovations. The reopening date will be announced later on the…

spots.name: Yongning town market
spots.desc: The town's market is bustling on the weekends and located on a street leading up to the town square tower. Vendors sell groceries, household goods, and antiques. The historic tower backdrop makes the street a small town version of Nanluoguxiang, a historic tourist street in Gulou. A local specialty sold in the market is cushions made of mugwort. Locals bundle the mugwort grown in the local area…

spots.name: 济源博物馆
spots.desc: It showcases Jiyuan's history, archaeology, and folk culture, making it a great place to learn about local culture.
spots.addr: Jianshe Road

spots.name: Dinosaur Museum
spots.desc: This is a cool attraction and outdoor park. There are several exhibits and large outdoor gardens. It takes 2-4 hours to see all the exhibits and gardens. To get to the museum a taxi will cost around ¥40 one way or ¥100 to have the taxi wait for you and take you both ways.

spots.name: Sculpture
spots.desc: There is a giant at the intersection of the main roads, one running east-west from the train station, the other north-south.

spots.name: Dinosaur Plaza
spots.desc: There is a large plaza near the centre of town that was under construction (2017). There looks like there is potential for a nice plaza with a dinosaur theme. There is loads of shopping all around. There was a fair in the plaza (July 2017). Several street barbecues set up every night just south of the plaza.

spots.name: Erlian Grassland Tour Loop
spots.desc: It is possible to use Erlian as the starting point for the Erlian Grassland Tour Loop itinerary.

spots.name: Central Market
spots.desc: There is a large indoor market with many small shops selling all sorts of goods from clothes to power tools. There are also many outdoor stores next to the market. There are many large shopping centers in the area also. There are money changers at the east entrance who will give you a decent exchange rate for Mongolian money if needed.

spots.name: Hulunbier Steppe
spots.desc: Hulunboer Prairie is one of the most famous grasslands in China and is known as "the most beautiful grassland in the world". The vast grassland, blue sky, leisurely cattle and sheep, and herds of Mongolian buns make up the most magnificent natural scenery. Visitors can ride horses on the prairie, experience traditional Mongolian culture, and even spend the night in Mongolian buns to enjoy the…

spots.name: Hailar Forest Park
spots.desc: Hailal Forest Park is a comprehensive park that integrates natural scenery and humanistic attractions. There are dense forests, clear streams, and abundant flora and fauna. The trails in the park are suitable for hiking, where visitors can relax and enjoy the tranquility of nature.

spots.name: Hailar District Museum
spots.desc: The Hailar District Museum showcases the historical, cultural and natural heritage of the Hulunbuir region. The museum contains a large number of historical relics, ethnic and cultural materials, and exhibitions related to grassland and nature. For visitors who want to learn more about the history and culture of the area, the museum is a great place to visit.

spots.name: Irguna Wetlands
spots.desc: Erguna wetland is one of the largest wetland in China, located near Hailar. The ecological environment of this wetland is very unique and is a habitat for many kinds of animals and plants. Known as a bird paradise, it attracts a large number of bird lovers and photographers every year to watch and shoot birds.

spots.name: Bayan Nur Roast Whole Lamb
spots.desc: This restaurant is famous for its signature roast whole lamb, a traditional Mongolian dish. The lamb is cooked to perfection, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, providing an authentic taste of Mongolian barbecue. It’s a must-try for meat lovers and anyone looking to experience a classic prairie feast.
spots.addr: No. 12, East Xinhua Street

spots.name: Hulunbuir Prairie Restaurant
spots.desc: This restaurant offers a wide selection of Mongolian dishes, with a focus on traditional prairie flavors. Dishes like roasted lamb and hand-pulled rice are highlights, and the environment reflects the essence of Mongolian culture. It’s a great place to experience authentic Mongolian hospitality and delicious local cuisine.
spots.addr: No. 1, Tonghua Street

spots.name: Mongolian Herder’s Home
spots.desc: Known for its rustic charm and traditional Mongolian dishes, this restaurant offers dishes like hand-pulled rice, lamb, and milk tea. The cozy, rustic setting provides an immersive experience, making it a perfect place for those who want to enjoy both delicious food and the authentic atmosphere of Mongolian herding culture.
spots.addr: No. 55, West Xinhua Street

spots.name: Prairie Feast
spots.desc: Prairie Feast stands out for its variety of Mongolian hotpot dishes and grilled meats, including lamb, beef, and vegetables. The restaurant is known for its generous portions and rich flavors, making it a great choice for those who want to try a variety of Mongolian dishes in a casual, friendly setting.
spots.addr: No. 88, Hailar Avenue

spots.name: Kazakh Flavor Restaurant
spots.desc: If you’re looking for something a bit different, this restaurant specializes in Kazakh cuisine, offering dishes such as hand-pulled lamb and traditional mare’s milk wine. The unique blend of flavors and cultural experience makes this an excellent place for food enthusiasts eager to explore more of Inner Mongolia’s diverse culinary traditions.
spots.addr: No. 25, South Taoyuan Street

spots.name: Manzhouli National Gate Scenic Area
spots.desc: The Manzhouli National Gate is the most iconic landmark of the city, located directly on the China–Russia border. The current structure is the fifth-generation gate, featuring a massive rectangular frame topped with the national emblem. Inside the scenic area, visitors can see Border Marker No. 41, retired steam locomotives, and the Manzhouli Border Defense Museum. On clear days, the gate stands…
spots.addr: 9 kilometers west of Manzhouli City, Hulunbur City, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, China

spots.name: Matryoshka Square (Taowa Scenic Area)
spots.desc: Matryoshka Square features one of the largest matryoshka doll buildings in the world, standing over 30 meters tall. The open square contains dozens of brightly painted giant dolls representing Chinese, Russian, and Mongolian cultural motifs. At night, the illuminated display creates a whimsical and surreal visual experience.
spots.hours: 09:00–21:00 (daily; the night view lighting time is usually from 19:00 to 21:00, subject to on-site notice in peak…
spots.addr: West of Wanda Plaza, Manzhouli City, Hulunbuir City, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, China

spots.name: Manzhouli Wedding Palace
spots.desc: Manzhouli Wedding Palace is a striking brick-red Gothic-style building on Dongshan Botanical Garden’s hillside, with sharp spires and delicate carvings. It mainly serves as a venue for wedding ceremonies and pre-wedding shoots, while also drawing tourists with its unique look. The hilltop spot offers a bird's-eye view of Manzhouli, making it a popular photo check-in landmark of the border city.
spots.addr: South of Matryoshka Square, Manzhouli City, Hulunbuir City, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, China

spots.name: Beihu Park (Manzhouli)
spots.desc: Manzhouli Beihu Park is a free urban park centered on a lake. It has lush greenery and waterfront trails perfect for casual walks. Summer brings boating fun, while winter turns the lake into an ice-skating spot. It’s a great place to experience local leisure life.
spots.addr: North of Minzhu Street, Manzhouli City, Hulunbuir City, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, China

spots.name: Manzhouli Mammoth Park
spots.desc: Manzhouli Mammoth Park is a theme park famous for its giant mammoth sculptures and grassland scenery. It displays dozens of lifelike mammoth statues, recalling the prehistoric ecological features of the region. The park combines cultural display and outdoor leisure, suitable for families and history lovers. It also offers ice-snow activities in winter, adding seasonal fun to the visit.
spots.addr: West of Matryoshka Square, Manzhouli City, Hulunbuir City, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, China

spots.name: Manzhouli Museum
spots.desc: Manzhouli Museum showcases the city’s border history and Sino-Russian cultural exchanges. It houses exhibits on local geology, ethnic customs and trade development. The museum offers free entry, requiring valid ID for registration. It is a key spot to understand Manzhouli’s unique border charm.
spots.addr: 22 Minzhu Street, Manzhouli City, Hulunbuir City, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, China

spots.name: Hulun Lake (Dalai Lake)
spots.desc: Hulun Lake is one of the largest freshwater lakes in Inner Mongolia. It boasts stunning grassland-lake scenery and rich aquatic biodiversity. The lake is a popular spot for birdwatching and lake-view picnics in summer. It’s a highlight of Manzhouli’s natural landscape.
spots.addr: New Barag Right Banner, Hulunbuir City, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, China (about 60 km southwest of Manzhouli City)

spots.name: Barag Mongolian Tribe Cultural Performance
spots.desc: Traditional Mongolian performances featuring music, dance, and ethnic costumes. These shows offer visitors an introduction to local grassland culture and nomadic traditions.
spots.addr: Barag Mongolian Tribe Scenic Area, Hulunbuir Grassland, near Manzhouli, Inner Mongolia

spots.name: Mammoth Park
spots.desc: Themed park featuring large mammoth sculptures and open spaces for walking and photography. It is a popular stop for visitors interested in Manzhouli’s border-region imagery.
spots.addr: Near the China–Russia border area, Manzhouli, Inner Mongolia

spots.name: Explore the China–Russia Border Area
spots.desc: Walk around the border-themed area near the National Gate to observe China–Russia border infrastructure and monuments. This is a unique experience available in only a few Chinese cities.
spots.price: Admission fee required for scenic areas
spots.addr: Near the National Gate Scenic Area, Manzhouli, Inner Mongolia

spots.name: Russian-style circus performances
spots.desc: Indoor circus and acrobatic shows inspired by Russian performance traditions, mainly catering to tourists visiting the Matryoshka Square complex.
spots.addr: Manzhouli Matryoshka Square
