spots.name: Manzhouli Wanda Plaza

spots.hours: 09:00-11:30, 13:30-16:00, no entry permitted after 11:00 in the morning and no entry permitted after 15:30 in the…
spots.addr: 1166 Longxiang Street, Jinxue Subdistrict (进学街道龙祥街1166号)

spots.name: Yanji People's Park
spots.desc: Yanji People's Park is a historic public park in central Yanji, located near the Yanji River. The park has flower areas, walking and jogging areas, and sports facilities such as football, basketball and table tennis courts. It is free to enter and is used by local residents for walking, exercise and leisure. It is also a good place to see everyday life in Yanji.
spots.addr: 151 Gongyuan Road

spots.name: Head Mountain
spots.desc: For a decent view over the city or a walk through nature, domestic tourists and locals alike visit this mountain, which is classified as AAAA tourist site and, surprisingly for a destination with this rating, has no entrance fees (as of 2019). Head towards the tiger statue; you begin walking on a boardwalk built through the forest, and soon have to climb up stairs – well over 1000 steps. Although…
spots.addr: Yanlong Road (延龙路)

spots.name: Yanji Dinosaur Kingdom
spots.desc: A dinosaur theme park located just south of the Yanji Dinosaur Museum. The park only opened in July 2022, so all the facilities are new and some have not been fully completed yet. If you can read Chinese, you can purchase tickets on the park's We Chat account (the account name is '延吉恐龙王国').
spots.price: Tickets for the amusement park are ¥198 for adults and ¥138 for children. Tickets for the water park are ¥138 for…
spots.addr: 1520 Longxiang Street (龙翔街1520号)

spots.name: Ma'ershan National Forest Park
spots.desc: A great spot for hiking and enjoying natural scenery. It is a popular tourist destination known for its dense forests and natural beauty. The park is rich in vegetation and offers fresh air, making it an excellent spot for hiking, climbing, and enjoying nature. Visitors can explore the scenic trails and experience the tranquility of the natural environment.

spots.name: Mengdumei Ski Resort
spots.local: Mèngdúměi Suǒshuǐchǎng, 梦都美滑雪场
spots.desc: It is a popular winter sports destination for skiing enthusiasts. The resort features a variety of ski slopes with different difficulty levels. The well-equipped facilities include rental equipment, dining services, and ski instructors.
spots.addr: Chunxing Village, Yilan Town

spots.name: Hands Coffee 핸즈커피 含旨咖啡
spots.desc: This small cozy cafe is pleasant and peaceful, which is quite rare in northeast China. It's a branch of a South Korean coffee franchise company. Serves various kinds of coffees (espresso based and hand drips), smoothies, cakes and fresh fruit juices in reasonable price. Waiters will greet you in Korean, but English menu is available. Free Wi-fi. It's next to the north bus station. Although the…
spots.addr: Xintian Building No. 103 Aidan-Road 743 爱丹路743号鑫田大夏103室

spots.name: Longshou Mountain
spots.local: 龙首山; Lóngshǒushān, Dragon Head Mountain
spots.desc: Longshou Mountain is located in Yinzhou District of Tieling City, east of Chai River, west of the city, across the north and south of Yinzhou. It is 1 km wide from east to west, 3 km long from north to south, and the highest peak is 156 meters above sea level. Because it came from the southeast, to the Chai River bank suddenly lifted up, like the head of a dragon, so the name Longhead mountain…

spots.name: Chaoyang Bird Fossil National Geopark
spots.local: 朝阳鸟化石国家地质公园; Cháoyáng Niǎohuàshí Guójiādìzhìgōngyuán
spots.desc: On this site during the 1990s, fossils were found that revolutionised human understanding of dinosaurs and the evolution of birds. In Chaoyang, they found feathered dinosaurs as well as some of the earliest examples of birds. Tickets can be purchased on the official WeChat account. The park reopened in April 2025 after completing a major upgrade.
spots.price: ¥85 (standard price), ¥43 (full-time students and persons aged 60 to 69), free admission is granted to children under…
spots.addr: 100 Longniao Street, Longcheng District (朝阳市龙城区龙鸟大街100号)

spots.name: Red Garden
spots.desc: A beautiful park set in Linxia's cultural downtown. Lovely temples with places to drink tea and have a meal in quiet grounds. The park connects the city square, from which you can follow the minarets of the numerous mosques in town including the beautiful Gong Bei Mausoleum (清真寺拱北)

spots.name: Gong Bei Mausoleum
spots.desc: Probably the largest of the many mausoleums dotting downtown Linxia. Shares its street with four other mausoleums of a similar style. Try to dive into the side streets behind this mosque to get a feel of local life. Ask for directions from the Red Park.

spots.name: Emperors Birthday Temple
spots.desc: The exact translation of this mountaintop temples name might not entice, but the views over Linxia are breathtaking. The temple looks down on the Red Park and Gong Bei Mosque with options to walk along the mountain peak for some distance. Standing in front of the West Bus Station (汽车西站) and looking towards the mountains, do not enter through the large and inviting gates but turn left and walk a…

spots.name: Museum of the Linxia Hui Autonomous Prefecture
spots.local: 临夏回族自治州博物馆
spots.desc: A comprehensive museum of the history and culture of the Prefecture. The museum is especially notable for its collection of painted pottery and other artefacts produced by the Majiaoyao Culture (the Majiaoyao Culture was a neolithic culture that thrived along the upper reaches of the Yellow River from around 3300 to 2000 BC).
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00 (November to April), 08:30-18:00 (May to October), closed on Mondays
spots.addr: Beibinhe East Road (北滨河东路)

spots.name: Antique Market
spots.desc: Has real and fake antiques. The selection there includes locally made bronze teapots, Tibetan metal and leather products, and porcelains. A traditional local product are eyeglasses of peculiar style.One product that travelers should NOT BUY are the furs. The skins of spotted leopards, an endangered species, appear on open display in the market. Leopard skins and other fur products have been…

spots.name: Red Park Cafe
spots.desc: Coffee shop (in the western sense) with a sleek modern look serving coffee, tea, bubble tea, and waffles. Owned by an English-speaking foreigner who can be helpful in getting information around town (as of 2016 this coffee shop no longer exists. Five out of five taxi drivers had never heard of it)

spots.name: Xumi Mountain Grottoes
spots.desc: During the Northern Wei, Sui, Tang, Song and Ming dynasties, more than 130 grottoes were tunneled into the eastern side of Sumeru Shan. Filled with Buddhist sculptures and almost 1400 years old.

spots.name: Guyuan Museum
spots.desc: Very nice collection of artifacts dating from the Stone Age through the Silk Road period to the Qing dynasty.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 133 Xicheng Road, Yuanzhou District (原州区西城路133号)

spots.name: Helan Mountain Rock Paintings
spots.desc: The Helan Mountain Rock Paintings are one of China’s most significant ancient rock art sites, located in the Helan Mountain range. These paintings reflect ancient grassland culture and religious beliefs, attracting many tourists and archaeologists.
spots.addr: Helan Mountain Range

spots.name: Shizuishan Museum
spots.desc: The Shizuishan Museum showcases the history, culture, and natural heritage of the Ningxia region, featuring ancient artifacts, fossils, and artworks. It is a great place to learn about the local history and culture.
spots.addr: 32 Wenchang Road, Dawukou District

spots.name: Shizuishan Yellow River Grand Canyon
spots.desc: The Yellow River Grand Canyon is located near Shizuishan and is a magnificent scenic spot along the Yellow River. With fast-flowing river waters and steep rock cliffs, it is an ideal location for hiking and photography
spots.addr: Yellow River Basin

spots.name: Longquan Temple
spots.desc: Longquan Temple is a Buddhist temple in Shizuishan, with a deep religious and historical background. The temple features grand architecture and is an important pilgrimage site for local devotees and tourists
spots.addr: Huihong District

spots.name: Shizuishan Beef and Lamb Restaurant
spots.desc: This restaurant specializes in beef and lamb dishes, known for its tender meat and rich flavors, which are loved by locals and tourists alike. The lamb skewers and beef hotpot are highly recommended, paired with authentic seasonings for a memorable taste.
spots.addr: Xinhua East Street, Dawu Kou District

spots.name: Xiaobaiyang Hotpot Restaurant
spots.desc: Known for its unique hotpot flavors, fresh ingredients, and delicious broth, this restaurant provides a cozy atmosphere perfect for dining with family or friends. The beef and lamb are particularly tender and worth trying.
spots.addr: No. 29 Changqing Street, Dawu Kou District

spots.name: Hao Weidao Restaurant
spots.desc: This restaurant serves traditional Ningxia dishes, especially hand-pulled lamb and local snacks. The flavors are authentic, and the prices are reasonable, making it a popular choice among locals for everyday dining.
spots.addr: Intersection of Xingfu Street and Shengli Road, Pingluo County

spots.name: Dadong Restaurant
spots.desc: This restaurant offers a wide variety of home-style Chinese dishes, specializing in Sichuan cuisine and Ningxia-flavored dishes. With friendly service and a comfortable environment, it’s an ideal place for family gatherings or casual meals with friends.
spots.addr: No. 17 Wenhua East Road, Huinong District

spots.name: Food Street (Snack Street)
spots.desc: For those wanting to sample a variety of authentic local snacks, Shizuishan’s Food Street is the perfect destination. It features many local Ningxia and Shaanxi-style dishes, such as Roujiamo (Chinese hamburger), fried rice noodles, and lamb skewers. The lively atmosphere makes it a great spot for snack lovers.
spots.addr: Dong Street, Dawu Kou District

spots.name: Ningxia Goji Tea House
spots.desc: This tea house specializes in offering Ningxia goji berry tea and local teas. With a quiet and relaxing environment, it’s a great place to enjoy goji berry tea and unwind.
spots.addr: Xinhua East Street, Dawu Kou District

spots.name: Sheep Milk Specialty Store
spots.desc: This store offers fresh sheep milk and related products, known for its rich flavor. It’s a great spot to experience and taste a traditional local drink.
spots.addr: Jinhu Road, Huinong District

spots.name: Shapotou
spots.desc: 沙坡头, Resort situated between sand and water, Shapotou Desert Research Center. Tourist area combines Tenggeli desert, Yellow River, mountain and oasis. Tickets ¥90 for park entrance, you then have to pay more if you want to do the attraction. You can choose a lot of activities in the tourist area - ride a camel, drift Yellow River (extra tickets).

spots.name: Cultural & Sports Complex
spots.desc: There is a museum to the south of the city across the river, but it is closed. The area around it has a library, sports arena, cinema and a cultural centre.

spots.name: Changtan Village
spots.desc: Visit the working 18th-century waterwheel at Changtan village then go whitewater rafting down the Yellow River to Shapatou.

spots.name: Kunlun Mountains UNESCO Global Geopark
spots.local: 昆仑山联合国教科文组织世界地质公园
spots.desc: The park occupies an area of about 7033 square kilometres in the eastern part of the Kunlun mountain range.

spots.name: Green Dragon Ridge
spots.desc: Narrow rock ridge with vertical cliffs on both sides (not for the faint of heart).

spots.name: South Peak
spots.desc: The tallest of the 5 peaks and during the day the most popular to reach that is not near a cable car station.

spots.name: North Peak
spots.desc: For most visitors this is the first peak as it is the closest to the north cable car station. It is only a 5-minute walk up. It has a height of around 1615 m.

spots.name: Central Peak
spots.desc: Not very spectacular peak but in the middle of all four directions and you can see the link between all peaks. You can also cut across to the other peaks through here if the road is open.

spots.name: East Peak
spots.desc: Just next to the peak is the sunrise viewing platforms. If you stay on the mountain or climb over night you will want to see it here.

spots.name: West Peak
spots.desc: Near the west cable car station and only 10 minutes up to the peak. Popular for people arriving here or making a circle from the north. Sunset platform is popular near the evening.

spots.name: Hongshi Gorge
spots.local: 红石峡; Hóngshíxiá; lit. Red Stone Gorge
spots.desc: Houses 44 cave dwellings, lush garden-like atmosphere, pagodas and massive inscriptions on the cliffsides.
spots.addr: Beiyuemiao Village, Yuyang Town, Yuyang District (榆阳区榆阳镇北岳庙村)

spots.name: Yulin Old Town
spots.desc: Well preserved with all the old hutongs and courtyards still preserved. Fragrant Cloud Temple (Xiangyun Si) and Bring Gladness Temple (Daixing Si) are hidden in among the hutongs, like jewels among the flowers.
spots.addr: Yuyang District (榆阳区)

spots.name: Take a walk in the old street
spots.desc: Everyone says that Yulin has long lost its ancient flavor, but only those who have been here knowing that all of Yulin’s fireworks and cityscape are displayed here. It's like going to Beijing without going to the Forbidden City. The status of the old street in the hearts of the Yulin people has long been established.In fact, Yulin Old Street represents the epitome of life in Old Yulin. There is…

spots.name: Fugu County Ancient City of Ming and Qing Dynasties
spots.desc: The buildings in the ancient cities of the Ming and Qing Dynasties usually follow the traditional architectural style of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, including ancient city walls, ancient temples, official residences and residential buildings. These buildings show the magnificence of ancient civilizations with their unique designs and exquisite craftsmanship. In the ancient city of the Ming and…

spots.name: Zhen Taibei
spots.desc: Zhenbeitai is a historical witness to the protection of Yulin in ancient times, and has made special contributions to ancient border trade and national harmony. Entering the new century, Zhenbeitai is of great value for Chinese and foreign people to explore historical origins, study Great Wall culture, and experience humanistic leisure.

spots.name: Hong Shixia
spots.desc: Red rock cliffs, a rare Danxia landform canyon landscape in northern China. Experience the geological relics caused by the Sinian crustal movement 1.4 billion years ago. The temperature in the Yuntai Mountain Scenic Area is about 5 degrees lower than at the foot of the mountain, and the temperature difference between day and night is relatively large. Please keep warm and prevent cold.

spots.name: Yuxi river
spots.desc: Hongshixia has 185 large and small cliff stone inscriptions since the Ming Dynasty, including 126 on the east cliff. The largest inscriptions are 4 meters square and vary in length and width. The stone carvings include poems, records of achievements, travel records, metaphors of scenery, expressions of feelings, etc. The calligraphy is complete with real cursive and official seals, as well as…

spots.name: Yulin City Museum
spots.desc: The museum's exhibition content usually includes the history, archaeological relics, folk customs, etc. of the Yulin area. You can see various ancient cultural relics, objects and pictures in the museum, and learn about the development and changes of Yulin in different historical periods. You may need to purchase tickets to visit the Yulin City Museum, and the ticket prices may vary based on…

spots.name: Yulin oil skin
spots.desc: The production process is very unique. Generally speaking, wheat flour and water are first mixed and mixed to form a dough, and then rolled out and folded repeatedly until a multi-layered dough is formed. Then, heat the oil in the pan and fry the dough in the hot oil so that the dough expands and becomes thinner, eventually forming a crispy oily crust. The unique feature of Yulin Youpi is that…

spots.name: Yulin Camellia oleifera
spots.desc: Camellia oleifera is a traditional drink in the Yulin area. It is usually made from tea leaves, peanuts, sesame seeds, pepper, and other raw materials. It has a unique fragrance and taste.

spots.name: Yulin Dali dates
spots.desc: Dali dates are one of the famous and high-quality products of Shaanxi Province. Due to its suitable climate and soil conditions, the Yulin area produces high-quality Dali dates and is deeply loved by consumers.

spots.name: Yulin Donkey Meat BBQ
spots.desc: Donkey Meat BBQ is a local specialty. Fire fillings often contain donkey meat. The unique cooking method gives it a unique flavor.Donkey meat roasted can be eaten as breakfast or snack, or it can be paired with some chili sauce or other dipping sauces to add flavor. Donkey meat roasting has a long history in Yulin area and is one of the traditional local delicacies. Donkey meat has become a local…

spots.name: Yulin walnuts
spots.desc: The walnuts produced in Yulin are full-fleshed and sweet, and are considered to be one of the high-quality walnuts.

spots.name: Yulin bacon
spots.desc: Yulin bacon usually undergoes a smoking process to add a unique smoked flavor. The traditional method of smoking is to hang bacon in a smokehouse and burn it with charcoal or wood, allowing the smoke to fully coat the bacon. The uniqueness of Yulin bacon lies in its fresh texture and smooth taste. The process of curing and smoking gives the bacon a delicious texture and unique flavor.

spots.name: Yulin Beef Jerky
spots.desc: The beef jerky produced in Yulin is fresh and tender in texture and rich in flavor. It is a local specialty meat product.Yulin beef jerky has a crispy, chewy texture, fresh and tender meat, and a certain aroma. Its unique production process and flavor make beef jerky a delicious snack.

spots.name: Xu Funiu Hot Pot
spots.desc: Environment: ancient Chengdu hot pot restaurant, pot bottom bottom flavour is just right, cooked with eagle tea.
spots.addr: Intersection of Yinsha Road and Wanghu East Road, Yuyang District, Yulin City

spots.name: Tomb of Hami king
spots.desc: Royal nine generations along with three Arabian preacher were buried there, tomb is made of four typical ethical architecture.

spots.name: Hami Museum
spots.desc: Two mummies are exhibited: their clothes, hair and blood vessels have remained in good condition due to immediate dehydration and dry climate.

spots.name: Ghost City
spots.desc: Famous for special geographic speciality. It is absolutely a natural region formed by strong wind and dry climate for thousands of years.

spots.name: Songshutang
spots.desc: A golden place for skiing during winter and summer resort. The ski run is not sharp but very good for beginners. It is a cool place during summer time, you could stay there for few days to enjoy the most quiet and natural life. Cheese is always available for all year long, fresh mushroom could be found after rain in Tian Mountain, BBQ is quite welcome in night life. If you have already arrived at…

spots.name: Swan River
spots.desc: The Swan River Scenic Area is 10 km long, covering an area of 2,400 mu, with a water area of 765 mu. As a water link connecting the Peacock River and the Rhododendron River, the scenic area is composed of 20 bridges, 10 islands and 12 docks as its main framework, and features cultural landscapes such as Cen Shen sculptures and Ban Chao sculptures. Every winter, it attracts hundreds of wild…

spots.name: Lop Nor Village
spots.local: 罗布人村寨风景名胜区
spots.desc: The terrain and landforms of the Luobu People's Village Scenic Area are mainly deserts and Gobi, with oases scattered among them, presenting unique geological features. The vegetation types are mainly desert vegetation, including drought-resistant plants such as saxaul and poplar. The main scenic spots include the traditional villages of the Robu people; The desert adventure area offers…
spots.addr: Within the territory of Dunkuotan Township, Yuli County, Bayingolin Mongolian Autonomous Prefecture

spots.name: Tomb of Amanisahan
spots.desc: Amanisahan was a poetess of the Uyghur Muqam. Her mausoleum is surrounded by a beautiful cemetery complex, including the tomb of the former sultan of Yarkent. Most are beautifully decorated with Arabic inscriptions.

spots.name: Golden Graveyard
spots.desc: This graveyard dates from the 17th century and is the burial place of Royal family members of the Yarkand Uyghur Kingdom.It is known to locals as “Golden Graveyard” as a sign of respect to the Yarkand Kingdom.

spots.name: Local markets
spots.desc: Tour the local markets where you will many products being produced in shop and local goods on sale

spots.name: Two or more days Taklamakan Desert Camel trekking in Yarkend
spots.desc: Yarkend. Yarkend is also another Uyghur cultural city which is located western edge of Taklamakan desert, karasu is a small desert village in Yarkend where you can start your camel ride trek into the desert, Yarkend Karasu village is 250 km south from Kashgar

spots.name: Old Town
spots.desc: One of the most authentic old towns seen in southern XinJiang. Less modernized than Kashgar's and more centralized than Hotan's.

spots.name: 19th Route Army Martyrs Cemetery
spots.local: 十九路军淞沪抗日阵亡将士陵园
spots.desc: Dedicated to the many members of the Kuomintang-led 19th Route Army who died fighting the Japanese during the January 28 Incident in Shanghai in 1932. Since most of the deceased soldiers and officers were originally from Guangdong Province, their bodies were taken here for burial. The cemetery includes a memorial hall and a museum.
spots.addr: 113 Shuiyin Road (水荫路113号)

spots.name: Guangdong Museum
spots.desc: The new museum is located in Zhujiang New Town, not to be confused with the old Guangdong Museum (in Yuexiu District near Metro 1 Peasant Movement Institute Station). This is the biggest museum in the city. It has exhibits Guangzhou's history, culture, science and nature.
spots.price: Arrive early as admission is limited to 5,000 per day. Personal ID is required to obtain free tickets at ticket office
spots.addr: 2 Zhujiang Dong Lu, Zhujiang New Town 珠江新城珠江东路2号

spots.name: Grandview Museum of Natural Science
spots.desc: A privately owned museum dedicated to the natural sciences. It displays a variety of rock and fossil specimens, including dinosaur fossils.
spots.hours: Mon-Fri 10:00-20:00, Sat Sun 10:00-22:00, no entry in last 30 minutes
spots.price: Standard tickets are ¥88; children under 1.5 meters and seniors aged 65 and over pay ¥48
spots.addr: Level 6, Grandview Mall, 228 Tianhe Road (天河路228号正佳广场6楼)

spots.name: Tianhe Sports Center
spots.local: 天河体育中心 Tiānhé Tǐyù Zhōngxīn
spots.desc: A large sports complex in the centre of Tianhe District, with a stadium, gymnasium, swimming facilities and other sports venues. It has hosted major sporting events including the Asian Games and National Games, and is also used by local residents for exercise and recreation.
spots.addr: 299 Tianhe Road (天河路299号)

spots.name: Grandview Mall (Zhengjia Plaza)
spots.desc: This is the largest mall in Guangzhou. It includes famous fashion stores and several department stores, with beautiful musical fountains and fantastic views. Number of shoppers can reach half a million a day on holidays and festivals. This mall includes many Western food chains, such as Starbucks, Dairy Queen, Pizza Hut and McDonald's. Other venues include ice skating rink, amusement park and a…
spots.addr: 228 Tianhe Road, (天河路228号)

spots.name: Tee Mall
spots.desc: This is one of the busiest and most popular shopping malls in the heart of the city.
spots.addr: 208 Tianhe Road (天河路208号)

spots.name: Zhongtian Shopping Mall
spots.local: 中天购物城 Zhōngtiān Gòuwù Chéng
spots.desc: This plaza is more than a place to shop and eat. The plaza has great one-stop service to meet your banking, dry cleaning, grooming and transportation ticket needs.
spots.addr: 天河北路 233号中信广场

spots.name: Chuan Guo Yan Yi
spots.desc: The restaurant specializes in Sichuan (Szechwan) hot pot. It is busy on Friday and Saturday nights. This high end restaurant is popular among expats and those who like hot and spicy food.
spots.addr: 140-148 Tiyu East Road (体育东路140-148号)

spots.name: Cow and Bridge Thai Restaurant
spots.desc: This famous Thai restaurant offers many varieties of Thai dishes. Ask for the more fiery version of your meal, if you're used to Thai cuisine, as the dishes are somewhat localized.
spots.addr: 2/F, Xiang Long Garden, 181 Tianhe North Road (天河北路181号祥龙花园二楼)

spots.name: Banana Leaf (Tianhe)
spots.desc: Banana Leaf is an established traditional Thai restaurant chain.
spots.addr: 28 Tianhe North Road (天河北路28号时代广场2楼)

spots.name: Tai Man Guan
spots.desc: The Thai restaurant offers many varieties of Thai dishes with great curry and noodle dishes.
spots.addr: 7F Tower North East, Teemall, 208 Tianhe Road (天河路208号天河东北塔7楼)

spots.name: 13 Factories
spots.desc: Menu has a heavy American Southern influence, with authentic gumbo, jambalaya, po' boys and pulled pork all on offer, but French, Spanish and Italian dishes are also served. It is a favor of both expats and locals.
spots.addr: 7 Tianhe North Street (体育西路天河北街七号)

spots.name: Oggi Trattoria
spots.desc: Come and enjoy their great pizza and pasta with choice Italian wine.
spots.addr: 1 Tiyu East Road (天河区体育东路1号)

spots.name: BOCA Restaurant and Cafe
spots.desc: This place serves appetizer, soups, salads, sandwiches, rice delights, pastas and other main courses. Kids' meal is available.
spots.addr: 75 Tianhe East Road #107 (天河东路75号首层107)

spots.name: Hooley's Irish Pub and Restaurant
spots.local: 活利仕西餐厅, 爱尔兰西餐酒吧
spots.desc: Hooley's is an Irish-themed pub with a focus on live music performances (rock, pop, folk and jazz). Serves Irish, Italian and fusion dishes. Bakes its own bread. Music Friday to Saturday with open mic sessions on Wednesdays and Ladies Night on Thursdays. Hooley's also has a branch in Zhongshan.
spots.addr: Shop 101, 8 Xinsheng Road, Zhujiang New Town (珠江新城兴盛路8号101号铺)

spots.name: Tavern Sports Bar
spots.desc: Tavern Bar is an English-style pub serving appetizers, pub-grub and international food. Happy Hour from 16:00-20:00 and all day Monday, Happy Hour pints from ¥20. Range of draught beers and cocktails. Shows live sports on big screen TVs. Pool tables and private rooms are available. Quiz night every Wednesday at 8:30PM.
spots.addr: poly 108/ 2 huajiu Road, Zhujiang New Town (珠江新城华就路2号)

spots.name: Xiaobei / Siu Bak
spots.desc: Likely Guangzhou's most diverse neighborhood, with banners here written in at least 4 languages: Chinese, English, French and Arabic. You'll find delicious Middle Eastern and Uyghur restaurants on the main street Baohan Zhijie (宝汉直街), before you meander into side streets full of Africans. Even the Chinese salespeople here have thick African accents when they speak English. You may feel like…

spots.name: Ancient City Wall
spots.desc: Built in 1380, the city wall used to surround the entire city. But in the early 20th century it was torn down for redevelopment, except for a 1-km long section in Yuexiu Park. The wall reaches up to 10-m high. In some parts, there are trees growing from the top of the wall with their roots spreading picturesquely down the wall.

spots.name: Guangzhou Martyrs' Memorial Garden
spots.local: 广州起义烈士陵园 Guǎngzhōu Qǐyìlièshì Língyuán
spots.desc: This park is dedicated to those who fought and died in the Communist Uprising in 1927.
spots.addr: Zhongshan 2nd Road (中山二路)

spots.name: East Ho Chung River Greenway
spots.desc: This small river flowing through Yuexiu has been cleaned up, and is now home to a walking path. It is under the Donghaoyong Elevated Road motorway.

spots.name: Huanghua Gang Commemoration Park
spots.desc: This is a park that will set you in a poignant mood. The main attraction is the monument built to commemorate the 72 martyrs who died during the 1911 uprising.
spots.addr: 79 Xianlie Middle Road (先烈中路79号)

spots.name: Guangxiao Temple (光孝寺)
spots.desc: As the sixth patriarch of Zen Buddhism, Hui Neng, trained at this temple in the 7th century, it is a popular pilgrimage site for Zen Buddhists. The temple has been destroyed several times by fire, and the current buildings date back to the mid-19th century.*
spots.addr: 109 Guangxiao Rd (光孝路)

spots.name: Liurong Temple
spots.desc: The Temple of Six Banyan Trees, which includes the 17-story, eight-sided Hua Ta, or Flowering Pagoda, is one of the most popular attractions in Guangzhou. The temple dates back to the 6th century, while the pagoda predates it by about 300 years.
spots.addr: 87 Liurong Rd (六榕路)

spots.name: Taoist temple
spots.desc: Five Fairy Taoist temple is in Hui Fu Xi Lu of the center of Guangzhou. It is the historical markers of that Guangzhou has been founded 2000 years.

spots.name: Guangzhou City Art Museum
spots.desc: This impressive gallery has more than 10,000 pieces of art work, including calligraphy, traditional Chinese paintings, sculptures and Tibetan Buddhist art (Thangka).
spots.price: ¥10 with visit to Guangzhou Museum (See Yuexiu Park)
spots.addr: next to the Zhenhai Tower in Yuexiu Park

spots.name: Guangdong Museum of Art
spots.desc: It focuses on contemporary Chinese art with particular emphasis on Guangdong artists. Personal ID is required to obtain free tickets at ticket office. Visitors are limited to 3000 a day. Admission fee for special exhibits.
spots.addr: 8 Yanyu Road (烟雨路8号), Er-Sha Island

spots.name: Guangzhou Uprising Museum
spots.desc: The Museum is at the site of the first Communist government building.
spots.addr: 200 Qiyi Rd (起义路200号)

spots.name: Guangzhou Zoo
spots.desc: Extensive zoo, seems well-run. It incorporates Guangzhou Ocean World 广州海洋馆, with over 200 kinds of fish and other rare ocean creatures.

spots.name: Canton-Hong Kong Strike Memorial Museum
spots.desc: Museum dedicated to the Canton (Guangzhou)-Hong Kong Strike of 1925-1926, the largest and longest general strike in modern Chinese history. The museum is housed in the building where the strike committee was based.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:30, no entry after 17:00, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 3 Dongyuan Side Street (东园横路3号)

spots.name: Friendship Store
spots.local: 广州友谊商店 Yǒuyí Shāngdiàn
spots.desc: It is one of the oldest department stores targeting foreigners in Guangzhou. You will also find its branches in Grandview Mall and Times Square on 28 Tianhe North Road (天河北路28号).
spots.addr: 369 Huanshi East Rd (环市东路369号)

spots.name: Wangfujing
spots.desc: This is a branch of the famous department store in Beijing, featuring mid to high-end products.
spots.addr: 40 Longlin Down Road (农林下路40号)

spots.name: Onelink Plaza
spots.desc: At first glance, this looks like a regular shopping mall but it is actually a wholesale market. Each shop usually carries specific products with many selections of varieties. You will find products such as arts and crafts, jewelry, sporting goods, toys, key chains, collectibles and gifts of all types. Many store and boutique owners from all over the world come here to buy their products. You will…
spots.addr: 39 Jiefang South Rd (解放南路39号)

spots.name: Dynasty Plaza
spots.desc: An underground shopping and entertainment complex known for its anime, pop-culture, fashion, and youth-oriented shops and events.
spots.addr: 26 Jiaochang West Road

spots.name: Anime Star City
spots.desc: An underground shopping center known for shops selling anime, manga, games and related ACG merchandise, as well as fashion and other goods.
spots.addr: 1 Jixiang Road

spots.name: Household Merchandise Street
spots.desc: The street has become a shopping center selling everyday goods.
spots.addr: Gaodi Street (高第街)

spots.name: Cultural Street
spots.local: 古玩字画街 / 文化商业街
spots.desc: A good place to look for antiques and traditional Chinese artistic goods.
spots.addr: Wende Road (文德路)

spots.name: Haiyin Shopping District
spots.desc: Selling appliances, sporting goods, cloth, fabrics, camera accessories and electronics.
spots.addr: at the northwest side of the Haiyin Bridge (海印大桥)

spots.name: Liuhua Congee House
spots.desc: Excellent dim sum and Cantonese porridge in beautiful surroundings.
spots.addr: Renmin North Road (人民北路903号流花湖公园)

spots.name: Four Seasons Restaurant
spots.desc: Classic Cantonese cuisine using fresh, quality ingredients. Renowned for its roasted suckling pig and Peking duck. Dim sum is served during lunch hours.
spots.addr: 122 Liuhua Road (流花路122号中国大酒店)

spots.name: Food Street Restaurant
spots.desc: Serving local and regional cuisine, this casual restaurant resembles the open Kitchens of Old Canton. Try their famous wonton noodles, dim sum and fisherman's Congee.
spots.addr: 122 Liuhua Road (流花路122号中国大酒店)

spots.name: Lian Xiang Lou
spots.desc: Founded in 1889, Lian Xiang Lou is known for its tasty dim sum and pastries. There are now more than 20 bakery stores throughout the city.
spots.addr: 67 Dishifu Road (第十甫路67号)

spots.name: Banana Leaf (GZTV Hotel)
spots.desc: Banana Leaf is an established traditional Thai restaurant chain.
spots.addr: G/F, 8 Luhu Rd

spots.name: Banana Leaf (World Trade Center)
spots.desc: Banana Leaf is an established traditional Thai restaurant chain.
spots.addr: 5/F, 371-375 Huanshi East Rd

spots.name: Vaastu
spots.desc: This high end restaurant opened its door in 2008. It serves traditional Indian food with vegetarian dishes available.
spots.addr: 13-15, 475 Huanshi Dong Lu (广州市越秀区环市东路475号东都大世界首层A区13号－15号)

spots.name: Sharmaji Vegetarian Indian Restaurant
spots.desc: One of the most famous Vegetarian Indian restaurants in Guangzhou. Founded in 2001, it serves vegetarian Indian buffet only, in the Indian ghetto in Guangzhou, near the Dong Yue Hotel. It is on the 4th floor of the Gitic Hotel. No meat or alcohol served.
spots.addr: 1号 Huang Tian Zhi Jie (广州市越秀区麓景路黄田直街1、2号)

spots.name: Prime Steakhouse
spots.desc: One of Guangzhou's finest steakhouses, serving Australian and Japanese prime cuts, seafood, pasta and desserts.
spots.addr: 122 Liuhua Road (流花路122号中国大酒店)

spots.name: Cafe Veranda
spots.desc: Serves a lavish international buffet and also has à la carte menu. All Western and Asian delights can be found here and the breakfast buffet is simply excellent.
spots.addr: 122 Liuhua Road (流花路122号中国大酒店)

spots.name: Oggi Pizzeria
spots.desc: The European theme style cafe and bar serves great pizzas and traditional Italian home dishes with wine carte and draught beer.
spots.addr: G/F Tianlun Garden, Jianshe 4th Road (建设四马路)

spots.name: Bosphorus Turkish Restaurants
spots.desc: There are two locations in GZ. Bosphorus Premium in ex Tang Club, and Bosphours Xiaobei in Zhaoqing Building. It has delicious and halal foods. The third location in Yiwu city. The Bosphorus premium has two floors, having lunch and dinner at 2nd floor, smoke and coffee at 3rd floor. The portions are large, price are acceptable according to food quality. This is a favorite for eating doner (one of…
spots.addr: 1 Jianshe 6th Rd

spots.name: Buongiorno Italian Restaurant
spots.desc: The authentic Italian restaurant is Italian managed and prepared, serving pizza, pasta, meat and fish dishes.
spots.addr: 3F Yian Plaza, 33 Jianshe 6th Road (越秀区建设六马路33号宜安广场3楼304/310)

spots.name: The Italian Restaurant
spots.desc: Despite the unimaginative name, this place offers good pizzas, pasta and beer. Buffet is available.
spots.addr: 3F Zhujiang Building East Tower, 360 Huanshi East Road (环市东路360号珠江大厦东座3楼)

spots.name: K's Western Delights
spots.desc: They serve Western-style homemade kosher sandwiches, managed and prepared by Westerners. Delivery service is available.
spots.addr: Tao Jin Jia Yuan

spots.name: Elephant and Castle
spots.desc: British style pub serving Kilkenny, Guinness and a variety of bottled and draft beers. Prices are reasonable for the area, especially during Happy Hour.

spots.name: Hill Bar
spots.desc: Reasonable price for drinks and live band performances nightly.

spots.name: Sapphire Lounge
spots.desc: On the 4th floor of China Hotel, Sapphire Lounge serves an extensive selection of classic and contemporary martinis, cocktails, wines, liquor and more in a chic and upbeat atmosphere. Perfect for after-work drinks or a night out.
spots.addr: 122 Liuhua Rd

spots.name: Sleeping Wood Cafe
spots.desc: Restaurant pub next to the old Holiday Inn City Centre. Serves western food and all kinds of alcoholic drinks. Bottled Tsingtao beer for ¥30. Nice and quiet place to unwind, especially in the open area. 2nd location along Pearl River.

spots.name: C:Union
spots.desc: Great place to hear atypical live music like reggae or classic rock. Bar has both an indoor section consisting of a dance floor and couches and an outdoor section with patio seating and a basement. Wide beer selection and bartenders measure all drinks out in plain view. Early on the bar is populated mostly by locals, however as the night progresses the bar quickly fills with expats. Patrons tend…
spots.addr: 115 Shuiyin Road (水荫路115号天溢大厦副大堂1楼)

spots.name: Club NaNa
spots.desc: Packs a variety of music, well-known throughout Guangzhou for its wild parties, including a singles lock and key party, a secret costume party, and live hip-hop shows. The owners may be seen handing out free drinks. Beware of the tequila shots. Begins as a largely Chinese club but around 23:30, the shaking switches from dice to dancing and it becomes a mix of East and West.
spots.addr: Tianlun Garden, 26 Jianshe 4th Road (建设4马路26号天伦花园)

spots.name: Penthouse
spots.desc: High class bar with dance floor. Variety of sparkling wine ensures you can live it up with standards. The DJs blast the hottest music.
spots.addr: 5 He Ping Rd

spots.name: The Cave
spots.desc: This is a favorite expat hangout. The resident DJ spins a wide range of music. The Cave features exotic dance performances, including live-python dances.
spots.addr: 360 Huanshi East Road (环市东路360号珠江大厦东侧)

spots.name: Gipsy King Bar
spots.desc: Underground bar similar to the Cave. Many local "working" girls sashay around. There are individual dance performances at one corner of the bar, while group performances start on the main dance floor at 22:00.
spots.addr: 360 Huanshi East Road (环市东路360号珠江大厦西地下)

spots.name: Heihei Club
spots.desc: Good crowd, blend of locals and foreigners. Good music though a little pricy. It was reported that pickpocketing is rampant here.
spots.addr: 2 Qiaoguang Road

spots.name: True Colors
spots.desc: Club has dozens of tables on the floor for groups to drink and play local dice games. The DJ booth overlooks the floor and between it and the massive windows runs a strip that can rise up for live performances and for models to runway walk. There's a dance floor that's maybe 25 m² where locals and expats dance. DJs come from all over the world and play their own mix of house occasionally…
spots.addr: 276 Yanjiang Zhong Lu

spots.name: Jin Qiao Cheng
spots.desc: A shopping mall in Kaiping that was completed in November 1993. It is a shopping and entertainment mall. Inside you can find fashion shops, gift shops, cosmetic shops, and DVD stores. With a construction area of 1.3 million m², there are a total of eight floors. There escalators, elevators, central air conditioning, closed-circuit television monitoring system, automatic fire control system…
spots.addr: 3 Guangming W Rd

spots.name: Kaiping Tourist Shopping street
spots.desc: Kaiping tourist shopping street is a two-storey large-scale special building, 800 metres long, south from Cangjiang river, north to 325 national highway, and east with Dong Xing road. This building is a highlights of European style, and is similar with many famous building such as The White House, the Arc de Triomphe in France, Germany Castle, London Bridge, the Netherlands windmill, etc..…

spots.name: Vegetarian Restaurant
spots.desc: Great mainland Chinese style vegetarian buffet. Operates from 11:00 or 11:30 to 14:00 for lunch.
spots.addr: Level two of the mall 500 m east of the bus station

spots.name: Shi Hua Shan
spots.desc: Just on the outskirts of Taicheng is Shi Hua Shan -- an accessible and hikeable mountain. Midway up is a small temple. At the base of the mountain is a small lake where you can rent pedal boats to enjoy an hour and the town square with a corner allocated to kid amusement rides.
spots.addr: Shihua Park Rd, Taicheng

spots.name: Beidu mountains
spots.desc: Beidu has a unique mountain landscape with big boulders everywhere -- sort of like M&Ms on top of an ice cream scoop. There is a public beach requiring an entrance fee but if you walk 100 meters up the road, the beach area is free (as of 2009).

spots.name: Mei's Courtyard
spots.desc: This is the place to get your fill of 1930s Chinese architecture. The quintessential 3-story house rings a giant courtyard. Various Hong Kong movies have been filmed here with souvenirs/props left behind for viewing.
spots.addr: Duanfen

spots.name: Taishan City Museum of Overseas Chinese Culture
spots.local: 台山市华侨文化博物馆
spots.desc: Large modern museum with exhibitions on the many Chinese people who migrated overseas from Taishan.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: Dezheng Road (德政路)

spots.name: Stone Flower Mountain Park
spots.desc: Stone Flower Mountain Park is an 8-km (5-mile) path around the Stone Flower Reservoir right above Stone Flower Square (you probably get the naming structure right?). The path is smooth enough for biking, skating and running. There are various bike rental vendors where you can rent 2-person or 4-person surrey's for ¥30-35 per hour. Along this path are 2 separate climbs -- one goes to a broken…
spots.addr: Shihua Park Road, Taicheng

spots.name: Tomb Sweeping Month
spots.desc: In Chinese custom, 1 month after the end of Chinese New Year is Tomb Sweeping Day. In Taishan though, offerings to ancestors can be made any time during the entire month instead of that single day. This is in part due to the large overseas population who want to return to make offerings but obviously can't all pick a single date. Hence during the entire month, people hike up mountains not only…
spots.addr: everywhere

spots.name: Fudu (Fu Doe) Hot Spring Holiday Resort
spots.desc: A very large and scenic outdoor hot spring spa. You can also sit in a spa where fish eat the dead skin off your body. The spa and pool areas have no shade so do evening trips during the intense summer months. When surprise summer storms roll through, the water slides and wave pool are closed for safety reasons. Buy entry fare at local travel agents for ¥55-¥75 depending on the 'season'.
spots.addr: Duhu Town (Doe Fook)

spots.name: Sunrise Hot Spring Spa (Hay Wun Loi)
spots.desc: A smaller spa but closest to the main city of Taicheng. All the spa areas have some coverage to keep the summer sun from roasting your skin. The larger areas for kid wading, wave pool, etc. have no such protection so keep out until the sun goes down. They also have a heated indoors swimming pool perfect for those who want to do laps instead of soaking. Regular price is ¥93 but if you can buy…
spots.addr: Sanhe Town (Saam Hup)

spots.name: Dreamland Resort (Hong Queue)
spots.desc: Large and scenic outdoor hot spring pa. Free sandwich and fruit snacks. Fares at local travel agents for ¥70.
spots.addr: south part of Baishan County

spots.name: Hei Sha Wan
spots.desc: This is a small bay with sand black from upstream mineral deposits. There is a swimming area with lifeguards where you will have to pay a parking fee and a shower fee afterwards. During the summer months, the water is warm and pleasant and you can spend hours floating on the surf waves -- with or without a swim ring. At night, the sunsets are pure red due to the nearby coal power plant. Luckily…
spots.addr: Tonggu Village

spots.name: Lang Qin Wan Beach
spots.desc: It's a good hour drive from Taicheng -- the last part on twisty roads which means the beaches has fewer people and is cleaner. There is an official beach that costs ¥35 for entry. There are also 'private' beaches connected to local villages where guests at the village hotels and restaurants have free access.
spots.addr: Lang Qin Wan, Baidu

spots.name: Xin Da Di
spots.desc: If your hair gets a bit long on your travels, ¥30 will get you a haircut. But if you only trust your personal hairstylist, you can still come here to get a relaxing shampoo and light massage for ¥15.
spots.addr: Gaoye Shopping Center, 1st level

spots.name: Zi Zu Tan Foot Massage Healthy Center
spots.desc: After many days of travel, your legs may be weary. Come here and for ¥65, you can get a 70-min foot and arm massage. For ¥80, it's 100-min foot/arm/back massage. Included is a simple meal of rice, noodles or fruit (your choice).
spots.addr: Santai Ave Middle at Qiaoguang Ave

spots.name: Hair Salon
spots.desc: Do you like spicy foods? Unfortunately, Taishanese do not so the selection of spices and curries for dining are limited. But as an alternative, this hair salon will wash your hair with a ginger shampoo that will set your scalp on fricking fire! It is like eating hot Thai curry but the feeling is on your head and neck instead of in your mouth. The "mint" sensation lasts for 2 hours afterwards.…
spots.addr: Yanfu Ave

spots.name: Xiachuan Island
spots.desc: For a summer beach vacation, Xiachuan offers a small but modern beach town with prices 1/3 that of Hainan. You can play on the surf, scuba dive, parasail, jetski and rent 2/3/4 seat bikes. The cost is ¥94 for a roundtrip boat ride, ¥20 for the on-island bus ride and ¥40 for the resort entrance fee. Buying a full package from a travel agent should give you ¥20 discount and save on…

spots.name: Currency Exchange
spots.desc: At these two locations, you will see a half a dozen middle-age women sitting on stools holding calculators -- these are Taicheng's money changers. They handle mostly U.S., Hong Kong and Canadian dollars.
spots.addr: Pedestrian St, Taicheng

spots.name: Bu Huan Jie
spots.desc: This is a quarter of a mile area closed to car traffic. At one end is the Gaoye Shopping Center. The other end empties out into snack street a block north of the Tian Liang Shopping Center. Along the way are shops, shops and shops spilling out into side streets. While cars are allowed in the side streets, traffic is very light as most drivers know they can't cross Pedestrian Street.
spots.addr: Taixi Rd, Taicheng

spots.name: Dong Men Shi Chang
spots.desc: Pedestrian street generally is for tourists and returning overseas Chinese. When locals want to shop for clothes and shoes, they go to this place first. It looks like a converted parking garage with a huge ramp that goes up to the 2nd floor. Inside, everything is old and grey with rusted metal but the prices are downright cheap. Since this place caters to locals, do not expect plus size clothes.…
spots.addr: Dongyun Rd, Taicheng

spots.name: Gaoye Shopping Center
spots.desc: At this shopping mall is a hotel w/ 2 restaurants inside the hotel, western restaurant, McDonald's, KFC-clone, pharmacy, supermarket, video arcade, movie theatre, book store and lots of shops. On the 2nd level near the upstairs McDonald's entrance are shops selling children's clothing. Unlike Dong Men Shi Chang, these clothes are targeted towards returning overseas Chinese and will have many…
spots.addr: Xinhe Rd at Beitang Rd, Taicheng

spots.name: Teeland Shopping Plaza
spots.desc: This is the other major shopping mall in Taicheng. On the 2nd level, you will find a supermarket taking up half the floor. The other half will be clothes targeted towards women working in offices -- or OL (office lady) in the Chinese vernacular. On the 3rd level is a jungle gym you can drop your kids off for an hour or two. They will give you a wristband to match up against your kid although they…
spots.addr: Tongji Rd at W Ring Rd

spots.name: Hai Mei Jie
spots.desc: Along this street, there are numerous shops selling dried seafood (salted fish, dried oysters, dried scallops, etc.) In the middle of the block is a building with many more tiny shops inside.
spots.addr: Nanchang St, Taicheng

spots.name: Dian Nao Shang Chang
spots.desc: At this corner, you will see half a dozen of computer shops at the street level. Upstairs are dozens more. While you will not find anything unique here, you will not get ripped off as this is not like the cross border shopping malls in Shenzhen or Zhuhai looking for gullible foreigners. So if you need replacement parts for a failed laptop or more memory cards for your camera, you will get…
spots.addr: Tongji Rd at Jiankang Rd

spots.name: Breakfast vendor
spots.desc: The dish of choice here is noodle soup. There is no variation at all -- it comes with a bit of vegetable, fish patty, mushroom and pork. However, the noodles are firm and fresh. And best of all, it only costs ¥3.
spots.addr: Yuan Mei Lu at Dong Jiao Lu

spots.name: Street Vendors
spots.desc: Gaoye Shopping Center motorcycle parking lot near McDonald's. Pedestrian ST near KFC. Pedestrian St near west end. The later the hours, the larger the selection of street vendors. Many BBQ vendors don't roll their carts out until 9PM.
spots.addr: various

spots.name: Xiao Chi Jie
spots.desc: Various shops offering fruit juices, milk tea, iced coffee and an assortment of snacks. Chabel Snacks here has free WIFI and Macau-style custard tarts "poe tot". The Taiwanese flat bread (similar to Malay bread) across the street is worth a try and right next door is noodles for ¥3.50. Farther down the street at Cheng East Rd and N Ring Rd is Young Station Snacks ... also with free WIFI and a…
spots.addr: Xianqian Rd at Zhengshi Rd, Taicheng

spots.name: Da Yu Ji Pork Chop
spots.desc: Formerly known as Chabel. Tea cuisine, blended fruit drinks, Macau-style egg tarts, Macau-style chicken/pork sandwiches. For less than ¥20, you can get a sandwich and drink.
spots.addr: Xianqian Rd between Zhengshi and Xuegong

spots.name: Gook Yull
spots.desc: During the winter months after the soil has dried out, the locals like to head out to farm areas for the equivalent of an outdoors barbeque. They build a tower of dried soil clumps, heat it searing red, place food wrapped in foil underneath and collapse the tower. This is called "gook yull". The meat turns out especially moist and flavorable -- far better than any baked food I've tasted from a…
spots.addr: any dried & unplanted farm land

spots.name: Hua Run Chao Shi
spots.desc: Your best bet for western food supplies is Vanguard shops. If want a slice of pizza, a donut, peanut butter, oatmeal and so on, you can get it here. It's also the only store with fresh refrigerated milk as all other stores only sell room-temperature box carton milk.
spots.addr: Gaoye Shopping Center, 1st floor

spots.name: Restaurant
spots.desc: You may have seen Chinese BBQ restaurants around the world with pre-roasted meats hanging in the window and they slice off pieces for you when you order. At this restaurant, the roast chicken "sil gai" flattened and half-cooked with a light "char-sil" sauce. When you finally order the chicken, they finish the cooking process by lathering it with boiling oil (not dipped). This leaves the chicken…
spots.addr: Qiaohu Rd at Chaoyang Rd

spots.name: Sunbus
spots.desc: For cheaper "Tea Cuisine", Sunbus has a wide selection and decent prices. During the times they offer their specials (off-hour lunch), they have a meal plus drink for 15-20¥.
spots.addr: Xue Gong Lu at Xianqian Rd

spots.name: Japanese Restaurant
spots.desc: Come here for cheap sushi. The rice is a bit soft/mushy but for 10¥ you can get a dish of 6 basic rolls. They also have a wide variety of noodles and rice dishes (slightly Japanese style) for 10-20¥.
spots.addr: Zhengshi St

spots.name: Teeland Snack Street
spots.desc: At the ground level, there are various food stalls offering small snacks. Right outside the gift shop (N Gee Fong) is a stall with the cheapest Macau-style custard tarts (poe tot). For 10¥, you can get 6 small ones.
spots.addr: Teeland Shopping Plaza

spots.name: Wei Tao Zui Cafe
spots.desc: You have a hunkering for lasagna? Cross-cut fries? Mashed potatoes? Risotto? Pasta with spaghetti sauce instead of just sweet ketchup? They have it. The menu isn't big and you periodically have to wait for a table (which is out of the ordinary for Taishan) but the food is the most "western-style" within a hundred mile radius.
spots.addr: Caolang St at Zhengshi St

spots.name: O.K. Duk
spots.desc: Hot pot (dah bene loe) is a popular method of cooking for the Chinese. Most of the time, hot pot restaurants will have a small stove on a table with a pot of water and you add whatever small items you like. At O.K. Duk, you sit at huge stone tables with integrated charcoal pits that stews gigantic 10lb fish in a slightly spicy broth. And when you're done with the fish, you can add in various side…
spots.addr: S273 at Xihu Rd, Taicheng

spots.name: Guo Lin
spots.desc: Clay Pot Eel Rice "Wong Seen Fon" is the restaurant's specialty. They also make a tasty fish dish "Lim Yee Mun Fa Sung" that is first deep fried and then stewed with peanuts. Private rooms surround a serene courtyard in the back and sometimes you can see the crocodiles they raise for meat.
spots.addr: S273, Shuibu Town

spots.name: Li Yuan
spots.desc: Here you will find a picturesque indoor/outdoor restaurant serving Shuibi cuisine. The cooking style is slightly different as they serve frog rice simmered slowly in an iron wok but the taste and texture comes out similar to the eel rice cooked in stone bowls. At times, they will have freshly caught wild boar on the menu. Their deep fried talapia stewed with dried bean curd "Fook Sull Jut Mun Foo…
spots.addr: Dagang Juicun, Shuibu

spots.name: Wu Shang
spots.desc: The cuisine here is Sijiu-style except they also offer "Bo Jai Jook". Instead of the typical rice porridge, it is cooked in a clay pot until it is thick enough to stick upside down from a spoon. This gives it more flavor and texture -- especially the porridge that has stuck to the sides of the clay pot. (You can accidentally make this dish by reheating a big pot of jook over 2-3 days.)
spots.addr: Xihu Rd at 273 Provincial Road

spots.name: Tian Meng Yuan
spots.desc: Pulled noodles "lie meen" are amazing as long as they don't get soft/soggy waiting to be delivered to your table. The clay pot rice noodles stewed with beef brisket "bow jai fun" is also good.
spots.addr: Tongi Rd at Gexin Rd, Taicheng

spots.name: Xin Hua Yuan
spots.desc: Here you will find Cantonese food and dim sum at modest prices. On average, the same dishes will be half the cost compared to Fu Lin Men (see the below splurge entry).
spots.addr: Beijiao Rd

spots.name: Arc de Triumph
spots.desc: If you have a hankering for an American breakfast, the best place to get it is at Hotel Gaoye's breakfast buffet which runs from 7:30AM to 10:30AM. In addition to coffee/eggs/ham/bacon/sausage, there also are Chinese breakfast foods. The cost is ¥38 plus 10% tip -- hotel guests eat free. The buffet is only open on weekends.
spots.addr: Hotel Gaoye, 2nd fl

spots.name: Fu Lin Men
spots.desc: This restaurant offers Cantonese food most similar to what's available in Hong Kong or Guangzhou. You can also have dim sum here early in the morning and late evenings.
spots.addr: 18 Tongi Rd, Taicheng

spots.name: Country Garden Phoenix Hotel
spots.desc: The Cantonese restaurant here arguably has the best dim sum in Taicheng. Dim sum is served mornings and late evenings -- the hours in between are open for lunch/dinner.
spots.addr: Shaganghu Development Zone, Taicheng

spots.name: Nan Sha
spots.desc: This restaurant specializes in fresh seafood. Especially good when available are the baked squid and hot plate sizzling oyster dishes. Also try the steamed turbot "doh bo".
spots.addr: Taihai Rd at Huanshi Middle Rd, Taicheng

spots.name: Duhu Seafood Street
spots.desc: This is a town 30 minutes drive from Taicheng. You will find many open air stalls selling live seafood. Pick whatever meets your fancy and take it to any of the local restaurants who will then cook to your preference. If you like fresh abalone, you can get it here from ¥5 to ¥15 per abalone depending on size/quality.
spots.addr: S365, Duhu Town

spots.name: Cu San
spots.desc: This is a western-style restaurant in Taishan with a huge menu offering everything from steak to lamb chops to grilled salmon. One of the managers speaks English fairly well and she will take orders from obvious "gwi loes".
spots.addr: Gaoye Shopping Center, 2nd fl

spots.name: Landmark Shopping Center
spots.desc: Midway across the length of the center are several open-air bars. During Spring and Autumn nights, the weather will be cool and refreshing for an outdoors drink. Summer nights could be oppressive though and winter nights perhaps too cold.
spots.addr: Taihai Rd at Tongji Rd, Taicheng

spots.name: Sheng Wang KTV
spots.desc: This is a karaoke club with a good selection of English songs. Rooms rent out on a food/drink minimum starting at ¥150. What this means is you have to spend at least this amount on food and drinks to meet the room charge.
spots.addr: 18 Tongji Rd, Taicheng

spots.name: V8 Club
spots.desc: V8 is the most popular night club in Taishan. Head there for a night of smoky drinks and loud songs.

spots.name: Taishan Ren Min Yi Yuan
spots.desc: If you need emergency medical treatment, the People's Hospital is the largest medical facility in Taishan. They have departments covering pediatric, ear/nose/throat, diagnostics/xray/ct/ultrasound. Treatments will be cheap (e.g. ¥140 for a CT Scan) but you will need to pay cash before a doctor will see you.
spots.addr: Huanbei Ave at Jiankang Rd

spots.name: Dentistry Practice (name unknown)
spots.desc: This is Taishan's biggest and most modern dental facility. A family of dentists in New York returned to open this dentistry practice. It is as clean, modern and equipped as any in the developed world -- newer than what our dentists had back in San Francisco.
spots.addr: Huanbei Ave at Dongcheng Ave

spots.name: Hezhou Museum
spots.desc: Hezhou's main museum. Contains exhibits on the history and culture of the city. Located in a market area with good breakfast options. The top level features the more ancient pottery exhibits, an outside courtyard collects stelae, and internal galleries include miscellaneous modern equipment, a Yuan dynasty anchor excavated from the local river, and some ethnic minority costumes.
spots.addr: 65 Tiyu Road, Babu District (八步区体育路65号)

spots.name: Fu Hill Temple
spots.desc: Stands in the middle of the He River. Fushan, also known as Yuyin Mountain. It is said that since the establishment of the Fushan Temple, no matter how large the mountain flood, Fushan has never been submerged, and it has always floated above the water surface. On the right side of the mountain gate is the Canglang Pavilion. On the mountaintop is the Chen Wang Temple, where there are grand…

spots.name: Hezhou Hakka Round Houses
spots.local: 贺州客家围屋景区, Hezhou Hakka Eco Museum 贺州客家生态博物馆
spots.desc: Characteristic weiwu (semi-circular round houses) built by the Han Chinese ethnic subgroup known as Hakka. See Fujian Tulou for more about this type of building.
spots.addr: Liantang Town, Babu District (八步区莲塘镇)

spots.name: Dagui Mountain National Forest Park
spots.desc: This is a national 4A level tourist attraction with forests, peaks, misty seas, and hanging rocks. The natural vegetation of Dagui Mountain is subtropical evergreen broad-leaved forest, belonging to a subtropical monsoon climate. It is a popular tourist destination; the main attractions include: Gaotai Range Rover, Wuma Waterfall, Green Forest Old Land, San Ying Tan Waterfall, Tiesuo Bridge, and…
spots.addr: Babu District

spots.name: Gupo Mountain National Forest Park
spots.local: 姑婆山国家森林公园, Guposhan Tourism Zone 姑婆山旅游区
spots.desc: Beware of hungry primates at the entrance who often steal food from tourists. The park is divided in to two main areas, the mapped lower portions which are comprised of a series of landscaped attractions with smaller waterfalls and various minor attractions, and the climb to the actual peak which is accessible from the last shuttle stop. The climb takes 5-7 hours round trip and requires good…
spots.addr: Pinggui District (平桂区)

spots.name: Shibashui Tourism Park
spots.local: 十八水旅游景区, Shibashui Eco-Tourism Park 十八水原生态公园
spots.desc: This has an area of 18 m² and is a national 4A level tourist attraction. There are ten waterfalls and eighteen water bays in the original ecological scenic area of Shiba Shui; the name translates as "eighteen waters". The scenic area is famous for its "three wonders of water, rocks, and trees", with a group of ten cascaded waterfalls with a drop of nearly 300 meters. With a large drop and great…
spots.addr: Luhua Village, Huangtian Town, Pinggui District (平桂区黄田镇路花村)

spots.name: Huangyao Ancient Town
spots.local: 贺州市黄姚古镇保护条例
spots.desc: The town was founded in 972 and is dominated by a special architecture with blue bricks, black tiles, and painted wooden beams. The town has a number of temples, pavilions and other historical buildings. It is surrounded by mountains with lots of caves.Huangyao Ancient Town Scenic Area is located in the northeast of Zhaoping County, Hezhou City, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, covering an area…
spots.addr: Zhaoping County (昭平县)

spots.name: Banyan Trees
spots.desc: Hezhou Ancient banyan tree is a famous ancient tree in Hezhou City, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous region, China, and is regarded as one of the local landmarks. The banyan tree, located in the eastern suburbs of Hezhou City, is said to be hundreds of years old and is a local historical witness and natural wonder. Its spectacular canopy covers a vast space, with trunks crisscrossing and branches…

spots.name: Ziyun Cave
spots.desc: Ziyun Cave Scenic spot is an independent limestone mountain karst cave in Babu Basin. It is a long stone mountain formed by the sea level rise during the geological fission of Zhuluo period. The stone mountain appearance is only more than 100 m high, about 800 m long, but after 190 million years of karst erosion, its underground cave length of about 6 km, an underground river in the cave, the…

spots.name: Lingfeng Commercial Street
spots.desc: Good place for leisure travel, there are shopping plazas, snack streets in this leisure block, from the afternoon to the evening, lovers dating, family shopping together to buy things is also very good, you can stroll for a long time.

spots.name: Shenshan Temple
spots.desc: The price is relatively high, mainly because the dining environment is relatively luxurious, the main dishes are: sour soup fish, pigeon egg pork, stuffed tofu, chopped pepper fish head, etc., these Hezhou characteristic dishes represent the local unique flavor and food culture, tasting them will bring you a food journey.

spots.name: Maojia Hotel (Hezhou Avenue Branch)
spots.desc: Buses near Maojia Hotel Hezhou Branch: 11, 5, 1, 7, 2, 6. The starting price of Hezhou taxi is ¥5. Maojia Hotel Hezhou branch is located near Xingui City Square (about 296 m northeast).
spots.addr: 广西壮族自治区贺州市八步区贺州大道158号

spots.name: Xiang Xiang Yuan Hotel
spots.desc: You can also taste Fanglin horseshoe, bean curd stuffed, Zhongshan oil tea and other special food. In addition, the rice snail pot is also a delicacy not to be missed. Clay pot is one of the characteristic cooking methods of Hezhou, which makes the soup delicious and the snail meat fresh and tender. It has become one of the signature dishes of Xiangyuan Hotel.
spots.addr: Next to Chaodong Street Primary School, Chaodong Town, Fuchuan Yao Autonomous County ( 广西壮族自治区贺州市富川瑶族自治县朝东镇朝东街小学旁)

spots.name: See happy tea drink
spots.desc: The atmosphere of the store is unique, creating many cinematic scenes, and the decor is excellent, especially suitable for wearing neo-Chinese style clothing. In addition, the store also takes into account the needs of customers and provides cosmetics for you to touch up before or after the meal. If you are bringing children, there is also a small attic on the second floor for children to play…

spots.name: Zhong Shan oil tea
spots.desc: Zhongshan oil tea is a traditional food in Zhongshan County, Hezhou. It uses camellia oil as the main raw material, plus onion, ginger, minced garlic and other spices, boiled into a unique oil tea. It not only tastes delicious, but also helps digestion and moistening the lungs.

spots.name: Chapel Hill (disambiguation)
spots.desc: Taiyao Mountain, the main peak of Shengtang Mountain, also known as Temple Mountain.It is composed of magenta gravel and sandstone of Devonian system, which has been eroded, cut and weathered by natural forces and surface water for a long time.
spots.addr: Jinxiu Yao Autonomous County

spots.name: Lotus Mountain Tourist Scenic Area
spots.desc: Lotus Mountain Scenic Area is a national nature reserve 16 km northwest of Jinxiu Yao, covering an area of about 23 km². The main peak can be more than 1350 meters above sea level, because the peaks towering, far away, the whole mountain looks like a budding lotus, hence the name.
spots.addr: Jinxiu Yao Autonomous County

spots.name: Grand Canyon
spots.desc: Baiye Grand Canyon is a scenic spot known as "Guangxi Jiuzhaigou", located in the east township of Wuxuan County, Laibin City, 38 km from Wuxuan County City. It is a typical Danxia landform, with a maximum elevation of 1200 meters.
spots.addr: Hema Township, Wuxuan County

spots.name: King Pan Festival
spots.desc: On the 16th day of the tenth lunar month, the Yao remember their ancestral king, the dragon-dog turned human King Pan. The Yao celebrate by singing, dancing, drinking, wearing traditional attire and offering sacrifices to their ancestor.

spots.name: Yuda International Hotel Restaurant
spots.desc: One of the few restaurants in Laibin which provides Western food.
spots.addr: 288 Renmin West Rd, Xingbin District

spots.name: Yangdi-Xingping scenic area
spots.desc: This stretch along the Li River is probably the most renowned and popular. The traditional bamboo rafts along this stretch have been replaced by rafts made of plastic pipe with two stroke motors. The "raft experience" is now a boom industry and hundreds of these small rafts cruise this route when the big tour boats have passed. The rafts are safe and the better operators provide life jackets.…

spots.name: Yulong River valley
spots.desc: The pretty valley is said to rival the Yangdi-Xingping stretch in terms of beauty. Besides rafting down the river on bamboo rafts, another popular way of seeing the valley is by cycling along riverside tracks. The journey will bring you through many farming villages and past several stone bridges across the river such as the Yulong Qiao and Fuli Qiao. Be warned though that the track is…

spots.name: Moon Hill
spots.desc: Another popular scenic spot south of town. The main attraction is a hill with a huge hole in the shape of a moon. The hills here can be climbed for spectacular vistas from the top. There is a ¥15 entry fee. (There is also another dirt trail to the right of the entrance; follow it left, hop over the barbed wire and follow the stone steps up to reach the main path for free.) It is not an incredibly…

spots.name: Assembling Dragon Cave
spots.desc: The Karst cave was so named because the grotesque peaks outside the cave look like dragons among the clouds. Inside the Assembling Dragon Cave are beautiful sculptures of nature in the form of varied formations of stalactites and stalagmites. These formations are lit by colorful neon lights, together with sweet music in the background, making one feels like he/she is in the fairyland! The Magical…

spots.name: Cormorant Fishing
spots.desc: Local tourism companies offer evening boat trips to watch fisherman using a traditional night fishing technique that employs cormorants.

spots.name: Yangshuo Park
spots.local: 阳朔公园, 人民公园 People's Park
spots.desc: A great place to observe the locals playing cards, a national pastime so it would seem. You’ll also see groups of women sitting around talking whilst doing their knitting, some even walk along the street whilst knitting and chatting.
spots.addr: 36 Diecui Road (叠翠路36号)

spots.name: Impression Liu Sanjie Theater
spots.desc: Every evening from 8 to 9:10pm a live performance is held where the surrounding karst mountains are part of the show.

spots.name: Blackrock
spots.desc: Claim focus on quality instructions, bilingual guides and safety. Offer other activities such as abseiling, kayaking and ziplining.
spots.addr: on Guihua Rd

spots.name: Insight Adventures
spots.desc: Insight Adventures are the largest operator in Yangshuo and offer climbing and many other activities such as kayaking, caving, biking and abseiling. They are the most expensive outfit in town and offer a large staff of foreign and Chinese guides.
spots.addr: Xian Qian Jie (off West Street)

spots.name: Terratribes
spots.desc: They also do multi-day camping, biking tours, rafting, caving, etc., for school/family/corporate groups. Stop by after dinner for a slack-lining session.
spots.addr: on Fu Qian Road (府前巷12号)

spots.name: Yangshuo Basecamp
spots.desc: A family-run organization based in a beautiful village. Afa and his brothers provide friendly instructions with a strong emphasis on safety. Other activities include rock climbing, ziplining, abseiling, camping and BBQ.
spots.addr: Fenglou Village (凤楼村) (just before Moon Hill)

spots.name: Bike riding
spots.desc: Wandering through the countryside on a bike and getting lost is one of the best things about Yangshuo. The villages often have dramatic mountain backdrops, and the people are generally friendly. Another popular trip is to take a boat ride with a bike, then bicycle back to town. Bike hire starts at around ¥15-20 per day, and tandems are a bit more. The bikes tend to be poorly maintained, so be…

spots.name: Yangdi - Xingping
spots.desc: As of Aug 2013, this 18- to 24-km walk can be done both ways and it is a far more peaceful way to enjoy the Li river and mountain scenery than a loud noisy boat down the river. It takes you along the pebbly shores of the river, through many small villages, fields and bamboo forests. You will have to take three bamboo raft across the river at about ¥10-30 each after bargaining. Just tell someone…

spots.name: Swimming in the Li River
spots.desc: During the summer, the water and temperature is good for swimming. Locals swim from the docks on the Li Jiang (Li River) a short way upstream of the town centre. The water is generally clean and crystal clear but you may want to avoid a main waste drain near to the dock. Keep walking up to the north from the dock for around 20 minutes to find out a popular swimming spot, nicknamed "the secret…

spots.name: Bamboo Rafting
spots.desc: Rafting along the Yulong river is particularly popular in summer, but travellers should take care not to go rafting if the water is brown and turbulent. In 2005 there was a fatality during high floods. The duration for rafting depends on the wharf that is your starting point and the ticket price varies accordingly. For example, from Shui'e di Wharf (水苊底码头) about 35 min on raft, Jima Wharf (骥马码头)…

spots.name: Exploring caves
spots.desc: There are an abundance of caves riddling the limestone hills. Guided tours are available. More serious cavers should talk to the staff at the various climbing shops (listed above) for information about possible cave climbs.

spots.name: Water caves
spots.desc: Make sure which water cave you are visiting since there are at least two of them about 15 km south of Yangshuo. The Moon Water Cave is 2 km west of GaoTian town, but the ticket office is 2 km north-east of GaoTian town, on the road to another cave called Water Cave. Both caves state on flyers that they have hot spring baths but the one in Moon Water Cave appears to be artificially heated (ticket…

spots.name: Impression Liu Sanjie
spots.desc: 70 minutes long. The show, set to the music from the movie of the same name and produced by famous Chinese director Zhang Yimou, who was also behind the Beijing Olympic games opening ceremony, is grand and impressive, though perhaps not particularly entertaining. It features a cast of more than 600 wearing traditional Zhuang, Miao and Yao dress, and a highly impressive light show. Liu Sanjie…
spots.hours: Every day but closed in Jan or Feb for maintenance
spots.price: ¥188 face value, travel agents sell at about ¥150 for the cheapest seat

spots.name: Used Bookstore
spots.desc: There is a used bookstore and reading room (with a large selection in English and some books in several other European languages) at Cafe Too. Prices are higher than at used bookstores in Western countries, but cheaper than new books. You can buy coffee, or a meal, and read them free. WiFi here is free and Philip, the owner, is a great source of local news and information. It is great for people…
spots.addr: 7 Cheng Zhong Road

spots.name: Muslim Food
spots.desc: There is one Chinese Muslim restaurant directly facing the entrance to Yangshuo bus station. It can easily be identified by the headscarves worn by the women employees there. It serves a variety of halal noodle and rice dishes.

spots.name: Balcony Bar
spots.desc: Fairly decent French food and crepe, movie every night at 21:00 and free internet.
spots.addr: Xianqian Jie

spots.name: Minority Cafe
spots.desc: Friendly staff and tasty food with decent size portions. The burrito and the chocolate and banana pancake are particularly good. Wireless internet and two computers available for customers. Regular expat hangout.
spots.price: Western food around ¥25, Gin and tonic ¥10, Beer ¥6
spots.addr: Guihua Lu

spots.name: Cafe China
spots.desc: Great coffee, great cheesecake, packed most nights, wireless internet, and good chocolate milkshake (though small).
spots.addr: on the corner of West Street and Xianqian Jie

spots.name: Cafe del Moon
spots.desc: Breakfast here is excellent value if you are hungry or want a lot of coffee. Ghastly croissants but the rest is good.
spots.addr: West St

spots.name: Dosa U.K.
spots.desc: Excellent, authentic home made South Indian food in brand new spot. Attentive service and very good prices. Kind of a hole in the wall and the decor is a bit over the top. Menu is limited but has the South Indian basics and a very good crispy dosa.
spots.addr: 110D Yang Guang

spots.name: Lucy's Place
spots.desc: Serves a variety of Western and Chinese dishes, including excellent fries and great coffee. Their apple crumble (¥20) is a must-try. The owner and manager (Lucy) is a terrific resource for things to do and places to go in Yangshuo.
spots.addr: 5, Guihua Rd

spots.name: Luna
spots.desc: Italian restaurant designed by Yangshuo Mountain Retreat owner, Chris Barclay, Luna offers gorgeous views of Moon Hill and the surrounding village. They also serve gourmet Chinese dumplings and offer a full bar. There's no elevator so be prepared to walk up.
spots.addr: Moon Hill Village

spots.name: Kelly's Cafe
spots.desc: Great service and food, cheap beer. Foreigners living in Yangshuo often hang out here. Also offers free wireless Internet. The Kelly's Cafe on Guiha street is better than the one on the side street. They both have great milk shakes but their veggie burgers are not the best in town as claimed. Also, a nice view and an ample breakfast.
spots.addr: Guihua Lu

spots.name: MC Blues
spots.desc: Good cocktails, happy hour from 18:00-20:00, great music, wireless internet, 2nd floor lounge and open late.

spots.name: Nature's Cup
spots.desc: English speaking, Excellent breakfast with bottomless coffee at a good price. Great coffee! The pear and ginger juice and 'adult shake' with Malibu rum are to die for. Best fresh drinks in Yangshuo.
spots.addr: 15 Binjian Rd

spots.name: Roof Garden
spots.desc: Rooftop of Yangshuo Hidden Dragon Villa in Big Banyan Tree scenery Zone nearby Yulong River. Overlooking the peaceful and beautiful mountains, Yulong River and rice paddies, the Roof Garden Restaurant divides into the open rooftop restaurant and enclose rooftop restaurant, each can accommodate 40 persons at the same time, 80 persons in total. The enclosed rooftop restaurant combines the…
spots.addr: Yangshuo Hidden Dragon Villa, Big Banyan Tree scenery zone

spots.name: Valentine
spots.desc: French Chef Nicolas with a romantic atmosphere. Original first class fusion cuisine. Great desserts including excellent chocolate cake. A good selection of tapas and cocktails.
spots.addr: Guihua Lu

spots.name: Carpe Diem restaurant
spots.desc: This charming restaurant with a great outside deck offers a fine selection of the local cuisine as well as a variety of international dishes in a quiet and relaxing setting with great views. Breakfasts, brunches, lunch and dining with generous portions. Weekly barbecue and Chinese buffet nights. Cozy bar with a nice selection of Belgian Beers and South-African wines. Belgian-Chinese management.
spots.addr: Shi Ban Qiao, 37

spots.name: Gan's Noodles
spots.desc: Specializing in handmade noodles, this tiny shop is an out of the way treasure most tourists will never visit. For ¥8 you get a great spicy beef noodle bowl. With a beer to wash it all down, this little 4 table shop had excellent service, while the servers don't know English, the menu has pictures and English names, and whatever you end up with will be amazing.

spots.name: Dynasty Dumplings
spots.desc: Small restaurant offering authentic Northern Chinese food, run by a couple from Liaoning. Very popular with Western tourists, they have the usual Chinese-English bilingual menu with pictures, so ordering is not a problem. Try their dumplings (¥12-15 for a serving of twelve).
spots.addr: 21 Xian Qian Jie, 县前街21号

spots.name: Monkey Jane's Rooftop Bar
spots.desc: Opens in the afternoon and closes late, often 03:00-04:00. Monkey Jane's Rooftop Bar & Hostel is a nice and chill rooftop bar in a small alley of West Street. During the day it's great for chilling and enjoying the scenery with a nice view of the hills around Yangshuo. At night there's often parties with cheap beer and cocktails and things go crazy every now and then. There's a beer pong table…
spots.addr: alley off West Street

spots.name: Cafe le Votre
spots.desc: Set back from the street with a courtyard in front, is a brew pub with its own beer. They have two brews, a wheat beer and a dark beer, both are rare finds in China. They also have French and Chinese food; quality is good and prices relatively high. Their courtyard is a great place for people-watching, but unfortunately it is also convenient for touts to find you.
spots.addr: West Street

spots.name: Kaya
spots.desc: A reggae bar, although with a larger range of music, moved from Guihua road to a new space on Xianqian St (with an open fire which is awesome in winter). Often has good live music (permanent open mic) and very laid back atmosphere. 10 kuai local beers, 15 kuai standard mixers as well as a wide range of cocktails and other drinks. Shisha 35 kuai. Nice chill-out area on the second floor. open later…
spots.addr: 31 xianqian St

spots.name: Mono Roof-top Bar
spots.desc: Bar is on the fourth floor, with a small rooftop drinking area, great for getting away from the heat and crowds at street level. Fantastic views of the mountains that are lit up at night time. Ground floor is being renovated as an art gallery to display the owner's paintings.
