spots.addr: Xingfu Street (幸福街59号; 幸福街)

spots.name: The small streets north of Hong Qiao Market
spots.desc: In these streets there are a number of small and inexpensive restaurants.

spots.name: Old Beijing Noodle King
spots.desc: Specialised in hand made noodles, but also other courses available. Bustling and authentic atmosphere.
spots.addr: 29 Chongwenmen Wai Dajie (崇文门外大街29号; Chóngwénménwàidàjiē)

spots.name: Beijing Gongdelin Vegetarian Restaurant
spots.local: 北京功德林素菜饭庄; Běijīnggōngdélínsùcàifànzhuāng
spots.desc: Established in 1922. Traditional Buddhist vegetarian restaurant specialised in courses imitating meet but based on toufu, mushrooms etc.
spots.addr: 158 Qianmen Nan Dajie (前门南大街158号; Qiánménnándàjiē)

spots.name: Fortune Long Beijing Bean Sauce Noodles
spots.desc: It has been synonymous with authentic zhajiangmian since 1994. ¥18 for one bowl of noodles.
spots.addr: 56 East Xinglong Street, Dongcheng

spots.name: Yunteng Restaurant
spots.desc: Yunnan cuisine, specialising in mushroom dishes. Located in the Yunnan provincial office building, and the food is as expected very Yunnan. The restaurant tries to look like a Yunnan rain forest, but does not really succeed, and the service level is not impressive, but the food is excellent.
spots.price: Expect ¥50-75 each person, more if you want some of the fancier mushrooms
spots.addr: 7 Dong Huashi Bei Li Dong Qu (东花市北里东区7号; dōnghuāshìběilǐdōngqū

spots.name: Daijiacun Restaurant
spots.desc: Dai Minority cuisine. The restaurant is decorated in classical Dai style. Dai traditional dancing and singing now and then.
spots.addr: Tiyuguan Road (体育馆路13号; Tǐyùguǎnlù)

spots.name: Capital M
spots.desc: Capital M is a modern Australian/European style restaurant. It provides cuisine and ambiance of a high standard. It overlooks part of Tiananmen Square and several colourful Chinese buildings which are illuminated at night. By Australian standards it provides excellent value.
spots.addr: 3/F, 2 Qianmen Pedestrian St (前门步行街2号3层; Qiánménbùxíngjiē)

spots.name: Maxim's de Paris
spots.desc: Traditional French cuisine and one of the first foreign restaurants to open in Beijing.
spots.addr: 2 Chongwenmen Xidajie (崇文门西大街2号; Chóngwénménxīdàjiē)

spots.name: Mt. Shangfang National Forest Park
spots.local: 上方山国家森林公园; Shàngfāngshān Guójiā Sēnlín Gōngyuán
spots.desc: Covering more than 300 hectares, this is said to be the largest national forest park in northern China, with nine caves, twelve peaks and dozens of temples scattered across it. The best known peak is Tianzhu Peak (天柱峰; Tiānzhùfēng).

spots.name: Cloud and Water Cave
spots.desc: A karst cave some 600 m long, inside Mt. Shangfang park. Its main draw is a stalagmite about 37 m tall.

spots.name: Pofengling
spots.desc: One of the best spots near Beijing for autumn colour, when the hillside turns almost entirely red. The display is brief — usually around the first week of November, and often over within a week.
spots.addr: Zhoukoudian

spots.name: Shihuadong Cave
spots.desc: A large limestone cave system, also promoted as the Fangshan Geological Park.

spots.name: Doudian Mosque
spots.desc: Said to be the largest mosque in Beijing. Founded in 1713 in Chinese temple style, it was rebuilt in 2002 and again in 2011 in an Arabic style.

spots.name: Shidu
spots.desc: A limestone gorge on the Juma River, marketed as a "little Guilin". Worth a day trip if you have never seen the karst scenery of Guilin, Ha Long Bay or Vang Vieng, though it is a smaller-scale version of them. The name means "tenth crossing": before the valley road existed, travellers going upstream had to ford the river again and again, and the villages are still known by the number of their…
spots.price: Free to drive or walk through the valley; each scenic spot charges its own admission

spots.name: Juma Leyuan
spots.local: 拒马乐园; ninth crossing (九渡)
spots.desc: An activity park rather than a scenic walk, with a cable car, a bungee jump and bamboo rafts for hire. The prices recorded here date from 2013 and are almost certainly out of date: cable car ¥60 return, bungee ¥200, raft ¥60 per hour for three people.
spots.price: Free to enter; activities charged separately

spots.name: Xihugang
spots.local: 西湖港; Qitan Gorge, beyond the fifteenth crossing
spots.desc: The furthest of the Shidu scenic spots, at the top of the valley.

spots.name: Qianli Embankment, Baiyangdian
spots.desc: Waterside scenery along the lake, with dense reed beds. Boat trips are available for lake views.
spots.addr: 10 km outside central Renqiu, Cangzhou, Hebei

spots.name: Sangezhuang Site
spots.desc: A Yangshao culture relic site dating back about 6,000 years and a provincial cultural relic protection unit. Visitors can see remains of prehistoric human settlements here.
spots.addr: Sangezhuang Village, Qijianfang Township, Renqiu, Cangzhou, Hebei（

spots.name: Yabazhuang Site
spots.desc: A Longshan culture site from roughly 5,000 years ago, listed as a Major Historical and Cultural Site Protected at the National Level. Large amounts of prehistoric pottery and stone tools have been unearthed here.
spots.addr: Northwest of Yabazhuang Village, Renqiu, Cangzhou, Hebei

spots.name: Maozhou City Site
spots.desc: Ruins of an ancient city wall, a county-level cultural relic protection site dating from the Warring States to Sui and Tang dynasties.
spots.addr: Maozhou Town, Renqiu, Cangzhou, Hebei

spots.name: Yanlingdui Memorial Hall
spots.desc: A red-themed museum introducing the anti-Japanese history of the Yanlingdui unit. Admission is free.
spots.addr: Baiyangdian Cultural Garden, Anxin, Xiong'an New Area, Hebei

spots.name: Maozhou Temple
spots.local: 鄚州大庙（扁鹊庙、药王庙）
spots.desc: Located in Maozhou Town. Known as "the great temple south of the capital". Built in the Yuan Dynasty to commemorate Bian Que. A temple fair takes place in the 4th lunar month every year.
spots.addr: North of Guzhou Village, Maozhou Town, Renqiu, Cangzhou, Hebei

spots.name: Renqiu Museum
spots.desc: South of People's Square. A comprehensive local museum with stone Buddha statues and local relics, showing Renqiu's full history from prehistory to modern times. Free entry.
spots.addr: North Citizen Square, Beizhan West Road, Renqiu, Cangzhou, Hebei

spots.name: Suyiwei Taosu (Xinyulou Department Store)
spots.local: 酥忆味桃酥(信誉楼百货店)
spots.desc: A bakery and snack shop inside Xinyulou Department Store. It sells Chinese pastries and packaged snacks, including pork floss cakes and crab roe-flavoured crispy rice snacks.
spots.addr: 1F, Xinyulou Department Store, Kunlun South Road, Xihuan Road Subdistrict, Renqiu

spots.name: Wanfo Garden
spots.local: 万佛园, Garden of Ten Thousand Buddhas
spots.desc: Compared to the Eastern Qing Tombs, the Wanfo Garden is a fairly modern place, having been established in 1993. But the garden utilizes traditional Qing designs in order to maintain a certain synchronicity with the tombs.
spots.price: Standard adult tickets are ¥50, adults aged 60 to 69 pay ¥25, adults over 70 and children under 1.2 meters enjoy free…

spots.name: Northern Song Dynasty Imperial Tombs
spots.desc: Contains the remains of seven of the nine emperors of the Northern Song Dynasty. Zhao Hongyin (the father of Zhao Kuangyin, the dynasty's founding emperor) is also buried here as are dozens of concubines, government officials, military leaders and nobles. In total there are around 1000 tombs.
spots.addr: 1/84 Dufu Road (杜甫路84附1)

spots.name: Yuzhou Forest Botanical Garden
spots.desc: Yuzhou Forest Botanical Garden is a large ecological scenic spot in Yuzhou City. It has a rich variety of plants, including common local plants and many rare trees and flowers. The air here is fresh and the scenery is beautiful, which is very suitable for walking, outdoor activities and getting close to nature. There are trails, viewing platforms and children's play areas in the park, which are…
spots.addr: Provincial Highway 103 (103省道)

spots.name: Henan Dahongzhai National Forest Park
spots.local: 河南大鸿寨国家森林公园
spots.desc: Henan Dahongzhai National Forest Park is a national forest park that integrates peaks, caves and canyon landscapes.
spots.price: Adult ticket price is ¥60/person, student or senior ticket price is ¥30/person (with valid ID)
spots.addr: In Jiushan Town

spots.name: China Jun Porcelain Cultural Park
spots.desc: The park is mainly composed of archways, Jun Porcelain Cultural Square, Tiancheng Pavilion, Jun Porcelain Cultural Heritage Display and Experience Area, Characteristic Tourism and Cultural Area, Jun Ceramics Scientific Research Incubation Base, Jun Porcelain Academic Exchange and Research Area, and Jun Porcelain Cultural Experience Center.
spots.addr: East side of Xuanyuan Avenue and Yingbei Avenue, Yingbei District

spots.name: Horse Stepping on Flying Swallow Scenic Area
spots.desc: This is an iconic sculpture that represents the essence of ancient Chinese art and culture. The sculpture depicts a galloping horse with a flying swallow under its hoof, symbolizing the perfect combination of speed and power. It is an important check-in attraction in Yuzhou City.
spots.addr: North side of the East Passenger Transport Station, Yuwang Avenue, Yingchuan Street

spots.name: Tomb of King Ding of Zhou Scenic Area
spots.desc: The mausoleum of Zhu Youdun, the king of Zhou Ding during the Ming Dynasty, is magnificent and well-preserved. It is a royal mausoleum of the Ming Dynasty that integrates history, culture, and architectural art. The surrounding environment of the mausoleum is peaceful, with towering ancient trees, reflecting the traditional Chinese mausoleum culture.
spots.addr: In Wuliang Town

spots.name: Zhangliang Cave
spots.desc: This an ancient cave as a long history and full of mystery. It is said to be the place where Zhang Liang, a founding hero of the Western Han Dynasty, lived and practiced in seclusion. The cave is deep and winding, and there are many ancient stone carvings and inscriptions on the cave walls, which are full of historical and cultural atmosphere. Zhangliang Cave is surrounded by beautiful scenery…
spots.addr: No. 1 Zhangliangdong Cultural Resort

spots.name: Por Ling Weng Temple
spots.desc: The Bolingweng Temple is a folk belief temple with a long history in Yuzhou. It is dedicated to the local patron saint "Bolingweng". It is said that this deity once protected the people in ancient times, and the temple has become an important belief center for local people. There are some ancient architectural elements and exquisite carvings in the temple. Although it is not large, it has strong…
spots.addr: Bolingweng Village, Shundian Town

spots.name: King Yu Locks Jiao Well
spots.desc: This famous historic sites in Yuzhou is closely related to the legend of Dayu's flood control. It is said that Dayu used his divine power to lock the dragon here to protect the local people from floods, so this ancient well has become a symbolic symbol. As a combination of myths and legends and folk beliefs, the Locking Dragon Well has important cultural and historical value.
spots.addr: 50 meters northeast of the intersection of Bashifang Street and Xidajie in the ancient city of Xiqu District

spots.name: Lianhua Mountain Taoist Temple
spots.desc: A scenic mountain and Taoist temple where visitors can hike, meditate, and enjoy panoramic views.
spots.addr: Lianhua Mountain

spots.name: Yuzhou Museum
spots.desc: This museum showcases the rich history and culture of Yuzhou, with exhibits on ancient pottery, artifacts from the Zhou Dynasty, and local history. A great place to learn more about the area’s heritage.
spots.addr: No. 10 Wenhua Road

spots.name: Yuzhou Cultural Park
spots.desc: A beautiful public park featuring gardens, walking trails, and cultural displays. It’s a popular spot for locals to relax, exercise, and participate in group activities like tai chi and dancing.
spots.addr: Central Park Road

spots.name: Yuzhou Cinema
spots.desc: For a break from sightseeing, catch the latest films at this modern cinema. It screens both local and international movies, with comfortable seating and a selection of snacks.
spots.addr: No. 22 South Yingchuan Road

spots.name: Lushan National Forest Park
spots.desc: This large national forest park offers visitors a chance to experience the great outdoors with hiking trails, scenic views, and lush forests. There are also picnic spots, camping areas, and opportunities for bird watching.
spots.addr: North of Yuzhou City, Lushan County

spots.name: Yuzhou Wetland Park
spots.desc: This park is an ecological haven with wetlands that support a variety of bird species and plant life. It's a peaceful spot for walking, birdwatching, and enjoying nature. The park also features educational displays about local environmental conservation efforts.
spots.addr: Yuzhou West District

spots.name: Yuwang Temple
spots.desc: Yuwang Temple is dedicated to Yu the Great, the legendary founder of the Xia Dynasty and the hero of Chinese flood control myths. The temple is a significant cultural site, featuring traditional architecture and relics related to Yu’s life and deeds.
spots.addr: Yuzhou City Center

spots.name: Yuzhou Cultural and Creative Market
spots.desc: This weekend market showcases local crafts, artwork, and creative goods from Yuzhou. It’s a great place to buy unique souvenirs, handmade pottery, and explore local artisan culture. Live music and food stalls make it a lively experience.
spots.addr: East Yingchuan Road

spots.name: Shenhou Porcelain Market
spots.desc: A vibrant marketplace specializing in local porcelain. Here you can find authentic, handmade pottery and explore a wide range of designs from local artists.
spots.addr: Shenhou Town

spots.name: Yuzhou Porcelain Cultural Shop
spots.desc: A shop dedicated to preserving and promoting Yuzhou's porcelain art. Visitors can purchase unique pieces and learn about the history of porcelain-making in the area.
spots.addr: No. 88 Yingchuan Road

spots.name: Yuzhou Handicraft Market
spots.desc: A weekend market offering a mix of traditional handicrafts, including embroidery, wooden carvings, and local specialty goods. A great place to pick up souvenirs.
spots.addr: East Yingchuan Road, near City Center

spots.name: Jun Porcelain Art Center
spots.desc: An upscale store offering premium Jun porcelain items, including decorative vases, tableware, and art pieces. Ideal for collectors.
spots.addr: No. 56 Zhongzhou Road

spots.name: Shenhou Kiln Workshop
spots.desc: An interactive workshop where visitors can watch the traditional kiln-firing process of Jun porcelain and purchase handcrafted items directly from artisans.
spots.addr: Shenhou Town, near Ancient Kilns Area

spots.name: Yingchuan Tea and Porcelain Store
spots.desc: A cozy shop offering a unique combination of local teas and porcelain teaware. Perfect for gifts or souvenirs.
spots.addr: No. 45 West Yingchuan Road

spots.name: Porcelain Lovers' Gallery
spots.desc: A gallery featuring artisan-created porcelain and ceramic artworks, with a focus on unique, contemporary designs.
spots.addr: South Zhongzhou Road

spots.name: Old Street Chicken Fillet
spots.desc: This snack bar is famous for its stewed pork and tofu pudding. The stewed pork has a chewy texture and tastes very good with garlic sauce and chili; the tofu pudding is smooth and tender, and the seasoning makes it very memorable.
spots.addr: About 260 meters southeast from the intersection of Jundu South Road and Wenbo Road

spots.name: ‌‌Huashi Yuanhu Mutton Restaurant‌
spots.desc: Huashi Yuanhu Mutton Restaurant is a restaurant that specializes in mutton, especially stewed mutton and mutton soup. The meat is tender and not smelly, and the soup is rich and delicious. The restaurant has a very good reputation in the local area, and many diners come to taste it. The restaurant uses traditional cooking methods to ensure that each dish retains the original flavor of the mutton.
spots.price: Lamb stew: ¥30 - 50 per serving Mutton offal soup: ¥20 - 35 per serving Mutton skewers: ¥5 - 10 per skewer
spots.addr: Huashi Town

spots.name: Fanpoquanniuzhuang
spots.desc: Fanpo Quanniu Zhuang is famous locally for its unique beef dishes and is a great place to taste Yuzhou-style beef.
spots.price: Whole beef banquet: ¥150 - 300 (depending on the number of people and the number of dishes), single beef dish: ¥30 - 60…
spots.addr: East Street, Fanpo Village, Fanpo Town

spots.name: Zhu Family Clay Pot Restaurant
spots.desc: This local favorite specializes in clay pot dishes, with rich stews and soups that are cooked and served in traditional clay pots.
spots.addr: No. 89, East Yingchuan Road

spots.name: Yuzhou Xiaolongbao
spots.desc: This small shop is known for its fresh and delicious xiaolongbao, or steamed buns filled with pork or other savory fillings. A perfect spot for breakfast or a light meal.
spots.addr: No. 33 Wenming Road

spots.name: Jiangnan Noodles
spots.desc: Serving a variety of noodle dishes, this restaurant offers flavors from both northern and southern China. Specialties include hand-pulled noodles and spicy beef noodle soup.
spots.addr: No. 20, South Yingchuan Road

spots.name: Shenhou Town Specialty Restaurant
spots.desc: This restaurant specializes in local cuisine from Shenhou Town, including traditional dishes made with Jun porcelain techniques. It’s a great place to try regional specialties while exploring the town.
spots.addr: Shenhou Ancient Town

spots.name: Yuzhou Roast Duck Restaurant
spots.desc: Specializing in roast duck, this restaurant serves crispy, flavorful duck with pancakes and hoisin sauce, a classic Chinese dish that’s perfect for sharing.
spots.addr: No. 50 Wenhua Road

spots.name: Shiji Dumpling House
spots.desc: This local favorite offers a wide selection of handmade dumplings with fillings like pork, cabbage, shrimp, and vegetables. It’s a popular spot for a quick and satisfying meal.
spots.addr: No. 18, East Yingchuan Road

spots.name: Yuzhou Night Market
spots.desc: The night market offers a vibrant street food experience, with dozens of stalls serving local delicacies such as skewers, fried noodles, and sweet treats. It’s a must-visit for food lovers.
spots.addr: West Yingchuan Road

spots.name: Fuchun Teahouse
spots.desc: This traditional teahouse offers a relaxing atmosphere with a variety of Chinese teas, pastries, and dim sum. It’s a great place to take a break and experience tea culture.
spots.addr: No. 45 Zhongshan Road

spots.name: Xiao’s Barbecue
spots.desc: This popular barbecue spot offers a wide range of grilled meats and vegetables. It’s a lively place to enjoy a casual evening with friends, with a menu featuring everything from skewered lamb to grilled fish.
spots.addr: No. 77 South Yingchuan Road

spots.name: Yuzhou Coffee House
spots.desc: A cozy spot for coffee lovers, offering a wide selection of freshly brewed coffees and teas. It’s a relaxing place to unwind after exploring Yuzhou’s many sights.
spots.addr: No. 15 Wenming Road

spots.name: Lotus Tea House
spots.desc: Located near the Taoist temple on Lianhua Mountain, this tea house offers traditional Chinese teas in a peaceful setting. It’s a great place to experience local tea culture while enjoying the mountain scenery.
spots.addr: Lianhua Mountain Scenic Area

spots.name: Shenhou Ancient Town Wine Bar
spots.desc: A cozy, laid-back bar in Shenhou Ancient Town, offering a variety of wines, beers, and cocktails. It’s a popular spot for both locals and tourists to relax in the evening.
spots.addr: Shenhou Ancient Town

spots.name: Yuzhou Beer Garden
spots.desc: An open-air beer garden that offers a variety of local and imported beers. It’s a lively spot for both locals and tourists, especially in the evening. It also serves barbecued snacks to accompany the drinks.
spots.addr: West Yingchuan Road

spots.name: Yuzhou Traditional Tea House
spots.desc: A quiet, traditional tea house offering a wide selection of Chinese teas. It is a good spot to experience local tea culture and enjoy a peaceful break from the busy streets.
spots.addr: No. 88 South Yingchuan Road

spots.name: Zhongmu County Museum
spots.desc: A museum showcasing Zhongmu's history, artifacts, and folk culture. Hosts temporary exhibitions and cultural programs.

spots.name: Zhongmu Wetland Park
spots.desc: Eco-friendly park with lakes, reeds, and wetland wildlife. Popular for birdwatching, photography, walking, and boating.

spots.name: Unique Henan·Land of Dramas
spots.desc: It features 21 theaters of various sizes and nearly a thousand actors, with a total performance duration of nearly 700 minutes.Only Henan·Drama Fantasy City primarily employs immersive theatrical art techniques and uses the unique theatrical "Phantom City" as a medium, emphasizing the design philosophy of the "Great Chessboard." Only the Henan·Drama Fantasy City Scenic Area project is grounded in…
spots.addr: Northwest corner of the intersection of Ping'an Avenue and Guangxin Street

spots.name: The China (Zhengzhou) Greening Expo Park
spots.desc: The garden covers a total area of 196 hectares and features 99 exhibition gardens. By the end of 2012, it was designated as a National AAAA-Level Tourist Attraction. In 2014, the garden housed over 1,300 species of plants, including 636,000 rare plants. The exceptional design showcases the essence of global garden artistry. By integrating Eastern charm with exotic influences from five continents…
spots.addr: Greenbo Avenue

spots.name: Huangdi Romance Park
spots.desc: A large immersive night-tour cultural park themed around the Yellow Emperor. The highlight is the grand live performance “Eternal Romance of the Yellow Emperor”, combining dance, projection, and storytelling. Popular among family visitors and tour groups.
spots.addr: 黄帝千古情景区

spots.name: Yellow Emperor’s Hometown Cultural Tourism Area
spots.desc: Traditionally regarded as the birthplace of the Yellow Emperor. It hosts the annual Ancestor Worship Ceremony, one of Henan’s major cultural events. The area includes ceremonial squares, memorial halls, and landscaped pathways.
spots.addr: North section of Xuanyuan Road

spots.name: Guandu Ancient Town Site
spots.desc: Remains of a historic Yellow River ferry town. Some old wells and traces of street layouts are still visible. The surrounding zone is being gradually revitalized into a cultural and leisure block with small shops and cafés.
spots.addr: Guandu Area

spots.name: Zhengzhou Haichang Marine Tourism Area
spots.desc: The Haichang Marine Tourism Area is a large ocean theme park that combines marine biodiversity displays, interactive experiences, and high-tech performances. The park features a polar animal museum, a dream jellyfish palace, and an underwater tunnel, with daily dolphin shows and interactive beluga whale performances.
spots.addr: located at the intersection of Zhengkai Avenue and Wenhua Road

spots.name: Jianye · Huayi Brothers Film Town
spots.local: 建业·华谊兄弟电影小镇
spots.desc: creating an immersive theatrical space by recreating Republican-era street scenes and film sets. The core experiences include a walking performance of "Crossing Dehua Street" (two shows daily at 10:30 and 15:30), a stunt reality show of "Central Plains Knife Guest," and a cross-themed photography area where cheongsams can be changed. Special Recommendation: The scenic area offers rental services…
spots.addr: at the intersection of Cultural Innovation Road and Hundred Flowers Street

spots.name: Zhongmu Wenming Road Night Market
spots.desc: Lively night market offering skewers, noodles, clay-pot dishes, and local snacks.
spots.addr: Wenming Road

spots.name: Fengxue Temple and Pagoda Forest
spots.desc: It is a large ancient architectural complex that gathers buildings from various dynasties, with over 140 buildings from the Tang to Qing dynasties, and is known as the "Museum of Ancient Architecture". There have been buildings throughout the Tang, Song, Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties. Such as the Seven Ancestral Pagoda in the Tang Dynasty, the Hanging Bell Pavilion in the Song Dynasty, the…
spots.addr: Huangzhuang Village, Qiling Township

spots.name: Coal Mountain Site
spots.desc: You can see relics such as house foundations, pottery kilns, water wells, and tombs from the Neolithic Age to the Xia Dynasty, as well as relics such as stone axes, pottery, bone tools, jade spears, and clear cultural layer accumulations.
spots.addr: Inside Coal Mountain Park on the southeast side of the intersection of Guangcheng Road and Xihuan Road

spots.name: Zhongshanzhai Site
spots.desc: It contains two cultural relics, Peiligang culture and Yangshao culture, and is a prehistoric cultural site with important academic value. The site covers an area of 750000 m².
spots.addr: Zhongshanzhai Village, Zhifang Town

spots.name: Donggou Kiln Site
spots.desc: It is an important folk porcelain kiln site in Henan during the Song, Jin, and Yuan dynasties, known for its fusion of Ru kiln and Jun kiln craftsmanship. In 2019, it was listed as a national key cultural relic protection unit.
spots.addr: Donggou Village, Dayu Town

spots.name: Jiufengshan Scenic Area
spots.desc: The scenic area is named after nine peculiar peaks distributed from west to east. Ruzhou used to be known as Nanliang and Zhounan, and Jiufeng Mountain is also known as "Nanshan" because it is located south of its territory. Built on Jiufengshan National Forest Park, Tengkou Reservoir, and the regional culture of Ruzhou, it is provincial-level forest park and a national AAAA level tourist…
spots.addr: Song Village, Pingwang, Mailing Town

spots.name: Ruzhou Guipo Scenic Area
spots.desc: The scenic area covers an area of 12 square kilometers and consists of a strange slope viewing area, a bamboo forest temple, and a Yuhuangshan leisure resort. The main slope of the core landscape "Sister Strange Slope" is 126 meters long, presenting an abnormal physical phenomenon of "riding uphill without pedaling".
spots.addr: Northeast of Qiling Township, about 9 kilometers away from the city center

spots.name: Ruhe National Wetland Park
spots.desc: Wetland Ecology+Sports and Leisure: National Wetland Park (3A Scenic Area); Set up a plastic track and a hydrophilic fitness area, where 204 species of animals can be observed, accompanied by a cute pet interactive area and a boat project.
spots.addr: In the southern part of the city, about 5 km north of the city center, it runs through the entire Ruzhou area (including the Rushui Riverside Park and Beach…

spots.name: City Central Park
spots.desc: Ecological+Comprehensive Fitness: including a lakeside trail, sports square, waterfall water system, high negative oxygen ion content. The Ruxing bus route provides direct access, with dedicated lanes for parent-child cycling and a children's sports area. In spring, visitors can enjoy flowers, while in autumn, the forest is fully dyed.
spots.addr: Rudong New District, starting from Ruhe North Road in the south and ending at Dream Avenue (north bank of the central part of Ruhe National Wetland Park) in…

spots.name: Xier Binhe Park
spots.desc: Waterfront+National Sports: with basketball courts, fitness equipment areas, and nighttime illuminated trails built along the riverbank; Set up a parent-child amusement park (climbing net, rocking music), open 24 hours a day, accessible by bus routes 16 and 20.
spots.addr: Along the banks of the Xier River, 100 meters east of the intersection of Xiangyang Road and Binhe West Road

spots.name: Danyang Lake Park
spots.desc: Comprehensive cultural tourism+sports: including forest ecological park, children's playground, aerial boardwalk, and leisure sports field. The children's area is equipped with water boating and maze amusement park, and flower picking can be participated in spring. It is also accompanied by science popularization explanatory signs and a mother and baby room.
spots.addr: Rudong New District, east side of Forest Ecological Park

spots.name: Ruyi Lake Park
spots.desc: Lakeview leisure+parent-child amusement: 8.7 hectares of water area can be used for boat rides and bumper cars; Set up exclusive children's playgrounds (slides, swings) and music fountain performance areas; Supporting picnic area and zoo, where small animals can be observed, suitable for all day family play.
spots.addr: In the northeast of the city, it borders Chaoyang East Road to the north and Yunchan Avenue to the west

spots.name: Coal Mountain Cultural Heritage Park
spots.desc: Cultural Sites+Fitness: Provincial Archaeological Site Park, including Xia Dynasty Cultural Site Exhibition Area and Middle aged and Elderly Fitness Area. Set up Tai Chi Square and basic sports facilities.
spots.addr: Coal Mountain Street, southeast of the intersection of Guangcheng Road and Xihuan Road (inside Coal Mountain Park)

spots.name: Ruhe Beach Park
spots.desc: Parent child sports+leisure and entertainment: Fujian Haisha Children's Area, where you can build sand castles and play with beach toys. Set up a water sports center (parent-child boat, water gyro); equipped with shower rooms and children's changing rooms.
spots.addr: On the south bank of the Ruhe River, in the middle of the Ruhe National Wetland Park (900 meters north of Qianzhuang Station)

spots.name: Humanistic Sports Park
spots.desc: Professional sports: focusing on competitive sports facilities, equipped with standard courts and track and field tracks, suitable for specialized sports training and team activities, and surrounded by sports equipment stores.
spots.addr: Along Hongxiang Avenue, 2.1 kilometers east of Heshun Prefecture

spots.name: Rushui Riverside Park (Parent Child Park)
spots.desc: Waterfront culture+parent-child: exclusive parent-child amusement park with climbing nets and rocking music; Set up a cute pet playground (where you can feed small rabbits and goats). Open night light shows and music fountains, equipped with child safety guardrails.
spots.addr: 200 meters southwest of the intersection of Hongxiang Avenue and Ruhe North Road, north bank of Ruhe National Wetland Park

It is divided into two islands, the South and North, with six famous attractions, but considering the convenience of tourists, it is recommended to choose a ¥100 ticket, including Wangfu Cliff on the South Island, Crescent Bay and Jiuzhang Cliff on the North…
spots.addr: 海滨路与海港街交叉口西50米

spots.name: Jiuzhang Cliff
spots.desc: Jiuzhang Cliff is located in the northwest corner of Beichangshan Island. It is a natural landscape famous for its towering and steep cliffs. There are not only mountains, cliffs, rocks, reefs and caves in various shapes and forms, but also a place where people can feel the greatness of nature. Standing at the foot of Jiuzhang Cliff and looking up at the cliffs, one can't help but sigh at the…
spots.addr: Dianzi Village, Beichangshan Township

spots.name: Dengzhou Ancient Ship Museum
spots.desc: Dengzhou Ancient Ship Museum is a commemorative attraction in Penglai, which is dedicated to displaying the history and culture of the ancient Dengzhou Port and unearthed ancient ships. The museum houses four ancient Chinese and foreign ships from the Yuan and Ming dynasties, red sandalwood rudders, huanghuali shipbuilding wood, wooden anchors and other precious national cultural relics. These…
spots.addr: No. 59, Yingbin Road, Penglai Pavilion Subdistrict, Penglai Pavilion Scenic Area (south side)

spots.name: Longzhaoshan National Geological Park
spots.desc: Longzhao Mountain is located at the northern end of Daheishan Island in Changdao County, Yantai City, Shandong Province. It is composed of five high, steep, and precipitous coastal cliffs stretching endlessly. The mountain is renowned for its unique marine erosion landform and is the most typical quartzite group distribution area in Chinese Mainland islands. It boasts natural wonders such as the…
spots.addr: The northern tip of Daheishan Island

spots.name: Penglai Speedboat Terminal
spots.desc: At the base of the pavilion, short speedboat trips around the bay and cliffs, tickets ¥100. Some services also go all the way out to nearby islands.
spots.addr: 100 meters west of West Haibin Road

spots.name: Wine of Penglai
spots.desc: Yantai Taoniuling is located in Mulangou Village, Daxindian Town. It has a modern and simple environment, which is very suitable for taking pictures. The natural environment is comfortable and the view is wide. The restaurant offers exquisite Cantonese set meals with full texture. It has the "3S" characteristics suitable for grape growth: sun, sand, and sea, and is known as one of the "seven…

spots.name: Penglai Farmers' Trade Plaza
spots.desc: The market is very large and neat. On the left side of the entrance, there are seasonings, cooked food, dry goods, and seafood. On the right side, there are vegetables, fruits, meat, and seafood. From 05:00 to 12:00, there are many people and the most goods. In the afternoon, there are fewer people in the vegetable and seafood areas. The seafood area is good, and the seafood you buy is fresh and…
spots.addr: New Farmers Market

spots.name: Fan Gongting
spots.desc: An ancient pavilion built in Song Dynasty. It was a private garden of Fan Zhongyan who was the most notable poet and prosiast in an age of lively literature prosperous.

spots.name: Muslim District
spots.desc: Including at least two large and historic mosques. The oldest one is the Zhenjiao Mosque (真教寺). It can date from eight centuries ago, which is one of the three most well-known mosques in Yuan Dynasty.

spots.name: Ou Yuan
spots.desc: A Ming Dynasty garden. It turned to be a combination of park and zoo, and is used as a performance area for citizens in the dawn and nightfall.

spots.name: Qingzhou Museum
spots.desc: Features some of the Buddhist statues unearthed in 1996/1997.
spots.hours: October-April: 09:00-16:30, May-September: 09:00-17:00, no entry in last 30 minutes. Entry is restricted to 3000…
spots.addr: 1 Fangongting Road West (范公亭西路1号)

spots.name: Tuoshan/Yunmenshan
spots.desc: Includes an ancient collection of Buddhist grottoes under national protection. The mountain is located approximately 4 km southwest of the city center.

spots.name: Mount Yangtian National Forest Park
spots.desc: A natural park with marvelous surface features. It is covered by virgin forest, through which crystal rivers are flowing, and dotted with quantities of natural rock cavities. What makes this park more amazing is the so-called thousand Buddha's cave, which is considered as the first cave for the Buddhas. This is because of the huge volume of the cavern and the 1048 Buddhas in it that are in…
spots.addr: Wangfen Town (王坟镇)

spots.name: Qingzhou Ancient City
spots.desc: The ancient city of Qingzhou has a long history, with a history of more than 2,200 years. Since the beginning of the Western Han Dynasty, there have been six ancient cities, including Guangxiancheng, Guanggucheng, Dongyangcheng, Nanyangcheng, Dongguanweizicheng, and Manchurian Zhufangqicheng, which have been the political, economic, military and cultural center of the whole Shandong region for…

spots.name: TaiHua City
spots.desc: It is a one-stop comprehensive shopping center integrating shopping, catering, leisure, business, culture, art, experience and other functions.
spots.addr: 3088 Zhaode South Rd

spots.name: Chaorantai
spots.desc: Chaorantai is the foundation of the city wall, which was built in the Northern Wei Dynasty. It was expanded by Su Shi, a famous writer, in the eighth year of the reign of Emperor Shenzong of the Northern Song Dynasty (1075). In 1948, Chaorantai was unfortunately destroyed during the Chinese Civil War. In January 2010, a new Chaorantai was completed at the original site.
spots.hours: Oct-Apr: 08:30-11:30, 13:30-17:00; May-Sep: 08:30-11:30, 14:00-17:30; no entry in last 30 minutes; closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 64 Beiguan Road (北关路64号)

spots.name: The Zhucheng section of the Great Wall of Qi
spots.desc: The ruins of the Great Wall of Qi in Zhucheng are fairly well preserved. Note: the coordinates used here are for the ruins near Hanjiagou Village (韩家沟村). More ruins may be found near Bogeya Village (鹁鸽崖村).

spots.name: Zhucheng Dinosaur Museum
spots.desc: The Zhucheng Dinosaur Museum covers an area of 5,400 square meters and is one of the largest dinosaur museums in northern China. A highlight of the museum is the world's second tallest hadrosaur fossil skeleton, a Zhuchengosaurus maximus measuring 9.1 meters high and 16.6 meters long.
spots.addr: 3 Mizhou West Road (密州西路3号)

spots.name: Zhucheng China Tyrannosaurus Museum
spots.desc: Displays fossils of Zhuchengtyrannus magnus, a dinosaur species that was first discovered at this very site.
spots.addr: 5389 Zangkejia Road (臧克家路5389号)

spots.name: Qingyun Temple
spots.desc: Qingyun Temple faces north and south, and has three main halls made of brick and wood, with blue bricks and black tiles. There are many ridge beasts on the roof, and there are also dragons on it. The gate of the temple is more than three meters high, and the two windows are very large, which is quite impressive. There are couplets carved on the pillars. During the Cultural Revolution, the temple…
spots.addr: Qingyun Village, Danjiadianzi Community, Linjiacun Town (林家村镇丹家店子社区青云村)

spots.name: Zhucheng Zoo
spots.desc: This is a relatively young zoo, having been founded in 2017. It has African lions, Siberian tigers, giraffes, zebras, monkeys, camels, deers, bears, and various other animals. Besides animals, the zoo also has an assortment of amusement rides.
spots.price: Standard entry fee is ¥70; children under 1.2 meters and seniors over 70 can enter for free
spots.addr: Dongsu Village West Side, Mizhou Subdistrict (密州街道东俗村西侧)

spots.name: Mount Yi
spots.desc: A scenic mountain about 10km south of downtown Zoucheng. In ancient times, this was one of the most famous mountains in China. Mencius once climbed the mountain, as did Confucius, Qin Shihuang, Sima Qian, Li Bai, Du Fu, Su Dongpo and many other notable historical figures.
spots.addr: Yishan Village, Yishan Town (峄山镇峄山村)

spots.name: Shangjiushan Ancient Village
spots.desc: A traditional stone village with many buildings dating from the Ming and Qing dynasties.
spots.price: Tickets normally cost ¥80 but can be purchased more cheaply on the Shangjiushan Ancient Village WeChat account
spots.addr: Shiqiang Town (石墙镇)

spots.name: Temple and Mansion of Mencius
spots.desc: The temple and mansion of the ancient philosopher Mencius, perennially known as China's "Second Sage" (after Confucius) can be found on the south side of the city, perhaps a mile's walk from downtown. The two sites (adjacent to each other, and visitable on a single ticket) are similar in their architecture, sculpture and landscaping to the "First Sage's" facilities in Qufu, but are much less…
spots.price: It is often said that if your family name is Meng (i.e., you are the sage's possible descendant), admission is free…
spots.addr: 44 Yashengfu Street (亚圣府街44号)

spots.name: Tomb of the Ming Prince of Lu
spots.local: 明鲁王陵, 明鲁王墓
spots.desc: The final resting place of Zhang Tan, a prince of Lu during the Ming Dynasty. Zhang Tan is buried here with his two wives. The tomb has been fully excavated and is open to the public. However, the artefacts on display are all replicas. The originals are kept at the Shandong Provincial Museum in Jinan.
spots.addr: Shangzhai Village, Zhongxindian Town (中心店镇尚寨村)

spots.name: Zoucheng Museum
spots.desc: The city's main museum. It includes a permanent exhibition about Mencius and his descendents. Visitor numbers are limited to 2000 per day.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 56 Shunhe Road (顺河路56号)

spots.name: Mencius Theater
spots.desc: Mencius Theater was built in 2016. It has a total of 5 floors and has a theater, multi-purpose hall, VIP hall, rehearsal hall and conference room. The total construction area is about 35,000 square meters, and it is a comprehensive public service place for large-scale literary and artistic performances of the masses in the city.
spots.addr: No. 2669 Taiping East Road, (山东省济宁市邹城太平东路2669号)

spots.name: Zoucheng cultural square
spots.desc: This is a good place to take a walk after a meal, and the architectural style in the square is also unique. In this square, there are both the style of modern gardens and the shadow of ancient traditional culture, which can be described as a fusion of ancient and modern. The whole square is creative with reference to the word "spring" in ancient seal script, which is very symbolic and represents…
spots.addr: Taiping East Road

spots.name: Zoucheng Yiwu Trade City
spots.desc: Introduction of Zoucheng Yiwu Trade City in Jining: On April 21st, the opening ceremony of Zoucheng Yiwu Trade City, a large wholesale market in southwest Shandong, was held grandly. Relevant leaders and guests from the National Business Federation, Shandong Provincial Party Committee Policy Research, Shandong Provincial Political Consultative Conference, Jining Municipal Committee, Zoucheng…
spots.addr: No.189, Chengqian West Road (northwest corner of Panlongzhu)

spots.name: Binhai New Area Museum
spots.desc: A local area museum focused mainly on the history and culture of Binhai New Area, including the historic port of Tanggu. The museum used to be known as Tanggu Museum (塘沽博物馆).
spots.hours: Tue-Sun 09:00-17:00, no entry in last 15 minutes, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 1/988 Zhongxin Road (中心路988号附1号)

spots.name: Chaoyin temple
spots.desc: The Chaoyin Temple was built on 1404 (during the Ming Dynasty). It used to be called Nanhaidasi Temple or Shuangshan Temple. It faces the Hai River mouth at Dagu and is one of the few temples that faces east. It is the only cultural relics in the south of the former Tanggu District that is open to the outside world.
spots.addr: No. 1 Chaoyinsi Road (潮音寺路增1号)

spots.name: National Maritime Museum of China
spots.desc: Visitors are expected to make an appointment before visiting the museum. You can make an appointment on the Chinese version of the website or on the museum's WeChat account (the WeChat account name is '国家海洋博物馆'; see website for QR code).
spots.hours: Tue-Fri 09:00-17:00, Sat Sun 09:00-18:00, public holidays 09:00-19:00, no entry in last 30 minutes, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 337 Haixuan Road, Sino-Singapore Eco-City (中新生态城海轩道377号)

spots.name: Tianjin Haichang Polar Ocean World
spots.local: 天津海昌极地海洋世界; Tiānjīn Hǎichāng Jídì Hǎiyáng Shìjiè
spots.desc: A large building where you can see a wide variety of fish and mammals from the northern and southern polar regions such as penguins, polar bears, whales, seals, wolves, a wide variety of marine life, etc. You can also check out the dolphin performances that they have scheduled a few times a day.
spots.price: ¥245 (adults), ¥160 (children between 1 and 1.4 meters in height); tickets are valid for two entries
spots.addr: No. 61 Xiangluowan Business District (响螺湾中心商务区61号 Tiānjīn Bīnhǎi Xīn Qū Xiǎngluówān Zhōngxin Shāngwù Qū 61 Hào)

spots.name: Tianjin TEDA Aircraft Carrier Theme Park
spots.local: 天津泰达航母主题公园
spots.desc: The star of this theme park is the Kiev, a decommissioned Soviet aircraft carrier dating from 1970. Visitors are able to board the Kiev and take a look around. A mock sea battle involving the Kiev is performed daily between the months of May and October. Also on display are a Chinese-made destroyer and a Chinese-made submarine. Besides exploring the old naval vessels, visitors can also immerse…
spots.hours: March-October opening hours: 09:00-17:30 (weekdays), 09:00-18:00 (weekends); November-February opening hours…
spots.price: Adult tickets are ¥220, tickets for children between 1.2 and 1.5 m are ¥110, children under 1.2 m enjoy free entry
spots.addr: Intersection of Zhongyang Avenue and Gongyuanzhi Road (中央大道与公园之路交叉路口)

spots.name: Baxianshan National Nature Reserve
spots.local: 八仙山国家级自然保护区, Eight Immortals Mountains National Nature Reserve
spots.desc: The nature reserve takes its name from the Baxianshan Mountains, a mountain range consisting of 19 peaks. The highest peak is Juxian Peak (聚仙峰), which stands 1052 meters above sea level, making it the second highest land formation in Tianjin.
spots.hours: As of August 2021, the nature reserve is temporarily closed due to geological disturbances; normal opening hours are…
spots.addr: Xiaogang Village North, Xiaying Town (下营镇小港村北)

spots.name: Jiulongshan National Forest Park
spots.local: 九龙山国家森林公园, Nine Dragons Mountains National Forest Park
spots.desc: A sprawling national park centered around the Jiulongshan Mountains. Notable sights within the park include Baozang Temple, Shangxin Pavilion, Longquan Cave, Huanghua Ridge (the highest peak in the park) and Wanglong Peak (the second highest peak).
spots.price: ¥40 (entry ticket), ¥50 (tour guide), ¥5 (parking fee); adults over 70 and children under 1.2 meters can enter the park…
spots.addr: Xiangyu Village North, Chuanfangyu Town (穿芳峪镇果香峪村北)

spots.name: Panshan Ski Area
spots.desc: A dilapidated ski park for beginners to experience snow sports for the first or second time.There are several bunny hills strewn with the bodies of fallen beginners slow to pick themselves up, posing serious collision hazards. Entrance and ski equipment rental costs only ¥5. If you need clothing, gloves goggles, helmet, or an instructor, rental costs will be charged and deducted from the ¥200…
spots.addr: Intersection of Panshan Avenue and Yanshan West Street (盘山大道与燕山西大街交汇处)

spots.name: Beiji Village (北极村)
spots.desc: Located at China's northernmost point, this village is famous for its Arctic scenery, including auroras and "Northern Lights Plaza." Visitors can also experience traditional northern Chinese culture.
spots.addr: Mohe County

spots.name: May 6th Fire Memorial Hall (五六火灾纪念馆)
spots.desc: A museum dedicated to the memory of the catastrophic forest fire on May 6, 1987. The hall displays photos, relics, and information about the firefighting efforts, environmental restoration, and the event's impact on Mohe. It's a sobering yet educational experience for visitors interested in history and environmental conservation.
spots.addr: Mohe County

spots.name: Guanyin Mountain (观音山)
spots.desc: A serene and culturally significant site, Guanyin Mountain is home to a towering Guanyin statue overlooking the surrounding forests. It is a popular spot for both pilgrims and tourists, offering stunning views of the natural landscape and a peaceful atmosphere for reflection. Visitors can also enjoy nearby hiking trails.
spots.addr: 5 km from Mohe City

spots.name: Heilongjiang First Bay (黑龙江第一湾)
spots.desc: Known as the "First Bay of the Heilongjiang River," this site offers stunning panoramic views of the river's dramatic bend as it forms a natural border between China and Russia. The area is surrounded by pristine forests and offers an excellent vantage point for photography, particularly at sunrise and sunset. Hiking trails and observation platforms are available for visitors.
spots.addr: Near Beiji Village, Mohe County

spots.name: Beihong Village (北红村)
spots.desc: Beihong Village is one of China's northernmost settlements, known for its traditional wooden houses, untouched natural beauty, and authentic rural lifestyle. The village is surrounded by lush forests and is an excellent place to experience the simplicity of life in China's far north. Visitors can also enjoy stargazing, particularly during the winter, when the Northern Lights may be visible.
spots.addr: Mohe County

spots.name: Santa Claus Village Scenic Area (圣诞村旅游景区)
spots.desc: The Santa Claus Village Scenic Area is a themed park inspired by Christmas traditions, featuring attractions like Santa’s House, reindeer sleds, and a snow-themed playground. Visitors can take photos with Santa Claus, enjoy holiday decorations year-round, and explore cultural exhibits showcasing Arctic life. A family-friendly destination, the park is especially lively during winter months.
spots.addr: Beiji Village, Mohe County

spots.name: Jiucun Shibawan National Wetland (九曲十八弯国家湿地)
spots.desc: This expansive wetland area is renowned for its winding waterways, lush vegetation, and abundant wildlife. It features a series of interconnected river bends that create picturesque views, especially at sunrise and sunset. Visitors can explore the wetland via elevated walkways, observation towers, and boat rides, making it a perfect destination for nature lovers and photographers.
spots.addr: Near Mohe County

spots.name: Santa Claus House (圣诞老人之家)
spots.desc: Santa Claus House is the centerpiece of the Santa Claus Village Scenic Area, offering visitors a whimsical holiday-themed experience. The house is decorated with festive ornaments, featuring displays about Christmas traditions, photo opportunities with "Santa," and interactive activities for children. It is a perfect destination for families and holiday enthusiasts.
spots.price: Included in the Santa Claus Village Scenic Area ticket (¥60)
spots.addr: Beiji Village, Mohe County

spots.name: Reindeer Park (驯鹿公园)
spots.desc: Reindeer Park offers visitors a chance to see and interact with domesticated reindeer, a rare experience in China. The park highlights the culture of the Ewenki people, one of China's indigenous groups known for their traditional deer herding practices. Visitors can feed the reindeer, learn about their habitat, and enjoy the serene Arctic environment. Guided tours and photo opportunities are…
spots.addr: Beiji Village, Mohe County

spots.name: The Aurora Festival
spots.desc: Mohe is the only place in the country where the Northern Lights and the midnight sun can be observed. During the summer solstice, daylight in Mohe can last up to 21 hours, attracting numerous visitors to experience the midnight sun and chase the aurora.
spots.addr: Mohe City

spots.name: Ice and Snow Festival
spots.desc: The Mohe Ice and Snow Cultural Festival, held annually around December 21, features activities like freezing water performances, snowmobile shows, ice dragon boating, and traditional sledding. Visitors can enjoy local dishes like fish stew and dumplings, celebrating the warmth of winter in extreme cold.
spots.addr: Mohe City

spots.name: Mohe Ice and Snow Cultural Festival
spots.desc: During the Mohe Ice and Snow Cultural Festival, visitors can experience the unique "freezing water into ice" activity. In extreme cold conditions of -40°C, hot water is thrown into the air, instantly turning into ice crystals and forming a spectacular arc-shaped ice mist. This activity is a favorite among tourists and has become a highlight of winter tourism in Mohe.

spots.name: Cod
spots.desc: The cod abundant in Mohe is a precious cold-water fish known for its tender meat and rich nutrition.

spots.name: Oncorhynchus keta
spots.desc: This is a large economic fish with delicious meat that can be eaten fresh or processed into canned products. Its roe enjoys a high reputation in the international market.

spots.name: Hazelnuts
spots.desc: Mohe is one of the main producing areas of hazelnuts in China. Hazelnut kernels are fat, white, crisp and delicious, rich in oil, and are a popular dried fruit.

spots.name: Amaranth mushroom
spots.desc: The Amaranth mushroom is a rare mushroom that only grows in a specific environment. It is delicious and has high nutritional value. It is known as the "Holy Mushroom".

spots.name: Air-dried sausage
spots.desc: Mohe's air-dried sausage has a long history. It is made from fresh lean meat and added with a variety of spices. It has a unique flavor and is a good companion to wine.

spots.name: Longjiang Agate
spots.desc: The agate produced in the Mohe area is famous for its large size and bright color. It is a semi-precious gem material; see gemstones.

spots.name: Chinese arctic blueberry
spots.desc: Mohe's blueberries are famous for being pollution-free and growing naturally in the primeval forests of the Daxingan Mountains, and are known as the "King of Berries". Blueberries can not only be eaten fresh, but are also often processed into dried fruits, jams, juices and other products.

spots.name: Chicken Stewed with Hazel Mushrooms
spots.desc: This is a traditional Northeastern dish that uses locally raised chickens and precious hazel mushrooms. It is carefully stewed and is delicious and nutritious.

spots.name: Guobao Pork
spots.desc: This dish uses pig tenderloin. After a unique cooking process, it is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. It is sweet and sour. It is one of Mohe’s classic dishes.

spots.name: Stews
spots.desc: There are many kinds of stews in Mohe, such as stewed goose, stewed ribs, etc. These stews are usually cooked in casseroles, which can maintain the heat of the dishes for a long time and are suitable for cold weather.

spots.name: Venison Hot Pot
spots.desc: Using fresh venison, paired with local mushrooms, wild vegetables and other ingredients, it is tender, juicy and has a unique taste.

spots.name: Frozen fruits
spots.desc: The winter in Mohe is very cold, so the frozen fruits here are also very delicious. Frozen apples, frozen pears, frozen persimmons and other fruits have a sweet taste and are local specialty desserts.

spots.name: White meat blood sausage
spots.desc: This is one of the specialty dishes of Northeast China. It combines the flavors of pork and pig blood. After being steamed, it has a bright color and a mellow taste.

spots.name: "Fragrant Grilled Lira Fashion Theme BBQ"
spots.local: 香烤里拉时尚主题烧烤
spots.desc: There are many types of barbecue in Mohe, including mutton skewers, beef skewers, grilled fish, etc. Each skewer is grilled to perfection, charred on the outside and tender on the inside, with a fragrant aroma.

spots.name: Mohe Restaurant
spots.desc: These coordinates are approximate, so it's recommended to confirm the exact location using up-to-date map services before visiting.

spots.name: Daxinganling Flavor Restaurant
spots.desc: Famous for dishes made with local wild game and fish, offering an authentic experience of the region’s food culture.

spots.name: ice and snow honey water
spots.desc: The winter in Mohe is long, and the nectar collected by the bees is unique, and the honey made has a unique flavor.

spots.name: Wild wolfberry tea
spots.desc: The wild wolfberry grown in the Mohe area is of high quality. Tea brewed with wild wolfberry has a very good nourishing effect and is suitable for drinking in cold climates, helping to enhance the body's resistance.

spots.name: Blueberry wine
spots.desc: The Mohe area is famous for its blueberry wine produced in its unique natural environment. Mohe’s blueberry wine is also part of the local intangible cultural heritage project and reflects the traditional winemaking skills of the local people.

spots.name: Tomb of the General
spots.desc: Although disputed, this large pyramid is considered to be the royal tomb of either King Gwanggaeto or his son King Jangsu of the Goguryeo kingdom.

spots.name: Stele of King Gwanggaeto
spots.desc: Stele of King Gwanggaeto, erected to commemorate King Gwanggaeto of Goguryeo, is one of the important existing stone carvings in Ji'an. The stele is large, and its inscription mainly records the military activities and expansion of the regime at that time. Protective facilities surround the stele, allowing visitors to view it from a certain distance. Even without carefully reading the…

spots.name: Tombs of Goguryeo Nobles
spots.desc: The Tombs of Goguryeo Nobles Numerous Goguryeo noble tombs are scattered in the suburbs and surrounding areas of Ji'an. These tombs vary in style; some retain traces of murals, while others are primarily stone mounds. The tombs are mostly scattered in mountainous or gentle slope areas, making them suitable for combined visits with other attractions such as the General's Tomb. However, some…

spots.name: Yalu Riverbank
spots.desc: The Yalu Riverbank is the most accessible and best place in Ji'an to slow down. The riverside walkway offers expansive views, with clear visibility of the North Korean villages on the opposite bank. This isn't a traditional "tourist attraction," but it vividly reflects Ji'an's geographical location as a border city and its daily life, becoming relatively quiet in the evening.

spots.name: Ji'an Gaojuli Relics Park
spots.local: 集安高句丽文物古迹公园
spots.desc: This is an important part of the World Heritage Site "Coguryo Royal Cities, Tombs and Tombs of Nobles," including the General's Tomb, the Stele of King Gwanggaeto, and the Gungnae Fortress. The park features exhibition halls, a protected area, and walking trails, systematically showcasing the history and culture of Goguryeo.

spots.name: Ji'an Museum
spots.desc: The museum houses and exhibits a large collection of artifacts from the Goguryeo period, including murals, pottery, and weapons, providing a comprehensive introduction to Goguryeo history and culture through physical objects, models, and multimedia presentations. The permanent exhibitions are divided into sections such as "Goguryeo History," "Funerary Art," and "Daily Customs."
spots.price: Free (tickets available upon presentation of ID card)
spots.addr: Near the intersection of Jianshe Street and Yunshui Road

spots.name: Ji'an Border Riverside Walk
spots.desc: The trail runs along the Yalu River, the border river between China and North Korea, offering panoramic views of the North Korean landscape. Viewpoints, rest pavilions, and informational signs are located along the way. At night, the trail is illuminated, making it ideal for walking, cycling, and sightseeing.
spots.addr: The Yalu River shoreline (accessible on foot from the city center along Yalu River Road)

spots.name: Wunvfeng National Forest Park
spots.desc: The park is renowned for its unique peaks, beautiful waters, and forest landscapes. Major attractions include the Five Maidens Peak, canyon waterfalls, and forest trails, making it a great destination for hiking, photography, and nature observation. The autumn foliage is particularly spectacular.The scenic area is named "Five Maidens Peaks" and consists of five main peaks: Heavenly Maiden Peak…
spots.addr: Wunüfeng National Forest Park is located beside National Highway 303, approximately 21 kilometers from Ji'an City.

spots.name: Riverside Promenade
spots.desc: The promenade has many restaurants where you can view North Korea across the river.

spots.name: Bingyu National Geopark
spots.local: 大连冰峪国家地质公园
spots.desc: The park's main geological feature is Bingyu Valley (冰峪沟 Bīngyù Gōu). This is a twisting river valley, winding through steep cliffs, in a relatively unspoiled countryside just outside Zhuanghe City. A trip to the valley is well worth it as there are opportunities for hiking, boat rides and enjoying a bit of nature. There are also a number of Buddhist and Taoist temples to explore along the river.…
spots.price: April to Octoberː ¥100, November to Marchː ¥90
spots.addr: Xianrendong Town (仙人洞镇)

spots.name: Juehua Island
spots.desc: The biggest island in Liaodong Bay. Sizewise it is similar with Macau. The island used to be a holy site for Buddlism in Liao Dynasty. Scenic include Dalong Palace from Liao Dynasty, Dabei Pavilion from Ming Dynasty, etc. At Xingcheng Port there are ferries to Jiuhua Island, and one way takes around 40 m.

spots.name: Shou Mountain
spots.desc: The beacon tower on the mountain is from Ming Dynasty. In 1627, Ming army defeated the Jin here. Now the mountain is a national forest park.

spots.name: Man Jus'ri Temple
spots.desc: Definitely the most impressive hall with several enormous, elaborately decorated, Buddha statues along the rear wall and a pair of small rooms behind. Pilgrims make a clockwise circuit, stopping to make monetary offerings to brightly coloured yak-butter sculptures and pray to silver Chortens containing living Buddhas. At times the hall may reverberate with chanting monks.

spots.name: Prayer Wheels
spots.desc: Lining about half of the minor Kora are brightly painted wooden drums, spun by an endless procession of mainly elderly pilgrims hopping their efforts will be rewarded in the next life. On each corner is a small room housing huge lumbering wheels that ring a bell with each rotation.

spots.name: Thangka sunning Terrace
spots.desc: A flat stone slope on the hillside where a giant Thangka is rolled out during the Tibetan New year. The rest of the time it's a nice place to sit and get an overview of the Monastery.

spots.name: Sangke grasslands
spots.desc: wonderful grasslands with many nomad tents and herds of yaks and sheep. 12 km outside Xiahe is Sangke town, where most people who rent a bike go to. There is nothing to see in the town, you really need to go into the grasslands to enjoy the wonderful views.

spots.name: Ancient town of Bajiao
spots.desc: A walled village that was built in the Han Dynasty (around 2000 years ago). Bajiao Cheng is still inhabited.

spots.name: Ganjia Grasslands
spots.desc: The whole region is covered in grasslands during the summer months and makes an enjoyable place to see some wide open spaces.

spots.name: White Rock Cliffs
spots.desc: As you get closer to Bajiao Cheng, you won't be able to miss the cliffs high up in front of you. A small monastery sits right at the foot of the White Rock Cliffs. There is a small village together with the monastery.

spots.name: Darzong Lake
spots.desc: A highland lake located at just above 3,000 m (10,000 ft). Forested mountains surrounding the lake on almost all sides and forests all around. A taxi round trip (2-3 hours) costs around ¥100 or take a bus going to Linxia (临夏) or Hezuo (合作) and get off 20 km (about half an hour) down the highway when you see a big sign on the right side of the road. Tell the driver that you want to go to…

spots.name: Hike in the hills
spots.desc: Take a trek for a nice view over the town or the distant snowy peaks while enjoying the peace and tranquillity, disturbed only by occasional wayward yak. The forest behind the Thangka sunning terrace may look inviting but the amount of rubbish covering the ground detracts greatly. A better option is to follow the canal at the Monastery's entrance uphill and head along the dry floodway till you…

spots.name: Gesar Restaurant
spots.desc: One of the original places that's barely changed in years. The extensive English menu has a mix of Chinese and Tibetan dishes, plus a few approximations of western treats. Worth trying is the Tsampa, JueMa Fan and capichino style Yak butter tea. Everything is made from scratch so wait times can be lengthy, but the Tibetan style benches around the stove make a comfortable and warm place to watch…

spots.name: Late Sparkie
spots.desc: Oddly named Sichuan Hotpot place with individual pots and a selection of goat and vegetables to put in the spicy broth.
spots.price: ¥14 for the pot and ¥2-10 for each plate of meat or vegetables

spots.name: Nirvana Hotel, Restaurant & Bar.
spots.desc: The hotel's restaurant offers Tibetan, Chinese and Western food in a clean and pleasant restaurant. Good food, good drinks, good service, good music, good wifi. Highly recommended.
spots.addr: Ya Ge Tang 247

spots.name: Qutan Temple
spots.desc: Colorful murals which furnish valuable material for art and archaeological studies.
spots.addr: Dongbei Road (东北路; Dōngběilù)

spots.name: Gar Monastery
spots.desc: A Tibetan Buddhist monastery in the Baimai area of Nangqen County.
spots.addr: Baimai Village, Nangqen County, Qinghai, China

spots.name: Xiangda Market
spots.desc: A local market area around Xiangda Street in central Nangqen.
spots.addr: Xiangda Street, Nangqen County, Qinghai, China

spots.name: Wutong Monastery
spots.desc: With a reputation unequalled in the Tibetan world, many visitors come here exclusively to see the monastery's collection of centuries old Thanka paintings and watch the resident artists continuing the tradition. Though the art is undoubtedly the headliner the rebuilt grounds are a fine example of modern Tibetan architecture elaborately decorated with brightly painted wood carvings. The complex is…
spots.addr: S203 Rd

spots.name: Tongren Bridge
spots.desc: Though it is hardly be the most graceful looking span it is the most significant structure in town. During construction locals would gather at the intersection of Dehong Lu and Zhongshan Lu to discuss its progress as they watched the two halves stretch toward the eventual joining at the middle point. Now that the bridge is finished, locals have taken a somewhat blasé inclination to it, if its…

spots.name: Gamble
spots.desc: A rotating cast of sketchy looking characters play a 3-card Monty style game with a trio of oversize dice decorated with tiger, yak and cow pictures. Lay your money down, give them a shake and you might win back your money - or a Yak. Remember: The only way to win is not to play.
spots.addr: Corner DehelongNan Lu and MaiXiu Lu

spots.name: Hike
spots.desc: The western hills rising up next to town look steep from the bottom but the ChinFanLing on the peaks at various elevations prove it's climbable and also give you something to aim for as you blaze your own path up the more mild inclinations. A network of trails leading off from the Thangka sunning terrace behind the Monastery is a good place to start and leads to some reasonably mellow slopes that…

spots.name: Clothing
spots.desc: The main market has a couple of surprisingly fashionable boutiques, including a clothing store owned by a Tibetan with excellent English. Others sell those exotic looking but impractically long sleeved coats all the Tibetan guys have hanging around their waist.

spots.name: Thangkas
spots.desc: The monks at Wutong Monastery have an unequaled reputation for creating the beautifully detailed images of Buddhist deities meticulously painted on stretched fine-weave canvas. These are not some cheap tourist fodder, but works of art by skilled artists. Pigments are hand ground from brightly coloured and inordinately heavy stones sourced from Tibet that the monks say are worth upwards of ¥80 per…

spots.name: Yurt
spots.desc: There are a few places that either manufacture or sell large black and white yurts. Not very practical for the average backpacker but ideal if you're moving your yaks on to greener pastures.

spots.name: Number One Noodle
spots.desc: All hyperbole aside, the proprietors are very welcoming to bumbling foreigners furtively sticking their head inside. Helpful point-and-eat pictures on the wall mostly give prices, though it's best to check before ordering the ones without a price. You might discover they are suspiciously expensive at bill paying time.
spots.addr: 8 MaiXiu Lu

spots.name: Name-changing Hui restaurant
spots.desc: One of the numerous names written on the doors is right but it is easily identifiable as the most brightly lit place at night. They have huge servings of the usual capsicum laden Hui dishes. Their mianpian looks like a mess but is stomach filling and good.
spots.addr: Dehelong Zhong Lu

spots.name: Tibetan restaurant
spots.desc: A newish looking place packed with low Tibetan style painted benches serves only three things; MoMo, Jiaozi and Baozi. While the Momo are delectable they are heavy with heart attack inducing amounts of fat that will require an entire jug of Yak Butter tea to flush out of your digestive system.
spots.addr: Dehelong Nan Lu

spots.name: Beer
spots.desc: Qinghai's beer of choice is Huang. It comes is various incarnations that all hover around the 3.3% level of potency. If sitting in your hotel drinking the shelf-temperature bottle you bought from the supermarket isn't your idea of a good night out, try hitting some of the Tibetan restaurants, though your drink is unlikely to be any colder. It's not permissible to drink at any of the Hui…

spots.name: Yak Butter tea
spots.desc: Most Tibetan places serve jugs of frothy Yak butter tea if they have some already made. If you're a connoisseur it would pay to try a few different places as quality is highly variable.

spots.name: Temple of Princess Wencheng
spots.desc: Worth a visit. If you wander around the monastery at the left of the temple, you may find an English-speaking monk who lives there and will be very happy to welcome you and show you around.

spots.name: Horse Fair
spots.desc: Local townspeople and nomads from far and wide come. Exciting displays of horsemanship, and traditional Tibetan singing and dancing.

spots.name: Ya Restaurant
spots.desc: Traditional Muslim noodle cuisine. The ganban, similar to spaghetti and just as delicious, is especially recommended. However, one traveller experienced food poisening from this restaurant.

spots.name: Erlangshan Scenic Area
spots.desc: Tranquil spot with several temples and fantastic views from the top of the mountain. As of May 2021, the park is temporarily closed.
spots.addr: Provincial Highway 204 (204省道)

spots.name: Shenmu Museum
spots.desc: Entry is limited to 800 visitors per day, including 400 in the morning and 400 in the afternoon.
spots.addr: Linzhou Street (麟州街)

spots.name: Ancient City of Gaojiabao
spots.desc: The walled city of Gaojiabao was founded in the Ming Dynasty and has many historical sites, including old residences and temples, as well as the city walls and gates. Unfortunately you won't find any accommodation here, so it's best to come here on a day trip.
spots.addr: Shenwang Road (神王路)

spots.name: Hongjiannao Lake
spots.desc: The largest desert freshwater lake in China. Sadly, due to climate change and human activities such as coal mining, the lake has been shrinking since the 1970s. Nonetheless, it remain ecologically important and is a haven for rare birds. Since the 2010s, some serious efforts have been made to replenish the lake. For the visitor, various forms of water transport are available to explore the lake…
spots.addr: Zhaojun Avenue, Erlintu Town (尔林兔镇昭君大道)

spots.name: Sino-Russian old wharf style street scenic spot
spots.local: 中俄老码头风情街景区
spots.desc: In the Sino-Russian old wharf-style scenic spot, there is a Russian-style food street. Special features: cold water fish, kvass and yogurt.
spots.addr: 20 meters south of the intersection of Youfeng Road and Wolongwan Road (友谊峰路与卧龙湾路交叉口南20米)

spots.name: Hemu Village
spots.desc: Hemu Village, the highest administrative body of the prairie, is the northernmost township in western China. Hemu Village is one of the famous Tuvan villages and the farthest and largest of the three remaining Tuvan villages (Hemu Village, Kanas Village and Baihaba Village), with a total area of 3,040 lm². There are more than 1,800 people in the township, among whom there are more than 1,400…
spots.price: May 1-Oct 15: ¥50 yuan per person; Oct 16-Apr 30: ¥25 per person
spots.addr: Xinjiang Kanas National Geopark, Great Kanas Tourism Area (布尔津县大喀纳斯旅游区新疆喀纳斯国家地质公园)

spots.name: Gikpring International Ski Resort
spots.desc: Hemu Village is in the mountains, where the average snow thickness in winter is 1 meter and the thickest place can reach 2 meters. It begins to snow in mid-September every year and lasts until April. Snow falls more than half of the year, so skiing is also one of the reasons the area attracts travelers.
spots.addr: 5 km east of Hemu Village (布尔津县禾木村东侧5公里)

spots.name: Horse Riding.Horse Sleigh
spots.desc: Many local residents in Hemu area have horse farms in their homes, and when it snows, they will open horseback riding and horse-drawn sleigh projects. You can choose to ride alone or led by a staff member. The price is 80yuan per hour. The horse-drawn sleigh project can also be from Hemu Village to the top of the Hemu Village viewing platform. The price is 160yuan per session.
spots.addr: Hemu

spots.name: Eid al-Adha
spots.desc: The residents of Burqin region are mainly ethnic minorities, and the Eid al-Adha Festival is equivalent to the New Year of some local ethnic minorities and is one of the most important festivals. In this festival, every family will prepare traditional national food, hand-grabbed mutton, Borsak and so on. During the day, there will be a horse race, and after the end, everyone will eat prepared…

spots.name: Jia Runfu Market
spots.local: 家润福(哈纳斯旅游购物广场店)
spots.desc: Jia Runfu Market is located on the B1 floor of the Tourist Shopping Plaza, which offers the specialty food and decorations of Burqin. It's all wrapped food that you can bring back as a gift to your friends.
spots.addr: B1 Floor, Hanas Tourist Shopping Plaza, Kanas South Road (布尔津县喀纳斯南路哈纳斯旅游购物广场B1层)

spots.name: Nature store
spots.desc: Nature store is located in Hemu Village, which mainly sells backpacks, pendants and ornaments with local minority characteristics. It also sells homemade fruit wine.
spots.addr: Gikprin Road 102 (吉克普林路102路)

spots.name: Night Market
spots.desc: It is a night market located in the center of Burqin County. It mainly sells roast mutton, naan and other local food.
spots.addr: 40 meters northwest of intersection of Shengquan Road and Wolongwan Road (布尔津县圣泉路与卧龙湾路交叉口西北40米)

spots.name: Fengzhang Coffee
spots.desc: This is a coffee shop in Hemu Village. Coffee drinks, desserts and alcohol are available. Because of the local production of milk, so the materials used in the store are mostly local materials, with a certain degree of freshness. And the coffee shop is located in the Hemu village scenic area, scenic sightseeing is also one of the features of the shop.
spots.addr: 187 Wai Hara, Hemu Village (禾木村围哈拉187号)

spots.name: Songjia'xiaochu
spots.desc: This restaurant mainly produces home-cooked dishes and Xinjiang specialties, such as roast mutton. There are also local pike fish produced in Burqin. This fish is produced in only two places in China.
spots.addr: Youyi Feng Road, Xintiandi Food Street, 3rd floor, elevator left side (opposite the west end of Food Street) 友谊峰路新天地美食街3楼电梯左侧（美食街西头马路对面）

spots.name: Lanqin Yuan · Silk Road food cold water fish
spots.local: 兰沁园·丝路美食冷水鱼
spots.desc: The restaurant specialises in cold-water fish. It also sells Xinjiang's special food, such as roast mutton and big plate chicken. The store is located in Burqin County, the traffic is more convenient.
spots.addr: Building 4-5, Platinum Bay Community, Meilifeng West Road, Shenhu Road (神湖路美丽峰西路铂金湾小区4号-5号楼)

spots.name: Coffee Stay
spots.desc: The coffee shop is located in the Xincun area of Kanas Scenic area. The store has a variety of origin coffee beans to choose from, Italian coffee and hand-brewed coffee.
spots.addr: 喀纳斯新村55号停泊酒店 (Park Hotel, 55 Kanas New Village)

spots.name: Ancient Ruins
spots.desc: The most famous thing about the city is an archeological find with mummies from the ancient Tocharian civilisation. These are about 4000 years old with Caucasian features. One man is about two meters, a woman near 180cm. The best place to see them, however, in the museum in Ürümqi.

spots.name: Museum
spots.desc: A Uyghur architectural gem of a warlord's home containing a display of ancient Zaghunluq grave artifacts and a collection more recent farm and household items.

spots.name: Molcha River Rock Carvings
spots.desc: Collection of thousands of petroglyphs along a riverside cliff face, depict ancient life, with pastoral scenes, spiritual belief, animals, dancing and battles dating to the Bronze Age and Iron Age.

spots.name: Wildlife Park
spots.desc: Enormous, verdant grasslands area, to see the endangered Tibetan antelope and a wide range of other wildlife.

spots.name: Tatleksu Jade Mine
spots.desc: Visitors can tour and, afterward, try their luck hunting for jade in the nearby river.

spots.name: Tazhong Oil Field
spots.desc: Xinjiang's vast oil reserves in the center of the Taklamakan Desert can be toured by visitors.

spots.name: Uyghur Neighborhood
spots.desc: Wandering in the Uyghur neighborhood with rural paths, giant grape trellises, colorful courtyard doors, and a sizable mosque.

spots.name: Muatagh ata and Karakul lake 5 Days Trekking
spots.desc: You will be not only astonished by the stunning view of Muztagh Ata (7546 m) and Konggor (7649 m) mountains around the karakul lake, but also can explore the remote villages of the nomad Kyrgyz people in the area, and the Muztagh Ata climbing Base Camp.

spots.name: Kiril Grottoes
spots.desc: One of China's four grottoes which was built earlier than Mogao Grottoes of Dunhuang. The 10,000 sq m of murals, kept in 236 caves are still in place today, are of high value for artists and researchers alike.

spots.name: Stone Fort and Grassland
spots.desc: Stone fort is in downtown Taskurgan. It has a history of more than 2,000 years, from Tang and Qing times, and it was the central palace of the Tajik kingdom. During your walk on the grassland you will encounter grazing animals and lots of birds. The entry tickets for both you buy in Tourist Service Center, ¥51 (2025; includes bus transfer and visit of Tajik folklore village in the end).

spots.name: Visit Tajik folklore village
spots.desc: In the village local people tell about their life, show and play traditional music instruments, show traditional clothes, take tourists for some traditional dancing. You can visit the village as part of Stone Fort and Grassland tour, but a separate visit can potentially be done.

spots.name: Eat and stay with Tajik families
spots.desc: Near Tajik folklore village there are many signs (with names written) pointing to houses of Tajik families, where hosts offer authentic food and accommodation. To reach the signs and houses you don't have to go through Tourist Service Center, you can enter from the main town street.

spots.name: Bazaar area
spots.desc: Area with a few supermarkets and other shops selling assorted junk.

spots.name: Dabu County Museum
spots.desc: Small museum devoted to the history and culture of the region.
spots.addr: Intersection of Xi Huan Lu and the Y189, Huliao Town (湖寮镇西环路与Y189交汇口)

spots.name: Tai'an Building
spots.desc: The Tai'an Building is a tulou building that was built in 1764. It is probably the most accessible tulou building in Dabu County, being the only one located in the county seat. The square shape of the building makes it very unique because most tulou buildings are round.
spots.addr: 1-143 Daxing Road, Huliao Town (湖寮镇大兴路143-1号)

spots.name: Sanhe Sun Yat-Sen Memorial Hall
spots.desc: Dedicated to Sun Yat-Sen, leader of the Xinhai Revolution and the founding father of China's first republic. This is officially the oldest Sun Yat-Sen memorial in China, having been completed in 1929, about 4 years after Sun's death.
spots.addr: Zhongshan Park, Sanhe Town (三河镇中山公园内)

spots.name: Sanheba Battle Memorial
spots.desc: Commemorates the Battle of Sanheba, a battle during the Chinese Civil War that took place here in September 1927. The battle is considered to be of great significance by some Chinese historians because although the Red Army troops led by Zhu De were outnumbered and forced to retreat, most of them survived and were able to make it to the safety of the Jinggang Mountains where they helped to…
spots.addr: Bayi Road, Sanhe Town (三河镇八一路)

spots.name: Ancestral Home of Lee Kuan Yew
spots.desc: The ancestral home of the first prime minister of Singapore. Lee himself never lived here, however. It was built by his great-grand father Lee Bok Boon in 1884. Lee Bok Boon had immigrated to Singapore in 1863, but returned to Dabu in 1882, leaving his wife and children (including Lee Kuan Yew's grandfather) behind in Singapore. Lee Bok Boon died only a few months after the house was built and…
spots.addr: Tangxi Village (党溪村)

spots.name: Fuda Ceramics Industrial Tourism Zone
