spots.desc: Owned and operated by the Fuda Ceramics Company. Visitors can enter the ceramics factory and view the entire production line. There are also display areas where you can see not only products produced by Fuda Ceramics, but also works by famous artists and some ancient ceramics.
spots.addr: Gaobei Ceramics Production Base, Gaobei Town (高陂镇高陂陶瓷生产基地)

spots.name: Hua'e Building
spots.desc: A classic circular-shaped tulou dating from 1608. The building is in excellent condition for its age and looks as good as any of the tulou you will find in Fujian Province. A few families still live here, so certain rooms are off limits.
spots.addr: Lianfeng Village (联丰村)

spots.name: Pingshan Terraced Fields Tourism Zone
spots.desc: Probably the most popular scenic area in Dabu County. Colors vary according to season. The best months for visiting are reportedly in March–April when the flowers are blooming and in September–October when the rice crops reach maturity.
spots.addr: Country Highway 150, Pingshan Village, Dadong Town (大东镇坪山村150乡道)

spots.name: Ruishan Ecotourism Resort
spots.local: 广东瑞山生态旅游度假村
spots.desc: An ecotourism resort in a mountainous area of the county. The resort's hotel reportedly does not accept foreign guests, but it should be okay to walk around the park and bathe in the hot springs.
spots.price: ¥50 (entry fee only), ¥75 (entry fee plus fare for sightseeing vehicle)
spots.addr: County Road 951 (951县道)

spots.name: 90 Degree Coffee Shop
spots.desc: One of the very few places in Dabu County where coffee is available.
spots.addr: 32 Fuqian Road, Huliao Town (湖寮镇府前路32号)

spots.name: Duoshi
spots.desc: Another great viewpoint, a decent hike from the cable car station.

spots.name: Guangdong Yao Museum
spots.desc: Home to China's largest and most comprehensive collection of Yao minority artefacts. The museum is also known as the Museum of China's Yao Nationality (中国瑶族博物馆).
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: Bowuguan Road, Sanjiang Town (三江镇博物馆路)

spots.name: Nangang Yao Village
spots.desc: This is the most popular of the Yao minority villages in Liannan County. Often referred to by its marketing name, 'the Millenium-old Yao Village' (千年瑶寨). The village is nestled in the mountains and surrounded by beautiful karst scenery.

spots.name: Sun Yat-Sen University
spots.desc: A university founded by and named after the founding president of the Republic of China. One of the premier universities in China. Is a public research university in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. The university was founded in 1924 by and named after Sun Yat-sen, a revolutionary and the founder of the Republic of China. The university's main campus, commonly referred to as the South Campus, is…

spots.name: Chen Liji Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine
spots.desc: Visitors are required to make a booking before visiting the museum. On most days, the museum only accepts group bookings. Weekends are reserved for visits by groups of 10 or more persons. Individuals may visit the museum on Wednesdays and special open days.
spots.addr: 1688 Guangzhou Avenue South (广州大道南1688号)

spots.name: Canton Fair Complex
spots.desc: Canton Fair, the largest trade fair in China, is held here several times a year. See Guangzhou article for details.
spots.addr: 380 Yuejiang Middle Road (阅江中路380号)

spots.name: Rock Square
spots.local: 凯德乐峰广场 Kǎidé Lèfēng Guǎngchǎng
spots.desc: A shopping mall that has shops, restaurants, a cinema, children's entertainment and other leisure facilities, making it a convenient place for shopping and entertainment.
spots.addr: 106-108 Gongye Avenue North

spots.name: R&F Haizhu Plaza
spots.local: 富力海珠城 Fùlì Hǎizhū Chéng
spots.desc: A shopping mall that has shops, restaurants, entertainment facilities and a cinema, making it a convenient place for shopping and leisure.
spots.addr: 1 Jiangnan West Road

spots.name: Fo World Sushishe
spots.desc: The restaurant is hidden in a small street, this place is especially crowded on the 1st and 15th of each month (lunar calendar). Part of the profits is given to the neighboring temple.
spots.addr: 2-8 Niunaichang St, Tongfu Middle Road (同福中路牛奶厂街二圣宫前2-8号)

spots.name: Oh Marco Wine Cellar
spots.desc: Oh Marco is a retail wine chain shop. There you can drink a glass or buy a bottle of wine. It offers full range of wines, directly imported from France. Perfect for after-work drinks.
spots.addr: 9 Yiyuan Road 4-5

spots.name: Shamian Island
spots.desc: The buildings and streets of the former British and French concession have been beautifully renovated, and vehicles restricted, creating an oasis of tranquility in an otherwise frenetic metropolis. Inevitably it's touristy, but not crowded. One of the colonial structures is the 19th-century Our Lady of Lourdes Chapel at 14 Shamian Street.

spots.name: Temple of 500 Genii
spots.desc: This Is the temple where the Indian monk Bodhidharma, who brought Chan (Zen) Buddhism to China, first settled when he arrived by ship from India.

spots.name: Renwei Taoist Temple
spots.local: 仁威祖庙 Rén wēi zǔ miào
spots.desc: Historic Taoist temple built in the traditional Cantonese architectural style, with many intricate carvings and mosaics on the roof of the temple buildings. Unlike the Chen Clan Academy, this is still an active temple.
spots.addr: Pantang Road (泮塘路)

spots.name: Liwan Museum
spots.desc: Liwan Museum is a local museum documenting the history, culture and traditional lifestyle of Liwan and Xiguan, one of Guangzhou's historic areas. The museum is housed in a traditional Xiguan-style historic building and is a useful stop for learning about Guangzhou's local heritage.
spots.addr: 84 Fengyuan North Street, Longjin West Road

spots.name: Cantonese Opera Art Museum
spots.desc: Cantonese Opera Art Museum is a museum dedicated to Cantonese opera. It features exhibition halls, a theatre and traditional Lingnan-style gardens, showcasing the history, culture and artistic traditions of Cantonese opera. The museum is located beside Lizhiwan Creek in the historic Liwan District.
spots.addr: 127 Enning Road (恩宁路127号)

spots.name: JinLun Guild Hall
spots.desc: A historic guild hall built in 1723 for Guangzhou's silk-weaving industry. It is located near Hualin Temple in Liwan District and preserves traditional Lingnan architecture and historical inscriptions.
spots.addr: 289 Kangwang South Road

spots.name: Liwan Lake Park
spots.desc: Liwan Lake Park is a large urban park in the historic Lizhiwan area of western Guangzhou. The park features several lakes, traditional Lingnan-style gardens, bridges and pavilions, offering a good place to experience the landscape and cultural atmosphere of old Guangzhou.
spots.addr: 155 Longjin West Road

spots.name: Guangzhou Railway Museum
spots.desc: The museum occupies what used to be the Guangzhou South Railway Station, a station on the old Guangdong-Hankou Railway, which used to be known as Huangsha Railway Station. It is the largest railway museum in South China.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:00, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: Zone D, Yujing Road No. 1, 3~5 Yujiang Road (誉江路3~5号御景壹号D区)

spots.name: Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street
spots.local: 上下九商业步行街 Shàng-xià-jiǔ
spots.desc: This shopping area is also a showcase of traditional Cantonese architecture Qilou (骑楼). It is particularly pretty at night when lights are lit up. Prices here are generally lower than Beijing Road's, but prepare to bargain.

spots.name: Qingping Market
spots.desc: It is a great place to go for exotic goods. The modern front of the market has quite a few stalls selling dried herbs used in Chinese Medicine. The real charm here lies just behind the modern exterior. The modern exterior is built onto a series of old historical narrow alleyways with shops selling herbs. You may see exotic animals for sale.
spots.addr: Qingping Road (清平路)

spots.name: Pan Xi Restaurant
spots.desc: Located in the heart of the Old Guangzhou, this Cantonese Restaurant serves dim sum next to trickling streams and stunning architecture. Try one of their famous dumplings shaped like a rabbit's head.
spots.addr: 151 Longjin West Road (龙津西路151号)

spots.name: Guangzhou Restaurant
spots.desc: This Cantonese family restaurant is famous for its signature dishes Wenchang Chicken and special baby pig. It has several branches in the city. Other locations include 20 Binjiang West Road (滨江西路20号) and 112 Tiyu East Road (体育东路112号).
spots.addr: 2 Wenchang South Road (文昌南路2号)

spots.name: Jianji Noodles
spots.desc: Famous traditional noodle place. Famous for fried noodles (炸酱伊面) and wonton noodles (云吞面).
spots.addr: 299 Changshou E Rd, Liwan Qu

spots.name: Taotao Ju Restaurant
spots.desc: This is the oldest traditional dim sum restaurant in the city but nowadays, their food not up to standard as their chef left for high end restaurant in Hong Kong. Dim sum hours are still busy, so reservation is recommended. Specialty includes moon cakes and other traditional Cantonese pastries.
spots.addr: 20 Dishifu Road (第十甫路20号)

spots.name: Wenji Restaurant
spots.desc: As the place was established by the former chefs from Qingping Restaurant, they have the original Qingping Chicken on the menu.
spots.addr: 10 Boahua Road (荔湾区宝华路旋源桥10号)

spots.name: Foo Yau Yuan Vegetarian Restaurant
spots.desc: This place serves creative vegetarian dishes with dim sum served in the morning.
spots.price: Most dishes are between ¥30 and ¥50 each
spots.addr: 荔湾路幸福新村福儿路1号 1 Fu'er Road, Xinfu Xincun, Liwan Road

spots.name: Lan Kwai Fong
spots.desc: This tourist friendly restaurant offers good curries and polite service on the quite Shamian Island.
spots.addr: 5 Shamian South St (沙面南街5号)

spots.name: Lucy's Cafe & Restaurant
spots.desc: Located near the White Swan hotel, Lucy's Cafe & Restaurant is an established American restaurant on Shamian Island. They serve everything from burgers to pasta to Tex-mex, and portions are large. This is a favorite for adoption families who stays on the island.
spots.addr: 3 Shamian South St (沙面南街3号)

spots.name: Memorial Museum of the 1911 Revolution
spots.desc: A museum about the Xinhai Revolution of 1911, which led to the overthrow of the Qing Dynasty and the birth of China's first republic.
spots.hours: 09:00-18:30, no entry after 17:45, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 563 Jinzhou North Road, Changzhou Island, Huangpu District (黄埔区长洲岛金洲北路563号)

spots.name: Memorial to the Sanyuanli People's Struggle Against the British
spots.local: 三元里人民抗英斗争纪念馆
spots.desc: Built in the early Qing Dynasty, this was originally a Taoist temple. Today it is a memorial museum dedicated to the Sanyuanli Incident, a military engagement that took place in 1841 during the First Opium War. Although from the British point of view, this was nothing more than a minor skirmish, the incident is seen in China as deeply significant because rather than being a clash between regular…
spots.addr: 34 Guangyuan Road, Baiyun District (白云区广园中路34号)

spots.name: Ancestral Hall of Dr. Chen Mingxian of the Song Dynasty
spots.desc: It was built during the Ming Jiajing period, rebuilt during the Qingdao Light Year, and rebuilt in 1927. The name of the temple is to commemorate the name of Dr. Chen Ziqiang. The locals call it the Siddhartha Hall. Covering an area of about 795 square meters, sitting north to south, the middle hall hung "Shide Hall" and the Qing court gave Chen Zizhang "loyal Jane" plaque. There is a statue of…
spots.addr: No.38, Zhongyuanli Street, Baiyun District

spots.name: Former Residence of Hong Xiuquan
spots.desc: The former home of the quasi-Christian leader of the Taiping Rebellion that resulted in the death of about 20 million people during the late Qing dynasty. Shortly after failing the imperial examinations on multiple occasions, Hong Xiuquan became delusional and claimed to have received visions in his dreams that he was the younger brother of Jesus Christ destined to overthrow the Qing Dynasty and…
spots.addr: Guanlubu, Dabu Village, Xinhua Subdistrict, Huadu District (花都区新华街道大布村官禄布 Guǎngzhōushì huādūqū xīnhuá jiēdào dàbùcūn guānlùbù)

spots.name: Temple of the Great Fairy of Fortune
spots.desc: Temple of the Great Fairy of Fortune is a city-level cultural relics protection unit, the main temple sits southwest to northeast, built in Qingguangxu 24 years (1898), after five renovations. Originally a temple of wealth, 27 years of Guangxu, the temple began to worship Lu Dongbin, commonly known as Da Xian Temple, the temple is not large, stacked structure, pillars and stairs are stone, a…
spots.addr: Baiyun District, Jinshu Island, Caibin Middle Road

spots.name: South Sea God Temple
spots.desc: Said to be the largest temple in China dedicated to the South Sea God.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 22 Xuri Street, Miaotou Village, Suidong Sub-district, Huangpu District (黄埔区穗东街道庙头村旭日街22号)

spots.name: Yuanxuan Taoist Temple
spots.desc: It includes three Taoist buildings in one complex: Sanqing Hall, Taihe Hall and Yuanchen Hall. Sanqing Hall is the most architecturally important of the three structures, while Yuanxuan Taoist Temple has carvings of divine beings. The central hall is covered by yellow glazed tiles and decorated with the bright images of Yuqing, Shangqing and Taiqing, the three authoritative deities in Taoism.
spots.addr: 38 Yingbin Avenue West, Huadu District (花都区迎宾大道西38号)

spots.name: Baishuizhai
spots.desc: A high waterfall. This is a pleasant spot to visit set in pleasant surroundings not far from the city. The waterfall is no giant but is claimed to be the highest in mainland China: it is best appreciated from a short distance away. If you enter the park, entrance about ¥70, the entire pathway to the mountain summit above the waterfall has been developed. In the lower reaches it is a plankway…

spots.name: Baiyun Children's Park
spots.desc: Large free children's park with a rich variety of rides, a beautiful natural environment and convenient transportation connections.
spots.addr: Baiyun District, Jinshu Island, Ring Road No. 3

spots.name: Gualuyuan Park
spots.desc: Famous for its grand momma of lychee trees, it is also a center for shopping, eating, and recreation.

spots.name: Huadu Square
spots.desc: A park-cum-recreation square located in the north part the city and near the government office buildings of Huadu District (花都区). The square incorporates, among other attractions, an outdoor theater, large fountain, outdoor dance area and statues. There is a large grass area that is similar to a Western style meadow and a subtropical forest and ornamental flower beds.

spots.name: Yuntai Garden
spots.desc: Situated at the foot of Baiyun (White Cloud) Mountain and is famous for its wide variety of rare flowers and trees. There are also seasonal exhibits (additional admission).

spots.name: Best-Way African Restaurant
spots.desc: This Nigerian restaurant serves cuisine cooked Igbo style (try the semo and egusi soup). It is a bit out of the way (down some narrow stairs and under a concrete overpass), but the ambiance is cozy inside with Nigerian music playing.
spots.addr: No. 003 1/F Jindu Bldg, 99 Guangyuan West Rd

spots.name: Lingnan Impression
spots.desc: This is a place to see the city's past before the economic boom. The park is a 15-minute walk from the subway station. Free shuttle is available on the weekend.

spots.name: Lianhua Shan (Lotus Mountain)
spots.desc: Features an impressive quarry from which red sand stones were mined about 2,000 years ago, a pagoda from 1612, and a barrack from 1664. The obligatory statue of Guanyin, the Buddhist Goddess of compassion, at the side of the Buddhist temple is also not to be missed. From Guangzhou, take Metro line 4 and exchange bus at Shiji Station. There are ferry services from Guangzhou at Tianzi Pier (天字码头)…

spots.name: Nansha Tianhou Temple
spots.desc: Dedicated to the sea goddess Mazu, whose formal title is Tianhou, meaning Queen of Heaven. The temple was founded during the Ming Dynasty and destroyed during the Second World War. It was rebuilt in 1995 with funding from a Hong Kong businessman.
spots.addr: 88 Tianhou Road, Nansha District (南沙区天后路88号)

spots.name: Guangzhou Oriental Museum
spots.desc: Visitors are required to make an appointment at least one day before visiting the museum.
spots.addr: Asian Games Culture Village, 118 Fulian Road, Shilou Town (石楼镇浮莲路118号亚运文化村内)

spots.name: Chimelong Water Park
spots.desc: This is a western style water park with great water rides. Warning for people over 190 cm, rides are closed for tall people.

spots.name: Guangzhou CrocoPark
spots.desc: You can see, play, touch, take pictures of crocodiles and even eat and buy stuff made of them!
spots.addr: Metro Line 2, Huijiang Station

spots.name: Chimelong Safari Park
spots.local: 广州香江野生动物世界 Xiāng-jiāng-yě-shēng-dòng-wù-shì-jiè, Xiangjiang Safari Park
spots.desc: Day safaris and night safaris offered, mini jungle train, free ranging animals. From the Metro station there are scheduled free shuttles to all the Chimelong parks.

spots.name: Million Sunflower Garden
spots.desc: Million Sunflower Garden theme park covers an area of 260,000 square meters, planting one million sunflowers, become the first in the country house, all imported seeds (mainly Japan) ornamental sunflower park.
spots.addr: Wanqingsha town

spots.name: Artron (Shenzhen) Art Center
spots.desc: A large-scale multi-function art center. Don't miss the award-winning Artron Wall, a 30-metre tall, 50-metre wide wall of art books, which is said to be the largest book wall in the world and features over 50,000 art books.
spots.addr: 19 Shenyun Road (深云路19号)

spots.name: He Xiangning Art Museum
spots.local: 何香凝美术馆; Hé​ Xiāng​níng​ Měi​shù​guǎn​
spots.desc: China's second national modern art museum, after the National Art Gallery of China. He Xiangning was the widow of Liao Zhongkai, the leader of the pro-Moscow left of the Kuomintang during the 1920s. Liao was expected to become KMT leader after Sun Yat-sen's death but he was assassinated by gangsters probably hired by Chiang Kai-shek. He Xiangning then became an important leader of the leftist…
spots.addr: 9013 Shennan Boulevard (深南大道9013号; Shēn​nán​dà​dào​)

spots.name: OCT Art and Design Gallery
spots.desc: Shenzhen is famous throughout China as a centre of design and the OCT Art and design gallery is where you go to see it exhibited. Set in a restored industrial building, the gallery holds regular exhibitions showcasing Shenzhen and China's industrial, domestic and fashion design.
spots.price: ¥30; free Tuesdays; ¥15 for students and teachers with ID and large groups; free for children under 1.1m and seniors…
spots.addr: Shennan Ave OCT 南山区华侨城深南大道

spots.name: OCT–LOFT Creative Culture Park
spots.desc: All kinds of contemporary art in a repurposed industrial area.
spots.addr: 2 Jinxiu Street North (锦绣北街2号)

spots.name: The Sea World Culture and Arts Center
spots.local: 海上世界文化艺术中心, 设计互联 Design Society
spots.desc: Shenzhen's largest design museum, plus cultural mall. Located close to the shopping/entertainment complex of the same name (below).
spots.addr: 1187 Wanghai Road, Shekou (蛇口望海路1187号)

spots.name: China Merchants History Museum
spots.desc: The official museum of the China Merchants Group (招商局集团), a major state-owned corporation based in Hong Kong.
spots.hours: 09:00-12:00, 13:30-17:30, closed on Sundays and the first three days of Chinese New Year
spots.addr: 21 Yanshan Road, Shekou (蛇口沿山路21号)

spots.name: Nanshan Museum
spots.desc: This museum covers the history of Nanshan and exhibits archaeological relics excavated in Nanshan.
spots.hours: 10ː00-18ː00, no entry after 17ː30, closed on Mondays (major public holidays excepted)
spots.addr: 2093 Nanshan Ave (南山大道2093号)

spots.name: Portofino
spots.desc: Shenzhen housing developments are often built around beautiful tropical gardens with luxurious club house amenities and one of the most famous of these is Portofino. It is built around a surprisingly attractive imitation of an Italian Piazzetta along a lake which has cafes, bars and restaurants without outdoor seating. Shenzhen's best Cantonese restaurant chain, Laurel, justly famed for the…

spots.name: Bora Cay Bay / 南洋长滩
spots.desc: Restaurant on Minghua. The restaurant's theme is Southeast Asia.

spots.name: Window of The World
spots.desc: Travel around the world in one day. This 480,000-m² park has a beautiful natural landscapes and wonderful lighting at night. Inside, you can climb the 1:3 scale Eiffel Tower, go inside the Egyptian Pyramids, see the Leaning Tower of Pisa, Taj Mahal, Grand Canyon, Niagara Falls, Mount Fuji, the Buckingham Palace and other famous landmarks. Inside Mount Fuji there's an amusement ride called Fast…
spots.price: ¥220 for adults over 1.5m, half price for children between 1.2m and 1.5m and seniors between 65 and 70 years of age…
spots.addr: 南山区华侨城深南大道

spots.name: Happy Valley Theme Park
spots.desc: A classic fun park. It is a lot bigger than Hong Kong Disneyland and many would say a lot better. Divided into theme areas it has the usual fun rides. Try the flume ride but be prepared to get wet. The Playa Maya is an excellent water park built around a Maya architectural theme. There are shows all day and well into the night.
spots.addr: Huaqiaocheng W Rd OCT 华乔城乔城西路

spots.name: Poly Theatre
spots.desc: This is a more or less middle-brow theatre specialising in musical theatre and often hosting Russian Army theatre troupes. The futuristic silver egg-shaped building alone makes it worth a visit.
spots.addr: Baoli Wenhua Square, Houhaibin Road (后海滨路保利文化广场; Hòu​hǎi​bīn​ Lù Bǎo​lì​ Wén​huà​Guǎng​chǎng​​)

spots.name: Nanshan Library
spots.desc: The library's main branch is on Changxing Road. There are also seven smaller branches.
spots.hours: There are different opening hours for different sections of the library. The adult reading rooms at the library's main…

spots.name: Nanshan Park
spots.desc: A forested hill with hiking trails. The peak (大南山 Dà Nánshān) is 336 meters high and the trails are mostly stairs, so this is a reasonably challenging hike. Plan about 2–3 hours round trip if you're a strong hiker, or longer if you want to explore more of the trails. The park is quiet, without many hikers, and on a clear day the peak has lovely views of the city, the water, and Hong Kong's New…
spots.addr: 51 Yanshan Road 沿山路51号

spots.name: Zhongshan Park
spots.desc: Shenzhen's oldest park. It was established in 1925 to honour the memory of Sun Yat-sen (Sun Zhongshan).
spots.addr: 3190 Nanshan Avenue (南山大道3109号)

spots.name: Xiao Nanshan
spots.desc: A smaller hill for hiking. The trailheads are not easy to find—there are several roads around the hill that look like they might go to a trailhead but actually don't.

spots.name: Shahe (Sand River) Golf Club
spots.desc: Another favorite with the locals. It has 27 holes plus a nine hole night course under lights. Gary Player designed the course.
spots.addr: Shahe East Rd (沙河东路)

spots.name: Xili Golf Club
spots.desc: This is a private club owned and managed by the Kuok family of Shangri-La fame. You will need an invitation to play here. It is worth getting it.
spots.addr: Tanglang Village Xili (西丽针塘郎村)

spots.name: Alps Ice and Snow World
spots.desc: Skating, skiing, and snow tubing. The skating rink has irregular shape. The ski slope is quite short and not very steep, but there is a lift to take you up. Snowboarding/skiing equipment and clothing can be rented (expect to leave a deposit). The sledding slope is great for children. It is quite cold inside even in hot weather.
spots.addr: 9037 Shennan Ave, HuaQiaoCheng

spots.name: La Roja Travel — Shenzhen Tech Tours
spots.desc: English-speaking technology tours in Nanshan. The 2.5-hour "Inside Shenzhen Technology" route covers robotaxi, drone delivery, Chinese EV displays, Huawei technology and robotics at Inno100. Private and shared Small Group formats meet in Shenzhen. Small Group uses up to five guests per guide, with additional guides for larger departures. DJI visits are not included.
spots.price: Small Group: ¥375 per participant for all ages; Private: live party-size pricing on the booking page
spots.addr: 3019 Houhaibin Road, Nanshan District (look for guide with red La Roja sign)

spots.name: Nanshan Book City
spots.desc: The Nanshan branch of Book City, Shenzhen's local chain of large bookstores.
spots.addr: 2748 Nanhai Boulevard 南海大道2748号

spots.name: OCT Harbour
spots.desc: Somewhat more famous than it deserves to be, because it's run by Overseas Chinese Town, which operates many of the big-name attractions in this district. OCT Harbour is sort of like a mall and an amusement park had a baby, and though it's mildly interesting to walk around, it's neither the best mall nor the best amusement park in Shenzhen (not even close).

spots.name: Garden City
spots.desc: Shopping centre which has a Decathlon store and a Walmart supermarket.
spots.addr: 1086 Nanhai Blvd

spots.name: C:UNION
spots.desc: A great place to discover Shenzhen's surprisingly vibrant alternative community. A variety of live bands from around China and sometimes abroad perform here every Saturday night, followed by a DJ playing electronic music. Shows start around 20:00. You can also check out the surrounding neighborhood whose restaurants and small art outlets create a hip vibe along the brick pedestrian roads.

spots.name: McCawley's Irish Bar & Restaurant
spots.desc: Irish decor bar with rock cover band. Serves a variety of Western dishes at prices around ¥80-100 per main course. Beer from ¥35 per pint and up.

spots.name: X-Ta-Sea Sports Bar & Restaurant
spots.desc: Features live rock music Tuesday to Saturdays by house band Kaktooz. Amenities include multiple TV screens, table football, darts, pool tables a menu of mostly Western-style food and free Wi-Fi.
spots.addr: Shekou, Sea World

spots.name: Baolin Temple
spots.desc: The main Buddhist temple in Shunde. It was founded in the 10th century but was largely destroyed in the 1950s. The temple was rebuilt at this location in 1996.
spots.addr: Baolin Road (宝林路)

spots.name: Yonggui Fisherman's Wharf
spots.desc: This wharf, on the south bank of Ronggui Desheng in central Shunde City, is a pilot demonstration area of the Ronggui Street "three old" renovation and revitalization project. Ronggui Fisherman's Wharf was rated as a national AAA tourist attraction in 2019.
spots.addr: Central City Rongguide Shenghe South Bank(中心城区容桂德胜河南岸)

spots.name: Foshan Shunde Chen Village Flower World Scenic Area
spots.local: 佛山市顺德区陈村花卉世界景区
spots.desc: Chencun Flower World is located in Chencun Town, Shunde District, known as the "thousand-year flower township", convenient transportation, 20 minutes from Guangzhou by car, 25 minutes from Shunde city and just a few minutes from Foshan. A total area of 10,000 acres, bringing together more than 300 flower enterprises from all over the world, here all kinds of flowers compete for beauty, each show…
spots.addr: No. 28, Peony Road, Flower World, Chencun(陈村花卉世界牡丹路28号)

spots.name: Long Deer Tourist Park
spots.desc: It is a comprehensive scenic spot, which combines eating, living, playing, appreciating, entertaining and buying in one, featuring Lingnan history and culture, Shunde water village style and peasant life. The park consists of several theme parks, including the park, the theme park, water world theme park, farm music theme park and animal theme park. Each park has its own characteristics…
spots.addr: Changlu Tourist Park, No. 8 Jiandong Road (southwest corner)

spots.name: Shunde Renjia
spots.desc: A well-known local restaurant specializing in classic Shunde cuisine, famous for its fresh ingredients.
spots.addr: Shunde District

spots.name: Friends Club
spots.desc: A fabulous place to watch the stage show, dance, and play dice, the most popular drinking game in Shunde. A hint: buy beer by the dozen, it is much cheaper!

spots.name: A lane with many pubs/ KTVs
spots.desc: A road with lined up with KTVs and clubs, alongside a canal. Be it wine, cocktails or beer, they have all to offer.

spots.name: Binyang Phoenix Lake Park
spots.desc: There are lots of plants and it's beautiful in the spring, and there's a lot of food around the park at night.

spots.name: Binyang South Street
spots.desc: A narrow old street, the famous national Cannon Dragon Festival originated here.

spots.name: Kunlun Pass
spots.desc: It is located at the junction of Binyang County and Kunlun Town, Nanning, Guangxi, 50 km away from Nanning. According to legend, Binyang Kunlun Pass was built by Fubo General Ma Yuan in the Han Dynasty, which has a history of more than 1,000 years.Kunlun Pass is the gateway and barrier of Nanning City, the terrain is dangerous, easy to defend and difficult to attack, it can be said that "one…

spots.name: Xie Ba herbal tea
spots.desc: There are many different flavors of herbal tea, and if you're drinking it for the first time, the taste of the shop may be relatively friendly.

spots.name: Old Wuzhou tea shop
spots.desc: The local people like the cold tea shop very much, regardless of spring, summer, autumn and winter there are many people to drink, you can also taste the special dessert.

spots.name: East Pagoda
spots.desc: Built in 1573 and expanded in the 17th century, the 50-metre-high East Pagoda is the tallest pagoda in Guangxi.

spots.name: Xiaoliancheng Fort
spots.desc: Excellent views of the town and surrounding countryside from this 'Little Great Wall' fort. On your way up the steep hill, you will also see a large, but very badly vandalised, temple in a cave.

spots.name: Longzhou Museum
spots.desc: While Longzhou is now a sleepy town it has had quite a history. The Longzhou museum has many artifacts and paintings from the Longzhou Rebellion, which was led by Deng Xiaoping. Some of the staff speak English and may be your best bet for tourist information. A Chinese language leaflet available here includes a tiny map - infuriatingly difficult to use but there does not appear to be any other…

spots.name: Ho Chi Minh's house
spots.desc: A museum focused on Ho Chi Minh's time in Longzhou. Includes some interesting photographs but, if you do not read Chinese or Vietnamese, there is little to learn here.

spots.name: Zhongshan Park
spots.desc: Worth seeing only if you have an interest in decay, litter and stagnant water.

spots.name: Former French Consulate
spots.desc: One of the few remaining remnants of Longzhou's colonial architecture.

spots.name: Huashan Happy World
spots.desc: A children’s amusement park near the Huashan Rock Art Scenic Area.
spots.addr: X557与X570交叉路口

spots.name: Liancheng Fortress Site
spots.desc: A historical military site dating back to the Ming Dynasty (14th to 17th centuries) now partially in ruins.

spots.name: Dance at the old market area
spots.desc: At night, you can visit the old market area where it got converted into the dancing square and dance with the locals. Light and music are provided along with several stages for different levels of dancers. The elders locals generally come out at night to dance as a form of daily exercise. A few blocks from the dancing square, there is the night market where you can pick up some food along the…

spots.name: Juanjuan Restaurant
spots.desc: Chinese restaurant commonly visited by Vietnamese tour groups crossing the border. Noted for its duck dishes.
spots.addr: Beida Rd

spots.name: Peninsula Park
spots.desc: At the confluence of the Chengbi River and the Youjiang River, it is surrounded by the Youjiang River at a 270-degree angle.
spots.addr: Huandao 2nd Road, Youjiang District (右江区环岛二路)

spots.name: People's Park
spots.local: 人民公园, 森林广场
spots.desc: The oldest park in Baise, it has children's playground and a small zoo.
spots.addr: 22 Xinxing Road, Youjiang District (新兴路22号)

spots.name: Baise Uprising Memorial Hall
spots.desc: Baise Uprising Memorial Park is one of China’s most important Red Tourism sites. It commemorates the Baise Uprising of 1929 led by Deng Xiaoping. The park includes the Memorial Hall, monuments, former revolutionary sites, and exhibition areas. It serves both as a historical education base and a large public park with panoramic city views.

spots.name: March 3rd Ethnic Song Festival
spots.desc: It is mainly celebrated by the Zhuang people, and usually held on the third day of the third lunar month. During the festival, there are activities such as antiphonal singing, folk song competitions, throwing embroidered balls, ethnic dances, traditional costume displays, and folk markets.

spots.name: Baise Uprising Commemoration Activities
spots.desc: To commemorate the 1929 Baise Uprising, Baise holds a commemorative ceremony and a series of red culture activities every December. These include a commemorative meeting, themed exhibitions, red-themed cultural performances, and patriotic education activities. This event has distinct local historical characteristics and is an important manifestation of Baise's "red culture."

spots.name: Baise Gymnasium
spots.desc: Baise Gymnasium is a major indoor sports facility located in the old city of Baise. It serves as a key venue for indoor sports training, local competitions, and public fitness activities, supporting community-level sports development in the city.
spots.addr: Wenti Lane 10, Youjiang District

spots.name: Baise Sports Center
spots.desc: It is designed to host large-scale sporting events, professional training, and public fitness programs, playing a central role in Baise's sports infrastructure.
spots.addr: Youjiang District

spots.name: Stars International Cinema
spots.desc: The cinema is located in the bustling Forest Center City, is a very popular cinema in the old town.
spots.addr: Forest Center City, 117 Zhongshan 2nd Road (右江区中山二路117号森林中心城1层)

spots.name: Guangying International Cinema
spots.desc: The cinema is in the Longjing area. It is relatively new and large, with good screening rooms.
spots.addr: 16 Longjing West Road (龙景西路16号)

spots.name: Gui Xiao Chu Guangxi Cuisine
spots.desc: Gui Xiao Chu Guangxi Cuisine (Baise Dream-Island Branch) is a well-liked local restaurant known for serving authentic Guangxi cuisine with a variety of regional specialty dishes. The restaurant features refined décor and diverse menu options highlighting the flavors of Guangxi and Zhuang ethnic food culture. It is popular among both residents and visitors as a representative dining spot for local…
spots.addr: Shop D-11, 4th Floor, Dingsheng Central City Dream Island Shopping Plaza, No. 16 Longjing West Road, Youjiang District

spots.name: Golden Triangle Food Street
spots.desc: Golden Triangle Food Street is a well-known dining area in central Baise that hosts a variety of local food stalls and restaurants. Rather than a single restaurant, it offers a concentrated street-food experience where visitors can sample regional specialties and Zhuang ethnic cuisine. It is a popular destination for both locals and tourists to explore Baise’s diverse culinary culture.
spots.addr: Golden Triangle Food Street, Youjiang District

spots.name: Forest Centre Center
spots.desc: The main shopping centers in the old city, it boasts a wide variety of shops, restaurants, and entertainment facilities such as cinemas.
spots.addr: 117 Zhongshan 2nd Road (右江区中山二路117号)

spots.name: Dream Island Shopping Center
spots.desc: One of the main shopping centers in the Longjing area, it boasts a wide variety of shops, restaurants, and entertainment facilities such as cinemas.
spots.addr: 16 Longjing West Road (龙景西路16号)

spots.name: Zhuang Embroidery Ball
spots.desc: The Zhuang embroidery ball is a traditional handicraft from the Baise region. Made with colorful Zhuang ethnic embroidery techniques, these decorative balls feature intricate patterns and vibrant designs. They symbolize friendship and good wishes in local customs and serve as a cultural souvenir reflecting the artistic heritage of the Zhuang people.

spots.name: Mango Dried Fruit
spots.desc: Baise dried mango is made from high-quality locally grown mangoes, processed using traditional and modern methods. With its sweet aroma and unique texture, it is one of Baise's signature agricultural souvenir foods. It is commonly purchased by visitors to share local flavors with friends and family.

spots.name: Oil Tea
spots.desc: Similar to Gongcheng oil tea in Guilin, it uses fried rice puff balls as the main ingredient, which are then steeped in boiling water to create a bowl of oil tea with a rich aroma of oil and rice.

spots.name: Lingyun Baihao Tea
spots.desc: Lingyun Baihao Tea is a famous Chinese tea from Lingyun County, named for the abundant white hairs on its leaves. It brews a light green, aromatic, mellow tea with a fresh, rich flavor and long finish.

spots.name: Tongling Grand Canyon
spots.desc: It is a dramatic karst canyon of over 10 km, with towering waterfalls, caves, underground rivers, and lush forest.
spots.price: Tickets purchased on the day are priced at ¥115, and ¥99 a day in advance
spots.addr: Xinling, Hurun Town, Jingxi (靖西市湖润镇新灵村)

spots.name: Sandieling (triple-layer hill) Waterfall
spots.desc: The waterfall is formed by the sudden drop of water from the Liuzhu River from the cliff. The cliff there is triple-layered, hence the name. The waterfall is about 40 meters high and 20 meters wide.
spots.addr: Xinqiao, Hurun Town, Jingxi (靖西市湖润镇新桥)

spots.name: Goose Spring
spots.desc: It is a crystal-clear karst spring surrounded by green hills and ancient bridges, known as one of China's tranquil natural springs.
spots.price: ¥45 for adults, ¥30 for elder, students and teachers. combined ticket for Goose Spring and Jiuzhou Ancient Town is ¥45
spots.addr: Nian'an, Xinjing Town, Jingxi (靖西市新靖镇念安屯)

spots.name: Quyang Lake
spots.local: Bameng Reservoir, 渠洋湖, 岜蒙水库
spots.desc: It is a scenic karst reservoir, dotted with islands and framed by green mountains, offering tranquil boat rides and mirror-like water surfaces.
spots.addr: Huiju, Quyang Town, Jingxi (靖西市渠洋镇会聚屯)

spots.name: Jiuzhou Ancient Town
spots.desc: It is a well-preserved historic town famed for its traditional Zhuang architecture, stone-paved streets, and centuries-old cultural heritage.
spots.price: ¥45 for adults, ¥30 for elder, students and teachers. combined ticket for Goose Spring and Jiuzhou Ancient Town is ¥45
spots.addr: Jiuzhou, Xinjing Town, Jingxi (靖西市新靖镇旧州村)

spots.name: Debao Red Leaf Forest Park
spots.desc: It is famous for its large-scale red maple forest and is a rare autumn viewing spot in the southern China. There is a reservoir and other places suitable for camping in the scenic area. There are buses that run during autumn, but you need to drive there at other times.
spots.addr: Bailong, Chengguan Town, Debao County (德保县城关镇云梯村百陇屯)

spots.name: Kingdom of Debao Pony
spots.local: Debao Short Horse Paradise, 德保矮马王国
spots.desc: It is a themed rural park celebrating the local miniature Debao ponies, where visitors can interact with, pet, and ride these rare small horses amid picturesque landscapes and family-friendly attractions. The park is located at the exit of Jixingyan (Jixing Rock), it is a spectacular karst cave system that tunnels through five mountains, featuring underground rivers, theatrical limestone…
spots.addr: Poning, Yandong Township, Debao County (德保县燕峒乡坡宁屯)

spots.name: Nidiya Farmland
spots.desc: It offers visitors a captivating blend of karst landscapes, minority-ethnic cultural heritage, and tranquil rural beauty. Famous for its Black Zhuang residents.
spots.addr: Zhongshan Village, Pohe Township, Napo (那坡县坡荷乡中山村)

spots.name: Gulong Mountain Grand Canyon Rafting
spots.desc: The Gulong Mountain Grand Canyon Scenic Area consists of three canyons: Gulao Gorge, Xinling Gorge, and Xinqiao Gorge. Rivers and two underground caves connect the gorges, forming a grand canyon complex comprised of three gorges and two caves. The entire canyon stretches 6.8 km. Canyon rafting tour offers a close encounter with the 118 m Gulong Waterfall.
spots.addr: Xinling, Hurun Town, Jingxi (靖西市湖润镇新灵村)

spots.name: Double Third Festival
spots.desc: Jingxi hosts its annual Double Third Festival celebrations each year, featuring performances of Zhuang ethnic songs and dances for audiences to enjoy. Local residents and visitors alike can participate in folk activities such as bonfire dancing and traditional Zhuang games. The opening ceremony will be held in Jinxiu Ancient Town (锦绣古镇), and other scenic spots such as Goose Spring will also hold…
spots.addr: South Section of Xiuqiu Avenue (绣球大道南段)

spots.name: South Zhuang Opera
spots.desc: South Zhuang Opera is a Zhuang Opera unique to Jingxi and its surrounding areas. The People's Stage in Jingxi Zhongshan Park arranges troupes to perform on market days.
spots.addr: People's Stage in Zhongshan Park, 445 Chengxi Road (城西路445号中山公园百姓舞台)

spots.name: North Farmers Market
spots.desc: The largest farmers' market in Jingxi, where you can buy a lot of fresh ingredients and various daily necessities, as well as many local specialty restaurants
spots.addr: 192 Chengxi Road (城西路192号)

spots.name: Global General Market
spots.desc: Jingxi's most central and classic market is also surrounded by a shopping area. You can buy all the items you need in your daily life here.
spots.addr: 371 Lingquan Street (灵泉街371号)

spots.name: Global Business Center
spots.desc: The largest commercial plaza in Jingxi, with a variety of chain brands and entertainment venues
spots.addr: The intersection of Zhuangjin Avenue and Xiuqiu Avenue (壮锦大道与绣球大道路口)

spots.name: Some very long hair
spots.desc: Longsheng is home to four minority nationalities: Miao, Yao, Dong and Zhuang. The Yao and Zhuang nationalities live in Longji. The Yao have distinctive clothing and hair styles which set them apart from other ethnic groups. Yao women are famous for having the longest hair in the world. They never cut their hair. Instead they wrap the hair in a bun on top of their head in a style resembling an…
spots.price: Free to look, ¥10 for a photo

spots.name: Unique traditional style of houses
spots.desc: built largely from timber, the houses are typically rectangular and three stories high, though in Ping'An many are four stories and relatively large. Each ascending floor is a little larger than the lower. The shingles, windows and beams are typical of other Chinese building styles. In DaZhai, there are small dwellings that use the thick bark of trees as roof shingles.

spots.name: Longsheng Hot Spring
spots.desc: A naturally hot spring and spa. It is recommended that you visit in winter or spring.

spots.name: Hiking
spots.desc: There is some fabulous hiking to be done around the rice terraces, though finding your way when outside the signposted areas can be tricky at times; a local guide can lead the way for a small fee.

spots.name: Around Ping'An
spots.desc: There is a well sign-posted walk around Ping'An that takes you through Ping'An town, and up to both viewpoints - Viewpoint 1 (called Nine Dragons and Five Tigers) and Viewpoint 2 (Seven Stars with Moon), both of which have spectacular views of the town and surrounding terraces. The route is well sign-posted (look for the stone-engraved maps about the place) with good paths; completing the full…

spots.name: Around Dazhai
spots.desc: It's a quieter and more rural village then Ping'An. No cars in the village. There are 3 peaks to hike and also some small villages around. In the village is also a library building where they sometimes dancing and music events and also a school building where you can watch the pupils through the windows. No ATM in Dazhai - but you can change in Wisdom Inn money, also with credit card.

spots.name: Ping'An to Zhongliu and Dazhai
spots.desc: The walk from Ping'An to Zhongliu takes approx 2 hours, from where it is another 2 hours to Dazhai. To Zhongliu Start by heading out from Ping'An up the hill to Viewpoint 1, then continue over the back and along a dirt road. This will take you past a lake and through a lovely valley. (more instructions needed!)

spots.name: Border stones
spots.desc: Border stones were set up after French - China skirmishes were ended with a peace treaty to mark the Southern border of China. On the stone #1 there are a few plates in English as well with more details about it. Minor curiosity point is that China claims there to have over 18,000 km seashore which would be halfway around the world. This statement is identical in Chinese as well. Bluish statue…

spots.name: Gold Beach (also Wanwei Beach and Jing Island)
spots.desc: This is a beach well worth visiting, but do not expect clear blue water, as the quartz sand makes the water appear quite murky, even though it is considered to be safe for swimming. Waves are often nice sized, but shells are quite abundant, so you may need footgear to protect your feet if you try to stand on waves for a longer period. Beach is also popular after sun has set, but you should stay…

spots.name: Nature park
spots.desc: Highlight of this AAAA class nature park is white water rafting with plastic boats. Opinions on it have been divided to those that have enjoyed it and to those who thought it had been too dangerous, so definitely not suitable for smaller children.

spots.name: Golf courses
spots.desc: There are two golf courses in Dongxing area: one in Mong Cai and another one in Fangchenggangbei.

spots.name: Cinema
spots.desc: There are about nine movies rolling out in cinemas, but none of them are spoken or subtitled in English (2016/05).

spots.name: Baisha Natural Tea Garden Town
spots.desc: Baisha's main tourist attraction. Best known for its scenic tea plantation. Wooden walkways have been built to enable visitors to get around the plantation. Visitors are urged not to pick or tread on the tea leaves. Outside the plantation, you can find numerous tea shops and tea houses.
spots.addr: Chacheng Road (茶城路)

spots.name: Baisha Meteor Crater
spots.desc: The Baisha Meteor was discovered in 1992 and is the first meteor crater to be discovered in China. The crater is covered in thick vegetation, so it can be very difficult for casual visitors to see the contours of the crater.
spots.addr: Baisha Farm, Yacha (牙叉镇白沙农场境内)

spots.name: Baisha Ethnological Museum
spots.desc: A small museum about the history and culture of the various ethnic groups that inhabit Baisha, including the Li, the Miao and the Han.
spots.addr: 3rd floor, Baisha Young Students' Extracurricular Activities Center, Binhe North Road, Yacha (牙叉镇滨河北路白沙青少年学生校外活动中心3楼)

spots.name: Baisha Cultural Park
spots.desc: The main venue in Baisha for festivals and public celebrations.
spots.addr: Cuiyuan Road, Yacha (牙叉镇翠园路)

spots.name: Baisha Sports and Culture Center
spots.desc: This is a major sports facility and is much larger than what one would normally expect for a place like Baisha. Some of China's national sports associations have training bases here, including the China Modern Pentathlon Association, the Chinese Mountainerring Association and the Chinese Boxing Federation.
spots.addr: Jinsha East Road, Yacha (牙叉镇金沙东路)

spots.name: Baisha Green Tea Product Sales and Exhibition Center
spots.local: 白沙绿茶产品展销中心
spots.desc: One of the largest tea shops in Baisha. The shop is run by the same company that owns the tea plantation at the Baisha Natural Tea Garden Town.
spots.addr: Yacha Middle Road, Yacha (牙叉镇牙叉中路)

spots.name: Betel Nut Valley Li & Miao Cultural Heritage Park
spots.local: 槟榔谷黎苗文化旅游区, 槟榔谷 Binglanggu
spots.desc: Hainan is home to a large population of ethnic minorities, predominantly the Li and Miao Ethnic Groups, and you can find out more about them at this park, about 30km outside of Sanya. The park is very commercial with a large number of shops, snacks for sale and (paid) opportunities for photographs with locals in traditional costumes or with indigenous animals. Despite this, it appears that there…
spots.addr: Ganza Ridge Nature Reserve, Baoting County (保亭黎苗族自治县甘什岭自然保护区)

spots.name: Meilang Twin Pagodas
spots.local: 美榔双塔, 美榔姐妹塔 Meilang Sister Pagodas
spots.desc: One of the oldest historical sites in Hainan, the pagodas date back to Yuan Dynasty and were originally part of the Jirui Nunnery, a nunnery that no longer exists. They were built by a Buddhist man named Chen Daoxu in honour of his two daughters. There is a small museum at the site.
spots.addr: Meilang Village, Meiting Township (美亭乡美榔村)

spots.name: R&F Mangrove Bay Wetland Preservation Park
spots.local: 富力红树湾红树林湿地保护公园
spots.desc: A wetland park established by a private real estate developer.
spots.addr: Hainan Western Expressway, Fushan Town (福山镇海南西线高速)

spots.name: Jinshan Temple
spots.desc: The second largest Buddhist temple in northern Hainan. It was founded during the Ming Dynasty but destroyed in the 1940s and rebuilt in 1992. A notable structure at the temple is an 88-meter high pagoda, which is said to be the tallest pagoda in the world dedicated to Bhaisajyaguru, the Buddha of medicine and healing.
spots.price: General entry to the temple is free; ¥50 is charged to visit the pagoda
spots.addr: Gongyuan Road, Jinjiang Town (金江镇公园路)

spots.name: Yongqing Temple
spots.desc: The largest Buddhist temple in the northern part of Hainan Island. It was established in the Song Dynasty, though the current structures date only from the 21st century.
spots.addr: 10 Yongqing Avenue, Laocheng Town (老城镇永庆大道10号)

spots.name: Luoyi Village
spots.desc: An old village dating from the Song Dynasty. Buildings are constructed with volcanic rock. The most notable building is the Li Family Ancestral Hall, which was built in the 18th century.

spots.name: Shique Village
spots.local: 石矍村, formerly known as Shishique Village 石石矍村
spots.desc: Another old village with buildings built with volcanic rock. The village is famous due to its close association with Madam Xian, a female general from Gaozhou (near Maoming) who is credited with bringing peace and stability to Hainan during the Sui Dynasty. Madam Xian and her family and entourage settled here in the early 7th century and even today the village is still largely populated by her…
spots.addr: Renmin Road, Macun Town (马村镇人民路)

spots.name: Fushan Coffee
spots.desc: This is the central branch of the Fushan Coffee coffee shop chain. Another branch can be found near the Fushan Coffee Cultural Center. There is also a branch about 2 km east of the Yongqing Temple. More branches can be found in Haikou and other places in Hainan.
spots.addr: National Highway 225, Fushan (福山镇225国道)

spots.name: Hainan Liberation Park
spots.local: 海南解放公园, formerly known as the Cape Lingao Tourism Area 临高角旅游区
spots.desc: Lingao's main tourist attraction. It commemorates the landing of PLA troops during the Hainan Campaign of the Chinese Civil War. Notable sights within the park include a giant statue representing the PLA soldiers; a museum about the Hainan Campaign, the remains of a trench used during the war, and a historic lighthouse built by the French in the 1890s.
spots.addr: County Highway 311, Lincheng (临城镇311县道)

spots.name: Lingao Confucius Temple
spots.desc: Founded during the Song Dynasty, the temple was destroyed during the Yuan Dynasty and rebuilt at its present location during the Ming Dynasty.
spots.addr: Jiangbei Road, Lincheng (临城镇江北路)

spots.name: Wenlan Cultural Park
spots.local: 文澜文化公园, Lanjiang Cultural Park 澜江文化公园
spots.desc: One of Lingao’s newest attractions. The park was established in the 2010s. It features a long line of memorial arches. Each set of arches has a unique style, representing different periods in Chinese history. A night market is held here every night from about 19:00.
spots.addr: Shizheng Avenue, Lincheng (临城镇市政大道)

spots.name: Lingao County Cultural Park
spots.desc: A park with indoor and outdoor sporting facilities, as well as a stage for traditional opera and puppet shows.
spots.addr: 30 Wenming Road, Lincheng (临城镇文明路30号)

spots.name: Lingao County Art and Culture Center
spots.desc: The main art center in Lingao County. It hosts both visual art exhibitions and performing arts shows.
spots.addr: Intersection of Shizheng Avenue and Jinlan Avenue, Lincheng (临城镇政大道与金澜大道交叉口)

spots.name: Yetian Ancient Village
spots.desc: Yetian Ancient Village is a cultural experience centre in Lingshui County which allows visitors to experience the cultures of the Li and Miao ethnic minorities who are indigenous to the area. As well as being built in the traditional style, the workers are all members of the ethnic minorities and are on hand to guide visitors through the centre. Visitors can see how traditional arts and crafts…
spots.addr: Yingzhou Village, Yingzhou Town

spots.name: Diao Luo Mountain National Forest Park
spots.desc: Diao Luo Mountain National Forest Park was created in 1994 by the Chinese Government to protect the tropical forest in the area. It is popular with hikers and travellers who want to escape the heat and sun of the beaches. There are walkways around scenic spots such as Little Sister Lake and Fengguo Waterfall, but asides from that the area is not very commercialised. A hotel can be found in Du Jia…

spots.name: Perfume Bay
spots.desc: This stretch of beach is rather undeveloped and thus delightfully peaceful (it will probably be only you for a good kilometer on either side). Visiting here is a delightful and mind-cleaning day trip, especially if joined with some hiking around the surrounding farms. Watch out for strong rip tides and pack snacks.

spots.name: Clearwater Bay
spots.desc: A 12-km coastal strip stretching from Yingzhou Town to Xincun Town. Clearwater Bay is more popular and more developed than Perfume Bay but the area remains rather quiet compared with Sanya. Unfortunately, swimming is prohibited due to dangerous waves.

spots.name: Mytikas Water Park
spots.desc: Lingshui's only water park. The park was opened in 2018 and parts of it are still under construction.
spots.hours: 11:00-19:00, no entry after 18:00. Some attractions close at 15:00. The park is closed from January 1st to June 25th.…
spots.addr: Li'an Town (黎安镇)

spots.name: Clearwater Bay Golf Club
spots.desc: Designed by Schmidt-Curley Design, a US golf course design company.
spots.price: Visitors should pay a minimum of ¥800 to play 9 holes or ¥1645 to play 18 holes. Additional fees apply for the hiring…
spots.addr: Clearwater Bay Avenue, Yingzhou Town (英州镇清水湾大道)

spots.name: Tiffany's Western Restaurant
spots.desc: Excellent choice of western classics with creative use of local ingredient. Also serving first class hamburgers.
spots.addr: Narada Resort Perfume Bay in Xiangshui (海南香水湾君澜度假酒店)

spots.name: Alexander Nevsky Russian Orthodox Church
spots.local: 汉口东正教堂 Hankou Orthodox Church
spots.desc: Founded in 1876 to serve the local Russian community. In 1891, Russian prince Nicholas II (who would later become the last tsar of Russia) visited Wuhan and provided funding for the rebuilding of the church, which was completed in 1893. It is the oldest surviving Russian Orthodox church in China. As of late 2024, it hosts a photo exhibition summing up the history of Chinese–Russian tea trade…
spots.addr: 48 Poyang Road, Jiang'an District (江岸区鄱阳街48号)

spots.name: August 7th Meeting Site
spots.local: 八七会议会址, 八七会议会址纪念馆 August 7th Meeting Site Memorial Museum
spots.desc: The August 7th Meeting was an emergency meeting of the CCP Central Committee, which was secretly convened at this site in 1927, just a few days after the Communist uprising in Nanchang sparked the beginning of the Chinese Civil War. The meeting was a major turning point in the history of the Party. At this meeting, the Party decided to abandon the conservative urban-based approach to revolution…
spots.hours: Tue-Sun 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 139 Poyang Street, Jiang'an District (江岸区鄱阳街139号)

spots.name: Chenshia Museum
spots.local: 钻石艺术博物馆, Diamond Art Museum
spots.desc: A private art museum established by Mr. Chen Dabing. The museum displays artworks from both Chinese and overseas artists.
spots.hours: Tue-Sun 09:00-12:00, 14:00-17:00, no entry after 16:00, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 1 Lugou Bridge Road, Jiang'an District (江岸区芦沟桥路1号)

spots.name: February 7th Memorial Museum
spots.desc: Dedicated to the strike by workers on the Beijing-Hankou Railway between February 4th and February 7th, 1923, one of the biggest strikes in China during the early 20th century. The strike broke out in response to the warlord Wu Peifu's ban on the workers' trade union federation, which had held its inaugral meeting in Zhengzhou on February 1st. Wu Peifu responded to the strike on February 7th by…
spots.addr: 2499 Jiefang Avenue, Jiang'an District (江岸区解放大道2499号)

spots.name: Former Residence of Song Qingling in Hankou
spots.local: 宋庆龄汉口旧居纪念馆
spots.desc: A classic 19th-century Russian style residence dating from 1896. Song Qingling, the wife of Sun Yat-Sen, lived here from 1926 to 1927 while working for the Kuomintang government. The residence has been restored to appear as it was when Song Qingling was here, and there are some old photographs on display.
spots.addr: 162 Yanjiang Avenue, Jiang'an District (江岸区沿江大道162号)

spots.name: Former Residence of Zhang Tianyou
spots.desc: Zhang Tianyou (Jeme Tien-Yow) (1861-1919) was an outstanding engineer from Guangdong Province who is credited with being the 'father of China's railways'. He lived here from 1912 until his death in 1919. The mansion is open to the public and hosts an exhibition about Zhang's life.
spots.hours: Tue-Sun 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 65 Dongting Street, Jiang'an District (江岸区洞庭街65号)

spots.name: Former Site of Eighth Route Army Wuhan Office
spots.local: 八路军武汉办事处旧址纪念馆, Memorial Museum of Wuhan Office of Chinese Eighth Route Army
spots.desc: The Eighth Route Army was a Communist-controlled army unit nominally subordinate to the Kuomintang-led Chinese national army during the Second World War. The army's former office in Wuhan is now a museum with exhibits relating to the war.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Wednesdays
spots.addr: 57 Changchun Street, Jiang'an District (江岸区汉口长春街57号)

spots.name: Former Site of Federation of Beijing-Hankou Railway Workers' Unions
spots.desc: Senior members of the Federation of Beijing-Hankou Railway Workers' Unions secretly convened at this office on February 4th, 1923 after the warlord Wu Peifu had forcibly closed down their office in Zhengzhou. It was here that they organised the famous strike that was violently suppressed by Wu Peifu's army on February 7th. Visitors interested in these events should also visit the February 7th…
spots.addr: 2185 Jiefang Avenue, Jiang'an District (江岸区解放大道2185号)

spots.name: Former Site of New Fourth Army Hankou Headquarters
spots.local: 汉口新四军军部旧址纪念馆
spots.desc: The New Fourth Army was the second of the two major Communist-controlled army units that fought during the Second World War. The New Fourth Army's former headquarters is just around the corner from the former site of the Eighth Route Army Wuhan Office, so the two sites are probably best visited together.
spots.addr: 332 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District (江岸区胜利街332号)

spots.name: Gude Temple
spots.desc: Established in 1874 and expanded in the early 20th century, the Gude Temple may not be as old as some of Wuhan's other temples, but it's well worth a visit due to the highly unusual building design, which successfully blends the architectural styles of Europe, the Middle East and Asia. From the outside, it looks a bit like a Christian church, but this is a Buddhist temple. The design was…
spots.addr: 74 Shanghuapo Road, Huangpu Street, Jiang'an District (江岸区黄浦大街上滑坡路74号)

spots.name: Hubei Electrical Power Museum
spots.desc: The museum is housed inside a former British-owned power station that dates from 1905. At the time, it was one of the largest power-generating facilities in China.
spots.addr: 22 Hezuo Road, Jiang'an District (江岸区合作路22号)

spots.name: St. Joseph's Cathedral
spots.local: 上海路天主堂 Shanghai Road Catholic Church
spots.desc: Wuhan's oldest and largest Catholic church. It was designed by an Italian missionary by the name of Angelus Vaudagna and completed in 1876.
spots.addr: 16 Shanghai Road, Jiang'an District (江岸区上海路16号)

spots.name: Wuhan Art Museum
spots.desc: The museum is housed inside the former Jincheng Bank, a neoclassical building that dates from the 1930s. The building was used as a military headquarters by the Japanese during their occupation of the city in World War II.
spots.hours: Tue-Sun 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:00, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 2 Baohua Street, Jiang'an District (江岸区保华街2号)

spots.name: Wuhan Museum of Science and Technology
spots.desc: Entry is limited to 3000 visitors per day. Children under 10 must be accompanied by an adult at all times.
spots.hours: Wed-Sun 09:00-16:30, no tickets issued after 15:30, closed Mon Tue
spots.addr: 91 Yanjiang Avenue, Jiang'an District (江岸区沿江大道91号)

spots.name: Wuhan Police Museum
spots.desc: Has around 830 artefacts pertaining to the history of Wuhan's police. The museum is housed inside an old European style building, which was the police headquarters of Hankou's German Concession from 1909 to 1917. Visitors are required to make an appointment on WeChat under the account 武汉文旅码, which can be done at the spot.
spots.addr: 271 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District (江岸区胜利街271号)

spots.name: Wuhan Planning Exhibition Hall
spots.desc: Maintains exhibitions on urban development and planning in Wuhan.
spots.hours: Mon-Sat 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Sundays
spots.addr: Wuhan Citizens Home, 117 Jinqiao Avenue, Jiang'an District (江岸区金桥大道117号武汉市民之家)

spots.name: Wuhan Water Conservation Science and Technology Museum
spots.desc: The only museum in China focused specifically on the theme of water conservation.
spots.addr: 19 Yanjiang Avenue, Jiang'an District (江岸区沿江大道19号)

spots.name: Dalin Museum for Sexology
spots.desc: One of the very few sex museums in China. Founded by Liu Dalin, a sexology professor from Shanghai University. Displays a wide variety of erotic artefacts from China's past.
spots.addr: Level 2, Tian'e Hotel, 285 Qingnian Road, Jianghan District (江汉区青年路285号小天鹅酒店2楼)

spots.name: Hankou Customs House Museum
spots.desc: Built in 1924, the former customs house is one of Hankou's main landmarks. The bell of the European style building is still in use and chimes every hour from 08:00 to 12:00 and from 14:00 to 21:00.
spots.hours: Tue-Sun 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:00, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 129 Yanjiang Avenue, Jianghan District (江汉区沿江大道129号)

spots.name: Zhongshan Park
spots.desc: One of China's oldest modern parks. It was established in 1910 as a private garden and brought into public ownership in 1927. Shortly afterwards, it was renamed Zhongshan Park in memory of Sun Yat-Sen, founder of China's first republic. The park features a number of old pavilions, bridges and other structures from the early 20th century. In the middle of the park is a statue of Sun Yat-Sen and…
spots.hours: Park opening hours: 06:30-23:30, amusement park opening hours: May-Oct 09:00-18:00, Nov-Apr 09:30-17:30
spots.price: Entry to the park is free. The amusement park charges ¥10 to ¥20 for each ride
spots.addr: 1265 Jiefang Avenue, Jianghan District (江汉区解放大道1265号)

spots.name: Wuhan Expo Garden
spots.desc: This is a large (a mile across) exhibition grounds on Wuhan's northwestern outskirts. Constructed from scratch on the site of a former landfill, it opened in the fall of 2015 for the 10th China (Wuhan) International Garden Expo (2015年第十届中国（武汉）国际园林博览会). There are two large exhibition buildings on site; at the time (Nov 2015) one has a garden expo running, the other has exhibits from the…
spots.hours: Daily 08:30-17:30 (hours are typically extended for special events such as the lantern festival), no entry after 17:00
spots.price: ¥60 (standard adult ticket), ¥30 (children aged from 6 to 18 and adults aged between 60 and 65). Children under 6 years…

spots.local: 武汉海昌极地海洋公园, 武汉极地海洋世界 Wuhan Polar Ocean World
spots.desc: Part of a nationwide chain of oceanariums. Home to sharks, dolphins, sealions, manatees, walruses, tortoises, polar bears, penguins and other popular marine and polar animals.

spots.name: Jiqing Street
spots.local: 吉庆街, 吉庆民俗街 Jiqing Folk Street
spots.desc: An ordinary-seeming street by day, becomes transformed by night into a bewildering maze of streetside restaurants and buskers performing music, dance, opera and stand-up comedy. It is a strongly-recommended experience. Food is plentiful and cheap, and it features a lot of unique local cuisine. The performances can be enjoyed by proxy as performers work other tables or they can be purchased. One…
spots.addr: Jiang'an District (汉口江岸区)

spots.name: Jianghan Road Pedestrian Mall
spots.local: 江汉路步行街, 江汉路步行商业街
spots.desc: Of potential interest to a visitor, a pedestrian mall almost as long as Shanghai's famed East Nanjing Road. During the day it is an interesting look at rampant consumerism in China's rapidly-growing middle class. At night, starting at 19:00, it is the same but is expanded on each side a few blocks deep by a night market with literally thousands of little stalls hawking every variety of goods…
spots.addr: jianghan District, Hankou (汉口江汉区)

spots.name: Indian Marka LIVAT Centre Wuhan
spots.local: 印度玛咖 武汉荟聚中心店
spots.desc: Traditional Indian cuisine with a vegan option. Indian Marka is a popular chain of restaurants in Wuhan, with at least three franchises in the City.
spots.addr: 4-13-08-SU, LIVAT Centre Wuhan, No. 1 Expo Garden Avenue, Qiaokou District (硚口区园博大道1号武汉荟聚购物中心F4，4-13-08-SU)

spots.name: Brussels Beer Garden
spots.desc: A good range of Belgian and German beers on draft and bottled.
spots.addr: 8/8 Xibeihu Road, Jianghan District (江汉区西北湖路8附8号)

spots.name: Jianghan Riverside Club District
spots.desc: Multiple Chinese style clubs with limited dancefloors but plenty of lounges and tables for lively and expensive drinking. As of 2019, Muse Club and Soho Bar are highlights. Venues generally close between 02:00-04:00, later on holidays such as Western New Years Eve. Wuchang residents can stay to 06:00 and catch the ferry across the river for breakfast at Hubu Lane.
spots.addr: Set among the main entrance to the Hankou Riverfront (汉口江滩) and next to Hankou's ferry port (汉口江滩轮船)

spots.name: Bridge Museum
spots.local: 桥梁博物馆, 武汉桥梁博物馆 Wuhan Bridge Museum, 中国桥梁博物馆 China Bridge Museum
spots.desc: Opened in December 2019, this is one of Wuhan's newest museums. It's said to be China's first comprehensive museum about bridges. Has exhibitions about the history of bridge construction in China and overseas. Visitors are supposed to make an appointment before visiting. If you understand Chinese, you can make a booking on WeChat (follow '武汉桥梁博物馆' and select '约桥博').
spots.hours: 09:00-12:00, 14:00-17:00, no entry in last 60 minutes, closed on Sundays
spots.addr: Ground floor, Bridge Science & Technology Building, China Zhongtie Major Bridge Engineering Group Co Ltd, 6 Sixin Avenue, Hanyang District…

spots.name: Hanyangzao Art District
spots.local: 汉阳造艺术区, 汉阳造广告创意产业园 Hanyangzao Advertising Creative Production Park
spots.desc: A former industrial site that has been transformed into an artist village. Has a fair amount of outdoor art on display, including graffiti, as well as sculptures made from household items and industrial parts.
spots.addr: 1 Guishan North Road, Hanyang District (汉阳区龟山北路1号)

spots.name: Museum of Zhang Zhidong in Wuhan
spots.desc: Zhang Zhidong (1837-1909) was a prominent government official during the late Qing Dynasty who was known for his advocacy of limited reforms to the Chinese imperial system and is credited with enacting reforms to the bureaucracy and helping to modernize Chinese industry. In Wuhan, he established China's first iron and steel mill, the Hanyang Iron Works. He then went on to found the Hubei Arsenal…
spots.addr: 169 Qintai Avenue, Hanyang District (汉阳区琴台大道169号)

spots.name: Qingchuan Pavilion and Temple of Yu the Great
spots.local: 晴川阁,禹稷行宫, 晴川阁景区 Qingchuan Pavilion Scenic Area
spots.desc: A temple complex dedicated to Yu the Great, a legendary ancient emperor who overwhelmed the great flood and, with the help of a yellow dragon and black turtle, created the geographical features of today's China. Includes a stele-bearing bixi turtle (one of the few such creatures within Wuhan's urban area; see also Baotong Temple and Longquanshan); good views over the river.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed at 15:00 on Thursdays
spots.addr: 86 Ximachang Street, Hanyang District (汉阳区洗马长街86号)

spots.name: Hougong Lake Wetlands Park
spots.desc: There is a musical fountain in the park, which is switched on at 20:00 on Friday and Saturday nights.
spots.addr: 58 Pengjiashantou, Caidian District (蔡甸区彭家山头58号)

spots.name: Baiyun Cave Scenic Area
spots.desc: Features a network of kart caves that stretches for a distance of around 300 metres. It is named after Baiyun Cave, which is the largest of the caves. Outside the caves is a military museum, which has an extensive collection of old military hardware on display.
spots.addr: Jiangxia District (江夏区)

spots.name: Canglong Island National Wetland Park
spots.desc: Canglong Island is not an island but rather a peninsula on the eastern shores of Tangxun Lake, China's largest urban lake. The park is home to a number of rare birds and animals. There are reportedly a lot of mosquitoes living here too.
spots.addr: 2 Lingjie Road, Jiangxia District (江夏区灵杰路2号)

spots.name: Jiangxia Central Park
spots.desc: Opened in late 2019, this is one of Wuhan's newest and largest urban parks. The concept for the park was inspired by New York's Central Park.
spots.addr: Northwest corner of the intersection of Wenhua Avenue and Jinlong Road, Jiangxia District (江夏区文化大道与金龙大街交叉口西北角)

spots.name: Jiangxia Museum
spots.local: 江夏区博物馆, 江夏博物馆
spots.desc: A small museum with exhibitions on the history of Jiangxia District. The museum will eventually be moving to a new location on the south side of Jiangxia Central Park.
spots.addr: 269 Xingxin Street, Jiangxia District (江夏区兴新街269号)

spots.name: Longquanshan Scenic Area
spots.local: 龙泉山风景区, Mount Longquan Scenic Area
spots.desc: The resting place of 9 members of the local branch of the Ming Dynasty (starting with one of the sons of the first Ming Emperor), decorated with temples, pavilions, and 3 stele-bearing turtles (bixi), set in the countryside a few miles to the southeast of Wuhan, proudly described as Wuhan's answer to the Ming Tombs of Beijing. A trail leads to a hilltop tower, from which great views of the area…
spots.addr: Longquan Township, Jiangxia District (江夏区龙泉乡)

spots.name: Qinglongshan National Forest Park
spots.local: 青龙山国家森林公园, Mount Qinglong National Forest Park
spots.desc: A large and fairly quiet nature park that doesn't get many tourists. Be prepared for long walks and bring your own food and water, especially if you're planning on hiking up the mountain.
spots.addr: Zhifang Street, Jiangxia District (江夏区纸坊大街)

spots.name: Wuhan Flower Expo Park
spots.desc: Features a massive flower plantation covering an area of around 3500 mu (about 233 hectares). The park may be visited at any time of the year, but is probably best visited during the annual Wuhan Spring Festival Flower Fair.
spots.price: Entry to the park is free
spots.addr: 江夏区五里界街道梁子湖大道 (Liangzihu Avenue, Wulijie Subdistrict, Jiangxia District)

spots.name: Big House Contemporary Art Center

spots.addr: 76 Linjiang Avenue, Wuchang District (武昌区临江大道76号)

spots.name: CCP Fifth Congress Site Memorial
spots.desc: It was built in 1918 as a primary school. From 1922 to 1927, it was home to Chen Tanqiu, one of the founding members of the Chinese Communist Party. The Party held its fifth congress here from April to May 1927. The building is now a branch of the Wuhan Revolution Museum and has exhibits about the early history of the Party. The hall where the congress was held has been restored to appear as it…
spots.addr: 20 Dufudi Road, Wuchang District (武昌区都府堤20号)

spots.name: CCP Party Discipline Construction History Museum
spots.local: 中国共产党纪律建设历史陈列馆
spots.desc: The Wuhan Revolution Museum's newest branch. The sign out the front is in Chinese only. However, there are some English explanations inside.
spots.addr: 20 Dufudi Road, Wuchang District (武昌区都府堤20号)

spots.name: Former Residence of Mao Zedong
spots.desc: Mao stayed here with his family in 1927 while carrying our revolutionary activities in Wuhan. The building was demolished in 1957 and rebuilt 10 years later. It is now a branch of the Wuhan Revolution Museum. This was not Mao's only residence in Wuhan. Another one can be found near the East Lake (see listing below).
spots.addr: 41 Dufudi Road, Wuchang District (武昌区都府堤路41号)

spots.name: Huayuanshan Catholic Church
spots.desc: Considered to be one of Wuhan's most beautiful churches. It was designed by Vincenzo Epiphane Carlassare, an Italian missionary, and completed in 1889.
spots.hours: General opening hours: 07:00-19:00. Mass is held on Sun at 06:30, 08:00 and 16:30

spots.name: James Jackson Museum
spots.desc: The James Jackson Museum is an art and design museum inside the former James Jackson Stadium, China's oldest modern indoor sports stadium, which was built in 1921. It is named after James Jackson, a British theology professor who was the first chancellor of Wenhua University, the forerunner of today's Central China Normal University.
spots.hours: Tue-Fri 10:00-20:00, Sat Sun and public holidays 09:00-21:00, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 188 Tanhualin, Wuchang District (武昌区昙华林188号)

spots.name: Lianxi Temple
spots.desc: One of Wuhan's most famous Buddhist temples, though generally quieter than most of the others. The Lianxi Temple was founded in the early Ming Dynasty but has been rebuilt several times. The present structures date mainly from the late Qing Dynasty. Today it is perhaps best known for being Wuhan's only nunnery.
spots.addr: No. 51 Tujialing 4th Village, Wuchang District (武昌区涂家岭四村51号)

spots.name: Shahu Lake Park
spots.local: 沙湖公园, Sha Lake Park, Sand Lake Park
spots.desc: Shahu Lake is the 2nd largest lake in Wuchang after the East Lake. It is physically connected to the East Lake via the Chu River.

spots.name: Uprising Gate
spots.desc: Historically known as Zhonghe Gate (中和门), this was one of the nine gates of the Wuchang City Wall, which was completed in the early Ming Dynasty. In 1911, the first battle of the Wuchang Uprising took place at the gate and it was through this gate that the Revolutionary Army entered the city. The gate was thereafter renamed Uprising Gate in commemoration of the event. The wall was largely…
spots.hours: Tue-Sun 09:00-16:30, no entry after 16:00, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 59 Qiyi Street, Shouyi Road, Wuchang District (武昌区首义路起义街59号)

spots.name: Wuchang Riverfront
spots.desc: At night, the riverfront is spectacularly lit up, with a huge tract of buildings all creating coordinated light patterns. The full show is around 20:00 for half an hour.
spots.addr: Linjiang Avenue, Wuchang District (武昌区临江大道)

spots.name: Hubei Province Foreign Languages Book Shop
spots.local: 湖北省外文书店 Hubei Sheng Waiwen Shudian
spots.desc: Another big book shop. The "foreign languages" in its name seems to refer mostly to the textbooks and dictionaries of foreign languages for the Chinese audience and the books translated into Chinese from foreign languages, but they carry some literature in English as well.
spots.addr: 11 Zhongnan Road, Wuchang District (武昌区中南路11号)

spots.name: Hubu Lane
spots.desc: A well-known place where you can find all kinds of famous foods, including Reganmian (热干面) and mianwo (面窝).
spots.addr: Wuchang District (武昌区)

spots.desc: The large suspension bridge is located in Xiangxi, Hunan Province, where the Detam River flows through the valley floor, and the design elevation of the bridge deck is about 330 meters above the ground. The bridge type scheme is a steel truss stiffened beam single-span suspension bridge with a total length of 1073.65 meters, and the main span of the suspension bridge is 1176 meters. At the end of…

Chatong Town (now Bian Town) was founded in the eighth year of Jiaqing in the Qing Dynasty (1803), known as "one foot on three provinces", is the first batch of…

spots.name: Qianzhou old town
spots.desc: In Jishou City, Hunan Province, there is an ancient and charming ancient city called Qianzhou. The city has a history of 4,200 years and is known as the first city in the thousand-year-old Miao Xinjiang. Qianzhou is a place where the Miao people gather, and for thousands of years, the Miao people have thrived here, giving birth to their unique culture. Xiangxi Miao culture is the business card of…

spots.name: Huangsiqiao old town
spots.desc: 24 kilometers west of Feng Huang county The ancient city of Huangsiqiao is a well-preserved stone city, the city wall is 5.6 meters high, 2.9 meters thick, and the circumference is 686 meters. There are 300 arrow buttresses and two outward forts on the city wall, and there are three city gates in the city, namely "Heyu Gate", "Shicheng Gate", and "Sunshine Gate", and each city gate is built with…

spots.desc: A large rock got jammed between the mountain and another interesting rock, forming a bridge. The trail here makes for a welcome escape from the tourist throngs above at the peak. Not far from the bridge is a ticket gate for those hiking up from temple in the northwest.

spots.desc: Another peak, with sporadic bus service from the bus terminal at the base of the cable car. There is a just past the peak.

spots.desc: The huge pagoda on the next ridge to the southwest, visible from most of the mountain, is attached to Nantai Temple. It has occasional bus service from the base of the cableway until 14:00 or 15:00.
