spots.desc: Located seven kilometers north of Longtan Ciping, five Tan eighteen waterfall called. Longtan falls in number, drop is big, beautiful appearance is known.

spots.name: Jinggangshan Revolution Museum
spots.desc: The museum was founded in 1959, under the personal supervision of Marshal Zhu De. The building is simple, solemn, and in a distinct national style.

spots.name: Museum of the History of the Chinese Soviet Congress System
spots.local: 中华苏维埃代表大会制度史陈列馆
spots.desc: A museum presenting the history of the Chinese Soviet Congress system. The exhibits include historical documents, photographs, and materials about democratic elections, government organization, and the development of the Soviet Congress system. The museum is located near the Second National Soviet Congress Site in Shazhouba Town.
spots.addr: Shazhouba Town, Ruijin, Jiangxi, China

spots.name: PRC Cradle Tourism Area
spots.desc: The Cradle of the Republic Tourist Area in Ruijin is known as the birthplace of the People’s Republic of China. It preserves many historical sites from the early revolutionary period, including the former offices of the Central Revolutionary Government. Visitors can learn about China’s revolutionary history and experience the spirit of the Red Army in a peaceful natural setting. The park is…

spots.name: Shazhouba Red Well Scenic Area
spots.desc: Shazhouba is where Mao Zedong once worked closely with local people. The famous “Red Well” was dug here under his guidance to solve villagers’ drinking water problems. The well has since become a symbol of the revolutionary spirit of “Serving the People”.
spots.addr: Shazhouba

spots.name: Yeping Revolutionary Site
spots.desc: The Provisional Central Government of the Chinese Soviet Republic was founded here, earning Ruijin the title “The Red Capital”. The site preserves former residences of leaders such as Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai, and Zhu De, as well as the Red Army Auditorium and the Grand Hall of the Soviet Government.
spots.addr: Yeping Township

spots.name: Luohanyan Scenic Area
spots.desc: It is famous for its unique rock formations, clear waterfalls, and ancient forests. With its majestic mountains and beautiful scenery, it’s an excellent place for hiking, exploring, and enjoying the tranquility of nature.
spots.addr: Luohanyan Township

spots.name: Yunshi Mountain
spots.desc: It is renowned for its bamboo groves, stone formations, and floating seas of clouds. Surrounded by misty peaks and fresh air, it offers a peaceful retreat for relaxation and nature appreciation.
spots.addr: Yunshi Mountain Town

spots.name: Tianmu Hot Spring
spots.desc: known for its relaxing environment and mineral-rich geothermal water. The hot spring is designed as a leisure and wellness destination, featuring multiple outdoor and indoor spring pools with varying temperatures. Surrounded by natural scenery, Tianmu Hot Spring offers a peaceful atmosphere ideal for stress relief, hydrotherapy, and family relaxation. The facility typically combines traditional…
spots.addr: Approximately 400 meters north of No. 9 Middle School, Hexi Village, Huangbai Township

spots.name: Cradle of the Republic Cultural Tourism Festiva
spots.local: 共和国摇篮文化旅游节
spots.desc: is a unique annual event held in Ruijin, usually in autumn. It celebrates Ruijin’s status as the “Cradle of the People’s Republic of China”. The festival includes red-themed cultural performances, revolutionary exhibitions, folk shows, and local food fairs. Visitors can explore historical sites, enjoy traditional art, and experience the deep revolutionary heritage that defines the city.

spots.name: Red Army Long March Departure Memorial Day
spots.desc: In October, this memorial day marks the beginning of the Central Red Army’s Long March in 1934. Ceremonies, musical performances, and walking events are organized at the Long March Departure Memorial Square. Participants retrace symbolic routes to honor the courage, unity, and perseverance of the Red Army soldiers.

spots.name: Ruijin Folk Culture Festival
spots.desc: It highlights the city’s blend of traditional customs and revolutionary heritage. The event features local operas, Hakka dragon and lion dances, folk songs, handicraft displays, and traditional farming experiences. It preserves ancient traditions.

spots.name: Sports Center
spots.desc: It is a comprehensive indoor sports stadium with a capacity of approximately 3,000 people, completed in 2007. The stadium is suitable for various indoor sports such as basketball, badminton, and table tennis, and also has several public basketball courts outside. It regularly hosts mass sports activities and is open to the public free of charge or at a low cost during certain hours.
spots.addr: 150 meters east of Mianshui Road

spots.name: Youth Badminton Club Training Base
spots.local: 青少年羽毛球俱乐部训练基地
spots.desc: It is a local indoor training facility specifically designed for youth badminton training. Primarily used for training and instruction, it also frequently serves as a recreational space for badminton enthusiasts.
spots.addr: Shazhouba Town

spots.name: 万合影城
spots.desc: Suitable for watching theatrical movies, general movie entertainment, and leisure activities.
spots.addr: 4th Floor, Building 5, Wanhe Plaza

spots.name: Sulma Shopping Plaza
spots.desc: This is a relatively new commercial complex in Ruijin, with a more modern environment than traditional shopping malls and a wider variety of shops, including clothing, restaurants, snack shops, and digital product stores. It enjoys high foot traffic and is a popular spot for locals to shop and relax, suitable for buying snacks, clothing, and household goods.
spots.addr: "Bayi South Road / East side of Hongdu Square commercial street"

spots.name: Hongdu Elite Mall
spots.desc: This is one of the earlier comprehensive shopping malls in downtown Ruijin, surrounded by a high volume of people. It mainly houses shops selling clothing, small commodities, and daily necessities, and also frequently features local specialties and gift shops, making it a great place to casually browse, buy everyday items, or pick up simple souvenirs.
spots.addr: Hongdu Avenue, Ruijin City (near Hongdu Square)

spots.name: Wanhe Plaza (Xianghu Area)
spots.desc: Ruijin's well-known open-air plaza commercial area is surrounded by restaurants, retail shops, and beverage stores, resembling a cluster of shopping districts. It's perfect for buying drinks, snacks, and gifts, and you can easily find coffee shops or trendy retail spots.
spots.addr: Xianghu Town, Ruijin City

spots.name: Ruijin International Grand Restaurant
spots.local: 瑞金国际大酒店中餐厅
spots.desc: The city’s classiest dining spot, located inside the Ruijin International Hotel. Expect a wide selection of Jiangxi and Cantonese dishes, all beautifully presented in a comfortable, modern setting. Great for business dinners or family celebrations. The staff are friendly and used to serving travelers. Try the braised pork or steamed fish — both house specialties.
spots.addr: 2nd Floor, Ruijin International Hotel, 282 Hongdu Avenue

spots.name: Longzhu Restaurant
spots.desc: A lively, centrally located spot serving a mix of local Ruijin specialties and classic Chinese comfort food. It’s always buzzing in the evening, with families and friends sharing big plates of spicy dishes. Try their fried river fish or stir-fried pork with chili. Portions are big and prices reasonable — no wonder it’s a local favorite.
spots.addr: 08 Longzhu Road

spots.name: Yuzi Jiayan
spots.desc: The restaurant specializes in fresh fish and seafood dishes as well as regional home-style cuisine popular in southeastern China. It offers a casual and welcoming atmosphere, making it a popular spot to enjoy traditional flavors and local specialties.
spots.addr: Or nearby major streets: Hongdu Boulevard

spots.name: Youxing Snack House Brunch
spots.desc: Situated about 60 meters northeast of the junction, the café offers a relaxed atmosphere where guests can enjoy brunch classics, light snacks, specialty drinks, coffee, and tea. It’s a popular local spot for morning to midday dining, known for its cozy setting and friendly service.
spots.addr: Northeast of Lijie St & Hualonggang Rd intersection

spots.name: Lanzhitingxia Beef Soup
spots.local: 正宗瑞金市烂厅下牛肉汤总店
spots.desc: A local restaurant specializing in Ruijin beef soup, a traditional dish from the area. The soup is savory and served with tender beef. It is an affordable choice for visitors who want to try a local breakfast or quick meal.
spots.addr: 39 Hongdu Avenue, Ruijin, Jiangxi, China

spots.name: Rice Wine
spots.desc: A traditional Chinese rice wine named after Ruijin City in Jiangxi Province. This type of rice wine is typically crafted using high-quality rice as the primary ingredient and undergoes fermentation and distillation.
spots.addr: Meikeng Village, Yunshishan Township, beside National Highway 323

spots.name: Beaten Tea
spots.desc: The process of making Ruijin pounded tea typically involves grinding ingredients such as tea leaves, peanuts, and sesame into powder, which is then mixed together. The resulting powder is stored in powdered form, and during preparation, it can be steeped in hot water. Additionally, various seasonings such as salt, sugar, and oil can be added according to personal taste preferences. In some…
spots.addr: Xianghuli Cultural and Creative Block, No. 18 Tongdang Lane

spots.name: Bar Street Lounge
spots.desc: Bar Street.Tucked away on the lively Bar Street in downtown Ruijin, this lounge offers laid-back vibes, a good selection of draft beers and cocktails, and occasional live music.
spots.addr: Xianghu Street

spots.name: Small Likeng
spots.desc: An old village with narrow pathways built around several creeks and canals that intersect. One of the most popular places to stay in the area (read: heavily touristy). There are Buddhist temples, active farms, traditional homes, and teahouses -- but also a lot of cars, motorbikes, and the high speed railway going above (but not stopping in) the village. There can be many guided tour groups, so it…

spots.name: Sixi Yancun
spots.desc: A strange claustrophobic duet of villages with tall gray walls and narrow maze-like streets and tumble-down buildings. With the tourist entrance set further away from the town, these villages manage to preserve their living identities better, and, especially towards the end of the day, it really does seem that time stopped in these villages many years ago. There is also an ancient bridge in Sixi…

spots.name: Big Likeng
spots.desc: Not operated by the same company as most of the other villages.

spots.name: Dazhang Shan Mountain
spots.desc: Strangely absent from some guidebooks, but a truly beautiful location. Soaring mountains, and green and crashing waterfalls at every turn. It has dreams of being the number 1 extreme sports area in China, but is quiet now. Probably because the cable car is not finished yet, and the only way up and down is on foot, albeit classic Chinese paved mountain paths. It claims the highest waterfall in…

spots.name: Jiangwan
spots.desc: Although probably not worth visiting on its own, if you are touring the eastern villages do spend an hour wandering around the old part of Jiangwan (away from the main road). The people are warm and friendly. Sit a while and chat to some of the old women sat out on steps and stools in the alleyways who always seem to be smiling.

spots.name: Xiaoqi
spots.desc: This is another duet of villages and on the whole very worthy of a visit. Lower Xiaoqi is tacky and pretty much a guided path around tourist shops, but head out the other side and cross the rice paddies to Upper Xiaoqi for a more secluded, and peaceful place to lose yourself in the buildings. The houses may be similar in both upper and lower Xiaoqi, but its so much easier to appreciate them in…

spots.name: Jiangling
spots.desc: A small villages which is famous for its terrace-style rapeseed flower around Tomb-Sweeping Day

spots.name: Huangling Village
spots.desc: A picturesque hilltop village. The village can be accessed either by cable car or sightseeing car or by walking up the hill.

spots.name: Art Museum of Sichuan Fine Arts Institute
spots.local: 四川美术学院美术馆, 罗中立美术馆 Luo Zhongli Art Museum
spots.desc: Situated at the Sichuan Fine Arts Institute's Huxi Campus, this is one of Chongqing's largest art museums. The museum is also known as the Luo Zhongli Art Museum. Mr Luo Zhongli is a famous oil painter who graduated from the institute. Some of Luo’s works have been reproduced on the exterior of the buildings.
spots.addr: 56 Daxuecheng Road South (大学城南路56号)

spots.desc: Cycling along the riverside is a relaxed way to explore Hechuan. The routes pass through riverside parks and urban areas and offer views of the Jialing River and surrounding scenery. Bicycles can be rented for riverside rides.
spots.addr: Dongjintuo Riverside Park

spots.name: Blueberry Picking and Countryside Walks
spots.desc: During the blueberry season, visitors can pick blueberries, walk through the countryside and visit local rural markets. The area also hosts seasonal cultural and outdoor activities.
spots.addr: Yangliu Village,Tuchang Town

spots.name: Diaoyucheng Tourism and Culture Festival Opening Ceremony
spots.desc: The opening ceremony of the 2026 Diaoyucheng Tourism and Culture Festival, featuring cultural performances and tourism activities.
spots.addr: Dongjintuo Riverside Park, Hechuan

spots.name: 2026 Hechuan Music and Beer Festival
spots.desc: Music performances, food, intangible cultural heritage activities and prize draws are held at multiple commercial areas in Hechuan during June 2026.
spots.addr: Wenfeng Ancient Street

spots.name: Jialing River "Most Beautiful Bay" Drone Show
spots.desc: A regular drone show featuring the history of Fishing Town, the scenery of the three rivers and local traditional culture. The show takes place above Hejiang Tower at Wenfeng Ancient Street.
spots.addr: Wenfeng Ancient Street, Hejiang Tower

spots.name: Dúdiào Zhongyuan — 2026 Diaoyu Fortress Themed Art Exhibition
spots.desc: An art exhibition featuring paintings, calligraphy, intangible cultural heritage designs, historical documents and cultural products related to Diaoyu Fortress. The exhibition features 68 works and runs from September 29 to October 14, 2026.
spots.addr: Hechuan District Art Museum,

spots.name: Hechuan Specialty Store
spots.desc: A local specialty shop selling traditional Hechuan products and food souvenirs. It is a convenient place to look for local specialties such as Hechuan Taopian and other packaged foods to take home.
spots.addr: 92 Heshi Road

spots.name: ChongQing Xinhua Bookstore Hechuan Branch
spots.desc: A local Xinhua Bookstore selling books, stationery, educational materials and cultural products. It is a useful place for visitors looking for Chinese books, local culture-related publications and small cultural souvenir.
spots.addr: 2 Jiaotong Street

spots.name: Hechuan Taopian
spots.desc: Hechuan Taopian is a tradition local sweet made from glutinous rice,walnuts,sugar and candied rose.It is thin,soft and sweet,and is one of Hechuan's best-known local specialties.It is also a popular souvenir

spots.name: Hechuan Roupian
spots.desc: Hechuan Roupian is a traditional dish from Hechuan. It is made mainly with pork and vegetables, and is fried until golden and crispy on the outside while remaining tender inside. It is one of Hechuan’s best-known local dishes.

spots.name: Hechuan Yangroufen
spots.desc: Hechuan Yangroufen is a local rice noodle dish served with mutton and a savory broth. It is commonly eaten as a breakfast or casual meal and is one of Hechuan’s traditional local foods

spots.name: Sanhui Pidan Douhua
spots.desc: Sanhui Pidan Douhua is a traditional local dish combining soft tofu with preserved egg and a savory sauce. It is a popular local specialty associated with Sanhui in Hechuan.
spots.addr: Sanhui

spots.name: Laitan Yinmi Wuji Zhou
spots.desc: Laitan Yinmi Wuji Zhou is a traditional chicken and rice porridge associated with Laitan Ancient Town. It is made with black-bone chicken and local yinmi rice and is a traditional specialty of the area.
spots.addr: Laitan Ancient Town

spots.name: Hechuan Tea House
spots.desc: Traditional tea houses can be found around Hechuan, especially in older streets and riverside areas. They are places to drink tea, relax and experience the slower pace of local life. Tea houses are also a common social space for local residents.
spots.addr: Laitan Ancient Street

spots.name: v8 Tea House
spots.desc: A local tea house where visitors can enjoy Chinese tea and relax in a traditional social setting
spots.addr: 70 Jiaotong Street,2F

spots.name: KUDI Coffee
spots.desc: A coffee shop in the Caifu Plaza area, offering coffee and other cold drinks. It is a convenient stop for visitors shopping or exploring the surrounding commercial area.
spots.addr: 36 Caifu Tianjie,Caifu Plaza No.1 Mansion

spots.name: Yinzi Memorial Hall Cultural Park
spots.desc: Park dedicated to the memory of Yin Zhen, a famous scholar who propagated Confucian ideas in Nanchuan during the Eastern Han Dynasty. Besides the memorial, one can also visit the Haihe Academy, a Confucian academy that was built here in the late Qing Dynasty.
spots.addr: Yinzi North Road, Xicheng Subdistrict (西城街道尹子北路)

spots.name: Zhuoshui ancient town scenic spot
spots.desc: In December 2020, Zhuoshui Scenic Spot was rated as a national AAAAA tourist attraction. In May 2023, it was listed by the Ministry of Culture and Tourism as one of the 10 Yangtze River theme national tourism routes and a part of the Yangtze River Scenic Range Trip. Here you can enjoy eight different types of scenery and architecture.
spots.addr: Zhuoshui Town (黔江区濯水镇濯水古镇景区)

spots.name: Qianjiang City Grand Canyon
spots.desc: This a typical karst landform, located in the core of Qianjiang main city, new city Zhoubai and Zhengyang. It spans seven geological epochs and is 10 km long, with a maximum depth of about 500 meters and an average depth of about 200 meters, integrating mountains, caves, gorges, waterfalls, wetlands, forests and geological wonders in one.
spots.addr: No. 1, North Section of Zhengzhou Road, Zhoubai Street (黔江区舟白街道正舟路北段1号)

spots.name: Three Forks River Riverside Park
spots.desc: A good place for leisure walking, the river across the cool bridge, flying eaves pavilions, carved beams painted buildings.
spots.addr: 40 meters southwest of the intersection of West Section of Xinhua Avenue and North section of Hebin West Road (新华大道西段与河滨西路北段交叉口西南40米)

spots.name: Tujia thirteen village scenic spot
spots.desc: Shijia Thirteen Village is an important part of Xiaonanhai Scenic area, 5 kilometers away from the core scenic area of Xiaonanhai, is the first Tujia ecological museum in China. It is composed of the Wuling Mountain Folk and Ecological Museum exhibition center and 13 original Tujia stockades. Tujia architectural culture, farming culture and national culture are deposited thick, integrating…
spots.addr: Qianjiang district new village (黔江区新建村)

spots.name: Abeng River turtle Gorge scenic spot
spots.desc: Entry to the scenic area is free but the scenic area requires a boat tour, so you need to purchase a ferry ticket for ¥166 a person. There will be audio explanations on board for a more complete understanding of the history of the site to visit.
spots.addr: A Pengjiang town thin water service station (黔江区阿蓬江镇细水服务站)

spots.name: Qianjiang Xiaonanhai National Geopark
spots.local: 黔江小南海国家地质公园
spots.desc: The National Geopark is also a relatively intact ancient earthquake site in China. Xiaonanhai Scenic spot has been rated as a national AAAA tourist attraction. It is a mountain fresh water submerged lake (weir) with the scenery of mountain, sea, island and gorge integrated into one, and it is also the most complete preserved ancient earthquake site in China.
spots.addr: Nanhai Village, XiaoNanhai Town (黔江区小南海镇南海村)

spots.name: Glass gallery bridge
spots.desc: The glass gallery bridge is located in Grand Canyon scenic area. The bottom of the glass gallery bridge is paved with glass, standing on the glass gallery bridge can directly overlook the scenery at the foot, and feel the charm of the Grand Canyon in the thrill. However, after this project enters the scenic spot, you need to buy tickets.
spots.addr: No. 1, North Section of Zhengzhou Road (黔江区正舟路北段1号)

spots.name: Go boating
spots.desc: You can board a boat to visit the scenic spot, or you can choose to rent a boat to tour by yourself. The small South Sea scenic area is surrounded by mountains, the lake is green as jade, and you can enjoy it more closely by boating.
spots.addr: Nanhai Village, XiaoNanhai Town, Changyun Road (黔江区昌云路小南海镇南海村)

spots.name: Alice Manor
spots.desc: Alice Manor sits beside the Abeng River, which is a national 4A level tourist attraction. With the Abeng River as the link and the Wuling Mountain as the support, the scenic spot is rich in natural and cultural resources. It integrates rare vegetation, wetlands, European-style architecture and experiential projects, and combines nature and fairy tales to present tourists with different romantic…
spots.addr: 500 meters southwest of Zhongba Neighborhood Committee, Fengjia Street (冯家街道中坝居委西南500米)

spots.name: Kang Yue era K-song foot bath
spots.desc: Kang Yue-era K song foot bath can be massage bath while singing KTV. The store also serves wine, drinks, fruit and other food.
spots.addr: Jiefang Road South Haixin City D total floor 4 Room No. 4-D1 room (解放路南海鑫城D栋总层数4房号 4-D1室)

spots.name: Puyu Spa
spots.desc: Puyu Spa provides foot bath massage, and can pick ears. Ear picking is also one of the traditional massage, in addition to cleaning the ears can also relax the meridians.
spots.addr: 4-16, Building 51, Qianlong Sunshine Garden, Guanba Road, Chengdong Street (城东街道官坝路黔龙阳光花园 51幢4-16)

spots.name: Dashizi Shopping Plaza
spots.desc: Dashizi shopping mall is the largest shopping center in Qianjiang District. A total of 6 floors, fast food is mainly distributed in the underground floor. Floor 2-3 is the clothing area.
spots.addr: No. 128 Jiefang Road (黔江区解放路128号)

spots.name: Jiahui market
spots.desc: Jiahui market is a supermarket chain. Located in Dashizi Shopping Plaza, Jiefang Road, Qianjiang District. Provide fresh meat, vegetables, packaged foods and daily necessities.
spots.addr: Dashizi Shopping Plaza, Jiefang Road (黔江区解放路大十字购物广场)

spots.name: Pandachu Qianjiang Chicken Giblet
spots.desc: Pandachu Qianjiang chicken giblet is located in Zhuoshui Town. It mainly sells Qianjiang's characteristic food, Qianjiang chicken gib, potato rice and so on. The overall taste is spicy. If the number of diners is large, you can call in advance to book a private room.
spots.addr: 24 East Red Army Road, Zhuoshui Town (濯水镇红军东一路24号)

spots.name: Guoqing's Chicken Giblets
spots.desc: Guoqing's Chicken Giblets is located in the center of Qianjiang District. It mainly sells chicken giblets and specialty stir-fry dishes. Think carefully if you can't eat offal foods. Most of the restaurant's dishes are made from offal and have a spicy flavor.
spots.addr: No. 241 Danhang Road (黔江区丹行路241号)

spots.name: Ring Town Snacks
spots.desc: Ring Town Snacks is a restaurant that has been open for over 20 years. Mainly sells handmade noodles, wide noodles and other pasta. The decoration environment of the store is general, and people can only use the stool outside the store to eat.
spots.addr: No.15 Jianshe Street (黔江区建设街15号)

spots.name: Goose Slate
spots.desc: Ranked fourth in the local food list in Qianjiang District, this restaurant is located in the center of Qianjiang City, and its signature dishes include: stone pot large intestine, mouthed chicken, and braised pork.
spots.addr: 139 Qian Long Street (黔龙街139号)

spots.name: Siye'Coffee Tavern
spots.desc: Siye'Coffee Tavern is a coffee shop and bar in downtown Qianjiang District. The store sells coffee and other drinks during the day and alcohol in the evening. It is a tavern that integrates the local characteristics of Qianjiang.
spots.addr: 484 Qianlong Street (黔龙街484号)

spots.name: Klin Coffee House
spots.desc: Klin coffee house, located in the downtown area of Qianjiang, sells brewed coffee and coffee-free drinks in addition to espresso. Food is also available, such as light waffles, sandwiches and more.
spots.addr: 3 West Central Riverside Road (河滨西路中段3号)

spots.name: Route 303 Store
spots.desc: This is a new comprehensive clean bar opened in 2024. Coffee is sold during the day and alcohol is sold at night.
spots.addr: 4888 Zhengyang Avenue(正阳大道4888号)

spots.name: Black Mountain Valley
spots.local: Black Valley, Heishan Valley, 黑山谷
spots.desc: Black Mountain Valley, sometimes translated as Black Valley or Heishan Valley, is a hundred-square kilometer nature reserve and geopark. It features gorges, caves, waterfalls, dense forests and interesting rock formations.
spots.price: ¥60 during slack season, ¥100 during peak season
spots.addr: Heishan Town, Qijiang District (綦江区黑山镇)

spots.name: Longlin Stone Forest
spots.local: Longlin Stone Sea, Wansheng Stone Forest, 龙鳞石海, 万盛石林
spots.desc: A set of limestone formations similar to the much more famous stone forest at Shilin in Yunnan Province, yet 200 million years older and a lot less touristy. The site is administered by the same company that administers the Black Mountain Valley Scenic Area.
spots.addr: Shilin Town, Qijiang District (綦江区石林镇)

spots.name: Dingshan Lake
spots.desc: Sitting at 900 m above sea level, this lake, which has a surface area of 4.6 million m², is a popular getaway during the summer for locals trying to escape the heat. The Dingshan Lake Cooling Off Festival (丁山湖歇凉节) is held here from July 15th each year.
spots.addr: Shifo Village, Dingshan Town 丁山镇石佛村

spots.name: Dongxi Ancient Town
spots.desc: Dongxi was established around 200 BC as a farming community and blossomed into a full-fledged town during the 7th century AD. Notable historical buildings include the Wantian Temple (万天宫), the Nanhua Temple (南华宫), the Maxiangyue Post Office (麻乡约民信局), and the Taiping Bridge (太平桥).

spots.name: Qijiang National Geopark
spots.local: 重庆綦江国家地质公园
spots.desc: Opened in April 2018, the park consists of three separate areas: Gujian Mountain Scenic Area, Laoying Mountain Scenic Area and Cuiping Mountain Scenic Area (also known as the Petrified Wood Scenic Area).
spots.hours: 09:00-18:00, ticket sales begin at 08:45 and end at 16:30
spots.price: A combined ticket to visit both the Laoying Mountain and Cuiping Mountain scenic areas costs ¥100.

spots.name: Wansheng Ordovician Theme Park
spots.local: 万盛梦幻奥陶纪主题公园
spots.desc: Part of the Ordovician Tourist Resort (奥陶纪旅游度假景区), this theme park features a number of unusual attractions, including several cliffside swings that allow riders to swing over a cliff, a glass walkway that extends 80 meters from the cliff, and a series of bridges with huge gaps between the planks, which can only be crossed while one is tethered by a rope. Avoid this place if you are afraid of…
spots.addr: Wansheng Economic & Technological Development Zone, Qijiang District (綦江区万盛经济技术开发区)

spots.name: Tree Summer Bistro
spots.desc: Tree Summer Bistro sells tea, drinks, BBQ and snacks. It is a new integrated type bar that opened in 2024.
spots.addr: 50 meters up from the Golden Kindergarten on 772 Old Road (交通路772号老路黄金幼儿园上行50米)

spots.name: Tongnan Museum
spots.desc: Museum with exhibitions on the natural and human history of Tongnan. The star attraction is a 5-meter-high, 28-meter-long Mamenchisaurus skeleton, which is said to be the biggest sauropod dinosaur skeleton discovered in Asia.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, no entry after 16:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 13 Dafo Road, Dafo Subdistrict (大佛街道大佛路13号)

spots.name: Chongkan Flower Field
spots.desc: A renowned ecotourism destination in Tongnan, famous for its seasonal flowers such as rapeseed, geraniums, and sunflowers. The Tongnan Rapeseed Flower Festival is held every spring, attracting large numbers of tourists and photography enthusiasts.
spots.addr: Chongkan Town

spots.name: Former residence of Yang Shangkun
spots.desc: This is the birthplace of Yang Shangkun, the fourth President of the People's Republic of China. Construction began in 1862, the first year of the Tongzhi reign of the Qing Dynasty, by Yang Shangkun's great-grandfather, Yang Shisui, according to the standards of a third-rank official residence. The courtyard, arranged in a herringbone pattern, covers approximately 2,800 m², with a building area…
spots.addr: Jinlong Village, Shuangjiang (双江镇金龙村)

spots.name: Dongsheng Tea Mountain Agricultural Tourism Park
spots.desc: There are over 5,000 mu (approximately 1,000 acres) of tea plantations and over 300 mu (approximately 1,000 acres) of jasmine bases. Dongsheng Tea Mountain boasts distinct seasons, with neither extreme summer heat nor severe winter cold, making it a rare summer retreat and leisure destination. After years of development, the scenic park has become a green, ecological agricultural tourism system…
spots.addr: Tea Tree Bay, Litai Village, Zitong Sub-district Office

spots.name: Binjiang Wetland Park
spots.desc: The park relies on the existing wetland park infrastructure and is designed according to wetland park standards. It is divided into a leisure and sports area, an urban square area, an ecological wetland area, and an urban extension area.
spots.addr: The area on the east side of the southern end of the Fujiang Bridge

spots.name: Fushan Park
spots.desc: The park is divided into four main areas: a waterfront leisure area, a specialized garden area, a core park area, and a leisure and sports area, to meet the needs of different visitors.
spots.addr: North side of Century Avenue, Jiangbei

spots.name: library
spots.desc: For tourists and researchers who prefer quiet and want to learn about local culture, history, local literature, and contemporary publications, this is a very convenient and resource-rich public cultural space.
spots.addr: No. 1003, Bayu Avenue, Guilin Street

spots.name: Agricultural Science City
spots.desc: The modern agricultural science and technology park integrates agricultural technology, seed industry, modern facility agriculture, and agricultural tourism.
spots.addr: Tai'an Town and Baizi Town

spots.name: Wanda Plaza
spots.desc: There are clothing stores, restaurants, supermarkets and cinemas inside. It is a good choice for shopping.
spots.addr: Jiangbei Jinfu Island

spots.name: Longxin Central Street
spots.desc: A commercial pedestrian street integrating shopping, dining and entertainment.
spots.addr: Longxin Avenue, Guilin Street

spots.name: Times Square
spots.desc: Offers a variety of food options at reasonable prices.It is not only a shopping venue, but also a space for citizens to socialize, relax, and take photos.
spots.addr: No. 99 Dong'an Avenue

spots.name: Chongqing Department Store
spots.desc: This is a long-established and highly renowned department store, a long-standing commercial landmark in the hearts of the people.
spots.addr: Binjiang Road, Zitong Street

spots.name: Wuyue Plaza
spots.desc: It features a variety of shops including clothing, cosmetics, home furnishings, restaurants, and cinemas, making it a major shopping and leisure destination for local residents.
spots.addr: No. 288 Guihua Avenue

spots.name: Nanjin Pass Ancient Street
spots.desc: The traditional old street is home to bamboo weaving, pottery, tea shops, local handicrafts, and nostalgic snacks.
spots.addr: Nanjin Pass Ancient Street Pedestrian Area

spots.name: Liji Chuanchuanxiang
spots.desc: The soup base is fragrant but not greasy, and the price is affordable, making it a popular choice for young people's gatherings.
spots.addr: About 190 meters west of the Bund Central Plaza, Binjiang Road

spots.name: Guilin Alley Snack Street
spots.desc: It brings together local specialties such as tofu pudding, skewers, ice jelly, grilled fish, hot and sour noodles, etc. It is very lively at night and is a popular place for locals to have a late-night snack and for tourists to experience authentic food.
spots.addr: Guilin Lane Pedestrian Street

spots.name: Welcome to Tai'an Fish
spots.desc: It is famous for its spicy and savory flavor and tender fish.
spots.addr: Near the canal bridge

spots.name: Huang Family Cold Noodles
spots.desc: This is a famous snack with a history of over a century. It has a chewy texture and a particularly prominent spicy flavor. The shop is very down-to-earth, and the focus is on experiencing authentic local flavors.
spots.addr: Datong Street in the old town

spots.name: Huang Si Tai An Fish House
spots.desc: This local restaurant specializes in Tai'an fish and offers common Sichuan hot dishes. The ambiance is that of a typical dine-in restaurant.
spots.addr: No. 454-456, Middle Section of Bayu Avenue

spots.name: Shuangjiang Ancient Town Old Teahouse
spots.desc: These teahouses are usually hidden in old streets and alleys, with a rustic environment and affordable prices, making them the best place to experience the daily life of the locals in Tongnan.
spots.addr: Shuangjiang Ancient Town Scenic Area

spots.name: Nanjin Pass Teahouse
spots.desc: This traditional teahouse preserves the local morning tea culture. Wooden tables and benches, Sichuan opera excerpts, and snack stalls are always present, making it bustling with activity in the mornings. It's a great place to experience the local lifestyle.
spots.addr: No. 18, Nanjin Pass Ancient Street

spots.name: Riverside Tea House
spots.desc: Built along the river, it offers a wide view and is perfect for enjoying tea and river views in the evening.
spots.addr: The eastern section of Binjiang Park (beside the riverside walkway)

spots.name: Ciyun Temple
spots.desc: Not to be confused with the temple of the same name in central Chongqing. The Ciyun Temple is the largest Buddhist temple in Wanzhou.
spots.addr: 1068 Section 1, Shalong Road (沙龙路一段1068号)

spots.name: Wanxian Incident Memorial
spots.desc: A memorial dedicated to the Wanxian Incident of 1926, an event officially referred to in Chinese as the ‘Wanxian September 5th Massacre’. The Wanxian Incident was a brief military conflict between the British and Yang Sen, the warlord who controlled Wanzhou at the time. During the conflict, British naval vessels fired their guns on the city, leading to a large number of casualties. The memorial…
spots.price: Fees vary depending on how much of the complex you want to see - it costs ¥80 to see everything
spots.addr: 10 Lanchigou (兰池沟10号)

spots.name: Wanzhou Grand Falls
spots.desc: Formerly known as Qinglong Falls (青龙瀑布), the waterfall has a width of 115 m and a height of 64.5 m. Because it is wider than Guizhou's Huangguoshu Waterfall, Chinese people call it the No. 1 waterfall in Asia. The waterfall flows year-round. Behind the waterfall, there are two natural grottos, one of which is occupied by a small Buddhist temple.
spots.addr: Ganning Town (万州区甘宁镇)

spots.name: Xishan Park
spots.desc: This is the oldest public park in Wanzhou and features both old plants and historical monuments. On the east side of the park stands the Xishan Clocktower (西山钟楼), which dates from 1931 and is considered one of Wanzhou’s most recognizable landmarks.. The clocktower chimes every hour and is lit up at night.
spots.addr: 13 Wangpai Road (王牌路13号)

spots.name: Hiking on Fairy Mountain
spots.desc: Gentle grassland trails and dense forests suitable for easy to moderate hikes. Winter snow scenery attracts local tourists for photography and snow play.
spots.addr: Fairy Mountain National Forest Park

spots.name: Rafting on Wujiang River
spots.desc: Scenic raft trip through karst canyon cliffs. Expect splashes — waterproof cover recommended.
spots.addr: Wujiang River Gorge

spots.name: Local Black Goat Products
spots.desc: Black goat is a regional specialty of Wulong. Vacuum-packed goat jerky or preserved slices are popular take-home gifts. Check expiration date for travel.
spots.addr: town center markets and souvenir shops

spots.name: Rock Tea & Mountain Herbal Tea
spots.desc: Tea grown in the cool karst mountain environment has a fresh and slightly floral fragrance. Great local gift that travels well.
spots.addr: Fairy Mountain shops and Wulong market

spots.name: Dried bamboo shoots
spots.desc: Bamboo is abundant in the region; dried bamboo shoots are easy to pack and suit many Chinese dishes.
spots.addr: Farm produce stores in town

spots.name: Yiji Mountain Mushroom Soup & BBQ
spots.local: 易记山珍菌王汤·烤肉·酱大骨
spots.desc: Restaurants serving local delicacies are common around Fairy Mountain, specializing in mushrooms, farm-style dishes, and barbecue.
spots.addr: Fairy Mountain Town Ginkgo Avenue

spots.name: Wang's Fairy Mountain Fatty Intestine Fish Main Store
spots.local: 王氏仙女山肥肠鱼总店
spots.desc: With "Fatty Intestine Fish" as its signature dish—a combination of fatty intestines and local river fish or other fish, in Sichuan/Chongqing style, it also offers local farmhouse-style dishes.
spots.addr: No. 30-1, Ginkgo Avenue (ground floor shops along Qise Tianjie street)

spots.name: Good Stove Firewood Chicken
spots.desc: It mainly offers Sichuan and Chongqing style dishes such as firewood-cooked chicken and home-style cooking. The environment is typical of casual restaurants, with dine-in as the primary option. The dishes are generally spicy and strongly flavored, reflecting local culinary characteristics.
spots.addr: No. 69, Furong Middle Road, Furong Street, Units 1-12

spots.name: Fairy Mountain Forest Café
spots.desc: Coffee, tea, soft drinks, and light meals are available for hikers or tourists to take a break before or after exploring the forest scenic area.
spots.addr: Near the entrance of Xianshan National Forest Park

spots.name: Wulong Riverside Tea House
spots.desc: A simple teahouse located by the river—where you can enjoy a drink and sample local tea and snacks.
spots.addr: Located on the banks of the Wulong River

spots.name: Qixia Temple
spots.desc: The original name of this temple was Yunsheng Palace (云升宫). It is 5 km northwest of Yunyang Town. It was built in the Han Dynasty, but repaired many times in the Northern and Southern Dynasties.
spots.addr: Yunyang County (云阳县)

spots.name: Yunyang Dinosaur National Geopark
spots.local: 云阳恐龙国家地质公园
spots.desc: Opened in 2024, this new geopark preserves an internationally significant dinosaur fossil site that was discovered only 10 years earlier. Of particular interest is the 150-meter long fossil wall, which contains over 5000 Jurassic fossils.
spots.hours: summer opening hours: 08:00-18:30; winter opening hours: 08:30-17:30; ticket sales end 1 hour before closing time
spots.addr: Pu’an Township (普安乡)

spots.name: Binjiang Shopping Park
spots.desc: Integrating retail, dining, entertainment, and family leisure functions, it has become an important symbol of the urban commercial upgrade in Yunyang.
spots.addr: Binjiang Avenue

spots.name: Nidang Stone Forest
spots.desc: The provincial-level scenic spot is in various poses and with different forms, like a maze.

spots.name: Lubuge deep valley lake
spots.desc: Vine trees are hidden, and winding paths lead to secluded places.

spots.name: Liu's Manor
spots.desc: The Xiawutun Sub-district Office located in the south of the city is the largest "Tunbao" style landlord and warlord building complex in China. It is composed of 13 courtyard houses with a combination of Chinese and Western styles. It is 360 m long from north to south and 130 m wide from east to west. It is the former residence of Liu Xianqian.

spots.name: Qianxinan Prefecture Museum
spots.local: 黔西南州博物馆, Qianxinan Bouyei and Miao Autonomous Prefecture Museum 黔西南布依族苗族自治州博物馆
spots.desc: If you are interested in history and culture, visit this museum to learn about the historical evolution, national culture and natural resources of the region.Highlights: The museum displays rich historical and cultural heritage of the Bouyei (Buyi) and Miao ethnic groups, as well as many geological exhibits related to karst landforms.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, closed on the eve of Chinese New Year
spots.addr: Level 2, Ethnic Culture Center, Jushan Square (桔山广场民族文化中心2层)

spots.name: Wanfeng Forest
spots.desc: Wanfeng Forest is one of the most famous scenic spots in Xingyi, famous for its unique karst mountain topography. Here you can hike, ride or sightseeing, admiring majestic peaks, green fields and flowing rivers.Highlights: There is a "little Guilin of the East" called, the peak shape is different, suitable for photography enthusiasts and natural explorers.

spots.name: Natural Bridge
spots.desc: Born Bridge is a typical karst cave landscape with clear streams underneath it. You can hike into the area and enjoy the specter of nature.Highlights: The natural bridge is called the "natural stone bridge", and the flowing water under the bridge, the scenery is very charming, making it a good place for photography and exploration.

spots.name: Visit Jumingshan Park
spots.desc: Qianling Mountain Park is located in Guiyang City, although it is a little far from Xingyi, but it is characterized by mountain scenery, lakes, ancient buildings and Buddhist culture, and is a good place to climb, stroll and relax.Highlights: You can climb mountains, visit ancient temples, and enjoy the tranquil natural environment and strong religious atmosphere.

spots.name: Xingyi Old Street Sour Soup Fish
spots.desc: Recommended dishes: Sour Soup Fish, Sour Soup Small LobsterSpecialty: Famous for its sour soup fish, the soup base is tangy and appetizing, with tender fish. The ambiance is elegant, making it perfect for family meals.
spots.addr: Old Street, Xingyi City

spots.name: Miao ethnic restaurants in Guizhou
spots.desc: Recommended dishes: Miao Sour and Spicy Fish, Miao Stir-Fried DishesSpecialty: This restaurant offers authentic Miao ethnic foods, with bold flavors of sourness and spiciness. The restaurant is full of ethnic atmosphere, and the dishes are both fragrant and flavorful.
spots.addr: Miao Ethnic Street, Xingyi City

spots.name: Hingyi Hot Pot Street
spots.desc: Recommended dishes: Guizhou Hot Pot, Grilled Lamb, Charcoal Grilled FishSpecialty: Known for its authentic hot pot, this place serves a variety of spicy and numbing hot pot broths. The street also offers various small food stalls for local snacks, making it a great spot for evening meals.
spots.addr: Hot Pot Street, Downtown Xingyi

spots.name: Old local restaurant in Guizhou
spots.desc: Recommended dishes: Sour and Spicy Rice Noodles, Hand-Pulled Rice, Guizhou Sausages.Specialty: Serving a variety of traditional Guizhou dishes, the rice noodles and sausages are particularly authentic and ideal for those who love bold flavors.
spots.addr: Downtown Xingyi

spots.name: The Grand Prairie Restaurant in Wangmo
spots.desc: Recommended dishes: Beef Hot Pot, Wild Vegetable Stir-Fry with Meat.Specialty: This restaurant makes use of local natural resources, offering dishes made from grassland beef and fresh wild vegetables, perfect for those who enjoy the flavors of the prairie.
spots.addr: Near Wangmo Grassland, Xingyi City

spots.name: Lotus Pool Tea House
spots.desc: Recommended fishes: Lotus Pond Meal Set, Miao Ethnic Traditional SnacksSpecialty: Located near the Lotus Pond Scenic Area, this tea house offers traditional Guizhou snacks and small dishes. It’s a peaceful place to enjoy tea and snacks.
spots.addr: Lotus Pond Scenic Area, Xingyi City

spots.name: Mosuo Museum
spots.local: 摩梭人博物馆, 摩梭民俗博物馆
spots.desc: A museum on the history, culture and customs of the Mosuo people.
spots.addr: Daluoshui Village (大落水村)

spots.name: Photo with the resident eagle
spots.desc: They have a captive eagle and you can have photos with it for a fee. Once you've agreed to the fee, the handler blows a whistle that lets the bird know he needs to stand on your arm and spread his wings for a photo op with the mountains and lake in the background. They will take several photos and you can choose the ones you like. ¥20 for each laminated photo. Different photo sizes are available.

spots.name: Canoe ride to the Island in the middle of the lake
spots.desc: The canoes are by the pier. Depending on the time of day, you may be able to negotiate the price with them. They wait until the canoe is full of passengers then they paddle you out to the island for 20 minutes and paddle you back.

spots.name: Gemu Mountain Cable Car
spots.desc: A quick visit to the top of the most prominent peak in the area via cable car with spectacular views. There is a cave near the top and some mountain monkeys to see.

spots.name: Rent a bicycle or electric/motor scooter
spots.desc: A popular activity here is to bike around the 70-km lake. Half of the road around the lake (Yunnan side) isn't paved and in not so good shape for bikes.

spots.name: Mosuo Bar
spots.desc: It's a small place by the lake. If you go early enough there's live performance by the resident guitarist and singer. There are not many bars by the lake, maybe a handful. This is one of them. There's a small bar counter and tables. The staff are friendly and would sometimes drink with you if they are not busy.

spots.name: Pingtou Qiang Village
spots.desc: Pingtou Qiang Village is a Qiang ethnic village in Maoxian. The village was rebuilt after the 2008 Wenchuan earthquake and follows traditional Qiang architectural styles, with houses built along the mountain slope. The village has traditional buildings, small lanes, streams and paths connecting the houses. It is also a place to experience local Qiang culture and rural scenery.
spots.addr: Pingtou Village

spots.name: Diexi Haizi
spots.desc: A scenic lake in Maoxian surrounded by mountains. It is known for its blue water and mountain scenery.
spots.addr: County Road 103

spots.name: Diexi Ancient City Ruins
spots.desc: The remains of an ancient settlement in Diexi Town. The site provides an opportunity to see historical remains in the Diexi area.
spots.addr: Diexi Town

spots.name: Black Tiger Qiang Village
spots.desc: A historic Qiang village known for its stone watchtowers and traditional mountain settlement. The village preserves several four-, eight- and twelve-sided stone towers and traditional Qiang residential buildings.
spots.addr: Heihu Village

spots.name: Chinese Qiang Ethnic Museum
spots.desc: A museum dedicated to Qiang history and culture. Exhibitions cover local history, Qiang customs, archaeological objects and the history of the Qiang communities in the upper Min River region.
spots.addr: 5 Xiqiang Avenue

spots.name: Maoxian Yuqiang Restaurant
spots.desc: A local Chinese restaurant in Maoxian serving Chinese-style dishes.
spots.addr: Chuanwen Highway

spots.name: Xiqiang Sichuan Restaurant
spots.desc: A local Sichuan restaurant serving Chinese-style dishes in Maoxian.
spots.addr: Xiqiang Avenue

spots.name: Shimo Douhua Home-style Restaurant
spots.desc: A local restaurant serving home-style Chinese dishes, including dishes featuring local ingredients such as yak meat and preserved meat.

spots.name: San Bu Cafe (三不咖啡）
spots.desc: A specialty coffee independent cafe run and owner by a young local Qiang woman. An interior design heaven, operating on multiple stories, just off the main shopping street. Coffees range from 15-25CNY.

spots.name: Yulei Mountain Park
spots.desc: A forested hill overlooking the Dujiangyan Irrigation System, featuring temples, pavilions and panoramic viewpoints of the Min River. A peaceful place for short walks and photography, especially at sunset.
spots.addr: South side of the Dujiangyan Scenic Area

spots.name: Fulong Temple
spots.desc: An ancient Taoist shrine located on a quiet stretch of the Min River. According to local legend, this is where Li Bing subdued the river dragon. The temple offers river views and a calm atmosphere away from tourist crowds.
spots.addr: Near the Min River upstream from the main scenic area

spots.name: Anlan Bridge
spots.desc: A historic-style suspension bridge offering impressive views of the Min River and the irrigation structures. Once made entirely of bamboo and vines, the modern reconstruction preserves the traditional appearance and remains one of the most iconic sights in Dujiangyan.
spots.addr: Crossing the Min River in the Dujiangyan Scenic Area

spots.name: Nanqiao Riverside Night View
spots.desc: A beautifully illuminated pedestrian bridge and riverside area popular with locals in the evening. The colorful lights, reflections on the water and lively street atmosphere make it an excellent spot for night photography.
spots.addr: Near the central riverside promenade

spots.name: Dujiangyan Museum
spots.desc: A small but informative museum covering the history of Dujiangyan, ancient hydraulic engineering, local culture and archaeological findings. Exhibits provide useful background before visiting the irrigation system.
spots.addr: Jianshe Road, central Dujiangyan

spots.name: Dujiangyan Panda Base
spots.desc: A panda zoo, which is (as of 2016) the only place in the world where you can get your picture taken while holding a giant panda. This is extremely expensive but the money is supposed to go to conservation. Some people remember this experience for the rest of their lives, while others are surprised that it ends so quickly (~15 seconds per person). The pandas are generally 1-2 years old, so they…

spots.name: Dujiangyan Panda Valley
spots.desc: Walk through a gorgeous forested valley to see giant pandas and red pandas. It is less crowded than the panda bases in Dujiangyan and Chengdu, but this is China, so it will still be far from empty. To beat the crowds, be in line at 7:30, right when it opens. Head to the red pandas first, as the walkways there are quite tight; you can then double back to see the giant pandas. If you have a Chinese…

spots.name: Qingcheng Mountain hiking (Front Mountain)
spots.desc: The Front Mountain is known for its shaded forest paths and Taoist temples. Hiking to the summit takes 2.5–4 hours. A cable car is available for easier access. Very suitable for beginners.
spots.addr: Qingchengshan Town, Dujiangyan

spots.name: Qingcheng Mountain Back Mountain trekking
spots.desc: A quieter and more rugged area for experienced hikers. Features waterfalls, wooden plank trails, and dense forest. A full-day hike (5–7 hours). Weather changes quickly, so proper shoes and rain gear are essential.
spots.addr: Tai’an Ancient Town, Dujiangyan

spots.name: Qingcheng Adventure Park (Zipline & ropes course)
spots.desc: Offers ziplining, rope bridges, and light climbing activities. Popular among families and groups. Safety equipment provided.
spots.addr: Near Qingchengshan Front Mountain Parking Area

spots.name: Min River rafting (seasonal)
spots.desc: Beginner-friendly rafting trips on the Min River, available June–September. Operators provide helmets and life jackets. Scenic mountain-and-river views along the way.
spots.addr: Yuzui area, near Dujiangyan Scenic Zone

spots.name: Lingyan Ancient Town riverside walk
spots.desc: A peaceful riverside village with teahouses, stone paths, and traditional architecture. Travellers can enjoy a quiet riverside walk or rent a small wooden boat.
spots.addr: Lingyan Town, Dujiangyan

spots.name: Taoist ritual experience (Qingcheng Mountain)
spots.desc: Some temples allow visitors to observe morning incense ceremonies or simple Taoist rituals. English interpretation is limited but the cultural atmosphere is rich.
spots.addr: Shangqing Palace, Qingcheng Mountain Front Area

spots.name: Tea picking & tasting experience
spots.desc: Local tea farms offer tea-picking activities, small DIY processing sessions, and tastings of Qingcheng green tea. Booking in advance recommended.
spots.addr: Jiezi or Qingcheng Tea Plantations, Dujiangyan

spots.name: Cultural craft workshops (mask painting / bamboo weaving)
spots.desc: Short beginner-friendly workshops on Sichuan opera mask painting, bamboo weaving, or incense making. Sessions last 1–2 hours.
spots.addr: Dujiangyan Old Town Art Street

spots.name: Dujiangyan night walk & riverside lights
spots.desc: The old city and riverside paths are beautifully illuminated at night. Perfect for relaxed evening strolls, photography, and street snacks.
spots.addr: South Bridge to Guanxian Tower area

spots.name: Qingcheng Hot Spring Resort
spots.desc: Natural hot-spring resorts offering outdoor pools and private baths. Popular at night, especially in winter.
spots.addr: Tai’an Ancient Town hot spring area

spots.name: Dujiangyan Water-Releasing Festival (放水节)
spots.desc: Held every April at Lidui Park and Erwang Temple. This traditional festival commemorates Li Bing and celebrates the annual opening of the irrigation system’s water flow with parades, rituals, and cultural performances.
spots.addr: Lidui Park & Erwang Temple

spots.name: Qingcheng Mountain Taoist Festivals (青城山道教节庆)
spots.desc: Taoist temples on Mount Qingcheng hold ceremonies, incense rites, and temple fairs during major lunar-calendar holidays. A rich cultural experience in one of China’s major Taoist centres.
spots.addr: Mount Qingcheng Scenic Area – Shangqing & Jianfu Palace

spots.name: Dragon Boat Festival on the Minjiang River (端午龙舟赛)
spots.desc: Local dragon-boat races held around the Dragon Boat Festival (May/June). The best viewing spot is the riverside promenade near the historic Anlan Bridge.
spots.addr: Minjiang River riverside near Anlan Bridge (Dujiangyan)

spots.name: Sunac Mall (Dujiangyan Branch)
spots.desc: Sunac Mall (Dujiangyan) is a large modern shopping and entertainment complex located in Dujiangyan City, part of Chengdu The mall features a wide selection of retail stores, restaurants, cafés, a cinema, and family-friendly entertainment options, making it a popular destination for both locals and visitors.One of its most iconic highlights is Zhongshuge Bookstore, a visually striking bookstore…
spots.addr: No. 1 Zhizhen Road

spots.name: Dujiangyan Bailun Plaza
spots.desc: Dujiangyan Bailun Plaza is one of the major shopping and entertainment complexes in downtown Dujiangyan. The plaza combines modern shopping, dining, and leisure facilities, offering visitors a comfortable and convenient place to spend their time. It features a wide range of fashion brands, restaurants, cafés, and entertainment options, making it popular among both locals and tourists.Located…
spots.addr: 211 Dujiangyan Avenue

spots.name: Nanqiao Night Market
spots.desc: Lively evening market near the South Bridge with dozens of stalls serving bean jelly, dumplings, skewers, and other snacks.
spots.addr: South Bridge (near the South Bridge Scenic Area)

spots.name: Yueji Xinglong · Qingcheng Cured Rib Copper Hot Pot
spots.local: 岳记兴隆·青城腊排铜火锅
spots.desc: Yueji Xinglong · Qingcheng Cured Rib Copper Hot Pot is a characteristic hot - pot restaurant in Dujiangyan. Its biggest feature is the combination of Qingcheng Mountain cured ribs and Tibetan - style copper pot. The cured ribs in the pot are well - stewed, and the meat can be easily removed from the bone with a gentle bite. The cured pig's trotters are soft, glutinous and full of collagen. In…
spots.price: The average cost per person is about ¥85.There are group-buying packages, such as a 2-person package priced at ¥38…
spots.addr: Shop 16, 1st Floor, Minjiang Huating, No. 483-16 GuanJing Road

spots.name: Dujiangyan Irrigation Project Youhutou Beer Hotel
spots.local: 都江堰老号尤兔头总店（幸福大道店）
spots.desc: Dujiangyan Lao Hao You Rabbit Head (Xingfu Avenue Store) is famed for its rabbit heads, the signature dish. They come in spicy and five-spice flavors—spicy ones are fragrant and numbing, five-spice ones rich with sesame. It also serves tender rabbit legs and refreshing frozen tofu pudding, all with authentic Sichuan tastes, loved by locals and visitors.
spots.addr: No.12, Fuzhou 14, Shangduan of Xingfu Avenue

spots.name: Qi Yue Tea (Dujiangyan Darongcheng Branch)
spots.local: 沏悦茶（都江堰大融城店）
spots.desc: Qi Yue Tea is a specialty tea shop located in the heart of Dujiangyan’s Darongcheng Shopping Mall. The shop offers a wide variety of premium teas, including green, oolong, and scented teas sourced from Sichuan’s renowned tea-growing regions.Visitors can enjoy freshly brewed tea in a cozy and serene environment, making it a perfect spot for relaxation or casual meetings. The shop emphasizes…
spots.price: The average spending per person is about 50¥, with a minimum consumption of around 30¥. Private rooms have a minimum…
spots.addr: No. 23, 4th Floor, Darongcheng Shopping Mall, Dujiangyan Avenue

spots.name: Dafo Monastery
spots.local: 大佛禅院, Great Buddha Monastery
spots.desc: According to some sources, this monastery, which covers an area of around 400 mu (about 27 hectares), is the largest Buddhist monastery in China. It was built during the Ming Dynasty at a site in the city's eastern suburbs. It was best known for a 12-metre-high bronze statue of Avalokiteśvara that is said to have had a thousand hands and a thousand eyes. During the Great Leap Forward campaign…
spots.addr: 274 Foguang Road South (佛光南路274号)

spots.name: Sweet skin duck
spots.desc: Sweet skin duck is improved from spiced duck, so it is also called sweet skin spiced duck. Sweet skin duck followed the Qing Dynasty imperial food process. Excavated and improved by the folk, its brine has unique characteristics, with brown and red color, crispy and slightly sweet skin, pleasant aroma, or crisp and sweet, or thick, attached to the tender meat, taste is not inferior to Beijing…

spots.name: Rice candy
spots.desc: Rice candy is a famous traditional snack, the snack is sweet and delicious, with rice fragrance, rice candy is mainly made of glutinous rice and white sugar.

spots.name: Leaf rice cake
spots.desc: Leaf rice cake is a traditional snack in Sichuan. Traditional food for Qingming Festival in western Sichuan and Spring Festival in southern Sichuan. Yerba has different names and characteristics in different regions.

spots.name: Emei Snow Bud
spots.desc: Emei Snow Bud, known in the Tang Dynasty as "Emei White Bud" and "Emei Snow Tea," and later referred to as "Snow Fragrance" or "Qingming Fragrance" during the Song and Ming dynasties, has been regarded as a distinguished gem among famous Emei teas since ancient times. As early as the 7th century, it held a prominent position among China’s top ten teas, documented in ancient texts like the Classic…

spots.name: Emei orange
spots.desc: Emei orange has a long history of cultivation. Ancient people used it as a perfume substitute because of its aromatic smell in the peel. Fruit oblate or similar pear shape, single fruit weight 100-170 grams, thick skin orange yellow, rough skin, neat meat, sour taste and strong, is a kind of nutritious fruit.

spots.name: Emei bamboo shoots
spots.desc: Emei bamboo shoot is a famous specialty of Mount Emei. There are many varieties of it, such as fresh bamboo shoots, salted bamboo shoots and so on. The Emei bitter bamboo shoots are very big, loved by consumers, and have been sold in Chengdu and other places.

spots.name: Niuhua Small Bamboo Skewer Malatang
spots.desc: "Chuan Chuan Xiang" is another form of hot pot, similar to malatang, so people often refer to it as "mini hot pot." It began with a simple broth and ingredients, but now almost anything can be cooked in it. It is said that in ancient times, in the misty, humid region of Sichuan, boatmen and trackers, after a day’s labor, would build makeshift stoves, set up clay pots, and make do with local…
spots.addr: Nos. 1, 3, and 5, Baoning 2nd Street, South Section of Mingshan Road

spots.name: Er Mao Ice Jelly
spots.desc: Ice jelly, also known as liangfen in some regions, is a famous snack that originated in the Yunnan and Guizhou areas. It later spread to Pengshan (Wuyang) in Sichuan and has become quite popular in Chengdu, particularly as a summer treat. It is known for being cool, fragrant, sweet, smooth, and refreshing, providing relief from heat, thirst, and fire. As a summer delicacy, it is loved by many for…
spots.addr: Dongxin Road Old Haochi Street

spots.name: Emei Maofeng
spots.desc: Emei Maofeng, originally named Fengming Maofeng, has been renamed to Emei Maofeng. It is a newly created famous tea from the Mengshan region. The finished tea leaves are tightly curled, tender, and glossy, with silver tips that are elegant and prominent. It has a fresh, clean aroma, a strong and refreshing taste, with a slightly yellowish and greenish tea liquor, and the leaves are tender, green…

spots.name: Grand Buddha Temple
spots.desc: A large temple complex including what is described as one of Sichuan's ten largest stone-carved sitting Buddhas. The area has many lesser shrines as well as a restored but ramshackle living complex, and offers many views of the city and river. From the road, you can't miss the large parking area.

spots.name: Number 1 Scholars Cave
spots.desc: One of Sichuan's greatest bargains, a small grotto where several of Langzhong's greatest scholars prepared for examinations. The complex occupies a small pond and temple. In low season, you can have the place all to yourself for a mesmerizing experience. The area is not quite visible from the road; look for a parking turnoff and informational sign.

spots.name: Langzhong Ancient City
spots.desc: Langzhong Ancient City covers a total area of 4.59 square kilometers, with a 2-square-kilometer core area, and contains multiple national and provincial cultural heritage sites. The city preserves the Tang and Song dynasty street layout and the architectural style of the Ming and Qing dynasties, centered around Zhongtian Tower. It is one of the best-preserved ancient cities in China, known as the…
spots.addr: Langzhong City

spots.name: Langzhong Old Street Tofu Rice
spots.desc: This restaurant is famous for its classic local dish, tofu rice, which features tender tofu and fragrant rice. The dishes here also reflect the local flavors, making it a great place to try authentic Langzhong cuisine.
spots.addr: Old Street

spots.name: Langzhong Flavored Snack Street
spots.desc: This area gathers many local food stalls, offering dishes like spicy noodles, hot pot tripe, sticky rice dumplings, and other classic Langzhong snacks. It’s a great spot to sample a variety of authentic Sichuan street foods.
spots.addr: Near the center of Langzhong City

spots.name: Langzhong Spicy Hotpot
spots.desc: Known for its rich and spicy flavor, Langzhong’s hotpot features a variety of vegetables, meats, and tofu, all cooked in a flavorful, spicy broth. It’s a must-try for anyone craving a hearty and flavorful Sichuan meal.
spots.addr: Jiangbei Street

spots.name: Langzhong Wangfu Restaurant
spots.desc: This restaurant offers traditional Sichuan dishes, particularly the famous spicy flavors of Sichuan cuisine, including Kung Pao chicken and fish-flavored shredded pork. The elegant environment makes it a perfect place for family gatherings and group meals.
spots.addr: South Dajie

spots.name: Longxing Temple
spots.desc: Longxing Temple is located in Pengzhou City, the north gate enclosure. It was built in the Eastern Jin Dynasty Xiankang three years (33 AD), and known as the "Dakong Temple" Liang Wu Di Yongding two years (558 AD) Zhigong Zen Master expansion of the temple, Wu Zetian Tianzhu two years (619 AD) renamed the "Danyun Temple". Tang Xuanzong Kaiyuan six years (718 AD), the imperial edict number…
spots.addr: Longxing North Street

spots.name: Yangping Taoist temple
spots.desc: Yangping Guan was built in the late Eastern Han Dynasty, is Zhang Tianshi to promote Taoist culture of the first place. Belongs to the Taoist twenty-four rule of the first, in the development of Taoist culture, dissemination process occupies an important position.
spots.addr: 100 m east of Pengbai Road in Yangping Village

spots.name: Pengzhou Mosque
spots.desc: Pengzhou mosque is an Islamic building. Built in Daoguang two years (1822), the Department of the Square Muslim predecessors gathered to collect funds. It is one of the three mosques in Pengzhou. Its appearance is a combination of Arabic and Chinese styles, is a wooden structure temple-style building. The temple is grand and magnificent.
spots.addr: 17 West Jinpeng Road

spots.name: Former residence of Yin Changheng
spots.desc: Yin Changheng was a political and military figure in the late Qing Dynasty. He led the Sichuan Revolutionary Uprising. His former residence was built in 1853, then renovated in 1998, and the current residence was completed in 2013. It covers a total area of 36 acres, including Yin Changheng Memorial Hall, Republican Culture Square, Xinhai Garden and Memorial Sculpture.
spots.addr: South of Changshi Road, Changheng Village, Shengping Township

spots.name: Baishuihe National Nature Reserve
spots.local: 白水河国家级自然保护区
spots.desc: Baishuihe National Nature Reserve is located in the south-central part of the Longmenshan fold belt, geologically belonging to the eastern part of the Hengduan Mountains, is a typical geomorphological zone in the transition section from the Sichuan Basin to the Tibetan Plateau, the terrain increases from southeast to northwest, with the lowest elevation of 1,480 meters, and the highest elevation…

spots.name: Yufu Wetlands
spots.desc: Yufu Wetland is a great place for visitors to get close to nature and relax. In all seasons of the year, there are blooming flowers in spring, cool greenery in summer, red leaves in autumn and snow in winter, each with its own scenery. Every time you visit this place, you will feel a different and unique charm.
spots.addr: 32 Pengbai Road

spots.name: Zhixin Yidu Shopping Center
spots.desc: It is a large shopping building with food, shopping, supermarket and movie theater on three floors.
spots.addr: 122 Jinpeng East Road

spots.name: Wangshuli commercial district
spots.desc: The business district is open, the building combines ancient and modern culture, and is also the theme block of the red spirit of Pengzhou City, with clothing stores, beauty stores, daily chemical stores, and all kinds of food. There are many benches for resting feet, which is a good place for residents to relax and have fun.
spots.addr: 23 Anrendong Street

spots.name: Tianpeng Peony Festival
spots.desc: Danjing Mountain in Pengzhou has been a holy place for Taoism and Buddhism since the Han Dynasty, and the religious event "Three Festivals" is held every year. In the Tang Dynasty, peony planting was popular in Tianpeng, and peonies became an important part of the religious festivals. Danjing Mountain is known as "Flower Mountain", and the peony is also the city flower of Pengzhou. Every spring…
spots.addr: Danjing Mountain，Pengbai Road, Danjingshan Township

spots.name: Bailu China-France Classical Music Festival
spots.desc: The festival will invite many outstanding music artists, a well-known symphony orchestra, and a number of repertory groups into the Bailu Township, to bring a high-quality music and art event, but also will be held into the piano art school, the sound of music - Master Lecture Hall, the closing ceremony and closing concert, elegant art into the community, classical music and art street exhibition…
spots.addr: Shuyuan Village, Bailu Township

spots.name: Guihua Township Long Kiln Ceramics Experience Center
spots.local: 桂花镇龙窑陶瓷体验中心
spots.desc: The kiln base was built in the late Ming and early Qing dynasties, today's Guihua Long Kiln, is rebuilt on the ancient kiln base, according to the mountain incline with earth bricks masonry into a slanting straight-flame cylindrical dome-shaped tunnel, divided into the kiln head, kiln bed, the kiln end of the three parts of the incline of the mountain masonry, the shape resembles a dragon (龙…
spots.addr: No. 1, Group 14, Shuanghong Village, Guihua Township

spots.name: White Porcelain Art Center
spots.desc: Relying on the cultural background of Pengzhou Song Dynasty white porcelain, the White Porcelain Art Center creates the regional brand of "Tianfu Culture, Pengzhou White Porcelain", and combines the traditional handicrafts with parent-child experience, famous potter in residence, ceramic experience hall, ceramic display area and other immersive experience methods to integrate the original ecology…
spots.addr: No. 63, Juntun West Street Longfeng District

spots.name: Yangsanjie Liangbantu
spots.desc: This is a Sichuan-style rabbit dish where diced rabbit meat is tossed with a secret red oil chilli, spring onions and fried peanuts.
spots.addr: 18, Yanxiu Street, Tianpeng Township

spots.name: Yuebaiwei Sichuan Restaurant
spots.desc: A classic Sichuan restaurant with beautiful decor and great food. Especially suitable for family gatherings or business banquets.
spots.addr: 11 Jinpeng East Road

spots.name: Chapanda
spots.desc: A local tea drink chain brand in Chengdu, insisting on the original leaf freshly extracted to ensure that the tea soup removes both the astringent flavor and retains the tea aroma. There are two shops in the Pengzhou downtown.

spots.name: Jinggang Temple
spots.desc: Temple with an adjacent shop that sells prayer flags and other Buddhist goods. At lunch time it is also possible to ask if you may eat in the temple kitchen, for a small fee.

spots.name: Paoma Mountain
spots.desc: This is the mountain under which the city lies, famous for being referenced to a popular love song and horse races in the past. Guide books have cautioned about incidents of muggings in the past, so going in groups may be advisable.

spots.name: Roman Catholic Church
spots.desc: Entry via stairway on right hand side, grounds floor is unrelated shops. It's a functional place of worship, more than an attraction.

spots.name: Old Town Spring
spots.desc: English signboards that give an interesting background to the history of the spring and horse races on Paoma Shan/Mountain.

spots.name: Town Square
spots.desc: Witness droves of locals dance to traditional music at the town square. They all mimic one leader through the steps, can you spot who she is?

spots.name: Yak Bridge
spots.desc: Serves as a marketplace for all things yak. Culturally relevant to the local Tibetans, it is a one-of-a-kind site to see. Warning, not for traveler with a weak stomach!

spots.name: Er Dao Qiao
spots.desc: A hot spring resort. A private room with a pool may entail a wait of up to a few hours, while a public pool is available immediately. A bit rough on the edges but this place is very affordable. It's the real deal offering great medicinal benefits. Bring your own towel.
spots.price: A private room with a pool is ¥10 per hour; a public pool is ¥48

spots.name: Mugecuo
spots.desc: National park containing lakes, forests, mountains, hikes, hot springs and grasslands. The entrance price is rather high by Chinese standards but it still well worth the (literally) breathtaking views. This is wild man's lake in Tibetan and you will be going up high to see the glory of the unspoiled alpine world. If you venture up in winter via taxi (¥200 one way) you most likely will be the…

spots.name: Kangding Love Song International Music Festival
spots.desc: An annual cultural and music festival associated with Kangding's famous love-song tradition. The 2026 festival featured street performances, music, cultural activities and interactive events at several locations in central Kangding, including Luliucheng.

spots.name: A're Tibetan restaurant
spots.desc: Venue for both good food and ambience. The restaurant is decorated in a traditional style, with adjacent private rooms and waitresses in traditional dress. Waitresses and local customers have a habit of dancing to the local music playing in the cafe. The food is varied and delicious. Westerners may appreciate the potato fried in Yak butter. Service is prompt.
spots.addr: Xinshi Dian Jie

spots.name: Sonam Tso
spots.desc: Small cafe serving drinks and - perhaps - western breakfast. Check out the unusual Tibetan handicraft prototypes that adorn the cafe walls.

spots.name: Kalakar Hotel
spots.desc: Restaurant on the second floor that serves up french fries, bobo shakes, and other East-West-blend fast foods.

spots.name: Tangsubao
spots.desc: a tiny hole-in-the-wall, serves up the best meat dumpings in Kangding, maybe anywhere. They do take-away, or you can ask them to set up a table in the street.

spots.name: Himalayan coffee
spots.desc: Surprisingly good coffee on the second floor of the building, overlooking the river/town. Has an international vibe to it.

spots.name: Yiren Ancient Town
spots.local: 彝人古镇, Ancient Town of the Yi Nationality
spots.desc: Not an actual ancient town, but an artificial one that was built in the early 21st century. Designed to showcase the culture of the Yi people (and of course make money from tourists). Cultural performances are held here every night, including a welcoming ceremony at 18:50 and dancing shows from 19:30 to 20:20.
spots.addr: Yong'an Road (永安路)

spots.name: New Roking Plaza
spots.desc: This is a shopping center in the center of town. There is nothing special about it though.
spots.addr: 2 Lùchéng Nánlù (鹿城南路2号)

spots.name: Xiangyuan Lamb
spots.desc: A local hotpot restaurant in Yiren Ancient Town specialising in lamb soup hotpot and other lamb dishes.
spots.addr: 533-535 Yong'an Road

spots.name: Yifuxuan Local Cuisine
spots.desc: A local Yunnan restaurant in Yiren Ancient Town serving Yi-style dishes and regional specialties.
spots.addr: C79-1, Yiren Ancient Town Development Zone

spots.name: Tropical Bush
spots.desc: Tropical Bush seems to be a chain of cafés in Chuxiong. At least the one on Huidong Street is a café/bar with a jungle theme. All the walls are covered in dark photo wallpaper with bad lighting and the guests sit on swings at their tables. The "cappuccino" here is hilarious and highly recommended, even though it is not drinkable.
spots.addr: Huidong Street (汇东街17-23号)

spots.name: Old Town of Heijing
spots.desc: Unlike Old Jinshan Town, this is a real historic town and has numerous old buildings dating from the Ming and Qing dynasties. The town can easily be visited on a day trip, though limited accommodation is available for those who wish to stay overnight.

spots.name: World Dinosaur Valley
spots.desc: World Dinosaur Valley is divided into three parts: a hot springs resort, a geological park and a dinosaur-themed amusement park. The geological park is probably the biggest drawcard. It includes a major fossil site where the remains of a huge number of dinosaur skeletons have been discovered. Around 60 of the dinosaur skeletons are on display at a museum built at the site.
spots.price: ¥65 just to visit the geological park, ¥160 to visit both the geological park and the amusement park, ¥118 to bathe in…
spots.addr: Hangrui Expressway (杭瑞高速)

spots.name: Anning Confucius Temple
spots.local: 安宁文庙, 连然文庙 Lianran Confucius Temple
spots.desc: One of the very few historical sites in Anning's central business district. the Anning Confucius Temple was built in 1337. Like many temples of its age, the temple has undergone many renovations over the centuries, most recently in 2002-2003 when parts of the temple that had been destroyed in the 20th century were rebuilt. Nonetheless, two original buildings remain standing, including the Dacheng…
spots.addr: 122 Lianran Street (连然街122号)

spots.name: Dongchuan Red Land
spots.desc: This area has terraced fields of red earth, with different crops in different fields, leading to a patchwork of colour that is particularly attractive in spring and fall when there are flowers. Although several viewpoints are within walking distance of the central town, the rest of the scenic area is quite spread out, it's a bit remote, and there's not much to do other than look at dirt, so it's…

spots.name: Mangshi Jingpo Ethnic Museum
spots.desc: Mangshi Jingpo Ethnic Museum is located on Jingpo Road in the city center of Mangshi. The museum showcases the history, culture, and arts of the Jingpo ethnic group, including traditional costumes, handicrafts, and historical documents. It has a rich collection of exhibits, ideal for visitors interested in the Jingpo culture. The museum is free to visit and is open daily from 09:00 to 17:00.
spots.addr: Jingpo Road

spots.name: Mangshi National Cultural Palace
spots.desc: Mangshi National Cultural Palace covers 154 acres and was completed in 1988. It features a triangular spire entrance with a gourd-shaped arch and Dai-style palace architecture. Inside, there are exhibition halls displaying the traditional culture and arts of the Dai and Jingpo ethnic groups. The palace also hosts various cultural events and festivals, making it an excellent place to learn about…
spots.addr: South Section of Youth Road

spots.name: Tree Encased Pagoda
spots.desc: Tree Encased Pagoda is an ancient pagoda surrounded by tree roots. The roots of the trees have grown around the pagoda, creating a unique and captivating landscape. The site attracts many visitors for its natural beauty. It is open all day and free to visit.

spots.name: Dehong Ethnic Customs Tourism Area
spots.desc: Dehong Ethnic Customs Tourism Area is an excellent place to learn about the culture of various ethnic groups in Dehong. Visitors can view traditional buildings, costumes, and handicrafts from the Dai, Jingpo, and other ethnic groups. The area is open all day and free to visit.

spots.name: Mangshi City Park
spots.desc: Mangshi City Park is a peaceful urban park, offering a relaxing space for locals and visitors alike. The park features walking paths, gardens, and small lakes. It is a great spot to take a stroll or enjoy a picnic in a tranquil environment.

spots.name: Yunnan Jingpo Autonomous County
spots.desc: Yunnan Jingpo Autonomous County is home to the Jingpo ethnic group and offers visitors a chance to explore the unique culture of this group. The county is known for its traditional villages, scenic landscapes, and unique customs, including traditional dances, songs, and handicrafts.

spots.name: Myanmar Border Town
spots.desc: Myanmar Border Town is a small town near the border with Myanmar. It is a hub for cross-border trade and offers a unique blend of Chinese and Myanmar cultures. Visitors can enjoy shopping for Burmese handicrafts, enjoy authentic Myanmar food, and experience the fusion of the two cultures in daily life.

spots.name: Peacock Lake Resort
spots.desc: Peacock Lake Resort is a popular tourist destination in Mangshi, offering a variety of water activities such as boating and fishing. Visitors can enjoy the natural scenery and experience the Dai culture. The resort has restaurants and accommodation facilities for extended stays.

spots.name: Mengding Hot Springs
spots.desc: Mengding Hot Springs is renowned for its rich minerals and therapeutic properties, making it an ideal place to relax. The hot spring area has several pools with comfortable water temperatures, and the surrounding environment is peaceful, perfect for relaxation and wellness.
spots.addr: Mengding Town

spots.name: Mangshi Cultural and Art Center
spots.desc: The Mangshi Cultural and Art Center is the main venue for cultural activities in the area, regularly hosting concerts, dance performances, and theatrical shows. The official website provides the latest performance information and ticket reservations.
spots.addr: No. 1, Cultural Road, Mangshi

spots.name: China Mangshi International Art Festival
spots.desc: The China Mangshi International Art Festival is a grand cultural event held annually, covering music, dance, and art exhibitions. The official website provides the latest event information and ticket bookings.
spots.addr: Mangshi International Convention Center
