spots.name: Dai Ethnic Culture Village
spots.desc: Dai Ethnic Culture Village is an excellent place to experience the traditional culture of the Dai people in Mangshi and its surroundings. Visitors can explore Dai traditional houses, lifestyles, and taste authentic Dai cuisine. The village also hosts cultural performances, showcasing Dai dance, music, and festive customs.

spots.name: Mangshi City Museum
spots.desc: The Mangshi City Museum houses a large collection of artifacts related to local history, ethnic culture, and natural resources. Through its exhibitions, visitors can learn about the history of Mangshi and the Dehong region, particularly the traditions and arts of the Dai and Jingpo ethnic groups.

spots.name: Dai Water Splashing Festival Celebration
spots.desc: The Dai Water Splashing Festival is one of the most important festivals in Mangshi, usually held in mid-April. It is a major celebration of the Dai New Year, symbolizing the washing away of misfortunes and welcoming a new beginning. During the festival, locals and tourists splash water on each other, and the streets are filled with singing, dancing, and music.

spots.name: Mangshi Border Trade Market
spots.desc: The Mangshi Border Trade Market is a hub for border trade, shopping, and cultural experiences. The market features a wide variety of goods, including local handicrafts, jewelry, spices, and fresh tropical fruits. Vendors from both China and Myanmar sell a range of products, making it an excellent place for tourists to purchase local specialties. There are also many stalls selling traditional Dai…

spots.name: Nanqiao Jewelry Street
spots.desc: Nanqiao Jewelry Street is a well-known jewelry and gemstone market in Mangshi, famous for Myanmar jade, rubies, sapphires, and other gemstones. The jewelry stores offer a wide selection of gems, and visitors can purchase high-quality jewelry and accessories. Store owners usually provide authenticity certificates for the products, but it is important to choose carefully.
spots.addr: Nanqiao Town

spots.name: Yifeng Market
spots.desc: Yifeng Market is a local shopping center frequented by residents of Mangshi. It offers a variety of goods, including local spices, seasonings, dried foods, and specialties. The market has a strong ethnic flavor, making it a great place to experience and buy unique products from the Dehong region. Visitors can also purchase Dai and Jingpo handicrafts, as well as various spices and herbs.

spots.name: Dai Handicraft Market
spots.desc: The Dai Handicraft Market is a place to showcase and sell traditional Dai handicrafts, such as hand-woven textiles, wood carvings, and intricate silver jewelry. The market is a great place for visitors to purchase authentic Dai items that reflect the region's rich culture. Many of the goods are handmade and sold by local artisans, allowing for direct interaction with the creators.

spots.name: Laotian Restaurant
spots.desc: Laotian Restaurant offers a range of authentic Laotian dishes, including Laos-style grilled fish, spicy salads, and sticky rice. It is known for its fresh ingredients and traditional cooking techniques. The restaurant has a cozy atmosphere, making it a popular spot for both locals and tourists.

spots.name: Dai Cuisine Restaurant
spots.desc: Dai Cuisine Restaurant serves traditional Dai dishes, such as spicy and sour grilled fish, fried rice, and specialty vegetable soups. The flavors of the dishes are influenced by the region's rich Dai culture, with an emphasis on fresh herbs, spices, and grilled meats.

spots.name: 万龙烤鱼
spots.desc: Wanlong Grilled Fish specializes in Dai-style grilled fish, a local delicacy. The fish is marinated with a mix of spices and grilled to perfection, offering a smoky and flavorful experience. This is a great place to enjoy authentic grilled fish in a relaxed setting.
spots.addr: No. 15 Chengxin Street

spots.name: 芒果糯米饭店
spots.desc: Mango Sticky Rice Shop serves the popular Thai dessert with a local twist. The sticky rice is paired with fresh mango slices and sweet coconut milk, making it a perfect way to end your meal in Mangshi.
spots.addr: No. 8 Yixiu Street

spots.name: Dai Tea House (芒市傣族茶馆)
spots.desc: A popular spot for enjoying traditional Dai tea, which is known for its calming and health-boosting properties. Visitors can sip on local tea varieties while tasting regional snacks like rice cakes and fried fritters.
spots.addr: No. 16 Cultural Square

spots.name: Mango Paradise Juice Stall
spots.desc: Popular among locals and tourists alike, this juice stall serves a variety of fresh fruit juices, including mango, pineapple, and passion fruit, sourced from the region’s abundant tropical fruits.
spots.addr: 15 Wenming Street

spots.name: Mangshi Night Bar
spots.desc: A popular spot for enjoying local rice wine and beer in a relaxed, lively atmosphere. The bar serves a variety of cocktails and offers a selection of locally brewed spirits to pair with traditional snacks.
spots.addr: 34 East Huancheng Road

spots.name: Yubeng Village
spots.desc: Tibetan village not accessible by any vehicles. You can ask at your hostel to book a seat for you in one of the minibuses departing every morning from FeiLaiSi to Xidang Hot Springs (西当温泉[xīdāngwēnquán]) where the hike starts. There are usually 6-7 seats in a bus and an overall price is ¥150 (June 2011). Talk to the other people planning to go there so you can share the price. There are a decent…

spots.name: Meilixue Mountain Nature Reserve
spots.local: 梅里雪山景区; Méilǐxuěshān Jǐngqū; also known as Snow Mountain
spots.desc: Hike to the Taizi Temple and Minyong Glacier. Taizi Temple has a guest house but unfortunately most of the rooms are severely damaged by a storm, there is still a few acceptable rooms, available at very low prices ¥20. Only recommended if you absolutely have to stay on the mountain, otherwise go back down to Mingyong Town (July 2009).

spots.name: Iger Trekking
spots.desc: Specializes in treks of the Meili Snow Mountain/Kawa Karpo Range, including Inner and Outer Kora treks.

spots.name: Nomad
spots.desc: Finnish woman who lives in Xidang village doing research. Treks to Yubeng, Mingyong, Sinong, Adong, Outer kora and Weixi area. Equipment available.

spots.name: Jin lake
spots.desc: A large urban lake in central Gejiu, surrounded by parks and public spaces. The lakeside area includes Jinhu Cultural Square and walking paths, and is a popular place for evening walks.
spots.addr: 112 Jinhu East Road

spots.name: Baohua Temple
spots.desc: A historic temple complex founded in 1670 during the Qing dynasty. The complex includes the Jade Emperor Pavilion, Sanqing Hall, Lingguan Pavilion, Guanyin Pavilion and several other traditional buildings. It is a protected cultural heritage site and has long been used for religious activities and local recreation.
spots.addr: Baohua Park, Baohua Road

spots.name: Gejiu City Museum
spots.desc: A local museum documenting Gejiu's history, mining industry and tin culture. Its exhibits include bronze artifacts and displays about the city's long history of tin mining.
spots.addr: Jinhu Cultural Square

spots.name: Yasha Di Waterfall Hot Spring
spots.desc: A mountain hot spring complex built around natural streams and waterfalls, with more than 20 outdoor pools. The spring water emerges at a high temperature and the site is surrounded by forested slopes.
spots.addr: Jiaosha Township, along the Ge-Yuan Expressway

spots.name: Northeast Dumpling King
spots.desc: A local Chinese restaurant specializing in dumplings and other northern Chinese dishes.

spots.name: Lao Pai Wang Ji Donkey Meat Rice Noodles
spots.desc: A local noodle restaurant known for rice noodles served with donkey meat.
spots.addr: Yongsheng Street

spots.name: Guoguo Malatang
spots.desc: A local restaurant serving malatang, a Sichuan-style dish of vegetables, meat and other ingredients cooked in a spicy broth.
spots.addr: 35 Youdian Lane

spots.name: Guyu Tea & Coffee
spots.desc: A modern café and teahouse on Jinhu West Road serving coffee, tea and light meals. It has indoor and outdoor seating with views toward Jin Lake, and is suitable for a relaxed coffee or evening drink.
spots.addr: 333 Jinhu West Road

spots.name: Mige Bar
spots.desc: A modern late-night bar on Jinhu East Road serving alcoholic drinks in a contemporary setting. It is suitable for evening drinks and stays open until late at night.
spots.addr: Shop 1, No. 189 and No. 187-6 Jinhu East Road

spots.name: Xianghuiqiao Railway Station
spots.desc: A historic railway station built in 1936 on the former Mengzi–Baoxiu Railway. The station building combines Chinese and Western architectural features and was designated a prefectural-level cultural heritage site in 2016. It is now a stop on the Jianshui tourist train.
spots.addr: Xinfang Village

spots.name: Jianshui Purple Pottery Museum
spots.desc: Learn about Jianshui’s traditional purple pottery and try hands-on pottery-making activities. The museum includes exhibition halls, a non-material cultural heritage display, a VR experience area and spaces for pottery-making experiences. Free guided tours are usually offered at 10:00 and 15:00.
spots.hours: Tu-Su 09:00-17:30; last admission 16:30; closed M except public holidays
spots.addr: 271 Wanyao Village (碗窑村271号)

spots.name: Ant Workshop Pottery Art Factory
spots.desc: A colorful art complex combining pottery culture, exhibition spaces and studios.
spots.addr: Longyao Ecological City, Lin'an Town

spots.name: Explore Jianshui's Ancient Wells
spots.desc: Explore historic wells scattered through Jianshui Old Town, including Daban Well and other traditional water sources.
spots.addr: Jianshui Old Town

spots.name: Jianshui Purple Pottery Street
spots.desc: A shopping area specializing in Jianshui purple pottery, including handmade teapots, cups, vases and other ceramic products.

spots.name: Jianshui People's Mall
spots.desc: A local shopping centre selling everyday goods and locally available products.
spots.addr: Beizheng Street

spots.name: Lin'an Restaurant
spots.desc: A long-established local restaurant serving traditional Jianshui and Yunnan dishes. It is known for local specialities such as steam-pot chicken and rice noodles, and is a convenient place to try regional food while exploring the old town.
spots.addr: 46 Lin'an Road (临安路46号)

spots.name: Waipo Weidao Yunnan Cuisine
spots.local: 外婆味道云南菜大当家（建水古城店）
spots.desc: A Yunnan-style restaurant in the old town serving local and regional dishes. A good option for travellers who want a sit-down meal with a broader selection of Yunnan food beyond snacks and noodles. The restaurant is open throughout the day and into the evening.
spots.addr: 5 Yinghui Street (迎晖街5号), Lin'an Town

spots.name: Jianshui Renjia Yipin Liang Restaurant
spots.desc: A local restaurant serving Jianshui and Yunnan-style dishes.
spots.addr: 69-1 Hanlin Street (翰林街69号附1号)

spots.name: Dahongpao Tea House
spots.desc: A local tea house where visitors can have tea and take a break.
spots.addr: Jianmin Road

spots.name: Tour with Sophia
spots.desc: Sophia is a local, very friendly and knowledgeable. Her English is good and she offers a variety of tour services to the terraces and further at reasonable pricing. She also gets you around the tourist cashiers and off the beaten tracks. You can either choose public transport to and from your destination of choice (starting at around ¥15/person, depending to where and when; you also pay her…

spots.name: Manzhao Buddhist Temple
spots.desc: A Dai-style temple. A distinctive feature is that the temple offers Dai handicraft experiences, including making traditional Dai paper lanterns.
spots.addr: 120 m southwest of Daiyi Zhaozhi in Menghun Town

spots.name: Menghai First Sacred Spring
spots.desc: A traditional Dai Buddhist temple，the temple’s name comes from a local legend, which says that the spring was created when the Buddha struck the ground with his staff to provide water for local residents. The site was therefore named First Sacred Spring. Local people often come here to collect water before major community events as a form of blessing.
spots.addr: 153 m south of No. 10 Xiangshan Xinying Lane

spots.name: Mengjinglai Scenic Area
spots.desc: A well-maintained Dai village with more than 200 households still living on site. The village retains traditional stilted Dai houses, wells, and temples, and daily life remains active. Residents continue traditional activities such as sugar making, weaving, and farming, offering insight into everyday Dai life. The village lies close to the China–Myanmar border, and visitors can view the opposite…
spots.addr: in Mengjinglai, Daluo Town

spots.name: One Tree Forest Scenic Area
spots.desc: The site is known for a 400–500-year-old banyan tree so large that it resembles an entire forest, which gives the area its name. The scenic area also includes a fruit orchard where visitors can pick fruit.
spots.addr: Daluo Town

spots.name: Bulang Mountain
spots.desc: Bulang Mountain is a tea-growing region in Menghai County, primarily planted with large-leaf tea varieties. Teas from this area are commonly noted for pronounced bitterness and a strong astringent character, followed by a fast and persistent returning sweetness (huigan). The liquor is typically intense, with a heavy body and layered aromas often described as floral and honey-like.

spots.name: Nannuo Mountain
spots.desc: Nannuo Mountain is a major tea-growing area in Menghai County, dominated by medium-leaf tea varieties. Teas from this area typically produce a darker liquor with a relatively balanced profile, combining mild bitterness, light astringency, and gentle sweetness. The overall mouthfeel is often described as smooth and even, with moderate honey-like aromas.

spots.name: Bada Mountain
spots.desc: Bada Mountain is known for its large-leaf tea varieties and long history of tea cultivation. Teas from this area are generally full-bodied, with a deep-colored liquor and noticeable bitterness that develops early and lingers. Astringency is present, while returning sweetness appears more gradually. The overall character is often described as strong and distinctly mountainous.
spots.addr: Bada Mountain Area

spots.name: Manlei Pagoda
spots.desc: Manlei Pagoda is a traditional Buddhist stupa located near Manlei Village in Menghai County. The site reflects local Dai Buddhist architectural styles and serves as a place of religious significance for nearby communities. The pagoda is typically visited together with surrounding villages and rural landscapes, offering insight into local religious practices and village life.

spots.name: Lost Buddhist Kingdom
spots.desc: The Lost Buddhist Kingdom refers to a group of culturally significant Buddhist sites and village landscapes in the Menghai area, associated with the historical spread of Theravada Buddhism in Xishuangbanna. The term is commonly used to describe lesser-known temples, stupas, and village settings that reflect traditional Dai Buddhist practices. Visits are typically informal and combined with…

spots.name: Manhe Great Buddha
spots.desc: Manhe Great Buddha is located in Manhe Village, accessible by taxi or private vehicle from Menghai town. Public transportation is limited, and most visitors combine the visit with nearby villages or religious sites.

spots.name: Bulang Mountain Tea Plantation
spots.desc: A renowned tea-growing area where ancient tea trees and terraced tea gardens create breathtaking scenery.

spots.name: Yuechun Hot Springs
spots.desc: The outdoor hot spring facility offers indoor saunas, hot stone therapy, and massage services. Drinks and full meals are available on site.Suitable for relaxation after travel.
spots.addr: Inside Mengbala International Tourist Resort, Manxing Lake area, along G219 National Highway

spots.name: Menghai Tea Factory
spots.desc: The home of the famous “Dayi Tea” brand, where you can tour the factory and purchase authentic tea products.

spots.name: Jiaming Tea Market
spots.desc: One of the most famous tea markets in Menghai, rated 4.3 stars. It gathers numerous tea merchants, ensuring the quality of the tea, making it a top choice for many seasoned tea drinkers. The market is clean and tidy, perfect for leisurely browsing, the vendors offer excellent service, and you can learn a great deal about tea.
spots.addr: It is about 100 meters west of the intersection of Xijing Road and Nanhai Road (1.7 kilometers from the center of Menghai)

spots.name: Guhua Roast Chicken
spots.desc: Menghai roast chicken is a representative dish of Dai cuisine and is recognized as local intangible cultural heritage. The restaurant’s signature items include roast chicken, chicken tofu, and pineapple rice, all prepared using traditional local methods.
spots.addr: No. 105 Manhe Village, next to the Big Buddha Temple

spots.name: Wild Mushroom Steam Hot Pot
spots.desc: This restaurant specializes in steam hot pot made with dozens of seasonal wild mushrooms, simmered with chicken or cured pork ribs for a light and aromatic broth. A house specialty is boletus rice, cooked with wild mushrooms and well suited as a main dish alongside the hot pot.
spots.addr: Shop 4–6, Hongyu Jinwan Residential Area

spots.name: Changyou Beef Soup Hot Pot
spots.desc: This local restaurant is known for clay pot–stewed yellow beef and sour radish goose, served with the house-made dipping sauce. Steamed rice is provided free of charge.
spots.addr: Room 207, 2nd Floor, Building 14, Phase 1, Shuijie Residential Area

spots.name: Xiaomantou Private Kitchen
spots.desc: A casual, locally popular eatery serving rice bowls and fried noodles in various flavors. Portions are generous, prices are affordable, and the service is fast, similar to a quick-meal restaurant.
spots.addr: 100 m northeast of Xiangshan Community (Old Street East)

spots.name: Grandma Yang's Braised Goose (Menghai Branch)
spots.desc: This restaurant is ranked #1 on the Menghai County food review list, with a score of 4.9. Their signature braised goose is incredibly fragrant as soon as it's served. The goose meat is tender and flavorful after being braised, and the broth is rich, savory, spicy, and flavorful, offering a complex and satisfying experience. The owner and staff are exceptionally friendly and even thoughtfully…
spots.addr: Zuijiangyue Beef Hot Pot, No. 23, Building 11, No. 223, Jingguan Road

spots.name: Sichuan-style Fragrant Beef Ribs Self-service BBQ
spots.local: 川蜀香牛肋条自助烤肉
spots.desc: Ranked #1 on the best-selling food list in Menghai County, this restaurant specializes in all-you-can-eat freshly sliced ​​beef ribs. The hot pot broth is authentically Sichuan and Chongqing style, and the ingredients are fresh and plentiful; the Sichuan peppercorn tripe is highly recommended. The restaurant is clean and hygienic, with ample air conditioning, and there are no time restrictions…
spots.addr: Second floor next to Yunshang Siji Hotel, Liming Road, Menghai Town (860 meters from the center of Menghai County)

spots.name: Longyuan Dry Pot Beef Restaurant
spots.desc: Ranked 4th on the Menghai County Food Popularity List, this restaurant offers a variety of options including clear broth hot pot, spicy stir-fry, and dry pot. Their signature pure oil dry pot beef is perfectly seasoned, with a savory and delicious flavor. The portion is generous; two or three people can't finish it. The owner is friendly and will even give you free cola, making it suitable for…
spots.addr: Chun Chao Shang Yuan, No. 4 Chaxiang Road, Menghai Town

spots.name: Niu Yiguo Fresh Beef Broth Hot Pot
spots.local: 牛一锅鲜牛肉清汤火锅
spots.desc: Located on a scenic riverside, this restaurant specializes in fresh beef hot pot cooked in a clear broth. The beef is fresh, delicious, tender, and juicy, and the clear broth preserves its pure flavor. Vegetables are self-service and fresh, and the hospitable owner even offers complimentary cold beef salad and finger-sized corn.
spots.addr: 60 meters northwest of the intersection of Qicai Avenue and Xiangshan Road (690 meters from the center of Menghai County)

spots.name: Guizhou-style roasted pepper beef shopkeeper
spots.desc: Specializing in roasted chili beef, all the beef dishes are very flavorful, with a tangy and spicy taste that's incredibly appetizing and perfect with rice. The portions are generous, the beef is tender, and it's great value for money. The owner is friendly and the food is served quickly, making it a great place to experience Guizhou cuisine.
spots.addr: No. 18, Building 11, Forbes Street (1.1 km from the center of Menghai County)

spots.name: Tea Countryside Restaurant, Menghai
spots.desc: This ethnic-style restaurant incorporates local Menghai tea elements and boasts a beautiful ambiance. Each private room has its own restroom and self-service tea station. The dishes are fresh, the kitchen is open, and the waiters are dressed in distinctive ethnic costumes. Banquets can be arranged, and private rooms are also available.
spots.addr: 2nd Floor, Building S2-5, Phase I, Shahe Town Water Street, Jingnan Community, Menghai Town

spots.name: Menghai Tea Factory
spots.desc: One of the most famous producers of pu'erh tea in China. The Menghai Tea Factory pioneered the accelerated fermentation technique in the 1970s, which has become the standard method of producing pe'erh in modern times.

spots.name: Xiangzi Tea Shop
spots.desc: A tea shop focusing on milk tea and drinks inspired by local flavors. Popular items include butter brown sugar Pu’er tea, tamarind plum tea, and jasmine milk tea.
spots.addr: Shop C-1-07, No. 2 Jingyang Road

spots.name: Atut Coffee Plantation
spots.desc: A coffee shop with a relaxed, artsy atmosphere. It offers pour-over coffee with different flavor profiles, American-style coffee, and tea drinks. A range of coffee beans is also available for purchase. Suitable for spending a quiet afternoon.
spots.addr: Unit A6-1-18, Building A6, No. 400 Jingguan Road

spots.name: Iton Juice · Chiang Mai Fruit Drinks
spots.desc: A juice and dessert shop offering fruit teas and ice cream made with seasonal fruits and edible flowers. A specialty is the seasonal honey-flower yogurt ice cream.
spots.addr: Shop C-1-29, Ground Floor, Building C, Old Square

spots.name: Yizhan Bar
spots.desc: A quiet bar with a private and relaxed atmosphere. Live singers may perform after 22:00 on some evenings. The bar serves beer, simple meals, and fruit platters.
spots.addr: 24 m from Guowei Hotel

spots.name: Kao Tan BBQ Bar
spots.desc: A lively bar combining barbecue and drinks. The menu includes grilled skewers and a range of fruit-flavored beers. The atmosphere is social and energetic. Games are held on Friday evenings, with prizes such as beer, snacks.Suitable for visitors who prefer a lively nightlife setting.
spots.addr: 41 Manhe Road

spots.name: Elephant Tea Shop (Menghai Branch)
spots.desc: This is a local brand that ranks third on the best-selling beverage list in Menghai County, specializing in drinks made with fresh Yunnan fruits. Their signature avocado yogurt with almonds has a rich, creamy flavor; the popping boba bursts in your mouth with a sweet and fragrant taste, paired with a refreshing avocado flavor—perfect for those on a diet. The store also offers Yunnan olive fruit…
spots.addr: Shop C-1-07, No. 2 Jingyang Road, Menghai Town

spots.name: Madder Coffee
spots.desc: Ranked 3rd on the Xishuangbanna coffee shop popularity list, this coffee is rich and flavorful with a complex and layered taste. The quiet and comfortable environment, with its simple yet modern decor, is perfect for afternoon tea with friends or taking photos. An Americano costs only 9 yuan, offering excellent value for money, making it one of the most recommended coffee shops by locals.
spots.addr: 200 meters north of the intersection of Yulin Avenue and Jingguan Road

It's an ideal place to experience a blend of tradition and modernity, where you…
spots.addr: No. 83 Manxing Road, Menghai Memory Intangible Cultural Heritage Village

spots.name: Luckin Coffee (Menghai Fozhao Street Store)

Their Orange C Americano perfectly blends sweet and sour flavors with the aroma of coffee, while their coconut drinks are rich in coconut flavor and include popping boba for added texture. Ordering via their app is convenient, making it ideal for quick purchases and takeout.
spots.addr: Shop A113-1, Foshuang Road, Fohai Commercial Street

spots.name: Jinuo Mountain Tropical Rainforest Scenic Area
spots.desc: Ranked #1 on Xishuangbanna's list of must-see natural landscapes, this natural oxygen bar boasts over 98% forest coverage. Its biggest highlight is the opportunity to experience the authentic Jinuo ethnic culture through rainforest treks led by local Jinuo guides. The trekking routes are well-designed, ranging from gentle forest paths to more challenging sections requiring hands and feet. Along…

Visitors can experience a 6-kilometer rainforest waterway trek, including fun activities like fetching water from vines and banana leaves, and even make their own Dai-style barbecue, experiencing the most authentic rainforest life.

spots.name: The Town God Temple
spots.desc: A Daoist temple dedicated to Guanyin, the goddess of mercy. Authentic worship still goes on, but like most temples in tourist destinations, it's quite exploited.

spots.name: Longyzhou Tower
spots.desc: Longyou Tower, also called Longzhou Pagoda or Wenfeng Pagoda, is a historic brick pagoda in the northeastern part of Longyou County. It was rebuilt in 1788 during the Qing dynasty. The tower has six sides and seven floors, and it is about 26.13 meters high. It is located near Longyou Park and is an example of traditional Chinese architecture.
spots.addr: Northeastern part of Longyou County, Quzhou, Zhejiang, China

spots.name: Huzhen Sarira Pagoda
spots.desc: Huzhen Sarira Pagoda is an ancient brick pagoda in Huzhen Town. It was rebuilt in 1058 during the Northern Song dynasty. The pagoda has six sides and seven floors and is about 27.31 meters high. It is an important example of Song dynasty architecture and was listed as a Major Historical and Cultural Site Protected at the National Level in 2001.
spots.addr: Tongji Street, Huzhen Town, Longyou County, Quzhou, Zhejiang, China

spots.name: Longyou Residential Court
spots.desc: Longyou Residential Court is located on Jiming Mountain in Longyou County, Zhejiang Province. It has many traditional houses from the Ming and Qing dynasties. These old buildings were moved from different places in Longyou and rebuilt here. Visitors can see traditional Chinese buildings, wood carvings and stone carvings, and learn about the history and culture of Longyou.
spots.addr: No. 46, Baota Road, Donghua Subdistrict, Longyou County, Quzhou, Zhejiang, China

spots.name: Simatai Great Wall (East Section)
spots.desc: The only open section of Simatai, comprising through . Tower 8 (known as the White Tower) sits perched atop a precipitous cliff ridge and offers sweeping views across the valley and Mandarin Duck Lake Reservoir. Tower 10 marks the boundary of the accessible public path.
spots.price: ¥40 (wall only); combo ticket with Beijing WTown ¥170
spots.addr: Simatai Village, Gubeikou Town, Miyun District

spots.name: Simatai Night Wall Tour
spots.desc: Simatai is the only section of the Great Wall illuminated at night. Handheld lanterns are available to carry along the walkway between Towers 5 and 6. The sight of the illuminated ridge winding across the dark peaks is one of the destination's primary highlights.
spots.addr: Simatai Cable Car Station

spots.name: Eight Banners Guild Hall
spots.desc: Showcases the military history and daily life of the Eight Banners (Baqi), the elite Manchu military system stationed at the Gubeikou border pass during the Qing dynasty to defend the capital. Exhibits include Qing battle banners, traditional armor, weaponry, historical barracks, and living quarters illustrating Manchu customs and cuisine. The central courtyard features a small martial arts drill…

Like Zhongshan Square, it may be interesting to some for the architecture alone, but this one has a much larger grassy area where kite flyers and fountains can be viewed (actually setting on the grass is frowned upon so don't expect to be able to throw a frisbee).…

To get to the side road either walk down the east side of Labour Park or take bus 2 or 5 from Qingniwa and get off at the Traditional…

It has been reported that you cannot get on the island and that the small speed boats and large sightseeing boats will only take you about 2 km away from the island. Others say you can get to the island by using the tourist ferries…

spots.name: Wishing Star Park

spots.name: City God Temple
spots.desc: The area around the Old City God Temple and the Yuyuan Gardens has become a large commercial hub, with many restored historical buildings as well as new buildings in a somewhat traditional style. Take photos, shop for souvenirs, and enjoy the many restaurants and eateries. Enjoy an illuminated diorama or other forms of 19th century street side entertainment. Come after 6:30PM when the lights show…

spots.name: Fuyou Antique Market
spots.desc: One of several multi-storey markets near Yuyuan metro station, at the northern end of the Old City - shop here for souvenirs, craft both modern and antique, as well as clothes and toys. Antiques are mainly in the lower basement floor of one of the buildings.

spots.name: Shiliupu Fabric Market
spots.desc: A warren of tailor shops offering custom made clothes, from tuxedoes to dress shirts to fake designer jackets and qipao, the traditional Chinese dress with a slit up the thigh. The prices are cheap but expect a lot tinkering afterward as your tailor will not be able to remake something as you like unless you tell her exactly what you want. The tailoring itself is average. Bargain hard and be…

spots.name: Nanxiang Steamed Bun Restaurant
spots.desc: Founded in 1900, this is the best-known restaurant specializing in small soup-filled buns called Xiaolongbao (also commonly referred to as "soup dumplings"), a characteristic Shanghai snack. This restaurant is popular for take-away and sit-down. The sit-down section (up the stairs) has a range of options - from the cheapest first floor dining room where you sit elbow-to-elbow with other patrons…

spots.name: Ningbo Dumpling Shop
spots.desc: Another historic restaurant specializing in Ningbo-style Tangyuan ("rice dough balls" or, confusingly, also "soup dumplings"), another popular snack. This restaurant offers Tangyuan with fillings found almost nowhere else, both sweet and savoury. A separate counter offers a range of Shanghainese small dishes.

spots.name: Mid-Lake Pavilion Teahouse
spots.desc: In the Yuyuan Gardens and reached by a 9-legged zigzag path to stop evil spirits. One of the most famous tea houses in all of China. A glass (not a pot) of your tea of choice is ¥20-25 downstairs and ¥40-55 upstairs — upstairs you'll get nice views, respite from the crowds, free snacks and even a souvenir or two. Pressure-free.

spots.name: Kezhi Yuan
spots.desc: Garden at the northern edge of the old district, on Xijing Street. The name Kezhi is made up of the characters 课 (kè) which means "to learn" and 植 (zhí) which means "to plant". It consists of three parts - the main hall, the garden and an artificial hill area. The most iconic landmark of the gardens is a five story building with a pavilion on its roof - the tallest structure in old Zhujiajiao.…

spots.name: Wooden Puzzles
spots.desc: They are sold at a shop on the left bank of the canal as you enter. Many of the puzzles with interlocking solid parts were devised by the ancient carpenter-puzzlemaker Luban (c. 500 BCE). Has a wide diversity of puzzles, mostly made in the famous Yunhe region in Zheijiang.

spots.name: Zher

Drinks and snacks are served outside under the willow trees during the spring and summer months. During the colder parts of the year it's better to sit in his newly renovated house, with psychedelically painted floors, comfortable armchairs and a film projector. The music follows the…

Located at the northern foot of Tianmu Mountain in Zhejiang Province, Anji County is located in Tianhuangping, nearly kilometers above sea level, surrounded by green bamboo and surrounded by mountains. Relying on the Tianhuangping pumped storage power Station, which is the first in Asia and the second in the world, it combines the majestic…

spots.name: Longyou Sponge Cake
spots.desc: A soft and slightly sweet steamed rice cake. It is one of the well-known traditional foods of Longyou and is often eaten as a snack or breakfast.

spots.name: Longyou Scallion Cake
spots.desc: A crispy local snack made with dough, scallions and meat. It is usually served hot and is popular as a street food.

spots.name: Longyou Steamed Bun
spots.desc: A traditional rice-flour food from Longyou. It is commonly made for festivals, family celebrations and traditional ceremonies.

spots.name: Longyou Rice Noodles
spots.desc: Thin rice noodles that are commonly used in local dishes and soups.

spots.name: Three Heads and One Palm
spots.desc: A spicy local dish from the Quzhou area. It includes duck head, rabbit head, fish head and duck feet, and is usually served with a spicy sauce.

spots.name: Longyou Fermented Bean Curd Snack
spots.desc: A traditional local food made with rice flour, dried pumpkin and spicy ingredients. It can be eaten as a snack or served with rice.

spots.name: Land Rover Experience Huzhou
spots.desc: Next to the Naked Retreats resort, Land Rover have an official experience centre where you go off road and see how far you can push a four wheel drive Land Rover. You will also see some of the remoter scenery of Moganshan mountains. Not particularly cheap, but an interesting experience nevertheless.
spots.price: ¥300 pp for tour, ¥2,000 for own drive
spots.addr: Shangxiazhuang Village, Paitou Town, Deqing County

spots.name: Moganshan Lodge
spots.desc: In town has helpful service, a nice patio, and can give you advice on things to do and where to stay.

spots.name: Goldfish mother Moganshan Mountain- Mountain restaurant
spots.desc: Mogan Mountain network red restaurant, mountain spring bamboo forest soil chicken soup is light and delicious, the meat is fresh and tender, hand-made old tofu is also very delicious, Taihu radish braised ox tendon is also very delicious.

spots.name: Sui Pagoda
spots.desc: A 9-storey hexagonal brick pagoda built in the Sui dynasty, this is 59.4m high and derelict. It's one of the oldest surviving brick pagodas in China. It used to have wooden roof structures, but these burned off in a catastrophic fire, leaving behind holes and turning the bricks yellow-orange. Part of the Guoqing scenic area.

spots.name: Shiliang Scenic Area
spots.desc: A trail winds through valleys and canyons past several waterfalls, temples, and a large rock that has been carved to look like a signature stamp. Most visitors walk from the lower entrance to the .

spots.name: Small Copper Teapot Waterfall
spots.desc: Part of the Shiliang Scenic Area. The waterfall falls through an orange-stained granite bowl in the cliff face, giving it its name. The cliffs facing each other above the top of the waterfall are claimed to resemble two apes drinking alcohol. A large boulder below the falls can be climbed for a better view, and there is a teahouse nearby.

spots.name: Sword-Tonging Spring
spots.desc: Part of the Shiliang Scenic Area, just below the upper entrance. This waterfall is over 40m high, and largely hidden from most angles because it occupies the sides of a narrow canyon which makes an abrupt turn just downstream of the falls. A small viewing pagoda next to the cliff face allows you to see it.

spots.name: Qiongtai Fairy Valley Scenic Area
spots.desc: Spectacular rocky granite valley with a reservoir and a waterfall. Most people walk from the lower entrance to the . Some sections of the trail are concrete walkways attached to the sides of cliffs, and a few sections of an older, more adventurous trail survive, including old arch bridges and access to a three-sided pagoda via stairs made of rebar.

spots.name: A-Thousand-Feet Waterfall
spots.desc: Part of Qiongtai Fairy Valley Scenic Area. Two-stage waterfall into a lovely pool, deep in the gorge.

spots.name: Huading Scenic Area
spots.local: 华顶景区, 华顶国家森林公园, Huading National Forest Park
spots.desc: This area contains temples and separate temple buildings, tea plantations, ancient rhododendron and azalea forests, ponds with metasequoia growing out of them, fake thatched-roof cottages, and an international rhododendron park. It gets fewer visitors than most of the other areas (except perhaps in spring for the rhododendrons), and some of the tourist infrastructure is not actively used. The…

spots.name: Chicheng Scenic Area
spots.desc: A large hill of conglomerate, with cliffs and caves. Dotted with temples and monasteries, with a large pagoda on top. As of November 2018, about half of it is closed while they install plumbing.

spots.name: Ji Gong Temple
spots.desc: Inside Chicheng scenic area. A major monastery associated with the monk Ji Gong.

spots.name: Ji Gong's Former Residence
spots.desc: Former home of Ji Gong, a Chan Buddhist monk in the 1100s (Southern Song dynasty). He purportedly possessed supernatural powers, which he used to help the poor and stand up to injustice. However, he was also known for his wild and eccentric behaviour, and for violating Buddhist monastic rules by consuming alcohol and meat. By the time of his death, Ji Gong had become a folk hero in Chinese…

spots.name: Tiantai Greentown Ski Resort
spots.desc: Shiliang town has a ski resort, open from late December to late February. It also has inner tube rides, snowmobiling, cross-country skiing, and other winter activities, ski rental, and a ski school.
spots.price: ¥200-260 per hour or per evening, higher prices on weekends and holidays.

spots.name: Lingfeng Scenic Area
spots.desc: This large zone is an easy walk from the town, and is centred around a peak split in half by the vertical . The floor of the cave slopes steeply upward, and is occupied by the 9-storey Guanyin Temple. The top level of the temple has hundreds of reflective golden statues sparkling in the rock walls. Around the corner to the north is Beidou Cave (北斗洞), with another large temple inside it. The…

spots.name: Fangdong/Jingtianhu Scenic Area
spots.desc: This zone features spectacular rocks and cliffs, a suspension bridge, and a walkway carved into a cliff face high above the valley. At the western end, it can be accessed via a , although this end is also accessible by road. There are trails up to the east end of the cliff section. Across a small valley to the west of this zone is a large peak claimed to resemble Guanyin sitting on a lotus throne.

spots.name: Lingyan Scenic Area
spots.desc: This zone contains Small Dragon Waterfall (小龙湫 Xiaolongqiu), which is not quite as large as the Big Dragon Waterfall. A glass walkway attached to the cliff goes behind the falls to access a valley of more spectacular rocks and cliffs. In the valley below the waterfall, there are several small caves, a temple, more rocks, and an afternoon highwire act.

spots.name: Yanhu Scenic Area
spots.desc: This large zone has several spectacular waterfalls, hiking options, the lake after which the park is named, and a small temple in a cave. It's also awkward to reach, and only half-heartedly developed for tourism. Few tourists visit it. Some park maps show the trail network from this zone connecting to Shimen (石门景点) to the east, but this needs to be verified. After a junction in a small town, the…

spots.name: Jingming Valley Scenic Area
spots.desc: The Jingming valley contains several thin waterfalls, pools, cliffs, and peaks that are thought to resemble things (like a tiger turning its head). Many minor viewing platforms, secondary trails, teahouses, etc. have been closed, likely for safety reasons. It is possible to return to the bottom of the valley via a very long stone slide, which costs roughly as much as admission to the valley…

spots.name: Xianqiao Bridge Scenic Area
spots.desc: This zone centres on a natural bridge, but also has the usual rocks, caves, and cliffs.

spots.name: Shimen Scenic Spot
spots.desc: The name would suggest that this obscure scenic spot has a stone gate.

spots.name: Yongshun Dye House
spots.desc: Founded in the late Qing dynasty, this workshop showcases traditional Chinese textile dyeing. Large bolts of indigo and brightly colored patterned fabrics hang from tall drying racks in the open-air courtyard, making it a popular photo stop. Visitors can try hands-on DIY cloth-dyeing workshops for an extra fee.
spots.addr: Inside Beijing WTown

spots.name: Sima Distillery
spots.desc: A functioning traditional distillery producing local sorghum liquor (baijiu). Visitors can watch the fermentation, steaming, and distilling process inside the workshop, sample fresh spirits, and purchase ceramic jugs of liquor directly from the cellars.
spots.addr: Inside Beijing WTown

spots.name: Yang Wudi Ancestral Temple
spots.desc: A traditional shrine and museum honoring General Yang Ye and the legendary Yang Clan Warriors of the Northern Song dynasty, who guarded the border passes against northern invaders. Features carved memorial tablets, weapons displays, and statues of the warrior family.
spots.addr: Inside Beijing WTown

spots.name: Music Water Dance Show
spots.local: 望京楼音乐水舞秀与无人机孔明灯秀
spots.desc: A nighttime multimedia performance featuring dancing water fountains, fire bursts, and 3D projection mapping against the stone walls of the resort.
spots.hours: Nightly from 19:00 (shows run in 15–20 minute cycles; schedule posted daily)
spots.addr: Wangjinglou Square

spots.name: Fire and Light Show
spots.desc: Fire show along the river in combination with a light show on the pagoda atop the hill.

spots.name: Riyue Island Food Street
spots.desc: A cluster of open-air and counter-serve stalls selling regional street food. spots.name: Wulonggou Great Wall
