spots.name: Yellow River old riverway
spots.desc: During the 500 years from the second year of Jianyan in the Song Dynasty (1128) to the fifth year of Xianfeng in the Qing Dynasty (1855), the Yellow River formed three Yellow River channels in Caoxian County, Shandong Province, with great influence on the Southern Song Dynasty, Ming and Qing Dynasties and Jialu Dynasties.

spots.name: Shanxian mingjia mutton soup
spots.desc: Shanxian mutton soup, belongs to the southwest Shandong Heze city Han traditional name to eat, with its "color white like milk, water and fat blend, pure texture, fresh and not shanshan, fragrant and not greasy, rotten and not sticky" unique style, loaded into the Chinese name recipe, to soup into the band only Shanxian mutton soup, known as the first soup in China.

spots.name: Taierzhuang Ancient Town
spots.desc: The ancient town covers an area of about 2 km² and is divided into several functional areas. There are many attractions such as ancient bridges, streets, canals, etc. If you just want to visit, 3-4 hours is enough, but if you like to take a slow tour or take pictures, it may take longer. During the tour, it is worth staying for lunch. There are many specialties of Lunan in the ancient town, such…
spots.hours: Open all year round (last entry at 23:59)

spots.name: Taierzhuang Battle Memorial Hall
spots.desc: The Taierzhuang Battle Memorial Hall covers an area of ​​about 5,000 square meters and was established to commemorate the historical event of the Taierzhuang Battle. There are several exhibition halls in the memorial hall, which display the historical background of the Taierzhuang Battle, the course of the battle, and the heroic Chinese anti-Japanese war heroes.The Taierzhuang Battle Memorial…

spots.name: Shuanglong Lake Wetland Park
spots.desc: Shuanglong Lake Scenic Area is a tourist destination that integrates natural landscape and cultural history. It is famous for its unique wetland resources and charming lake and mountain scenery. The scenic area is named after two winding rivers that converge into a lake, like two dragons playing with a pearl. Shuanglong Lake Scenic Area has a vast wetland ecosystem, where the water is clear, the…

spots.name: Taierzhuang Canal National Wetland
spots.desc: Shandong Taierzhuang Grand Canal National Wetland Park is mainly composed of river wetlands such as the lower reaches of Taogou River, the lower reaches of Yicheng Shahe floodway, and the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal section between the two river mouths. The plane layout is an oblique "U" shape, surrounding the Taierzhuang urban area, and is a typical river wetland. The total planned area is…

spots.name: Li Family Courtyard
spots.desc: A store with good taste and color, located in a busy traffic area.

spots.name: Canal Fish House
spots.desc: Yunhe Fish Restaurant is a home-style restaurant in the ancient city of Taierzhuang. It is very busy. The fish is very tender and has no fishy smell. The spicy chicken with Taierzhuang characteristics is also very delicious and worth tasting.

spots.name: Dongwangfu Spicy Chicken
spots.desc: Authentic Shandong cuisine, the fish is very fresh and big, the spicy chicken is also delicious, there is a parking space at the door, it is worth a try.

spots.name: Xijiangyue Music Bar
spots.desc: This is a bar where you can drink and eat. The restaurant environment is good, clean and tidy.

spots.name: Dalian Han Tombs Museum
spots.desc: Displays items unearthed from several tombs in the area that date from the Han Dynasty.
spots.addr: Yingsha Road, Shagang Village, Yingchengzi Sub-district (营城子街道沙岗村营沙路)

spots.name: Golden Pebble Beach
spots.desc: Named after the unique rock formations of the area, is a tourist destination which has at its heart Dalian's best beach courtesy of specially imported sand. Surrounded by tourist attractions that could perhaps be best described as traps rather than attractions, it's the beach that's most likely to reward visitors. Swimming isn't too popular because of the temperature and cleanliness of the water…

spots.name: Battery Hill Park
spots.desc: A park in the centre of Dalian Development Area with four cannons dating back to Qing dynasty, and cherry blossom in spring.
spots.addr: main gate served by DDA bus routes 1, 4, 6, 8, 11; foot path opposite Kaifaqu metro station

spots.name: Deputy Lieutenant-General's Yamen
spots.local: 副都统衙门, 金州副都统衙门博物馆
spots.desc: It was built during the 19th century to serve the Deputy Lieutentant-General of Jinzhou. In 1900, the yamen was vacated when the Russians occupied the city. Later, during the Japanese occupation, the site was turned into a police station. It continued to be used as a police station until 1999. The buildings were then demolished and rebuilt according to the original design. The site is now a…
spots.addr: 255 Minzhu Street, Yongzheng Sub-district (拥政街道民主街255号)

spots.name: Guan Xiangying Memorial Hall
spots.desc: Guan Xiangying, who was born in Jinzhou, was a prominent figure in the Communist Party and the People's Liberation Army from the 1920s until his death in 1946. His achievements include playing a leadership role in the Long March and helping to establish the Hunan-Hubei-Sichuan-Guizhou Soviet. The memorial hall tells the story of his life and career. Entry is restricted to 2000 visitors per day.…
spots.addr: 173 Daguan Hamlet, Guanjia Village, Xiangying Sub-district (向应街道关家村大关屯173号)

spots.name: Museum of Mao Zedong Badges
spots.desc: Contains an impressive collection of badges bearing the image of Mao Zedong. Also displays statues and photos of Mao.
spots.addr: Golden Pebble Beach Culture Expo Square, 65 Golden Pebble Road (金石路65号金石滩文化博览广场内)

spots.name: Guanyin Temple
spots.desc: Arguably one of the most famous temples in Southern Liaoning. A Buddhist temple built in the Ming dynasty; very popular during Spring Festival and 16th March with a special event.
spots.price: Admission adults ¥20; children, senior citizens from 60 to 69 and students ¥10; senior citizens over 70 free

spots.name: Xiangshui Temple
spots.desc: One of the few truly ancient sites in and around Dalian, the Daoist Xiangshui Temple was first constructed during the Tang Dynasty around a thousand years ago, though much of the current temple stems from renovations during the Qing Dynasty. The temple is built around a large cavern, the waterfalls inside give the temple its name ("Water-sounds Temple") and is part of a wider network of temples…

spots.name: Dalian Modern Museum
spots.desc: This museum to the north of Xinghai Square contains a number of high quality, interactive exhibits on Dalian, both historical and current. It is well worth a visit for anyone even slightly interested in the city itself.
spots.addr: 10 Huizhan Road (会展路10号)

spots.name: Dalian Seashell Museum
spots.desc: Housed in a modern building shaped like a giant shell, the seashell museum contains a huge variety of shells and other examples of sea life. Though very specialized, the museum still makes for an interesting diversion.
spots.hours: April 27th to October 7th: 08:30-17:30, October 8th to April 26th: 09:00-16:30, closed from February 6th to February…
spots.addr: No. 2, Zone D, Xinghai Square (星海广场D区2号)

spots.name: Dalian Natural History Museum
spots.desc: Mainly focuses on marine life though it also includes a dinosaur fossil exhibit.
spots.hours: 09:00-16:30, no tickets sold after 15:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 40 Xicun Street, Heishijiao (黑石礁西村街40号)

spots.name: Sun Asia Ocean World
spots.local: 大连圣亚海洋世界, Shengya Ocean World
spots.desc: An oceanarium featuring numerous marine and polar animals. Not to be confused with its competitor, the Tiger Beach Ocean Park in Zhongshan District. Somewhat confusingly, 'Sun Asia Ocean World' may refer to either the park as a whole or only that section of the park that is focused on marine animals. The other major section of the park is the Sun Asia Polar World. Unlike the case at Tiger Beach…
spots.price: ¥110 to visit Ocean World, ¥80 to visit Polar World, ¥190 for a combo ticket which includes not only Ocean World and…
spots.addr: 8-6-608 Zhongshan Road (中山路608-6-8号)

spots.name: Xinghai Park
spots.desc: It consists of a 150,000-m² land garden and an 800-m-long arch-shaped beach, has high-quality greenery, and presents the atmosphere and artistic conception of the Vienna Royal Garden. A large swimming pool has been built in the west of the park, making it the largest summer paradise in Dalian. It is one of Dalian's oldest and largest coastal parks. It was built by the South Manchuria Railway…
spots.addr: 634 Zhongshan Road (中山路634号)

spots.name: Walking (hiking)
spots.desc: Small mountains near Heping Square and also along Huanghe Lu offering some impressive views of the city and sea.

spots.name: Xi'an Lu
spots.desc: This street is the largest shopping area outside the center and boasts a shopping complex (Roosevelt Center) on the western side of the junction with Huanghe Lu. There's also a large electronics center just north of the new shopping mall and a smaller one next to Carrefour. Several tailors offer suits or traditional Chinese silk dresses at really reasonable prices (tailoring lasts 5-6 days).

spots.name: I-55 Cafe
spots.desc: Closed for redecoration; location at Xinghai Sq open. A popular place for locals and expats alike enjoying coffee brewed by the cup and a popular weekend morning breakfast buffet (¥85). Try the bakery items and sandwiches. Has an outdoor deck that is lit up at night and free WiFi access. About 100 m from the coastline.

spots.name: Be For Time
spots.desc: Chain tea house, and unlike traditional ones, caters to a young crowd with modern furnishings and milkshakes alongside the usual varieties of green tea. This, combined with the ¥16 all you can drink deal, makes it very popular with students and decent place to spend a couple of hours.
spots.addr: various, incl. W of Huanghe and Xi'an Lu intersection

spots.name: Russian Street
spots.local: 俄羅斯風情街 Éluósī Chuíqíngjiē
spots.desc: One of the few places it's still possible to get a glimpse of Dalian's colonial past. Most of the old Russian and Japanese buildings were razed in the many bursts of redevelopment the city has seen over the years, but the old architecture is "preserved" in the sense many of the buildings along the road are actually modern facsimiles of old Russian buildings rather than the genuine article. The…
spots.addr: Across Shengli Bridge, NE of train station

spots.name: Dalian Art Museum
spots.local: 大连美术馆, formerly known as the Dalian Art Gallery 大连艺术展览馆
spots.desc: In a spectacular old Russian building dating from 1902, the museum contains a varied and changing selection of works from local artists, ranging from traditional Chinese styles to works of modern art. The museum also periodically hosts touring shows from prominent artists both Chinese and foreign.
spots.addr: 35 Shengli Street (胜利街35号)

spots.name: Zhongshan Park
spots.desc: Construction began during the Japanese occupation of Dalian. It is located in the eastern part of Shahekou District, with an area of 11,300 square meters. Before the founding of the People's Republic of China, there were two desolate hills in the east and west, called Liujiatun Hill. In order to commemorate the Japanese Prince Shotoku, the Japanese colonial authorities built the "Prince Shotoku…

spots.name: Dalian Forest Zoo
spots.local: 大连森林动物园 Dàlián Sēnlín Dòngwùyuán
spots.desc: A major attraction for Chinese tourists primarily because of its pandas (both red pandas and great pandas live in the zoo), although many other exotic species are also represented. The zoo is essentially split into two parts, with a walking section at the top of the hill and a safari area at the base near Fujiazhuang. The two sections are joined by a cableway and a foot path, with the pandas…
spots.price: The admission fee from April to October is ¥120, but from November to March, it is only ¥100. The fee includes tickets…
spots.addr: 60 Yingchun Road, Nashidao Street (南石道街迎春路60号)

spots.name: Brooklyn Bar and Restaurant
spots.desc: 2F is the main bar area with five tables and 3F has a larger seating area with table tennis table (1F is kitchen). Feature a movie night (Th) and quiz night (Su). Owner/manager is Western and has brought his bartending and kitchen skills for locals and expats to enjoy, featuring pizza and hamburgers with homemade buns. Clean spot with free WiFi.
spots.addr: 184 Bulao Jie (不老街184号)

spots.name: All's Well
spots.desc: Slightly cheaper coffee (including free refills of the coffee of the day) and all you can eat buffets at dinner time. Sell a lot of baked goods, namely cakes.
spots.addr: 13 Wuyi Lu (and others)

spots.name: Starbucks
spots.desc: The only location in the district, with free wi-fi for paying customers. To the dismay of customers, no restroom available but plenty within the attached shopping mall.
spots.addr: 291 Zhongshan Lu, Tower A Wanda Commercial Sq

spots.name: Labour Park
spots.desc: The largest park in Dalian containing a number of attractions, including a small aviary area, a few man made lakes and an amusement park (which, like the one in Xinghai Square, is overpriced and fairly uninteresting). Off season the park is free and can be a pleasant place to take a stroll, but it is probably not worth paying to get in during the holiday periods.
spots.price: ¥10-15 during holidays, free the rest of the time

spots.name: Tiger Beach Ocean Park
spots.local: 老虎滩海洋公园; Lǎohǔtān Hǎiyáng Gōngyuán
spots.desc: This tourist area is somewhat misnamed, as there really is not a beach to speak of. There are a number of tourist attractions, the most prominent of which is the Polar Aquarium. Other attractions include the Sea Creature Aquarium, the Coral Aquarium, the Bird Forest and the Happy Theatre. Though popular with tourists, the area, though pretty, is unlikely to hold the attention of more jaded…
spots.price: Apr 10-Oct 31: ¥198, Nov 1-Apr 9: ¥180 (includes all major attractions but does not include transport within the park)…
spots.addr: 9 Binhai Middle Road (滨海中路9号)

spots.name: Donghai Beach/Haizhiyun Park
spots.local: 东海 Dōnghǎi, 海之韵公园 Hǎizhīyùn Gōngyuán
spots.desc: Like Tiger Beach, Donghai Beach is not as much a beach as it is a cluster of tourist sights. There is a stretch of what could be called a beach but it is shingle rather than sand. The sights here are somewhat more interesting than at Tiger Beach, with some nice modern art sculptures and mock fossils along Binhai Road a little way up from the beach. This stretch of road also includes a section of…
spots.price: Admission is free. The sightseeing car costs ¥20 one-way or ¥30 return
spots.addr: Binhai Road North (滨海北路)

spots.name: Dalian Worker's Theatre
spots.desc: A theatre which specializes in local opera forms. Great for those interested in seeing the kind of opera more associated with north-eastern China.
spots.addr: 41 Puzhao Street (普照街41号)

spots.name: Friendship Centre
spots.desc: Lots of imported goods. Some may can be found elsewhere for less, but if you are looking for really exclusive products, both imported and domestically produced, this is the place to go. There is also a number of other high-end shops (Cartier, Gucci, Armani, etc.) and shopping areas east of here along Renmin Lu.
spots.addr: 8 Renmin Lu

spots.name: Qingniwaqiao Shopping Area
spots.desc: Host to a number of moderately expensive department stores, supermarkets and shopping centres. Designer clothing can be found in abundance here.

spots.name: Tianjin Street
spots.desc: Pedestrian street with a number of department stores, supermarkets and shopping centres. It also offers a large number of stalls, selling goods ranging from underwear to swords, that operate along the length of the road.

spots.name: Times Square
spots.desc: Dalian's most up-scale (international) stores are found here.

spots.name: Victory Square Shopping Centre
spots.desc: Hidden underneath the Square, this huge mall contains a large food court, tearooms, a video arcade and a bowling alley in addition to a massive number of small stalls selling a wide variety of goods. This can be a good place to come to get decent bargains however, it is confusingly laid out and maps are nowhere to be seen while the few signs there are, are in Chinese. Allow plenty of time when…

spots.name: Century City Food Court
spots.desc: Offers Chinese fare, some Japanese and some Korean. Mālàtàng (麻辣烫), a kind of soup served in a wide dish with various ingredients cooked inside the soup (the name literally means "hot, spicy and mouth numbing" but do not be put off by the name). Chili sauce (served in a side bowl along with sesame sauce) available. As with most mālàtàng places, to order you simply select the ingredients you wish…

spots.name: Cafe Copenhagen
spots.desc: The food, location and nice decor matched with a clean environment make this a popular place to grab a bite to eat or enjoy a drink, including a few types of beer on tap, made-to-order energy drinks, coffee creations and libations. With their excellent breads and breakfast foods served Danish style, it is perhaps the city's best place for a brunch without splurging at a 5-star hotel. The cafe has…
spots.price: Starters and salads ¥30-60, mains ¥50-120, pizzas serving 1-2 people ¥58-75, drinks ¥25-60
spots.addr: 125 Tianjin St

spots.name: Dongdouting
spots.desc: Dalian's proximity to South Korea and significant Korean population means there is a large number of both northern and southern Korean restaurants. Meat, seafood, and vegetables for barbecuing (most liberally marinated in spices) can be cooked on the table or by staff.
spots.addr: 65 Jiefang Jie (and other)

spots.name: Red Lotus Cantonese, Seafood and Dim Sum Restaurant
spots.desc: Authentic dim sum and the chef is excellent. Cantonese specialties and Dalianese seafood recipe also. 20 private rooms but better book in advance.
spots.addr: 123 Changjiang Lu

spots.name: Qing Dynasty Dumplings
spots.desc: Dumplings are a common staple in North China, and this Shenyang-based chain does them better than most. Wide variety of dumplings but the menu lacks English (but not photos). Try the sample plate, offering four different foods from various parts of China.
spots.addr: 5 Wuwu Lu

spots.name: Zhongshan Hotel Dim Sum, Indian and Russian Hot Pot Restaurants
spots.desc: The usual dim sum dishes are offered and in the same dining area as the Indian restaurant. The hotel also has a Russian hot pot and vegetarian restaurant.
spots.hours: Daily 24 hours for dim sum only
spots.addr: Jiefang Lu

spots.name: Ademain
spots.local: 阿都曼日本现代创作料理; ādōumàn Rìběn Xiàndài Chuàngzuò Liàolǐ
spots.desc: Offers a wide range of dishes, one of the cheaper Japanese places.
spots.addr: 8 Wuwu Lu

spots.name: Intermezzo Italian Restaurant
spots.desc: Authentic recipes. 5-star quality, good selection of affordable wine and grappa.

spots.name: Alice Bar
spots.desc: Near-naked ladies dancing on poles and house band singing mainly pop tunes. One pool table, lots of TVs.
spots.addr: Wenlin Jie

spots.name: Blossom Jazz
spots.desc: Live jazz sets throughout the evening offered by the house band. All the beer is imported, nearly all from Germany.
spots.addr: Kunming Jie

spots.name: Bobo's
spots.desc: A small pub with 2 rooms. The first, which contains the bar, has TVs and a dart board. Continuing to the back is a basement-like room with booths. The pub serves a variety of drinks, including Harbin beer starting at ¥10.

spots.name: Dave's Bar
spots.desc: Still a popular bar (sort of the first popular Western-themed bars) but has something of a seedy air nowadays. Small dance floor with DJs playing electronica and hip-hop most nights. Cheap local beer.

spots.name: Jazz Bar
spots.desc: Features a live band (sometimes playing jazz, other times pop songs). There is a large central area spanned by balconies and decorated in fake greenery. German draught beer is most popular.

spots.name: The Lounge
spots.desc: Classy hotel lounge with a very good resident jazz band who usually play during happy hour and after dinner hours. Champagne cocktails, draft beer and imported wines by the glass. Afternoon high tea features the best of the classicals recipes and some yummy creations.

spots.name: Paulaner Brauhaus
spots.local: 凯宾斯基饭店; Kǎibīnsījī Fàndiàn
spots.desc: One of the places to get a microbrew made on the spot. Live house band typically playing pop. Food available as well. Just outside the bar's entrance is a cigar hut.
spots.addr: 92 Jiefang Lu

spots.name: Stroller's
spots.desc: Diverse offerings of bottled beers, with a few on tap. TVs, music, and food give it a restaurant feel but due to the large number of offerings, especially bottled beer, it's a good spot to hunker down and have a few. Happy Hour specials. Has a non-smoking section although it is not a real big establishment. Have a tradition of asking each customer, particularly non-Chinese, their first name and…

spots.name: All's Well Coffee
spots.desc: Also sell cakes and has a buffet with pizza, soups, Chinese cuisine, fruit, dessert, and Tsingtao.

spots.name: Amici
spots.desc: Menu has pizzas, sandwiches and other food. Also serves alcoholic beverages and has free wi-fi for paying customers.
spots.addr: 1F New World Department Store Tianjin Jie, another at Renmin Lu and Yimin Jie

spots.name: Cafe and Deli
spots.desc: Branded Jerome Chocolates, pastries, Haagen Dasz ice cream parlor and on Friday evenings, wine and pizza parties. Bakery items half-price after 18:00. Kids corner for mommies club.

spots.name: SPR Coffee
spots.desc: Make their coffee by the cup, also serve juice drinks and beer. Has food, but drinks are what is known. This location has 2 floors, has high ceilings and a piano.
spots.addr: At least one in the district, including 211-1 Youhao Lu

spots.name: Guazhou County Museum
spots.desc: A small museum about the history and culture of Guazhou County.
spots.addr: 52 Xianfu Street, Yuanquan Town (渊泉镇县府街52号)

spots.name: Memorial to the Red Western Route Army and the Battle of Anxi
spots.local: 红西路军安西战役纪念馆
spots.desc: Commemorates the Battle of Anxi, a battle that took place in Guazhou in 1937 during the Long March, part of the Chinese Civil War.
spots.addr: Gongyuan Street, Yuanquan Town (渊泉镇公园街)

spots.name: Museum of Xuanzang's Pilgrimage
spots.desc: A museum about Xuanzang, a celebrated Buddhist monk from Henan Province who went on a pilgrimage to India in the 7th century and brought back many sacred Buddhist scriptures, which he translated into Chinese, winning the admiration of Emperor Taizong. Xuanzang's journey to India was the main inspiration for Journey to the West, a famous Ming Dynasty novel.
spots.addr: Yuanquan Street, Yuanquan Town (渊泉镇渊泉街)

spots.name: Zhang Zhi Park
spots.desc: The park is officially known as the Cultural Production Park of the Cursive Calligraphy Master's Hometown (草圣故里文化产业园景区) but colloqiually known as Zhang Zhi Park. It is dedicated to Zhang Zhi, a second-century calligrapher who is famous for perfecting the cursive style of Chinese calligraphy. There is a museum about Zhang Zhi in the middle of the park.
spots.addr: 45 Yuanquan Street, Yuanquan Town (渊泉镇渊泉街45号)

spots.name: Son of the Earth
spots.desc: A 15-meter-long sculpture of a sleeping baby created by artist Dong Shubing in 2016.

spots.name: Pochengzi City Ruins
spots.desc: Founded during the Han Dynasty, Pochengzi, also known as Changlecheng (or Changle Town) was the county seat of the now defunct county of Changle. It was abandoned sometime during the Tang Dynasty.
spots.addr: Pochengzi Village, Tashi Township (踏实乡破城子村)

spots.name: Qiaowan City Ruins
spots.desc: The city was founded in 1732 and was gradually abandoned after being attacked by Muslim rebels in 1862. There is a small archaeological museum at the site.
spots.addr: National Highway 312, Hedong Township (河东乡312国道)

spots.name: Li Family Dragon Palace
spots.desc: A complex of halls and temples dedicated to the veneration of the ancestors of the Li family, including Li Shimin, the second emperor of the Tang Dynasty who is also known as Emperor Taizong.
spots.addr: Yixin Village, Gongchang Town (巩昌镇一心村)

spots.name: Longxi County Museum
spots.desc: The museum provides a comprehensive introduction to the history of the county and has a special exhibition on the Li Family.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:30, no entry after 17:00, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: East Side of Li Family Dragon Palace Square, Gongchang Town (巩昌镇李家龙宫广场东侧)

spots.name: Weiyuan Tower
spots.desc: A defensive structure that was built over 950 years ago during the Northern Song Dynasty. It was rebuilt and expanded in the first year of the Ming Dynasty (1368).
spots.addr: 78 Xida Street, Gongchang Town (巩昌镇西大街78号)

spots.name: Minle rapeflower fields
spots.desc: South of town, just before the highway enters the mountains, a large section of the fields is set up for tourism. There are viewing platforms, trails, horses, and well-decorated yaks, and it is possible to climb up a small ridge to get a better view over the expansive patchwork of fields. Admission was free in July 2018, but that may change.

spots.name: Yellow River Scenic Area (黄河大桥风景区)
spots.desc: Scenic spot on the Yellow River. Easy to get to by taxi. Hitchhiking back to town is no problem.

spots.name: Qing Dynasty Walls
spots.desc: Some old city walls dating from the Qing Dynasty remain in Guide. They are out in the open and are refreshingly devoid of an entrance fee or any tourist infrastructure.

spots.name: Yuhang Pavilion
spots.desc: Possibly the old city of Guide or a temple, it's surrounded by the aforementioned Qing dynasty walls.
spots.addr: North Street

spots.name: Rent bikes and cycle around
spots.desc: Explore this city and enjoy being stared at, should be feasible to see most of the place in a day.

spots.name: Four Summons Ceremonies
spots.desc: Four times annually with large visits of pilgrims, sunning a large portrait of Buddha, butter sculpture shows and Buddhist philosophy debates (provided you speak Tibetan).

spots.name: Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Yongan Site
spots.local: 太平天国在永安活动旧址，太平天国开国封王地
spots.desc: The centrepiece of the site is the reconstructed Wu Temple (武庙), a temple dedicated to Guan Yu, a 2nd century general. When the forces of the Taiping Rebellion occupied the city, they desecrated the temple and made it their headquarters. There is a museum about the Taiping Rebellion behind the temple. Among the artefacts at the museum are a substantial collection of weapons and the skulls of two…
spots.hours: Tue to Fri: 08:00-12:00, 15:00-18:00. Weekends: 09:00-16:00. Closed on Mon
spots.addr: 32 Minzhu Street (民主街32号)

spots.name: West Battery Park
spots.desc: The West Battery stands on a hill overlooking the town. It was one of four fortifications that were built by the Taiping army to defend their position in Mengshan. The battery has been restored and equipped with replica cannons (which actually look rather different from the originals) and there is a statue of Xiao Chaogui, the West King of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom. Also in the park is a…
spots.addr: Intersection of Meijiang North Road and Meijiang Middle Road (湄江北路与湄江中路交叉口)

spots.name: East Battery Ruins
spots.desc: In marked contrast to the West Battery, the East Battery has been largely neglected and has basically been allowed to rot and become covered in weeds. That being said, one could argue that due to the lack of any modern restoration work, the East Battery has a more authentic appearance.
spots.addr: 100 metres south of the intersection of Donghuan Road and Liaowang North Lane (东环路与僚望北巷交叉口南100米)

spots.name: Liang Yusheng Park
spots.desc: This park is dedicated to Liang Yusheng, one of the most famous wuxia writers of the 20th century, who was born in a village in Mengshan County. The park contains numerous statues and other monuments to remind visitors of Liang's legacy. Martial arts shows are performed daily at the park's Martial Arts Square. The shows typically depict scenes from some of Liang's best known novels. There is also…
spots.addr: 250 Tongwen Street (通文街250号)

spots.name: Yongan Temple
spots.desc: Mengshan's largest Buddhist temple. The first Yongan Temple was built during the reign of the Jiaqing Emperor (1796-1820), but demolished in the 1950s. The present structures were constructed in the 1980s.
spots.addr: 173 Shengli Street (胜利街173号)

spots.name: Old Banyan Tree Park
spots.desc: A small park containing a few old banyan trees. The oldest and most sacred tree is the Zhoutou Banyan (州头古榕), which is said to have been planted over 1000 years ago during the Song Dynasty.
spots.addr: Liantang Lane (莲塘巷)

spots.name: Longevity Bridge
spots.desc: Longevity Bridge (or Changshou Bridge) is a traditional-style covered bridge that dates from the early 19th century.

spots.name: Capri
spots.desc: One of the very few decent Western restaurants in Mengshan. The restaurant is well-decorated and has a good view of the river.
spots.addr: 14 Guangming Street (蒙山镇光明街14号)

spots.name: Chengyang Wind and Rain Bridge
spots.desc: Listed as one of the three famous ancient bridges in China. Built in 1912, this semi-permanent bridge has stone piers and wooden girders and pavilions connected by a tile-roofed corridor.

spots.name: Bird's Nest Stadium
spots.desc: A bullfighting arena with shows about the Dong minority in the evenings

spots.name: Moria Cafe
spots.desc: An amazing place if you want to have real coffee, pizza, steak, spaghetti and cakes. The staff were taught by an American then he sold to a local but it is genuine and still good. Near the Wind rain bridge are a few places but this joint is the best in the whole area. (3 days searching to no avail, clearer location might help)
spots.addr: Opposite Sanjiang city Drum Tower

spots.name: Crocodile Hill
spots.desc: This scenic spot is in the Volcanic Park in the west of South Bay. Crocodile Hill can be reached either by walking or by taking a shuttle bus leaving at the Volcanic Geological Museum (¥20/trip). Tricycle drivers, motor cycles and bicycles are not allowed to enter the Volcanic Park. The island's entrance ticket must be shown to enter Crocodile Hill. Crocodile Hill has a round walk partially…

spots.name: Shiluokou
spots.desc: Shiluokou is on the western coast of Weizhou Island. Its long sand beach, the clear water and its coral reefs made it the most famous beach on Weizhou. On its managed beach are deck chairs, cold beverages, seafood BBQ and water sports available.

spots.name: Multicolored/Colorful Beach
spots.desc: In low tide's sunrises this volcanic stone beach on the east coast of Weizhou Island offers a breathtaking view when the sun is dazzling reflecting on the wave cut wet stone surface.

spots.name: Catholic church in Shengtang Village
spots.desc: The Catholic church in the middle of Shengtang Village was built over a decade in 1853 by French missionaries. It is made of coral sedimentary rocks from the sea bottom and built in neo-Gothic style.
spots.addr: Shèngtáng

spots.name: Saint Maria Church
spots.desc: The Saint Maria Church is a small Gothic-style Catholic Church in Chengzai village. It is less famous than the Catholic church in Shengtang Village but still opens its doors for Sunday Mass.

spots.name: Sanpo Temple
spots.desc: Sanpo Temple in Weizhou's South Bay is also known as Tianhou Temple. After it collapsed due to landslides it was rebuilt a few years ago. The former temple was built in 1732 to chase away the evil and bring peace to the island. Local fisherman still come to the temple to pray for good luck, a good catch and a safe home coming from the sea.

spots.name: Coral Reefs
spots.desc: The sea around Weizhou Island is rich in corals. They can be seen in low tide periods, while diving or joining a tour with glass bottom boots in West Beach (Shiluokou).

spots.name: Xieyang Island
spots.desc: Xieyang Island is a smaller island 17 km to the southeast of Weizhou Island. Its total area is about 1.9 km². A small path leads from its north to its south. It is famous for its birdlife and peaceful atmosphere and home for a little more than 100 people. The passage from Weizhou to Xieyang is including backpassage between ¥750 to ¥1,200 a boat, which can be shared by up to 12 passengers.

spots.name: Banana Plantations
spots.desc: Beside seafood, bananas are the most important goods produced on Weizhou. Banana plantations can be found beside the roads all over the island. The very tastefully fresh small and sweet bananas just cost a few yuan for a kilo.

spots.name: Drippy Rock
spots.desc: So named for a set of cliffs that drip water long after a downpour. Also the location of some nice beaches, and some on-beach eateries.

spots.name: Having fun on the beaches
spots.desc: Weizhou offers some of the best (and emptiest) beaches in China. However, because they don't have lifeguards, children and people unable to swim should not play in the sea unattended!

spots.name: Diving
spots.desc: With instructor. All the material is provided. 30 minutes for around ¥130. Booking at your living place, in South Bay or at Shiluokou.

spots.name: Sailing
spots.desc: The Piggy Bar Hostel in South Bay offers attended sailing on a small sports sailer.

spots.name: Hiking
spots.desc: Exploring Weizhou Island by foot is fun. And because it is not very big, it's almost impossible to get lost.

spots.name: South Bay Seafood Market
spots.desc: The island's main marketplace for seafood, with the largest range and lowest prices. Pick your selection, take it home and cook it up – or pay a fee at a restaurant and have them cook it for you. Other grocery items can be purchased in the surrounding shops, which offer the largest range of products on the island.
spots.addr: South Bay Road

spots.name: ATM
spots.desc: Rural Agricultural Bank of China. This ATM does not accept international bank cards. China Unionpay only.
spots.addr: South Bay Road, close to the dockside of the market

spots.name: Bo'ao Forum
spots.local: Permanent Site of the Bo'ao Forum for Asia; 博鳌亚洲论坛永久会址
spots.desc: The site of an annual meeting of Asian heads of government and business leaders, which is a popular tourist attraction for Chinese tour groups. Of little interest to the average foreign tourist.

spots.name: China (Hainan) Museum of the South China Sea
spots.desc: Hainan's second largest publicly-owned museum. The first exhibition hall focuses on the historical basis for China's territorial claims in the South China Sea, and includes maps and documents that purportedly demonstrate that China has exercised sovereignty over the region for centuries. Another notable exhibition is a collection of artefacts that were recovered from the Huangguangjiao One, a…
spots.hours: 9AM-5PM, no entry after 4PM, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: Museum Road, Tanmen Town (潭门镇博物馆路)

spots.name: Boao Golf & Country Club
spots.desc: It is surrounded by mountains, river and ocean. The course is built totally upon the original landscape. The natural plant and surroundings have been kept unchanged.

spots.name: Aozhuang
spots.desc: One of Boao's best dining experiences is found not in a high-class restaurant but at a local seafood restaurant right on the beach near the town of Boao. The restaurant is an open air restaurant looking east towards the South China Sea. While the food is delicious, with superb local seafood and fresh vegetables, the biggest attraction is the location. To relax on a balmy evening over a cold beer…

spots.name: Fourth Patriarch Temple
spots.desc: Sizu Temple is an important holy place of Chinese Zen Buddhism. This is the place of practice and missionary work of the four ancestors of Zen Buddhism, which can be traced back to the Sui and Tang Dynasties. The temple is located in the beautiful mountains and forests, covered with clouds all year round, full of tranquility and sacred atmosphere. Here you can appreciate the birthplace of Chinese…
spots.addr: Sizu Temple Road

spots.name: 黄梅戏博物馆
spots.desc: Huangmei Opera Museum is a museum specializing in the art and culture of Huangmei Opera. The origin, development process and important figures of Huangmei Opera are recorded here. The museum displays a wealth of opera materials, costumes, musical instruments and video materials, which makes people immersed in the charm of this traditional opera art. Here you can enjoy the art of traditional opera…
spots.addr: No. 123 Huangmei Avenue

spots.name: Huangmei Silk
spots.desc: Huangmei silk is famous for its traditional handicraft production. The silk is soft, smooth and durable, and is widely used to make high-end clothing, scarves and bedding. This kind of silk is not only a practical product, but also carries the local handicraft culture. The silk is of excellent quality and exquisite in design. It is suitable as a gift and retains the traditional production…
spots.addr: Handicraft market

spots.name: Huangmei Tea
spots.desc: The green tea produced by Huangmei is famous for its fragrant fragrance and sweet aftertaste. It is hand-picked with high-quality tea leaves in the mountains, which is of excellent quality. It is an excellent choice for gifts and self-use. Tea is rich in antioxidants, which is beneficial to health and suitable for daily drinking or as a gift.
spots.addr: Huangmei Specialty Store

spots.name: Buddhist Souvenirs
spots.desc: Wuzu Temple and Sizu Temple sell a variety of Buddhist-related souvenirs, including Buddha beads, incense burners, amulets and scriptures. These items are not only of religious significance, but also of artistic value. They are special souvenirs purchased after the tour. Buddhist souvenirs are not only exquisite handicrafts but also rich in culture and religious significance. They can be used as…

spots.name: Yuanfu Daotian Train Restaurant
spots.desc: Restaurant in a permanently parked renovated train in a nice setting with rice fields and a duck pond.There are also rooms to rent near the rice field and a Youth Hostel in a sleeper car of the train.
spots.addr: Yong'an Dahe

spots.name: Huangmei Tofu Skin
spots.desc: Yellow plum bean skin is a traditional local snack, which is made of rice pulp as the main ingredient and made by a special process. The bean skin is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, and the aroma is fragrant. It is usually very popular as a breakfast or snack on the street of Huangmei. The traditional recipe will be served with some chili sauce or garlic sauce, which is rich in…
spots.addr: Huangmei Food Street

spots.name: Buddhist Vegetarian Meals
spots.desc: The Suzhai Hall around Wuzu Temple offers exquisite vegetarian meals. The dishes are made of natural ingredients, such as fresh vegetables, bean products and various herbs. The fasting here is light in taste and rich in nutrition, which is favored by vegetarian lovers and Buddhists. The taste of the food is unique, and every bite has the peace and depth of Zen Buddhism. While experiencing Zen…
spots.addr: Wuzu Temple Suzai Hall

spots.name: Huangmei Crisp Pastry
spots.desc: Yellow plum shortbread is a traditional dessert of yellow plum. The skin is crispy on the outside and the inside is sweet but not greasy. It is often used as a snack for breakfast or afternoon tea. Its production method is exquisite and uses traditional handicrafts. The shortbread is golden and crispy on the outside, and there can be a variety of flavors such as red beans and sesame seeds inside…
spots.addr: Huangmei Pastry Shop

spots.name: Huangmei Green Tea
spots.desc: Huangmei Green tea is a local traditional green tea, famous for its high quality tea leaves and unique processing technology. The tea has a fresh taste, sweet taste and slight sweetness. Green tea is very popular among tea drinkers because of its rich antioxidant content. Huangmei Green Tea adopts local tea growing methods to ensure the freshness and purity of the tea. The tea is fragrant and…
spots.addr: Teahouse or specialty store

spots.name: Huangmei Country Restaurant
spots.desc: Rice wine is a traditional drink of yellow plum, which is brewed with local high-quality rice and unique fermentation technology. The wine tastes sweet and has a slight sense of drunkenness. It is usually combined with local cuisine to enhance the dining experience. The taste of rice wine is very suitable for tourists who like slightly alcoholic drinks, which can not only satisfy the taste buds…

spots.name: Yellow plum wine
spots.desc: Yellow plum wine is a kind of fruit wine made from local plums, with a sweet plum fragrance and moderate sour taste. The alcohol content is low, which is suitable for tourists who like fruit wine. It is brewed with local fresh plums, which is fresh and flavorful. The wine is soft and suitable for drinking on various occasions.

spots.name: Huangmei Black Tea
spots.desc: Huangmei black tea is loved by tourists and locals for its rich tea aroma and mellow taste. The unique craft of black tea makes it richer in taste, which is suitable for people who like the rich taste of tea. Red tea has excellent quality and rich taste, which is suitable for tea guests with a variety of tastes. It can be matched with Huangmei's characteristic pastries to improve the fun of using…

spots.name: Huangmei Flower Tea
spots.desc: Huangmei tea is made of locally grown flowers of Huangmei, which has the characteristics of floral fragrance. Flower tea is suitable for tourists who like fresh taste and health care. Flower tea is made of natural flowers, which is healthy and delicious, especially suitable for female tourists. The tea soup is fragrant and rich in health ingredients, which is suitable for all kinds of people to…

spots.name: Nüshu Cultural Experience
spots.desc: Learn about Nüshu, a traditional script historically used by women in the Jiangyong area, through local cultural exhibitions and activities.

spots.name: Guoshanxia kiln site
spots.desc: A short walk in the forest from the village takes you to the relic of a Song dynasty kiln site. There is a large pile of pottery pieces piled high. Although the site was only archaeologically discovered in 2014, the pile has been there for 1,000 years. Unfortunately there is no attempt to protect the site and scavengers are free to pick up pieces, so this place may disappear piece by piece with…

spots.name: Yaoli Museum
spots.desc: A museum about the history of the town, with a particular focus on the local ceramics industry. The museum is housed inside the former Cheng Family Ancestral Hall, which dates from the Ming Dynasty.
spots.price: The entry fee is included in the town pass

spots.name: Elephant Trunk Hill
spots.desc: A hill that resembles an elephant, with a huge gap between trunk and body. From here, a boardwalk attached partway up the cliff runs north several kilometres to . This popular trail is most commonly walked from Fairy Pool to Elephant Trunk Hill. A shorter but much less flat hiking trail that is definitely not on the tourist circuit continues south, winding its way under rocks and over hills and…

spots.name: Coffin acrobatic show
spots.desc: Daily on the even hours, there is a show on the front of Xianshui Rock where a coffin is lifted into a hole in the cliff in an artistic interpretation of how this may originally have been done. The show includes acrobatic performances, people rappelling down the cliff, and cormorant fishermen on bamboo rafts.

spots.name: Shangqing Ancient Town
spots.desc: A tourist district of Shangqing town with old-style storefronts along two streets. While this area has been almost entirely reconstructed in concrete, two or three of the buildings are actually old.

spots.name: Zhengyiguan
spots.desc: Rebuilt ancient Taoist temple with a large rock outcrop looming behind it. Aside from the view from its front gate, the main attraction is probably a famous well to the right of the main hall. An attendant will serve you a cup of water, which is considered both potable and good for various illnesses.

spots.name: Shangqing Temple
spots.desc: Former site of a very famous Taoist temple, now an archaeological site with concrete drum and bell towers and gate. The site contains a few old trees and a small memorial mound.

spots.name: Hiking
spots.desc: The park has few trails open for hiking, but there is a boardwalk partway up the cliff from Fairy Pool to Elephant Trunk Hill maybe 4km), and a hiking trail from there to the bus stop for Xianshui Rock (2-3km). The latter hiking trail includes a loop to access of Elephant Trunk Hill and other hills in the park, and winds its way through cracks between the rocks. It is very seldom used.

spots.name: Rafting
spots.desc: The scenery along the river is probably best seen from the raft ride, which starts south of No Mosquito village and ends near the burial cliffs. Rafts are PVC motorboats designed to resemble bamboo. The ride takes under an hour, and is very tame but not completely placid.

spots.name: Dream of Tao
spots.desc: A large outdoor performance called Dream of Tao, inspired by Taoism, lights up the cliffs in the middle of the park nightly on the hour. This show is ticketed separately and includes shuttle bus access. The audience moves along the river with the performance.

spots.name: No Mosquito Village
spots.desc: Most of the houses in this village have been converted into restaurants.

spots.name: Northern Hot Springs Park
spots.local: 北温泉风景区, 北泉风景区, 北温泉公园
spots.desc: For around 1600 years, this area has been a popular bathing spot as well as an important religious site for followers of Buddhism. In the late 2000s, the hot springs were controversially commercialised and brought under the control of the Bolian Resorts Group (柏联酒店集团). Fortunately, some sections of the old park have been preserved, including the historic Hot Springs Temple (温泉寺).
spots.price: ¥10 to visit the park, a minimum of ¥308 to bathe in the hot springs
spots.addr: State Highway 212 (212国道旁边)

spots.name: Congjiang Drum Tower
spots.desc: A traditional Dong drum tower representing the architectural and cultural traditions of the Dong communities in the Congjiang area.

spots.name: Xiaoqikong Ancient Bridge
spots.desc: The key attraction of this scenic spot, Xiaoqikong Ancient Bridge was built in the Daoguang period of the Qing Dynasty. It is said to traverse the Guizhou-Guangxi border, but disappointingly the real border is a few kilometers outside of park bounds. It is a stone arch bridge with seven holes, known for its beautiful natural environment and historical and cultural values, and the jade green…
spots.price: 110RMB/person (Scenic Area Pass), in addition, you need to purchase the scenic area sightseeing bus ticket, which costs…
spots.addr: On the Zhangjiang River in the southwestern part of Libo County, near the entrance to the Xiaoqikong Scenic Area

spots.name: Three major waterfalls
spots.desc: Broken Bridge Falls, Raya Falls, 68-step plunge waterfall. The Broken Bridge Waterfall is famous for its unique bridge-shaped structure and majestic water flow, where visitors can feel the majesty of the flying water. Raya Falls has a drop of about 40 meters, creating a wide curtain of water, and its quiet surroundings make it a popular spot for taking photos. 68 Steps Falls, on the other hand…
spots.price: You don't need to buy a separate ticket after buying a scenic pass
spots.addr: The three waterfalls are linked together and are located together on the main road of the Xiaoqikong Scenic Area

spots.name: water forest
spots.desc: The Water Forest is famous for its unique karst landscape and rich ecosystem. The area is surrounded by several rivers, creating the peculiar landscape of the Water Forest, where trees grow in the water, creating a beautiful scene of “trees in the water, water in the forest”. The rich vegetation and diverse animal life make it an ideal place for ecological photography and bird watching. The…
spots.price: You don't need to buy a separate ticket after buying a scenic pass
spots.addr: East side of the ancient bridge of Xiaoqikong in the scenic area, about 1.5 kilometers away from the ancient bridge

spots.name: Wolong Pool
spots.desc: Named for its mirror-calm waters and beautiful surroundings, Wolong Pool is an ideal spot for sightseeing and relaxation. It contains a manmade waterfall from a weir, from which the pool is dammed from. The clear deep-blue water of the pool often provides a reflection of the surrounding karst mountain scenery, making it a popular destination for photographers and nature lovers. The water is so…
spots.price: You don't need to buy a separate ticket after buying a scenic pass
spots.addr: Located in the downstream of the Water Forest, about 2 kilometers from the Xiaoqikong Ancient Bridge

spots.name: Tianzhong Cave
spots.desc: The cave is famous for its unique stalactite landscape and abundant underground rivers. The cave is wide, with stalactites and stalagmites of various shapes and sizes creating a mysterious and beautiful underground world, making it a popular destination for photography and adventure enthusiasts.
spots.addr: Located in Daqikong Scenic Area, about 3 kilometers from Daqikong Bridge

spots.name: Lake Biyori in Turquoise Hill, Xinjiang
spots.desc: Famous for its clear turquoise lake, the lake complements the surrounding karst landscape and forests, creating a beautiful natural landscape. Visitors can walk around the turquoise lake, take photos and enjoy the unique natural scenery. Viewing platforms are also usually located around the lake for visitors to rest and watch the scenery.
spots.price: You don't need to buy a separate ticket after buying a scenic pass
spots.addr: Located in the area of Daqikong Scenic Area near Daqikong Bridge and Tiansheng Bridge

spots.name: natural bridge
spots.desc: Tiansheng Bridge is a naturally formed stone bridge, famous for its unique karst landscape and spectacular natural scenery. Visitors can easily access Tiansheng Bridge through the trail in the scenic area and enjoy the surrounding landscape on the way. Tiansheng Bridge is a popular excursion point in the Daqikong Scenic Area due to its unique shape and the beautiful scenery around it.
spots.price: You don't need to buy a separate ticket after buying a scenic pass
spots.addr: Southeast of Dachikong Bridge, about 2 kilometers from Dachikong Bridge

spots.name: canyon trail
spots.desc: is a trail that follows the Shui Chun River and is designed to give visitors a better view of the canyon's natural beauty and water flow. The trail starts from the Shuichun River Bridge and winds down the river, passing through several viewpoints and rest areas where visitors can appreciate the cliffs, the clear water of the river and the surrounding virgin forest.
spots.addr: Located in a scenic area, the entrance to the Gorge Trail is usually connected to the Shui Chun River Bridge

spots.name: Yuanyang Lake
spots.desc: Yuanyang Lake in Libo is a popular tourist attraction that offers a unique boating experience. Visitors can rent transparent rowing boats on the lake and row into the Wizard of Oz by their own manual rowing, with a transparent bottom that allows them to clearly see the fish and water plants underwater, and bring along a water gun for a water fight. This adds to the fun and wonder of boating.…

spots.name: Mawlam Forest National Park
spots.desc: The park is known for its karst peaks and funnel landscapes, where visitors can participate in caving adventures. The caving routes here are divided into two classic routes: the main caving route and the classic route through the karst primitive funnel forest, which provide a rich experience of nature exploration. While exploring the caves, visitors will have the opportunity to see stalactites of…

spots.name: Xiaoqikong
spots.desc: Tree Adventure：the challenge of courage and wisdom. On a sunny weekend, with the curiosity and expectation of the unknown tree world, we stepped into the fantasy world of "Tree Adventure" in Xiaoqikong Scenic Spot. Each step of the program is full of challenges and fun. There are obstacles of various shapes and difficulties, such as climbing nets, swing bridges, high-altitude zip lines, tree…

spots.name: Mengliu Buyei Style Town, East Gate of Libo Xiaoqikong (small seven holes)
spots.desc: The night here is waiting to be savored by every traveler. The night market is bustling with lights and starlight intertwined into a dream. Buyei flavor snacks are fragrant, the freshness of roasted fish, the sweetness of patties, the mellow of rice wine, each bite is the ultimate temptation to the taste buds. Handicrafts are in abundance.

spots.name: Zhangjiang Tribe
spots.desc: This is a shopping street with a concentration of ethnic minority specialty stores. Nearby are many stores selling specialty goods of the Buyi, Shui, Miao and Yao ethnic groups, which are suitable for tourists to shop for souvenirs.

spots.name: Libo County Yuping Town Yi Xiang Ethnic Craft Shop
spots.desc: Specializing in all kinds of ethnic minority ornaments, such as handicrafts of the Shui ethnic group, the Buyi ethnic group and the Miao ethnic group.

spots.name: Deng Ji Feng Pig Shop
spots.desc: Specializes in selling local Li Bo preserved meat products, the quality of which has been praised.

spots.name: Aqua Horse Tail Embroidery Shopping Center
spots.desc: Specializes in aqua embroidery handicrafts with strong ethnic characteristics.

spots.name: 66 Three Sour Shop
spots.desc: Outsiders feel at ease rushing shrimp sour, very tasty. Very fragrant and appetizing kind of sour and spicy flavor.
spots.price: 70RMB shrimp and sour small pot +4RMB rice; rice is 2 yuan/person, free to renew
spots.addr: No.83, Lida Road

spots.name: Jinfeng Hot and Sour Soup
spots.desc: The two meat and one veggie in the set menu are optional in the store!
spots.addr: No. 60, Tangdi Road

spots.name: Casserole Chuang Bean and Rice Hot Pot
spots.desc: A boon for those who love light Cantonese! The meatballs that came with the hotpot were light and flavorful, and the kidney beans were delicious after they were cooked.
spots.addr: No. 77, Tangdi Road

spots.name: Yao Kitchen
spots.desc: A well-known large restaurant catering to tourists that has earned many awards for their high-quality cooking. It serves many Guizhou dishes, including some exotic dishes from the Yao ethnic minority. Their braised pork is especially delicious. The surroundings are bright and clean and the portions are large. They offer Maotai and other alcoholic beverages too.
spots.addr: outside the xiaoqikong attraction old town

spots.name: Laoshanhe Canyon Scenic Area
spots.desc: A scenic area known for its canyon landscape and natural scenery.

spots.name: Tonghe Zhuangyuanfu Scenic Area
spots.desc: A cultural and historical attraction associated with Xia Tonghe.
spots.addr: Gaojian Village, Xianchang Town

spots.name: Baiyang Village
spots.desc: A village known for its local ethnic culture and rural scenery.

spots.name: 24 Zigzags
spots.desc: The 24 Zigzags is a historic mountain road with 24 sharp bends. It was built in the 1930s and became an important route for transportation during the Second World War. The road is one of Qinglong's best-known historical landmarks.

spots.name: Panjiang Bridge Scenic Area
spots.desc: The Panjiang Bridge area lies around the Beipan River and contains historical sites associated with the ancient routes through southwestern Guizhou. The area includes cultural remains connected with the Tea Horse Road.
spots.addr: Guangzhao Town

spots.name: Hama Pass Scenic Area
spots.desc: Hama Pass is a historic area associated with the old routes through Qinglong. The scenic area combines historical remains with mountain scenery.

spots.name: Feishuiyan Scenic Area
spots.desc: Feishuiyan is a scenic area known for waterfalls, mountain scenery and rural landscapes.

spots.name: Miao Jiang Sister Square
spots.desc: It is a leisure place, and many activities are held here during the festival. The square decoration is very national style.

spots.name: Red Yang ten thousand mu grassland
spots.desc: Hongyang ten thousand Mu grassland is an important scenic spot in Nangong Forest Park, located in the south of Taigong Town, Taijiang County, the north foot of Leigong Mountain, the jurisdiction of Hongzhai Village, 16 km from the county seat. Ten thousand mu of grassland stretching undulating, known as the "southern Tianshan" laudatory name. At the end of Ming Dynasty, the king of Guangxi, Wu…

spots.name: Miao Embroidery Museum
spots.desc: The museum houses collections of Miao embroidery, traditional clothing, and related cultural artifacts. It includes two main exhibition halls and four themed galleries, focusing on Miao sub-group dress traditions and embroidery techniques.
spots.addr: No. 5 Wenchang East Road

spots.name: Fanpai Miao Village
spots.desc: A Miao village situated on a high slope, consisting of over 440 households of indigenous Miao residents. Traditional wooden stilt houses dominate the architecture. A small stream runs through the village, which also features a bullfighting ground, ancestral ritual sites such as Drum Mountain, Yi Lang, and the Drum Cave. The village hosts the Miao ancestral festival, Drum Cang Festival, once every…
spots.addr: Fanzhao Town

spots.name: Shidong Old Town
spots.desc: A historic town in Taijiang known for its Miao cultural traditions and traditional riverside settlement.

spots.name: Village BA
spots.desc: A village basketball tournament originating in Taipan Village. The tournament is traditionally associated with the local Chixin Festival and has become known nationwide as “Village BA”. Games combine rural basketball with local Miao cultural activities and attract large numbers of spectators.

spots.name: Taijiang Trade City
spots.desc: There are many good restaurants and food stalls in this area, as well as wet markets and shops selling clothes.

spots.name: Miaozhuang Fresh Goose
spots.desc: This restaurant specializes in Miao cuisine. Signature dishes include drunken goose hotpot and Guizhou fermented chili stewed fish, both of which are quite spicy. Non-spicy options can be requested with the staff.
spots.addr: Shop 101, Phase 1, Miaojiawan

spots.name: Miao-Tong Village Stone Pot Fish
spots.desc: The restaurant features stone pot hotpot with its signature Guizhou red sour soup base and fresh fish. The dish is sour and spicy, offering a flavorful and appetizing experience.
spots.addr: 10 m south of Fuhai Mingchu, Alley 3

spots.name: Xiangwei Qianyuan
spots.desc: Popular with locals, the restaurant serves stir-fried dishes and hotpot with a generally spicy flavor. Signature dishes include steamed fish with chopped chili and stir-fried bamboo shoots with cured meat.
spots.addr: 2nd floor, Jindan A Jiao Supermarket

spots.name: Weining Mosque
spots.desc: A mosque serving the Hui Muslim community in Weining, reflecting the county's multi-ethnic cultural heritage.

spots.name: Wuyang River Boat Cruise
spots.desc: Take a boat cruise along the Wuyang River and enjoy the surrounding gorges, peaks and waterfalls. The cruise covers a scenic stretch of about 35 km outside and around Zhenyuan.

spots.name: Ancient city red sour soup
spots.desc: The most delicious sour soup fish in the town is "Ancient City Red Sour Soup", one of the old shops with a long history. Old town far people have always had the north fall xiang south ancient city, north fall Xiang refers to the Hebei bank of the "fall Xiang sour soup house" South ancient city is the ancient city red sour soup, when the residents of both sides of the two places to eat out, came…

spots.name: Find fine cafes
spots.desc: The coffee shop features quilts with the word "Zhenyuan" printed on them. Take a photo and punch in at an emergency.

spots.name: Ruoergai Grassland Scenic Area
spots.desc: Ruoergai Grassland Scenic Area is located on the eastern edge of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, at an elevation of 3,300–3,600 meters, and is also known as the Songpan Plateau. It is a highland basin surrounded by mountains, including the Min Mountains, Qionglai Mountains, Guoluo Mountains, Animaqing Mountains, and the Western Qinling Mountains.
spots.addr: Sichuan Province, Aba Tibetan and Qiang Autonomous Prefecture, Ruoergai County, next to G213

spots.name: Sisters Restaurant
spots.desc: Serves excellent traditional Sichuan food, and allows non-chinese speakers to point at the ingredients on display out the front.
spots.addr: Rilong

spots.name: Cow Shed
spots.desc: The most unique restaurant in the national park serving traditional Tibetan food, including freshly-baked bread with yak butter, yak and potato stew, and yak butter tea.
spots.addr: Shuangqiao Valley

spots.name: Icedrock Bar
spots.desc: Has the only espresso coffee machine in Siguniangshan, along with the expertise to use it. The owners hand-roast their own coffee beans, bake their own bread and have valuable advice and interesting stories about the area. There is also a computer with internet and Wi-Fi, drum kit, guitars and stereo with a broad music selection for visitors wanting to jam.

spots.desc: A large park that includes hotels, bars, restaurants and shopping. Go around 8:30PM and enjoy the vendors, music, and dancing.
spots.addr: 565 Bailuzhou Street, Siming District (思明区白鹭洲路565号)

spots.name: Mountains to Sea Trail
spots.desc: Elevated trail for walking with beautiful sights of the city. With a total length of 23 km, it starts at Huweishan Park north of Yundang Wai Lake and ends at Guaynishan Beach.

spots.name: Xiamen Shimao Strait Tower
spots.desc: Xiamen Shimao Strait Tower is an urban complex integrating hotels, office buildings, SOHO offices, sightseeing, shopping, leisure, entertainment and catering. Xiamen Shimao Strait Tower covers an area of about 30,000 square meters, the above-ground construction area of 270,000 square meters, the total construction area of about 330,000 square meters; Among them, Tower A has 64 floors on the…
spots.addr: No. 180-188 Yanwu West Road, Siming District

spots.name: Xiamen-Above-the-Clouds Observation Deck
spots.desc: Probably the best place to see Xiamen's skyline. The observation deck sits atop Building B of the 300-metre high Shimao Cross-Strait Plaza twin-tower complex.
spots.hours: 09:00-21:00 (main observation deck on 55th floor), 09:00-20:30 (Love Balcony and Sea & Sky Walk on 58th floor)
spots.price: ¥160 (adults aged under 60), ¥80 (persons over 60), ¥80 (children between 1.1 and 1.49 metres in height). Free…
spots.addr: Tower B, Shimao Cross-Strait Plaza

spots.name: Hulishan Fortress
spots.desc: Xiamen has always been vulnerable to attack from the sea and various fortifications have been built over the centuries. The Ming built a fort to defend against Japanese pirates in 1387. The remains of Koxinga's fortifications from the late 1600s are now a tourist attraction on Gulangyu. Cold War era tourist attractions on Taiwan-controlled Kinmen off the coast include guns built for shelling…
spots.addr: 2 Zengcuo'an Road, Siming District (思明区曾厝埯路2号)

spots.name: Music Square
spots.desc: A park-like area along the boardwalk with sculptures of/about many famous composers and musicians, both Western and Chinese. Look for the public toilets with the musical notes on the wall, or a large red sculpture that looks somewhat like an open fan.
spots.addr: 318 Huandao Road South, Siming District (思明区环岛南路318号)

spots.name: 10,000-Rock Botanical Garden
spots.desc: Over 2 km² (500 acres) of gardens, some dedicated to particular plants such as bamboo, palms or coniferous trees, with a lake, bridges, several temples, a network of footpaths, a bonsai exhibit, and an exhibit hall with over a thousand types of flowers.
spots.addr: Siming District (思明区)

spots.name: Xiamen Culture and Art Centre
spots.local: 厦门文化艺术中心, Xiamen Wenhua Yishu Zhongxin
spots.desc: Both a museum and a performance venue. The Xiamen Library is here too.
spots.addr: 95 Tiyu Road, Siming District (思明区体育路95号)

spots.name: Xiamen Culture House
spots.desc: Incorporates the Xiamen Art Museum (美术馆). Cultural performances, including music, dance and drama shows are also held in this building.
spots.hours: 09:00-17:00, closed on Mondays (art museum opening hours only)
spots.price: Admission to the art museum is free. Ticket prices for the performances may vary
spots.addr: Xiamen Culture and Art Centre

spots.name: Xiamen Olympic Museum
spots.desc: A museum about the Olympic Games. Established with the approval of the International Olympic Committee and the China Olympic Committee.
spots.addr: 2017 Lüling Road, Siming District (思明区吕岭路2017号)

spots.name: Wuyuan Bay Wetland Park
spots.desc: Xiamen's largest wetland park, covering an area of about 85 hectares or about half the size of Gulangyu Island.
spots.addr: Huli District (湖里区)

spots.name: Zhongshan Park
spots.desc: A large park named for Dr. Sun Yat Sen (Sun Zhong Shan in Mandarin), leader of the 1911 revolution that overthrew the Qing and established the Republic of China. It has a statue of him, several gardens, a small zoo, a flower exhibit hall, a lake with rental paddle boats, dance shows, and bumper cars.
spots.addr: Siming District (思明区)

spots.name: Kite surfing
spots.desc: Training with English speaking IKO-certified instructors, equipment for sale and storage, compressor and shower facilities.
spots.addr: Huandau Road, near Asia Golden Bay Hotel

spots.name: Xiamen Mandarin Fun School
spots.desc: A registered private school specializing in teaching Chinese to foreigners, with lessons for students at different levels.
spots.addr: Room 2304, Wei Ye Na Building, Century Bay, North Hubin Road, Siming District (思明区湖滨北路世纪海湾维也纳楼2304室)

spots.name: Xiamen Marathon
spots.desc: An international marathon race run every year in Xiamen on the first Saturday in January. This is a large event; it had over 50,000 runners in 2013. Some of the world's top long distance runners compete and their times are impressive; in 2014 the men's winner was Mariko Kiplagat at 2:08:06 and women's Mare Dibaba 2:21:36. The course is mostly along the Huándǎo Lù ring road with the finish line…

spots.name: Island Meets Time
spots.desc: A theme park near Xiamen's International Cruise Terminal. The park features performance zones and themed street districts showcasing cultural heritage elements of Southern Fujian. There are live performances including evening light shows. Visitors can watch scheduled stage productions, interact with costumed characters, try traditional folk games such as a traditional Mid Autumn dice game (博饼)…
spots.price: From ¥93 (adult); ¥63 (senior, 60+ or child 6-13yrs); tickets available via Trip.com and other travel platforms.…
spots.addr: 东港北路 15、17-19号 Donggang North Road 15, 17-19

spots.name: SM Laiya
spots.desc: Two large shopping malls that are part of the Filipino SM chain; the company founder was born in Xiamen.

spots.name: Wanda Plaza
spots.desc: Newer (2011) mall with Uniqlo, a large Japanese clothing chain.

spots.name: Metro
spots.desc: A German chain well established in China, catering mainly to restaurants and hotels. For Western groceries it is often better than Walmart or Tesco, but some items are sold only in bulk quantities.

spots.name: Huangdu Imperial Banquet – Immersive Palace Feast
spots.desc: Huangdu Imperial Banquet is an immersive cultural dining experience set in an elaborately decorated palace-style venue. Diners are seated for a multi-course meal of imperial-style dishes. There is live classical dance performances throughout the meal, recreating the feel of attending a royal court banquet of the past. Optional Hanfu costume rental and make-up services allow guests to dressup.
spots.price: From around ¥300+/person depending on day of week, lunch or dinner, or seating arrangement
spots.addr: No. 188, Qianpu Road, Lianqian Subdistrict, Siming District, Xiamen

spots.name: Coyote Cafe & Cantina
spots.desc: Tex-Mex food made with fresh ingredients. Excellent cheesecake.
spots.addr: 58-2 Ganglong Huayuan

spots.name: Marco Polo Hotel
spots.desc: Does a good Sunday international buffet for ¥120 plus service.

spots.name: Mama Mia
spots.desc: Another Italian place, which for some reason chose a location right next door to an existing one

spots.name: Burger Bar
spots.desc: Good quality burgers made with Australian Wagyu beef. A build your own menu with different size patties, including a cheese stuffed option. Not many seats inside but service is quick.
spots.addr: Guanren Lu

spots.name: Chongching
spots.desc: Excellent Sichuan food, moderate prices, plain decor. Staff do not speak English, but there is English on the menu.

spots.name: The Londoner
spots.desc: British-themed pub with a range of draft beers, home of the Xiamen Typhoons Rugby Union Football Club.
spots.addr: 5-8 Guanren Lu

spots.name: Tuscany Cafe
spots.local: 厦门市湖滨北路27号海湾新城102之二
spots.desc: Mainly European dishes with a few Mexican dishes. The owner/chef is a former chef of the Four Seaons Hotel, Hong Kong. The prices are reasonable, with most items under ¥50 with free bruschetta. They also have a special lunch menu which is quite cheap. The staff are able to speak English.
spots.addr: Shop 102-2

spots.name: Xiamen Sports Cafe
spots.desc: Nice sports bar popular with some locals but mainly expats. The bar has a reasonably priced food menu, with the pizza being of high quality. Daily happy hour with cheap pints of Tiger. Especially good if it is your first time to Xiamen and you are looking for some advice on things to do
spots.addr: Shop 103

spots.name: Tastes of South-East Asia
spots.local: 厦门滨北中行肯德基后面
spots.desc: Bright, clean and colourful, TOSEA serves a selection of fresh homemade food from Vietnam, Thailand, Laos, Malaysia and Indonesia. All at very reasonable prices. English/Chinese menus.
spots.addr: Shop 106

spots.name: Greg's Restaurant
spots.desc: Greg's is a little piece of France in China. They serve traditional French dishes, from bouillabaisse to the lamb shank, including Gillardeau oysters from Arcachon. The chef adapts his recipes for each customer, personalising the sauce and way of cooking. He also changes the menu seasonally, featuring fresh seasonal products.
spots.addr: 1C N 10 Hubin Bei Road

spots.name: JJ Bar and Grill
spots.desc: A neon sign above the entrance says "Welcome to Texas" and that is the theme. For an American looking for a taste of home, this is good choice – steaks, barbecue, fajitas, and a lot of classic US-style appetizers. If you're really sporty, there is even a mechanical bull. Band at night plays mostly western classics. Frequent dinner stop for expats. Just around the corner are the popular nightclubs.
spots.addr: Haiwan Park

spots.name: Me & You 2
spots.desc: Owner is a cheerful Scandinavian; decor includes some Viking-themed items. Good menu with both Asian and Western options including a large range of pizzas from ¥45-65 (they also deliver). They have Becks, Tiger and Stella on tap. Happy hour until 20:00 (Becks and Tiger are half price). Live music sometimes (in English).
spots.addr: No.1 Hou Hai Ting, Haiwan Park

spots.name: Prague Cafe
spots.desc: A Czech restaurant with hamburgers, homemade sandwiches, Czech beer, and organic Xiamen-made bread. Sometimes there is goulash as well. Prices are good (about ¥45 for a very large hamburger with fries). Owner/manager is Czech and speaks English. Across from Xiada.

spots.name: Lujiang Harbourview Hotel
spots.desc: Has a nice sixth floor al fresco restaurant looking out at Gulangyu Island. The restaurant has an English menu and serves mainly Fujian specialities. Highlight was some excellent wasabi marinated cucumber slices.
spots.addr: Lujiang Road & Zhongshan Rd

spots.name: Little Chili
spots.desc: Offers excellent Chinese food, mainly spicy Sichuan food, at an affordable price. There is English on the menu, but staff do not speak English.
spots.addr: Xiahe Commercial Building (厦禾商厦), No.323, Xiahe Rd

spots.name: 1801 Bar
spots.desc: A disco with mainly R&B and hip-hop music. Open well into the small hours, sometimes past dawn.
spots.addr: 1st floor of the United Hotel, Hubin Bei Lu (Lakeside South Road)

spots.name: The Key
spots.desc: Live music from a Filipino cover band with a broad repertoire — jazz and latin as well as rock and hip hop.
spots.addr: 109 Hubin Xilu (Lakeside West Street)

spots.name: Temple Cafe
spots.desc: Coffee, beer and cocktails in a unique location, in the courtyard of a functioning Buddhist temple. Western menu, moderate prices.
spots.addr: No. 61 Zengcuo An, Siming District

spots.name: Tastylife
spots.desc: The most comprehensive collection of western supermarket items including a good selection of international beers.
spots.addr: 10-105 Jianye Rd

spots.name: Nanxun Ancient Town Scenic Area
spots.desc: Nanxun Ancient Town is one of the six great ancient towns in Jiangnan, renowned as the "Land of Culture" and the "Hometown of Poetry and Books". The scenic area fully preserves the residences, gardens, streets, and water systems from the Ming and Qing dynasties, with major attractions including Xiaolianzhuang, Jiaye Tang Library, Zhang Shiming's old residence, and Liu Family Ladder. You can take…
spots.hours: The ancient town area is open 24 hours, with paid attractions open from 08:00 to 17:00 in summer and from 08:00 to…

spots.name: Nanxun Night Tour and Boat Ride
spots.desc: Nanxun at night, illuminated by lights, possesses a unique charm, with the outlines of riverside buildings clearly visible and their reflections picturesque. You can take a hand rowed boat or an electric boat to cruise under the ancient bridges, experiencing a tranquility and poetic beauty different from the daytime. Daytime boat tickets are approximately ¥80 per boat (shared boats are possible)…

spots.name: Universal Theater

spots.name: Culture Yard
spots.desc: Explore Chinese culture through various workshops. Culture Yard is a foreign-run cultural centre in the heart of Beijing that offers language courses as well as cultural workshops, which focus on introducing Chinese culture to the international community, and foreign culture to the local community. Culture Yard hosts film, mahjong, tea, calligraphy, discussion seminars, art classes, Mandarin and…
spots.addr: 10 Shique Hutong (石雀胡同10号)

spots.name: Huajiayiyuan
spots.desc: One of the largest tourist traps. Tasteless food in lovely plates though. Housed in a series of interconnected courtyards. Not as much for people who like Chinese food; rather those who like taking pictures of food. Try places where you see locals waiting on benches to be seated instead.
spots.addr: Dongzhimennei Street 235 (东直门内大街235号; Dōngzhíménnèi Dàjiē)

spots.name: Yuxiang Renjia
spots.desc: Delicious Sichuan food. If you want to try Sichuan but are a little afraid of the spiciness, this place is a good choice: It's still spicy, but not as mouth-numbing as some other places. Reasonable prices, and a faux rural-village decor. There are a dozen locations around town.

spots.addr: 79 Hepingli Xijie (和平里西街79号; Hépínglǐxījiē)

spots.desc: Capital Spirits claims to be the world’s first bar dedicated to baijiu and craft liquor. The serve baijiu, craft Chinese beers, lesser-known fine spirits from around the world, and specialty baijiu cocktails.
spots.addr: 23 Xinsi Huntong 辛寺胡同23号

spots.name: Beijing New Culture Movement Memorial

spots.desc: The New Culture Movement was an intellectual and literally movement that began in the mid-1910s following the establishment of the first Chinese republic. Participants in the movement, which included Mao Zedong and other future leaders of the Communist Party, sought to replace traditional Chinese culture with a new culture based on Western and international standards. In 1919, the New Culture…
spots.hours: 09:00-16:00, no entry after 15:30, closed on Mondays
spots.addr: 29 Wusi Street (五四大街29号)

spots.desc: Both Chinese and foreign plays and both classical and experimental.
spots.addr: 45A Mao'er Hutong, Di'anmenwai Street (地安门外大街猫儿胡同45号; Dìānménwàidàjiēmāoérhútòng)

spots.desc: Bicycle shop for hire, purchases and upgrades owned by a champion bike acrobat.
spots.addr: Fangjia Hutong 46, E105A 北京市东城区方家胡同46号，E105A

spots.name: Nanluoguxiang
spots.local: 南锣鼓巷; Nánluógǔxiàng; some partly translated signs say 'South Luogu Alley'
spots.desc: This restored hutong, just east of Drum Tower and Houhai, is lined with boutiques and small shops. Not the place for bargains, but this is where to come for unique and distinct gifts including T-shirts, pottery, jewellery, etc.

spots.name: NagQu
spots.desc: A small shop selling handcrafted bags, scarfs and pottery made with natural materials.
spots.addr: No.67 Wudaoying Hutong 东城区五道营胡同67号

spots.name: Yilongzhai
spots.desc: A simple Hui eatery that is head and shoulders above similar Islamic restaurants in the area in terms of tastiness, serving favorite Islamic dishes like noodles in beef soup (lamian, 拉面), lamb kebabs (chuanr, 串儿), and delectable naan (nang, 馕).
spots.addr: 地安门外大街帽儿胡同甲43号

spots.addr: 1 Fangzhuanchang Hutong, Dongcheng, Beijing, China

spots.name: Mr Shi's Dumplings
